0GF725HRpIVwMd2f.name: 机械化先进型战争机器 Robotic Advanced War Machine
0GF725HRpIVwMd2f.publicNotes:
强悍而凶猛的战争机器代号为“thermatrod”，其设计旨在最大限度地制造战场上的杀戮与破坏。相比之下，“vracinea”则是协约世界已观测到的身份不明的生物科技战争机器中最弱小的种类之一。它流线形的身躯隐蔽而敏捷，迅速穿梭于敌方防线内外，将数据传给驾驶者，然后离去。若被发现，vracinea就会自毁，以销毁携带的数据记录。

这场入侵始于阿巴隆的新械族接连发现的探测器。传感器炽亮、长着分节触须的奇异机器不知从何处现身，看似毫无规律地撕裂基础设施，并在整个协约世界宙域搜集情报。恐慌迅速蔓延，但这些机器总会消失得无影无踪，或在被捕获时爆炸，因此始终无法证实目击报告或辨明其身份。流言渐起，称这些机器采用了一种前所未见的生物科技。不久，理事军正式介入，将这些事件封锁在最高机密权限的精金壁垒之后。

后断层纪元325年阳愈月（Sarenith），在数十次军事行动均未能与行踪飘忽的探测器交战之后，一支从伊达里号派出的战斗机联队终于走运，在其中一台机器自毁前将其瘫痪。协约世界的顶尖科学家设法让这台生物科技载具吐露了部分秘密，它由此成为了“本土制造”的遥控战争机器的原型，如今这类机器正接受战斗应用测试。这些仿制品并非活物，而是使用机器人制造模板建造的，因为原始生物科技设计的核心过于复杂，协约科技尚无法对其进行逆向工程。

遥控战争机器是可以从极远距离控制的替身。原始的生物科技战争机器通过心灵链接或未知无线电频率连接驾驶者的心智。机械式遥控战争机器则通过数据链路连接计算机，供驾驶者使用键盘、虚拟现实设备，甚至电子游戏手柄来控制自己的替身。

items.name: 星际通讯
items.expectedDescription: A remote war machine maintains a constant data link with its pilot, using its pilot's languages and skill modifiers for any unlisted skill. In addition, the pilot can speak through the data link using the remote war machine as a mouthpiece.
items.description: 这台遥控战争机器会与其驾驶员保持持续的数据连接，并使用驾驶员的语言及技能调整值来处理任何未列出的技能。此外，驾驶员还能通过数据链接以这台遥控战争机器作为“传声筒”进行发声。

items.name: 弹道防御矩阵
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature attempts a ranged Strike against the remote war machine

Requirements The war machine is currently outside the creature's reach

Effect The remote war machine makes a ranged Strike against the triggering creature. If the result of this Strike is equal to or greater than the result of the triggering Strike, the triggering Strike is treated as though it were a critical miss.
items.description:
触发 一个生物尝试对遥控战争机器进行远程打击

需求 战争机器当前位于该生物的触及范围之外

效果 遥控战争机器对触发生物进行一次远程打击。若此次打击的结果大于或等于触发打击的结果，则将触发打击视为攻击大失败。

items.name: 攻击模式·阿尔法
items.expectedDescription: The remote war machine Steps or Strides, then makes two Strikes against the same target. Both Strikes count toward its multiple attack penalty, but its multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after it makes both Strikes.
items.description: 遥控战争机器快步或行走，然后对同一目标进行两次打击。这两次打击都计入其多重攻击减值，但在完成两次打击之前，多重攻击减值不会增加。

items.name: 超音速爆发
items.expectedDescription: The war machine Steps or Strides twice. The war machine gains a +10-foot circumstance bonus to its Speed during these moves.
items.description: 战争机器快步或行走两次。在这些移动期间，战争机器的速度获得+10尺环境加值。

items.expectedName: Interplanar Teleport (at will; self only; to and from Akashic Record and the Universe only)
items.name: 跨界传送（随意；仅自身；只能往返于阿卡西记录与物质宇宙）
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements You have a planar key for the destination plane, used as a locus

You and your allies traverse the barriers between planes of existence. The targets move to another plane, such as the Plane of Fire, the Netherworld, or the Outer Rifts. You must know the destination plane exists and use a magic planar key created from material from that plane as a locus for the spell. While the planar keys for most prominent planes are uncommon, just like the spell interplanar teleport, more obscure planes and demiplanes often have rare or possibly even unique planar keys.

The spell is highly imprecise, and you appear 1d20×25 miles from the last place one of the targets (of your choice) was located the last time that target traveled to the plane. If it's the first time traveling to a particular plane for all targets, you appear at a random location on the plane. Interplanar teleport doesn't provide a means of return travel, though casting interplanar teleport again allows you to return to your previous plane unless there are extenuating circumstances.
items.description:
需求 你持有目的地位面的位面密钥，用作施法载体

你和你的盟友跨越位面之间的屏障进行旅行。目标移动至其他位面，比如火元素位面、幽界、或者外层裂隙。你必须知晓目标位面的存在，而且需要使用由该位面的物质制作的魔法位面密钥作为本法术的施法载体。就如同跨界传送这个法术本身一样，大多数著名位面的位面密钥具有罕见稀有度，而鲜为人知的位面及半位面通常具有稀有、甚至有可能具有独特稀有度的位面密钥。

该法术极其不精准，你会出现在目标之一（由你选择）上一次造访该位面时的位置周边，误差为1d20×25里。若所有目标都是初次造访某个特定位面，你们就会出现在该位面的随机位置。跨界传送不会提供返回的手段，不过除非发生了什么另外情况，否则再次施放跨界传送能让你返回自身之前身处的位面。

items.name: 鹰眼术
items.expectedDescription: You create an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} floating eye at a location within range (even if it's outside your line of sight or line of effect). The eye can't move, but you can see in all directions from that point as if using your normal visual senses.
items.description: 你在射程内创造出一个@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}的悬浮眼睛（它甚至可以在你的视觉线或者效果线之外）。这只眼睛不能移动，但是你可以从该处看到所有方向，如同使用你通常的视觉感官。

items.name: 困惑术
items.expectedDescription:
You befuddle your target with strange impulses, causing it to act randomly. The effects are determined by the target's Will save. You can Dismiss the spell.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target babbles incoherently and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 minute. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns to end the confusion.

Critical Failure The target is Confused for 1 minute, with no save to end early.

Heightened (8th) You can target up to 10 creatures.
items.description:
你以奇异的冲动扰乱目标心智，使其随机行动。法术效果由目标的意志豁免决定。你可以解消该法术。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标胡言乱语，并且获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 1}。

失败 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{困惑}1分钟。在其每个回合结束，它能尝试一次新豁免来结束困惑术。

大失败 目标困惑1分钟，并且没有提前结束的豁免。

升阶（8环阶） 你能以至多10个生物为目标。

items.name: 锐耳术
items.expectedDescription: You create an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} floating ear at a location within range (even if it's outside your line of sight or line of effect). It can't move, but you can hear through the ear as if using your normal auditory senses.
items.description: 你在射程内创造出一个@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}的悬浮耳朵（它甚至可以在你的视觉线或者效果线之外）。它不能移动，但是你可以通过该耳朵听到声音，如同你通常的听觉感官。

items.name: 加速术
items.expectedDescription:
Magic empowers the target to act faster. It gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition and can use the extra action each round only for Strike and Stride actions.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 6 creatures.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ElkXovNrHB0Doi6O]{Spell Effect: Haste}
items.description:
魔法强化了目标，令其行动迅速。它获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{迅捷}状态，并且每轮只能将额外动作用于打击或行走。

升阶（7环阶） 你能以至多6个生物为目标。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ElkXovNrHB0Doi6O]{法术效果：加速术}

items.name: 极化认知
items.expectedDescription: You rapidly catalog and collate information relevant to your current situation. You can instantly use up to 6 Recall Knowledge actions as part of Casting this Spell. For these actions, you can't use any special abilities, reactions, or free actions that trigger when you Recall Knowledge.
items.description: 你高速分类整理与你当前情况相关的信息。作为施放此法术的一部分，你可以立即使用至多6个回忆知识动作。对于这些动作，你不能使用任何在你回忆知识时触发的特殊能力，反应动作，或者自由动作。

items.name: 类人形态
items.expectedDescription:
You transform your appearance to that of a Small or Medium humanoid, such as a dwarf, elf, goblin, halfling, human, or orc. You gain the humanoid trait in addition to your other traits while in this form, as well as any trait related to the creature's kind (such as goblin or human). If this transformation reduces your size, it reduces your reach accordingly (typically to 5 feet). This transformation doesn't change your statistics in any way, and you don't gain any special abilities of the humanoid form you assume. You can still wear and use your gear, which changes size (if necessary) to match your new form. If items leave your person, they return to their usual size.

Humanoid form grants you a +4 status bonus to Deception checks to pass as a generic member of the chosen ancestry, and you add your level even if you're untrained, but you can't make yourself look like a specific person. If you want to Impersonate an individual, you still need to create a disguise, though the GM won't factor in the difference in ancestry when determining the DC of your Deception check. You can Dismiss this spell.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.B9Hzt4ki8eqlXxyh]{Spell Effect: Humanoid Form}

Heightened (3rd) You gain darkvision or low-light vision if the form you assume has that ability.

Heightened (5th) You can take on the appearance of a Large humanoid. If this increases your size, you gain the effects of the enlarge spell.
items.description:
你将自身变成某种中型或者小型类人生物的外观，例如矮人、精灵、地精、半身人、人类或者兽人。处于此形态时，你保留原有的其他特征，并获得类人特征，以及其他与该生物类型相关的特征（例如地精或者人类）。如果该变形减少了你的体型，它也会相应缩短你的触及（通常减少到5尺）。该变形不会改变你的任何数据，并且你不会获得你变形为的类人形态的任何特殊能力。你仍然可以穿戴和使用你的装备，它会改变大小来适应你的新形态（仅如果需要）。如果物品离开你，它会回到本来的大小。

类人形态 赋予你在伪装成所选族裔普通成员的欺骗检定上+4状态加值，并且你会加上你的等级，即使你未受训，但是你不能让你看起来像某个特定的人。如果你想要假扮某个特定人物，你仍然需要制造伪装，但GM不会将族裔不同计入你的欺骗检定DC中。你可以解消该法术。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.B9Hzt4ki8eqlXxyh]{法术效果：类人形态}

升阶（3环阶） 如果你变作的形态有，则你获得黑暗视觉或者昏暗视觉。

升阶（5环阶） 你可以变为大型类人生物的外形。如果这使你的体型增大，你获得变巨术的效果。

items.name: 愚者之思
items.expectedDescription:
You dull the target's mind, depending on its Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} until the start of your next turn.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 3} for 1 minute.
items.description:
你令目标精神迟钝，基于其意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 1}，持续至你下个回合开始。

失败 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 2}，持续1分钟。

大失败 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 3}，持续1分钟。

items.name: 通译语言
items.expectedDescription:
The target can understand the meaning of a single language it is hearing or reading when you cast the spell. This doesn't let it understand codes, language couched in metaphor, and the like (subject to GM discretion). If the target can hear multiple languages and knows that, it can choose which language to understand; otherwise, choose one of the languages randomly.

Heightened (3rd) The target can also speak the language.

Heightened (4th) You can target up to 10 creatures, and targets can also speak the language.
items.description:
在你施放该法术时，目标会理解其正听到或者阅读的一种语言的含义。这不会令其能够理解密文，使用隐喻表达的含义，或者类似的内容（由GM所判定）。如果目标能够听见数种语言并且了解该情况，它能选择要理解的那种语言；否则，随机选择这种语言。

升阶（3环阶） 该目标也能使用该语言交流。

升阶（4环阶） 你能以至多10个生物作为目标，并且这些目标也能使用该语言交流。

items.expectedDescription:
You execute a psychic search of the Akashic Record for information about a specific topic and magically transfer this data to your comm unit or computer. When you Cast this Spell, choose any skill in which you're trained that has the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} action.

Any time during the duration, you can consult your comm unit while attempting a Recall Knowledge check using your chosen skill. This check gains a +1 status bonus. Checking your comm unit is part of the action to Recall Knowledge. You must be holding the comm unit to do so. The comm unit instantly compiles and displays snippets and selections from various media relevant to the topic, which grants you the bonus. If you roll a critical failure on this check, you get a failure instead. If the check is successful and the subject is a creature, you gain additional information or context about the creature. Once you reference the comm unit, the spell ends. When the spell ends, your access to the Akashic Record ends, and all the information you downloaded returns to the Akashic Record.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.h1i8c47U0IOrMrHJ]

Heightened (3rd) You can reference your comm unit three times before the spell ends.
items.description:
你通过灵能搜索阿卡西记录，获取特定主题的信息，并将数据魔法传输至通讯单元或计算机。施放此法术时，选择任何你至少为受训熟练度且能进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]动作的技能。

在持续时间内的任何时候，你都可以在使用所选技能进行回忆知识检定时查询通讯单元。该检定会获得+1状态加值。检查通讯单元是回忆知识动作的一部分。你必须手持通讯单元才能这样做。通讯单元会立即编译并显示与主题相关的各种媒体片段和精选内容，从而为你带来加值。如果你在检定中掷出大失败，改为失败。如果检定成功，且对象是生物，你将获得有关该生物的额外信息或内容。一旦你查询了通讯单元的信息，法术就会结束。当法术结束时，你对阿卡西记录的访问也会结束，你下载的所有信息都会返回阿卡西记录。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.h1i8c47U0IOrMrHJ]

升阶（3环）法术结束前可以用通讯单元查询信息3次。
items.name: 阿卡西下载（随意）
分析目标
items.expectedDescription:
You focus on the target, gathering data as magical holograms display information. When the casting is complete, you learn biometric information about the target, including its fingerprints, medical conditions, and other basic physiological information. You or anyone you advise about the analysis gains a +1 status bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} the creature, to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} on the creature, and to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about it. If the target is illusory or under the effects of illusion magic, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your analyze target spell.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

Heightened (3rd) The status bonus increases to +2, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Heightened (6th) The status bonus increases to +3, and you can target any number of creatures.
items.description:
你专注在目标身上，收集数据并以魔法全息图像显示。当施法完成，你会获得目标的所有生物特征信息，包括指纹、医疗状况和其他基本生理信息。你或任何得到你基于分析建议的人，在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]为该生物、对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]、以及对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]的检定上获得+1状态加值。如果目标是幻觉或者处于幻术魔法效果下，仅当效果的环级低于你分析目标的法术环级，你才能够探测到结果。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

升阶（3环）状态加值提升到+2，并且你可以至多10名生物作为目标。

升阶（6环）状态加值提升到+3，并且你可以任意名生物作为目标。

items.name: 晕眩术
items.expectedDescription:
You push into the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals 1d6 mental damage, with a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你侵入目标的精神，利用精神冲击令目标晕眩。该冲击造成1d6心灵伤害，具有基础意志豁免。如果目标在豁免中大失败，它获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 1}。

升阶（+2） 该伤害增加1d6。

items.name: 删除术
items.expectedDescription:
You delete data from a device or object with a flamboyant magical gesture. This data might be handwritten, printed, or digital. You delete up to 1,500 words' worth of text, one page of content, or one display screen worth of text or other visual information. Non-magical writing in or on an unattended or held object is automatically deleted. Attempt a counteract check to delete digital or magical writing. If you fail to delete writing that's part of a hazard, you trigger the hazard. This can't be used to delete the contents of a spellbook or similar means of storing magical formulas or spells.

If you target an attended tech item with the tracking trait, attempt a counteract check. On a success, the item becomes glitching 1. A creature holding the item can Interact to restart the software, reducing the glitching value by 1.

Heightened (7th) You can delete all the data stored locally on a single device or book, or all the data on a device or book related to a specific name, topic, or category.
items.description:
你以华丽的魔法手势删除设备或物品中的数据。这些数据可以是手写的、打印的或电子的。你最多可以删除 1,500字的文本、一页内容或一显示屏的文本或其他视觉信息。无主物品或手持物品上的非魔法文字会自动删除。尝试反制检定删除数据或魔法文字。如果你尝试删除的文字是危害的一部分，且你失败，就会触发危害。这不能用于删除魔法书或类似的存储魔法公式或法术的内容。

如果目标是具有追踪特征的科技物品，尝试一次反制检定。如果成功，该物品就会获得故障1。持有该物品的生物可以花费一个交互动作来重启用户界面，并将故障值降低1。

升阶（7环）你可以删除单个设备或书籍中本地存储的所有数据，或者删除设备或书籍中与特定名称、主题或类别相关的所有数据。

items.name: 侦测魔法
items.expectedDescription:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).
items.description:
你发出一股标记魔法存在的脉冲。你不会获得魔法存在或不存在以外的任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你或者你盟友的魔法物品以及持续法术。仅当幻术魔法的环阶低于你的侦测魔法环阶时，你才能侦测幻术魔法。但是，具有幻术灵光但是没有在外表上做伪装的物品（例如一瓶隐形药水），通常能够正常侦测。

升阶（3环阶） 你能知晓法术侦测出的最强魔法效果的环阶或等级，具体由GM决定。

升阶（4环阶） 如3环阶，你也能指出最高环阶魔法的来源。如同一种模糊感官，你不会了解具体的位置，但是可以将来源锁定到5尺立方（或者最近的那个五尺立方，如果来源体积比这个区域更大）。

items.name: 伪装灵光
items.expectedDescription:
You alter how an item's or spell's magical aura appears to effects like detect magic. You can hide the auras entirely, have an item register as a common item of lower level, or make a spell register as a common spell of the same or lower rank. You can Dismiss the spell. A caster using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gpzpAAAJ1Lza2JVl]{Detect Magic} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.OhD2Z6rIGGD5ocZA]{Read Aura} of a higher rank than disguise magic can attempt to disbelieve the illusion using the skill matching the tradition of the spell (Arcana for arcane, Religion for divine, Occultism for occult, or Nature for primal). Further attempts by the same caster get the same result as the initial check to disbelieve.

Heightened (2nd) You can Cast this Spell on a creature, disguising all items and spell effects on it.
items.description:
你改变物品或法术的魔法灵光在侦测魔法等效应中的呈现方式。你可以完全隐藏灵光，使物品显示为等级更低的常见物品，或者让一个法术看起来是相同或更低环阶的常见法术。你可以解消该法术。使用比伪装灵光更高环阶的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gpzpAAAJ1Lza2JVl]{侦测魔法}或者@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.OhD2Z6rIGGD5ocZA]{阅读灵光}的施法者，可以使用与此法术根源相符的技能（奥术为奥法，神术为宗教，异能为神秘，原能为自然）来尝试识破幻术。相同的施法者的进一步的识破尝试会得到与初次检定相同的结果。

升阶（2环阶） 你可以对一个生物施放该法术，伪装其身上所有的物品和魔法效果。

items.name: 阅读灵光
items.expectedDescription:
You focus on the target object, opening your mind to perceive magical auras. When the casting is complete, you know whether that item is magical. You or anyone you advise about the aura gains a +2 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{Identify Magic} on the item. If the object is illusory, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your read aura spell.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.J6OhRNSN23KzOPRL]{Spell Effect: Read Aura}

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to 10 objects.

Heightened (6th) You can target any number of objects.
items.description:
你专注于目标物体，拓展神智，以感受魔法灵光。当你完成施法后，你得知该物品是否具有魔法。你或任何经你告知灵光信息的人在对该物品@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{辨识魔法}时获得+2环境加值。如果该物体是幻象，仅当该效果的环阶低于你的阅读灵光环阶时你才能发现此事实。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.J6OhRNSN23KzOPRL]{法术效果：阅读灵光}

升阶（3环） 你能以至多10个物体为目标。

升阶（6环） 你能以任意数量物体为目标。

items.name: 护盾术
items.expectedDescription:
You raise a magical shield of force. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction with your magic shield. The shield has Hardness 5. You can use the spell's reaction to reduce damage from any spell or magical effect, even if it doesn't deal physical damage. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity}

Heightened (+2) The shield's Hardness increases by 5.
items.description:
你举起一面力场构成的魔法护盾。这视同你使用了举盾动作，赋予你在AC上的+1环境加值，直到你的下个回合开始，且无需用手持握。

当该法术生效时，你可以使用你的魔法护盾来进行 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{盾牌格挡}反应动作。该盾牌具有硬度5。你可以使用该法术的反应动作来减少任何来自法术或者魔法效果的伤害，即使这不造成物理伤害。在你使用盾牌格挡后，该法术结束，并且你无法在10分钟内再次施放它。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{法术效果：护盾术}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{效果：护盾术免疫}

升阶（+2） 该盾牌的硬度增加5。

items.name: 料敌机先
items.expectedDescription:
The next time you make an attack roll before the end of your turn, roll it twice and use the better result. The attack ignores circumstance penalties to the attack roll and any flat check required due to the target being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}. You are then temporarily immune to sure strike for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.fpGDAz2v5PG0zUSl]{Spell Effect: Sure Strike}
items.description:
在你的回合结束前，你下一次尝试攻击掷骰时，骰两次并使用较好的结果。该攻击会忽视对攻击掷骰的环境减值，以及因目标@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}或者@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{藏匿}而需进行的任何纯骰检定。然后你临时免疫料敌机先10分钟。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.fpGDAz2v5PG0zUSl]{法术效果：料敌机先}

items.name: 阿卡西之眼
items.expectedDescription: Instead of using their own memories, an Akashic dragon can ascertain information from the Akashic Records. This gives it the Akashic Record Lore skill, which it can use to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} of any kind.
items.description: 阿卡西龙能够不依靠自身记忆，而是从阿卡西记录中获取信息。这赋予它阿卡西记录学识技能，可用于任何类型的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{回忆知识}。

items.name: 全域视野
items.expectedDescription: @Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.AllAroundVision]
items.description: @Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.AllAroundVision]

items.expectedName: +2 status to all saves vs. occult
items.name: 对抗异能的所有豁免获得+2状态加值
阿卡西干扰
items.expectedDescription:
90 feet. The swirl of constant uploads and downloads near the Akashic dragon make attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} unpredictable. A creature other than an akashic dragon that enters or begins its turn in the area must attempt a @Check[will|dc:23] save. Regardless of the result of the saving throw, the creature is temporarily immune to this dragon's Akashic interference for 1 minute.

Critical Success For 1 round, when the creature attempts to Recall Knowledge, it gains a +3 status bonus to its check.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure For 1 round, when the creature attempts to Recall Knowledge, it takes a –3 status penalty to its check.

Critical Failure As failure, but the effect lasts 1 minute.
items.description:
90尺。阿卡西龙附近持续上传下载的信息流使@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{回忆知识}变得难以预测。阿卡西龙以外的生物进入区域或在区域内开始回合时，必须尝试@Check[will|dc:23]豁免。无论豁免结果如何，该生物都会临时免疫这条龙的阿卡西干扰1分钟。

大成功 1轮内，生物尝试回忆知识时，检定获得+3状态加值。

成功 生物不受影响。

失败 1轮内，生物尝试回忆知识时，检定承受–3状态减值。

大失败 同失败，但效应持续1分钟。

items.name: 偏转激光
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger The dragon is critically hit by an attack

Effect The young Akashic dragon raises a web of deflecting lasers using the eyes embedded all over their body, gaining resistance 8 to all damage against the triggering attack and absorbing some of the blow's energy, recharging their Akashic Barrage. If the Akashic dragon has succeeded at a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} check against the creature in the last minute, they gain resistance 11 instead.
items.description:
触发 龙被一次攻击重击

效果 青年阿卡西龙用遍布全身的嵌眼激发偏转激光网，对触发攻击的所有伤害获得抗力8，并吸收部分攻击能量，为阿卡西弹幕重新充能。若阿卡西龙在过去1分钟内曾成功对该生物进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{回忆知识}检定，则改为获得抗力11。

items.name: 阿卡西适应性
items.expectedDescription: The Akashic dragon can activate magic and tech items with the Cast a Spell activation of any tradition as if the spells they contain were occult spells.
items.description: 阿卡西龙可以启动来自任意根源、以施放法术作为启动方式的魔法和科技物品，如同其中的法术属于异能法术。

items.name: 阿卡西弹幕
items.expectedDescription: The dragon condenses cutting truths and fiery revelations from the Akashic Record into sizzling laser fire that they project as a cone from their primary eye to assail their foes. This deals @Damage[10d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage in a @Template[type:cone|distance:30] (@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic] save). If a creature critically fails its Reflex save against Akashic Barrage and the Akashic dragon has succeeded at a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about the creature in the last minute, the creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round. The dragon can't use Akashic Barrage again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Akashic Barrage]]{1d4 rounds}.
items.description: 龙将阿卡西记录中的锐利真理和炙热启示凝聚成灼热激光，由主眼以锥形投射，攻击敌人。这会造成@Damage[10d6[fire]|options:area-damage]伤害，影响@Template[type:cone|distance:30]（@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic]豁免）。若生物对抗阿卡西弹幕的反射豁免大失败，且阿卡西龙在过去1分钟内成功进行过有关该生物的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{回忆知识}检定，该生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞1}，持续1轮。龙在[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Akashic Barrage]]{1d4轮}内无法再次使用阿卡西弹幕。

items.name: 敌手记录
items.expectedDescription: The first time each encounter the Akashic dragon hits and deals damage to a creature with their jaws Strike, they receive information about the creature as if they'd succeeded at a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about that creature.
items.description: 每次遭遇中，阿卡西龙首次以颚部打击命中一个生物并造成伤害时，便获得有关该生物的信息，如同成功进行了有关该生物的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{回忆知识}检定。

0c3BeBw8lcnhWjeK.name: 青年阿卡西龙（施法者） Akashic Dragon (Young, Spellcaster)
0c3BeBw8lcnhWjeK.publicNotes: 阿卡西龙通常藏身于残破、堆满遗物的巢穴，鲜少在外界露面，但偶尔也会居住在繁忙的空间站或城市等知识枢纽。这些龙天生与阿卡西记录直接相连，是傲慢的知识保管者，自认没有其他生物可能比它们更了解宇宙的秘密——而这一判断往往确实无误。阿卡西龙会在阿卡西记录中停留很长时间，离开时常以为已过去许多天，然而对银河系的其他地方而言，仅仅过了几小时。

0eiGTfhbUJWZwMRg.name: 地狱骑士持节士 Hellknight Signifer
0eiGTfhbUJWZwMRg.publicNotes:
展现出非凡技艺、学术修养和魔法造诣的地狱骑士可能会晋升为持节士。

地狱骑士是炼狱骑士。他们曾在失落的格拉利昂统治整个国家，而协约世界的地狱骑士则以更全面的方式执行法律、维持秩序，乘坐庞大的堡垒星舰四处传播影响力，而不驻留在某个地方。战斗中的地狱骑士纪律严明、毫不留情且致命。

items.name: 灼热圣光
items.expectedDescription:
You shine a blazing ray of light tinged with holy energy. Make a ranged spell attack. The ray deals 5d6 fire damage. If the target has the unholy trait, you deal an extra 5d6 spirit damage.

Critical Success The target takes double damage.

Success The target takes full damage.

If the light passes through an area of magical darkness or targets a creature affected by magical darkness, holy light attempts to counteract the darkness. If you need to determine whether the light passes through an area of darkness, draw a line between yourself and the spell's target.

Heightened (+1) The fire damage increases by 2d6, and the spirit damage against unholy creatures increases by 2d6.
items.description:
你发出一道带有圣洁能量的闪耀射线。尝试一次远程法术攻击。该射线造成5d6火焰伤害。如果目标有邪秽特征，你造成额外5d6精魂伤害。

大成功 目标承受双倍伤害。

成功 目标承受完整伤害。

如果该光线通过一个魔法黑暗区域，或者以一个受到魔法黑暗影响的生物为目标，灼热圣光会尝试反制该黑暗。若需判断光线是否穿过黑暗区域，则在你与法术目标之间画一条直线。

升阶（+1） 该火焰伤害增加2d6，对邪秽生物造成的额外精魂伤害增加2d6。

items.name: 分担痛苦
items.expectedDescription:
You telepathically share the sensation of agonizing pain with a creature. The target takes 3d12 mental damage and attempts a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} for 1 minute.

Heightened (6th) The spell targets up to four creatures and deals 6d12 mental damage.
items.description:
你以心灵感应向一个生物分享剧痛的感受。目标受到3d12心灵伤害，并尝试意志豁免。

大成功 生物不受影响。

成功 生物受到一半伤害。

失败 生物受到全部伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙1}，持续1分钟。

大失败 生物受到全部伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙2}，持续1分钟。

升阶（6环） 法术至多以四个生物为目标，并造成6d12心灵伤害。

items.name: 解除魔法
items.expectedDescription: You unravel the magic behind a spell or effect. Attempt a counteract check against the target. If you successfully counteract a magic item, the item becomes a mundane item of its type for 10 minutes. This doesn't change the item's non-magical properties. If the target is an artifact or similar item, you automatically fail.
items.description: 你干扰法术或者效果中的魔法力量。尝试一次反制检定，对抗目标。如果你成功对抗一个魔法物品，该物品成为该类型的普通物品，持续10分钟。这不会改变物体的非魔法性质。如果目标是一件神器或者类似的物品，你自动失败。

items.name: 噪鸣爆
items.expectedDescription:
A cacophonous noise blasts out, dealing 2d10 sonic damage. Each creature must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is deafened for 1 minute, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10.
items.description:
刺耳的噪音迸裂而出，造成2d10音波伤害。每个生物必须尝试一次强韧豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物承受一半伤害。

失败 该生物承受完整伤害，并且@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{耳聋}1轮。

大失败 该生物承受双倍伤害，耳聋1分钟，并且@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 1}。

升阶（+1） 该伤害增加1d10。

items.name: 抵抗能量伤害
items.expectedDescription:
A shield of elemental energy protects a creature against one type of energy damage. Choose acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage. The target and its gear gain resistance 5 against the damage type you chose.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.con2Hzt47JjpuUej]{Spell Effect: Resist Energy}

Heightened (4th) The resistance increases to 10, and you can target up to two creatures.

Heightened (7th) The resistance increases to 15, and you can target up to five creatures.
items.description:
元素护盾保护一个生物免受某一种类型能量的伤害。选择酸蚀，寒冷，电击，火焰或者音波伤害。目标和其装备获得对你所选择伤害类型的抗力5。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.con2Hzt47JjpuUej]{法术效果：抵抗能量伤害}

升阶（4环） 该抗力增加到10，并且你能以至多两个生物为目标。

升阶（7环） 该抗力增加到15，并且你能以至多五个生物为目标。

items.name: 祝福术
items.expectedDescription:
Blessings from beyond help your companions strike true. You and your allies gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls while within the emanation. Once per round on subsequent turns, you can Sustain the spell to increase the emanation's radius by 10 feet.

Bless can counteract @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7ZinJNzxq0XF0oMx]{Bane}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Gqy7K6FnbLtwGpud]{Spell Effect: Bless}
items.description:
来自彼方的祝福帮助你的伙伴准确命中敌人。你和处于此弥漫内的盟友在攻击掷骰上获得+1状态加值。在随后的回合中，每轮一次，你可以维持该法术将弥漫的半径增加10尺。

祝福术可以反制@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7ZinJNzxq0XF0oMx]{绝望术}。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Gqy7K6FnbLtwGpud]{法术效果：祝福术}

items.name: 侦测魔法
items.expectedDescription:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).
items.description:
你发出一股标记魔法存在的脉冲。你不会获得魔法存在或不存在以外的任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你或者你盟友的魔法物品以及持续法术。仅当幻术魔法的环阶低于你的侦测魔法环阶时，你才能侦测幻术魔法。但是，具有幻术灵光但是没有在外表上做伪装的物品（例如一瓶隐形药水），通常能够正常侦测。

升阶（3环阶） 你能知晓法术侦测出的最强魔法效果的环阶或等级，具体由GM决定。

升阶（4环阶） 如3环阶，你也能指出最高环阶魔法的来源。如同一种模糊感官，你不会了解具体的位置，但是可以将来源锁定到5尺立方（或者最近的那个五尺立方，如果来源体积比这个区域更大）。

items.expectedName: Diabolic Pact (DC 22, Doesn't Require Secondary Casters)
items.name: 魔鬼契约（DC 22，不需要次要施法者）
items.expectedDescription:
You make an appeal to a powerful devil, asking them to bind some of their subordinates to your service. If you succeed, the devil sends you their choice of one devil of level 2 or lower, two devils of level 0 or lower, or three devils of level –1 or lower.

Critical Success The devils are sent to you and serve you for [[/gmr 1d4 #Weeks]]{1d4 weeks}.

Success The devils are sent to you and serve you for [[/gmr 1d4 #Days]]{1d4 days}.

Failure Your request is denied.

Critical Failure Not only is your request denied, but the powerful devil sends word of its displeasure to your master.

Heightened (+1) Increase the level of devil sent to you by 2 for each option.
items.description:
你恳请强大的魔鬼，请求他派遣一些手下受你调遣。若你的仪式成功，魔鬼会根据自身的选择进行派遣，这可能是1个2级或更低等级的魔鬼、2个0级或更低等级的魔鬼、或者3个-1级或更低等级的魔鬼。

大成功 被派来的魔鬼会为你服务[[/gmr 1d4 #Weeks]]{1d4周}。

成功 被派来的魔鬼会为你服务[[/gmr 1d4 #Days]]{1d4天}。

失败 你的请求被拒绝了。

大失败 你的请求不仅被拒绝了，且强大的魔鬼会将自身的不满告知你的主人。

升阶（+1） 每个选项中为你派遣的魔鬼等级增加2级。

items.name: 衰弱术
items.expectedDescription:
You sap the target's strength, depending on its Fortitude save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the start of your next turn.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3} for 1 minute.
items.description:
你抽走目标的力量，基于其强韧豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭 1}，直到你的下个回合开始。

失败 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭 2}，持续1分钟。

大失败 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭 3}，持续1分钟

items.name: 伤害术
items.expectedDescription:
You channel void energy to harm the living or heal the undead. If the target is a living creature, you deal 1d8 void damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. If the target is a willing undead creature, you restore that amount of Hit Points. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 The spell has a range of touch.

2 (concentrate) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing an undead creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (concentrate) You disperse void energy in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. This targets all living and undead creatures in the area.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.
items.description:
你引导虚能，以伤害活物或者治疗不死生物。如果目标是活物，你对其造成1d8虚能伤害，并且它可以进行基础强韧豁免。如果目标是自愿不死生物，你使目标恢复等量生命值。你在施放该法术时花费的动作数量决定其目标，范围，区域和其他参数。

1 该法术的射程为接触。

2（专注）该法术的射程为30尺。如果你在治疗一个不死生物，回复的生命值增加8。

3（专注）你在@Template[emanation|distance:30]内释放虚能。这会以区域中所有活物和不死生物为目标。

升阶（+1） 治疗或者伤害的量增加1d8，2动作版本的额外治疗增加8。

items.name: 治疗术
items.expectedDescription:
You channel vital energy to heal the living or damage the undead. If the target is a willing living creature, you restore 1d8 Hit Points. If the target is undead, you deal that amount of vitality damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

2 (concentrate) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing a living creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (concentrate) You disperse vital energy in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. This targets all living and undead creatures in the burst.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.
items.description:
你引导命能，以治疗活物或者伤害不死生物。如果目标是自愿活物，你使其恢复1d8生命值。如果目标是不死生物，你对其造成等量命能伤害，并且它可以进行基础强韧豁免。你在施放该法术时花费的动作数量决定其目标，范围，区域和其他参数。

1 该法术的射程为接触。

2（专注）该法术的射程为30尺。如果你在治疗一个活物，回复的生命值增加8。

3（专注）你在@Template[emanation|distance:30]内释放命能。这会以区域中所有活物和不死生物为目标。

升阶（+1） 治疗或者伤害的量增加1d8，两个动作版本的额外治疗增加8。

items.name: 引火术
items.expectedDescription:
You snap your fingers and point at a target, which begins to smolder. Make a spell attack roll against the target's AC, dealing 2d4 fire damage on a hit. If the target is within your melee reach, you can choose to make a melee spell attack with the flame instead of a ranged spell attack, which increases all the spell's damage dice to d6s.

Critical Success The target takes double damage and 1d4 persistent fire damage.

Success The target takes full damage.

Heightened (+1) The initial damage increases by 1d4 and the persistent fire damage on a critical hit increases by 1d4.

@Damage[(@item.rank)d4[persistent,fire]]{Scaling Persistent Fire Damage}

@Damage[(@item.rank)d6[persistent,fire]]{Scaling Persistent Fire Damage (Melee)}
items.description:
你打个响指并指向一个目标，后者便开始阴燃。作出一次法术攻击检定对抗目标的AC，命中时造成2d4点火焰伤害。若目标位于你的近战触及范围内，你能选择用火焰进行一次近战法术攻击以取代远程法术攻击，这会使得法术的所有伤害骰提升至d6骰子。

大成功 目标承受双倍伤害以及1d4点持续火焰伤害。

成功 目标承受全额伤害。

升阶（+1） 起始伤害增加1d4点，重击的持续火焰伤害增加1d4点。

@Damage[(@item.rank)d4[persistent,fire]]{随环阶提升的持续火焰伤害}

@Damage[(@item.rank)d6[persistent,fire]]{随环阶提升的持续火焰伤害（近战）}

items.name: 光亮术
items.expectedDescription:
You create an orb of light that sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet) in a color you choose. If you create the light in the same space as a willing creature, you can attach the light to the creature, causing it to float near that creature as it moves. You can Sustain the spell to move the light up to 60 feet; you can attach or detach it from a creature as part of this movement.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you Cast the Spell while you already have four light spells active, you must choose one of the existing spells to end.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.cVVZXNbV0nElVOPZ]{Spell Effect: Light}

Heightened (4th) The orb sheds light in a 60-foot radius (and dim light for the next 60 feet).
items.description:
你创造一个光球，它发出由你选择的颜色的光芒，在20尺半径内产生明亮光照（以及接下来的20尺产生昏暗光照）。如果你在一个自愿生物所占据的空间内创造光球，你可以将光球连结到该生物，使光球在该生物附近悬浮，并随其移动。你可以维持法术以移动光球至多60尺，作为这个移动的一部分，你可以将光球连结到一个生物或是从一个生物上解除连结。

你可以解消该法术。若你已经有4个光亮术生效时施放此法术，你必须结束一个已存在的法术。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.cVVZXNbV0nElVOPZ]{法术效果：光亮术}

升阶（4环） 光球在60尺半径内产生明亮光照（并在接下来的60尺产生昏暗光照）。

items.name: 回旋弹
items.expectedDescription:
A spinning disk or smooth orb of shimmering steel leaps from one target to another. You deal 2d4 bludgeoning or slashing damage (with a basic Reflex save).

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.
items.description:
一道由闪烁钢铁构成的旋转圆盘或光滑球体在目标之间弹射跃动。造成2d4钝击或挥砍伤害，需要进行基础反射豁免。

升阶 （+1）伤害增加1d4。

items.name: 护盾术
items.expectedDescription:
You raise a magical shield of force. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction with your magic shield. The shield has Hardness 5. You can use the spell's reaction to reduce damage from any spell or magical effect, even if it doesn't deal physical damage. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity}

Heightened (+2) The shield's Hardness increases by 5.
items.description:
你举起一面力场构成的魔法护盾。这视同你使用了举盾动作，赋予你在AC上的+1环境加值，直到你的下个回合开始，且无需用手持握。

当该法术生效时，你可以使用你的魔法护盾来进行 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{盾牌格挡}反应动作。该盾牌具有硬度5。你可以使用该法术的反应动作来减少任何来自法术或者魔法效果的伤害，即使这不造成物理伤害。在你使用盾牌格挡后，该法术结束，并且你无法在10分钟内再次施放它。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{法术效果：护盾术}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{效果：护盾术免疫}

升阶（+2） 该盾牌的硬度增加5。

items.name: 微灵盟友
items.expectedDescription:
You summon a Tiny bouncing wisp of light that easily distracts even the most determined of combatants. The wisp floats near your target. A wisp doesn't take up space, grant flanking, or have any other attributes a creature would. The wisp generates bright light in a 10-foot radius. When you Cast the Spell and each time you Sustain the spell, your wisp attempts to distract your target, which must succeed at a Will save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of your next turn. A creature who critically succeeds becomes immune to wisp ally for 1 hour.

Heightened (+1) You create one additional wisp, allowing you to choose a different target. Each wisp you create must have a different target, and all of them attempt to distract their targets at the same time when you cast or Sustain this spell.
items.description:
你召唤一只小小的活跃微灵，能够分散意志最坚定的战斗人员的注意。微灵在你目标周围悬浮游弋。微灵没有占据空间，不会提供夹击，也没有其他生物会具有的属性。微灵能在10尺半径内产生明亮光照。当你施放该法术以及每次你维持该法术时，微灵试图分散目标的注意力。该目标必须通过意志豁免，否则在你下一回合开始前将陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]。豁免大成功的生物将对微灵盟友临时免疫1小时。

升阶（+1）你在施法时创造出额外一只微灵，这允许你选择一个额外目标。你创造的每个微灵都必须有不同的目标，并且当你维持该法术时，它们会同时分散各自目标的注意力。

items.name: 激光手枪
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This compact pistol is the most popular sidearm in the Pact Worlds thanks to its reliability, durability, and affordability. Most common laser pistols have a lightweight polycarbon body ending in a long, slim barrel.
items.description:
强化： 1

这把紧凑的手枪因可靠、耐用且价格实惠，成为协约世界（Pact Worlds）最受欢迎的随身武器。大多数普通激光手枪有轻质聚碳枪身，末端连着细长的枪管。

items.name: 保温织服
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

Tempweave suits are reinforced hooded garments woven with thermal fabric and venting wires, popularly worn for trips to humid climates like the jungles of Castrovel or Pulonis.
items.description:
强化： 1

温控编织服以保温面料和散热导线织成，是一种经过加固的兜帽服饰，前往卡斯卓韦或普洛尼斯（Pulonis）的丛林等潮湿气候地区旅行时，穿戴它很流行。

items.name: 弹跳喷射器
items.expectedDescription:
Boosters attached to your armor supercharge your leap.

Activate—Jump 1 (manipulate)

Frequency once per round

Effect You activate the jump jets to get a quick boost. You Fly up to 20 feet with a maximum height of 10 feet, or you Fly up to 20 feet straight up. You must land at the end of this movement or fall. Jump jets can't lift you if you're encumbered.
items.description:
附着在你护甲上的推进器增进你的跳跃。

启动—跳跃 1 （操作）

频率每轮一次

效果 你启动弹跳喷射器，获得短暂的推进力。你飞行至多20尺，最大高度为10尺；也可以改为垂直向上飞行至多20尺。你必须在移动结束时落地，否则就会坠落。如果你处于超载状态，弹跳喷射器就无法将你举起。

items.name: 焚烧不义
items.expectedDescription: 10 feet. Magical wards cause a signifer's surrounding foes to catch flame. An enemy creature that starts its turn in the area must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:19] save or take @Damage[1d4[persistent,fire]] damage. A signifer can activate and deactivate this aura as a single action that has the concentrate trait. Regardless of the result of the save, the creature is immune to the aura for 1 minute.
items.description: 10尺。魔法结界令持节士周围的敌人着火。在区域内开始回合的敌对生物必须成功通过@Check[fortitude|dc:19]豁免，否则受到@Damage[1d4[persistent,fire]]伤害。持节士可以用具有专注特征的单动作启动或关闭此灵光。无论豁免结果如何，该生物免疫此灵光1分钟。

items.name: 有罪宣告
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency once per round

Effect The signifer accuses a target within 60 feet of misdeeds, then attempts an Intimidation check to [[/act demoralize]] them. As long as the target is frightened due to Proclamation of Guilt, it's also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF].
items.description:
频率 每轮一次

效果 持节士指控60尺内的一个目标犯有恶行，然后尝试威吓检定以对其[[/act demoralize]]{挫败士气}。只要目标因有罪宣告而惊惧，它也会@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{被压制}。

items.name: 及远法术
items.expectedDescription: If the next action the signifer uses is to Cast a Spell that has a range, increase that spell's range by 30 feet.
items.description: （专注，塑法）如果持节士使用的下个动作是施放一个具有射程的法术，提升该法术射程30尺。

items.name: 短讯术
items.expectedDescription: You send the creature a mental message of 25 words or fewer, and it can respond immediately with its own message of 25 words or fewer.
items.description: 你向该生物发送一段25词或者更短的精神信息，它可以立即以自己的一段不超过25词的信息回应。

items.name: 实言术（恒定）
items.expectedDescription:
The target can understand all words regardless of language and also speak the languages of other creatures. When in a mixed group of creatures, each time the target speaks, it can choose a creature and speak in a language that creature understands, even if the target doesn't know what language that is.

Heightened (7th) The duration is 8 hours.
items.description:
无论什么语言，目标都可以理解其所有的词语，也能说其他生物的语言。当处于一群各异的生物中时，每次目标说话时，都可以选择一个生物，并使用一种该生物理解的语言来讲述，即使该目标不知道这语言具体是什么。

升阶（7环） 持续时间为8小时。

items.name: 次元拴绳
items.expectedDescription:
You stitch the target to its current plane. While the target is affected by planar tether, the spell attempts to counteract any teleportation effect that would move the target, or any effect that would transport it to a different plane. Planar tether's duration is determined by the target's Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The effect's duration is 1 minute.

Failure The effect's duration is 10 minutes.

Critical Failure The effect's duration is 1 hour.
items.description:
你将目标固定到其当前位面。当目标受到次元拴绳影响时，该法术会尝试反制任何会移动目标的传送效应，以及任何会将其送往另一个位面的效应。次元拴绳的持续时间由目标的意志豁免决定。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 该持续时间为1分钟。

失败 该持续时间为10分钟。

大失败 该持续时间为1小时。

items.name: 英雄气概
items.expectedDescription:
You unlock the target's inner heroism, granting it a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, Perception checks, saving throws, and skill checks.

Heightened (6th) The status bonus increases to +2.

Heightened (9th) The status bonus increases to +3.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.l9HRQggofFGIxEse]{Spell Effect: Heroism}
items.description:
你解放了目标内在的英勇，赋予其在攻击掷骰、察觉检定、豁免和技能检定上的+1状态加值。

升阶（6环） 该状态加值增加到+2。

升阶（9环） 该状态加值增加到+3。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.l9HRQggofFGIxEse]{法术效果：英雄气概}

items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature within range enters an environment that would be harmful to it.

A shimmering bubble envelops the target's body, allowing it to breathe normally in a vacuum or other unsafe environment and protecting it from severe temperatures and radiation.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 5 additional creatures to gain protection against the environment the triggering creature entered. The spell lasts for 8 hours and also protects against extreme temperatures and radiation.

Heightened (10th) You can target up to 10 additional creatures to gain protection against the environment the triggering creature entered. The spell lasts until your next daily preparations and also protects against incredible temperatures and radiation.
items.description:
触发射程内的生物进入对其有害的环境。

一个闪亮的气泡包裹目标的身体，让它在真空或其他不安全的环境中正常呼吸，并保护它免受严重（severe）温度和辐射的伤害。

升阶（7环）你可指定最多5个额外生物为目标，使其获得针对触发生物所处环境的防护效果。法术持续8小时，并且可以抵御极端（extreme ）温度和辐射。

升阶（10环）你可指定最多10个额外生物为目标，使其获得针对触发生物所处环境的防护效果。法术持续到你下次日常准备，并能抵御严酷（incredible ）温度和辐射。
items.name: 生命容器（随意）
安定心神
items.expectedDescription:
You forcibly calm creatures in the area, soothing them into a nonviolent state; each creature must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success Calming urges impose a -1 status penalty to the creature's attack rolls.

Failure Any emotion effects that would affect the creature are suppressed and the creature can't use hostile actions. If the target is subject to hostility from any other creature, it ceases to be affected by calm.

Critical Failure As failure, but hostility doesn't end the effect.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Qr5rgoZvI4KmFY0N]{Spell Effect: Calm}
items.description:
你令区域内的生物强制冷静，令它们进入平和的状态；每个生物必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 平静的冲动令该生物在攻击掷骰上承受-1状态减值。

失败 任何会影响该生物的情绪效果会被压制，并且该生物无法进行敌对行为。如果该目标成为任何其他生物敌对行为的目标，它不再受到安定心神的影响。

大失败 如同失败，但是敌对行为不会结束该效果。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Qr5rgoZvI4KmFY0N]{法术效果：安定心神}

items.name: 净化苦难
items.expectedDescription:
Gentle restorative magic pushes back the effects of toxins and more complex maladies. Choose an affliction on the target, such as a curse, disease, or poison. If it has advanced past stage one, reduce the stage by one. This reduction can be applied only once to a given case of an affliction, with the case ending when it's completely cured. Although the reduction can't occur again, heightened versions of this spell attempt to counteract with each casting.

Heightened (3rd) Attempt to counteract the affliction if it is a disease or poison.

Heightened (4th) Attempt to counteract the affliction if it is a curse, disease, or poison.
items.description:
温和的恢复魔法抑制毒素和更复杂疾患的影响。选择目标的一个苦难，例如诅咒、疾病、或者毒素。如果它已经超过阶段1，减少1个阶段。直到某一次苦难被完全治愈之前，对于这次苦难，这种减少只能生效一次。尽管这种减少不能再次发生，升阶版本的该法术每次施法都能尝试反制它。

升阶（3环） 如果苦难是疾病或者毒素，尝试反制它。

升阶（4环） 如果苦难是诅咒、疾病或者毒素，尝试反制它。

items.name: 清神醒脑
items.expectedDescription:
You drive mental contamination from the target's mind. Attempt to counteract an effect of your choice imposing one of these conditions on the target: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied}. If you failed to counteract the effect but you would have if its counteract rank were 2 lower, instead suppress the effect until the beginning of your next turn. The effect's duration doesn't elapse while it's suppressed. This spell can't counteract or suppress conditions that are part of curses, diseases, or a natural state of the target.

Heightened (4th) Add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed} to the list of conditions.

Heightened (6th) As 4th rank, plus add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed}.

Heightened (8th) As 4th rank, plus add doomed and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned}.
items.description:
你将精神污染从目标的头脑中驱除。尝试反制目标上的任一个由你选择的造成下列状态的效果：@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧}以及@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞}。如果你未能反制该效果，但是如果其反制环阶低2的话你会成功，则改为压制该效应，直至你的下回合开始。在被压制时，该效果的持续时间不会减少。该法术不会反制或者压制属于目标的诅咒、疾病或者自然情况一部分的状态。

升阶（4环） 增加@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{困惑}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{被控制}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢}到状态列表中。

升阶（6环） 同4环阶，额外增加@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{毁灭}到状态列表中。

升阶（8环） 同4环阶，额外增加毁灭和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑}到状态列表中。

items.name: 忍受环境
items.expectedDescription:
You shield the target against dangerous temperatures. Choose severe cold or heat. The target is protected from the temperature you chose (but not extreme cold or heat).

Heightened (3rd) The target is protected from severe cold and severe heat.

Heightened (5th) The target is protected from severe cold, severe heat, extreme cold, and extreme heat.
items.description:
你保护目标对抗危险气温。选择严寒或炎热。目标不受你选择的气温的影响，但这对极寒和极热无效。

升阶（3环） 目标受到保护，免遭严寒和炎热影响。

升阶（5环） 目标受到保护，免遭严寒、炎热、极寒和极热影响。

items.name: 识破无形
items.expectedDescription:
Your gaze pierces through illusions and finds @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} creatures and spirits. You can see invisible creatures as though they weren't invisible, although their features are blurred, making them @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} and difficult to identify. You can also see incorporeal creatures, like ghosts, phased through an object from within 10 feet of an object's surface as blurry shapes seen through those objects. Subtler clues also grant you a +2 status bonus to checks you make to disbelieve illusions.

Heightened (5th) This spell has a duration of 8 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.T5bk6UH7yuYog1Fp]{Spell Effect: See the Unseen}
items.description:
你的目光穿透了幻术，发现了隐形生物和魂灵。你能看到@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}生物，就如同它们并未隐形一般，然而它们的体征仍然很模糊，使得它们具有@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}并且难以被识别。你还能看到虚体生物，比如穿入物体内的幽灵；你能透过物体，看到位于物体表面以内10尺内的此类生物的模糊轮廓。对细节更强的洞察力还让你在进行识破幻术的检定时，获得+2状态加值。

升阶（5环） 持续时间为8小时。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.T5bk6UH7yuYog1Fp]{法术效果：识破无形}

items.name: 关照术
items.expectedDescription:
As long as you and the target are on the same plane of existence and both alive, you remain aware of its present state. You know the target's direction from you, distance from you, and any conditions affecting it.

Heightened (4th) The spell's range increases to 30 feet, and you can target up to 10 creatures.
items.description:
只要你和目标处于相同的位面，并且均活着，你就会一直知晓其当前状态。你知晓目标和你相对的方向，与你的距离，以及任何正影响其的状态。

升阶（4环） 该法术的射程增加到30尺，并且你能以至多10个生物为目标。

items.name: 通译语言
items.expectedDescription:
The target can understand the meaning of a single language it is hearing or reading when you cast the spell. This doesn't let it understand codes, language couched in metaphor, and the like (subject to GM discretion). If the target can hear multiple languages and knows that, it can choose which language to understand; otherwise, choose one of the languages randomly.

Heightened (3rd) The target can also speak the language.

Heightened (4th) You can target up to 10 creatures, and targets can also speak the language.
items.description:
在你施放该法术时，目标会理解其正听到或者阅读的一种语言的含义。这不会令其能够理解密文，使用隐喻表达的含义，或者类似的内容（由GM所判定）。如果目标能够听见数种语言并且了解该情况，它能选择要理解的那种语言；否则，随机选择这种语言。

升阶（3环阶） 该目标也能使用该语言交流。

升阶（4环阶） 你能以至多10个生物作为目标，并且这些目标也能使用该语言交流。

items.name: 侦测魔法
items.expectedDescription:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).
items.description:
你发出一股标记魔法存在的脉冲。你不会获得魔法存在或不存在以外的任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你或者你盟友的魔法物品以及持续法术。仅当幻术魔法的环阶低于你的侦测魔法环阶时，你才能侦测幻术魔法。但是，具有幻术灵光但是没有在外表上做伪装的物品（例如一瓶隐形药水），通常能够正常侦测。

升阶（3环阶） 你能知晓法术侦测出的最强魔法效果的环阶或等级，具体由GM决定。

升阶（4环阶） 如3环阶，你也能指出最高环阶魔法的来源。如同一种模糊感官，你不会了解具体的位置，但是可以将来源锁定到5尺立方（或者最近的那个五尺立方，如果来源体积比这个区域更大）。

items.name: 严厉护卫
items.expectedDescription:
You ward an ally against the attacks and hostile spells from the target enemy. The target ally gains a +1 status bonus to Armor Class and saving throws against the target enemy's attacks, spells, and other effects.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ctMxYPGEpstvhW9C]{Spell Effect: Forbidding Ward}

Heightened (6th) The status bonus increases to +2.
items.description:
你保护一个盟友，以抵御目标敌人的攻击和敌对法术。目标盟友在对抗目标敌人的攻击、法术及其他效应时，AC和豁免获得+1状态加值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ctMxYPGEpstvhW9C]{法术效果：严厉护卫}

升阶（6环） 该状态加值增加到+2。

items.name: 神导术
items.expectedDescription:
You ask for the guidance of supernatural entities, granting the target a +1 status bonus to one attack roll, Perception check, saving throw, or skill check the target attempts before the duration ends. The target chooses which roll to use the bonus on before rolling. If the target uses the bonus, the spell ends. Either way, the target is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3qHKBDF7lrHw8jFK]{Spell Effect: Guidance}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3LyOkV25p7wA181H]{Effect: Guidance Immunity}
items.description:
你请求超自然存在的引导，赋予目标在持续时间结束前的一次攻击掷骰、察觉检定、豁免或技能检定上获得+1状态加值。目标在掷骰前选择是否使用该加值。如果目标使用该加值，该法术结束。无论怎样结束，该目标接下来会临时免疫1小时。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3qHKBDF7lrHw8jFK]{法术效果：神导术}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3LyOkV25p7wA181H]{效果：神导术免疫}

items.name: 治疗术
items.expectedDescription:
You channel vital energy to heal the living or damage the undead. If the target is a willing living creature, you restore 1d8 Hit Points. If the target is undead, you deal that amount of vitality damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 The spell has a range of touch.

2 (concentrate) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing a living creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (concentrate) You disperse vital energy in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. This targets all living and undead creatures in the burst.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.
items.description:
你引导命能，以治疗活物或者伤害不死生物。如果目标是自愿活物，你使其恢复1d8生命值。如果目标是不死生物，你对其造成等量命能伤害，并且它可以进行基础强韧豁免。你在施放该法术时花费的动作数量决定其目标，范围，区域和其他参数。

1 该法术的射程为接触。

2（专注）该法术的射程为30尺。如果你在治疗一个活物，回复的生命值增加8。

3（专注）你在@Template[emanation|distance:30]内释放命能。这会以区域中所有活物和不死生物为目标。

升阶（+1） 治疗或者伤害的量增加1d8，两个动作版本的额外治疗增加8。

items.name: 灌注命能
items.expectedDescription:
You empower attacks with vital energy. The number of targets is equal to the number of actions you spent casting this spell. Each target's unarmed and weapon Strikes deal an extra 1d4 vitality damage. (This damage typically damages only undead). If you have the holy trait, you can add that trait to this spell and to the Strikes affected by the spell.

Heightened (3rd) The damage increases to 2d4 damage.

Heightened (5th) The damage increases to 3d4 damage.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.X7RD0JRxhJV9u2LC]{Spell Effect: Infuse Vitality}
items.description:
你使用命能增强攻击。目标的数量等于你施放该法术时花费的动作数量。每个目标的无武装和武器打击额外造成1d4命能伤害。（该伤害通常只会伤害不死生物）。如果你具有圣洁（holy）特征，你可以将该特征附加到此法术及受其影响的打击上。

升阶（3环） 该伤害增加到2d4。

升阶（5环） 该伤害增加到3d4。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.X7RD0JRxhJV9u2LC]{法术效果：灌注命能}

items.name: 调整重心
items.expectedDescription: Applying a combination of vital energy and acupressure, you help the target regain its footing. The target loses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} condition if it has it. The target becomes immune to the off-guard condition until the start of your next turn, even if the condition would be circumstantially applied, such as by being flanked or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. The target is then immune to reorient for 10 minutes.
items.description: 结合使用元气和穴位按摩，帮助目标重新站稳。目标会失去@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]状态（如果有的话）。在下一回合开始前，目标将免疫措手不及状态，即使是被夹击或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]等会施加措手不及情况下也是如此。然后，目标在 10 分钟内对调整重心免疫。

items.name: 庇护术
items.expectedDescription:
You ward a creature with protective energy that deters attacks. Creatures attempting to attack the target must attempt a Will save each time. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends.

Critical Success Sanctuary ends.

Success The creature can attempt its attack and any other attacks against the target this turn.

Failure The creature can't attack the target and wastes the action. It can't attempt further attacks against the target this turn.

Critical Failure The creature wastes the action and can't attempt to attack the target for the rest of sanctuary's duration.
items.description:
你引动防护能量，保护一个生物抵御攻击。尝试攻击该目标的生物必须每次尝试一次意志豁免。如果目标使用敌对动作，该法术结束。

大成功 庇护术结束。

成功 该生物可以尝试这次攻击，并在本回合内继续对目标进行其他攻击。

失败 该生物无法攻击目标，并浪费该动作。本回合内它无法继续尝试攻击目标。

大失败 该生物浪费该动作，并且在庇护术剩余持续时间中均无法尝试攻击目标。

items.name: 灵魂链接
items.expectedDescription:
You form a spiritual link with another creature, taking in its pain. When you Cast this Spell and at the start of each of your turns, if the target is below maximum Hit Points, it regains 2 Hit Points (or the difference between its current and maximum Hit Points, if that's lower). You lose as many Hit Points as the target regained.

This is a spiritual transfer, so no effects apply that would increase the Hit Points the target regains or decrease the Hit Points you lose. This transfer also ignores any temporary Hit Points you or the target have. Since this effect doesn't involve vitality or void energy, spirit link works even if you or the target is undead. While the duration persists, you gain no benefit from regeneration or fast healing. You can Dismiss this spell, and if you're ever at 0 Hit Points, spirit link ends automatically.

Heightened (+1) The number of Hit Points transferred each time increases by 2.
items.description:
你和其他生物建立了一条灵魂链接，令你代为承受其苦痛。当你施放该法术，以及在你回合开始时，如果目标生命值低于其最大生命值，它回复2生命值（或者其当前生命值和最大生命值的差值，如果这更低）。你失去等于目标回复量的生命值。

这是一种基于灵魂的转移，所以没有任何效果会增加目标获得的生命值或者减少你失去的生命值。这种转移也会忽略你或者目标所拥有的任何临时生命值。由于该效果中没有任何命能或者虚能作用，灵魂链接在你或者目标为不死生物时也生效。在持续时间中，你不会从再生或者快速回复中受益。你可以解消该法术，并且一旦你为0生命值，灵魂链接自动结束。

升阶（+1） 每次转移的生命值增加2。

items.name: 稳定伤势
items.expectedDescription: Life energy shuts death's door. The target loses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} condition, though it remains @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} at 0 Hit Points.
items.description: 生命能量将目标从鬼门关拉回。目标失去 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{濒死} 状态，但它仍然 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{失去意识}，并为0生命值。

items.expectedName: +2 status to all saves vs. divine
items.name: 对抗神术的所有豁免获得+2状态加值
调谐灵光
items.expectedDescription: 60 feet. All allied creatures in the aura gain a +5-foot status bonus to Speeds (if the dragon is photon-attuned), or all enemies take a –5-foot status penalty to Speeds (if the dragon is graviton-attuned).
items.description: 60尺。灵光内所有盟友的各项速度获得+5尺状态加值（若龙与光量子调谐），或所有敌人的各项速度承受–5尺状态减值（若龙与引力子调谐）。

items.name: 反应打击
items.expectedDescription: @Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ReactiveStrike]
items.description: @Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ReactiveStrike]

items.name: 宇宙调谐
items.expectedDescription:
The cosmic dragon is always attuned to an underlying stellar force: either photons or gravitons. They can swap attunement as a free action once at the start of their turn in combat and is otherwise attuned to whichever force they choose at any time outside of combat. The dragon's melee Strikes deal an additional @Damage[2d6[fire]] damage while they're photon-attuned and an additional @Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]] damage plus Knockdown while they're graviton-attuned. The damage of their cosmic blast Strike is likewise determined by their current attunement, as are the effects of some of their other abilities. The dragon can choose to exclude any creatures from any effect of the aura or action that uses the aura.

The dragon can always sense the distance and direction to the nearest Drift beacon and to the Starstone on Absalom Station.
items.description:
宇宙龙始终与某种基本恒星之力调谐：光量子或引力子。战斗中，它可以在回合开始时以自由动作切换调谐，每次回合开始时仅限一次；战斗外则可随时选择与任意一种力量调谐。与光量子调谐时，龙的近战打击额外造成@Damage[2d6[fire]]伤害；与引力子调谐时，额外造成@Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]]伤害并附加击倒。其宇宙爆裂打击的伤害同样由当前调谐状态决定，部分其他能力的效应也是如此。龙可以选择任意生物，使其不受灵光或使用此灵光的动作所产生的任何效应影响。

龙始终能够感知最近的漂流信标和艾巴萨罗姆空间站的星石的距离与方向。

items.name: 星辰吐息
items.expectedDescription: The dragon unleashes divine power like that from the core of a star or black hole, dealing @Damage[7d10[spirit]|options:area-damage] damage in a @Template[type:cone|distance:30] (@Check[will|dc:29|basic|options:area-effect] save). The dragon can't use Stellar Breath for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.
items.description: 龙释放如同源自恒星或黑洞核心的神能，造成@Damage[7d10[spirit]|options:area-damage]伤害，影响@Template[type:cone|distance:30]（@Check[will|dc:29|basic|options:area-effect]豁免）。龙在[[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4轮}内无法使用星辰吐息。

items.name: 星辰微粒
items.expectedDescription: The dragon conjures a mote of stellar energy that shares their current attunement. They direct the mote to a square within 90 feet. While the mote is deployed, the dragon's attunement aura also emanates from that square, with the same emanation radius. The dragon can Sustain to move the mote up to 90 feet or to recall the mote from any distance. The mote is made of cosmic energy, doesn't occupy a space, and can't be targeted or destroyed by any effect.
items.description: 龙召唤一枚与其当前调谐状态一致的恒星能量微粒，并将其指引到90尺内的一个方格。微粒部署期间，龙的调谐灵光也会从该方格弥漫，弥漫半径相同。龙可以维持，以将微粒移动至多90尺，或从任意距离召回微粒。微粒由宇宙能量构成，不占据空间，也无法被任何效应选为目标或摧毁。

items.name: 星辰脉冲
items.expectedDescription:
The dragon imposes an effect on creatures within their attunement aura. The effect is based on the dragon's current attunement. The dragon can't use Stellar Pulse again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Stellar Pulse]]{1d4 rounds}.

  • Graviton Each creature must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:29|options:area-effect] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} for 1 round.

  • Photon Each creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} and can use the extra action only to Stride or Strike.
items.description:
龙对调谐灵光内的生物施加效应，效应取决于其当前的调谐状态。龙在[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Stellar Pulse]]{1d4轮}内无法再次使用星辰脉冲。

  • 引力子 每个生物必须成功通过@Check[fortitude|dc:29|options:area-effect]豁免，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}，持续1轮。

  • 光量子 每个生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{迅捷}，额外动作仅能用于行走或打击。

1RqCl3eyMXaPKaFZ.name: 青年宇宙龙（施法者） Cosmic Dragon (Young, Spellcaster)
1RqCl3eyMXaPKaFZ.publicNotes: 这些威严的龙体现了构成宇宙万物基础并维系其平衡的恒星之力。宇宙龙睿智、合群、耐心，接纳遇见的所有生灵；它们将所有生物视为宇宙中平等的组成部分，既可能与学者共同讨论天体物理，也可能与受压迫者一同感慨命运的曲折。大多数宇宙龙都能变身，但通常只是为了让其他生物感到自在。它们厌恶欺骗，即使处于另一种形态，也总会表明自己是龙。

1jR4M0O907VzjNnv.name: 铁流磁力聚合体 Ferrofluid Magneto-Cluster

items.name: 磁力感知
items.expectedDescription: A ferrofluid magneto-cluster can feel magnetic fields, allowing it to detect large sources of magnetic metal (Bulk 1 or greater) and items with the tech trait within the listed range.
items.description: 铁流体能感受到磁场，允许它侦测到所列范围内的大型磁性金属源（负载1或更大）以及具有科技特征的物体。

items.name: 磁场
items.expectedDescription: 30 feet. A ferrofluid magneto-cluster is surrounded by a constant field that interferes with nearby equipment. Items with the tech trait inside the aura take a –1 circumstance penalty to all checks using them. Unattended metal objects in the aura of 1 Bulk or less are pulled adjacent to the ooze.
items.description: （灵光，金，原能） 30 尺。铁流体泥怪周围环绕着常驻的磁场，会干扰附近的设备。在灵光内使用具有科技特征的物品时，所有使用这些物品进行的检定都会承受-1 环境减值。灵光内 1 负载及以下的无主金属物体会被拉至与泥怪相邻。

items.name: 附着
items.expectedDescription:
A ferrofluid magneto-cluster can attach itself to any creature its size or larger that has the tech trait or is wearing or wielding items with the tech trait. This is similar to Grab, but the ooze moves with that creature rather than holding it in place.

As long as the ooze is attached, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}, and the creature it's attached to must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:11] to Interact with items with the tech trait. On a failure, the item becomes attached to the ooze (treat as if being held by the ooze).
items.description:
铁流体磁力聚合体可以附着在体型与其相同或更大，且自身具有科技特征或穿戴、持用具有科技特征物品的生物身上。这与擒获类似，但泥怪会随该生物移动，而非将其固定在原地。

泥怪附着期间会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}，被附着的生物必须成功通过@Check[flat|dc:11]，才能与具有科技特征的物品交互。失败时，物品附着在泥怪身上（视为被泥怪持握）。

items.name: 消磁
items.expectedDescription: A ferrofluid magneto-cluster that takes fire damage has its magnetic field deactivated until the end of the ooze's next turn. It releases itself from any creature it was attached to, drops any held items, and can't use Magnetic Leap or Attach until its magnetic field returns.
items.description: 受到火焰伤害的铁流体泥怪的磁场会失效，直到该泥怪的下回合结束。它会从其附着的任何生物身上脱离，丢弃所持握的任何物品，并且在磁场恢复之前无法使用磁力跳跃或附着。

items.name: 磁力跳跃
items.expectedDescription: The ferrofluid magneto-cluster instantly Attaches to a creature within its magnetic field that meets the requirements of that ability. A ferrofluid ooze can't use this ability again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Magnetic Leap]]{1d4 rounds}.
items.description: 铁流体磁力聚合体立即对其磁场内、满足附着能力需求的一个生物使用附着。铁流体泥怪在[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Magnetic Leap]]{1d4轮}内无法再次使用此能力。

items.name: 金属风暴
items.expectedDescription: The ferrofluid magneto-cluster contracts, then spews metal shards in a @Template[type:cone|distance:30], dealing @Damage[5d8[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic] save). Any creature that fails its save is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 round (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} on a critical failure).
items.description: 铁流体磁力聚合体收缩，随后向@Template[type:cone|distance:30]喷出金属碎片，造成@Damage[5d8[piercing]|options:area-damage]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic]豁免）。任何豁免失败的生物还会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙1}，持续1轮（大失败时为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙2}）。

items.name: 磁极转换
items.expectedDescription:
The ferrofluid magneto-cluster shifts the polarity of its magnetic field, causing it to briefly repulse magnetic objects. Each creature in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:30] save or else they're forced to drop any items with the tech trait they're wielding in an adjacent square.

In addition, each creature with the tech trait or wearing armor with the tech trait must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:30] save or be knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.
items.description:
铁流体磁力聚合体改变其磁场的极性，使其短暂排斥磁性物体。@Template[type:emanation|distance:30]内的每个生物必须尝试@Check[reflex|dc:30]豁免，否则被迫将其持用的所有科技特征物品丢在相邻方格内。

此外，每个具有科技特征或穿戴科技特征护甲的生物必须成功通过@Check[fortitude|dc:30]豁免，否则被击倒而@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}。

1jR4M0O907VzjNnv.publicNotes:
磁力聚合体通常由数个较小的铁流体泥怪结合而成，但也有记录表明，这些生物会在大型工业事故后自发出现。与体型较小的“表亲”一样，磁力聚合体泥怪会寻找电磁源，也会搜寻并吞噬磁性物体及能够被磁化的金属。它们完全无视有机生命，通常只有在生命体不愿交出磁性材料时才会构成危险。一些聚合体吞噬了太多金属和物品，以至于被误认为拾荒黏怪。任何被磁力聚合体吞噬的金属都会立即获得磁性。

作为活体磁力加速器，铁流体磁力聚合体泥怪能够高速发射收集到的金属，以此防卫。其发射速度极高，连一片普通金属碎片都能加速到足以穿透高科技防弹护甲。

银河各处的阴暗废弃之地潜伏着许多种泥怪，它们只为满足食欲才会现身，对冒险者、探险家和不幸的工人构成同样的威胁。
