2DMxWPhGQfZQot2k.name: 刻法克虫 Khefak
2DMxWPhGQfZQot2k.publicNotes:
初次遇见刻法克虫的探险者不仅会惊讶于它的攻击性，也会惊讶于它攻击的目标：护甲和其他装备。在刻法克虫领地中，缺乏经验的探险者远征归来时真的两手空空并不罕见，令当地人颇感好笑。

刻法克生物基因公司通过生物工程培育刻法克虫，让它们吞噬煞油废料，以将废料精炼成星舰燃料。这些生物最终却成为了解决方案自身变成问题的典型例子。漂流域航行被发现后，阿基顿的煞油市场崩溃，采矿设施——包括刻法克虫——也随之失去了需求。刻法克生物基因公司摧毁了生产设施，以为已经彻底消灭了自己的造物。然而刻法克虫生命力顽强，少数幸存者离开了设施。除煞油外，它们也能以无机材料为食，繁殖速度又极快，因此迅速遍布阿基顿。其中一些偷渡到星舰上，得以扩散至整个协约世界。

items.name: 啃食废料
items.expectedDescription: A khefak chews on an unattended object to feed, dealing @Damage[4[piercing]] damage every 10 minutes to the object. This damage ignores 10 points of Hardness. If a khefak doesn't spend at least 1 hour Gnawing Scrap per day, it begins to starve until it spends 10 minutes Gnawing Scrap.
items.description: 刻法克虫啃咬无主物体以进食，每10分钟对其造成@Damage[4[piercing]]伤害。此伤害忽略10点硬度。若刻法克虫每天未花费至少1小时啃食废料，它便开始挨饿，直至花费10分钟啃食废料。

2DtTG1VJ5KPM83Wu.name: 接生圣者利贝罗巴 Liberoba Midwife
2DtTG1VJ5KPM83Wu.publicNotes:
利贝罗巴为新诞者接生。众多肢体从这个生物怪异的身体上伸出，每一条的末端都是血淋淋的奥克腾岩剪刀。

十三名凡人接生者照料了新诞者的降生，并因这位初生外神的觉醒而转化成诡异的存在。只要这个位面上还留有哪怕一粒奥克腾岩——曾经包裹新诞者的行星胎盘的冰冻碎块之名——接生圣者便总能再生出一模一样的新躯体。

接生圣者共有13种，但其真正数量无人知晓。他们的名字是否源自那些灵魂被用作创造接生圣者的火种的凡人仆从，或是对新诞者另有含义，同样是个谜。

每名接生圣者都以自己照料新诞者的方式来定义自身：包裹襁褓、喂养、背负、怀抱、守望、看护、祝福，或为这位外神提供其他养育之举。接生圣者是能够跨维度旅行的强大存在。他们可能出现在漂流域、艾布萨罗姆空间站的幽灵层等阈限空间，也可能现身于极寒边域的奥克腾岩碎片云中。他们难以理解的行动总在推进新诞者莫测的计划——或是他们自己的计划。

协约世界与接生圣团最为人熟知的遭遇，就发生在新诞者刚刚降生之后。为新诞者包裹襁褓、脸旁环绕着蠕动触须兜帽的阿姆涅卡直接袭击了艾布萨罗姆空间站，引发巨大能量涌动，危及站内所有人的生命。混乱随之爆发，但一群恰巧在正确时机搭上正确电梯的冒险者来到了空间站的幽灵层，在那里挫败了阿姆涅卡，阻止这名接生圣者汲取空间站反应堆的能量。此事之后，接生圣团再未如此直接地出手，但许多人怀疑这只是时间问题，也没人知道其他接生圣者究竟有多强大。

items.name: 警示波动
items.expectedDescription:
You deter enemies with a wave of hostile intent. The target takes 7d8 nonlethal mental damage, and the target must attempt a Will save. The psychic energy then arcs to another creature within 30 feet of the first target, jumps to another creature within 30 feet of that target, and so on. You can end the wave at any point. You can't target the same creature more than once, and you must have line of effect to all targets. Roll the damage only once, and apply it to each target (halving or doubling as appropriate for its saving throw outcome).

Critical Success The target creature is unaffected, and the wave ends with that target.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d8.
items.description:
你以一波敌意威慑敌人。目标受到7d8非致命心灵伤害，并且必须尝试意志豁免。随后，心灵能量会跃向初始目标30尺内的另一个生物，再跳向该生物30尺内的另一个生物，以此类推。你可以在任何时候终止波动。你不能以同一生物为目标超过一次，并且必须对所有目标都具有效果线。只掷一次伤害骰，再将伤害应用于每个目标（根据其豁免结果适当地减半或翻倍）。

大成功 目标生物不受影响，且波动在该目标处终止。

成功 目标受到一半伤害。

失败 目标受到全部伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧1}。

大失败 目标受到双倍伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧2}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加2d8。

items.name: 怪异怒火
items.expectedDescription:
You channel the bizarre powers that exist beyond the outer reaches of the universe, dealing 3d12 mental damage to each creature in the area as phantasmal claws, jaws, and tentacles lash out at each target. Each creature in the area must attempt a Will save. The area is difficult terrain for any creature sickened by the effects of this spell.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d12.
items.description:
你引导存在于宇宙外缘之外的怪异力量，幻影利爪、巨颚与触须鞭打每个目标，对区域内每个生物造成3d12心灵伤害。区域内每个生物都必须尝试意志豁免。对因本法术效果陷入恶心的任何生物而言，该区域为困难地形。

大成功 生物不受影响。

成功 生物受到一半伤害。

失败 该生物受到全部伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}。

大失败 生物受到双倍伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心2}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d12。

items.name: 熵击
items.expectedDescription:
You unleash a ray of entropy that rapidly and indiscriminately decays matter. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, the target takes 5d8 void damage, or it takes 2d6 persistent acid damage and is glitching 1 if it has the tech trait. On a critical hit, double the damage, and if the creature has the tech trait, it's glitching 2 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1 die.
items.description:
你释放一道熵射线，迅速且不加区分地使物质衰败。对目标的AC进行一次远程法术攻击。命中时，目标受到5d8虚能伤害；若目标具有科技特征，则改为受到2d6持续酸蚀伤害，并陷入故障1。重击时，伤害翻倍；若该生物具有科技特征，则还会陷入故障2和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑1}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1个伤害骰。

items.name: 分担痛苦
items.expectedDescription:
You telepathically share the sensation of agonizing pain with a creature. The target takes 3d12 mental damage and attempts a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} for 1 minute.

Heightened (6th) The spell targets up to four creatures and deals 6d12 mental damage.
items.description:
你以心灵感应向一个生物分享剧痛的感受。目标受到3d12心灵伤害，并尝试意志豁免。

大成功 生物不受影响。

成功 生物受到一半伤害。

失败 生物受到全部伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙1}，持续1分钟。

大失败 生物受到全部伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙2}，持续1分钟。

升阶（6环） 法术至多以四个生物为目标，并造成6d12心灵伤害。

items.name: 噪鸣爆
items.expectedDescription:
A cacophonous noise blasts out, dealing 2d10 sonic damage. Each creature must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is deafened for 1 minute, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10.
items.description:
刺耳的噪音迸裂而出，造成2d10音波伤害。每个生物必须尝试一次强韧豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物承受一半伤害。

失败 该生物承受完整伤害，并且@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{耳聋}1轮。

大失败 该生物承受双倍伤害，耳聋1分钟，并且@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 1}。

升阶（+1） 该伤害增加1d10。

items.name: 灵魂激涌
items.expectedDescription:
You channel your life force into a spear of energy. You lose 6 Hit Points or, if you're in a bond with a vitality network that has at least 12 Hit Points, you can reduce the vitality bond's Hit Points by 12 instead. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, you deal 6d6 spirit damage. On a critical hit, the target takes double damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}.

Heightened (+1) Increase the damage dealt by 2d6 and the Hit Points lost by 2 (or by 4 if you spend Hit Points from a vitality network).
items.description:
你将生命力引导成一支能量长矛。你失去6点生命值；或者，若你与一个至少有12点生命值的命能网络联结，可以改为将命能联结的生命值减少12点。对目标的AC进行一次远程法术攻击。命中时，你造成6d6精魂伤害。重击时，目标受到双倍伤害并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失1}。

升阶（+1） 造成的伤害增加2d6，失去的生命值增加2点（若消耗命能网络的生命值，则增加4点）。

items.name: 诡枪术
items.expectedDescription:
You condense a beam of mind-assaulting eldritch energy from the dark spaces between the stars and fire it at a target. Make a ranged spell attack roll against the target's AC. If you hit, you deal 2d6 mental damage. On a critical success, you deal double damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你自星辰之间的幽深领域凝聚一束袭魂慑魄的怪异能量攻击目标。尝试一次远程法术攻击骰对抗目标的AC，如果命中，你造成2d6心灵伤害，在大成功时造成双倍伤害。

升阶（+1）伤害增加1d6。

items.name: 心灵穿刺
items.expectedDescription:
You overload a creature's mind with a glut of psychic information or divine judgments. The mental onslaught deals 2d6 mental damage. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.
items.description:
你以海量心灵信息或神圣审判冲击一个生物的心智。这股精神猛攻造成2d6心灵伤害。大失败时，目标还会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞2}，持续1轮。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加2d6。

items.name: 音波尖啸
items.expectedDescription:
You unleash a painfully rapid cone of vibrations by letting out a cathartic scream, dealing 1d8 sonic damage to creatures in the area with a basic Fortitude save. A creature that fails its saving throw also becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Heightened (+1) Increases the damage by 1d8.
items.description:
你发出一声宣泄情绪的尖叫，释放出振动快得令人痛苦的锥形音波，对区域内的生物造成1d8音波伤害，进行基础强韧豁免。豁免失败的生物还会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心1}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d8。

items.name: 再生20（由心灵或圣洁伤害阻止）
items.expectedDescription: @Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Regeneration]
items.description: @Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Regeneration]

items.name: 超声波脉冲
items.expectedDescription:
100 feet. Liberoba constantly emits sonic pulses that are disruptive to biomatter. Creatures that enter or begin their turn in the aura must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:28] save to resist the nauseating pulses. On a failure, a creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} for 1 round; on a critical failure, it's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} for 1 round.

Liberoba can sense the presence of any creature inside ultrasonic pulse's area. This functions as an imprecise sense. Liberoba treats a creature that fail its save against ultrasonic pulse as though they can always see it, ignoring the effects of any cover, concealment, invisibility, or similar effects, as long as the creature remains inside the aura.
items.description:
100尺。利贝罗巴持续释放干扰生物质的声波脉冲。进入灵光或在其内开始回合的生物必须尝试@Check[fortitude|dc:28]豁免，以抵抗令人作呕的脉冲。失败时，生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心2}，持续1轮；大失败时，它还会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑1}，持续1轮。

利贝罗巴能感知超声波脉冲区域内任何生物的存在，这视为一种不精确感官。只要生物仍留在灵光内，利贝罗巴便视为始终能够看见对抗超声波脉冲的豁免失败的生物，忽略任何掩蔽、隐蔽、隐形或类似效应。

items.name: 中断接生
items.expectedDescription: Liberoba pulls all enemies within 30 feet up to 30 feet toward them, into an adjacent square if possible; each target can negate this movement with a successful @Check[fortitude|dc:28] save. Liberoba then makes an aucturnite shears Strike against each adjacent foe. These attacks count as one Strike for the purposes of calculating their multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after all the attacks. Targets that succeed at their saves are temporarily immune to Breach Delivery for 1 hour.
items.description: 利贝罗巴将30尺内的所有敌人向自身拉近至多30尺，尽可能拉入相邻方格；每个目标可通过成功的@Check[fortitude|dc:28]豁免来抵消此次移动。利贝罗巴随后对每个相邻敌人进行一次奥克腾岩剪刀打击。这些攻击在计算其多重攻击减值时视为一次打击，但多重攻击减值直到所有攻击结束后才会增加。豁免成功的目标临时免疫中断接生1小时。

items.name: 寰宇挛缩
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger Liberoba's turn begins

Effect Liberoba radiates powerful contractions in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:20] around them. Each creature in the area takes @Damage[3d10[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[fortitude|dc:28|basic] save. On a critical failure, the creature is also knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.
items.description:
触发 利贝罗巴的回合开始

效果 利贝罗巴在自身周围的@Template[type:emanation|distance:20]内散发强烈的挛缩。区域内每个生物受到@Damage[3d10[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage]伤害，进行@Check[fortitude|dc:28|basic]豁免。大失败时，生物还会被击倒而@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}。

items.name: 返回奥克腾
items.expectedDescription: Presulea teleports to the location of any aucturnite fragment within a planetary range. Presulea automatically uses this ability as a free action when reduced to 0 Hit Points as long as a piece of aucturnite is within range, reforming their body and recovering completely over the next 24 hours.
items.description: （传送） 利贝罗巴传送至行星距离内任意有奥克腾岩的位置。如果利贝罗巴降至0生命值，它以自由动作自动使用此能力，并且只要奥克腾岩处于范围内，它就能在24小时候重构其身体并完全恢复。

cnText_system_attributes_hp_details.text: 再生20（由心灵或圣洁伤害阻止）

2PVFsdaTR9mTfCid.name: 死链尸妖 Necrolinked Wight
2PVFsdaTR9mTfCid.publicNotes: 双眼空洞的死链尸妖是一类死于过度沉迷社交媒体之人化作的不死生物，它们游荡于现实与虚拟世界，渴求着互动与存在感。在他们眼中，所有生者全都是潜在的关注者，仅此而已。死链尸妖追猎那些涉足科技的人，妄图将他们变成痴迷的粉丝。他们不断用精简的魔法科技代码发出哀嚎，仿佛在对着某个早已被人遗忘的网络辩论尖叫，试图通过经由超自然配置过的内容覆写设备进而吸引他人的注意力。然而一旦他们的受害者被死链上，这些新晋的死链尸妖便会失去兴趣，被同样的黑暗死灵算法驱使。

items.name: 通讯单元
items.expectedDescription:
A personal comm unit is a pocket-sized device that combines a minor portable computer and a cellular communications device, allowing instantaneous wireless communication with other comm units in both audio- and text-based formats at planetary range. A personal comm unit also includes a calculator, a flashlight (emits bright light in a 5-foot radius around you and dim light in the next 5 feet), a browser that accesses any local infospheres, and several entertainment options (including games).

Personal comm units integrated into armor have some voice-activated capabilities; you can communicate with other comm units in audio-based formats and receive responses without needing a free hand, but typing a message, browsing the infosphere, or using an app requires the use of at least one hand.

Comm units that function at longer ranges aren't as portable; they include built-in generators that provide the necessary amount of power and rely on active Drift beacons to communicate. Short-term use of these units can be purchased in most major settlements.
items.description:
个人通讯单元是一款集微型编写计算机和蜂窝通讯设备于一体的袖珍设备，可在行星范围内以文本和音频形式与其他通讯单元即时性无线通讯。一款个人通讯单元也集成了计算器，手电筒（在周围发出5尺明亮光照和相邻的5尺昏暗光照），一个可访问任何当地信息圈的浏览器，以及几个包含游戏在内的娱乐选项。

护甲集成型个人通讯单元具备声控功能；你不需要一只空闲手便可以音频形式和其他通讯单元交流并接受回复，但是发送文本，浏览信息圈或使用应用程序仍需占用至少一只手。

长距离通讯单元便携性较低；其包含内置的供能单元来提供必要数额的功率，且依赖激活的漂流信标进行交流。多数定居点都提供这些终端的短期使用服务。

items.name: 已匹配的通讯单元
items.expectedDescription: The comm unit of a necrolinked wight can be disabled for 1 hour with a successful DC 15 check to Disable a Device or Disable a System. A necrolinked wight with a disabled comm unit is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}, gains a +6 bonus to Perception, and can't Check its Feed.
items.description: 成功通过DC 15的解除装置或解除系统检定，可使死链尸妖的通讯器失效1小时。通讯器失效的死链尸妖陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢1}，察觉获得+6加值，且无法检查信息流。

items.name: 社交媒体成瘾
items.expectedDescription: The necrolinked wight is driven by a desire to continue their cycles of spiteful hatred and media consumption on the infosphere. They spend their first action of each round to Check Feed. Eternally obsessed, a necrolinked wight will always try to stay within range of an active infosphere signal. A necrolinked wight with no infosphere access or perceived threats functions as if their aligned comm unit was disabled and does whatever it can to regain infosphere access.
items.description: （神术）死链尸妖渴望在信息圈重复恶毒恨意和信息消费的永恒循环。受着欲望驱使，他们每轮第一个行动永远是使用检查信息流能力。屈服于永恒的痴迷，死链尸妖永远会试图呆在信息圈信号活跃的范围内。无法访问信息圈或是没有感知到威胁的死链尸妖会如同他们的通讯单元被禁用了一般行动，并会尽其所能地重新访问信息圈。

items.name: 检查信息流
items.expectedDescription: The necrolinked wight looks up information on their aligned comm unit about a specific creature using Computers instead of any other skill. On a success, the creature takes a –2 status penalty to its next Will save against necrotic transmission for 1 minute ( –3 status penalty on a critical success).
items.description: 死链尸妖在其已匹配的通讯器上查找一个特定生物的信息，使用计算机而非其他任何技能。成功时，该生物的下一次对抗死灵传输的意志豁免承受–2状态减值，持续1分钟（大成功时为–3状态减值）。

items.name: 死灵传输
items.expectedDescription: A creature that takes damage from a necrolinked wight's Shriek must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:15] save, or its subconscious is scanned and used to infect its non-augmentation tech items with a virus. Infected tech items display algorithmically generated content catering specifically to the creature's deepest desires, causing the creature to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} as long as they're holding or wearing the tech item. On a critical failure, the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated}, and all creatures and objects other than the tech item are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} from the creature. The creature or its allies can end the effect on any specific tech item by Interacting to reboot the affected item and succeeding at a @Check[computers|dc:15] check; on a failure, the item becomes glitching 1 (glitching 2 on a critical failure).
items.description: 受到死链尸妖嚎叫伤害的生物必须成功通过一次@Check[will|dc:15]豁免，否则其潜意识会被扫描，并被用来向其非殖装类科技物品植入病毒。受感染的科技物品显示由算法生成、专门迎合该生物内心最深欲望的内容，使该生物在持握或穿戴此科技物品期间陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}。大失败时，该生物还陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{迷魂}，且除该科技物品以外的所有生物和物体，对该生物而言均处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。该生物或其盟友可以通过交互重启受影响的物品，并成功通过一次@Check[computers|dc:15]检定，来结束任一特定科技物品上的效果；失败时，该物品陷入故障1（大失败时为故障2）。

items.name: 注册衍体
items.expectedDescription: A living creature that dies while @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by necrotic transmission rises as a necrolinked wight after [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.
items.description: 一个活物若在被死灵传输@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{迷魂}时死亡，就会在[[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4轮}后复生为死链尸妖。

2lUmJOYTvroP2Yas.name: 瑞瓦林兽终灵 Rivarin Endling
2lUmJOYTvroP2Yas.publicNotes:
瑞瓦林兽是毛茸茸的，长着扁齿，三眼的四足草食动物，在寒冷的德斯塔隆二号（Destalon-2）上被封建社会作为驮兽饲养。瑞瓦林兽与其初生的社会一同被烬蛛族灭绝。烬蛛族很快便逃离了该星球，据称是在遭遇了长着锯齿状獠牙，凶恶红眼的幽灵巨兽袭击之后。

每个物种在诞生与进化过程中都遵循着自然的弧线：兴起、繁荣、衰落，最终走向灭绝。当这些轨迹遭遇极端非自然的终结——意外捕食、工业化浪潮或外来病原体摧毁种群时——终灵便诞生了。这些灭绝物种的幽魂成员，往往作为对自身灭绝的"回应"而诞生。异星生物学家对终灵的起源众说纷纭，无法确认它们究竟是物种最后集体悲恸的具象化，还是复仇的个体精魂——那些最后熄灭的微光。

items.name: 战争视觉
items.expectedDescription: A rivarin endling can sense the presence of bleeding, frightened, or wounded creatures as a precise sense at the listed range.
items.description: 瑞瓦林兽终灵能在所列范围内以精确感官感知到处于流血，惊惧或受伤状态的生物的存在。

items.name: 反应打击
items.expectedDescription: @Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ReactiveStrike]
items.description: @Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ReactiveStrike]

items.name: 复生
items.expectedDescription: When an endling is destroyed, it reforms after [[/gmr 2d4 #days]]{2d4 days} within the area where it first emerged, fully healed. An endling can be permanently destroyed only if someone determines the reason for its existence and sets right whatever prevents the spirit from resting, such as an act of decolonization, ecological restoration, or curing the disease responsible for its extinction.
items.description: 终灵被摧毁后，会在[[/gmr 2d4 #days]]{2d4天}后于它最初出现的区域内重组，恢复全部生命值。只有当有人查明其存在的缘由，并消除阻碍灵魂安息的因素，例如采取去殖民化行动、进行生态修复，或治愈导致其灭绝的疾病，才能永久摧毁终灵。

items.name: 虚能治疗
items.expectedDescription: @Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.NegativeHealing]
items.description: @Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.NegativeHealing]

items.name: 渴血
items.expectedDescription: Creatures hit by a rivarin endling's Strikes must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:29] save or take @Damage[1d10[persistent,bleed]] damage.
items.description: 被瑞瓦林兽终灵的打击命中的生物必须成功通过@Check[fortitude|dc:29]豁免，否则受到@Damage[1d10[persistent,bleed]]伤害。

items.name: 恫吓
items.expectedDescription:
The rivarin endling Flies, then rears up in a terrifying display. Creatures within 30 feet must attempt a @Check[will|dc:29] save.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} and must spend the first action of its next turn @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing}.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and fleeing for 1 round.
items.description:
瑞瓦林兽终灵飞行，随后昂首挺立，展现可怕的姿态。30尺内生物必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:29]豁免。

成功 生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧1}。

失败 生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧2}，且必须将其下一回合的第一个动作用于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}。

大失败 生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧3}，并逃跑1轮。

2oGp04TzbcaiLlOa.name: 活化科技护甲 Animated Tech Armor
2oGp04TzbcaiLlOa.publicNotes:
活化科技护甲擅长担任忠诚的保镖、训练假人或安保。

物品可通过多种方式被活化，从而承担多样功能。自古以来，武器与盔甲便通过魔法或仪式被赋予生命，化作守护者与哨兵。

items.name: 不可靠科技

items.name: 宇宙调谐
items.expectedDescription:
The cosmic dragon is always attuned to an underlying stellar force: either photons or gravitons. They can swap attunement as a free action once at the start of their turn in combat and is otherwise attuned to whichever force they choose at any time outside of combat. The dragon's melee Strikes deal an additional @Damage[2d6[fire]] damage while they're photon-attuned and an additional @Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]] damage plus Knockdown while they're graviton-attuned. The damage of their cosmic blast Strike is likewise determined by their current attunement, as are the effects of some of their other abilities. The dragon can choose to exclude any creatures from any effect of the aura or action that uses the aura.

The dragon can always sense the distance and direction to the nearest Drift beacon and to the Starstone on Absalom Station.
items.description:
宇宙龙始终与某种基本恒星之力调谐：光量子或引力子。战斗中，它可以在回合开始时以自由动作切换调谐，每次回合开始时仅限一次；战斗外则可随时选择与任意一种力量调谐。与光量子调谐时，龙的近战打击额外造成@Damage[2d6[fire]]伤害；与引力子调谐时，额外造成@Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]]伤害并附加击倒。其宇宙爆裂打击的伤害同样由当前调谐状态决定，部分其他能力的效应也是如此。龙可以选择任意生物，使其不受灵光或使用此灵光的动作所产生的任何效应影响。

龙始终能够感知最近的漂流信标和艾巴萨罗姆空间站的星石的距离与方向。

items.name: 龙之狂怒
items.expectedDescription: The dragon makes two claw Strikes and one tail Strike in any order.
items.description: 龙按任意顺序进行两次爪部打击和一次尾部打击。

items.name: 龙之威势
items.expectedDescription: The dragon recharges their Stellar Breath whenever they score a critical hit with a Strike.
items.description: 每当龙的打击重击时，它便为星辰吐息重新充能。

items.name: 星辰吐息
items.expectedDescription: The dragon unleashes divine power like that from the core of a star or black hole, dealing @Damage[7d10[spirit]|options:area-damage] damage in a @Template[type:cone|distance:30] (@Check[will|dc:29|basic] save). The dragon can't use Stellar Breath for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.
items.description: 龙释放如同来自恒星或黑洞核心的神圣力量，造成@Damage[7d10[spirit]|options:area-damage]伤害，范围为@Template[type:cone|distance:30]（@Check[will|dc:29|basic]豁免）。龙在[[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4轮}内无法使用星辰吐息。

items.name: 星辰微粒
items.expectedDescription: The dragon conjures a mote of stellar energy that shares their current attunement. They direct the mote to a square within 90 feet. While the mote is deployed, the dragon's attunement aura also emanates from that square, with the same emanation radius. The dragon can Sustain to move the mote up to 90 feet or to recall the mote from any distance. The mote is made of cosmic energy, doesn't occupy a space, and can't be targeted or destroyed by any effect.
items.description: 龙召唤一枚与其当前调谐状态一致的恒星能量微粒，并将其指引到90尺内的一个方格。微粒部署期间，龙的调谐灵光也会从该方格弥漫，弥漫半径相同。龙可以维持，以将微粒移动至多90尺，或从任意距离召回微粒。微粒由宇宙能量构成，不占据空间，也无法被任何效应选为目标或摧毁。

items.name: 星辰脉冲
items.expectedDescription:
The dragon imposes an effect on creatures within their attunement aura. The effect is based on the dragon's current attunement. The dragon can't use Stellar Pulse again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Stellar Pulse]]{1d4 rounds}.

  • Graviton Each creature must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:29] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} for 1 round.

  • Photon Each creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} and can use the extra action only to Stride or Strike.
items.description:
龙对调谐灵光内的生物施加效应，效应取决于其当前的调谐状态。龙在[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Stellar Pulse]]{1d4轮}内无法再次使用星辰脉冲。

  • 引力子 每个生物必须成功通过@Check[fortitude|dc:29]豁免，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}，持续1轮。

2xUsBYfaAcvd82UJ.name: 青年宇宙龙 Cosmic Dragon (Young)
2xUsBYfaAcvd82UJ.publicNotes: 这些威严的龙体现了构成宇宙万物基础并维系其平衡的恒星之力。宇宙龙睿智、合群、耐心，接纳遇见的所有生灵；它们将所有生物视为宇宙中平等的组成部分，既可能与学者共同讨论天体物理，也可能与受压迫者一同感慨命运的曲折。大多数宇宙龙都能变身，但通常只是为了让其他生物感到自在。它们厌恶欺骗，即使处于另一种形态，也总会表明自己是龙。

2yV2zP6CiddspRxM.name: 尸骸舰队军官 Corpse Fleet Officer
2yV2zP6CiddspRxM.publicNotes:
尸骸舰队军官是胆识过人的战斗领袖，能增强其不死盟友，并受训以消灭生者。

尸骸舰队是由拒绝屈服于生者意志的不死至上主义者组成的军队。尸骸舰队由伊奥克斯海军叛逃者建立，旨在瓦解协约世界的团结，将伊奥克斯从生者，以及站在他们那边的骨贤的影响中解放出来。尸骸舰队顽强不屈且极其残忍，以死亡与毁灭为业，吞噬生者，剥削亡者。

34uf5wsM7LwBxhmw.name: 羚豹 Arabuk
34uf5wsM7LwBxhmw.publicNotes:
羚豹需要3年才能成年。随着每年成长，它们的鹿角会愈发壮观，有些个体的鹿角长度甚至能超过15尺。

在阿基顿星的冬域地区旅行时，人们可能会遭遇当地顶级掠食者——食肉性的羚豹。

On a slope, this causes the snow and any creatures that fail its save to move downhill 30 feet per round. items.description: 站在雪上的非羚豹生物，若对羚豹的犄角回响进行反射豁免失败，便被击倒而陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}。犄角回响区域内至多@Template[cube|distance:20]的积雪崩塌，造成@Damage[5d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage]伤害，影响相邻生物（@Check[reflex|dc:24|basic|options:area-effect]豁免）。斜坡上，这会使积雪和所有豁免失败的生物每轮朝下坡移动30尺。每个被卷入雪崩的生物在其回合开始时受到@Damage[3d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:24|basic|options:area-effect]豁免），失败时仍被困在雪崩中。

items.description: 羚豹摇头，使犄角相互碰撞。直到其回合结束，任何被其犄角命中的生物都必须通过一次@Check[fortitude|dc:22|options:inflicts:stunned]豁免，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑1}（大失败时为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑2}）。

3ZxpWhscwtELicqD.name: 经理魔（执照魔鬼） Wahtunshna
3ZxpWhscwtELicqD.publicNotes:
经理魔是经纪人、商业谈判专家和战争投机者。他们活跃于马尔法涅（Malfane）诸城与水行星恩布罗伊（Embroi），并日益频繁地出席近宇的企业法务会议。这些魔鬼精通谈判、工商管理及上百种文化中的企业术语，在为公司提供竞争优势的同时，也为自身建立声誉。地狱的知识与工业力量对许多谋求压制竞争对手的企业极具诱惑力，而经理魔也极乐于提供协助。企业以在产品中植入间谍软件、在服务条款中添加魔鬼条款为代价，换取使用地狱知识产权的机会，并将这些地狱式臃肿软件转嫁给客户。有传言称，经理魔会尽可能助推初创企业的频繁更迭，暗中破坏任何试图突破或绕开魔鬼协议条款的公司。

在空间站的阴影深处、法庭的庄严厅堂以及企业集团的办公室之中，魔鬼们以力量为诱饵引诱凡人，为魔鬼的征服铺平道路。魔鬼的契约形式多样，可能是精心拟定的正式协议，也可能是转瞬即逝的口头承诺，但最终结果都如出一辙：一个凡人的灵魂被定罪，地狱的势力则因此得到壮大。从马尔法涅（Malfane）公开的统治，到恩布罗伊（Embroi）隐秘的控制，再到与银河各地灵魂之间暗中缔结的契约，魔鬼们不断推进他们冷酷无情的事业，将暴政四处散播，迫使宇宙变得愈发像他们那地狱般的官僚国度。

items.name: 虚空低语
items.expectedDescription:
The target hears ominous sounds containing unspeakable mysteries from beyond the stars that disorient its mind. The target attempts a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The target hears the strange whispers, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target begins to wander aimlessly, using each action to Step in a random direction. When it moves, the target takes the safest route and doesn't enter hazardous terrain. The spell has a duration of 1 minute or until a creature uses a hostile action against the target.

Critical Failure As failure, except the target babbles incoherently. Any creature that begins its turn within 20 feet of the target must attempt a Will saving throw. On a failure, it must use its first action on its next turn to Step in a random direction and becomes immune to this spell for 24 hours. This is an incapacitation effect.
items.description:
目标听见来自群星之外的不祥声响，其中蕴含不可言说的奥秘，令它心智迷乱。目标尝试意志豁免。

大成功 生物不受影响。

成功 目标听到奇怪的低语，陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞1}，持续1轮。

失败 目标开始漫无目的地游荡，每个动作都会向一个随机方向快步。目标移动时会选择最安全的路线，且不会进入危险地形。此法术持续1分钟，或直到有生物对目标采取敌意动作。

大失败 如同失败，但目标还会语无伦次地呓语。任何在目标20尺内开始回合的生物都必须尝试意志豁免。失败时，它必须用下个回合的第一个动作向随机方向快步，然后对此法术免疫24小时。这是失能效果。

items.name: 侦测思想
items.expectedDescription:
You sense the presence of thinking creatures around you. You detect the presence or absence of thoughts from conscious creatures that have Intelligence modifiers of –3 or higher. You can choose to ignore the thoughts of creatures you're familiar with so they don't interfere with your detection of other thoughts. The spell can penetrate some barriers, but 3 feet of dirt or wood, 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of metal, a thin sheet of lead, or any force barrier blocks it. Creatures who are immune to mental effects are immune to detection by this spell.

Heightened (4th) You detect the number of thinking minds and whether or not the creatures are telepathic. Creatures with telepathy have louder thoughts than creatures who don't have telepathy and might be able to sense your intrusion, at the GM's discretion.
items.description:
你能感知周围生物的想法。你可以侦测周围是否存在智力调整值不低于-3的清醒生物的思维。可选择忽略熟悉生物的思维，避免干扰其他目标的侦测。该法术可以穿透一些障碍，但3尺的泥土或木头、1尺的石头、1英寸的金属、薄薄的铅片或任何立场障碍都会阻挡它。对心灵效果免疫的生物对该法术的侦测免疫。

升阶（4环）你可侦测范围内存在思维活动的意识体数量，并判断其是否具备心灵感应能力。拥有心灵感应能力的生物思维波动更强，普通生物思维信号较弱且无反馈，具体由GM裁定。

items.name: 末日刷屏
items.expectedDescription:
You magically broadcast grim news onto nearby devices, holo projectors, screens, and other displays (including comm units on armor). Creatures in the area who can see one or more displays must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by the display.

Failure The creature is fascinated by the display and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} (even if the fascination ends).

Critical Failure The creature is fascinated by the display, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1} (even if the fascination ends).
items.description:
你以魔法在附近的设备、全息投影仪、屏幕及其他显示装置（包括护甲上的通讯装置）上播出噩耗。区域内能看见至少一个显示装置的生物必须进行意志豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物被显示装置@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{迷魂}。

失败 该生物被显示装置迷魂，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧2}（即使迷魂结束，惊惧仍然生效）。

大失败 该生物被显示装置迷魂，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧3}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{毁灭1}（即使迷魂结束，后两者仍然生效）。

items.name: 网络筛查
items.expectedDescription:
You ritually sift through the local infosphere and gain mystical insight about a topic. During the casting of this spell, ask about the results of a particular course of action. The spell can predict results up to 30 minutes into the future and reveals the GM's best guess among the following outcomes.

  • Weal The results will be good.
  • Woe The results will be bad.
  • Weal and Woe The results will be a mix of good and bad.
  • Nothing There won't be particularly good or bad results. The GM rolls a secret @Check[flat|dc:6|traits:secret]. On a failure, the result is always "nothing." This makes it impossible to tell whether a "nothing" result is accurate. If anyone asks about the same topic as the first casting of sift the sphere during an additional casting, the GM uses the secret roll result from the first casting. If circumstances change, it's possible to get a different result.

Heightened (4th) The spell can predict results up to 1 week into the future.
items.description:
你以仪式梳理本地信息圈，获得关于某个主题的神秘洞见。施放此法术期间，你询问采取某项特定行动的结果。法术可以预测未来至多30分钟内的结果，并从以下结果中揭示GM认为最可能发生的一项。

  • 吉结果将是好的。
  • 凶结果将是坏的。
  • 吉凶参半结果将有好有坏。
  • 无结果不会特别好或特别坏。GM秘密进行一次@Check[flat|dc:6|traits:secret]。失败时，结果总是“无”。这使人无法判断“无”的结果是否准确。如果之后施放网络筛查时，有人询问与首次施法相同的主题，GM使用首次施法的秘密掷骰结果。如果情况发生变化，则可能得到不同的结果。

升阶（4环）法术可以预测最多一周内的结果。

items.name: 绝望术
items.expectedDescription:
You fill the minds of your enemies with doubt. Enemies in the area must succeed at a Will save or take a –1 status penalty to attack rolls as long as they are in the area. Once per round on subsequent turns, you can Sustain the spell to increase the emanation's radius by 10 feet and force enemies in the area that weren't yet affected to attempt another saving throw.

Bane can counteract @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XSujb7EsSwKl19Uu]{Bless}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.UTLp7omqsiC36bso]{Spell Effect: Bane}
items.description:
你将疑虑充满敌人的心智。在区域的敌人必须成功通过一次意志豁免，否则只要在区域内，在攻击掷骰上即会承受-1状态减值。在后续的回合中，每轮一次，你可以维持该法术将弥漫的半径增加10尺，并令区域内尚未受到影响的敌人再次尝试豁免。

绝望术可以反制@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XSujb7EsSwKl19Uu]{祝福术}。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.UTLp7omqsiC36bso]{法术效果：绝望术}

items.name: 魔鬼契约
items.expectedDescription:
You make an appeal to a powerful devil, asking them to bind some of their subordinates to your service. If you succeed, the devil sends you their choice of one devil of level 2 or lower, two devils of level 0 or lower, or three devils of level –1 or lower.

Critical Success The devils are sent to you and serve you for [[/gmr 1d4 #Weeks]]{1d4 weeks}.

Success The devils are sent to you and serve you for [[/gmr 1d4 #Days]]{1d4 days}.

Failure Your request is denied.

Critical Failure Not only is your request denied, but the powerful devil sends word of its displeasure to your master.

Heightened (+1) Increase the level of devil sent to you by 2 for each option.
items.description:
你恳请强大的魔鬼，请求他派遣一些手下受你调遣。若你的仪式成功，魔鬼会根据自身的选择进行派遣，这可能是1个2级或更低等级的魔鬼、2个0级或更低等级的魔鬼、或者3个-1级或更低等级的魔鬼。

大成功 被派来的魔鬼会为你服务[[/gmr 1d4 #Weeks]]{1d4周}。

成功 被派来的魔鬼会为你服务[[/gmr 1d4 #Days]]{1d4天}。

失败 你的请求被拒绝了。

大失败 你的请求不仅被拒绝了，且强大的魔鬼会将自身的不满告知你的主人。

升阶（+1） 每个选项中为你派遣的魔鬼等级增加2级。

items.name: 诡枪术
items.expectedDescription:
You condense a beam of mind-assaulting eldritch energy from the dark spaces between the stars and fire it at a target. Make a ranged spell attack roll against the target's AC. If you hit, you deal 2d6 mental damage. On a critical success, you deal double damage.

items.description:

items.name: 神导术

You ask for the guidance of supernatural entities, granting the target a +1 status bonus to one attack roll, Perception check, saving throw, or skill check the target attempts before the duration ends. The target chooses which roll to use the bonus on before rolling. If the target uses the bonus, the spell ends. Either way, the target is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

items.name: 传讯术
items.expectedDescription:
You mouth words quietly, but instead of coming out of your mouth, they're transferred directly to the ears of the target. While others can't hear your words any better than if you normally mouthed them, the target can hear your words as if they were standing next to you. The target can give a brief response as a reaction, or as a free action on their next turn if they wish, but they must be able to see you and be within range to do so. If they respond, their response is delivered directly to your ear, just like the original message.

items.description:
你无声地念出言语，这段言语会直接送到目标耳中，而不是从你的嘴中念出。其他人只能像平常看你无声地动嘴一样，无法更清楚地听到这些话，但法术目标会如同正站在你身边一般听到你的言语。目标可以通过一个反应动作做出一段简要回应，或者根据其意愿，也可以通过其下个回合的自由动作来回应，但它如此做时必须能看见你，并且在射程内。如果它做出回应，它的回应会直接送达你的耳中，如同最初的信息一般。

items.name: 魅惑术
items.expectedDescription:
To the target, your words are honey and your visage seems bathed in a dreamy haze. It must attempt a Will save, with a +4 circumstance bonus if you or your allies recently threatened it or used hostile actions against it.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you use hostile actions against the target, the spell ends. When the spell ends, the target doesn't necessarily realize it was charmed unless its friendship with you or the actions you convinced it to take clash with its expectations, meaning you could potentially convince the target to continue being your friend via mundane means.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and aware you tried to charm it.

Success The target is unaffected but thinks your spell was something harmless instead of charm, unless it identifies the spell.

Failure The target's attitude becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v66R7FdOf11l94im]{Friendly} toward you. If it was Friendly, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v44P3WUcU1j0115l]{Helpful}. It can't use hostile actions against you.

Critical Failure The target's attitude becomes Helpful toward you, and it can't use hostile actions against you.

Heightened (4th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations.

Heightened (8th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations, and you can target up to 10 creatures.
items.description:
在目标看来，你的言语甜蜜动听，你的形象笼罩在梦幻般的光晕中。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免，如果你或者你的盟友最近威胁它或者对它进行了敌对行为，会获得+4环境加值。

你可以解消该法术。如果你对目标使用任何敌对动作，法术终止。当该法术结束时，目标不一定会意识到自己被魅惑了，除非它和你的友好关系，或者你说服它去做的事情与其期望发生冲突。这也即是说你可以通过常规的方法说服目标继续作为你的朋友。

大成功 目标不受影响，并且意识到你尝试魅惑它。

成功 该目标不受影响，但是认为你的法术是某种无害的东西，而不是魅惑术，除非它能识别该法术。

失败 目标对你的态度变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v66R7FdOf11l94im]{友善}。如果已经是友善，则变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v44P3WUcU1j0115l]{乐于帮助}。它不能对你做出敌对行为。

大失败 目标变为乐于帮助并且不能对你做出敌对行为。

升阶（4环） 法术持续至你下次进行每日准备。

升阶（8环） 法术持续至你下次进行每日准备，并且你能以至多10个生物作为目标。

items.expectedDescription: 30 feet. While in their Facade Form (see below), the quyu emits an aura to infatuate nearby creatures. A creature that ends its turn in the aura must attempt a @Check[will|dc:24] save or it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by the quyu for 1 minute and takes a –2 circumstance penalty to attack the quyu for 1 round, even if the quyu leaves Facade Form.
items.description: 30尺。处于伪装形态（见下文）时，枯狳散发出使附近生物痴迷的灵光。在灵光内结束回合的生物必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:24]豁免，否则会被枯狳@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{迷魂}，持续1分钟，且攻击枯狳时承受–2环境减值，持续1轮，即便枯狳离开伪装形态也是如此。

items.name: 残酷解剖
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements A creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} by the quyu's jaws or is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} with the quyu

Effect The quyu makes a claw Strike against the required creature. If the attack hits, that creature also takes @Damage[2d6[persistent,bleed]] damage.
items.description:
需求 一个生物被枯狳的颚@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{受擒}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{束缚}，或被枯狳@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{迷魂}

items.name: 伪装形态
items.expectedDescription: The quyu compresses and reshapes themself to appear as an adorable, helpless creature. They have an automatic result of 35 on Deception checks and DCs to pass as the creature. While in this form, the quyu is Tiny and can't attack, and their pathetic gaze aura is active. The quyu can Dismiss this form.
items.description: 枯狳压缩并重塑自身，呈现为一只可爱而无助的生物。假扮该生物时，它的欺骗检定结果和DC均自动取35。处于此形态时，枯狳为超小型，无法攻击，且其可怜凝视灵光生效。枯狳可以解消此形态。

3c45EKPqzfpBPvzt.publicNotes:
乍一看，枯狳似乎是一种小巧可爱的生物，可能类似于宠物或无助的动物。然而，这种外表是一种策略，用来引诱毫无戒心的生物进入它们的掌控之中。它们的真实形态是有着两颗头的扭曲肉结，有着无眼的眼窝和滴着酸液的大口——它们绝非无助。

枯狳可以无限期地在没有空气、食物或水的情况下生存。它们有着危险的组合：无穷的好奇心和对其他物种生存的完全漠视。它们起源于如今流散带的一颗小行星上，但由于它们的伪装，它们已经悄无声息地扩散到无数星球，在那里它们为了自己残忍的追求而捕猎和解剖生物。

这些独居生物喜欢在渗透进一个文明的边缘之前，先观察该地区的野生和家养物种。在那里，它们会建立安静的掩护身份，通常是作为孩子们的宠物，只是为了捕捉并活体解剖毫无戒心的受害者。

枯狳会呈现出它们认为最可能被其所处环境中的生物认为是可爱的任何外表，即使它们模仿的生物在该世界的生态中没有位置。它们可能会以可爱的、普通的小猫、兔子或类似的毛茸茸的生物形态出现，即使是在小行星矿场或深海之中。

items.name: 触须猛击
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature takes a hostile action against the kyokor, produces a visible area effect, or flies within 120 feet of the kyokor

Effect The kyokor deals @Damage[(6d10+28)[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage in a @Template[type:line|distance:120], and each creature in the area must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:40] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and is pushed 20 feet away. If flying, it descends 20 feet.

cnText_system_details_description.expected:
The kyokor's tentacles snake out, causing devastation.

When a kyokor passes by or through a settlement—or even attacks!—it leaves a trail of destruction that can be represented by the following hazards.

Terrifying, skyscraper-sized beasts roam the wastelands of Daimalko. Called colossi by the population, these monsters erupted from deep within the earth to stomp cities into dust, decimating the population and destroying every surface civilization on the planet in a terrifying Awakening. Kyokors are among the most dreaded colossi. There's no hope of defeating one without a valko—a war machine created by Daimalko's stubborn survivors to fight the colossi.
cnText_system_details_description.text:
克约科的触须蜿蜒伸出，造成破坏。

克约科经过或穿越聚居地——甚至发动攻击！——时，会留下一条毁灭之路，可以用以下危害表示。

令人恐惧、如摩天大楼般庞大的巨兽游荡在戴马尔科的荒原上。当地居民称它们为巨像。在那场可怕的觉醒中，这些怪物从地下深处涌出，将城市践踏成尘土，令人口锐减，并摧毁了这颗星球上的所有地表文明。克约科是最令人畏惧的巨像之一。没有瓦尔科就毫无战胜它的希望；瓦尔科是戴马尔科顽强的幸存者为对抗巨像而制造的战争机器。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[arcana|dc:45] (legendary), @Check[occultism|dc:45] (legendary), or @Check[performance|dc:45] (legendary) to soothe or divert the kyokor's attention; using a guardian orb (see the sidebar on this page) to command the kyokor ends the hazard
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[arcana|dc:45]（传奇）、@Check[occultism|dc:45]（传奇）或@Check[performance|dc:45]（传奇）以安抚克约科或转移其注意力；使用守护宝珠（见本页侧栏）指挥克约科会结束此危害

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: The kyokor's tentacles can't writhe again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge writhe]]{1d4 rounds}.
cnText_system_details_reset.text: 克约科的触须在[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge writhe]]{1d4轮}内无法再次蠕动。

4Ne5pnML3LV9xYYU.name: 变形怪 Proog
4Ne5pnML3LV9xYYU.publicNotes:
变形怪，在泥怪中尤为独特，在许多协约世界的家庭中备受珍视。这些温顺可亲的生物在绝大多数情况下都无害，能迅速适应家庭生活，易于训练，似乎乐于通过令人喜爱或滑稽的变形取悦主人。在生命周期后期，这些生物会毫无预兆地一分为二进行繁殖。饲主们观察到，每只新生变形怪都需要重新学习原体掌握的各种技巧，这促使研究者推断，原始个体在繁殖过程中已然消亡。

各种各样的泥怪潜伏在星系各处阴暗荒废之地，它们只为满足食欲而现身，威胁着冒险者、探险家和不幸的工人。

items.name: 拟态物体
items.expectedDescription: A proog can spend 1 minute altering its appearance to imitate any solid object of 1 Bulk or less, though it can't duplicate moving parts or specialized functions. A mimicking proog gains a +2 Circumstance bonus to Deception checks to conceal its true nature. Touching the proog negates this bonus.
items.description: 变形怪可以花费1分钟将自身外表变为模仿任何不高于1负载的固态物体，不过它不能复制活动部件或特定功能。处于拟态状态的变形怪在隐蔽自己真身的欺骗检定上获得+2环境加值。触摸变形怪将无视此加值。

items.name: 口袋保护
items.expectedDescription: A proog can climb onto a Medium or larger creature occupying its space and attempt a Stealth check to [[/act hide]], even if observed.
items.description: 变形怪可以爬到占据自身空间的中型或更大生物身上，并尝试隐秘检定以[[/act hide]]，即使处于可见状态也可以。

4WTe8VPGlVdQxx6Y.name: 机械化卓越型战争机器 Robotic Superior War Machine
4WTe8VPGlVdQxx6Y.publicNotes:
常驻卡洛-马霍伊的工程师设计了代号“atlapak”的机器人战争机器，用于水战。与其两栖创造者一样，atlapak也同样擅长陆地作战。代号“ksarik”的机器首次现身于对乌尔丽卡氏族控股公司（Ulrikka Clanholdings）在流散带经营的一处采矿前哨的可怕袭击中。ksarik展开作战形态时，会化为一大团布满尖刺的触须与瞪视的红色传感器，能在几分钟内撕碎数个排的士兵。

这场入侵始于阿巴隆的新械族接连发现的探测器。传感器炽亮、长着分节触须的奇异机器不知从何处现身，看似毫无规律地撕裂基础设施，并在整个协约世界宙域搜集情报。恐慌迅速蔓延，但这些机器总会消失得无影无踪，或在被捕获时爆炸，因此始终无法证实目击报告或辨明其身份。流言渐起，称这些机器采用了一种前所未见的生物科技。不久，理事军正式介入，将这些事件封锁在最高机密权限的精金壁垒之后。

后断层纪元325年阳愈月（Sarenith），在数十次军事行动均未能与行踪飘忽的探测器交战之后，一支从伊达里号派出的战斗机联队终于走运，在其中一台机器自毁前将其瘫痪。协约世界的顶尖科学家设法让这台生物科技载具吐露了部分秘密，它由此成为了“本土制造”的遥控战争机器的原型，如今这类机器正接受战斗应用测试。这些仿制品并非活物，而是使用机器人制造模板建造的，因为原始生物科技设计的核心过于复杂，协约科技尚无法对其进行逆向工程。

遥控战争机器是可以从极远距离控制的替身。原始的生物科技战争机器通过心灵链接或未知无线电频率连接驾驶者的心智。机械式遥控战争机器则通过数据链路连接计算机，供驾驶者使用键盘、虚拟现实设备，甚至电子游戏手柄来控制自己的替身。

items.name: 星际通讯
items.expectedDescription: A remote war machine maintains a constant data link with its pilot, using its pilot's languages and skill modifiers for any unlisted skill. In addition, the pilot can speak through the data link using the remote war machine as a mouthpiece.
items.description: 这台遥控战争机器会与其驾驶员保持持续的数据连接，并使用驾驶员的语言及技能调整值来处理任何未列出的技能。此外，驾驶员还能通过数据链接以这台遥控战争机器作为“传声筒”进行发声。

items.description: @Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ReactiveStrike]

items.description: 战争机器快步或行走两次。在这些移动期间，战争机器的速度获得+10尺环境加值。

4oGJJFXVdCDA7oFL.name: 烬蛛族血战者 Jinsul Warblooded
4oGJJFXVdCDA7oFL.publicNotes:
血战者是指那些在烬蛛族神权国麾下经历过至少六场战斗而幸存下来的烬蛛族。他们在其他烬蛛族组成的部队中担任低级指挥官，或是作为精英狙击手和突击队员。血战者常常选择不参与他们认为“有失身份”的战斗，除非需要作为增援介入，否则他们更愿意自行训练或远远观战。这些烬蛛族通常会利用额外的训练时间，学习如何在战斗中识别出关键敌人。

烬蛛族（Jinsuls）是一个好战的物种，散布于浩界之中。它们长有六条腿，身形臃肿，周身布满眼睛；其身体上有着明显的几丁质节段，还长有一组上前肢，可用于操作设备。烬蛛族很久以前曾生活在被称为荡劫星域（the Scoured Stars）的星域，但最终离开那里，在环境恶劣的拉克斯（Rax）星球上定居下来。近来，神使杜鲁斯（the divine herald Dhurus）将烬蛛族整合为一个具有强大凝聚力的势力，即烬蛛族神权国，该势力一度短暂地重新占领了荡劫星域。最终，由多个种族以及寻星者协会（Starfinder Society）成员组成的联盟击败了杜鲁斯，烬蛛族重新分散到了浩界中。

烬蛛族在宇宙深处拥有数不胜数的基地与舰队，他们大多数都是劫掠者，四处搜刮装备，并与其他种族较量以检验自身实力。烬蛛族被灌输了这样一种观念，即自视为高等种族，认为只有荡劫星域的其他居民才稍具价值，因此他们更倾向于与敌人展开近距离战斗。

烬蛛族的数量不足以满足他们在星系中所控制的众多飞船和太空站的所有需求。为此，他们依靠机器人和自动化计算机系统（始终至少由一名烬蛛族军官指挥）来确保太空站高效运转。这些系统被编程得与烬蛛族自身一样致命且冷酷无情；即便是看起来最为无害的自动化系统或机器人，比如垃圾清理机，也可能配备致命武器，或是暗藏凶险的术法科技（technomagical）反制手段。

items.name: 电弧步枪
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This rifle's oversized body contains a larger version of an arc pistol capacitor, with a short barrel and polycarbon stock designed to insulate the wielder from high voltage. The arc rifle's larger capacitor allows it to produce a charge with enough power to subdue a rampaging renkroda.
items.description:
强化： 1

这把步枪宽大的枪身中装有电弧手枪电容器的放大版本，短枪管和聚碳枪托则能使持用者与高压电绝缘。电弧步枪更大的电容器能够产生足以制服狂暴掠吼龙（renkroda）的强力电荷。

items.description: @Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.AllAroundVision]

items.expectedDescription: The jinsul aims with their melee or ranged weapon against a target within 60 feet. For the rest of their turn, successful Strikes made with that weapon deal an additional 1d4 precision damage and reduce the target's cover bonus to AC by 1.
items.description: 烬蛛族以60尺范围内的一个目标为对象，使用近战或远程武器进行瞄准。在其回合剩余时间中，使用该武器成功打击目标时，将额外造成1d4点精准伤害，并将目标从掩蔽中获得的AC加值降低1。

items.description: 烬蛛族行走，然后进行[[/act long-jump]]。它可以行走不足10尺，而不会导致跳远检定自动失败。

4qkyqWbZ9BsXP3pL.name: 核泊精 Hesper
4qkyqWbZ9BsXP3pL.publicNotes: 这些核能妖精栖息于反应堆中，体现着其辐射家园瞬息万变的本质。他们随情绪变幻色彩，这种特性有时能预示其危险的倦怠发作。核泊精从无恶意，却鲜少考量自身行为的后果。

items.name: 刺激细胞
items.expectedDescription:
You vitalize and stimulate the target at a cellular level, giving it a temporary burst of energy that unfortunately takes an exhausting toll. The target gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition and can use the extra action to Stride or Strike. After that round ends, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} until it can rest for 10 minutes.

Heightened (6th) You can target up to six creatures by using 2 actions to Cast this Spell.
items.description:
你从细胞层面激发目标的活力，使其获得短暂的能量爆发，但不幸的是，这将使其精疲力竭。目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]状态，并可以使用额外的行动行走或打击。该轮结束后，目标会变得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]，直到休息10分钟。

升阶（6环）你可以使用2动作施放此法术，最多同时以6个生物为目标。

items.name: 魅惑术
items.expectedDescription:
To the target, your words are honey and your visage seems bathed in a dreamy haze. It must attempt a Will save, with a +4 circumstance bonus if you or your allies recently threatened it or used hostile actions against it.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you use hostile actions against the target, the spell ends. When the spell ends, the target doesn't necessarily realize it was charmed unless its friendship with you or the actions you convinced it to take clash with its expectations, meaning you could potentially convince the target to continue being your friend via mundane means.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and aware you tried to charm it.

Success The target is unaffected but thinks your spell was something harmless instead of charm, unless it identifies the spell.

Failure The target's attitude becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v66R7FdOf11l94im]{Friendly} toward you. If it was Friendly, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v44P3WUcU1j0115l]{Helpful}. It can't use hostile actions against you.

Critical Failure The target's attitude becomes Helpful toward you, and it can't use hostile actions against you.

Heightened (4th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations.

Heightened (8th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations, and you can target up to 10 creatures.
items.description:
在目标看来，你的言语甜蜜动听，你的形象笼罩在梦幻般的光晕中。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免，如果你或者你的盟友最近威胁它或者对它进行了敌对行为，会获得+4环境加值。

你可以解消该法术。如果你对目标使用任何敌对动作，法术终止。当该法术结束时，目标不一定会意识到自己被魅惑了，除非它和你的友好关系，或者你说服它去做的事情与其期望发生冲突。这也即是说你可以通过常规的方法说服目标继续作为你的朋友。

大成功 目标不受影响，并且意识到你尝试魅惑它。

成功 该目标不受影响，但是认为你的法术是某种无害的东西，而不是魅惑术，除非它能识别该法术。

失败 目标对你的态度变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v66R7FdOf11l94im]{友善}。如果已经是友善，则变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v44P3WUcU1j0115l]{乐于帮助}。它不能对你做出敌对行为。

大失败 目标变为乐于帮助并且不能对你做出敌对行为。

升阶（4环） 法术持续至你下次进行每日准备。

升阶（8环） 法术持续至你下次进行每日准备，并且你能以至多10个生物作为目标。

items.name: 光亮术
items.expectedDescription:
You create an orb of light that sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet) in a color you choose. If you create the light in the same space as a willing creature, you can attach the light to the creature, causing it to float near that creature as it moves. You can Sustain the spell to move the light up to 60 feet; you can attach or detach it from a creature as part of this movement.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you Cast the Spell while you already have four light spells active, you must choose one of the existing spells to end.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.cVVZXNbV0nElVOPZ]{Spell Effect: Light}

Heightened (4th) The orb sheds light in a 60-foot radius (and dim light for the next 60 feet).
items.description:
你创造一个光球，它发出由你选择的颜色的光芒，在20尺半径内产生明亮光照（以及接下来的20尺产生昏暗光照）。如果你在一个自愿生物所占据的空间内创造光球，你可以将光球连结到该生物，使光球在该生物附近悬浮，并随其移动。你可以维持法术以移动光球至多60尺，作为这个移动的一部分，你可以将光球连结到一个生物或是从一个生物上解除连结。

你可以解消该法术。若你已经有4个光亮术生效时施放此法术，你必须结束一个已存在的法术。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.cVVZXNbV0nElVOPZ]{法术效果：光亮术}

升阶（4环） 光球在60尺半径内产生明亮光照（并在接下来的60尺产生昏暗光照）。

items.name: 修复术
items.expectedDescription:
You repair the target item. You restore 5 Hit Points per spell rank to the target, potentially removing the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{Broken} condition if this repairs it past the item's Broken Threshold. You can't replace lost pieces or repair an object that's been completely destroyed.

Heightened (2nd) You can target a non-magical object of 1 Bulk or less.

Heightened (3rd) You can target a non-magical object of 2 Bulk or less, or a magical object of 1 Bulk or less.
items.description:
你修复目标物品。你回复目标每法术环阶5点生命值，并且如果修复后的生命值超过物品的破损阈值，会移除 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{破损} 状态。你无法补回丢失的组成部分，或者修复已经完全损毁的物体。

升阶（2环） 你能以1负载或者更低的非魔法物品为目标。

升阶（3环） 你能以2负载或者更低的非魔法物品为目标，或者1负载或者更低的魔法物品为目标。

items.name: 魔法伎俩
items.expectedDescription:
The simplest magic does your bidding. You can perform simple magical effects for as long as you Sustain the spell. Each time you Sustain the spell, you can choose one of four options.

  • Cook Cool, warm, or flavor 1 pound of nonliving material.
  • Lift Slowly lift an unattended object of light Bulk or less 1 foot off the ground.
  • Make Create a temporary object of negligible Bulk, made of congealed magical substance. The object looks crude and artificial and is extremely fragile-it can't be used as a tool, weapon, or locus or cost for a spell.
  • Tidy Color, clean, or soil an object of light Bulk or less. You can affect an object of 1 Bulk with 10 rounds of concentration, and a larger object at 1 minute per Bulk.

Prestidigitation can't deal damage or cause adverse conditions. Any actual change to an object (beyond what is noted above) persists only as long as you Sustain the spell.
items.description:
最简单的魔法帮你完成杂务。只要你维持该法术，你就可以产生简单的魔法效果。每当你维持该法术时，你可以选择四个选项中的一个。

  • 烹饪 为1磅非活物材料冷却，加热，或者调味。
  • 抬起 将一件轻负载或者更低的无主物品缓慢抬离地面1尺。
  • 创造 创造一个负载可忽略的临时物体，它由凝结的魔法物质组成。该物体看起来粗糙、不自然，且极其脆弱——它无法被用做工具、武器、施法载体或法术费用。
  • 整理 为一件轻负载或者更低的物体染色，清洁，或者弄脏它。你可以通过10轮专注来影响一件1负载的物体，对于更大的物体为每负载1分钟。

魔法伎俩无法造成伤害或者负面效果。对一件物体的任何改变（在上述内容之外的）只会在你仍维持该法术时持续。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d12点电击以及1d4点音波。

The hesper is aware of but can't physically interact with their surroundings and is protected from those outside. If the reactor is broken, the hesper takes @Damage[2d10[force]] damage and is immediately expelled from it. If the reactor is destroyed while the hesper is inside, the hesper must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:15] save or be slain instantly.

效果 核泊精行走进入反应堆，穿过其外壳，并在内部时获得快速治疗5。核泊精能够感知周围环境，但无法与之进行物理交互，并受到防护，抵御外界侵扰。如果反应堆损坏，核泊精受到@Damage[2d10[force]]伤害，并立即被排出。如果反应堆在核泊精处于内部时被摧毁，核泊精必须成功通过一次@Check[fortitude|dc:15]豁免，否则立即死亡。

items.name: 突变之触
items.expectedDescription:
A hesper can deliver an enormous, mutating dose of radiation with a touch. Creatures struck by a hesper's fist Strike must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:18] save. On a failure, the creature gains a random mutation from the table below for 1 hour (or 24 hours on a critical failure).

[[/r 1d8]]Mutation
1Extra eyes: Target is dazzled in bright light and gains a +2 status bonus to sight-based Perception checks.
2Bioelectric cells: Tech items held by the target regain all spent charges at the end of the creature's turn. Tech items are glitching 1 for as long as the target holds them. If the target is a creature with the tech trait, it becomes glitching 1, and its melee Strikes deal an additional @Damage[1d6[electricity]] damage.
3Spikes: Target gains an unarmed melee attack that deals @Damage[1d4[piercing]] damage. It takes a –2 status penalty to attack rolls with two-handed weapons.
4Glowing Tumors: Target sheds light as a flashlight and takes a –2 status penalty to Stealth checks.
5Gills: Target gains the amphibious trait and takes a –1 status penalty to Fortitude saves.
6Musk gland: Target gains a 30-foot stench aura with a DC equal to their class DC.
7Protective growths: Target gains a +1 status bonus to AC and takes a –2 status penalty to Dexterity-based checks.
8Cellular alteration: The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened} for the duration and gains @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.fJSNOw4zHGbIm4bZ]{Fast Healing} with a value equal to half its level (rounded up).
items.description:
核泊精可以通过触摸释放足以引发突变的巨量辐射。被核泊精拳头打击命中的生物必须尝试一次@Check[fortitude|dc:18]豁免。失败时，该生物从下表随机获得一种突变，持续1小时（大失败则为24小时）。

[[/r 1d8]]突变
1额外眼睛： 目标在明亮光照下陷入目眩，并在基于视觉的察觉检定上获得+2状态加值。
2生物电细胞： 在该生物的回合结束时，目标持握的科技物品恢复所有已消耗充能。只要目标仍持握这些科技物品，它们便处于故障1。如果目标是具有科技特征的生物，其陷入故障1，且其近战打击额外造成@Damage[1d6[electricity]]伤害。
3尖刺： 目标获得一种造成@Damage[1d4[piercing]]伤害的近战无武装攻击。其使用双手武器的攻击检定受到–2状态减值。
4发光肿瘤： 目标如手电筒般发光，并在隐秘检定上受到–2状态减值。
5鳃： 目标获得两栖特征，并在强韧豁免上受到–1状态减值。
6麝香腺： 目标获得一个30尺恶臭灵光，其DC等于目标的职业DC。
7防护性增生： 目标在AC上获得+1状态加值，并在基于敏捷的检定上受到–2状态减值。
8细胞变异： 目标在持续时间内陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心}，并获得数值等于其等级一半（向上取整）的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.fJSNOw4zHGbIm4bZ]{快速治疗}。

4vGM6E9c4cSTqzse.name: 成年宿主龙 Host Dragon (Adult)
4vGM6E9c4cSTqzse.publicNotes: 无论这些行动迟缓、贪食的巨龙漫游至何处，都有数不胜数的昆虫尾随其后，它们在宿主龙周围蜂拥而至，栖息于宿主龙身体上无数的孔洞之中。宿主龙既是虫群本身的一部分，也是虫群生态的一部分——虫群以它们的身体为食，而龙又以虫群为食；在这一可怖且延续数百年的循环中，即便宿主龙一生未曾摄取任何其他物质，也仍会不断变得更加庞大、更加强大。宿主龙从昆虫的原始本能中汲取力量，尽管它们拥有智慧，却常常表现得像那些聚集在它们身边的昆虫一样。宿主龙厌恶回答问题，并会以激烈手段抗拒他人对其本性的任何探究。

52WVLSR7qq73zQ98.name: 自由船长无赖 Free Captain Knave
52WVLSR7qq73zQ98.publicNotes:
自由船长们对雇员并不挑剔，会接纳几乎所有他们认为能遵守海盗法典的人。大多数自由船长的船只每次航行都会招募几名新人，其中有些人甚至会再次随船出航。虽然这些水手通常被安排做船上最卑贱、最琐碎的工作，但一旦战斗打响，他们就会抓住每个机会向其他船员证明自己的价值。

自由船长们数代以来一直是协约世界间星际航运的祸患，但自从漂流航道启用后，这些法外狂徒利用新建立的标准化星际航线，将目标锁定在星系各处的船只，从而扩大了他们的活动范围和规模。

54ZWC7aaow65f46U.publicNotes:
碎舰者是子弹形状的活体钢块，其等离子场迸发着电流。碎舰者在太空中推进自己，寻找星舰发出的微弱电子信号。在追踪目标后，碎舰者会以强力突进方式撞击星舰，然后撕开船体以接触到内部的船员，吞食乘客、部件和货物，为它们的行星间捕食行为提供能量。

碎舰者尤其被电池吸引，甚至会优先吞食充满电的电池，而非营养更丰富的活体生物。这些电池会永久成为碎舰者的一部分，用以储存并调用来自该元素生物的多余热量。那些在漫长存在期间摄入了大量电池的碎舰者，常常从内部发光或迸发电流。

元素是源自原初位面的能量具现，其形态千变万化——既可能是风与水中的无智涡流，亦可是运用原能魔法的玄奥存在。随着星际航行的实现与科技的发展，更多元素的活体化身得以在宇宙中显形。

山火、太阳风暴、洪水等自然异象会令成群狂乱的元素生物肆虐行星乃至星域。有时，强大元素生物的聚集将引发史诗级的灾变：譬如焚毁星球电网的超规格耀斑爆发，或于气态巨行星大气中永不停歇的巨型风暴。

66tw46IKra4XaN0w.name: 电光炫灵 Plasmazer
66tw46IKra4XaN0w.publicNotes:
电光炫灵是一群脾气暴躁、色彩鲜艳的风元素生物。自霓虹灯发明后，它们在宇宙中便越来越常见。它们以危险的光爆与色爆形式现身，能直接瘫痪城市电网，并将电力转化为闪烁的霓虹万花筒。它们常化身为当地传说中神鸟或其他神话生物的形态。有些追求新潮的夜店老板曾尝试驾驭电光炫灵为舞会制造特效，但结果往往是满场舞客狼狈躲避等离子射线的场面。“等离子滑步”（plasma slide）是一种排舞的名称，它的走红源于一起事件：在伊奥克斯星上有一家以狂野派对闻名的全天营业的俱乐部“霓虹墓穴”（Neon Crypt），当时一只电光炫灵在那里失控逃脱，这种舞蹈随即爆红网络。

元素是源自原初位面的能量具现，其形态千变万化——既可能是风与水中的无智涡流，亦可是执掌原能魔法的玄奥存在。随着星际航行的实现与科技的发展，更多元素的活体化身得以在宇宙中显形。

山火、太阳风暴、洪水等自然异象会令成群狂乱的元素生物肆虐行星乃至星域。有时，强大元素生物的聚集将引发史诗级的灾变：譬如焚毁星球电网的超规格耀斑爆发，或于气态巨行星大气中永不停歇的巨型风暴。

6HgCFAlJv7fYs8sm.publicNotes:
尽管年纪尚小，幼年相位兽仍是危险而可怕的掠食者。

相位兽是凶残至极的恐龙形生物，堪称卡斯卓韦行星上最危险、最令人畏惧的顶级掠食者。这些行走的武器拥有致命的生理构造：巨口内排列着双排锋利如剃刀的牙齿，镰刀般锋利的相位刃前肢能以超声波速度振动，笞鞭状的尾巴则能吸收周围大气中的电能。并且相位兽还狡黠敏锐——头顶的触须头冠能感知心灵感应信号，令当地的弗米蚁族与拉申塔人无处遁形。它们的相位刃能如切割灌木般轻易撕裂墙壁与载具，确保猎物无处可逃。
