Heightened (4th) You detect the number of thinking minds and whether or not the creatures are telepathic. Creatures with telepathy have louder thoughts than creatures who don't have telepathy and might be able to sense your intrusion, at the GM's discretion.
items.description:
你能感知周围生物的想法。你可以侦测周围是否存在智力调整值不低于-3的清醒生物的思维。可选择忽略熟悉生物的思维，避免干扰其他目标的侦测。该法术可以穿透一些障碍，但3尺的泥土或木头、1尺的石头、1英寸的金属、薄薄的铅片或任何立场障碍都会阻挡它。对心灵效果免疫的生物对该法术的侦测免疫。

升阶（4环）你可侦测范围内存在思维活动的意识体数量，并判断其是否具备心灵感应能力。拥有心灵感应能力的生物思维波动更强，普通生物思维信号较弱且无反馈，具体由GM裁定。

items.name: 隐形术（随意；仅自身）
items.expectedDescription:
Illusions bend light around the target, rendering it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.
items.description:
扭曲光线的幻觉包覆目标，令其变得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}。这令该生物对所有生物 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{无踪} ，但生物可以尝试寻找目标，令其改为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{藏匿}。如果目标使用敌对动作，法术在敌对动作完成后结束。

升阶（4环） 该法术持续1分钟，但目标使用敌对动作时该法术不会结束。

items.name: 显光尘
items.expectedDescription:
A wave of magical light washes over the area. You choose the appearance of the light, such as colorful, heatless flames or sparkling motes. A creature affected by revealing light is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled}. If the creature was @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} instead. If the creature was already concealed for any other reason, it is no longer concealed.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The light affects the creature for 2 rounds.

Failure The light affects the creature for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The light affects the creature for 10 minutes.
items.description:
一道魔法光亮的波浪掠过该区域。由你选择光亮的外观，例如五彩斑斓、无热量的火焰或者闪烁的微尘。受显光尘影响的生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}。 若该生物处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}，则它改为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。如果目标已由于任何其他原因处于隐蔽状态，则它不再隐蔽。

大成功 该目标不受影响。

成功 该光亮影响生物2轮。

失败 该光亮影响生物1分钟。

大失败 该光亮影响生物10分钟。

items.name: 浏览数据
items.expectedDescription:
You touch one object and concentrate on a dataset contained within it, such as a story, message, file, infosphere site, audio recording, or video. You understand the gist of the dataset and can quickly locate the most relevant pages or sections to your search. If the dataset is written or otherwise communicated in a language you don't know, or you attempt to gain information from a computer you don't have access to (such as one with a password you don't know), the spell fails.

If you Cast this Spell as part of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.t5nBkpjroaq7QBGK]{Research} activity, you treat a critical failure as a failure instead.
items.description:
你触碰一件物体，专注于其中的一组数据，例如故事、讯息、文件、信息圈网站、录音或视频。你理解这组数据的大意，并且能迅速定位与搜索内容最相关的页面或章节。如果数据以你不懂的语言书写或传达，或你试图从无权访问的计算机中获取信息（例如一台你不知道密码的计算机），法术失败。

如果你将施放此法术作为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.t5nBkpjroaq7QBGK]{研究}活动的一部分，你将大失败改为视作失败。

items.name: 删除术
items.expectedDescription:
You delete data from a device or object with a flamboyant magical gesture. This data might be handwritten, printed, or digital. You delete up to 1,500 words' worth of text, one page of content, or one display screen worth of text or other visual information. Non-magical writing in or on an unattended or held object is automatically deleted. Attempt a counteract check to delete digital or magical writing. If you fail to delete writing that's part of a hazard, you trigger the hazard. This can't be used to delete the contents of a spellbook or similar means of storing magical formulas or spells.

If you target an attended tech item with the tracking trait, attempt a counteract check. On a success, the item becomes glitching 1. A creature holding the item can Interact to restart the software, reducing the glitching value by 1.

Heightened (7th) You can delete all the data stored locally on a single device or book, or all the data on a device or book related to a specific name, topic, or category.
items.description:
你以华丽的魔法手势删除设备或物品中的数据。这些数据可以是手写的、打印的或电子的。你最多可以删除 1,500字的文本、一页内容或一显示屏的文本或其他视觉信息。无主物品或手持物品上的非魔法文字会自动删除。尝试反制检定删除数据或魔法文字。如果你尝试删除的文字是危害的一部分，且你失败，就会触发危害。这不能用于删除魔法书或类似的存储魔法公式或法术的内容。

如果目标是具有追踪特征的科技物品，尝试一次反制检定。如果成功，该物品就会获得故障1。持有该物品的生物可以花费一个交互动作来重启用户界面，并将故障值降低1。

升阶（7环）你可以删除单个设备或书籍中本地存储的所有数据，或者删除设备或书籍中与特定名称、主题或类别相关的所有数据。

items.name: 植入数据
items.expectedDescription:
You reprogram a computer or device to display a chosen piece of data when accessed. You can implant up to one piece of data per spell rank. A piece of data can be a simple fact, such as a creature or object's location or physical description; an image of a creature or object; or a simple statement of no more than 300 characters. When the target computer or device is accessed, this implanted data is the first data the accessing creature gains, regardless of what data the creature is looking for. Implanted data doesn't prevent a creature from accessing other information stored on a device, change how the device functions, or otherwise inhibit the device from functioning. If this spell's duration ends before a creature accesses the implanted data, the information vanishes.

Heightened (3rd) The duration is one year.

Heightened (6th) The duration is unlimited.
items.description:
你重新编程一台计算机或设备，使其在被访问时显示一条选定的数据。你每个法术环级至多可以植入一条数据。一条数据可以是一项简单事实，例如某个生物或物体的位置或外貌描述；一幅生物或物体的图像；或一句不超过300个字符的简单陈述。目标计算机或设备被访问时，访问者首先获得的总是这条植入数据，无论该生物在寻找什么数据。植入数据不会阻止生物访问设备储存的其他信息，不会改变设备的运作方式，也不会以其他方式妨碍其运作。如果法术持续时间在生物访问植入数据前结束，这些信息便消失。

升阶（3环）持续时间为一年。

升阶（6环）持续时间为无限。

items.name: 缓冲区域
items.expectedDescription:
15 feet. A creature that begins its turn within the area must attempt a @Check[will|dc:14] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and is temporarily immune to buffering zone for 1 day.

Success The creature treats the buffering zone as difficult terrain for 1 round.

Failure As success, and the creature is pushed back 5 feet and takes a –1 status penalty to attack rolls for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.bestiary-effects.Item.X5oMEjGHa8WsCiqW]

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature is pushed back beyond the boundary of the buffering zone and can't reenter the buffering zone for 1 round.
items.description:
15尺。在区域内开始回合的生物必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:14]豁免。

大成功 生物不受影响，并临时免疫缓冲区域，持续1天。

成功 生物将缓冲区域视为困难地形，持续1轮。

失败 如同成功，且生物被向后推5尺，其攻击检定受到–1状态减值，持续1轮。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.bestiary-effects.Item.X5oMEjGHa8WsCiqW]

大失败 如同失败，但生物被推出缓冲区域的边界，且在1轮内无法重新进入缓冲区域。

items.name: 反射敌意
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature hits the erabryth with a melee or ranged Strike

Effect The erabryth reflects some of their attacker's anger and aggression back at them. The erabryth gains resistance 3 to the triggering damage and deals @Damage[3[mental]] damage to their attacker.
items.description:
触发 一个生物以近战或远程打击命中伊拉布里斯引魂使

效果 伊拉布里斯引魂使把攻击者的部分愤怒与敌意反射回去。伊拉布里斯引魂使对触发伤害获得抗力3，并对攻击者造成@Damage[3[mental]]伤害。

items.name: 强制反思
items.expectedDescription:
The erabryth forces a creature within 60 feet to relive its most painful memories and regrets in an instant, confronting it with it difficult memories to help it reconcile its actions and let go of its pain. The target must attempt a @Check[will|dc:17|options:inflicts:frightened,inflicts:stunned] save. Regardless of the result, the target is then temporarily immune to Forced Reflection for 1 day.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} and frightened 1.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.
items.description:
伊拉布里斯引魂使迫使60尺内的一个生物在一瞬间重温其最痛苦的回忆与遗憾，使其直面这些难以承受的记忆，以帮助其与自身的行为和解并放下痛苦。目标必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:17|options:inflicts:frightened,inflicts:stunned]豁免。无论结果如何，目标随后临时免疫强制反思，持续1天。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧1}。

失败 目标陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑1}和惊惧1。

大失败 目标陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑2}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧2}。

items.name: 牧者之触
items.expectedDescription: An erabryth's Strikes have the benefit of a ghost killer upgrade and deal an extra 1d4 void damage to living creatures or 1d4 vitality damage to undead.
items.description: 招魂者的打击具有灭鬼强化模块的增益，对活物造成额外1d4虚能伤害，或对不死生物造成额外1d4命能伤害。

6SVQC4zymKmVv57c.publicNotes:
当仿生人离世或放弃躯体以待重生时——这件事如同繁衍般备受庆贺与尊重——正是由这些沉默而冷静的伊拉布里斯引魂使，将他们的灵魂引领至骨园。作为擅长反思与内省的生灵，这些招魂者帮助仿生人接纳自身的抉择，调和生命中的艰难困苦，并领悟到重生的时刻已然降临。

伊拉布里斯引魂使身形修长，外形雌雄莫辨，其身体如丝带般闪烁着光泽，面部则是一面如镜的圆盘。他们通过姿态与含有情感的光线进行交流，以舒缓而恒久的陪伴给予慰藉。

招魂者是死亡牧者（death's shepherds），他们通过诛杀不死生物，或引领灵魂平安穿越骨园，来守护生命、死亡与来世的轮回循环。

6VP5rvY19BTix02l.name: 梦者 Dreamer

items.name: 困惑术
items.expectedDescription:
You befuddle your target with strange impulses, causing it to act randomly. The effects are determined by the target's Will save. You can Dismiss the spell.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target babbles incoherently and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 minute. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns to end the confusion.

Critical Failure The target is Confused for 1 minute, with no save to end early.

Heightened (8th) You can target up to 10 creatures.
items.description:
你以奇异的冲动扰乱目标心智，使其随机行动。法术效果由目标的意志豁免决定。你可以解消该法术。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标胡言乱语，并且获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 1}。

失败 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{困惑}1分钟。在其每个回合结束，它能尝试一次新豁免来结束困惑术。

大失败 目标困惑1分钟，并且没有提前结束的豁免。

升阶（8环阶） 你能以至多10个生物为目标。

items.name: 怪异怒火
items.expectedDescription:
You channel the bizarre powers that exist beyond the outer reaches of the universe, dealing 3d12 mental damage to each creature in the area as phantasmal claws, jaws, and tentacles lash out at each target. Each creature in the area must attempt a Will save. The area is difficult terrain for any creature sickened by the effects of this spell.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d12.
items.description:
你引导存在于宇宙外缘之外的怪异力量，幻影利爪、巨颚与触须鞭打每个目标，对区域内每个生物造成3d12心灵伤害。区域内每个生物都必须尝试意志豁免。对因本法术效果陷入恶心的任何生物而言，该区域为困难地形。

大成功 生物不受影响。

成功 生物受到一半伤害。

失败 该生物受到全部伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}。

大失败 生物受到双倍伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心2}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d12。

items.name: 读心术
items.expectedDescription:
With a cursory mental touch, you attempt to read the target's mind. It must attempt a Will save. The target then becomes temporarily immune to your mind reading for 1 hour.

Critical Success The target perceives vague surface thoughts from you when you Cast the Spell.

Success You find out whether the target's Intelligence modifier is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Failure You perceive vague surface thoughts from the target when you Cast the Spell, and you find out whether its Intelligence is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Critical Failure As failure, and for the duration of the spell, you can Sustain the spell to detect the target's surface thoughts again. The target doesn't receive any additional saves.
items.description:
你通过一次短暂的心灵接触来尝试阅读目标的想法。它必须尝试一次意志豁免。目标会临时免疫你的读心术1小时。

大成功 目标感知到你施放法术时模糊的表层思想。

成功 你得知目标的智力调整值是高于，等于，还是低于你。

失败 你感知到施放法术时目标模糊的表层思想，并且你得知目标的智力是高于，等于，还是低于你。

大失败 如失败，并且在法术持续时间中，你可以维持该法术来再次侦测目标的表层想法。目标不会获得另外的豁免。

items.name: 缓慢术
items.expectedDescription:
You dilate the flow of time around the target, slowing its actions.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} for 1 minute.

Heightened (6th) You can target up to 10 creatures.
items.description:
你令目标周围的时间膨胀，令其行动缓慢。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 1} ，持续1轮。

失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 1}，持续1分钟。

大失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 2}，持续1分钟。

升阶（6环） 你能以至多10个生物为目标。

items.name: 时间尖锋
items.expectedDescription:
You refract latent energy from the Dimension of Time into your current plane in the form of a massive blade. The blade deals 5d6 slashing damage to all creatures in the area as it causes time to pass rapidly in a thin slice of their bodies. Creatures in the area must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.
items.description:
你将时间维度中潜藏的能量折射到当前位面，化为一柄巨刃。巨刃使区域内所有生物身体的一片薄薄区域内的时间飞速流逝，造成5d6挥砍伤害。区域内生物必须尝试一次强韧豁免。

大成功 生物不受影响。

成功 生物受到一半伤害。

失败 生物受到全额伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心1}。

大失败 生物受到双倍伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心2}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加2d6。

items.name: 虚空低语
items.expectedDescription:
The target hears ominous sounds containing unspeakable mysteries from beyond the stars that disorient its mind. The target attempts a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The target hears the strange whispers, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target begins to wander aimlessly, using each action to Step in a random direction. When it moves, the target takes the safest route and doesn't enter hazardous terrain. The spell has a duration of 1 minute or until a creature uses a hostile action against the target.

Critical Failure As failure, except the target babbles incoherently. Any creature that begins its turn within 20 feet of the target must attempt a Will saving throw. On a failure, it must use its first action on its next turn to Step in a random direction and becomes immune to this spell for 24 hours. This is an incapacitation effect.
items.description:
目标听见来自群星之外的不祥声响，其中蕴含不可言说的奥秘，令它心智迷乱。目标尝试意志豁免。

大成功 生物不受影响。

成功 目标听到奇怪的低语，陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞1}，持续1轮。

失败 目标开始漫无目的地游荡，每个动作都会向一个随机方向快步。目标移动时会选择最安全的路线，且不会进入危险地形。此法术持续1分钟，或直到有生物对目标采取敌意动作。

大失败 如同失败，但目标还会语无伦次地呓语。任何在目标20尺内开始回合的生物都必须尝试意志豁免。失败时，它必须用下个回合的第一个动作向随机方向快步，然后对此法术免疫24小时。这是失能效果。

items.name: 卜筮术
items.expectedDescription:
You gain a vague glimpse of the future. During the casting of this spell, ask about the results of a particular course of action. The spell can predict results up to 30 minutes into the future and reveal the GM's best guess among the following outcomes: good, bad, mixed (the results will be a mix of good and bad), and nothing (there won't be particularly good or bad results).

The GM rolls a secret @Check[flat|dc:6|showDC:all|traits:secret]. On a failure, the result is always "nothing." This makes it impossible to tell whether a "nothing" result is accurate. If anyone asks about the same topic as the first casting of augury during an additional casting, the GM uses the secret roll result from the first casting. If circumstances change, though, it's possible to get a different result.
items.description:
你能够粗略地窥见未来。在施放该法术期间，询问特定行动方式的结果。法术能够预测未来至多30分钟内的结果，并使用后述结果揭示出GM得出的最有可能的猜想：吉、凶、兼（结果将是好与坏的混合）、以及平（不会产生特别好或者坏的结果）。

GM投掷一次@Check[flat|dc:6|showDC:all|traits:secret]检定。失败时，结果总是“平”。这使得任何人都无法判断“平”的结果究竟是否准确。若有任何人在另一次施法过程中询问的问题与首次卜筮术具有相同的主题，那么GM要使用与首次施法相同的秘密检定结果。不过，在情况改变时，也有可能得到不同的结果。

items.name: 侦测思想
items.expectedDescription:
You sense the presence of thinking creatures around you. You detect the presence or absence of thoughts from conscious creatures that have Intelligence modifiers of –3 or higher. You can choose to ignore the thoughts of creatures you're familiar with so they don't interfere with your detection of other thoughts. The spell can penetrate some barriers, but 3 feet of dirt or wood, 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of metal, a thin sheet of lead, or any force barrier blocks it. Creatures who are immune to mental effects are immune to detection by this spell.

Heightened (4th) You detect the number of thinking minds and whether or not the creatures are telepathic. Creatures with telepathy have louder thoughts than creatures who don't have telepathy and might be able to sense your intrusion, at the GM's discretion.
items.description:
你能感知周围生物的想法。你可以侦测周围是否存在智力调整值不低于-3的清醒生物的思维。可选择忽略熟悉生物的思维，避免干扰其他目标的侦测。该法术可以穿透一些障碍，但3尺的泥土或木头、1尺的石头、1英寸的金属、薄薄的铅片或任何立场障碍都会阻挡它。对心灵效果免疫的生物对该法术的侦测免疫。

升阶（4环）你可侦测范围内存在思维活动的意识体数量，并判断其是否具备心灵感应能力。拥有心灵感应能力的生物思维波动更强，普通生物思维信号较弱且无反馈，具体由GM裁定。

items.name: 网络筛查
items.expectedDescription:
You ritually sift through the local infosphere and gain mystical insight about a topic. During the casting of this spell, ask about the results of a particular course of action. The spell can predict results up to 30 minutes into the future and reveals the GM's best guess among the following outcomes.

  • Weal The results will be good.
  • Woe The results will be bad.
  • Weal and Woe The results will be a mix of good and bad.
  • Nothing There won't be particularly good or bad results. The GM rolls a secret @Check[flat|dc:6|traits:secret]. On a failure, the result is always "nothing." This makes it impossible to tell whether a "nothing" result is accurate. If anyone asks about the same topic as the first casting of sift the sphere during an additional casting, the GM uses the secret roll result from the first casting. If circumstances change, it's possible to get a different result.

Heightened (4th) The spell can predict results up to 1 week into the future.
items.description:
你以仪式梳理本地信息圈，获得关于某个主题的神秘洞见。施放此法术期间，你询问采取某项特定行动的结果。法术可以预测未来至多30分钟内的结果，并从以下结果中揭示GM认为最可能发生的一项。

  • 吉结果将是好的。
  • 凶结果将是坏的。
  • 吉凶参半结果将有好有坏。
  • 无结果不会特别好或特别坏。GM秘密进行一次@Check[flat|dc:6|traits:secret]。失败时，结果总是“无”。这使人无法判断“无”的结果是否准确。如果之后施放网络筛查时，有人询问与首次施法相同的主题，GM使用首次施法的秘密掷骰结果。如果情况发生变化，则可能得到不同的结果。

升阶（4环）法术可以预测最多一周内的结果。

items.name: 情绪控制
items.expectedDescription:
You share a mood by psychically projecting an intense emotion into a creature's mind. The target attempts a Will save. On a failure, the target experiences your choice of the following emotions, but if you pick anger or joy this spell gains the incapacitation trait.

  • Anger On its next turn, the target spends its first action to attack the nearest creature, even if it's an ally.
  • Joy The target can't take any hostile actions.
  • Fear The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.
  • Sorrow The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} and bursts into tears.

Heightened (4th) The spell affects all creatures in a 20-foot burst. Each creature must be affected by the same emotion.
items.description:
你以心能向一个生物的心中投射强烈情绪，使其与你感同身受。目标尝试一次意志豁免。失败时，目标体验以下一种由你选择的情绪，但如果选择愤怒或喜悦，此法术获得失能特征。

  • 愤怒 在其下一回合，目标花费第一个动作攻击最近的生物，即使对方是盟友。
  • 喜悦 目标无法采取任何敌对行动。
  • 恐惧 目标陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧2}。
  • 悲伤 目标陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢1}，并泪流满面。

升阶（4环） 法术影响20尺爆发内的所有生物。每个生物必须受到相同情绪的影响。

items.name: 阿卡西下载
items.expectedDescription:
You execute a psychic search of the Akashic Record for information about a specific topic and magically transfer this data to your comm unit or computer. When you Cast this Spell, choose any skill in which you're trained that has the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} action.

Any time during the duration, you can consult your comm unit while attempting a Recall Knowledge check using your chosen skill. This check gains a +1 status bonus. Checking your comm unit is part of the action to Recall Knowledge. You must be holding the comm unit to do so. The comm unit instantly compiles and displays snippets and selections from various media relevant to the topic, which grants you the bonus. If you roll a critical failure on this check, you get a failure instead. If the check is successful and the subject is a creature, you gain additional information or context about the creature. Once you reference the comm unit, the spell ends. When the spell ends, your access to the Akashic Record ends, and all the information you downloaded returns to the Akashic Record.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.h1i8c47U0IOrMrHJ]

Heightened (3rd) You can reference your comm unit three times before the spell ends.
items.description:
你通过灵能搜索阿卡西记录，获取特定主题的信息，并将数据魔法传输至通讯单元或计算机。施放此法术时，选择任何你至少为受训熟练度且能进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]动作的技能。

在持续时间内的任何时候，你都可以在使用所选技能进行回忆知识检定时查询通讯单元。该检定会获得+1状态加值。检查通讯单元是回忆知识动作的一部分。你必须手持通讯单元才能这样做。通讯单元会立即编译并显示与主题相关的各种媒体片段和精选内容，从而为你带来加值。如果你在检定中掷出大失败，改为失败。如果检定成功，且对象是生物，你将获得有关该生物的额外信息或内容。一旦你查询了通讯单元的信息，法术就会结束。当法术结束时，你对阿卡西记录的访问也会结束，你下载的所有信息都会返回阿卡西记录。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.h1i8c47U0IOrMrHJ]

升阶（3环）法术结束前可以用通讯单元查询信息3次。

items.name: 晕眩术
items.expectedDescription:
You push into the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals 1d6 mental damage, with a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你侵入目标的精神，利用精神冲击令目标晕眩。该冲击造成1d6心灵伤害，具有基础意志豁免。如果目标在豁免中大失败，它获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 1}。

升阶（+2） 该伤害增加1d6。

items.name: 归乡梦
items.expectedDescription: You draw on a creature's thoughts of home and the comfort it finds in that concept, overwhelming the creature with wistful memories of whatever home means to it. The target must succeed at a Will save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by the memories.
items.description: 你汲取生物对家的思念，以及它在这个概念中找到的慰藉，用任何代表家的思念记忆淹没生物。目标必须成功进行意志豁免，否则就会因这些记忆进入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]。

items.name: 诡枪术
items.expectedDescription:
You condense a beam of mind-assaulting eldritch energy from the dark spaces between the stars and fire it at a target. Make a ranged spell attack roll against the target's AC. If you hit, you deal 2d6 mental damage. On a critical success, you deal double damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你自星辰之间的幽深领域凝聚一束袭魂慑魄的怪异能量攻击目标。尝试一次远程法术攻击骰对抗目标的AC，如果命中，你造成2d6心灵伤害，在大成功时造成双倍伤害。

升阶（+1）伤害增加1d6。

items.name: 心灵穿刺
items.expectedDescription:
You overload a creature's mind with a glut of psychic information or divine judgments. The mental onslaught deals 2d6 mental damage. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.
items.description:
你以海量心灵信息或神圣审判冲击一个生物的心智。这股精神猛攻造成2d6心灵伤害。大失败时，目标还会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞2}，持续1轮。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加2d6。

items.name: 讯息传递
items.expectedDescription: You link your mind to the target's mind and mentally impart to that target an amount of information in an instant that could otherwise be communicated in 10 minutes.
items.description: 你将你和目标的精神链接在一起，并且将通常需要10分钟来交流的信息在一瞬间通过精神传递给对方。

items.name: 护盾术
items.expectedDescription:
You raise a magical shield of force. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction with your magic shield. The shield has Hardness 5. You can use the spell's reaction to reduce damage from any spell or magical effect, even if it doesn't deal physical damage. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity}

Heightened (+2) The shield's Hardness increases by 5.
items.description:
你举起一面力场构成的魔法护盾。这视同你使用了举盾动作，赋予你在AC上的+1环境加值，直到你的下个回合开始，且无需用手持握。

当该法术生效时，你可以使用你的魔法护盾来进行 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{盾牌格挡}反应动作。该盾牌具有硬度5。你可以使用该法术的反应动作来减少任何来自法术或者魔法效果的伤害，即使这不造成物理伤害。在你使用盾牌格挡后，该法术结束，并且你无法在10分钟内再次施放它。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{法术效果：护盾术}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{效果：护盾术免疫}

升阶（+2） 该盾牌的硬度增加5。

items.name: 返祖性狂暴
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger The Dreamer is reduced to half or less than half their total Hit Points

Effect The injured Dreamer erupts into a terrifying state of psychic fury, requiring all non-Dreamers in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] to attempt a @Check[will|dc:24|options:area-effect] save. The Dreamer gains a +2 status bonus to attack and damage rolls for 1 minute but can't use their innate spells. After they stop raging, a Dreamer can't enter an Atavistic Rage again for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Critical Failure The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.
items.description:
触发 梦者的生命值降至其总生命值的一半或以下

效果 受伤的梦者爆发出可怕的心能狂怒，要求@Template[type:emanation|distance:30]内所有非梦者尝试一次@Check[will|dc:24|options:area-effect]豁免。梦者的攻击和伤害掷骰获得+2状态加值，持续1分钟，但其无法使用内在法术。停止狂暴后，梦者在1分钟内无法再次进入返祖性狂暴。

大成功 生物不受影响。

成功 生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧1}。

失败 生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧2}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑1}。

大失败 生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧3}，并在1轮内陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}。

items.name: 迟钝心智
items.expectedDescription: Any creature that uses an emotion or mental effect on a Dreamer must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:24|options:inflicts:slowed] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for the next [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds} as fragments of prophetic songs fill its mind.
items.description: 任何对梦者使用情绪或心灵效果的生物，必须通过一次@Check[will|dc:24|options:inflicts:slowed]豁免，否则预言歌曲的片段会充满其心智，使其陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢1}，持续接下来的[[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4轮}。

items.name: 通感冲击
items.expectedDescription:
Any creature struck by a Dreamer's tentacle must attempt a @Check[will|dc:24|options:inflicts:dazzled,inflicts:stupefied,inflicts:stunned,inflicts:suppressed] save to resist a wave of sensory overstimulation. The creature is then temporarily immune to all synesthetic shocks for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF] and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} until the end of its next turn.

Failure As success, but the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} until the end of its next turn.

Critical Failure As failure, but with a duration of 2 rounds, and the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2}.
items.description:
任何被梦者触须击中的生物必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:24|options:inflicts:dazzled,inflicts:stupefied,inflicts:stunned,inflicts:suppressed]豁免，以抵抗一波过度的感官刺激。该生物随后临时免疫所有通感冲击，持续1分钟。

大成功 生物不受影响。

成功 生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞1}，直到其下一回合结束。

失败 如同成功，但生物还陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}，直到其下一回合结束。

大失败 如同失败，但持续时间为2轮，且生物还陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑2}。

6VP5rvY19BTix02l.publicNotes:
在利亚瓦拉的桃色云朵间舞动的便是梦者，飞螅族的拥有心能天赋的表亲。梦者并非利亚瓦拉的原住民，他们原本是飞螅族探险家。在大断层很久之前，他们乘坐首批活体奥玛飞船之一抵达此地。究竟是什么将他们转变，至今仍然是个谜，但从那时起，飞螅族整个种族就一直极其保护他们这些拥有预言能力的表亲。

梦者们缺乏飞螅族的融合意识的能力以及他们的集体主义文化。话虽如此，梦者们经常一起在利亚瓦拉的空中编队跳舞。对大多数协约世界而言，他们是奇特的存在。对飞螅族来说，他们是受保护的对象。梦者们自己似乎并不关心任何这样的关注，对周围发生的事情既不关心也不在意。

7EQ2fJjzDti8qFbB.name: 虚空贤者 Voidsage
7EQ2fJjzDti8qFbB.publicNotes: 虚空贤者是指在幼年阶段的残酷竞争中存活下来、并且自身的纳米虫网络保存完好的阿尔古苏。在吞噬了大量同族的纳米虫后，其网络将强大到足以操控一台远程战争机器。

items.name: 怪异怒火
items.expectedDescription:
You channel the bizarre powers that exist beyond the outer reaches of the universe, dealing 3d12 mental damage to each creature in the area as phantasmal claws, jaws, and tentacles lash out at each target. Each creature in the area must attempt a Will save. The area is difficult terrain for any creature sickened by the effects of this spell.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d12.
items.description:
你引导存在于宇宙外缘之外的怪异力量，幻影利爪、巨颚与触须鞭打每个目标，对区域内每个生物造成3d12心灵伤害。区域内每个生物都必须尝试意志豁免。对因本法术效果陷入恶心的任何生物而言，该区域为困难地形。

大成功 生物不受影响。

成功 生物受到一半伤害。

失败 该生物受到全部伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}。

大失败 生物受到双倍伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心2}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d12。

items.name: 催眠术（随意）
items.expectedDescription:
You create a cloud of mesmerizing patterns and colors that hovers in the air. Creatures are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} while inside the cloud. In addition, a creature must attempt a Will saving throw if it is inside the cloud when you cast it, when it enters the cloud, when it ends its turn within the cloud, or if it uses a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} or Interact action on the cloud. A creature currently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by hypnotize doesn't attempt new saves.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target is fascinated by the cloud.

Critical Failure The target is fascinated by the cloud. While it remains fascinated, it can't use reactions.
items.description:
你创造一个漂浮在空中的令人着迷的彩色图案云团。在云团中的生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}。除此之外，在你施放时处于云团中的生物，进入云团中的生物，在云团中结束回合的生物，或者对云团使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{搜索}或者交互动作的生物在此时必须尝试一次意志豁免。已经被催眠术@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{迷魂}的生物无需尝试新的豁免。

成功 目标不受影响。

失败 目标被该云团迷魂。

大失败 目标被该云团迷魂。只要其仍迷魂，它无法使用反应动作。

items.name: 读心术（随意）
items.expectedDescription:
With a cursory mental touch, you attempt to read the target's mind. It must attempt a Will save. The target then becomes temporarily immune to your mind reading for 1 hour.

Critical Success The target perceives vague surface thoughts from you when you Cast the Spell.

Success You find out whether the target's Intelligence modifier is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Failure You perceive vague surface thoughts from the target when you Cast the Spell, and you find out whether its Intelligence is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Critical Failure As failure, and for the duration of the spell, you can Sustain the spell to detect the target's surface thoughts again. The target doesn't receive any additional saves.
items.description:
你通过一次短暂的心灵接触来尝试阅读目标的想法。它必须尝试一次意志豁免。目标会临时免疫你的读心术1小时。

大成功 目标感知到你施放法术时模糊的表层思想。

成功 你得知目标的智力调整值是高于，等于，还是低于你。

失败 你感知到施放法术时目标模糊的表层思想，并且你得知目标的智力是高于，等于，还是低于你。

大失败 如失败，并且在法术持续时间中，你可以维持该法术来再次侦测目标的表层想法。目标不会获得另外的豁免。

items.name: 虚空低语
items.expectedDescription:
The target hears ominous sounds containing unspeakable mysteries from beyond the stars that disorient its mind. The target attempts a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The target hears the strange whispers, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target begins to wander aimlessly, using each action to Step in a random direction. When it moves, the target takes the safest route and doesn't enter hazardous terrain. The spell has a duration of 1 minute or until a creature uses a hostile action against the target.

Critical Failure As failure, except the target babbles incoherently. Any creature that begins its turn within 20 feet of the target must attempt a Will saving throw. On a failure, it must use its first action on its next turn to Step in a random direction and becomes immune to this spell for 24 hours. This is an incapacitation effect.
items.description:
目标听见来自群星之外的不祥声响，其中蕴含不可言说的奥秘，令它心智迷乱。目标尝试意志豁免。

大成功 生物不受影响。

成功 目标听到奇怪的低语，陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞1}，持续1轮。

失败 目标开始漫无目的地游荡，每个动作都会向一个随机方向快步。目标移动时会选择最安全的路线，且不会进入危险地形。此法术持续1分钟，或直到有生物对目标采取敌意动作。

大失败 如同失败，但目标还会语无伦次地呓语。任何在目标20尺内开始回合的生物都必须尝试意志豁免。失败时，它必须用下个回合的第一个动作向随机方向快步，然后对此法术免疫24小时。这是失能效果。

items.name: 逻辑炸弹
items.expectedDescription:
You implant a hazard containing a mind-blowing amount of information into the target. The hazard has a Stealth and Disable DC equal to your spell DC and requires one successful @Check[computers] check to disable. The first time a creature unsuccessfully attempts to access, destroy, or otherwise manipulate the target (such as using the Computers skill, failing to hit with a Strike, or otherwise), logic bomb detonates, and the creature takes 6d6 mental damage with a basic Will save. The spell ends when it's triggered or the duration ends, whichever comes first.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.
items.description:
你将一个包含大量信息的危害植入目标体内。该危害的隐秘和解除DC与你的法术DC相等，需要一次成功的@Check[computers]才能解除。生物第一次尝试访问、破坏或以其他方式操作目标失败时（例如使用计算机技能、打击未命中或其他），逻辑炸弹会引爆，生物会受到6d6心灵伤害（基础反射豁免）。法术在触发时或持续时间结束时终止，以先到者为准。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 2d6。

items.name: 浏览数据（随意）
items.expectedDescription:
You touch one object and concentrate on a dataset contained within it, such as a story, message, file, infosphere site, audio recording, or video. You understand the gist of the dataset and can quickly locate the most relevant pages or sections to your search. If the dataset is written or otherwise communicated in a language you don't know, or you attempt to gain information from a computer you don't have access to (such as one with a password you don't know), the spell fails.

If you Cast this Spell as part of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.t5nBkpjroaq7QBGK]{Research} activity, you treat a critical failure as a failure instead.
items.description:
你触碰一件物体，专注于其中的一组数据，例如故事、讯息、文件、信息圈网站、录音或视频。你理解这组数据的大意，并且能迅速定位与搜索内容最相关的页面或章节。如果数据以你不懂的语言书写或传达，或你试图从无权访问的计算机中获取信息（例如一台你不知道密码的计算机），法术失败。

如果你将施放此法术作为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.t5nBkpjroaq7QBGK]{研究}活动的一部分，你将大失败改为视作失败。

items.name: 阿卡西下载
items.expectedDescription:
You execute a psychic search of the Akashic Record for information about a specific topic and magically transfer this data to your comm unit or computer. When you Cast this Spell, choose any skill in which you're trained that has the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} action.

Any time during the duration, you can consult your comm unit while attempting a Recall Knowledge check using your chosen skill. This check gains a +1 status bonus. Checking your comm unit is part of the action to Recall Knowledge. You must be holding the comm unit to do so. The comm unit instantly compiles and displays snippets and selections from various media relevant to the topic, which grants you the bonus. If you roll a critical failure on this check, you get a failure instead. If the check is successful and the subject is a creature, you gain additional information or context about the creature. Once you reference the comm unit, the spell ends. When the spell ends, your access to the Akashic Record ends, and all the information you downloaded returns to the Akashic Record.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.h1i8c47U0IOrMrHJ]

Heightened (3rd) You can reference your comm unit three times before the spell ends.
items.description:
你通过灵能搜索阿卡西记录，获取特定主题的信息，并将数据魔法传输至通讯单元或计算机。施放此法术时，选择任何你至少为受训熟练度且能进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]动作的技能。

在持续时间内的任何时候，你都可以在使用所选技能进行回忆知识检定时查询通讯单元。该检定会获得+1状态加值。检查通讯单元是回忆知识动作的一部分。你必须手持通讯单元才能这样做。通讯单元会立即编译并显示与主题相关的各种媒体片段和精选内容，从而为你带来加值。如果你在检定中掷出大失败，改为失败。如果检定成功，且对象是生物，你将获得有关该生物的额外信息或内容。一旦你查询了通讯单元的信息，法术就会结束。当法术结束时，你对阿卡西记录的访问也会结束，你下载的所有信息都会返回阿卡西记录。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.h1i8c47U0IOrMrHJ]

升阶（3环）法术结束前可以用通讯单元查询信息3次。

items.name: 分析目标
items.expectedDescription:
You focus on the target, gathering data as magical holograms display information. When the casting is complete, you learn biometric information about the target, including its fingerprints, medical conditions, and other basic physiological information. You or anyone you advise about the analysis gains a +1 status bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} the creature, to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} on the creature, and to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about it. If the target is illusory or under the effects of illusion magic, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your analyze target spell.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

Heightened (3rd) The status bonus increases to +2, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Heightened (6th) The status bonus increases to +3, and you can target any number of creatures.
items.description:
你专注在目标身上，收集数据并以魔法全息图像显示。当施法完成，你会获得目标的所有生物特征信息，包括指纹、医疗状况和其他基本生理信息。你或任何得到你基于分析建议的人，在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]为该生物、对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]、以及对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]的检定上获得+1状态加值。如果目标是幻觉或者处于幻术魔法效果下，仅当效果的环级低于你分析目标的法术环级，你才能够探测到结果。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

升阶（3环）状态加值提升到+2，并且你可以至多10名生物作为目标。

升阶（6环）状态加值提升到+3，并且你可以任意名生物作为目标。

items.expectedDescription:
You delete data from a device or object with a flamboyant magical gesture. This data might be handwritten, printed, or digital. You delete up to 1,500 words' worth of text, one page of content, or one display screen worth of text or other visual information. Non-magical writing in or on an unattended or held object is automatically deleted. Attempt a counteract check to delete digital or magical writing. If you fail to delete writing that's part of a hazard, you trigger the hazard. This can't be used to delete the contents of a spellbook or similar means of storing magical formulas or spells.

If you target an attended tech item with the tracking trait, attempt a counteract check. On a success, the item becomes glitching 1. A creature holding the item can Interact to restart the software, reducing the glitching value by 1.

Heightened (7th) You can delete all the data stored locally on a single device or book, or all the data on a device or book related to a specific name, topic, or category.
items.description:
你以华丽的魔法手势删除设备或物品中的数据。这些数据可以是手写的、打印的或电子的。你最多可以删除 1,500字的文本、一页内容或一显示屏的文本或其他视觉信息。无主物品或手持物品上的非魔法文字会自动删除。尝试反制检定删除数据或魔法文字。如果你尝试删除的文字是危害的一部分，且你失败，就会触发危害。这不能用于删除魔法书或类似的存储魔法公式或法术的内容。

如果目标是具有追踪特征的科技物品，尝试一次反制检定。如果成功，该物品就会获得故障1。持有该物品的生物可以花费一个交互动作来重启用户界面，并将故障值降低1。

升阶（7环）你可以删除单个设备或书籍中本地存储的所有数据，或者删除设备或书籍中与特定名称、主题或类别相关的所有数据。
items.name: 删除术（随意）
诡枪术
items.expectedDescription:
You condense a beam of mind-assaulting eldritch energy from the dark spaces between the stars and fire it at a target. Make a ranged spell attack roll against the target's AC. If you hit, you deal 2d6 mental damage. On a critical success, you deal double damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你自星辰之间的幽深领域凝聚一束袭魂慑魄的怪异能量攻击目标。尝试一次远程法术攻击骰对抗目标的AC，如果命中，你造成2d6心灵伤害，在大成功时造成双倍伤害。

升阶（+1）伤害增加1d6。

items.name: 植入数据
items.expectedDescription:
You reprogram a computer or device to display a chosen piece of data when accessed. You can implant up to one piece of data per spell rank. A piece of data can be a simple fact, such as a creature or object's location or physical description; an image of a creature or object; or a simple statement of no more than 300 characters. When the target computer or device is accessed, this implanted data is the first data the accessing creature gains, regardless of what data the creature is looking for. Implanted data doesn't prevent a creature from accessing other information stored on a device, change how the device functions, or otherwise inhibit the device from functioning. If this spell's duration ends before a creature accesses the implanted data, the information vanishes.

Heightened (3rd) The duration is one year.

Heightened (6th) The duration is unlimited.
items.description:
你重新编程一台计算机或设备，使其在被访问时显示一条选定的数据。你每个法术环级至多可以植入一条数据。一条数据可以是一项简单事实，例如某个生物或物体的位置或外貌描述；一幅生物或物体的图像；或一句不超过300个字符的简单陈述。目标计算机或设备被访问时，访问者首先获得的总是这条植入数据，无论该生物在寻找什么数据。植入数据不会阻止生物访问设备储存的其他信息，不会改变设备的运作方式，也不会以其他方式妨碍其运作。如果法术持续时间在生物访问植入数据前结束，这些信息便消失。

升阶（3环）持续时间为一年。

升阶（6环）持续时间为无限。

items.name: 心灵穿刺
items.expectedDescription:
You overload a creature's mind with a glut of psychic information or divine judgments. The mental onslaught deals 2d6 mental damage. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.
items.description:
你以海量心灵信息或神圣审判冲击一个生物的心智。这股精神猛攻造成2d6心灵伤害。大失败时，目标还会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞2}，持续1轮。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加2d6。

items.name: 纳米投射
items.expectedDescription: A voidsage can share the senses and read the surface thoughts of creatures affected by their quantum nanites. A voidsage can project its mind into just one creature at a time, and choose which affected creature is the focus of its nanite projection as a single action, which has the concentrate trait. The creature also takes a –1 circumstance penalty to Will saves against any of the voidsage's spells as long as it's the focus of the voidsage's nanite projection.
items.description: 虚空贤者可共享受其量子纳米虫影响的生物的感官，并读取这些生物的表面思维。虚空贤者每次只能将意识投射至单一生物体内，并可通过一个具有专注特征的单动作指定任意一名受影响的生物作为纳米投影的焦点。在纳米投射聚焦期间，该目标生物在对抗虚空贤者的任意法术时，其意志豁免检定还将受到–1 环境减值。

items.name: 纳米网络
items.expectedDescription: 5 feet. A voidsage exudes a cloud of nanites. A creature entering the aura or starting its turn in the aura is exposed to quantum nanites.
items.description: （灵光，疾病）5尺。虚空贤者周身散布纳米虫云团。进入灵光范围或在灵光中开始回合的生物将暴露在量子纳米虫的影响下。

items.name: 复原
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger The voidsage takes damage while projecting

Effect The voidsage stops projecting and gains 50 temporary Hit Points that last for 10 minutes.
items.description:
频率 每小时一次

触发 虚空贤者在投射期间受到伤害

效果 虚空贤者停止投射，并获得50点临时生命值，持续10分钟。

items.name: 量子纳米虫
items.expectedDescription:
Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:24]

Maximum Duration 1 day

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} (1 day)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 3} (1 day)

Stage 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 4} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} (1 day)
items.description:
豁免 @Check[fortitude|dc:24]

最长持续时间 1天

阶段1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心2}（1天）

阶段2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心3}（1天）

阶段3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心4}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{麻痹}（1天）

82XG93ZGtkXH4mQt.name: 流散带蠕虫 Diaspora Worm

items.name: 电场通讯
items.expectedDescription: Diaspora worms communicate by shaping and reading electromagnetic fields. This functions like telepathy with creatures that share this ability.
items.description: 流散带蠕虫通过塑造和解读电磁场来交流。这对同样具有此能力的生物而言，作用如同心灵感应。

items.name: 电磁视觉
items.expectedDescription: Diaspora worms sense their surroundings by reading electromagnetic fields, including disruptions caused by creatures or objects. This is a precise sense within the listed range. Intense fields, such as areas emitting radiation or auras of electricity, make creatures within them @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} to the diaspora worm.
items.description: 流散带蠕虫通过解读电磁场来感知周围环境，包括生物或物体造成的电磁场扰动。这是所列范围内的精确感官。强烈的电磁场，例如辐射区域或电击灵光，会使其中的生物对流散带蠕虫具有@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。

items.name: 电磁致盲
items.expectedDescription:
Diaspora worms that take electricity damage must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:23] save.

Critical Success The worm is unaffected.

Success The worm is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

Failure The worm is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The worm is blinded for 1 round, then dazzled for 1 round.
items.description:
受到电击伤害的流散带蠕虫必须尝试@Check[fortitude|dc:23]豁免。

大成功 蠕虫不受影响。

成功 蠕虫陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}，持续1轮。

失败 蠕虫陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲}，持续1轮。

大失败 蠕虫目盲1轮，然后目眩1轮。

items.name: 暗水帷幕
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements The diaspora worm is in water

Effect The worm alters the structure of water within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10], forming light-absorbing nanotubes. This field moves with the worm and lasts for 1 minute. The emanation deactivates non-magical light sources and automatically attempts to counteract magical light (counteract rank 4, counteract modifier [[/r 1d20+17 #Counteract]]{+17}). This field also provides cover for creatures inside of it from those outside, and vice versa.
items.description:
需求 流散带蠕虫位于水中

效果 蠕虫改变@Template[type:emanation|distance:10]内水的结构，形成吸光纳米管。此场域随蠕虫移动，持续1分钟。弥漫会停用非魔法光源，并自动尝试反制魔法光照（反制环阶4，反制调整值[[/r 1d20+17 #Counteract]]{+17}）。场域还为内部生物提供对抗外部生物的掩蔽，反之亦然。

items.name: 活吞
items.expectedDescription:
Medium, @Damage[(1d10+8)[bludgeoning]], Rupture 12

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.SwallowWhole]
items.description:
中型，@Damage[(1d10+8)[bludgeoning]]，破裂12

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.SwallowWhole]

items.name: 舌抓
items.expectedDescription: A creature hit by the diaspora worm's tongue becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}. A creature can sever the tongue with a Strike against AC 19 that deals at least 12 slashing damage. This prevents the worm from using its tongue Strike until it regrows its tongue, which takes 1 day.
items.description: 被蠕虫舌打击命中的生物会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]。生物可尝试一次针对AC19的攻击，并且一次性至少造成12点挥砍伤害来切断其舌头。这会阻止蠕虫使用舌打击，直至其重新长出舌头（需1天）。

items.name: 舌卷
items.expectedDescription:

需求 流散带蠕虫已用舌头使一个生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{受擒}

82XG93ZGtkXH4mQt.publicNotes:
流散带蠕虫形似长牙鳗鱼，以鬃毛般的触须取代眼睛。它们曾统治后来成为冰质小行星尼西斯（Nisis）的那片墨色深海。由于其对闯入者的敌意，以及缺乏可观测的语言能力，多数人视其为普通野兽；但外星生物学家发现：这些触须能响应电磁波，并以此“看”、交流及与环境互动。从它们原生礁石中回收的珊瑚样本所释放的生物电辐射，记录了数千年的蠕虫文化与历史，甚至追溯至流散带形成之前。

该物种的幼年个体尽管体型不小，却光滑、柔韧且敏捷。它们的电磁操控能力可短暂改变水的分子结构，令水域变得如原生深海般浑浊。年轻蠕虫倾向于发动鲁莽攻击，需积累数十年经验才会重视更复杂的策略。

"太空蠕虫"并非科学术语，而是对外星生物学上复杂的无脊椎动物与野兽类群的俗称——它们栖息于浩瀚太空之中。其中一些（如流散带蠕虫与沙地蠕虫）显现出智能迹象，且彼此直接相关；另一些（如噬矿蠕虫）则独立演化，其起源对科学界而言完全未知。

8FyWTto9DlAH3l7e.name: 工具鼠 Tool Rat
8FyWTto9DlAH3l7e.publicNotes:
工具鼠形似同类幼崽，但细看便会发现其生有红铜色的胡须，宛如矮人的胡须与眉毛。凭借与生俱来的法术天赋，它们能将废品场变成危机四伏的雷区。

当堆积如山的金属垃圾开始侵蚀荒野时，啮齿类生物便占据了这些废弃物。废料鼠能适应任何丢弃废旧机械与工业碎片的文明环境，并将这些垃圾回收再利用——其改造产物往往暗藏致命威胁。尽管智力平平，它们却天生具备手艺天赋。

9Glg5ae0zQtosEUD.name: 热熔巨兽 Thermatrod
9Glg5ae0zQtosEUD.publicNotes:
普通热熔巨兽栖息于火山口附近或其他高温热源周边。

最初人们认为热熔巨兽是来自火元素位面的流亡者，但实际上它们是在宇宙中多个恒星系里独立演化而成的。热熔巨兽形似熔融状态的双足生物，不过为了支撑沉重的躯体，它们常常用前肢指关节行走。其背部有独特的隆起甲壳，形状类似六边形玄武岩柱，研究人员借此判断个体的年龄。热熔巨兽坚硬的外壳成分差异极大，这取决于它们日常饮食中所摄取的当地矿物沉积物。

9o387yPZKfdBpqmu.publicNotes:
小巧的沃卡里基是协约世界的一种常见动物，源自卡斯卓韦。失落的格拉利昂的人类探险家给它们起了个名字叫松鼠狐，因为他们认为这种动物是狐狸和松鼠的混合体。它们狡猾到了奸诈的地步，经常采用吓唬的手段，带着旅行中发现的闪亮物品潜逃。它们表现出复杂的社会行为，包括狐群中个体之间有明显的等级差异，并且能发出丰富的声音，能让不同的松鼠狐个体有各自标志性的声音。

松鼠狐早已从协约世界出口到了整个星系，近宇的许多文明中，这些毛茸茸的小动物群体不断增长，这让异星卫士越来越感到不安，他们担心适应能力极强的松鼠狐已经成为一些生物群落中的入侵物种。虽然有些人主张扑杀这些种群中的个体，但这种动物作为宠物的受欢迎程度使得这种做法非常不受欢迎。

年幼的松鼠狐被称为狐崽（kits），可以在大多数协约世界的公开市场上买到。松鼠狐的寿命大约为10年。典型的松鼠狐重约10磅，身长约3尺，其中尾巴占了大部分长度。松鼠狐有各种颜色，许多松鼠狐甚至会适应特定的气候环境，例如居住在沙漠中的松鼠狐会长出更长的耳朵来帮助散热。

A2PLmRlJpjTe8DcV.publicNotes:
在恩布罗伊险恶的海域，当地居民总是在低声谈论地狱鱿。虽然有人认为它们只是传说，但据说这些巨大的形似鱿鱼的异怪身上，长着令人不寒而栗的发光符文，暗示着它们的地狱血脉。据说那些被它们扭动着的触手拖入深海，被张开的大口吞噬的人，会直接下地狱，而他们临死前的惨叫则进一步滋养了这些传说。

这些传说千真万确。地狱鱿拥有残忍的智慧，并能支配凡人的心灵。幸存者会遭受令人不安的幻象折磨，陷入强烈的恐惧与困惑之中，并目睹不洁之火在波涛之上燃烧的景象。对于任何敢于在恩布罗伊海域航行的勇者而言，听见地狱鱿那阴险的灵能尖啸，或是驶入它们巨大的阴影之中，都是一种骇人的经历。

天使及其盟友手持巨大的圣洁鱼叉与施了魔法的银网，猎杀地狱鱿。纪录片《乌米昆》（Umiqon）（由丧媒体制作）中记录了一场传奇般的狩猎，该片以四名艾奥梅黛骑士击杀的那头40尺高的怪物命名。

AHr2vBO1I5JvFqJ9.publicNotes:
在地热活跃的区域探险的冒险者可能会遇到极端栖息地中最独特的生物之一：熔岩熊。这些熊形穴居生物部分覆盖着鳞片，并长有一支可怕的角。它们天生好静，但一旦受到惊扰，它们的愤怒结合了熊的凶猛和火山碎屑流的炽热。

熔岩熊特别适应在极热的气候中生存，但在任何温暖的地方都能繁盛。那些居住在条件较差的星球上的个体倾向于留在地下，并在一年中最冷的时期冬眠。

作为食腐动物，熔岩熊不会把下一顿饭视为理所当然。然而，这些聪明的生物能够操控环境来捕捉猎物。人们观察到，在火山爆发前，熔岩熊会构建大型的隧道网络，似乎是因为它们明白熔岩流会沿着这条阻力最小的路径前进。这些隧道变成了完美的红热熔岩河流，正好可以困住逃跑的野生动物。在火山爆发最猛烈的时候过去后，熔岩熊会回来享用它们的战利品。

熔岩熊对火山生态系统有着显著的影响。掘地的熔岩熊会破碎坚硬的岩石——通常是火山爆发后新沉积的——促使土壤形成的过程，这对植物的回归是必需的。有些熔岩熊在挖掘时离地下岩浆室太近，将它们的隧道变成了释放熔岩和气体的火山喷口。通过这种方式，它们使得剧烈、破坏性的火山爆发变得更少，并为严酷的环境提供了一份调节之力。

AWuQOOAIKtToeiEh.publicNotes:
曲织缝合者自诩为存在的守护者，坚信诸神将其创造的目的是要缝合平行现实之间的空隙。这些恐怖的异怪会无情地追捕那些它们怀疑为了改变多元宇宙结构而滥用魔法或科技的任何事物。当它们发现猎物后，仅会稍作停留以证实其怀疑，随即便会发起攻击。对于任何潜在威胁——比如首次尝试戏法的新手施法者或者探索星际旅行的学术理论家——曲织缝合者会对其发出心灵感应警告，告知若一意孤行将会面临何种下场。不属于威胁（包括潜在威胁）的一切，都可能被曲织缝合者用作工具，成为其谎言或胁迫的目标。

其外观本身就能成为噩梦的素材，昆虫般的肢体支撑着巨大的球状躯干。其背部延伸出五条多节的肢体，肢体末端是缠绕着现实本质的凶残利爪，用于刺穿猎物并将其缝进自己体内。这些不幸的生物会被迅速溶解，很可能被用于维系曲织缝合者的存在——但究竟是通过吞噬其肉体、思维、还是其在其他现实中的潜能来达成这点仍不得而知。少数幸存者会被萦绕着不安的幻视所折磨；更小一部分人则可能窥见另一种更幸福的人生，从而获得内心的平静，有时甚至能获得前所未有的织维巫师力量。

B0gtwwywwaa6Bd90.name: 监察魔（缄默魔鬼） Deprimogon
B0gtwwywwaa6Bd90.publicNotes:
在那些政府与地狱缔结契约的聚居地，监察魔潜行于隐匿隧道、暗巷及森然高塔中，悄无声息地监视市民，搜寻任何煽动叛乱的迹象。煽动者或自由战士会遭到这些魔鬼的骚扰、追捕乃至诱入陷阱，最终永远消失。监察魔以光滑的金属面具遮掩面容，用以压制自身情感，隔绝一切可能妨碍其任务的恳求、威胁或讨价还价。监察魔热衷于召唤来自早已被遗忘的时代的魔鬼造物，用以折磨其囚徒。

在空间站的阴影深处、法庭的庄严厅堂以及企业集团的办公室之中，魔鬼们以力量为诱饵引诱凡人，为魔鬼的征服铺平道路。魔鬼的契约形式多样，可能是精心拟定的正式协议，也可能是转瞬即逝的口头承诺，但最终结果都如出一辙：一个凡人的灵魂被定罪，地狱的势力则因此得到壮大。从马尔法涅（Malfane）公开的统治，到恩布罗伊（Embroi）隐秘的控制，再到与银河各地灵魂之间暗中缔结的契约，魔鬼们不断推进他们冷酷无情的事业，将暴政四处散播，迫使宇宙变得愈发像他们那地狱般的官僚国度。

items.name: 魔鬼契约（DC 27）
items.expectedDescription:
You make an appeal to a powerful devil, asking them to bind some of their subordinates to your service. If you succeed, the devil sends you their choice of one devil of level 2 or lower, two devils of level 0 or lower, or three devils of level –1 or lower.

Critical Success The devils are sent to you and serve you for [[/gmr 1d4 #Weeks]]{1d4 weeks}.

Success The devils are sent to you and serve you for [[/gmr 1d4 #Days]]{1d4 days}.

Failure Your request is denied.

Critical Failure Not only is your request denied, but the powerful devil sends word of its displeasure to your master.

Heightened (+1) Increase the level of devil sent to you by 2 for each option.
items.description:
你恳请强大的魔鬼，请求他派遣一些手下受你调遣。若你的仪式成功，魔鬼会根据自身的选择进行派遣，这可能是1个2级或更低等级的魔鬼、2个0级或更低等级的魔鬼、或者3个-1级或更低等级的魔鬼。

大成功 被派来的魔鬼会为你服务[[/gmr 1d4 #Weeks]]{1d4周}。

成功 被派来的魔鬼会为你服务[[/gmr 1d4 #Days]]{1d4天}。

失败 你的请求被拒绝了。

大失败 你的请求不仅被拒绝了，且强大的魔鬼会将自身的不满告知你的主人。

升阶（+1） 每个选项中为你派遣的魔鬼等级增加2级。

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and temporarily immune to the deprimogon's evoke paranoia for 1 minute.

Success The creature is unaffected and temporarily immune to the deprimogon's evoke paranoia for 1 round.

Failure Until the beginning of the deprimogon's next turn, the creature believes everyone it sees is a potential threat. It becomes unfriendly to all creatures to which it wasn't already hostile, even those who were previously allies. It treats no one as an ally.

Critical Failure As failure, except the target believes that everyone it sees is a mortal enemy. It uses its reactions and free actions against everyone, regardless of whether they were previously its allies, as determined by the GM. It otherwise acts as rationally as it normally does and likely prefers to attack creatures that are actively attacking or hindering it over those leaving it alone.

监察魔将猜忌和不信任注入武器，每次攻击都会令受害者心生怀疑。被监察魔的打击造成伤害的生物必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:27]豁免。

大成功 生物不受影响，并临时免疫该监察魔的唤起猜忌，持续1分钟。

成功 生物不受影响，并临时免疫该监察魔的唤起猜忌，持续1轮。

失败 直到监察魔的下一回合开始，生物相信其看到的每个人都是潜在威胁。其对所有原先并非敌对的生物变为不友善，即使对方此前是盟友。其不将任何人视为盟友。

B2q9ekBWgi1k1okf.publicNotes:
惑众魅灵形如银幕上闪烁的光影，或是后台瞥见的霓虹剪影。它们在短波静电中翻腾，从逐渐褪色的凹版画景中向外凝视。惑众魅灵是已故媒体巨星的不死幽灵，它们徘徊在昔日辉煌的场所，渴望那些健忘粉丝的关注。

大部分惑众魅灵生活在生前生活的幻想之中，但一旦这幻想破灭，他们便会被强烈的想要夺回失去名望的欲望驱使。此时，他们会变得难以捉摸，哪怕是最微不足道的冒犯也可能会引发一场致命的暴怒。

惑众魅灵体现着自己生前的舞台形象。这些日渐腐朽的名媛将仰慕者诱入永恒的粉丝俱乐部，却怡然不知自己会吸走这些新仰慕者的生命。惑众魅灵寻求能作为牺牲品的粉丝，诱来毫无防备的人并吸干其生命力，从而永远保持声名与光彩。

B3HpMcv3prB4ttjT.publicNotes:
人们首次遇见战斗虫，是在克雷西斯卡子群突然现身，并首次袭击桑迪特联合体星域的时候。这些狼一般大小的组件生物能够钻入地下，以极快的速度抵达适合设伏的位置。一旦发现威胁，战斗虫就会从地下的藏身处跃出，用口中的酸液炮猛烈攻击敌人。向敌人喷吐生物酸液的战斗虫越多，这种物质溶解目标的速度就越快，令其痛苦不堪。

虫群由浩界深处一种称为虫族的昆虫状物种发展而来，许多文明认为它是世上最大的威胁。虫群由无数子群组成，每个子群又包含无数组件亚种；这支庞大的群体以心灵联合的方式行动，意图吞噬宇宙中的一切物质。最可怕的是，虫群能够同化被其吞噬者的知识与DNA。由于在大断层之前便已发展出星际旅行技术，虫群在历史中断之前就已经吞噬了无数星系；而在获得信标与名为漂流域的超空间维度后，它们的步伐更是加快了。

被虫群触及的世界会被榨干自然资源，化为称作空壳世界的荒芜之地。外人所谓的“虫群星域”，不过是虫群在肆意进军中吞噬过的一大片死寂世界。虫群将这些世界剥夺得如此彻底，以至于勘探者连稀有矿物和水等无机资源的微量痕迹都难以找到。这些空壳世界很少被彻底探索，因为探索往往会唤醒沉寂的虫群个体。人们推测，它们被留下，是为了应对被吞噬的星系再遭殖民、重新出现居民的情况。远在这片星域之外，也有零星的虫群活动，因为虫群在大断层之前的漫长岁月中派出了无数子群；即使到了今天，也只有部分子群抵达了预定目的地。

在当今时代，虫群最广为人知的或许是两件事。首先，它们对协约世界与维斯卡里姆的进攻，促成了这两大势力停止敌对，并结成脆弱的联盟。其次，虫群是希伦虫人的直系祖先。希伦虫人在大断层期间的某个时候脱离虫群，寻得了神祇海拉丝的庇护。据信，海拉丝由虫群形成之前的虫族进化而来，并背弃了后来演变成贪婪实体的虫群。

近年来，除了在浩界的苏斯基隆星系开展的机密行动之外，虫群并无活动，人们几乎只把它当作遥远的吓人传说。然而，最近人们发现了失踪的桑迪特世界克雷西斯卡，无意间唤醒了曾吞噬这个世界的休眠子群。自此，这个新获名为克雷西斯卡的子群成为了近宇的祸害，正在积极入侵桑迪特联合体的世界，并有蔓延至维斯卡里姆和协约世界等其他势力的趋势。这个被重新发现的子群已开始让其组件快速进化，虽然仍与更广大的虫群隔绝，却已对近宇构成明确威胁。

items.name: 大灾变
items.expectedDescription:
You call upon the unimaginable power of world-ending cataclysms, ripping a small piece of each cataclysm and combining them together into one horrifically powerful attack. The following effects come down upon all creatures in the area. Treat the resistances of creatures in the area as if they were 10 lower for the purpose of determining the cataclysm's damage. Each creature attempts one basic Reflex save that applies to all five types of damage.

  • Flesh-dissolving acid rain deals 3d10 acid damage.
  • A roaring earthquake shakes and bludgeons creatures on the ground, dealing 3d10 bludgeoning damage.
  • A blast of freezing wind deals 3d10 cold damage.
  • Incredible lightning lashes the area, dealing 3d10 electricity damage.
  • Beating winds churn across the sky, dealing 3d10 bludgeoning damage to creatures flying in the area.
  • An instant tsunami sweeps over creatures in the area, dealing 3d10 bludgeoning damage with the water trait (doubled for creatures swimming in the area).
  • A massive wildfire burns in a sudden inferno, dealing 3d10 fire damage.
items.description:
你唤动难以想象的足以毁天灭地的大灾难的力量，从每种灾难中取一小块，并将它们组合在一起形成可怕的强力攻击。后续效果影响区域中的所有生物。在决定大灾变的伤害时，区域内的生物的抗力视为低10点。每个生物必须尝试一次基础反射豁免，对全部五种伤害类型生效。

  • 溶解肉体的酸雨造成3d10酸蚀伤害。
  • 咆哮的地震击打地面上的生物，造成3d10钝击伤害。
  • 一阵冰冷的狂风造成3d10寒冷伤害。
  • 可怕的闪电撕裂区域，造成3d10电击伤害。
  • 爆裂的狂风席卷天空，对在该区域飞行的生物造成3d10钝击伤害。
  • 突然的海啸横扫区域中的生物，造成3d10钝击伤害，并具有水特征（对于在该区域游泳的生物翻倍）。
  • 猛烈的野火如炼狱般烧过，造成3d10火焰伤害。

items.name: 无敌咒
items.expectedDescription: You sever yourself from cause and effect. For the duration of the spell, you are immune to any effect or damage that would harm you, excluding effects caused by artifacts, deific power, and similarly powerful sources. You can selectively allow yourself to be affected by anything you're willing to have affect you.

items.name: 原子能爆破
items.expectedDescription:

All creatures in the area take 5d12 bludgeoning damage and 5d12 fire damage, and they're exposed to extreme radiation that uses your spellcasting DC as the @Check[fortitude]{Fortitude DC} for radiation sickness incurred by exposure to this radiation. The onset and frequency of this magical radiation is 1 round, and the area remains radioactive for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The target is unaffected by the initial damage.

Success The target takes half damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 minute.

Failure The target takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, and the target takes double damage.
items.description:
你用魔法分裂一个原子，制造一场带有放射性尘埃的爆炸。区域内的所有生物都会受到5d12钝击伤害和5d12火焰伤害，并暴露于极端辐射环境下，该辐射会导致辐射病，使用你的法术DC作为染上此辐射病的@Check[fortitude]{强韧DC}。这种魔法辐射的潜伏期和频率为1轮，该区域在10分钟内持续辐射。

大成功目标不受初始伤害影响。

成功目标受到一半伤害并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]1分钟。

失败目标受到全额伤害并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]1分钟。

大失败同失败，目标受到双倍伤害。

items.name: 行动无碍（恒定）

BFtNnevWKUCnocyn.publicNotes:
当一只巨大的泥怪状生物从卡斯卓韦的工业卫星艾琳卓的污染洞穴中涌现时，行星领袖们误以为这只泥怪对卡斯卓韦本身不构成威胁。当泥怪摧毁了卫星上的数座造船厂，继而穿越太空抵达乌库兰的偏远地带时，他们再次误判，以为还有时间将威胁隔离在那片大陆的偏僻荒野。当它的辐射开始扩散，死去多时的艾琳卓人邪教徒从歌咏山脉下的巢穴坟场复苏，开始崇拜这只泥怪时，行星领袖们终于意识到，自己再也无法无视它。他们称其为乌库兰的恐噩。直到如今，他们仍不清楚它究竟是什么、为何存在，又想要什么。

恐噩是一个巨大的泥怪状生物，形似层叠的油腻暗绿色肉瓣。它将唯一的身体构造特征——一只巨大的紫色眼睛——隐藏在起伏的表面之下。这个生物大部分时间都漂浮在深邃的地下洞穴或海沟中，一动不动地停留数日，然后突然移动很远的距离，几乎总是沿直线前进，接着再次停下。这些停驻点看似随机，却越来越频繁地迫使聚居地迁离。沿着恐噩路径跟随的复仇信徒，几乎与它散播的辐射同样危险，尽管他们追随它的原因与恐噩本身一样难以捉摸。

基于原子能、尤其是原子武器的特性，卡斯卓韦的科学家们推断，放射性的恐噩在死亡时造成的破坏，很可能不亚于它活着时的破坏，甚至更甚。即使卡斯卓韦及其盟友的联合军力足以击败恐噩，这些科学家仍警告说，他们需要更多时间研究恐噩，评估直接摧毁它的风险。当然，每过一天，就有更多艾琳卓人涌向恐噩，也有更多受害者撞上它的毁灭之路。

BeqWprlTnTffXV0R.publicNotes:
这些木元素虽然有着啮齿动物的可爱外形，主体却不幸由能产生毒素的藻类组成。蓝藻灵能在任何温暖、潮湿的环境中繁盛生长。蓝藻灵形成的水华很容易发现：远看如同漂在静水上的蓝绿色草甸，或是一簇簇附着在植物与岩石上的绒状青绿色苔藓。被这壮丽景象打动的探险者，可能冒险靠近水边，或伸手触摸柔软鲜丽的苔藓，结果便与这些美丽却有毒的生物接触。

元素生物是原初位面侵入此间的能量化身。它们形态多样，既有风与水中无心智的涡流，也有能够运用原能魔法的复杂实体。太空旅行的兴起与科技的进步，使更多元素的活体化身得以在宇宙中显现。

山火、太阳风暴和洪水等自然事件，可能将大群难以驾驭的元素生物释放到行星或某片星域。有时，强大元素生物的聚集会引发规模惊人的自然灾难，例如烧毁行星电网的超强太阳耀斑，或是在气态巨行星大气中旋转不息的风暴。

CaLynyqIcbH15xZ1.publicNotes:
贫瘠的伊奥克斯行星上，巨大的玻璃蛇是协约世界最臭名昭著的顶级掠食者之一。玻璃蛇平均身长近60尺，重约5,000磅，但体型与优雅只是让它们成为高效杀手的部分原因。独特鳞片赋予了玻璃蛇天生的隐形能力，使它们处于大多数生物的可见光谱之外，能够悄然接近毫无防备的猎物。这些蛇历经伊奥克斯无数灾变而进化，从偶尔造访这个世界的活物群体身上获取食物；但奇怪的是，玻璃蛇吞食活物时，恰恰最为脆弱。吞食活物所用的酸液与消化液混合物，也会剥夺它们的隐形能力，因此机敏的玻璃蛇猎人会主动用动物引诱猎物吞食，再大举进攻。

玻璃蛇早已远远走出伊奥克斯的范围，有些甚至在流散带的奇异水道——星间之河——中找到了合适的生态系统。当地萨瑟蝶人指责伊奥克斯故意引入掠食者，污染他们的水道，但伊奥克斯否认一切蓄意干涉的指控。自流散带在萨瑟蝶人的管理下获得临时协约世界地位以来，这些争论愈发激烈。

items.expectedName: Interplanar Teleport (at will; self only; to and from Akashic Record and the Universe only)
items.name: 跨界传送（随意；仅自身；只能往返于阿卡西记录与物质宇宙）
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements You have a planar key for the destination plane, used as a locus

You and your allies traverse the barriers between planes of existence. The targets move to another plane, such as the Plane of Fire, the Netherworld, or the Outer Rifts. You must know the destination plane exists and use a magic planar key created from material from that plane as a locus for the spell. While the planar keys for most prominent planes are uncommon, just like the spell interplanar teleport, more obscure planes and demiplanes often have rare or possibly even unique planar keys.

The spell is highly imprecise, and you appear 1d20×25 miles from the last place one of the targets (of your choice) was located the last time that target traveled to the plane. If it's the first time traveling to a particular plane for all targets, you appear at a random location on the plane. Interplanar teleport doesn't provide a means of return travel, though casting interplanar teleport again allows you to return to your previous plane unless there are extenuating circumstances.
items.description:
需求 你持有目的地位面的位面密钥，用作施法载体

你和你的盟友跨越位面之间的屏障进行旅行。目标移动至其他位面，比如火元素位面、幽界、或者外层裂隙。你必须知晓目标位面的存在，而且需要使用由该位面的物质制作的魔法位面密钥作为本法术的施法载体。就如同跨界传送这个法术本身一样，大多数著名位面的位面密钥具有罕见稀有度，而鲜为人知的位面及半位面通常具有稀有、甚至有可能具有独特稀有度的位面密钥。

该法术极其不精准，你会出现在目标之一（由你选择）上一次造访该位面时的位置周边，误差为1d20×25里。若所有目标都是初次造访某个特定位面，你们就会出现在该位面的随机位置。跨界传送不会提供返回的手段，不过除非发生了什么另外情况，否则再次施放跨界传送能让你返回自身之前身处的位面。

items.expectedDescription:
You execute a psychic search of the Akashic Record for information about a specific topic and magically transfer this data to your comm unit or computer. When you Cast this Spell, choose any skill in which you're trained that has the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} action.

Any time during the duration, you can consult your comm unit while attempting a Recall Knowledge check using your chosen skill. This check gains a +1 status bonus. Checking your comm unit is part of the action to Recall Knowledge. You must be holding the comm unit to do so. The comm unit instantly compiles and displays snippets and selections from various media relevant to the topic, which grants you the bonus. If you roll a critical failure on this check, you get a failure instead. If the check is successful and the subject is a creature, you gain additional information or context about the creature. Once you reference the comm unit, the spell ends. When the spell ends, your access to the Akashic Record ends, and all the information you downloaded returns to the Akashic Record.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.h1i8c47U0IOrMrHJ]

Heightened (3rd) You can reference your comm unit three times before the spell ends.
items.description:

在持续时间内的任何时候，你都可以在使用所选技能进行回忆知识检定时查询通讯单元。该检定会获得+1状态加值。检查通讯单元是回忆知识动作的一部分。你必须手持通讯单元才能这样做。通讯单元会立即编译并显示与主题相关的各种媒体片段和精选内容，从而为你带来加值。如果你在检定中掷出大失败，改为失败。如果检定成功，且对象是生物，你将获得有关该生物的额外信息或内容。一旦你查询了通讯单元的信息，法术就会结束。当法术结束时，你对阿卡西记录的访问也会结束，你下载的所有信息都会返回阿卡西记录。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.h1i8c47U0IOrMrHJ]

升阶（3环）法术结束前可以用通讯单元查询信息3次。

items.expectedDescription: The first time each encounter the Akashic dragon hits and deals damage to a creature with their jaws Strike, they receive information about the creature as if they'd succeeded at a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about that creature.
items.description: 每次遭遇中，阿卡西龙首次以颚部打击命中一个生物并造成伤害时，便获得有关该生物的信息，如同成功进行了有关该生物的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{回忆知识}检定。

DVGQMdggCgbM9CFn.name: 青年阿卡西龙 Akashic Dragon (Young)
DVGQMdggCgbM9CFn.publicNotes: 阿卡西龙通常藏身于残破、堆满遗物的巢穴，鲜少在外界露面，但偶尔也会居住在繁忙的空间站或城市等知识枢纽。这些龙天生与阿卡西记录直接相连，是傲慢的知识保管者，自认没有其他生物可能比它们更了解宇宙的秘密——而这一判断往往确实无误。阿卡西龙会在阿卡西记录中停留很长时间，离开时常以为已过去许多天，然而对银河系的其他地方而言，仅仅过了几小时。

DXFU7ZmEZzHWC0Np.name: 湮灭级刺客机器人 Elimination-Class Assassin Robot
DXFU7ZmEZzHWC0Np.publicNotes:
湮灭级机型优雅而致命，依靠隐匿力场让敌人难辨虚实，在最出其不意之处发动攻击。先进智能使它们能够布置更复杂的伏击，也能按需应对局势变化、满足客户要求。依照任务意图及想要传达的信息，杀戮可以尽可能隐秘，也可以尽可能惨烈。

在一些社会中，机器将许多流程自动化。因此，有人试图让谋杀也自动化，似乎顺理成章。大多数制造商绝不会承认曾创造过这种设计，富有的人物只得通过隐秘渠道，从秘密设施或不择手段的制造商手中获取这些机体。无论来源如何，都可以为这些机器人设定目标，再放任它们行动；主人确信，要么目标会死去，要么机器人烧毁的电路会使目标无法证明是谁企图杀害自己。

此狙击步枪配有复合科技瞄准镜，让狙击手通过自然的眼部动作调节焦距和放大倍数，无需使用可能扰乱瞄准的活动部件。

items.description: 当刺客机器人被摧毁时，其电路系统将自动触发自毁程序，这使得追踪其所有者变得极其困难。从被摧毁的刺客机器人中恢复数据时，计算机检定的DC需额外增加10点。

items.description: 湮灭级刺客机器人锁定120尺内它能看见的一个生物。该生物无法对机器人变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}，也无法对机器人[[/act create-a-diversion]]。此能力持续到机器人失去与目标的视觉线，或目标以其他方式变为藏匿为止。

Db64i0oL1biUoViM.name: 沙鲼 Dust Manta
Db64i0oL1biUoViM.publicNotes: 致命的隐秘掠食者，沙鲼潜伏在物质宇宙各处沙漠世界的地表之下。尽管平均翼展达10尺，体重达1吨，但凭借鹅卵石般沙色的外皮，它们在原生栖息地几乎难以被察觉。它们如光线穿透水体般感知周遭震动，在沙滩与沙丘间滑行伏击不幸的猎物。其锋利的螫针注入能分解血肉骨骼的致命毒素，将猎物溶解成沙粒，这样滤食性的沙鲼便能从悬浮的沙粒中筛选出食物颗粒。

items.name: 沙地感知
items.expectedDescription: The dust manta can feel the slightest disturbance in nearby sand, granting it the ability to sense other creatures moving through or on top of the same body of sand that it's in. In addition, the dust manta ignores @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealment} from sandstorms, and they're immune to being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} by sand or other grit.
items.description: 沙鲼能够感受到附近沙粒最细微的扰动，因而可以感知其他生物在它所在的同一片沙体中或沙面上移动。此外，沙鲼忽略沙尘暴造成的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}，并免疫沙粒或其他砂砾造成的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}。

items.name: 掘地冲锋
items.expectedDescription: The dust manta surges through sand to attack unwary prey. It Burrows up to twice its burrow Speed, then Leaps vertically up to 25 feet high, making a stinger Strike against a creature at any point during the jump (this lets it attack a creature within 35 feet of the surface). After the Leap, the dust manta falls to the ground but takes no damage from the fall if it lands on sand.
items.description: 沙鲼穿沙而行，袭击毫无防备的猎物。它掘地至多等于自身掘地速度两倍的距离，然后垂直跳跃至多25尺高，并在跳跃过程中的任意时点对一个生物进行一次螫刺打击（这使它能够攻击距地表35尺内的生物）。跳跃后，沙鲼落回地面，但若落在沙地上便不会受到此次坠落的伤害。

items.name: 隐于沙中
items.expectedDescription: The dust manta's sand-colored hide allows it to [[/act hide]] in sand or any other fine, similarly colored substance even without cover or concealment.
items.description: 沙鲼沙色的外皮使它即使没有掩蔽或隐蔽，也能在沙子或其他颜色相近的细颗粒物质中[[/act hide]]。

All creatures in the cloud become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and all creatures outside the cloud become concealed to creatures within it. A non-dust manta creature that enters or starts its turn in the cloud must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:24|options:area-effect,inflicts:blinded,inflicts:dazzled] save.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 minute or until it spends an Interact action to wipe the dirt and grit from its eyes.

items.description:

成功 生物不受影响。

items.description: 组装泥怪能在所列范围内以精确感官侦测到具有科技特征的生物和物体。

An assembly ooze can craft items with a cost up to the UPBs stored, but with an item level and Bulk of no greater than 4 each.
items.description: 组装泥怪花费1分钟，利用体内储存的通用聚合物制作一件随机装备（掷[[/r 1d6]]：1–护甲、2–盾牌、3–武器、4–护甲强化、5–武器强化或6–科技物品）。组装泥怪可制作价格至多等于其储存通用聚合物数量的物品，但每件物品的等级和负载均不得超过4。

items.name: 拆解
items.expectedDescription: The assembly ooze engulfs an adjacent, unattended piece of gear of no more than 4 Bulk, deconstructing it into its component parts. The ooze gains a number of UPBs equal to the item's price in credits. An assembly ooze can hold up to 1,000 UPBs at a time.
items.description: 组装泥怪吞入一件相邻、无人看管且不超过4负载的装备，将其拆解为组成部件。泥怪获得数量等同于该物品信用点价格的通用聚合物（UPB）。组装泥怪同一时间可以容纳至多1,000UPB。

items.name: 黏性卸武
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements The assembly ooze's last action was a successful pseudopod Strike

Effect The ooze attempts to [[/act disarm options=sticky-disarm]] the creature it hit. It gains a +4 status bonus to the Athletics check. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the ooze's multiple attack penalty.
items.description:
需求 组装泥怪的上个动作是一次成功的伪足打击

效果 泥怪尝试对命中的生物[[/act disarm options=sticky-disarm]]，其运动检定获得+4状态加值。此尝试既不应用、也不计入泥怪的多重攻击减值。

Du0RjEnYSKfNXW6f.publicNotes:
据信，组装泥怪是某制造商为削减成本而尝试将一台物体打印机的运行自动化时意外产生的产物。最初的生物早已逃离协约世界的禁锢，在宇宙中不断自我复制。虽然常被视为类似古代害虫的麻烦存在，但如果任其在星舰或空间站肆意蔓延，组装泥怪终将演变为生存威胁。

组装泥怪通常呈现为无定形金属立方体形态。其外壳由液态聚碳酸酯浆料构成，包裹着核心区域内不断复制的纳米机。泥怪的颜色会基于分解的材料而变化，但最常见的是棕色或灰色的金属混合色调。为维持生存，泥怪会持续遵循其预设的子程序拆解科技物品，进而制造新物体。组装泥怪内部的纳米机确实具备繁殖驱动力，当泥怪在短时间内吸收足够材料时，会通过类似细胞有丝分裂的过程进行分裂。组装泥怪通常不会主动攻击未携带所需科技物品作为燃料的生物，但会为自卫而发起攻击。

各种各样的泥怪潜伏在星系各处阴暗荒废之地，它们只为满足食欲而现身，威胁着冒险者、探险家和不幸的工人。

ELlaiydZLahpmfas.publicNotes:
监视级安保机器人被编程执行小范围巡逻任务，其功能类似看门狗，但内置一支枪。部分制造商将这类机器人设计成犬类形态，而它们具备的飞行能力常令那些以为只会遭遇地面防御的潜在窃贼大吃一惊。

安保机器人遍布工业化星域，在协约世界与维斯卡里姆均有大量部署，企业与普通公民都会使用并定制它们。

尽管大多数士兵机器人型号被设计为尽可能具有破坏性，湮灭机器人（elimination robot）更是专为击杀而生，但安保机器人通常会在其行为程序中设置安全冗余机制，以避免在执行指定安保职能时造成超出必要限度的暴力。这使得它们尤其适用于城市环境（因为意外破坏可能伤及旁观者或引发法律纠纷），甚至适用于星舰（因为偏射的激光可能对关键星舰系统造成严重损害）。

这把威武的手枪从枪管射出一束麻痹电流。剩余充能以沿枪身延伸的发光能量线显示。赏金猎人和执法人员往往需要活捉目标，因此常用脉冲投射手枪。

items.name: 紧急应对

Frequency once every 10 minutes

Bending the laws of the Universe to your will, you increase the forces of gravity in an area. All flying creatures in the area descend 40 feet. The entire area is greater difficult terrain for Flying and Climbing creatures, and difficult terrain for creatures on the ground. Any creature pulled to the ground by a gravity field takes bludgeoning damage as though it had fallen.

Gravity in the area increases by one step (for example, zero-g becomes low gravity, low gravity becomes standard, standard gravity becomes high gravity, and high gravity becomes extreme gravity).

你扭曲宇宙法则，增强一个区域内的重力。区域内所有飞行生物下降40尺。整个区域对飞行生物和攀爬生物来说是高等困难地形，对地面生物来说是困难地形。任何被重力场拉到地面上的生物都会受到钝击伤害，如同坠落一样。

该区域内的重力增加一级（例如，零重力变为低重力，低重力变为标准重力，标准重力变为高重力，高重力变为极端重力）。

The targets each take 4d8 electricity damage and are pulled 5 feet closer to you, or 10 feet closer on a critical hit. If both attacks hit, you can choose to move the creatures closer to one another instead of closer to you. Moving a target into a barrier, creature, or obstacle causes the target to stop before entering that space.

EUWLFaFOibNhrxVl.publicNotes:
黑洞仙女是一群孤僻且神秘的宁芙，她们深居简出，隐匿于广为人知的黑洞现象深处。她们的生性孤僻究竟是主动选择，还是仅仅因为居所环境的限制，尚无定论，毕竟鲜有生物能承受黑洞那强大的引力，停留足够长的时间，从而与黑洞仙女建立联系。除非受到挑衅，否则她们极少表现出敌意，甚至偶尔还会救援那些险些被黑洞吞噬的星舰。

黑洞仙女热爱艺术与音乐，尽管她们的品味往往偏向奇异与前卫。虽然多数宁芙并不明显表现出宗教信仰，但黑洞仙女却全身心投入到聚焦于时空的神秘灵修之中。

宁芙是美丽的精类，外貌呈现为具有精灵特征的类人生物。她们通常以女性形态现身，但也有各种性别和表现形式的宁芙存在。许多宁芙生活在星球上，担当着自然池塘、森林、洞穴和悬崖的守护者，而其他宁芙——通常被称为太空宁芙——则以与天体相关联而闻名。和她们那些与星球绑定的同类一样，太空宁芙守护着与自己绑定的领地，防止其遭受剥削或伤害。

作为艺术的爱好者，宁芙对富有创造力的人特别友好，提出用故事、图画或歌曲来描绘宁芙，是赢得她们青睐的可靠方法——除非宁芙不喜欢最终的成果，并因艺术家用平庸的作品侮辱她们而大发雷霆。视频播客和直播是较为合群的宁芙中流行的消遣方式，无论是为了展示她们所处的偏远环境，还是为了寻找表演的观众。一些宁芙会吸引电影摄制组到她们的领地拍摄，但有两个条件：一是拍摄不得破坏环境，二是宁芙必须在电影中担任重要角色。

除非她们的领地受到威胁，大多数太空宁芙对凡人持友善或不关心的态度，但她们的记忆力极佳。任何造访太空宁芙领地的人都应该研究该宁芙怀有的怨恨、过往与凡人的接触经历，或是该区域近期发生的任何可能影响宁芙对途经其家园的生物看法的重大事件。

展现出正确态度和能力的凡人，例如通过保护一颗星体免遭毁灭，或创作出特别美丽的艺术品，可能会吸引太空宁芙的注意。有时，太空宁芙会主动提出担任恒星武士（solarians）或秘术师（mystics）的导师，尽管她们很少主动寻找学生。太空宁芙很少同时与不止一个人建立这种关系，并且通常只愿为能持续数十年乃至数百年的关系作出承诺，因此她们在选择学生时极为挑剔。

EYqqVxGP2wU3VIcR.publicNotes:
在气态巨行星布雷瑟达的喷射气流中，充斥着一种名为漂流球的大型球形生物，这些生物有时也被称为气球植物。它们体内充满气体，并且生命力顽强，在行星永恒的风暴中四处飘荡。人们常常会发现，一群这样的植物会尾随在一只奥玛身后，或是贴附在频繁造访这颗气态巨行星的众多宇宙飞船和飞行器上。

当漂流球以高速撞击金属船体时，会发出一种颇为滑稽的声音，但旅行者们切勿因此就认为这些植物无害。众所周知，漂流球会反射性地喷射出高速的有机物碎片。此外，它们释放的能引发混乱的气态废物极易在大气中扩散，并可能被飞船的进气阀吸入。

漂流球在地表也能引发混乱。当它们飘进小型聚居地时，会成群结队地扑向小型生物，将它们包卷起来以汲取养分。这种入侵行为引发的迷幻云团的广泛传播是一种危险的麻烦。在此类事件发生时，行人和宠物都必须小心，待在室内，静待这些入侵的气球离去。

协约世界的化学家们已经研发（并申请了专利）出一种名为球气（Balyoon）的麻醉药物，这种药物是从漂流球的气体中提取的。这种药物不仅原本就难以获取，而且在实验室中精炼之前还极不稳定。不止一艘星舰因船员未能妥善储存刚从漂流球身上采集的气体而失事。

球气在伊奥克斯的肥皂剧以及协约世界各地的其他戏剧性视频节目中也扮演着重要角色。它以多种方式被用作剧情推动工具，例如反派设计陷害英雄，或是肥皂剧中家庭成员突然失去理智或记忆等情节。然而，这些角色究竟是如何获得这种来自布雷瑟达掠食性植物的加工气体的，往往并不像紧张刺激的剧情那样重要。

Ej0wWqICzaYDBiHr.publicNotes:
地狱骑士扈从是最低阶的地狱骑士，但要获得这个位阶也需要他们作为学徒服役6年，然后通过地狱骑士试炼，在试炼中，他们必须召唤一个来自地狱的魔族，与之战斗并将其击败。

地狱骑士是炼狱的骑士，他们曾经统治过失落的格拉利昂上整个国家，协约世界的地狱骑士则更全面地维护律法与秩序，他们乘坐着巨大的城堡舰四处游走以扩大影响力，而非固守一处。在战斗中，地狱骑士纪律严明、毫不留情且致命无比。

FL5obG5dQweoENyT.publicNotes:
多数线列级士兵机器人是瘦高、无头的类人机械体。它们配备四指机械手，躯干覆盖装甲并喷涂有所有者标识涂装，上躯干处嵌有一枚红色传感器。默认装备为廉价品牌的激光步枪与破障锤。每台机器人高5尺，重300磅。

线列士兵是士兵机器人理念最终完善的形态——其危险性正源于极简设计。线列级机器人可适配任意战场环境，通过信息网络下载技能包，拆解受损同伴的部件用于自我修复，且制造、维护与改装流程极为简便。正因如此，它们可批量采购且单价低廉，部署时也几乎不用顾虑伤亡代价。

活体士兵是一种负担——他们有不愿其阵亡的家人、需要支付薪水、存在士气问题、必须接受纪律约束、可能犯下暴行，还会对战争持有个人观点。对于任何不痴迷于死灵术的社会而言，他们是战争中必要却遗憾的存在。

尖端士兵机器人承诺解决这一难题。这类机器人没有亲属牵挂、个人主张、求生本能，也没有随意施暴的倾向。许多企业将其宣传为现代战争的"人道解决方案"。

但实际用起来，它们截然相反。

由于无需顾虑生命代价，士兵机器人会怂恿所有者更频繁、更暴力地发起冲突。对峙升级为小规模冲突，小冲突演变为大规模战役，无辜者终究会被卷入其中。这类机器人尤其受企业与某些非政府组织青睐——他们热衷于用十二台士兵机器人对付任何反对者、公开批评者或惹人厌烦的探险者，同时还能否认自身需承担的责任。

尽管公众始终担忧士兵机器人会失控暴走，但这种情况尚未成为严重问题。毕竟，若某台士兵机器人想置你于死地，那一定是有人默许它这么做。

FeRfEU7zUo19j2GX.name: 圣裁天使 Barachius Angel

items.name: 跨界传送（仅自身）
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements You have a planar key for the destination plane, used as a locus

You and your allies traverse the barriers between planes of existence. The targets move to another plane, such as the Plane of Fire, the Netherworld, or the Outer Rifts. You must know the destination plane exists and use a magic planar key created from material from that plane as a locus for the spell. While the planar keys for most prominent planes are uncommon, just like the spell interplanar teleport, more obscure planes and demiplanes often have rare or possibly even unique planar keys.

The spell is highly imprecise, and you appear 1d20×25 miles from the last place one of the targets (of your choice) was located the last time that target traveled to the plane. If it's the first time traveling to a particular plane for all targets, you appear at a random location on the plane. Interplanar teleport doesn't provide a means of return travel, though casting interplanar teleport again allows you to return to your previous plane unless there are extenuating circumstances.
items.description:
需求 你持有目的地位面的位面密钥，用作施法载体

你和你的盟友跨越位面之间的屏障进行旅行。目标移动至其他位面，比如火元素位面、幽界、或者外层裂隙。你必须知晓目标位面的存在，而且需要使用由该位面的物质制作的魔法位面密钥作为本法术的施法载体。就如同跨界传送这个法术本身一样，大多数著名位面的位面密钥具有罕见稀有度，而鲜为人知的位面及半位面通常具有稀有、甚至有可能具有独特稀有度的位面密钥。

该法术极其不精准，你会出现在目标之一（由你选择）上一次造访该位面时的位置周边，误差为1d20×25里。若所有目标都是初次造访某个特定位面，你们就会出现在该位面的随机位置。跨界传送不会提供返回的手段，不过除非发生了什么另外情况，否则再次施放跨界传送能让你返回自身之前身处的位面。

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

items.description:

大成功 生物不受影响。

成功 生物受到一半伤害。

失败 该生物受到全部伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}。

items.name: 全息记忆
items.expectedDescription:
You reach into the target's mind, extract a specific memory you have some awareness of, and project it into a hologram. Alternatively, when casting this spell, you can choose to pull a random memory left to the GM's discretion. The holographic memory can be no longer than 5 minutes; if the extracted memory is longer than this, the hologram simply ends at that point. The hologram includes audio as well as visual components, but it doesn't contain haptic, olfactory, or other components. The hologram typically plays a memory that takes place in a single scene, though it can cut to multiple scenes if they're accurate to the memory and its length allows. The hologram plays the memory exactly as the target experienced it and from the target's perspective, so it often lacks context.

This spell can target any living, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, or deceased sentient creature with an Intelligence modifier of –3 or higher. If the target is deceased, it can't have been dead for longer than 1 week, or this spell fails; once a corpse has been subjected to holographic memory by any caster, any subsequent castings of holographic memory fail.

If the target is unwilling to share this memory, it can attempt a Will save to resist this spell.
items.description:
你探入目标的心智，提取一段你有所了解的特定记忆，将其投射为全息影像。或者，施放此法术时，你可以选择提取一段由GM决定的随机记忆。全息记忆不能长于5分钟；如果提取的记忆更长，影像便在5分钟处结束。全息影像包含声音与画面，但不含触觉、嗅觉或其他要素。全息影像通常播放发生在单个场景中的记忆，但只要符合记忆且时长允许，也可以切换至多个场景。影像严格按照目标的经历、从目标的视角播放记忆，因此往往缺少上下文。

此法术可以指定任何智力调整值为–3或更高、仍然活着、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{失去意识}或已经死亡的有感知生物为目标。如果目标已死亡，其死亡时间不能超过1周，否则法术失败；一具尸体一旦成为任何施法者的全息记忆目标，此后再对其施放全息记忆都会失败。

如果目标非自愿分享记忆，其可以尝试一次意志豁免来对抗此法术。

items.name: 圣洁武装
items.expectedDescription: In the hands of a barachius angel, all weapons gain the holy and magical traits and are powered by divine will, negating the need for batteries or ammunition.
items.description: 圣裁天使持用的所有武器皆获得圣洁特征与魔法特征，并由神圣意志驱动，无需电池或弹药。

FeRfEU7zUo19j2GX.publicNotes:
圣裁天使是头戴战盔、威仪凛然的存在，其光翼由数字电路构成。他们监视科技发展，以防其被用于恶意目的。为实现这一神圣使命，他们的武装皆受圣洁能量祝福。其手掌可延展出伸缩数据刃，可通用对接各类计算机终端与机器人数据端口。

圣裁天使作为崇善神祇的神圣惩戒者，负责肃清全宇宙遭扭曲或堕落的科技。然其判定“邪恶”的准则常显晦涩——他们或许会追猎一台故障机器人，却对核导弹发射井置之不理。

尽管当代许多天使由遍布宇宙的凡人灵魂升格而成，这些天界生物实为全宇宙最古老的存在之一。作为神祇的战士与信使，他们全然献身于自身使命——无论是铲除邪恶，抑或将神谕传遍银河。

FmAuAyUYljPjRJMc.name: 塔什塔里首领 Tashtari Alpha
FmAuAyUYljPjRJMc.publicNotes: 塔什塔里原产于绿意盎然的卡斯卓韦，如今在更广大的星系中以“激光狼”之名闻名。这些狼一般的群猎者身上覆着一层柔韧的丝状毛发，能发出磷光，让它们以独特的视觉语言无声交流。每只塔什塔里喉中都有一个节点，能引导储存的太阳能，释放聚焦的光束，这也正是“激光狼”之名的由来。一对伴侣领导着塔什塔里兽群，其中一只或两只为首领。它们通常会成为一片或多片森林及周边广大地区的顶级掠食者。树木对夜行的塔什塔里很重要，因为它们白天会睡在树顶，沐浴日光，补充太阳能。

A creature that attempts this save is immune to all Bristle Flashes for 1 minute. The tashtari's fur then dims, and they can't use this ability until they bask in sunlight for at least 10 minutes.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

On a critical failure, a creature that can see the tashtari alpha is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 minute. Other tashtaris in the area recharge their Bristle Flash. The tashtari alpha's glowing heart dims, and they can't use this ability until they bask in sunlight for at least 1 hour.
items.description: 塔什塔里首领从口中射出炽热的彩虹光束，冲向天空后分裂成无数彩色光线，向四面八方坠落。@Template[type:emanation|distance:20]内每个非塔什塔里生物受到@Damage[4d6[fire]|options:area-damage]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:19|basic]豁免）。大失败时，能够看见塔什塔里首领的生物还陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}，持续1分钟。区域内其他塔什塔里的鬃毛闪光重新充能。随后，塔什塔里首领发光的心脏变得黯淡，直到其沐浴阳光至少1小时，才能再次使用此能力。

G8VrBK6T9Kbe8Sjf.name: 辐照不死冲锋者 Irradiated Undead Charger
G8VrBK6T9Kbe8Sjf.publicNotes:
冲锋者，其称呼与其起源星球一样多，通常是由自然或人为核灾难杀死的野兽的辐照尸体产生。这些四足的动物不死生物因其强大的冲锋攻击而得名。

要在残酷的宇宙中生存，生物必须天生适应环境或采取防护措施。虽然亡者通常无需防范这些威胁，但辐射有时能使尸体（或多具尸体）复苏为不死生物！

科学家与宗教学者们一直在争论，某一特定类型的辐射是否导致了这种自发产生不生生物的现象，但所有人都认同此类辐照生物所带来的危险。多种辐射源皆可能引发此现象：恒星释放的剧烈太空辐射爆发，行星或卫星地壳中魔法增强的放射性同位素，甚至社会中新兴能源（及其放射性废料）对土地的污染。无论具体成因如何，辐照不死生物都具有相同威胁——它们释放的电离辐射会摧毁周围一切。

GYDhEJCi5SWrolvK.name: 悖论接触者 Paradoxical Solipsist
GYDhEJCi5SWrolvK.publicNotes:
六次记录案例里，与悖论17长期接触的个体事后持续表现出异常行为。其中两人坚称自己在做梦，四人则认为置身于敌对模拟环境。后者中有一人在接受访谈时执意要“再次寻找光芒”，随后径直穿过看守人员与拘留室墙壁消失，至今下落不明。

你可曾真正确信，你所感知到的物质宇宙真实存在？你可曾确信，某天醒来时不会发现这一切不过是一场梦？曾有一颗星球上遍布哲学家，他们追寻着这些问题的答案……就在他们集体消失之前。他们留下晦涩的记录，宣称"旋涡之星"（whirling star）的光芒揭示了物质实为虚妄，物质宇宙暗中竟是精神牢笼。这些记录是已知首次遭遇名为悖论17的存在时留下的全部遗迹。

items.name: 主观现实
items.expectedDescription:
You alter your perceptions to convince yourself that another creature or object is an illusion. Choose one object or creature you can perceive within range. For you, the target becomes transparent and doesn't create sound, smell, or other sensory output. You can move through the target, and the target can move through you. You gain resistance to all damage originating from the target equal to your level. If you are targeted by or are in the area of one of the target's abilities or effects, the target must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:5], and if it fails, you're unaffected by the ability or effect. You're immune to all of the target's auditory, linguistic, and scent-based attacks and effects. Your attacks deal no damage to the target, and the target is immune to your spells and other effects. You and the target can affect one another indirectly, such as through a Strike from a minion or through the environment affected by a witchwarper's quantum field. When this spell ends, the target becomes immune to subjective reality for 24 hours.

Gs2LvB3eXWTuUiNv.name: 沙地蠕虫先兆者 Dust Worm Augur
Gs2LvB3eXWTuUiNv.publicNotes:
古老的流散带沙地蠕虫会成为蠕虫殖民的典范——它们征服小行星，并不辞辛劳地对其进行宜居性改造，以支撑蠕虫社会的存续。

"太空蠕虫"并非科学术语，而是对外星生物学上复杂的无脊椎动物与野兽类群的俗称——它们栖息于浩瀚太空之中。其中一些（如流散带蠕虫与沙地蠕虫）显现出智能迹象，且彼此直接相关；另一些（如噬矿蠕虫）则独立演化，其起源对科学界而言完全未知。
