H53Dsx2DYmd9hBIn.name: 故障小魔怪 Botnib
H53Dsx2DYmd9hBIn.publicNotes:
卑微的故障小魔怪（botnib），也被称作计算机故障小魔怪，与现代计算机设备及网络有着本能的羁绊。这些嬉戏的精类以制造混乱为使命，通过影响计算机系统在所到之处掀起骚动。他们天生具备与数字设备沟通的能力，常沉迷于这类系统，如同拼一副有趣的拼图般肆意破坏。

早在大断层之前很久，小魔怪便以残忍的诡计肆虐物质宇宙，如今它们已完全适应了科技充斥的星系。无论是扰乱通讯装置，星舰，还是整座空间站，小魔怪都乐此不疲地制造毁灭与混乱。

items.name: 删除术
items.expectedDescription:
You delete data from a device or object with a flamboyant magical gesture. This data might be handwritten, printed, or digital. You delete up to 1,500 words' worth of text, one page of content, or one display screen worth of text or other visual information. Non-magical writing in or on an unattended or held object is automatically deleted. Attempt a counteract check to delete digital or magical writing. If you fail to delete writing that's part of a hazard, you trigger the hazard. This can't be used to delete the contents of a spellbook or similar means of storing magical formulas or spells.

If you target an attended tech item with the tracking trait, attempt a counteract check. On a success, the item becomes glitching 1. A creature holding the item can Interact to restart the software, reducing the glitching value by 1.

Heightened (7th) You can delete all the data stored locally on a single device or book, or all the data on a device or book related to a specific name, topic, or category.
items.description:
你以华丽的魔法手势删除设备或物品中的数据。这些数据可以是手写的、打印的或电子的。你最多可以删除 1,500字的文本、一页内容或一显示屏的文本或其他视觉信息。无主物品或手持物品上的非魔法文字会自动删除。尝试反制检定删除数据或魔法文字。如果你尝试删除的文字是危害的一部分，且你失败，就会触发危害。这不能用于删除魔法书或类似的存储魔法公式或法术的内容。

如果目标是具有追踪特征的科技物品，尝试一次反制检定。如果成功，该物品就会获得故障1。持有该物品的生物可以花费一个交互动作来重启用户界面，并将故障值降低1。

升阶（7环）你可以删除单个设备或书籍中本地存储的所有数据，或者删除设备或书籍中与特定名称、主题或类别相关的所有数据。

When you Cast or Sustain the Spell, you can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion} with the illusion, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to your Deception check. If the attempt fails against a creature, that creature disbelieves the figment.

HVw3jIZpGTHcgoIp.publicNotes:
熟悉卡斯卓韦的资深探险者都懂得时刻警惕天空，以免被半透明的拖网者偷袭。这种生物能吐出裹着粘性涂层的丝线，其涂层具有轻微麻醉效果，让它们能够始终舒适地停留在空中，从远处潜行跟踪猎物，再将其拉到近前。

成年拖网者主动降落或停驻于任何物体上的情况极为罕见。通常它们会与任何物体至少留出一线空隙。如果被迫落地，拖网者能用触手笨拙地移动，但多数情况下，它们会抓住第一个机会立即腾空而起。

HWmGOBNNNvrzg5e1.name: 网暴魔（社交邪魔） Civusdaemon
HWmGOBNNNvrzg5e1.publicNotes:
诞生于信息圈层与数字网络的网暴魔，是一种怀有恶意的力量，它们扭曲在线空间以折磨凡人。这些邪魔代表着社交媒体中压迫与仇恨所导致的死亡，它们隐匿于暗处，以极具破坏性的方式折磨敌人，以至于对方常常自杀。

来自末日荒原的邪魔，是彻底致力于毁灭一切生命的存在。它们的存在基于特定的死亡方式，以侍奉其主宰——天启四骑士（Apocalypse Riders）为目的，追求万物的死亡。每种邪魔都代表着一种独特的死亡方式，并运用其特有的力量来推动这种死亡形式的实现。

科技的进步只是催生了新的死亡与折磨方式，因此新型邪魔会不断诞生——每当积累足够数量的新型死亡案例时，便会催生出相应的邪魔。这些新生的"当代邪魔"往往更倾向于在整个星系中活动，而非留在末日荒原，因为它们能更有效地在凡人中散播折磨。

items.name: 梦魇术
items.expectedDescription:
You send disturbing nightmares to your target. The next time the target falls asleep, it must attempt a Will save. If you know the target only by name and have never met them, the target gets a +4 circumstance bonus to the Will save.

Critical Success The target suffers no adverse effects and is temporarily immune for 1 week.

Success The target experiences the nightmares but suffers no adverse effects other than unpleasant memories.

Failure The target experiences the nightmares and awakens @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}.

Critical Failure The target experiences the nightmares, awakens Fatigued, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} until it is no longer Fatigued.
items.description:
你向目标送去一段恼人的噩梦。在目标下一次入睡时，它必须尝试一次意志豁免。如果你仅知道目标的名字，且从未见过它，目标在意志豁免上获得+4环境加值。

大成功 目标不承受任何负面效果，并临时免疫1周。

成功 目标经历了噩梦，但不会承受除了糟糕回忆以外的负面效果。

失败 目标经历噩梦，并且在醒来时@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{疲乏}。

大失败 目标经历噩梦，醒来时疲乏，并且获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失 2} 直到不再疲乏。

items.name: 暗示术
items.expectedDescription:
Your honeyed words are difficult for creatures to resist. You suggest a course of action to the target, which must be phrased in such a way as to seem like a logical course of action to the target and can't be self-destructive or obviously against the target's self-interest. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and knows you tried to control it.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target immediately follows your suggestion. The spell has a duration of 1 minute, or until the target has completed a finite suggestion or the suggestion becomes self-destructive or has other obvious negative effects.

Critical Failure As failure, but the base duration is 1 hour.

Heightened (8th) You can target up to 10 creatures.
items.description:
你的甜言蜜语令生物难以抗拒。你向目标指示一系列动作，其用语对目标而言必须是一系列合理的动作，并且它不可以招致自毁或者明显违背目标自身利益。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响，并且知道你尝试控制它。

成功 目标不受影响。

失败 目标立即按照你的指示行动。该法术的持续时间为1分钟，或者直到目标完成一个有终点的指示，或者直到指示变得会招致自毁，或具有其他明显的负面效果。

大失败 如同失败，但基本持续时间为1小时。

升阶（8环） 你能以至多10个生物为目标。

items.name: 锐耳术
items.expectedDescription: You create an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} floating ear at a location within range (even if it's outside your line of sight or line of effect). It can't move, but you can hear through the ear as if using your normal auditory senses.
items.description: 你在射程内创造出一个@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}的悬浮耳朵（它甚至可以在你的视觉线或者效果线之外）。它不能移动，但是你可以通过该耳朵听到声音，如同你通常的听觉感官。

items.name: 读心术
items.expectedDescription:
With a cursory mental touch, you attempt to read the target's mind. It must attempt a Will save. The target then becomes temporarily immune to your mind reading for 1 hour.

Critical Success The target perceives vague surface thoughts from you when you Cast the Spell.

Success You find out whether the target's Intelligence modifier is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Failure You perceive vague surface thoughts from the target when you Cast the Spell, and you find out whether its Intelligence is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Critical Failure As failure, and for the duration of the spell, you can Sustain the spell to detect the target's surface thoughts again. The target doesn't receive any additional saves.
items.description:
你通过一次短暂的心灵接触来尝试阅读目标的想法。它必须尝试一次意志豁免。目标会临时免疫你的读心术1小时。

大成功 目标感知到你施放法术时模糊的表层思想。

成功 你得知目标的智力调整值是高于，等于，还是低于你。

失败 你感知到施放法术时目标模糊的表层思想，并且你得知目标的智力是高于，等于，还是低于你。

大失败 如失败，并且在法术持续时间中，你可以维持该法术来再次侦测目标的表层想法。目标不会获得另外的豁免。

items.expectedDescription:
A willing creature you touch becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} to everyone except a second target within the spell's range. If the invisible creature uses a hostile action against anyone who isn't the target that can see them, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (5th) You can make up to 6 willing creatures within 30 feet invisible, but they all must have the same target.
items.description:
一个你接触的自愿生物对除射程内第二目标以外的人@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]。如果隐形生物对目标以外的任何人使用敌对行动，该敌对行动结束后，法术也随之结束。

升阶（5环）你可以让30尺内最多6个自愿生物隐形，但他们的目标必须是同一人。
items.name: 选择性隐形（随意）
分担痛苦
items.expectedDescription:
You telepathically share the sensation of agonizing pain with a creature. The target takes 3d12 mental damage and attempts a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} for 1 minute.

Heightened (6th) The spell targets up to four creatures and deals 6d12 mental damage.
items.description:
你以心灵感应向一个生物分享剧痛的感受。目标受到3d12心灵伤害，并尝试意志豁免。

大成功 生物不受影响。

成功 生物受到一半伤害。

失败 生物受到全部伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙1}，持续1分钟。

大失败 生物受到全部伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙2}，持续1分钟。

升阶（6环） 法术至多以四个生物为目标，并造成6d12心灵伤害。

items.name: 侦测思想
items.expectedDescription:
You sense the presence of thinking creatures around you. You detect the presence or absence of thoughts from conscious creatures that have Intelligence modifiers of –3 or higher. You can choose to ignore the thoughts of creatures you're familiar with so they don't interfere with your detection of other thoughts. The spell can penetrate some barriers, but 3 feet of dirt or wood, 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of metal, a thin sheet of lead, or any force barrier blocks it. Creatures who are immune to mental effects are immune to detection by this spell.

Heightened (4th) You detect the number of thinking minds and whether or not the creatures are telepathic. Creatures with telepathy have louder thoughts than creatures who don't have telepathy and might be able to sense your intrusion, at the GM's discretion.
items.description:
你能感知周围生物的想法。你可以侦测周围是否存在智力调整值不低于-3的清醒生物的思维。可选择忽略熟悉生物的思维，避免干扰其他目标的侦测。该法术可以穿透一些障碍，但3尺的泥土或木头、1尺的石头、1英寸的金属、薄薄的铅片或任何立场障碍都会阻挡它。对心灵效果免疫的生物对该法术的侦测免疫。

升阶（4环）你可侦测范围内存在思维活动的意识体数量，并判断其是否具备心灵感应能力。拥有心灵感应能力的生物思维波动更强，普通生物思维信号较弱且无反馈，具体由GM裁定。

items.expectedDescription:
You magically broadcast grim news onto nearby devices, holo projectors, screens, and other displays (including comm units on armor). Creatures in the area who can see one or more displays must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by the display.

Failure The creature is fascinated by the display and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} (even if the fascination ends).

Critical Failure The creature is fascinated by the display, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1} (even if the fascination ends).
items.description:
你以魔法在附近的设备、全息投影仪、屏幕及其他显示装置（包括护甲上的通讯装置）上播出噩耗。区域内能看见至少一个显示装置的生物必须进行意志豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物被显示装置@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{迷魂}。

失败 该生物被显示装置迷魂，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧2}（即使迷魂结束，惊惧仍然生效）。

大失败 该生物被显示装置迷魂，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧3}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{毁灭1}（即使迷魂结束，后两者仍然生效）。
items.name: 末日刷屏（随意）
分析目标
items.expectedDescription:
You focus on the target, gathering data as magical holograms display information. When the casting is complete, you learn biometric information about the target, including its fingerprints, medical conditions, and other basic physiological information. You or anyone you advise about the analysis gains a +1 status bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} the creature, to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} on the creature, and to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about it. If the target is illusory or under the effects of illusion magic, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your analyze target spell.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

Heightened (3rd) The status bonus increases to +2, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Heightened (6th) The status bonus increases to +3, and you can target any number of creatures.
items.description:
你专注在目标身上，收集数据并以魔法全息图像显示。当施法完成，你会获得目标的所有生物特征信息，包括指纹、医疗状况和其他基本生理信息。你或任何得到你基于分析建议的人，在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]为该生物、对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]、以及对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]的检定上获得+1状态加值。如果目标是幻觉或者处于幻术魔法效果下，仅当效果的环级低于你分析目标的法术环级，你才能够探测到结果。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

升阶（3环）状态加值提升到+2，并且你可以至多10名生物作为目标。

升阶（6环）状态加值提升到+3，并且你可以任意名生物作为目标。

items.name: 侦测魔法
items.expectedDescription:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).
items.description:
你发出一股标记魔法存在的脉冲。你不会获得魔法存在或不存在以外的任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你或者你盟友的魔法物品以及持续法术。仅当幻术魔法的环阶低于你的侦测魔法环阶时，你才能侦测幻术魔法。但是，具有幻术灵光但是没有在外表上做伪装的物品（例如一瓶隐形药水），通常能够正常侦测。

升阶（3环阶） 你能知晓法术侦测出的最强魔法效果的环阶或等级，具体由GM决定。

升阶（4环阶） 如3环阶，你也能指出最高环阶魔法的来源。如同一种模糊感官，你不会了解具体的位置，但是可以将来源锁定到5尺立方（或者最近的那个五尺立方，如果来源体积比这个区域更大）。

items.name: 伤口回响
items.expectedDescription:
You manifest an injury from the future or past to harm a creature in the present. Choose bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage. The target takes 1d8 of the selected damage type with a basic Will save. If the target fails its save and then takes the same type of damage before the end of your next turn, it takes an additional @Damage[ceil((@item.level)/2)d4[persistent,bleed]] damage.

Heightened (+2) The initial damage increases by 1d8, and the persistent damage on a failure increases by 1d4.
items.description:
你自未来或者过去具现出一道伤口来伤害当下的生物。选择钝击，穿刺或挥砍伤害，目标受到1d8所选类型伤害，具有一次基础意志豁免。如果目标豁免失败，并且在你的下个回合结束前受到了相同类型的伤害，其还会额外受到@Damage[ceil((@item.level)/2)d4[persistent,bleed]]伤害。

升阶（+2）初始伤害增加1d8，豁免失败时的持续伤害增加1d4。

items.expectedDescription: A civusdaemon knows the presence of any creatures connected to any local infospheres it has access to. A creature who is connected to an infosphere is visible to the civusdaemon as a precise sense. Disconnected creatures who've been active on an infosphere within the past day leave enough residual trace that a civusdaemon can sense them as an imprecise sense.
items.description: 网暴魔能够感知任何它能够登录的本地信息圈中连接着的其他生物的存在。对于连接到信息圈的生物，网暴魔能以精确感官来感知它们。而对于在过去24小时内曾活跃于某一信息领域但当前未连接的生物，它们仍会留下足够的残留痕迹，使得网暴魔能以模糊感官感知它们的存在。

items.name: 人格中伤
items.expectedDescription:
The civusdaemon targets the online reputation of a creature it's aware of on a shared infosphere. After 1 day of downtime, the civusdaemon attempts a @Check[computers|defense:computers] check against the target's Computers DC.

If successful, the target takes a –2 circumstance penalty to all checks made on that infosphere because of damage to their reputation. The civusdaemon can maintain this effect each day by spending another day of downtime without needing to attempt an additional check.

If the civusdaemon maintains this for a week or more, the penalty increases to –4. The creature or an ally of the creature can spend a day of downtime to attempt a @Check[computers|dc:26], @Check[deception|dc:26] or @Check[diplomacy|dc:26] check to counter the character attack.

On a success, the civusdaemon's efforts end, and the target becomes immune to this ability for 1 month.

On a critical success, the target or ally also identifies a specific location that the civusdaemon operates out of, such as one where it frequently connects to the infosphere.
items.description:
网暴魔针对同一信息圈内一个其知晓的生物，损害其线上声誉。花费1天休整期后，网暴魔尝试一次@Check[computers|defense:computers]检定，对抗目标的计算机DC。

成功时，目标因声誉受损，在该信息圈内进行的所有检定受到–2环境减值。网暴魔每天都可以再花费一天休整期来维持此效果，无需额外尝试检定。

如果网暴魔维持此效果一周或更久，减值提高至–4。该生物或其盟友可以花费一天休整期，尝试一次@Check[computers|dc:26]、@Check[deception|dc:26]或@Check[diplomacy|dc:26]检定，来对抗人格中伤。

成功时，网暴魔的行动结束，目标免疫此能力，持续1个月。

大成功时，目标或盟友还会查明网暴魔开展活动的一个具体地点，例如其经常接入信息圈的位置。

items.name: 鲜血盛宴
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements The ranonek has a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}

Effect The ranonek sucks blood from the grabbed creature. This requires an Athletics check against the creature's Fortitude DC if the victim is grabbed and is automatic if the creature is restrained or if it took 50 or more damage since the start of the ranonek's last turn. The victim is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} until it receives healing (of any kind or amount), and the ranonek regains @Damage[25[healing]] Hit Points, gaining any excess Hit Points as temporary Hit Points that last for 1 minute.
items.description:
需求 一个生物因觅血熊而陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{受擒}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{束缚}

效果 觅血熊从受擒生物身上吸血。如果受害者处于受擒，需要一次运动检定，对抗该生物的强韧DC；如果生物处于束缚，或其自觅血熊上一回合开始以来受到至少50伤害，则自动成功。受害者陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失1}，直到其接受任何类型、任意数量的治疗；觅血熊恢复@Damage[25[healing]]生命值，超出的生命值转化为临时生命值，持续1分钟。

items.name: 冲天猛冲
items.expectedDescription: The Ranonek Strides, Climbs, or Leaps twice (in any combination), then makes a claw or jaws Strike at the end of the movement. If it ends this movement by Leaping, the ranonek doesn't begin to fall until the end of the ranonek's turn, but it needs a solid surface to Leap from for each Leap.
items.description: 觅血熊行走、攀爬或跳跃两次（可以任意组合），然后在移动结束时进行一次爪或颚打击。若这次移动以跳跃结束，觅血熊直到自身回合结束才开始坠落，但每次跳跃都需要一个坚实表面供其起跳。

items.expectedDescription:
Large, @Damage[(2d6+7)[bludgeoning]], Rupture 24

HtH5gXXGPHbRgtHm.publicNotes:
这些巨大的熊形吸血魔兽在崔阿克斯寒冷的丛林环境中游荡。虽然它们一年中大部分时间都在冬眠，但觅血熊会在严寒来临前醒来，以捕捉随着冰川逼近而迁徙的野兽、龙或其他生物。这些白色毛发的掠食者拥有像大型猫科动物一样强壮而精瘦的腿，它们利用树线隐藏自己，并跃起从半空中抓下飞行的猎物。觅血熊会用猎物的身体来缓冲坠落，然后将它们猛地撞击到地面，将它们的内脏变成肉酱，之后才开始吸食它们的血液。

觅血熊的消化系统利用了几根高度压缩的管道，使它们能够从较小的猎物中挤出血液。当另一顿美餐试图飞走时，它们可以咳出并喷射含有它们被吸干猎物残余的干燥弹丸，在猎物逃得太远之前将其击落。那些记录这些残余物的人已经证实，这些巨大的生物比起其他任何猎物都更喜欢捕食龙；这并不令人惊讶，因为觅血熊可以在不到一分钟的时间内吸干许多青年龙，并将整个龙人吞下。

items.name: 撼地
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger The kyokor moves at least 60 feet

Effect The ground shakes in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:120] from the kyokor's space.

The ground becomes difficult terrain, and creatures on it are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} for 1 round. Ground vehicles move at half speed.

Fissures open above underground spaces (like sewers, sinkholes, or catacombs). Creatures in the area tumble into the resulting 40-foot-deep hole unless they succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:40] save. Near a body of water, these tremors creates dangerous waves. Creatures in the water or within 60 feet of the waterline are struck by waves that deal @Damage[3d8[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:35|basic] save). On a critical failure, a creature is instantly swept 60 feet out to sea and 60 feet under the water's surface.
items.description:
触发 狂寇移动至少60尺

效果 地面在以狂寇空间为起点的@Template[type:emanation|distance:120]内震动。

地面变为困难地形，其上的生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙2}，持续1轮。地面载具以一半速度移动。

地下空间（例如下水道、落水洞或地下墓穴）上方出现裂隙。区域内的生物会跌入由此形成的40尺深坑，除非其成功通过一次@Check[reflex|dc:40]豁免。水体附近，这些震动会掀起危险波浪。水中或水线60尺内的生物遭到波浪冲击，受到@Damage[3d8[bludgeoning]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:35|basic]豁免）。大失败时，生物立即被卷向海中60尺远，并被卷入水面下60尺深处。

cnText_system_details_description.expected:
The footsteps of a kyokor (or other kaiju) shake the ground, causing the earth around it to tremble as though from a powerful earthquake.

When a kyokor passes by or through a settlement—or even attacks!—it leaves a trail of destruction that can be represented by the following hazards.

Terrifying, skyscraper-sized beasts roam the wastelands of Daimalko. Called colossi by the population, these monsters erupted from deep within the earth to stomp cities into dust, decimating the population and destroying every surface civilization on the planet in a terrifying Awakening. Kyokors are among the most dreaded colossi. There's no hope of defeating one without a valko—a war machine created by Daimalko's stubborn survivors to fight the colossi.
cnText_system_details_description.text:
克约科（或其他怪兽）的脚步震动大地，令周围的地面如同遭遇强烈地震般颤抖。

克约科经过或穿越聚居地——甚至发动攻击！——时，会留下一条毁灭之路，可以用以下危害表示。

令人恐惧、如摩天大楼般庞大的巨兽游荡在戴马尔科的荒原上。当地居民称它们为巨像。在那场可怕的觉醒中，这些怪物从地下深处涌出，将城市践踏成尘土，令人口锐减，并摧毁了这颗星球上的所有地表文明。克约科是最令人畏惧的巨像之一。没有瓦尔科就毫无战胜它的希望；瓦尔科是戴马尔科顽强的幸存者为对抗巨像而制造的战争机器。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[athletics|dc:39] (trained), @Check[civil-engineering-lore|dc:39] (trained), or @Check[crafting|dc:39] (trained) to brace a small structure or surface to cancel the effects of the quake in that area, @Check[arcana|dc:41] (legendary), @Check[occultism|dc:41] (legendary), or @Check[performance|dc:41] (legendary) to calm or divert the kyokor; three total successes are required to disable the hazard; @Check[piloting|dc:30] (trained) if in a vehicle to avoid the kyokor's path (disables the hazard only for that vehicle)
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[athletics|dc:39]（受训）、@Check[civil-engineering-lore|dc:39]（受训）或@Check[crafting|dc:39]（受训），以支撑小型建筑或表面，消除地震在该区域的效应；@Check[arcana|dc:41]（传奇）、@Check[occultism|dc:41]（传奇）或@Check[performance|dc:41]（传奇），以安抚克约科或转移其注意力；总计需要三次成功才能解除此危害；若身处载具内，可进行@Check[piloting|dc:30]（受训）以避开克约科的路线（仅为该载具解除危害）

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: The kyokor (or other kaiju) doesn't move this way again for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.
cnText_system_details_reset.text: 克约科（或其他怪兽）在[[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4轮}内不会再次沿此路线移动。

items.name: 蟹化术
items.expectedDescription:
You manipulate the target's genetic code and accelerate the inevitable, pressuring the target to undergo carcinization and become a crab. A willing target fully transforms into a crab, as if it had cast animal form heightened to the same rank as this spell and using the following statistics.

  • Crab

    • Speed 25 feet, swim 15 feet
    • Melee 1 big claw, Damage 2d8 piercing
    • Melee 1 claw (agile), Damage 2d4 piercing.
    • Can breathe air and water.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.16Li37zRYKClxqsv]

Unwilling targets must instead attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target's body gains minor features of a crab, its appendages turning into claws and causing it to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}.

Failure The target transforms into a partial crab-like being, becoming clumsy 1, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Critical Failure The target is transformed into a partial crab-like being and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.
items.description:
你操纵目标的遗传编码，促使不可避免的演变加速，迫使目标经历蟹化而变为螃蟹。自愿目标完全变为螃蟹，视为其施放了升阶至与本法术同环阶的动物形态，并使用以下数据。

  • 螃蟹

    • 速度25尺，游泳15尺
    • 近战 1巨螯，伤害 2d8穿刺
    • 近战 1螯（灵巧），伤害 2d4穿刺。
    • 可以呼吸空气和水。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.16Li37zRYKClxqsv]

非自愿目标则必须尝试一次强韧豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标的身体出现轻微的螃蟹特征，附肢变为螯，使其陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙1}。

失败 目标变为部分蟹化的生物，陷入笨拙1、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞1}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心1}。

大失败 目标变为部分蟹化的生物，陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙2}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞2}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心2}。

items.name: 毒云术
items.expectedDescription:
You conjure a poisonous fog. This functions as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9XHmC2JgTUIQ1CCm]{Mist}, except the area moves 10 feet away from you each round. You deal 6d8 poison damage to each breathing creature that starts its turn in the spell's area. You can Dismiss the spell.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d8.
items.description:
你创造一团有毒云雾。该效果如同@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9XHmC2JgTUIQ1CCm]{迷雾术}一般，除了该区域会每轮远离你10尺。在法术区域内开始回合的每个需要呼吸的生物受到6d8毒素伤害。你可以解消该法术。

升阶（+1） 该伤害增加1d8。

items.name: 石墙术
items.expectedDescription:
You shape a wall of solid stone. You create a 1-inch-thick wall of stone up to 120 feet long, and 20 feet high. You can shape the wall's path, placing each 5 feet of the wall on the border between squares. The wall doesn't need to stand vertically, so you can use it to form a bridge or set of stairs, for example. You must conjure the wall in an unbroken open space so its edges don't pass through any creatures or objects, or the spell is lost.

Each 10-foot-by-10-foot section of the wall has AC 10, Hardness 14, and 50 Hit Points, and it's immune to critical hits and precision damage. A destroyed section of the wall can be moved through, but the rubble created from it is difficult terrain.

Heightened (+2) The Hit Points of each section of the wall increase by 15.
items.description:
你塑造一面岩石墙壁。你创造一个至多120尺长，20尺高1寸厚的石墙。你可以塑形石墙的路径，将墙壁的每5尺放在方格之间的边界上。该墙壁无需竖直，所以举例而言，你可以用其塑造一座桥，或者一组阶梯。你必须将该墙创造在连续的开放空间中，令其边界不会穿过任何生物或者物体，否则你会失去该法术。

每一段10尺乘10尺的墙壁具有AC10，硬度14，以及50生命值，并且它免疫重击和精准伤害。一段被摧毁的墙壁可以移动通过，但是因此留下的碎石会令其变成困难地形。

升阶（+2） 每一段墙的生命值增加15。

items.name: 行动无碍
items.expectedDescription:
You repel effects that would hinder a creature or slow its movement. While under this spell's effect, the target ignores effects that would give them a circumstance penalty to Speed. When they attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} an effect that has them @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, they automatically succeed unless the effect is magical and of a higher rank than the unfettered movement spell.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.CdAyAiMGESvgNQtz]{Spell Effect: Unfettered Movement}
items.description:
你驱散可能影响一个生物的阻碍。当处于该法术效果中时，法术目标忽视会赋予其速度环境减值的效果。当法术目标尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{逃脱}一个令其@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{受擒}或者@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{束缚}的效果时，它自动成功，除非该效果是魔法性的，并且其环阶比行动无碍更高。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.CdAyAiMGESvgNQtz]{法术效果：行动无碍}

items.name: 地缚术
items.expectedDescription:
Using the weight of earth, you hamper a target's flight, with effects based on its Fortitude save. If the creature reaches the ground safely, it doesn't take falling damage.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target falls safely up to 120 feet.

Failure The target falls safely up to 120 feet. If it hits the ground, it can't Fly, levitate, or otherwise leave the ground for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target falls safely up to 120 feet. If it hits the ground, it can't Fly, levitate, or otherwise leave the ground for 1 minute.
items.description:
你使用大地的重量以干扰目标的飞行能力，其效果基于强韧豁免。如果该生物安全到达地面，它不会承受坠落伤害。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标安全坠落至多120尺。

失败 目标安全坠落至多120尺。如果它碰到地面，它1轮内不能飞行，浮空或者以其他方式离开地面。

大失败 目标安全坠落至多120尺。如果它碰到地面，它1分钟内不能飞行，浮空或者以其他方式离开地面。

items.name: 生命容器
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature within range enters an environment that would be harmful to it.

A shimmering bubble envelops the target's body, allowing it to breathe normally in a vacuum or other unsafe environment and protecting it from severe temperatures and radiation.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 5 additional creatures to gain protection against the environment the triggering creature entered. The spell lasts for 8 hours and also protects against extreme temperatures and radiation.

Heightened (10th) You can target up to 10 additional creatures to gain protection against the environment the triggering creature entered. The spell lasts until your next daily preparations and also protects against incredible temperatures and radiation.
items.description:
触发射程内的生物进入对其有害的环境。

一个闪亮的气泡包裹目标的身体，让它在真空或其他不安全的环境中正常呼吸，并保护它免受严重（severe）温度和辐射的伤害。

升阶（7环）你可指定最多5个额外生物为目标，使其获得针对触发生物所处环境的防护效果。法术持续8小时，并且可以抵御极端（extreme ）温度和辐射。

升阶（10环）你可指定最多10个额外生物为目标，使其获得针对触发生物所处环境的防护效果。法术持续到你下次日常准备，并能抵御严酷（incredible ）温度和辐射。

items.name: 风墙术
items.expectedDescription:
You create a barrier of gusting winds that hinders anything moving through it. The wall of swirling winds is 5 feet thick, 60 feet long, and 30 feet high. The wall stands vertically, but you can shape its path. Though the wall of wind distorts the air, it does not hamper sight. The wall has the following effects.

  • Ammunition from physical ranged attacks-such as arrows, bolts, sling bullets, and other objects of similar size-can't pass through the wall. Attacks with bigger ranged weapons, such as javelins, take a -2 circumstance penalty to their attack rolls if their paths pass through the wall. Massive ranged weapons and spell effects that don't create physical objects pass through the wall with no penalty.
  • The wall is difficult terrain to creatures attempting to move overland through it. Gases, including creatures in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.V8wXOsoejQhe6CyG]{Vapor Form}, can't pass through the wall.
  • A creature that attempts to fly through the wall using a move action must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature can move through the wall normally this turn.

Success The flying creature can move through the wall this turn, but the wall is difficult terrain.

Failure The wall stops the movement of the flying creature, and any remaining movement from its current action is wasted.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature is pushed 10 feet away from the wall.
items.description:
你创造一层会干扰所有通过事物的暴风墙。这面由旋风组成的墙有5尺厚，60尺长，30尺高。该墙为竖直的，但你可以指定其形态。虽然风墙会搅动空气，但不会阻碍视觉。该墙壁具有下列效果。

  • 来自物理远程攻击的弹药（例如箭，矢，投石索弹丸，以及其他类似大小的物体）无法穿过该墙。更大的远程武器的攻击，例如标枪，如果其路线通过该墙壁，则其在攻击掷骰上承受-2环境减值。重型远程武器和不创造实体物体的法术效果可以不受减值地通过该墙。
  • 该墙对尝试从地面通过它的生物为困难地形。气体，以及处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.V8wXOsoejQhe6CyG]{蒸汽形态}的生物，无法穿过墙壁。
  • 尝试使用移动动作飞过墙壁的生物必须尝试一次强韧豁免。

大成功 该生物本回合可以正常移动穿过该墙。

成功 该飞行生物本回合可以穿过该墙，但该墙为困难地形。

失败 该墙阻挡飞行生物的移动，并且当前动作的剩余移动力被浪费。

大失败 如同失败，并且该生物会被推离该墙10尺。

items.name: 纠缠植被
items.expectedDescription:
Plants and fungi burst out or quickly grow, entangling creatures. All surfaces in the area are difficult terrain. Each round that a creature starts its turn in the area, it must attempt a Reflex save. On a failure, it takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds until it leaves the area, and on a critical failure, it's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} for 1 round. Creatures can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} to remove these effects.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.rjM25qfw5BKj9h97]{Spell Effect: Entangling Flora}
items.description:
植物与菌类无法抑制地快速成长，缠绕生物。区域内的所有表面均为困难地形。对于每轮内在该区域内开始自身回合的生物，必须尝试一次反射豁免。失败时，其速度承受-10尺环境减值，直至离开该区域为止，大失败时，它还会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}1轮。生物能够尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{逃脱}来移除这些效果。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.rjM25qfw5BKj9h97]{法术效果：纠缠植被}

extraFields.expected: all squares in a 20-foot-radius burst that contain plants
extraFields.text: 20尺半径爆发范围内所有含有植物的方格

items.name: 忍受环境
items.expectedDescription:
You shield the target against dangerous temperatures. Choose severe cold or heat. The target is protected from the temperature you chose (but not extreme cold or heat).

Heightened (3rd) The target is protected from severe cold and severe heat.

Heightened (5th) The target is protected from severe cold, severe heat, extreme cold, and extreme heat.
items.description:
你保护目标对抗危险气温。选择严寒或炎热。目标不受你选择的气温的影响，但这对极寒和极热无效。

升阶（3环） 目标受到保护，免遭严寒和炎热影响。

升阶（5环） 目标受到保护，免遭严寒、炎热、极寒和极热影响。

items.name: 动物交谈
items.expectedDescription: You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with animals. The spell doesn't make them more friendly than normal. Cunning animals are likely to be terse and evasive, while less intelligent ones often make inane comments.
items.description: 你能向动物提问、得到动物的回答、以及对动物使用交涉技能。该法术不会让动物们变得比平时更加友善。狡猾动物的沟通表现得简短且模棱两可，而缺乏智能的动物通常会发表无意义的意见。

items.name: 水中呼吸
items.expectedDescription:
The targets can breathe underwater.

Heightened (3rd) The duration increases to 8 hours.

Heightened (4th) The duration increases to until your next daily preparations.
items.description:
目标可以在水中呼吸。

升阶（3环） 该持续时间增加到8小时。

升阶（4环） 持续时间延长至你的下次每日准备。

items.name: 重负术
items.expectedDescription:
You reinforce the target's musculoskeletal system to bear more weight. The target can carry 3 more Bulk than normal before becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]{Encumbered} and up to a maximum of 6 more Bulk.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.5yCL7InrJDHpaQjz]{Spell Effect: Ant Haul}
items.description:
你增强了目标的骨骼和肌肉系统，以承受更大的重量。目标在陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]{超载}前，可比平常多携带3负载，最大承载量也增加6负载。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.5yCL7InrJDHpaQjz]{法术效果：重负术}

items.name: 酸液喷溅
items.expectedDescription:
You fling a large glob of acid that immediately detonates, spraying nearby creatures. Creatures in the area take 1d8 acid damage with a basic Reflex save; on a critical failure, the creature also takes @Damage[(1+floor((@item.rank -1)/2))[persistent,acid]] damage.

Heightened (+2) The initial damage increases by 1d8, and the persistent damage on a critical failure increases by 1.
items.description:
你发射一团立即爆发的酸液，泼溅到周围生物上。区域中的生物承受1d8酸蚀伤害，这有一次基础反射豁免；在大失败时，该生物也会承受@Damage[(1+floor((@item.rank -1)/2))[persistent,acid]]伤害。

升阶（+2） 该初始伤害增加1d8，并且大失败时的持续伤害增加1。

items.name: 侦测魔法
items.expectedDescription:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).
items.description:
你发出一股标记魔法存在的脉冲。你不会获得魔法存在或不存在以外的任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你或者你盟友的魔法物品以及持续法术。仅当幻术魔法的环阶低于你的侦测魔法环阶时，你才能侦测幻术魔法。但是，具有幻术灵光但是没有在外表上做伪装的物品（例如一瓶隐形药水），通常能够正常侦测。

升阶（3环阶） 你能知晓法术侦测出的最强魔法效果的环阶或等级，具体由GM决定。

升阶（4环阶） 如3环阶，你也能指出最高环阶魔法的来源。如同一种模糊感官，你不会了解具体的位置，但是可以将来源锁定到5尺立方（或者最近的那个五尺立方，如果来源体积比这个区域更大）。

items.name: 侦测毒素
items.expectedDescription:
You detect whether a creature is venomous or poisonous, or if an object is poison or has been poisoned. You do not ascertain whether the target is poisonous in multiple ways, nor do you learn the type or types of poison. Certain substances, like lead and alcohol, are poisons and so mask other poisons.

Heightened (2nd) You learn the number and types of poison.
items.description:
你可以侦测一个生物是否分泌毒素或者具有毒素，或者一件物体是否是毒素或者已经被下毒。你无法判断目标是否有多种毒素，也无法了解毒素的种类。特定的物质，例如铅或者酒精，是毒素，并会遮盖其他毒素。

升阶（2环） 你会得知毒素的数量和类型。

items.name: 恐惧术
items.expectedDescription:
You plant fear in the target; it must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to five creatures.
items.description:
你将恐惧植入目标；它必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}。

失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}。

大失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 3}，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}，持续1轮。

升阶（3环） 你能以至多五个生物为目标。

items.name: 寻觅星辰
items.expectedDescription:
In your mind's eye, you chart a path through the cosmos. If you're in Pact Worlds space, you immediately know which direction to travel in order to reach the Starstone on Absalom Station. If you're outside the Pact System, you know the direction to the nearest Drift beacon or the Starstone.

Heightened (7th) You can instead know the direction to a familiar location, such as a world or way station you've visited.
items.description:
在你的脑海中，你绘制了一条穿越宇宙的路径。如果你在协约世界的空间中，你就能立刻知道前往星石和艾巴萨罗姆空间站的方向。如果你在协约世界以外的空间，你会知道前往最近的漂流信标或星石的方向。

升阶（7环）你可以知道前往熟悉地点的方向，例如你曾经去过的世界或中转站。

items.name: 跌绊术
items.expectedDescription:
A burst of microgravity causes a tremor around the target, pulling it toward the ground. The target must attempt a Reflex save.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round. If the target was flying, swimming, or floating, it falls 10 feet downward.

Critical Failure The target falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. If the target was flying, swimming, or floating, it falls 20 feet downward.

Heightened (+1) If the target falls, it falls an additional 5 feet on a failure and 10 feet on a critical failure.
items.description:
一阵微弱重力会在目标周围造成震颤，将其拉向地面。目标尝试反射豁免。

失败目标会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]1轮。如果目标是在飞行、游泳或漂浮，则会向下坠落10尺。

大失败目标@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]。如果目标正在飞行、游泳或漂浮，则会向下坠落20尺。

升阶（+1） 如果目标在飞行，失败时会额外向下坠落5尺，大失败时会额外向下坠落10尺。

items.name: 绊足藤
items.expectedDescription:
A vine appears from thin air, flicking from your hand and lashing itself to the target. Attempt a spell attack roll against the target.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.TwtUIEyenrtAbeiX]{Spell Effect: Tangle Vine}

Critical Success The target gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} condition and takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 round. It can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} against your spell DC to remove the penalty and the immobilized condition.

Success The target takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 round. It can attempt to Escape against your spell DC to remove the penalty.

Failure The target is unaffected.

Heightened (2nd) The effects last for 2 rounds.

Heightened (4th) The effects last for 1 minute.
items.description:
一条藤蔓凭空出现，从你手上弹射而出并捆绑在目标身上。对目标进行一次法术攻击掷骰。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.TwtUIEyenrtAbeiX]{法术效果：绊足藤}

大成功 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}状态，并且其速度承受-10尺环境减值，持续1轮。它能尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{逃脱}对抗你的法术DC，来以此移除减值和禁足状态。

成功 目标速度承受-10尺环境减值，持续1轮。它能尝试逃脱对抗你的法术DC来移除减值。

失败 目标不受影响。

升阶（2环） 效果持续2轮。

升阶（4环） 效果持续1分钟。

items.name: 虫群覆盖
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger The dragon critically fails a saving throw

Effect Swarming insects interfere with the effect, sacrificing themselves to protect their host's body and mind. The dragon attempts a @Check[flat|dc:17]. On a success, the dragon fails the saving throw instead of critically failing.
items.description:
触发 龙的豁免大失败

效果 成群昆虫干扰此效果，牺牲自身来保护宿主的身体与心智。龙尝试一次@Check[flat|dc:17]。成功时，龙的该次豁免由大失败变为失败。

items.name: 恐怖威压
items.expectedDescription:
90 feet. @Check[will|dc:30|options:area-effect,inflicts:frightened]

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.FrightfulPresence]
items.description:
90尺，@Check[will|dc:30|options:area-effect,inflicts:frightened]

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.FrightfulPresence]

items.expectedName: +2 status to all saves vs. mental
items.name: 对抗心灵的所有豁免获得+2状态加值
剧痛咬击
items.expectedDescription: A creature that takes damage from a host dragon's jaws Strike or is swallowed by the dragon is also bitten by hundreds of tiny insects; the creature must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:28] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} for 1 round.
items.description: 受到宿主龙颚部打击伤害或被龙吞下的生物，还会被数百只小昆虫叮咬；该生物必须通过一次@Check[fortitude|dc:28]豁免，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭2}，持续1轮。

items.name: 虫群共生
items.expectedDescription: The host dragon is immune to any attack made by a swarm of insects or similar creature (at the GM's discretion).
items.description: 宿主龙免疫昆虫集群或类似生物（由GM裁定）发动的一切攻击。

items.name: 活吞
items.expectedDescription:
Large, @Damage[(3d10+7)[bludgeoning]] plus excruciating bites, Rupture 26

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.SwallowWhole]
items.description:
大型，@Damage[(3d10+7)[bludgeoning]]外加剧痛咬击，破裂26

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.SwallowWhole]

items.name: 虫群吐息
items.expectedDescription: The dragon disgorges a swarm of biting insects that deals @Damage[9d8[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage in a @Template[type:cone|distance:40] (@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic] save). They can't use Swarm Breath again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Swarm Breath]]{1d4 rounds}.
items.description: 龙吐出一群叮咬的昆虫，造成@Damage[9d8[piercing]|options:area-damage]伤害，范围为@Template[type:cone|distance:40]（@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic]豁免）。之后[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Swarm Breath]]{1d4轮}内无法再次使用虫群吐息。

items.name: 虫群形态
items.expectedDescription: The dragon transforms into an insect swarm. They drop all held, worn, and carried items. While in this form, they can't use attack actions (except Swarming Bites and Swarm Breath) and can't cast spells, but they can move through areas small enough for their individual insects to fit without having to Squeeze. They can use the same action to coalesce back into their normal form.
items.description: 龙变成昆虫集群，丢下所有持握、穿戴和携带的物品。处于此形态时，它无法使用攻击动作（虫群噬咬和虫群吐息除外），也无法施法，但可以穿过单只昆虫能够容身的狭小区域，而无需挤过。它可以使用同一动作重新聚合，恢复正常形态。

items.name: 虫群噬咬
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements The dragon is a swarm

Effect Each enemy in the swarm's space takes @Damage[8d6[piercing]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:30|basic] save). A creature that fails its save is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 round.
items.description:
需求 龙处于集群形态

效果 集群空间内的每个敌人受到@Damage[8d6[piercing]]伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:30|basic]豁免）。豁免失败的生物还会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭1}，持续1轮。

IPsjMNnWhtCiEWSm.name: 成年宿主龙（施法者） Host Dragon (Adult, Spellcaster)
IPsjMNnWhtCiEWSm.publicNotes: 无论这些行动迟缓、贪食的巨龙漫游至何处，都有数不胜数的昆虫尾随其后，它们在宿主龙周围蜂拥而至，栖息于宿主龙身体上无数的孔洞之中。宿主龙既是虫群本身的一部分，也是虫群生态的一部分——虫群以它们的身体为食，而龙又以虫群为食；在这一可怖且延续数百年的循环中，即便宿主龙一生未曾摄取任何其他物质，也仍会不断变得更加庞大、更加强大。宿主龙从昆虫的原始本能中汲取力量，尽管它们拥有智慧，却常常表现得像那些聚集在它们身边的昆虫一样。宿主龙厌恶回答问题，并会以激烈手段抗拒他人对其本性的任何探究。

IXwnR3Xb9WMEPFJP.name: 剥皮水蛭 Flayer Leech

items.name: 伪装身份
items.expectedDescription: While a flayer leech is in an effigy, it gains the ability to understand and speak all languages known by the corpse as well as knowledge of the corpse's physical abilities, identity, role in society, and personality. However, it doesn't gain the specific memories or knowledge of the corpse.
items.description: 剥皮水蛭藏身于伪装尸体中时，能够理解并说出该尸体生前所知的所有语言，同时了解死者的身体能力、身份、社会角色和性格。然而，它不会获得死者的具体记忆或知识。

items.name: 再生5（由酸蚀或音波伤害阻止）
items.expectedDescription: @Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Regeneration]
items.description: @Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Regeneration]

items.name: 强光致盲
items.expectedDescription: @Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.LightBlindness]
items.description: @Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.LightBlindness]

items.name: 创造伪装
items.expectedDescription: A flayer leech consumes the brain of the corpse of a Medium or Small creature dead for no longer than an hour, taking over its body. It also stitches together any wounds the corpse might have, presenting only barely visible lines. It can use Stealth to [[/act impersonate skill=stealth]] and doesn't need a disguise kit to do so, but it takes a –2 circumstance penalty to the check if any creature engages the flayer leech in conversation for 1 minute. When in this effigy form, it loses its weakness to bludgeoning and gains weakness 5 to sonic damage. It can make proboscis melee Strikes through extension in its wrists, but it can't make subsonic blast ranged Strikes. A flayer leech can Dismiss the effigy.
items.description: 剥皮水蛭吞食一具死亡不超过一小时的中型或小型生物尸体的大脑，占据其身体。其还会缝合尸体可能存在的所有伤口，仅留下几乎看不见的细线。其可以使用隐秘来[[/act impersonate skill=stealth]]，且无需伪装工具包，但如果任何生物与剥皮水蛭交谈1分钟，该检定便受到–2环境减值。处于这种伪装形态时，其失去钝击弱点，获得音波伤害弱点5。其可以从腕部伸出口器进行近战打击，但不能进行次声波冲击远程打击。剥皮水蛭可以解消伪装。

items.name: 汲取骨髓
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements The flayer leech's last action was a successful proboscis Strike against a living creature

Effect The flayer leech vibrates its proboscis at subsonic speed, drilling into a creature's marrow or equivalent bone structure. The required creature must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:21] saving throw or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}. On a critical failure, it can't reduce this sickened condition for 1 minute.
items.description:
需求 剥皮水蛭的上个动作是对一个活物进行成功的长吻打击

效果 剥皮水蛭以次声波频率振动长吻，钻入生物的骨髓或等同的骨骼结构。满足需求的生物必须通过一次@Check[fortitude|dc:21]豁免，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心1}。大失败时，它在1分钟内无法降低此恶心状态。

items.name: 颚舞
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements The flayer leech isn't currently in an effigy

Effect The flayer leech wriggles its facial tendrils in a tantalizing way. Each creature within 30 feet that can see the flayer leech must attempt a @Check[will|dc:21] saving throw or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by the flayer leech for 1 minute.
items.description:
需求 剥皮水蛭当前未处于伪装中

效果 剥皮水蛭以诱人的方式扭动面部触须。30尺内每个能看见剥皮水蛭的生物都必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:21]豁免，否则被剥皮水蛭@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{迷魂}，持续1分钟。

items.name: 扭曲骨骼
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements The flayer leech is in an effigy

Effect s The flayer leech has a link to any marrow it's tasted. It sends out subsonic waves to vibrate its enemies' skeletal structures, causing immense pain. Any creature within 40 feet with the sickened condition from the flayer leech's Drink Marrow ability takes @Damage[3d8[sonic]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:21|basic] save).
items.description:
需求 剥皮水蛭处于伪装中

效果 剥皮水蛭与它尝过的所有骨髓都有联系。它释放次声波，使敌人的骨骼结构振动，造成剧烈疼痛。40尺内任何因剥皮水蛭的汲取骨髓能力而具有恶心状态的生物都受到@Damage[3d8[sonic]]伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:21|basic]豁免）。

IXwnR3Xb9WMEPFJP.publicNotes:
剥皮水蛭是一种超小型的无脊椎猎食者，它们拥有多关节的口器，并演化出了一种极为奇特的生命周期：它们会剥下猎物的皮肤披在身上，伪装成猎物的模样，同时吞噬其内脏以完成繁殖。

剥皮水蛭会捕杀并啃食活物，以猎物的骨髓为食。这种进食能为它们提供维持数周生存所需的养分。剥皮水蛭会松开花瓣状口器上的触须，将其延伸至最长2米的距离，并用这些触须将猎物的残骸缝合起来，并保留大脑供自己后续享用。随后，它们会利用这些触须作为伪骨骼，为尸体提供结构支撑并操控其移动，从而让尸体仿佛重新活过来，模仿其动作与生前习性。然而，剥皮水蛭并不具备猎物生前的特定记忆，因此对于熟悉其受害者的人来说，很容易识破这种伪装。剥皮水蛭利用这种伪装作为安全的庇护所，同时继续啃食猎物剩余的骨髓与神经系统，并会像守护其家园一样捍卫这些新获得的躯体。

J4ZwkpWk2eKQKJFg.name: 云鳐 Cloud Skate
J4ZwkpWk2eKQKJFg.publicNotes: 云鳐是性情多疑的生物，总会尽可能避开人类聚居地。它们在温顺期会组成庞大群落迁徙，即便进入凶猛的捕猎周期仍保持小规模结群，对旅人构成威胁。它们凭借三条强健的尾巴在云层间穿行，用有其整个单节身躯那么宽的布满鲸须的巨口吞噬整个猎物。

items.expectedDescription: If a cloud skate dies due to fire or electricity damage, its internal reservoirs of explosive gases and combustible fluids detonate in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:20] that deals @Damage[6d8[fire]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:21|basic|options:area-effect] save).
items.description: 若云鳐死于火焰或电击伤害，其体内储存的爆炸性气体和可燃液体便会引爆，范围为@Template[type:emanation|distance:20]，造成@Damage[6d8[fire]|options:area-damage]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:21|basic|options:area-effect]豁免）。

Frequency once per hour

items.description:

items.name: 实言术（恒定）
items.expectedDescription:
The target can understand all words regardless of language and also speak the languages of other creatures. When in a mixed group of creatures, each time the target speaks, it can choose a creature and speak in a language that creature understands, even if the target doesn't know what language that is.

Heightened (7th) The duration is 8 hours.
items.description:
无论什么语言，目标都可以理解其所有的词语，也能说其他生物的语言。当处于一群各异的生物中时，每次目标说话时，都可以选择一个生物，并使用一种该生物理解的语言来讲述，即使该目标不知道这语言具体是什么。

升阶（7环） 持续时间为8小时。

items.name: 次元移位（随意）
items.expectedDescription:
You instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to an unoccupied space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container—the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are then temporarily immune for 1 hour.
items.description:
你立即将自身以及自己正在穿戴和持有的物品从当前空间转移走，移动至法术射程内你能看到的未被占据的空间。如果这将会带着其他生物与你一同移动——即便你把该生物放置在异次元容器中——你就会失去该法术。

升阶（5环） 法术射程增加至1里。你不需要看到目的地，只要你曾经去过目的地，并且知晓该地点与你相对的位置以及距离即可。之后你会在1小时内临时免疫该法术。

items.name: 全息记忆
items.expectedDescription:
You reach into the target's mind, extract a specific memory you have some awareness of, and project it into a hologram. Alternatively, when casting this spell, you can choose to pull a random memory left to the GM's discretion. The holographic memory can be no longer than 5 minutes; if the extracted memory is longer than this, the hologram simply ends at that point. The hologram includes audio as well as visual components, but it doesn't contain haptic, olfactory, or other components. The hologram typically plays a memory that takes place in a single scene, though it can cut to multiple scenes if they're accurate to the memory and its length allows. The hologram plays the memory exactly as the target experienced it and from the target's perspective, so it often lacks context.

This spell can target any living, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, or deceased sentient creature with an Intelligence modifier of –3 or higher. If the target is deceased, it can't have been dead for longer than 1 week, or this spell fails; once a corpse has been subjected to holographic memory by any caster, any subsequent castings of holographic memory fail.

If the target is unwilling to share this memory, it can attempt a Will save to resist this spell.
items.description:
你探入目标的心智，提取一段你有所了解的特定记忆，将其投射为全息影像。或者，施放此法术时，你可以选择提取一段由GM决定的随机记忆。全息记忆不能长于5分钟；如果提取的记忆更长，影像便在5分钟处结束。全息影像包含声音与画面，但不含触觉、嗅觉或其他要素。全息影像通常播放发生在单个场景中的记忆，但只要符合记忆且时长允许，也可以切换至多个场景。影像严格按照目标的经历、从目标的视角播放记忆，因此往往缺少上下文。

此法术可以指定任何智力调整值为–3或更高、仍然活着、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{失去意识}或已经死亡的有感知生物为目标。如果目标已死亡，其死亡时间不能超过1周，否则法术失败；一具尸体一旦成为任何施法者的全息记忆目标，此后再对其施放全息记忆都会失败。

如果目标非自愿分享记忆，其可以尝试一次意志豁免来对抗此法术。

items.name: 腐蚀转化
items.expectedDescription:
You launch a torrent of magical nanites that begin dissolving your target. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, you deal 3d8 acid damage plus 1d6 persistent acid damage. On a critical hit, double the initial damage, but not the persistent damage.

Heightened (+2) The initial damage increases by 2d8, and the persistent acid damage increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你发射出一股魔法纳米粒子，开始溶解你的目标。对目标进行远程法术攻击检定。命中时，你会造成3d8酸蚀伤害加1d6持续酸蚀伤害。如果大成功，初始伤害加倍，但持续伤害不加倍。

升阶（+2）初始伤害增加2d8，持续酸蚀伤害增加1d6。

items.name: 侦测思想
items.expectedDescription:
You sense the presence of thinking creatures around you. You detect the presence or absence of thoughts from conscious creatures that have Intelligence modifiers of –3 or higher. You can choose to ignore the thoughts of creatures you're familiar with so they don't interfere with your detection of other thoughts. The spell can penetrate some barriers, but 3 feet of dirt or wood, 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of metal, a thin sheet of lead, or any force barrier blocks it. Creatures who are immune to mental effects are immune to detection by this spell.

Heightened (4th) You detect the number of thinking minds and whether or not the creatures are telepathic. Creatures with telepathy have louder thoughts than creatures who don't have telepathy and might be able to sense your intrusion, at the GM's discretion.
items.description:
你能感知周围生物的想法。你可以侦测周围是否存在智力调整值不低于-3的清醒生物的思维。可选择忽略熟悉生物的思维，避免干扰其他目标的侦测。该法术可以穿透一些障碍，但3尺的泥土或木头、1尺的石头、1英寸的金属、薄薄的铅片或任何立场障碍都会阻挡它。对心灵效果免疫的生物对该法术的侦测免疫。

升阶（4环）你可侦测范围内存在思维活动的意识体数量，并判断其是否具备心灵感应能力。拥有心灵感应能力的生物思维波动更强，普通生物思维信号较弱且无反馈，具体由GM裁定。

items.name: 注入纳米机器
items.expectedDescription:
You inject magical nanobots into a creature. Make a melee spell attack roll. On a hit, the target takes 4d6 acid damage. On a critical hit, the target takes double damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round as nanobots swarm through the target's biological or mechanical systems.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.
items.description:
你将魔法纳米机器人注入一个生物体内。进行一次近战法术攻击检定。命中时，目标会受到 4d6 酸蚀伤害。如果大成功，纳米机器人会蜂拥穿过目标的生物或机械系统，使该生物受到双倍伤害并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]1轮。

升阶（+1）伤害增加2d6。

items.name: 浏览数据（随意）
items.expectedDescription:
You touch one object and concentrate on a dataset contained within it, such as a story, message, file, infosphere site, audio recording, or video. You understand the gist of the dataset and can quickly locate the most relevant pages or sections to your search. If the dataset is written or otherwise communicated in a language you don't know, or you attempt to gain information from a computer you don't have access to (such as one with a password you don't know), the spell fails.

If you Cast this Spell as part of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.t5nBkpjroaq7QBGK]{Research} activity, you treat a critical failure as a failure instead.
items.description:
你触碰一件物体，专注于其中的一组数据，例如故事、讯息、文件、信息圈网站、录音或视频。你理解这组数据的大意，并且能迅速定位与搜索内容最相关的页面或章节。如果数据以你不懂的语言书写或传达，或你试图从无权访问的计算机中获取信息（例如一台你不知道密码的计算机），法术失败。

如果你将施放此法术作为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.t5nBkpjroaq7QBGK]{研究}活动的一部分，你将大失败改为视作失败。

items.name: 删除术
items.expectedDescription:
You delete data from a device or object with a flamboyant magical gesture. This data might be handwritten, printed, or digital. You delete up to 1,500 words' worth of text, one page of content, or one display screen worth of text or other visual information. Non-magical writing in or on an unattended or held object is automatically deleted. Attempt a counteract check to delete digital or magical writing. If you fail to delete writing that's part of a hazard, you trigger the hazard. This can't be used to delete the contents of a spellbook or similar means of storing magical formulas or spells.

If you target an attended tech item with the tracking trait, attempt a counteract check. On a success, the item becomes glitching 1. A creature holding the item can Interact to restart the software, reducing the glitching value by 1.

Heightened (7th) You can delete all the data stored locally on a single device or book, or all the data on a device or book related to a specific name, topic, or category.
items.description:
你以华丽的魔法手势删除设备或物品中的数据。这些数据可以是手写的、打印的或电子的。你最多可以删除 1,500字的文本、一页内容或一显示屏的文本或其他视觉信息。无主物品或手持物品上的非魔法文字会自动删除。尝试反制检定删除数据或魔法文字。如果你尝试删除的文字是危害的一部分，且你失败，就会触发危害。这不能用于删除魔法书或类似的存储魔法公式或法术的内容。

如果目标是具有追踪特征的科技物品，尝试一次反制检定。如果成功，该物品就会获得故障1。持有该物品的生物可以花费一个交互动作来重启用户界面，并将故障值降低1。

升阶（7环）你可以删除单个设备或书籍中本地存储的所有数据，或者删除设备或书籍中与特定名称、主题或类别相关的所有数据。

items.name: 植入数据
items.expectedDescription:
You reprogram a computer or device to display a chosen piece of data when accessed. You can implant up to one piece of data per spell rank. A piece of data can be a simple fact, such as a creature or object's location or physical description; an image of a creature or object; or a simple statement of no more than 300 characters. When the target computer or device is accessed, this implanted data is the first data the accessing creature gains, regardless of what data the creature is looking for. Implanted data doesn't prevent a creature from accessing other information stored on a device, change how the device functions, or otherwise inhibit the device from functioning. If this spell's duration ends before a creature accesses the implanted data, the information vanishes.

Heightened (3rd) The duration is one year.

Heightened (6th) The duration is unlimited.
items.description:
你重新编程一台计算机或设备，使其在被访问时显示一条选定的数据。你每个法术环级至多可以植入一条数据。一条数据可以是一项简单事实，例如某个生物或物体的位置或外貌描述；一幅生物或物体的图像；或一句不超过300个字符的简单陈述。目标计算机或设备被访问时，访问者首先获得的总是这条植入数据，无论该生物在寻找什么数据。植入数据不会阻止生物访问设备储存的其他信息，不会改变设备的运作方式，也不会以其他方式妨碍其运作。如果法术持续时间在生物访问植入数据前结束，这些信息便消失。

升阶（3环）持续时间为一年。

升阶（6环）持续时间为无限。

items.name: 修复术
items.expectedDescription:
You repair the target item. You restore 5 Hit Points per spell rank to the target, potentially removing the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{Broken} condition if this repairs it past the item's Broken Threshold. You can't replace lost pieces or repair an object that's been completely destroyed.

Heightened (2nd) You can target a non-magical object of 1 Bulk or less.

Heightened (3rd) You can target a non-magical object of 2 Bulk or less, or a magical object of 1 Bulk or less.
items.description:
你修复目标物品。你回复目标每法术环阶5点生命值，并且如果修复后的生命值超过物品的破损阈值，会移除 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{破损} 状态。你无法补回丢失的组成部分，或者修复已经完全损毁的物体。

升阶（2环） 你能以1负载或者更低的非魔法物品为目标。

升阶（3环） 你能以2负载或者更低的非魔法物品为目标，或者1负载或者更低的魔法物品为目标。

items.name: 寻觅星辰
items.expectedDescription:
In your mind's eye, you chart a path through the cosmos. If you're in Pact Worlds space, you immediately know which direction to travel in order to reach the Starstone on Absalom Station. If you're outside the Pact System, you know the direction to the nearest Drift beacon or the Starstone.

Heightened (7th) You can instead know the direction to a familiar location, such as a world or way station you've visited.
items.description:
在你的脑海中，你绘制了一条穿越宇宙的路径。如果你在协约世界的空间中，你就能立刻知道前往星石和艾巴萨罗姆空间站的方向。如果你在协约世界以外的空间，你会知道前往最近的漂流信标或星石的方向。

升阶（7环）你可以知道前往熟悉地点的方向，例如你曾经去过的世界或中转站。

items.name: 微灵盟友
items.expectedDescription:
You summon a Tiny bouncing wisp of light that easily distracts even the most determined of combatants. The wisp floats near your target. A wisp doesn't take up space, grant flanking, or have any other attributes a creature would. The wisp generates bright light in a 10-foot radius. When you Cast the Spell and each time you Sustain the spell, your wisp attempts to distract your target, which must succeed at a Will save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of your next turn. A creature who critically succeeds becomes immune to wisp ally for 1 hour.

Heightened (+1) You create one additional wisp, allowing you to choose a different target. Each wisp you create must have a different target, and all of them attempt to distract their targets at the same time when you cast or Sustain this spell.
items.description:
你召唤一只小小的活跃微灵，能够分散意志最坚定的战斗人员的注意。微灵在你目标周围悬浮游弋。微灵没有占据空间，不会提供夹击，也没有其他生物会具有的属性。微灵能在10尺半径内产生明亮光照。当你施放该法术以及每次你维持该法术时，微灵试图分散目标的注意力。该目标必须通过意志豁免，否则在你下一回合开始前将陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]。豁免大成功的生物将对微灵盟友临时免疫1小时。

升阶（+1）你在施法时创造出额外一只微灵，这允许你选择一个额外目标。你创造的每个微灵都必须有不同的目标，并且当你维持该法术时，它们会同时分散各自目标的注意力。

items.name: 弧网
items.expectedDescription: The iridia can communicate through items and creatures with the tech trait, projecting sound from and speaking through the item or creature's voice, speakers, or other audio output. In addition, the excuba can use any item or creature with the tech trait within their digital telepathy aura as the point of origin for their spells and abilities when calculating range, distance, line of effect, and area of effect.
items.description: 光谱族可与具有科技特征的物品或生物沟通，通过它们的嗓音、扬声器或其他音频输出装置投射声音并说话。此外，在计算法术和能力的范围、距离、效果线、效果区域时，光谱族可将其数字心灵感应灵光内任何具有科技特性的物品或生物，作为其施放原点。

items.name: 滑移驱动
items.expectedDescription: An iridia has an internal biomechanical Drift engine, allowing them to function as a Drift engine for a starship or vehicle they pilot as a 1-minute activity. An excuba can enter or exit the Drift themself as a 1-minute activity. When an excuba gets a critical failure on a Piloting check to Navigate or Plot a Course through the Drift, they get a failure instead.
items.description: 光谱族内置生物机械漂流引擎，可作为自己所驾驶飞船或载具的漂流引擎——激活此功能需耗时1分钟。光谱族自行进入或离开漂流域时，也需耗时1分钟。当光谱族在通过漂流域导航或规划航线的驾驶检定中出现大失败时，结果将改为普通失败。

items.name: 科技感知
items.expectedDescription: The iridia senses creatures and objects with the tech trait as a precise sense within the listed range.
items.description: 在所列范围内，光谱族可将具有科技特性的生物和物体，以精确感知探测到。

items.name: 数字心灵感应
items.expectedDescription: 100 feet. An iridia can communicate telepathically with any item or creature with the tech trait within their aura as well as with other technologically telepathic creatures (such as those with shortwave and similar abilities). This ability also allows the spectra to remotely attempt Computers checks within their aura.
items.description: 100尺。虹光体可以与灵光内任何具有科技特征的物品或生物，以及其他具有科技心灵感应能力的生物（例如具有短波通讯或类似能力的生物）进行心灵感应交流。此能力也让光谱族能在其灵光内远程尝试计算机检定。

items.name: 反应打击
items.expectedDescription: @Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ReactiveStrike]
items.description: @Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ReactiveStrike]

items.name: 维度跃迁
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency once per round

Trigger The iridia is targeted by a ranged Strike

Effect A rainbow of visual distortion cascades across the iridia. They desynchronize from reality and are briefly replaced by a two-dimensional rendering, gaining concealment against the triggering Strike.
items.description:
频率 每轮一次

触发 虹光体成为远程打击的目标

效果 彩虹般的视觉扭曲掠过虹光体。它脱离与现实的同步，短暂地被一幅二维图像取代，对触发打击获得隐蔽。

items.name: 变身
items.expectedDescription:
The excuba can take on the appearance of any Small or Medium humanoid.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]
items.description:
值守体可以变成任何小型或中型类人生物的外貌。

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

JN6R3FfXN0V6OH6b.publicNotes:
当凡人在漂流域外遭遇光谱族时，通常遇到的便是虹光体。这些闪烁蛋白石光泽的双足生物，作为漂流域的使者与代理人穿梭于宇宙，宣扬新技术与新兴科技的种种益处。它们倡导生活各领域的发展与进步，尤其专注于推动新技术的前进。然而，它们的目标常与两类人格格不入：一类是摒弃具争议性或危险技术的人，另一类是面对未经检验的新发现时持谨慎态度的人。

据记载，虹光体会造访浩界中远离艾布萨罗姆空间站与漂流航道的偏远世界——在这些地方，三贤一最初的信标及漂流旅行的奥秘曾被压制、遗失或误解。它们为这些与世隔绝世界的居民带来实现星际旅行的指引，并给予他们第二次融入星系共同体的机会。

在浩瀚众界，时间的计量单位并非百年、千年或百万年，而是以"永世"（eons）——即现实本身的迭代周期为尺度。直到近三个世纪，随着漂流域（Drift）技术的出现与普及，光谱族才崭露头角，在原本停滞不前的浩瀚众界思潮中，于一片新兴领域里蓬勃发展。

尽管光谱族的起源与目标仍笼罩在迷雾中，但与它们相关的遭遇事件总围绕三大主题：新科技发现、分享超光速旅行知识，以及保护漂流域。无人知晓光谱族是否在漂流域诞生前就已存在，但它们与超空间位面的关联无可争议。著名形而上学家认为，光谱族是由被卷入漂流域的原始精质（quintessence）融合而成的产物——正如漂流域本身由多元宇宙的碎片生长而来。若此说属实，光谱族对漂流域技术扩散的兴趣便蒙上一层微妙的阴翳：每一台新的漂流引擎，都在为漂流域与光谱族自身的扩张"收割"浩瀚众界及其所有住民。

KBQSErxejd8S8RQP.name: 黑洞仙后 Gwereiad Queen
KBQSErxejd8S8RQP.publicNotes:
作为宁芙中最为稀有的一类，黑洞仙后诞生于超大质量黑洞之中，她们或是由较弱的黑洞仙女扬升而来，或是在黑洞强大能量的作用下自然生成。相较于普通的黑洞仙女，她们往往更为疏离，言谈间仅使用融合科学与神秘主义的独特隐喻。

宁芙是美丽的精类，外貌呈现为具有精灵特征的类人生物。她们通常以女性形态现身，但也有各种性别和表现形式的宁芙存在。许多宁芙生活在星球上，担当着自然池塘、森林、洞穴和悬崖的守护者，而其他宁芙——通常被称为太空宁芙——则以与天体相关联而闻名。和她们那些与星球绑定的同类一样，太空宁芙守护着与自己绑定的领地，防止其遭受剥削或伤害。

作为艺术的爱好者，宁芙对富有创造力的人特别友好，提出用故事、图画或歌曲来描绘宁芙，是赢得她们青睐的可靠方法——除非宁芙不喜欢最终的成果，并因艺术家用平庸的作品侮辱她们而大发雷霆。视频播客和直播是较为合群的宁芙中流行的消遣方式，无论是为了展示她们所处的偏远环境，还是为了寻找表演的观众。一些宁芙会吸引电影摄制组到她们的领地拍摄，但有两个条件：一是拍摄不得破坏环境，二是宁芙必须在电影中担任重要角色。

除非她们的领地受到威胁，大多数太空宁芙对凡人持友善或不关心的态度，但她们的记忆力极佳。任何造访太空宁芙领地的人都应该研究该宁芙怀有的怨恨、过往与凡人的接触经历，或是该区域近期发生的任何可能影响宁芙对途经其家园的生物看法的重大事件。

展现出正确态度和能力的凡人，例如通过保护一颗星体免遭毁灭，或创作出特别美丽的艺术品，可能会吸引太空宁芙的注意。有时，太空宁芙会主动提出担任恒星武士（solarians）或秘术师（mystics）的导师，尽管她们很少主动寻找学生。太空宁芙很少同时与不止一个人建立这种关系，并且通常只愿为能持续数十年乃至数百年的关系作出承诺，因此她们在选择学生时极为挑剔。

items.name: 事件视界
items.expectedDescription:
You unleash the power of a supermassive black hole. All creatures in the area take 6d10 bludgeoning and 6d10 void damage. Event horizon ignores up to 10 resistance creatures in the area have to bludgeoning, and up to 10 resistance they have to void. Each creature attempts a Reflex save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the end of its next turn.

Failure The creature takes full damage, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 3} until the end of its next turn, and slowed 1 for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is slowed 3 until the end of its next turn, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} for 1 minute.
items.description:
你释放超大质量黑洞的力量。区域内所有生物受到6d10钝击伤害和6d10虚能伤害。事件视界忽略区域内生物至多10点钝击抗力和至多10点虚能抗力。每个生物尝试一次反射豁免。

大成功 生物不受影响。

成功 生物受到一半伤害，且陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢1}，直到其下一回合结束。

失败 生物受到全额伤害，陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢3}直到其下一回合结束，并陷入缓慢1，持续1分钟。

大失败 生物受到双倍伤害，陷入缓慢3直到其下一回合结束，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢2}，持续1分钟。

items.name: 呼召宇宙
items.expectedDescription:
You reach into the void and call down a vertical column of dangerous cosmic material that rains destruction upon creatures in the area and shrouds the terrain around it in a swirl of stardust. This matter is made up of bits of burning stars and chunks of frozen comets, and it deals 5d12 cold damage and 5d12 fire damage to every creature in the area when you Cast the Spell. For the spell's duration, the cosmic material reduces visibility and mobility, making the area greater difficult terrain and making everything seen within or through the area @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Heightened (10th) The cold and fire damage each increase by 2d12.
items.description:
你探入虚空并召来一片危险的宇宙物质，其在一个垂直圆柱内摧毁其中生物，并将地形化为星尘漩涡。这种物质由燃烧的恒星或冰冻的彗星组成，对施法时区域内的所有生物造成5d12火焰伤害和5d12寒冷伤害。在法术持续期间内，宇宙物质降低了能见度和机动性，使该区域内变为高等困难地形并且让该区域内或者透过其的所有事物获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]。

升阶（10环）寒冷伤害和火焰伤害各增加2d12。

items.name: 内爆术
items.expectedDescription:
You crush the target by causing it to collapse in on itself, dealing 75 damage. The first time each round you Sustain the spell, you must choose a new target to be subject to the same effect; the same creature can never be targeted more than once with a single casting of this spell. You also can't affect more than one creature per turn with implosion. You can't target a creature that's incorporeal, gaseous, or liquid, or otherwise lacking a solid form.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 10.
items.description:
你通过令目标自身崩坏来摧毁目标，造成75伤害。每轮你首次维持此法术时，你必须选择一个新的目标承受相同的效果；相同的生物不能被同一次施放的该法术重复作为目标。你也不能在一回合中通过内爆术影响超过一个生物。你不能以虚体，气体，液体或者其他缺少固体形态的生物作为目标。

升阶（+1） 该伤害增加10。

items.name: 念动爆发
items.expectedDescription:
You launch a barrage of powerful psychokinetic energy that overpowers creatures, hurls objects, and deals damage. When you Cast this Spell and the first time each round you Sustain the spell, you can choose one of the following effects. You can't choose the same effect twice in a row.

  • Back Off! You hurl up to 15 objects or creatures up to 40 feet in any direction (including up or down). You can hurl up to a total weight of 40 Bulk per creature or object. Creatures take bludgeoning damage based on the distance they moved and land @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, as though they'd taken falling damage. Creatures that succeed on a Fortitude save against the spell avoid being moved.
  • Hard Rain You pummel all creatures in the area with debris and objects in the area, dealing 5d10 bludgeoning damage with a basic Reflex save.
  • Psychokinetic Slam Your psychokinetic storm slams into all creatures in the area. Make a ranged spell attack roll. All targets you hit take 7d6 force damage and are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.
items.description:
你发射一连串强大的精神能量，压倒生物、投掷物品并造成伤害。当你施放此法术时，以及每轮第一次维持此法术时，你可以选择以下效果之一。不能连续两次选择相同的效果。

  • 退开！你将至多15个物体或生物向任意方向（包括向上或向下）抛出至多40尺。你可以抛掷的每个生物或物体重量至多为40负载。生物根据移动距离受到钝击伤害，并在落地时@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}，如同受到坠落伤害。成功通过此法术强韧豁免的生物不会被移动。
  • 骤雨你以区域内的碎屑和物体猛击区域内所有生物，造成5d10钝击伤害，进行一次基础反射豁免。
  • 念动力猛击你的念动力风暴撞向区域内所有生物。进行一次远程法术攻击掷骰。所有被命中的目标受到7d6力场伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 1}。

items.name: 重力场
items.expectedDescription:
Bending the laws of the Universe to your will, you increase the forces of gravity in an area. All flying creatures in the area descend 40 feet. The entire area is greater difficult terrain for Flying and Climbing creatures, and difficult terrain for creatures on the ground. Any creature pulled to the ground by a gravity field takes bludgeoning damage as though it had fallen.

Gravity in the area increases by one step (for example, zero-g becomes low gravity, low gravity becomes standard, standard gravity becomes high gravity, and high gravity becomes extreme gravity).
items.description:
你扭曲宇宙法则，增强一个区域内的重力。区域内所有飞行生物下降40尺。整个区域对飞行生物和攀爬生物来说是高等困难地形，对地面生物来说是困难地形。任何被重力场拉到地面上的生物都会受到钝击伤害，如同坠落一样。

该区域内的重力增加一级（例如，零重力变为低重力，低重力变为标准重力，标准重力变为高重力，高重力变为极端重力）。

items.name: 播种奇点
items.expectedDescription:
A tiny particle of incredibly dense mass magically blossoms into a gravitational singularity that pulls creatures toward it and spatially compresses any creatures that are moved into it. You create a singularity in a 5-foot square that is unoccupied by any creatures. All creatures and unsecured objects in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:50] around the singularity are moved toward the singularity when the spell is cast, depending on their Reflex save (see below). Creatures and objects are moved starting with those closest to the singularity, so they might block the path of other creatures and objects that are pulled in later.

Creatures' spaces can overlap in the square that contains the singularity. A creature or object that enters the singularity or ends its turn there takes 10d10 bludgeoning damage with no saving throw. While in the singularity, a creature can take no actions except to attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} against your Spell DC. When the spell ends, the singularity disappears, and overlapping creatures are moved to the closest unoccupied space, as determined by the GM.

Squares in the emanation are difficult terrain for creatures moving away from the singularity, and creatures moving toward the singularity can move 10 feet for each 5 feet of movement they spend.

A creature needs to attempt a Reflex save if it's in the area when the spell is cast and when it ends its turn in the area.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is pulled 10 feet toward the singularity.

Failure The creature is pulled 20 feet toward the singularity.

Critical Failure The creature is pulled 30 feet toward the singularity.
items.description:
一粒质量极其密集的微小粒子在魔法作用下扩展为引力奇点，将生物拉向自身，并在空间上压缩被移入其中的生物。你在一个未被任何生物占据的5尺方格内创造一个奇点。法术施放时，奇点周围@Template[type:emanation|distance:50]内的所有生物和未被固定的物体，根据其反射豁免结果向奇点移动（见下文）。生物和物体从距离奇点最近者开始移动，因此它们可能挡住随后被拉入的其他生物和物体的路径。

生物的空间可以在包含奇点的方格内重叠。进入奇点或在其中结束其回合的生物或物体受到10d10钝击伤害，无法豁免。在奇点内，生物除了对抗你的法术DC尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{逃脱}之外，无法采取任何动作。法术结束时，奇点消失，重叠的生物被移至最近的未占用空间，具体由GM决定。

对于向远离奇点方向移动的生物，弥漫区域内的方格是困难地形；向奇点靠近的生物每花费5尺移动距离，便可移动10尺。

施放法术时位于区域内，以及在区域内结束其回合的生物，需要尝试一次反射豁免。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功该生物被拉向奇点10尺。

失败该生物被拉向奇点20尺。

大失败该生被拉向奇点30尺。

items.name: 噬星爆发
items.expectedDescription:
A globe of freezing darkness explodes in the area, dealing 8d10 cold damage to creatures in the area, plus an additional 8d4 void damage to living creatures. Each creature in the area must attempt a Reflex save.

If the globe overlaps with an area of magical light or affects a creature affected by magical light, eclipse burst attempts to counteract the light effect.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} by the darkness for an unlimited duration.

Heightened (+1) The cold damage increases by 1d10 and the void damage against the living increases by 1d4.
items.description:
一颗冰寒的黑暗球体在区域中爆发，对区域内生物造成8d10寒冷伤害，并对活物额外造成8d4虚能伤害。区域中的每个生物都必须尝试反射豁免。

若球体与魔法光照区域重叠，或影响到正受到魔法光照影响的生物，噬星爆发会尝试反制该光照效果。

大成功 生物不受影响。

成功 生物受到一半伤害。

失败 该生物承受完整伤害。

大失败 生物受到双倍伤害，并因黑暗而陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲}，持续时间无限。

升阶（+1） 寒冷伤害增加1d10，对活物的虚能伤害增加1d4。

items.name: 处死一指
items.expectedDescription:
You point at a creature and invoke the demise of all things. The target takes 70 void damage with a basic Fortitude save. If the target is undead or otherwise has void healing, the spell loses the death and void traits and gains the vitality trait, and the target takes 70 vitality damage with a basic Fortitude save.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 10.
items.description:
你将你的手指指向目标生物，并祈求万物的终结。目标承受70点虚能伤害，这有一次基础强韧豁免。如果目标是不死生物，或者具有虚能治疗能力，该法术失去死亡和虚能特征，获得命能特征，并且目标改为承受70点命能伤害，这有一次基础强韧豁免。

升阶（+1） 该伤害增加10。

items.name: 虚空淹没
items.expectedDescription:
A well of desolate darkness scours all life, dealing 10d10 void damage to all living creatures in the area. Each creature in the area must attempt a Reflex save. If void scour overlaps with an area of magical light or affects a creature affected by magical light, void scour attempts to counteract the light effect.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and @Damage[(@item.rank - 6)d6[persistent,void]] damage, and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and @Damage[(@item.rank - 5)d6[persistent,void]] damage, and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2}.

Heightened (+1) Increase the initial void damage by 2d10. The persistent void damage increases by 1d6 on a failure, or by 2d6 on critical failure.
items.description:
一口荒寂的黑暗深井涤荡一切生命，对区域内所有活物造成10d10虚能伤害。区域内每个生物必须尝试一次反射豁免。如果虚空淹没与魔法光亮区域重叠，或影响了受到魔法光亮影响的生物，虚空淹没会尝试抵消该光亮效果。

大成功 生物不受影响。

成功 生物受到一半伤害。

失败 生物受到全额伤害及@Damage[(@item.rank - 6)d6[persistent,void]]伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失1}。

大失败 生物受到双倍伤害及@Damage[(@item.rank - 5)d6[persistent,void]]伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失2}。

升阶（+1） 初始虚能伤害增加2d10。失败时的持续虚能伤害增加1d6，大失败时则增加2d6。

items.name: 假像术
items.expectedDescription:
You turn yourself @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} and create an illusory duplicate of yourself. When you Sustain the spell, you can mentally dictate a course of action for your duplicate to follow that round. Your duplicate acts as though it had your full number of actions, though it can't actually affect anything in the environment. Both the duplicate and your invisibility persist for the spell's duration. Performing a hostile action doesn't end mislead's invisibility, just like a 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility} spell. A creature that determines the duplicate is an illusion doesn't necessarily know you're invisible, and one that can see your invisible form doesn't necessarily know your duplicate is an illusion.

If you Cast a Spell, attack, or otherwise interact with another creature, as a part of that action you can attempt a Deception check against observers' Perception DCs to convince them your duplicate used that action. This doesn't fool anyone who's aware your duplicate is an illusion, nor does it work if the attack obviously couldn't have come from the duplicate. For instance, if you fired a ray, you could make it look like it came from the duplicate as long as the duplicate was positioned appropriately, but if you attacked with a sword and your duplicate was across the room from the target, your Deception check would automatically fail.
items.description:
你将自身变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}，并且创造一个自身的幻术复制。当你维持该法术时，你可以通过意念指定一系列行动，你的复制该轮会按此行动。你的复制会如同具有你的完整数量的动作一般行动，尽管它不能影响环境中的任何事物。你的复制和你的隐形都会持续整个法术持续时间。进行敌对动作不会结束假像术的隐形，如同4环阶@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{隐形术}法术。一个了解到该复制为幻象的生物并不会直接知道你是隐形的，并且可以看见你的隐形形态的生物并不会直接知道你的复制是幻象。

如果你施放法术、攻击或以其他方式与另一生物互动，以该动作的一部分，你可以尝试一次欺骗检定，对抗观察者的察觉DC，以令它相信你的复制品使用了该动作。这不会欺骗任何了解你的复制品为幻觉的生物，并且在攻击显然不可能来自复制品时也无效。例如，你发射了一道射线，并且你可以令其看起来来自你的复制，只要你的复制的位置合适，但如果你使用剑攻击，并且你的复制在房间里与目标相对的另一个角落，你的欺骗检定自动失败。

items.name: 口袋真空
items.expectedDescription:
You create a sudden vacuum, forcing creatures in the area to hold their breath or fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} and start suffocating. The explosive decompression deals 5d12 bludgeoning damage to each creature in the area when the spell is cast or that enters the area during the duration (unless they were already in a vacuum), with a basic Fortitude save. Creatures who critically fail the save are also knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d12.
items.description:
你会突然制造出真空状态，迫使周围的生物屏住呼吸，否则就会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]并开始窒息。施法时或在法术持续时间内进入该区域的生物都会受到突然减压造成的5d12钝击伤害（除非他们原本就处于真空状态），这需要一次基础强韧豁免。豁免大失败的生物会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]。

升阶 （+1） 伤害增加1d12。

items.name: 冷葬
items.expectedDescription:
You flash freeze a target then send subsonic waves through it, potentially reducing it into fine powder. Make a spell attack against the target. If you hit a target, the target takes 6d8 cold damage and must attempt a Fortitude save. If you critically hit, the target gets a result one degree of success worse than it rolled on its Fortitude save. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points is blasted to fine powder; its gear remains.

Critical Success The target is unaffected by further damage.

Success The target takes an additional @Damage[((@item.level -3)d8)[sonic]] damage.

Failure The target takes an additional @Damage[((@item.level)d8)[sonic]] damage.

Critical Failure The target takes an additional @Damage[((@item.level +6)d8)[sonic]] damage.

Heightened (+1) The cold and sonic damage each increase by 1d8.
items.description:
你会瞬间冻结一个目标，然后向其发送亚音速波，有可能将其变成粉末。对目标发动法术攻击。如果你击中目标，则目标会受到6d8点寒冷伤害，并必须尝试一次强韧豁免。如果你的法术攻击造成重击，目标的强韧豁免结果会下降一级成功度。减至0HP的生物会被炸成粉末，但其装备会保留。

大成功目标不受进一步伤害的影响。

成功目标受到额外@Damage[((@item.level -3)d8)[sonic]]伤害。

失败目标受到额外@Damage[((@item.level)d8)[sonic]]伤害。

大失败目标受到额外@Damage[((@item.level +6)d8)[sonic]]伤害。

升阶（+1）寒冷和音波伤害增加1d8

items.name: 警示波动
items.expectedDescription:
You deter enemies with a wave of hostile intent. The target takes 7d8 nonlethal mental damage, and the target must attempt a Will save. The psychic energy then arcs to another creature within 30 feet of the first target, jumps to another creature within 30 feet of that target, and so on. You can end the wave at any point. You can't target the same creature more than once, and you must have line of effect to all targets. Roll the damage only once, and apply it to each target (halving or doubling as appropriate for its saving throw outcome).

Critical Success The target creature is unaffected, and the wave ends with that target.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d8.
items.description:
你以一波敌意威慑敌人。目标受到7d8非致命心灵伤害，并且必须尝试意志豁免。随后，心灵能量会跃向初始目标30尺内的另一个生物，再跳向该生物30尺内的另一个生物，以此类推。你可以在任何时候终止波动。你不能以同一生物为目标超过一次，并且必须对所有目标都具有效果线。只掷一次伤害骰，再将伤害应用于每个目标（根据其豁免结果适当地减半或翻倍）。

大成功 目标生物不受影响，且波动在该目标处终止。

成功 目标受到一半伤害。

失败 目标受到全部伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧1}。

大失败 目标受到双倍伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧2}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加2d8。

items.name: 石塑形体
items.expectedDescription:
