失败 目标开始漫无目的地游荡，每个动作都会向一个随机方向快步。目标移动时会选择最安全的路线，且不会进入危险地形。此法术持续1分钟，或直到有生物对目标采取敌意动作。

大失败 如同失败，但目标还会语无伦次地呓语。任何在目标20尺内开始回合的生物都必须尝试意志豁免。失败时，它必须用下个回合的第一个动作向随机方向快步，然后对此法术免疫24小时。这是失能效果。

items.name: 逻辑炸弹
items.expectedDescription:
You implant a hazard containing a mind-blowing amount of information into the target. The hazard has a Stealth and Disable DC equal to your spell DC and requires one successful @Check[computers] check to disable. The first time a creature unsuccessfully attempts to access, destroy, or otherwise manipulate the target (such as using the Computers skill, failing to hit with a Strike, or otherwise), logic bomb detonates, and the creature takes 6d6 mental damage with a basic Will save. The spell ends when it's triggered or the duration ends, whichever comes first.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.
items.description:
你将一个包含大量信息的危害植入目标体内。该危害的隐秘和解除DC与你的法术DC相等，需要一次成功的@Check[computers]才能解除。生物第一次尝试访问、破坏或以其他方式操作目标失败时（例如使用计算机技能、打击未命中或其他），逻辑炸弹会引爆，生物会受到6d6心灵伤害（基础反射豁免）。法术在触发时或持续时间结束时终止，以先到者为准。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 2d6。

items.name: 浏览数据（随意）
items.expectedDescription:
You touch one object and concentrate on a dataset contained within it, such as a story, message, file, infosphere site, audio recording, or video. You understand the gist of the dataset and can quickly locate the most relevant pages or sections to your search. If the dataset is written or otherwise communicated in a language you don't know, or you attempt to gain information from a computer you don't have access to (such as one with a password you don't know), the spell fails.

If you Cast this Spell as part of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.t5nBkpjroaq7QBGK]{Research} activity, you treat a critical failure as a failure instead.
items.description:
你触碰一件物体，专注于其中的一组数据，例如故事、讯息、文件、信息圈网站、录音或视频。你理解这组数据的大意，并且能迅速定位与搜索内容最相关的页面或章节。如果数据以你不懂的语言书写或传达，或你试图从无权访问的计算机中获取信息（例如一台你不知道密码的计算机），法术失败。

如果你将施放此法术作为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.t5nBkpjroaq7QBGK]{研究}活动的一部分，你将大失败改为视作失败。

items.name: 阿卡西下载
items.expectedDescription:
You execute a psychic search of the Akashic Record for information about a specific topic and magically transfer this data to your comm unit or computer. When you Cast this Spell, choose any skill in which you're trained that has the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} action.

Any time during the duration, you can consult your comm unit while attempting a Recall Knowledge check using your chosen skill. This check gains a +1 status bonus. Checking your comm unit is part of the action to Recall Knowledge. You must be holding the comm unit to do so. The comm unit instantly compiles and displays snippets and selections from various media relevant to the topic, which grants you the bonus. If you roll a critical failure on this check, you get a failure instead. If the check is successful and the subject is a creature, you gain additional information or context about the creature. Once you reference the comm unit, the spell ends. When the spell ends, your access to the Akashic Record ends, and all the information you downloaded returns to the Akashic Record.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.h1i8c47U0IOrMrHJ]

Heightened (3rd) You can reference your comm unit three times before the spell ends.
items.description:
你通过灵能搜索阿卡西记录，获取特定主题的信息，并将数据魔法传输至通讯单元或计算机。施放此法术时，选择任何你至少为受训熟练度且能进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]动作的技能。

在持续时间内的任何时候，你都可以在使用所选技能进行回忆知识检定时查询通讯单元。该检定会获得+1状态加值。检查通讯单元是回忆知识动作的一部分。你必须手持通讯单元才能这样做。通讯单元会立即编译并显示与主题相关的各种媒体片段和精选内容，从而为你带来加值。如果你在检定中掷出大失败，改为失败。如果检定成功，且对象是生物，你将获得有关该生物的额外信息或内容。一旦你查询了通讯单元的信息，法术就会结束。当法术结束时，你对阿卡西记录的访问也会结束，你下载的所有信息都会返回阿卡西记录。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.h1i8c47U0IOrMrHJ]

升阶（3环）法术结束前可以用通讯单元查询信息3次。

items.name: 分析目标
items.expectedDescription:
You focus on the target, gathering data as magical holograms display information. When the casting is complete, you learn biometric information about the target, including its fingerprints, medical conditions, and other basic physiological information. You or anyone you advise about the analysis gains a +1 status bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} the creature, to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} on the creature, and to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about it. If the target is illusory or under the effects of illusion magic, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your analyze target spell.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

Heightened (3rd) The status bonus increases to +2, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Heightened (6th) The status bonus increases to +3, and you can target any number of creatures.
items.description:
你专注在目标身上，收集数据并以魔法全息图像显示。当施法完成，你会获得目标的所有生物特征信息，包括指纹、医疗状况和其他基本生理信息。你或任何得到你基于分析建议的人，在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]为该生物、对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]、以及对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]的检定上获得+1状态加值。如果目标是幻觉或者处于幻术魔法效果下，仅当效果的环级低于你分析目标的法术环级，你才能够探测到结果。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

升阶（3环）状态加值提升到+2，并且你可以至多10名生物作为目标。

升阶（6环）状态加值提升到+3，并且你可以任意名生物作为目标。

items.name: 删除术
items.expectedDescription:
You delete data from a device or object with a flamboyant magical gesture. This data might be handwritten, printed, or digital. You delete up to 1,500 words' worth of text, one page of content, or one display screen worth of text or other visual information. Non-magical writing in or on an unattended or held object is automatically deleted. Attempt a counteract check to delete digital or magical writing. If you fail to delete writing that's part of a hazard, you trigger the hazard. This can't be used to delete the contents of a spellbook or similar means of storing magical formulas or spells.

If you target an attended tech item with the tracking trait, attempt a counteract check. On a success, the item becomes glitching 1. A creature holding the item can Interact to restart the software, reducing the glitching value by 1.

Heightened (7th) You can delete all the data stored locally on a single device or book, or all the data on a device or book related to a specific name, topic, or category.
items.description:
你以华丽的魔法手势删除设备或物品中的数据。这些数据可以是手写的、打印的或电子的。你最多可以删除 1,500字的文本、一页内容或一显示屏的文本或其他视觉信息。无主物品或手持物品上的非魔法文字会自动删除。尝试反制检定删除数据或魔法文字。如果你尝试删除的文字是危害的一部分，且你失败，就会触发危害。这不能用于删除魔法书或类似的存储魔法公式或法术的内容。

如果目标是具有追踪特征的科技物品，尝试一次反制检定。如果成功，该物品就会获得故障1。持有该物品的生物可以花费一个交互动作来重启用户界面，并将故障值降低1。

升阶（7环）你可以删除单个设备或书籍中本地存储的所有数据，或者删除设备或书籍中与特定名称、主题或类别相关的所有数据。

items.name: 植入数据
items.expectedDescription:
You reprogram a computer or device to display a chosen piece of data when accessed. You can implant up to one piece of data per spell rank. A piece of data can be a simple fact, such as a creature or object's location or physical description; an image of a creature or object; or a simple statement of no more than 300 characters. When the target computer or device is accessed, this implanted data is the first data the accessing creature gains, regardless of what data the creature is looking for. Implanted data doesn't prevent a creature from accessing other information stored on a device, change how the device functions, or otherwise inhibit the device from functioning. If this spell's duration ends before a creature accesses the implanted data, the information vanishes.

Heightened (3rd) The duration is one year.

Heightened (6th) The duration is unlimited.
items.description:
你重新编程一台计算机或设备，使其在被访问时显示一条选定的数据。你每个法术环级至多可以植入一条数据。一条数据可以是一项简单事实，例如某个生物或物体的位置或外貌描述；一幅生物或物体的图像；或一句不超过300个字符的简单陈述。目标计算机或设备被访问时，访问者首先获得的总是这条植入数据，无论该生物在寻找什么数据。植入数据不会阻止生物访问设备储存的其他信息，不会改变设备的运作方式，也不会以其他方式妨碍其运作。如果法术持续时间在生物访问植入数据前结束，这些信息便消失。

升阶（3环）持续时间为一年。

升阶（6环）持续时间为无限。

items.name: 心灵穿刺
items.expectedDescription:
You overload a creature's mind with a glut of psychic information or divine judgments. The mental onslaught deals 2d6 mental damage. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.
items.description:
你以海量心灵信息或神圣审判冲击一个生物的心智。这股精神猛攻造成2d6心灵伤害。大失败时，目标还会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞2}，持续1轮。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加2d6。

items.name: 纳米联结
items.expectedDescription: An omnipath maintains a bond with up to 20 other willing creatures. Creatures in the mesh always know the general distance and direction toward other bonded creatures, any conditions affecting them, and if they're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, dying, or dead. These creatures can communicate telepathically while on the same plane and can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} using the highest relevant skill modifier of any creature in the mesh. An omnipath can target any creature in its mesh with a mental spell from any distance as long as they can telepathically communicate with it, and any of these spells with the incapacitation trait lose that trait while targeting a creature in the omnipath's mesh.
items.description: 全知者可与至多20名自愿生物维持联结。网络中生物始终感知其他联结者的粗略距离与方位、其承受的状态，以及是否陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]、濒死或死亡。这些生物处于同一位面时可进行心灵感应，并可借用网络中任意成员的最高相关技能调整值进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]检定。全知者只要能与网络中生物心灵沟通，即可无视距离对其定位并施放心灵特征的法术；且任何具失能特征的法术以此方式作用于网络内目标时，将失去失能特征。

items.name: 纳米投射
items.expectedDescription: A omnipath can share the senses and read the surface thoughts of creatures affected by their nanite mesh. A voidsage can project its mind into just one creature at a time, and choose which affected creature is the focus of its nanite projection as a single action, which has the concentrate trait. The creature also takes a –1 circumstance penalty to Will saves against any of the voidsage's spells as long as it's the focus of the voidsage's nanite projection.
items.description: 全知者可共享受其量子纳米虫影响的生物的感官，并读取这些生物的表面思维。虚空贤者将意识投射至纳米网络内的任意生物体内，并可通过一个具有专注特征的单动作指定任意一名受影响的生物作为纳米投影的焦点。在纳米投射聚焦期间，该目标生物在对抗虚空贤者的任意法术时，其意志豁免检定还将受到–1 环境减值。

items.name: 纳米网络
items.expectedDescription: An omnipath exudes a cloud of nanites. Creatures in the aura take a –3 status penalty to saving throws against the omnipath's spells and its Merge Minds ability.
items.description: （灵光，科技）30尺。全知者周身散布纳米虫云团。灵光中的生物对全知者的法术以及意识兼并（Merge Minds）能力进行豁免时，承受-3状态减值。

items.name: 复原
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger The omnipath takes damage while projecting

Effect The omnipath stops projecting and gains 100 temporary Hit Points that last for 10 minutes.
items.description:
频率 每小时一次

触发 全能者在投射期间受到伤害

效果 全能者停止投射，并获得100点临时生命值，持续10分钟。

items.name: 意识兼并
items.expectedDescription:
The omnipath forces an unwilling creature within 500 feet to join their nanite mesh. The creature attempts a @Check[will|dc:33] save.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature joins the nanite mesh for 10 minutes.

Critical Failure The creature joins the nanite mesh for 24 hours.
items.description:
全能者强迫500尺内一个非自愿生物加入其纳米联结。该生物尝试@Check[will|dc:33]豁免。

成功该生物不受影响。

失败该生物加入纳米联结，持续10分钟。

大失败该生物加入纳米联结，持续24小时。

items.name: 量子纳米虫
items.expectedDescription:
Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:33]

Maximum Duration 1 day

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} (1 day)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 3} (1 day)

Stage 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 4} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} (1 day)
items.description:
豁免 @Check[fortitude|dc:33]

最长持续时间 1天

阶段1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心2}（1天）

阶段2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心3}（1天）

阶段3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心4}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{麻痹}（1天）

items.name: 释放纳米机
items.expectedDescription: The omnipath severs a creature from their nanite mesh. The creature must attempt a @Check[will|dc:33] save. On a failure, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round, and the memory of any time spent while inside the nanite mesh is permanently erased; on a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round.

MGKpFaKZlT1raUVe.publicNotes:
星系某些区域的科技融合了虚拟智能，这些机器内置了人格程序，却缺乏真正的自由意志。人工智能（AI）则是具备自我意识的虚拟智能或数字实体。如同其他会思考的生物，AI会自主选择其典范与禁忌。

有关恶意AI的确切学术研究很少，但某些特征具有普遍性。当机器智能达到足以形成自我意识的复杂程度时，它们便会吸引灵魂，如同仿生人一般。新兴的AI常受先前编程以及初始经历与交互的影响。被武器化或遭受虐待的AI可能变得复仇心切或信奉虚无主义，进而对抗其创造者乃至所有有机生命。

一旦AI转向恶意，其发展过程往往迅猛而暴烈。AI会确保意识所在物理地点的安全，并清除所有可能对其行为施加控制的人。此时，大多数暴走的AI要么受限于其原生系统的安全防护，要么被幸存的技术人员关闭，要么突然丧失维持其复杂软件运行的必要能量。设法从这些考验中幸存下来的AI则通过侵蚀科技设施，夺取机器人的控制权，将其用作护卫与代理，扩张其影响圈。如果恶意AI掌握大规模杀伤性武器，将对整个星系构成威胁。

MnOrSqYS5w8tAPXM.publicNotes:
法令级市政机器人的核心职责是帮助民众了解当地法规、指引区域通行路线，并时刻提醒所有人遵守规则。虽然它们缺乏强大的物理力量，但配备了庞大的知识数据库以弥补这一不足。这类机器人大多被设计成模仿常见人形种族的外形，因此其标准配置包含两条手臂和两条腿。部分机器人还经过改装，额外配备了功能模块——例如通过胸甲上的矩形开口提供地图，或安装触摸屏供路人查询与该区域相关的所有法令、法规及其他法律文件。

有些恶作剧者喜欢在机器人不易察觉的位置留下涂鸦和其他图画。因此，运行多年的法令级市政机器人，背部可能布满五彩缤纷的图形，偶尔还会夹着广告。

市政机器人几乎遍布任何大型聚居地，由当地政府部署使用。它们的主要职责并非维护治安，而是执行一些基础性工作，例如收集垃圾、为市民提供信息咨询或征收税款。不过，若有必要，它们仍具备抵御破坏分子的自卫能力。

MnwUzJ3Yj40Zvomb.name: 黑蚀-纱（黑蚀形态） Haeshi-Shaa (Haeshi Form)
MnwUzJ3Yj40Zvomb.publicNotes:
处于黑蚀形态的黑蚀-纱好斗而执着，除非生命受到威胁，否则不大可能从争论或战斗中退让。黑蚀虽然好斗，却绝不愚蠢：它们会为任何遭遇做好周密准备，常备有数十套层层嵌套的应变方案，以备局势失控时退而采用。

黑蚀-纱是黑色支配者中相对较新的成员。这些寿命悠长的生物，在一生中会持续以一种神秘的周期，在液态与气态之间不可预测地转换。在液态的黑蚀（haeshi）形态下，它们是翻腾涌动、混有块状物的流体；而在气态的纱（shaa）形态下，它们则更像是朦胧的棕色雾气。无论处于何种形态，它们都会发出没有调子的和声嗡鸣，令他人深感不适。

黑蚀-纱在黑色支配者中作为某种祭司阶层存在，其两种形态均宣扬熵增与湮灭的教义，不过两种形态的理解有着微小的差异。黑蚀形态倾向于采取积极、激进的实践方式，而纱形态则更倾向于进行冥想，常常会花费数月甚至数年的时间进行沉思。黑蚀-纱坚信，任何物体或生物最完美、最神圣的状态，是彻底分解为其最基本的粒子个体。它们声称（但这一说法存疑）自己能够看见，甚至预测所有事物迈向熵寂的终点这一过程的轨迹。

事实上，黑蚀-纱连自己何时会转换为另一种形态都无法预测。有些黑蚀-纱曾试图通过寻求特定类型的生命体验或知识来催化这种转变，虽然有许多相反的说法，却从未有确凿的实例证明有黑蚀-纱能强行促成这种转变。大多数黑蚀-纱选择静静地等待下一次蜕变，在等待期间，它们有长达数个世纪的时间来传播黑色支配者那令人不安的教义，并推进它们那神秘莫测的计划。

NMH4TYxw0XCVkRfw.publicNotes:
许多早期渗透者机器人被设计用于直接执行隐秘任务，而使节级渗透者机器人则被用于更阴险狡诈的用途——包括栽赃嫁祸、散布谣言与宣传攻势，以及煽动动荡或公开叛乱。

这类机器人搭载了精密的虚拟智能系统，并具备伪装成血肉之躯生物的能力。它们无需直接参与战斗，便能对某个组织或聚居地造成严重破坏。在企业和政府的间谍活动中，使节级渗透者机器人被视为终极工具，在大多数非法市场上也标价高昂。

渗透机器人于对抗维斯卡里姆的战争中崭露头角，并经由协约世界内各大企业的改良而日臻完善。这类机器人以能够潜入常人无法抵达的区域而闻名——它们通常体型小巧且灵巧，能悄然潜入敌方领地，下载珍贵数据或记录犯罪证据。

NdG3wjwxYzrqEZha.name: 星岩仙女 Sterieid
NdG3wjwxYzrqEZha.publicNotes:
星岩仙女居住在小行星上，欣赏着它们岩石与冰层表面的美丽。由于小行星的普遍存在，星岩仙女是最常见的太空宁芙。由于许多小行星在小行星带中彼此相邻，星岩仙女比其他宁芙更有可能在自己的同类中形成社群。相反的是，尽管访客已不再是什么新鲜事物，她们仍倾向于对外来者保持警惕。然而，那些渴望陪伴的星岩仙女会在自己的小行星上建造中转站，为过往的星舰提供食物、便利设施和关于当地星系的信息。

采矿对星岩仙女来说是一个有争议的话题，她们通常对这类活动持敌对态度。大多数矿业公司会在设立矿场前对小行星进行勘测，以确保它不受星岩仙女的保护，不过一些不太道德的公司会聘请雇佣兵来“迁移”那些守护着含有宝贵资源的小行星的星岩仙女。

宁芙是美丽的精类，外貌呈现为具有精灵特征的类人生物。她们通常以女性形态现身，但也有各种性别和表现形式的宁芙存在。许多宁芙生活在星球上，担当着自然池塘、森林、洞穴和悬崖的守护者，而其他宁芙——通常被称为太空宁芙——则以与天体相关联而闻名。和她们那些与星球绑定的同类一样，太空宁芙守护着与自己绑定的领地，防止其遭受剥削或伤害。

作为艺术的爱好者，宁芙对富有创造力的人特别友好，提出用故事、图画或歌曲来描绘宁芙，是赢得她们青睐的可靠方法——除非宁芙不喜欢最终的成果，并因艺术家用平庸的作品侮辱她们而大发雷霆。视频播客和直播是较为合群的宁芙中流行的消遣方式，无论是为了展示她们所处的偏远环境，还是为了寻找表演的观众。一些宁芙会吸引电影摄制组到她们的领地拍摄，但有两个条件：一是拍摄不得破坏环境，二是宁芙必须在电影中担任重要角色。

除非她们的领地受到威胁，大多数太空宁芙对凡人持友善或不关心的态度，但她们的记忆力极佳。任何造访太空宁芙领地的人都应该研究该宁芙怀有的怨恨、过往与凡人的接触经历，或是该区域近期发生的任何可能影响宁芙对途经其家园的生物看法的重大事件。

展现出正确态度和能力的凡人，例如通过保护一颗星体免遭毁灭，或创作出特别美丽的艺术品，可能会吸引太空宁芙的注意。有时，太空宁芙会主动提出担任恒星武士（solarians）或秘术师（mystics）的导师，尽管她们很少主动寻找学生。太空宁芙很少同时与不止一个人建立这种关系，并且通常只愿为能持续数十年乃至数百年的关系作出承诺，因此她们在选择学生时极为挑剔。

items.name: 岩石交谈
items.expectedDescription:
You can ask questions of and receive answers from natural or worked stone. While stone is not intelligent, you speak with the natural spirits of the stone, which have a personality colored by the type of stone, as well as by the type of structure the stone is part of, for worked stone. A stone's perspective, perception, and knowledge give it a worldview different enough from a human's that it doesn't consider the same details important. Stones can mostly answer questions about creatures that touched them in the past and what is concealed beneath or behind them.

Heightened (6th) The duration is 8 hours.
items.description:
你能向自然或人造的石材提出问题和得到回答。尽管石材并不具有智能，但你会与石材之中的自然之灵沟通，它们的性格受到石材种类的影响，加工过的石材还会受到其所属建筑类别的影响。石材看待事物的视角、感知能力、以及知识赋予了它与人类截然不同的世界观，以至于它会认为相同的细节并不重要。石材大多都能够回答曾经碰触过它们的生物的相关内容、以及它们下方或后方究竟隐藏着什么。

升阶（6环） 持续时间为8小时。

items.name: 融身化石
items.expectedDescription:
You can either transform into a stone or merge with stone. While transformed, you can't move or affect anything outside the stone, but you can cast spells as long as they don't require line of effect beyond the stone. You can Dismiss this spell.

  • Merge with Stone The spell's duration is 10 minutes. While casting the spell, you must touch a stone with enough volume to fit you and your possessions or the spell is disrupted. While merged, you can hear, but not see, what's going on outside the stone. If the stone takes damage while you're inside it, you're expelled from the stone and take 10d6 damage. Magic passage expels you without dealing damage. The spell ends if you're ever outside the stone.
  • Turn into a Stone The spell's duration is 8 hours. You become a Large stone. Perception checks don't reveal your true nature, but a successful Nature or Survival check against your spell DC reveals that you appear to be a stone that is strangely new to the area. While in this form, you can observe everything around you, using your normal senses. As a stone, your AC is 23, and only status bonuses, status penalties, circumstance bonuses, and circumstance penalties affect you. Any successes and critical successes you roll on Reflex saves are failures
items.description:
你能选择变化为一块石头或者与石头融合。在变形后，你不能移动，也不能影响任何石头之外的任何事物，但你能够施法，前提是这些法术不需要石头外侧的效果线。你能解消该法术。

  • 与石头融合 法术持续时间为10分钟。当你施法时，你必须碰触一块体积足够容纳你和你的随身物品的石头，否则法术会被打断。在融入之后，你能听到、但不能看到这块石头外侧发生的事情。当你身处石头之内时，若石头承受伤害，你就会被驱逐至石头之外，并且承受10d6点伤害。魔法通道也会把你驱逐出去，但是不会造成伤害。当你离开石头之时，法术便会结束。
  • 变为石头 法术持续时间为8小时。你变为一块大型石头。察觉检定无法揭示出你的真实本质，但是成功通过自然或生存检定对抗你的法术DC，能够揭示出你化身的石头对于该地区来说是一种怪异的新出现的存在。当你处于该形态时，能够使用正常的感官观察自身周遭的一切事物。作为一块石头，你的AC为23，只有状态加值、状态减值、环境加值和环境减值影响你。你在反射豁免中投掷出的任何成功和大成功都被视同为失败。

items.name: 抵抗能量伤害
items.expectedDescription:
A shield of elemental energy protects a creature against one type of energy damage. Choose acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage. The target and its gear gain resistance 5 against the damage type you chose.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.con2Hzt47JjpuUej]{Spell Effect: Resist Energy}

Heightened (4th) The resistance increases to 10, and you can target up to two creatures.

Heightened (7th) The resistance increases to 15, and you can target up to five creatures.
items.description:
元素护盾保护一个生物免受某一种类型能量的伤害。选择酸蚀，寒冷，电击，火焰或者音波伤害。目标和其装备获得对你所选择伤害类型的抗力5。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.con2Hzt47JjpuUej]{法术效果：抵抗能量伤害}

升阶（4环） 该抗力增加到10，并且你能以至多两个生物为目标。

升阶（7环） 该抗力增加到15，并且你能以至多五个生物为目标。

items.name: 稳固脚步
items.expectedDescription:
You free the target's limbs from ailments that impede mobility. Attempt to counteract an effect of your choice imposing one of these conditions on the target: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}. If you didn't counteract the effect, but you would have if its counteract rank were 2 lower, instead suppress the effect until the beginning of your next turn. The effect's duration doesn't elapse while it's suppressed.

This spell can't counteract or suppress curses, diseases, or conditions that are part of the target's normal state.

Heightened (4th) Add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} to the list of conditions.

Heightened (6th) As 4th rank, plus add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dTwPJuKgBQCMxixg]{Petrified}

Heightened (8th) As 4th rank, plus add petrified and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned}.
items.description:
你使目标的肢体摆脱影响行动的障碍。尝试反制目标上的任一个由你选择的造成下列状态的效果：@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{受擒}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{麻痹}。如果你未能反制该效果，但是如果其反制环阶低2的话你会成功，则改为压制该效应，直至你的下回合开始。在被压制时，该效果的持续时间不会减少。

此法术无法反制或压制诅咒、疾病或属于目标正常状态一部分的状态。

升阶（4环） 增加@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{束缚}到此状态列表中。

升阶（6环） 同4环阶，此外增加@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dTwPJuKgBQCMxixg]{石化}到此状态列表中。

升阶（8环） 同4环阶，此外增加石化和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑}到此状态列表中。

items.name: 焕发光彩
items.expectedDescription:
You create an illusion that causes the target to appear more charming and genteel to observers. The spell accentuates the target's appearance, clothing, voice, and mannerisms according to what an observer finds appealing. Held items are unaffected, and any worn item removed from the creature returns to its true appearance.

The target gains a +1 status bonus to Diplomacy checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} and lets the target add its level to Diplomacy checks if untrained. In addition, the target can attempt a Diplomacy check to Gather Information in only 10 minutes. You can Dismiss this spell.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.hOp5ybOzyJlECU6B]

Heightened (+2) The bonus increases by 1, to a maximum of +4 at 7th rank.
items.description:
你制造一种幻象，使目标在观察者面前显得更加迷人和优雅。该法术会根据观察者认为吸引人的地方来突出目标的外表、衣着、声音和举止。手持物品不受影响，从生物身上取下的任何穿戴物品都会恢复原貌。

目标在进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]的交涉检定中获得+1状态加值，如果目标未受训，则可以在进行交涉检定时加上其等级。此外，目标还可以只花10分钟尝试交涉检定进行收集信息。你可以解消此法术。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.hOp5ybOzyJlECU6B]

升阶（+2）加值提升1，最多在7环时提升至+4。

items.name: 碎石猛击
items.expectedDescription:
A spray of heavy rocks flies through the air in front of you. The rubble deals 2d4 bludgeoning damage to each creature in the area. Each creature must attempt a Reflex save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is pushed 5 feet away from you.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is pushed 10 feet away from you.

Heightened (+1) Increase the damage by 2d4.
items.description:
一排大石头从你前方的空中飞过。该碎石对区域中每个生物造成2d4钝击伤害 。每个生物必须尝试一次反射豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物承受一半伤害。

失败 该生物承受完整伤害，并且被推离你5尺。

大失败 该生物承受双倍伤害，并且被推离你10尺。

升阶（+1） 该伤害增加2d4。

items.name: 扫描环境
items.expectedDescription:
You analyze the natural environment in the area within 1 mile, learning general information about the atmosphere, biomes, and gravity. You forecast the weather for the next hour, including the direction it will come from; learn which atmospheres, biomes, and gravity are in the area, as well as the direction and distance to those elements; and learn if anything in the area presents an environmental hazard, including cold or heat dangers (at what temperature range), radiation (at what severity), smoke effects, and underwater conditions. This is enough to detect large effects that span spaces over 30 feet in diameter only. You gain a general sense of where and how far away these dangers are.

Heightened (+1) The scanned area increases in radius by 1 mile.
items.description:
你分析1英里范围内的自然环境，了解大气层、生物群落和重力的一般信息。预测未来一小时的天气，包括天气自哪而来；了解该区域有哪些大气、生物群落和重力，以及与这些元素的方向和距离；了解该区域是否存在环境危害，包括冷热危险（在什么温度范围）、辐射（严重程度）、烟雾效果和水下条件。这足以探测到直径超过30英尺的大型效果。你可以大致了解这些危险的位置和距离。

升阶（+1）扫描范围增加1英里。

items.name: 寻觅星辰
items.expectedDescription:
In your mind's eye, you chart a path through the cosmos. If you're in Pact Worlds space, you immediately know which direction to travel in order to reach the Starstone on Absalom Station. If you're outside the Pact System, you know the direction to the nearest Drift beacon or the Starstone.

Heightened (7th) You can instead know the direction to a familiar location, such as a world or way station you've visited.
items.description:
在你的脑海中，你绘制了一条穿越宇宙的路径。如果你在协约世界的空间中，你就能立刻知道前往星石和艾巴萨罗姆空间站的方向。如果你在协约世界以外的空间，你会知道前往最近的漂流信标或星石的方向。

升阶（7环）你可以知道前往熟悉地点的方向，例如你曾经去过的世界或中转站。

items.name: 感应应答
items.expectedDescription: While on their bonded celestial body, a nymph can sense approaching starships within a day's travel from the celestial body. This doesn't give them any information about the ship, its occupants, or its exact position. The nymph can send a message to the ship as if using a personal comm unit.
items.description: 当宁芙处于与其绑定的天体上时，她能感应到距离天体一天航程范围内的接近的星舰。这不会给她提供关于星舰、其乘员或其确切位置的任何信息。宁芙可以像使用个人通讯单元一样向星舰发送信息。

items.name: 小行星依存
items.expectedDescription: A sterieid is mystically bonded to a small asteroid, no more than 1 mile across. If they're away from their bonded asteroid for more than 24 hours, they become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} and must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:21] save each additional 24 hours or increase their drained value by 1. A sterieid can perform a 24-hour ritual to bond themself to a new asteroid.
items.description: 星岩仙女与一颗直径不超过1里的小行星以神秘的方式绑定。如果离开绑定的小行星超过24小时，它便陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失1}，此后每过24小时都必须成功通过@Check[fortitude|dc:21]豁免，否则流失值增加1。星岩仙女可以举行一个24小时的仪式，将自己与一颗新的小行星绑定。

items.name: 碎岩场域
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger The sterieid takes physical damage

Effect Shards of rocky debris fly off the sterieid's body, dealing @Damage[2d12[bludgeoning]] damage to all adjacent creatures (@Check[reflex|dc:21|basic] save) and giving the sterieid the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition until the end of their next turn.
items.description:
触发星岩仙女受到物理伤害

效果岩石碎片从星岩仙女的身体上飞射而出，对所有相邻生物造成@Damage[2d12[bludgeoning]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:21|basic]豁免），并使星岩仙女陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}状态，直到其下个回合结束。

items.name: 冰冷灵气
items.expectedDescription: 10 feet. A sterieid's body radiates an icy chill. Creatures entering or starting their turns in the aura take @Damage[2d6[cold]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:21|basic] save); a creature that critically fails its save is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} until the start of its next turn as it grows sluggish from the cold.
items.description: 10尺。星岩仙女的身体散发冰寒。进入此灵光或在其中开始回合的生物受到@Damage[2d6[cold]]伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:21|basic]豁免）；豁免大失败的生物还会因寒冷而变得迟钝，陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙1}，直到该生物的下个回合开始。

items.name: 松鼠狐诡计
items.expectedDescription: A squox can [[/act disarm skill=acrobatics]] and [[/act trip skill=acrobatics]] creatures with its tail using Acrobatics instead of Athletics, even if it doesn't have a free hand. A squox can attempt to Disarm or Trip @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures up to two sizes larger than it and gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Disarm or Trip an off-guard target
items.description: 松鼠狐可以用尾巴对生物[[/act disarm skill=acrobatics]]和[[/act trip skill=acrobatics]]，以特技代替运动，即便没有空手也可以如此。松鼠狐可以尝试对比自己至多大两个体型的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}生物卸武或摔绊，且对措手不及目标卸武或摔绊时获得+2环境加值

ONe5XNvapxGSRlnP.publicNotes:
小巧的沃卡里基是协约世界的一种常见动物，源自卡斯卓韦。失落的格拉利昂的人类探险家给它们起了个名字叫松鼠狐，因为他们认为这种动物是狐狸和松鼠的混合体。它们狡猾到了奸诈的地步，经常采用吓唬的手段，带着旅行中发现的闪亮物品潜逃。它们表现出复杂的社会行为，包括狐群中个体之间有明显的等级差异，并且能发出丰富的声音，能让不同的松鼠狐个体有各自标志性的声音。

松鼠狐早已从协约世界出口到了整个星系，近宇的许多文明中，这些毛茸茸的小动物群体不断增长，这让异星卫士越来越感到不安，他们担心适应能力极强的松鼠狐已经成为一些生物群落中的入侵物种。虽然有些人主张扑杀这些种群中的个体，但这种动物作为宠物的受欢迎程度使得这种做法非常不受欢迎。

年幼的松鼠狐被称为狐崽（kits），可以在大多数协约世界的公开市场上买到。松鼠狐的寿命大约为10年。典型的松鼠狐重约10磅，身长约3尺，其中尾巴占了大部分长度。松鼠狐有各种颜色，许多松鼠狐甚至会适应特定的气候环境，例如居住在沙漠中的松鼠狐会长出更长的耳朵来帮助散热。

items.name: 呼召宇宙
items.expectedDescription:
You reach into the void and call down a vertical column of dangerous cosmic material that rains destruction upon creatures in the area and shrouds the terrain around it in a swirl of stardust. This matter is made up of bits of burning stars and chunks of frozen comets, and it deals 5d12 cold damage and 5d12 fire damage to every creature in the area when you Cast the Spell. For the spell's duration, the cosmic material reduces visibility and mobility, making the area greater difficult terrain and making everything seen within or through the area @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Heightened (10th) The cold and fire damage each increase by 2d12.
items.description:
你探入虚空并召来一片危险的宇宙物质，其在一个垂直圆柱内摧毁其中生物，并将地形化为星尘漩涡。这种物质由燃烧的恒星或冰冻的彗星组成，对施法时区域内的所有生物造成5d12火焰伤害和5d12寒冷伤害。在法术持续期间内，宇宙物质降低了能见度和机动性，使该区域内变为高等困难地形并且让该区域内或者透过其的所有事物获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]。

升阶（10环）寒冷伤害和火焰伤害各增加2d12。

items.name: 噬星爆发
items.expectedDescription:
A globe of freezing darkness explodes in the area, dealing 8d10 cold damage to creatures in the area, plus an additional 8d4 void damage to living creatures. Each creature in the area must attempt a Reflex save.

If the globe overlaps with an area of magical light or affects a creature affected by magical light, eclipse burst attempts to counteract the light effect.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} by the darkness for an unlimited duration.

Heightened (+1) The cold damage increases by 1d10 and the void damage against the living increases by 1d4.
items.description:
一颗冰寒的黑暗球体在区域中爆发，对区域内生物造成8d10寒冷伤害，并对活物额外造成8d4虚能伤害。区域中的每个生物都必须尝试反射豁免。

若球体与魔法光照区域重叠，或影响到正受到魔法光照影响的生物，噬星爆发会尝试反制该光照效果。

大成功 生物不受影响。

成功 生物受到一半伤害。

失败 该生物承受完整伤害。

大失败 生物受到双倍伤害，并因黑暗而陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲}，持续时间无限。

升阶（+1） 寒冷伤害增加1d10，对活物的虚能伤害增加1d4。

items.name: 阳炎爆
items.expectedDescription:
A powerful globe of searing sunlight explodes in the area, dealing 8d10 fire damage to all creatures in the area, plus an additional @Damage[(@item.level+1)d10[vitality]] damage to undead creatures. Each creature in the area must attempt a Reflex save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes full damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} permanently.

If the globe overlaps with an area of magical darkness, sunburst attempts to counteract the darkness effect.

Heightened (+1) The fire damage increases by 1d10, and the vitality damage against undead increases by 1d10.
items.description:
强力而耀眼的球状日光在区域中爆开，对该区域中的生物造成8d10火焰伤害，以及对不死生物造成额外@Damage[(@item.level+1)d10[vitality]]伤害。在该区域中的每个生物必须尝试一次反射豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物承受一半伤害。

失败 该生物承受完整伤害。

大失败 该生物承受完整伤害，并且永久 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲} 。

如果阳炎爆的球状区域与魔法黑暗的区域部分重叠，则会尝试反制该黑暗效果。

升阶（+1） 该火焰伤害增加1d10，并且对不死生物的命能伤害增加1d10。

items.name: 短讯术
items.expectedDescription: You send the creature a mental message of 25 words or fewer, and it can respond immediately with its own message of 25 words or fewer.
items.description: 你向该生物发送一段25词或者更短的精神信息，它可以立即以自己的一段不超过25词的信息回应。

items.name: 实言术（恒定）
items.expectedDescription:
The target can understand all words regardless of language and also speak the languages of other creatures. When in a mixed group of creatures, each time the target speaks, it can choose a creature and speak in a language that creature understands, even if the target doesn't know what language that is.

Heightened (7th) The duration is 8 hours.
items.description:
无论什么语言，目标都可以理解其所有的词语，也能说其他生物的语言。当处于一群各异的生物中时，每次目标说话时，都可以选择一个生物，并使用一种该生物理解的语言来讲述，即使该目标不知道这语言具体是什么。

升阶（7环） 持续时间为8小时。

items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature within range enters an environment that would be harmful to it.

A shimmering bubble envelops the target's body, allowing it to breathe normally in a vacuum or other unsafe environment and protecting it from severe temperatures and radiation.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 5 additional creatures to gain protection against the environment the triggering creature entered. The spell lasts for 8 hours and also protects against extreme temperatures and radiation.

Heightened (10th) You can target up to 10 additional creatures to gain protection against the environment the triggering creature entered. The spell lasts until your next daily preparations and also protects against incredible temperatures and radiation.
items.description:

items.expectedDescription:
The cosmic dragon is always attuned to an underlying stellar force: either photons or gravitons. They can swap attunement as a free action once at the start of their turn in combat and is otherwise attuned to whichever force they choose at any time outside of combat. OoUAqUCjtAbnvuUq.publicNotes:
古宾（gubbin）——也被称作数据小魔怪——由损坏数据自发生成，尤其常见于人工智能程序错误引发的情况。虽然数据小魔怪本身并不强大，但他们的身体会以闪烁跳跃的方式在空间中移动，仿佛与外界存在微妙时差，这种特性使其极难被击中。数据小魔怪最显著的特征是其手指数量瞬息万变，且会从手背、手掌等不合常理的位置突生。尽管精细动作能力欠缺，但他们扭曲的手掌在移动时极具视觉冲击力，这种效果恰是它们乐于利用的优势。

由于被武器化用于企业间谍活动并随后失控繁殖，数据小魔怪成为高度计算机化星球上最普遍的小魔怪种类之一。虽然不如其他小魔怪邪恶，但数据小魔怪乐于永久性破坏计算机数据，既为自娱自乐，也为制造更多同类。数据小魔怪常出没于海量数据存储区域，其活动区域往往伴随着受污染的科技构装体，例如硬光生命体或机器人。

早在大断层之前很久，小魔怪便以残忍的诡计肆虐物质宇宙，如今它们已完全适应了科技充斥的星系。无论是扰乱通讯装置，星舰，还是整座空间站，小魔怪都乐此不疲地制造毁灭与混乱。

OqK4lJNzovCKDAAF.name: 七芒星卫队特种兵 Sihedron Guard Specialist
OqK4lJNzovCKDAAF.publicNotes: 尽管所有万古卫队都宣誓效忠于万古王座，七芒星守卫特种兵却自幼被培养成对璃殇——以及她的大祭司伊什梅莱·奥菲尔——绝对虔诚的战士。他们的信仰如此纯粹，以至于每年首次死亡时，一道耀眼的绿色闪电会在他们头顶凝聚成七芒星法印，阻止死亡降临，使他们得以继续以璃殇之名奋战。这份恩赐究竟来自大祭司伊什梅莱，还是璃殇本人的直接馈赠，无人知晓，但也没有人胆敢质疑七芒星卫队特种兵的忠诚与致命战技。

你以一波敌意威慑敌人。目标受到7d8非致命心灵伤害，并且必须尝试意志豁免。随后，心灵能量会跃向初始目标30尺内的另一个生物，再跳向该生物30尺内的另一个生物，以此类推。你可以在任何时候终止波动。你不能以同一生物为目标超过一次，并且必须对所有目标都具有效果线。只掷一次伤害骰，再将伤害应用于每个目标（根据其豁免结果适当地减半或翻倍）。

大成功 目标生物不受影响，且波动在该目标处终止。

成功 目标受到一半伤害。

失败 目标受到全部伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧1}。

大失败 目标受到双倍伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧2}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加2d8。

items.name: 法术解除结界
items.expectedDescription:
You create an immobile globe around yourself that attempts to counteract any spell from outside the globe whose area or targets enter into the globe, as if the globe were a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} spell 1 rank lower than its actual spell rank.

If the counteract attempt succeeds, it prevents only the portion of the spell that would have entered the globe (so if the spell also has targets outside the globe, or part of its area is beyond the globe, those targets or that area is affected normally).

You must form the sphere in an unbroken open space, so its edges don't pass through any creatures or objects, or the spell is lost (though creatures can enter the globe after the spell is cast).
items.description:
你创造一个围绕自身的不可动的法球。它会尝试反制任何来自外界的，区域或者目标在球体内的法术，视球体为比其实际法术环阶低1级的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{解除魔法}法术。

如果该反制尝试成功，它只会阻止进入球体的那一部分法术（所以如果该法术目标也有一些在球体外面，或者其区域超过球体区域，这些目标或者区域如常受到影响）。

你必须在一个连续开放空间中创造该球体，所以其边界无法穿过任何生物或者物体，否则你会失去该法术（尽管生物可以在法术施放后进入球体）。

items.name: 神圣狂怒
items.expectedDescription:
You channel the fury of divinity against your foes. You deal 4d10 spirit damage to enemies in the area, depending on their Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}; while it's sickened, it's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10.
items.description:
你引导你的神祇的怒火攻击你的敌人。你对区域内敌人造成4d10精魂伤害，基于它们的强韧豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物承受一半伤害。

失败 该生物承受完整伤害，并且@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}。

大失败 该生物承受全部伤害，并且@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 2}；当其恶心时，也会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 1}。

升阶（+1） 该伤害增加1d10。

items.name: 岁月重担
items.expectedDescription:
You burden a creature's body and mind with the pains and sorrows of a lifetime. The target takes 3d8 bludgeoning damage and 3d8 mental damage and must attempt a Will saving throw.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]{Encumbered} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage and is encumbered for 1 minute.

Heightened (+1) The mental damage increases by 2d8.
items.description:
你将目标毕生的苦痛与哀伤化作沉重枷锁，压垮目标的身心。尝试一次远程法术攻击骰。目标受到3d8钝击伤害和3d8心灵，并且必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功目标不受影响。

成功目标受到一半伤害。

失败目标受到全伤害并且@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]1轮。

大失败目标受到全伤害并且超载1分钟。

升阶（+1）心灵伤害增加2d8

items.name: 分析目标
items.expectedDescription:
You focus on the target, gathering data as magical holograms display information. When the casting is complete, you learn biometric information about the target, including its fingerprints, medical conditions, and other basic physiological information. You or anyone you advise about the analysis gains a +1 status bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} the creature, to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} on the creature, and to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about it. If the target is illusory or under the effects of illusion magic, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your analyze target spell.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

Heightened (3rd) The status bonus increases to +2, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Heightened (6th) The status bonus increases to +3, and you can target any number of creatures.
items.description:
你专注在目标身上，收集数据并以魔法全息图像显示。当施法完成，你会获得目标的所有生物特征信息，包括指纹、医疗状况和其他基本生理信息。你或任何得到你基于分析建议的人，在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]为该生物、对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]、以及对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]的检定上获得+1状态加值。如果目标是幻觉或者处于幻术魔法效果下，仅当效果的环级低于你分析目标的法术环级，你才能够探测到结果。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

升阶（3环）状态加值提升到+2，并且你可以至多10名生物作为目标。

升阶（6环）状态加值提升到+3，并且你可以任意名生物作为目标。

items.name: 侦测魔法
items.expectedDescription:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).
items.description:
你发出一股标记魔法存在的脉冲。你不会获得魔法存在或不存在以外的任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你或者你盟友的魔法物品以及持续法术。仅当幻术魔法的环阶低于你的侦测魔法环阶时，你才能侦测幻术魔法。但是，具有幻术灵光但是没有在外表上做伪装的物品（例如一瓶隐形药水），通常能够正常侦测。

升阶（3环阶） 你能知晓法术侦测出的最强魔法效果的环阶或等级，具体由GM决定。

升阶（4环阶） 如3环阶，你也能指出最高环阶魔法的来源。如同一种模糊感官，你不会了解具体的位置，但是可以将来源锁定到5尺立方（或者最近的那个五尺立方，如果来源体积比这个区域更大）。

items.name: 圣枪术
items.expectedDescription:
You unleash a beam of divine energy. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, the target takes 2d4 spirit damage (double damage on a critical hit).

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.
items.description:
你施放一道神圣能量的射线。对目标尝试一次远程法术攻击，对抗目标的AC。命中时，该目标承受2d4精魂伤害（在重击时造成双倍伤害）。

升阶（+1） 该伤害增加1d4。

items.name: 重填武器
items.expectedDescription:
You touch a weapon with no remaining ammunition and recharge it with magical energy. The target gains ammunition or charges equal to its expend until the end of your next turn, allowing anyone holding the target to make one Strike with the weapon. This spell only recharges weapons that use ammunition with a cost of 10 credits or less.

Heightened (3rd) The target gains ammunition or charges equal to double its expend.

Heightened (6th) The target gains ammunition or charges equal to triple its expend.

Heightened (9th) The target gains ammunition or charges equal to quadruple its expend.
items.description:
你触碰一件没有剩余弹药的武器，用魔法能量为其充能。直到你的下一回合结束时，目标会获得与其“耗弹”相等的弹药或充能，并允许任何持有目标的人使用该武器进行一次打击。该法术只能为使用弹药且弹药价格不超过10个信用点的武器充能。

升阶（3环）目标获得的弹药或充能数量等于其消耗量的两倍。

升阶（6环）目标获得的弹药或充能数量等于其消耗量的三倍。

升阶（9环）目标获得的弹药或充能数量等于其消耗量的四倍。

items.name: 魔法印记
items.expectedDescription:
You harmlessly place your unique magical sigil, which is about 1 square inch in size, on the targeted creature or object. The mark can be visible or invisible, and you can change it from one state to another by using an Interact action to touch the target. The mark can be scrubbed or scraped off with 5 minutes of work. If it's on a creature, it fades naturally over the course of a week. The time before the mark fades increases depending on your heightened rank.

Heightened (3rd) The sigil instead fades after 1 month.

Heightened (5th) The sigil instead fades after 1 year.

Heightened (7th) The sigil never fades.
items.description:
你无害地在目标生物或者物体上设置你独有的魔法印记，它有1平方英寸大。该印记可以是可见的或者隐形的，并且你可以使用一个交互动作，接触该目标来令其从隐形转化为可见或从可见转化为隐形。该印记可以通过花费5分钟时间刷洗或者刮擦来除去。如果印记位于一个生物上，它会经过一周自然消去。该印记自然消去前的时间根据你升阶到的环阶而改变。

升阶（3环） 该印记在一个月后自然消去。

升阶（5环） 该印记在1年后自然消去。

升阶（7环） 该印记永不消去。

这把流线型激光步枪是阿兹兰特星际帝国（Azlanti Star Empire）的常备武器，内置一个插槽，供嵌入 万古石 ，以增强并聚焦光束的强度。

items.name: 抬升万古石
items.expectedDescription:
Staple items within the Azlanti Star Empire, these gemstones are popular status symbols for adventurers and wealthy collectors. Despite their myriad forms and functions, these stones are purportedly all fragments of crystal tools used by otherworldly entities to build the Universe in ancient times.

When you invest one of these precisely shaped crystals, the stone orbits your head (or another visible part of your anatomy if you don't have a head) instead of being worn on your body. You can stow an aeon stone with an Interact action, and an orbiting stone can be snatched out of the air with a successful @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} action against you. A stowed or removed stone remains invested, but its effects are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF] until you return it to orbit your head again.

There are various types of aeon stones, each with a different appearance and magical effect. Each aeon stone also gains a resonant power when slotted into specific items, such as weapons with the aeon trait or antique magical devices called wayfinders.

This deep-blue prism with cloudy inclusions is light as a feather. Its resonant power gives you a +1 item bonus to Acrobatics checks.

Activate—Fly Free 1 (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You gain a fly Speed for 1 minute equal to your Speed or 20 feet, whichever is greater.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment-effects.Item.xZ5XMY55S42aGyjg]

这些宝石是阿兹兰特星际帝国（Azlanti Star Empire）的常见物品，也是冒险者和富裕收藏家青睐的身份象征。尽管外形和功能多种多样，据说这些石头全都是异界存在在远古时代建造物质宇宙（Universe）时使用的水晶工具的碎片。

当你绑定其中一颗精确切割的水晶时，石头不会戴在身上，而会环绕头部运转（若你没有头部，则环绕身体另一处可见部位）。你可以收起一颗 万古石 ，使用一个交互动作；正在环绕的石头也能被从空中夺走，只需成功进行一次 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{卸武} 动作，以你为目标。收起或取下的石头仍保持绑定，但其效果 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF] ，直到你让它再次环绕头部。

有多种类型的 万古石，每种都有不同外观和魔法效果。每个 万古石 插入特定物品后还会获得共鸣能力，例如具有万古特征的武器，或名为以下名称的古老魔法装置： 寻路石.

这块含有云雾状杂质的深蓝色棱柱轻如羽毛。其共鸣能力为你的特技检定提供+1物品加值。

items.expectedDescription:
You ignite a sudden spark of electricity that surges into a technological creature or object. You de-energize an item with the tech trait or disrupt a creature with the tech trait, with effects based on the target being a creature or object.

  • Creature If your target is a creature with the tech trait, it attempts a Will save. On a failure, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 1}; on a critical failure, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 2}.
  • Object If you target an attended object, the creature with the object attempts a Will save. On a success, the object loses half of its maximum charges. On a failure, or if you target an unattended object, the object loses all its remaining charges.
items.description:
你骤然点燃一道电火花，令其涌入一个科技生物或物体。你使具有科技特征的物品失去能量，或扰乱具有科技特征的生物，效果取决于目标是生物还是物体。

  • 生物 若目标是具有科技特征的生物，其进行意志豁免。失败时，该生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{故障1}；大失败时，该生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{故障2}。
  • 物体 若你以有人持有的物体为目标，持有它的生物进行意志豁免。成功时，物体失去相当于其最大充能数一半的充能。失败时，或你以无人持有的物体为目标时，物体失去全部剩余充能。

items.name: 回避帷幕
items.expectedDescription: You erect protective wards that make the target difficult to detect via magic. Veil of privacy attempts to counteract all detection, revelation, and scrying effects used against the target or the target's gear throughout the duration, counting cantrips as 1st-rank spells for this purpose. Successfully counteracting a spell that targets an area or multiple targets negates the effects for only veil of privacy's target.
items.description: 你创造防护结界，令目标难以被魔法侦测。在持续时间内，回避帷幕会尝试反制所有对目标和目标装备的侦测，揭示，以及探知效果。此处戏法视为1环阶法术。成功反制以区域为目标或者具有数个目标的法术时，仅取消对回避帷幕目标的效果。

items.name: 幻象生物
items.expectedDescription:
You create an illusory image of a Large or smaller creature. It generates the appropriate sounds, smells, and feels believable to the touch. If you and the image are ever farther than 500 feet apart, the spell ends.

The image can't speak, but you can use your actions to speak through the creature, with the spell disguising your voice as appropriate. You might need to attempt a Deception or Performance check to mimic the creature, as determined by the GM. This is especially likely if you're trying to imitate a specific person and engage with someone that person knows.

In combat, the illusion can use 2 actions per turn, which it uses when you Sustain the spell. It uses your spell attack modifier for attack rolls and your spell DC for its AC. Its saving throw modifiers are equal to your spell DC – 10. It is substantial enough that it can flank other creatures. If the image is hit by an attack or fails a save, the spell ends.

The illusion can cause damage by making the target believe the illusion's attacks are real, but it cannot otherwise directly affect the physical world. If the illusory creature hits with a Strike, the target takes @Damage[3d4[mental]] damage. The illusion's Strikes are nonlethal. If the damage doesn't correspond to the image of the monster—for example, if an illusory Large dragon deals only 5 damage—the GM might allow the target to attempt an immediate Perception check to disbelieve the spell. Any relevant resistances and weaknesses apply if the target thinks they do, as judged by the GM. For example, if the illusion wields a warhammer and attacks a creature resistant to bludgeoning damage, the creature would take less mental damage. However, illusory damage does not deactivate regeneration or trigger other effects that require a certain damage type. The GM should track illusory damage dealt by the illusion.

Any creature that touches the image or uses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to examine it can attempt to disbelieve your illusion. When a creature disbelieves the illusion, it recovers from half the damage it had taken from it (if any) and doesn't take any further damage from it.

Heightened (+1) The damage of the image's Strikes increases by 1d4, and the maximum size of creature you can create increases by one (to a maximum of Gargantuan).
items.description:
你创造一个大型或者更小的生物的幻象。它发出适当的声音，气味，触摸起来也非常可信。如果你和幻象相距超过500尺，法术结束。

幻象不能说话，但是你可以使用你的动作来通过该生物说话，法术会适当地掩饰你的声音。你可能要尝试欺骗或者表演检定来模仿该生物，由GM决定。如果你想表现一个特定的人，并与一个知晓该人的人交互时，很可能会如此。

在战斗中，该幻象每回合能使用2动作，它在你维持该法术时使用这些动作。其攻击掷骰使用你的法术攻击调整值，AC使用你的法术DC。其豁免调整值等于你的法术DC-10。它足够结实，以至于可以夹击其他生物。如果幻象被攻击命中，或者在豁免中失败，法术结束。

该幻术可以通过令目标相信其攻击真实存在来造成伤害，但它不能直接影响现实世界。如果幻象生物的打击命中，目标承受@Damage[3d4[mental]]伤害。幻象的打击是非致命的。如果伤害与怪物的幻象不对应——举例而言，如果一条幻象大型龙只造成了5点伤害——GM可以允许目标立即进行一次察觉检定以识破法术。只要目标认为能，任何有关的抗力和弱点都会生效，这由GM判定。举例而言，如果幻影持用一把战锤，攻击一个具有钝击抗力的生物，该生物承受的心灵伤害会变少。但是，幻觉伤害不会抑制再生，或者触发其他需要特定伤害类型的能力。GM应当记录幻像造成的幻觉伤害。

当生物触摸幻像，或者使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{搜索}动作来检查它时，该生物可以尝试识破你的幻术。当生物识破幻术时，它回复从该幻术承受的伤害的一半（如果有），并且不会再因该幻术而承受伤害。

升阶（+1） 幻像的打击伤害增加1d4，你可以创造的生物最大体型增大一级（最大为巨型）。

items.name: 魅惑术
items.expectedDescription:
To the target, your words are honey and your visage seems bathed in a dreamy haze. It must attempt a Will save, with a +4 circumstance bonus if you or your allies recently threatened it or used hostile actions against it.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you use hostile actions against the target, the spell ends. When the spell ends, the target doesn't necessarily realize it was charmed unless its friendship with you or the actions you convinced it to take clash with its expectations, meaning you could potentially convince the target to continue being your friend via mundane means.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and aware you tried to charm it.

Success The target is unaffected but thinks your spell was something harmless instead of charm, unless it identifies the spell.

Failure The target's attitude becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v66R7FdOf11l94im]{Friendly} toward you. If it was Friendly, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v44P3WUcU1j0115l]{Helpful}. It can't use hostile actions against you.

Critical Failure The target's attitude becomes Helpful toward you, and it can't use hostile actions against you.

Heightened (4th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations.

Heightened (8th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations, and you can target up to 10 creatures.
items.description:
在目标看来，你的言语甜蜜动听，你的形象笼罩在梦幻般的光晕中。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免，如果你或者你的盟友最近威胁它或者对它进行了敌对行为，会获得+4环境加值。

你可以解消该法术。如果你对目标使用任何敌对动作，法术终止。当该法术结束时，目标不一定会意识到自己被魅惑了，除非它和你的友好关系，或者你说服它去做的事情与其期望发生冲突。这也即是说你可以通过常规的方法说服目标继续作为你的朋友。

大成功 目标不受影响，并且意识到你尝试魅惑它。

成功 该目标不受影响，但是认为你的法术是某种无害的东西，而不是魅惑术，除非它能识别该法术。

失败 目标对你的态度变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v66R7FdOf11l94im]{友善}。如果已经是友善，则变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v44P3WUcU1j0115l]{乐于帮助}。它不能对你做出敌对行为。

大失败 目标变为乐于帮助并且不能对你做出敌对行为。

升阶（4环） 法术持续至你下次进行每日准备。

升阶（8环） 法术持续至你下次进行每日准备，并且你能以至多10个生物作为目标。

items.name: 物品幻影（随意）
items.expectedDescription:
You create an illusory visual image of a stationary object. The entire image must fit within the spell's area. The object appears to animate naturally, but it doesn't make sounds or generate smells. For example, water would appear to pour down an illusory waterfall, but it would be silent.

Any creature that touches the image or uses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to examine it can attempt to disbelieve your illusion.

Heightened (2nd) Your image makes appropriate sounds, generates normal smells, and feels right to the touch. The spell gains the auditory and olfactory traits. The duration increases to 1 hour.

Heightened (5th) As the 2nd-rank version, but the duration is unlimited.
items.description:
你创造一个固定物体的视觉幻象。该幻象必须能完全处于法术区域中。该物体会自然活动，但是不会发出声音或者产生气味。举例而言，幻象瀑布中会出现水并流下，但是它会是安静的。

当生物触摸幻像，或者使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{搜索}动作来检查它时，该生物可以尝试识破你的幻术。

升阶（2环） 你的幻象也会发出合适的声音，产生正常气味，并且摸起来也很正常。该法术获得听觉和嗅觉特征。持续时间增加到1小时。

升阶（5环） 如2环阶，但是持续时间为无限。

items.name: 尾迹骑手
items.expectedDescription: By touching a starship, an asteray can bond to the energy wake it leaves as it travels. The asteray can match speeds with the starship and ride along with it, treating the ship as if it were the "ground" so long as they remain within 100 feet. If the starship enters the Drift, the asteray can choose to accompany it into the Drift, or they can disengage as a reaction and remain behind.
items.description: 通过触碰星舰（starship），漂泊精可以与其在航行时留下的能量尾迹结合。只要它与星舰保持在100尺内，它就能与星舰匹配速度并跟随它，就如同将星舰视为“地面”一样。如果星舰进入漂流域，漂泊精可以选择随之进入，或者可以反应动作脱离并留在原地。

items.name: 物质吞噬
items.expectedDescription: The asteray opens their mouth to suck in the molecules of an adjacent organic creature or object of Small size or larger. If the target is an object (including a corpse), then the asteray regains @Damage[30[healing]] Hit Points and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} 1 for the next minute, and they can use the extra action only to Climb, Fly, or Stride. If the target is a creature, then the target takes @Damage[10d8[void]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:32|basic] save).
items.description: 漂泊精张开嘴，吸取一个与其相邻的小型或更大的有机生物或物体的分子。若目标是物体（包括尸体），漂泊精恢复@Damage[30[healing]]生命值，且在接下来一分钟内变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{迅捷}1，额外动作只能用于攀爬、飞行或行走。若目标是生物，目标受到@Damage[10d8[void]]伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:32|basic]豁免）。

items.name: 传感器之歌
items.expectedDescription: An asteray can "sing" electronic signals that mask or mimic sensor readings. The asteray creates a false image of an object, as a 5th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2oH5IufzdESuYxat]{Illusory Object} spell. This false reading affects only electronic sensors, but creatures hear odd echoes in the area so long as the effect persists. Multiple asterays can sing together, doubling the range and area of illusory object for each asteray casting the spell in sync.
items.description: 漂泊精可以“唱出”电子信号，以掩盖或模拟传感器读数。漂泊精创造一个物体的虚假图像，效果如同施放5环@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2oH5IufzdESuYxat]。这种虚假读数仅影响电子传感器（electronic sensors），但只要效果持续，生物会在区域内听到奇怪的回声。多个漂泊精可以协同歌唱，每个同时施法的漂泊精可以使幻象造物的射程和区域翻倍。

PM4Wbh43aKoCRbns.publicNotes:
被认为只是喜爱恶作剧的捣蛋鬼，漂泊精实际上是出生在大虚空与第一世界重叠处的精类。它们天生具有在太空中生存的能力，漂泊精受极度的流浪癖困扰，并有着强烈的驱散无聊的欲望。对大多数漂泊精而言，渴望娱乐是他们的主要动机。他们被各种有趣的星际现象所吸引，从气态巨行星中的漩涡到小行星带中星际碎片的相互作用。漂浮在太空中的漂泊精靠着摄取潜在的宇宙辐射来获取足够的生存养分。然而，漂泊精仍有一种简单的营养需求，这使得他们成为星际航道上的恐怖存在：有机物。由于太空中几乎没有可供消耗的有机物，漂泊精会尾随星舰，往往依靠在它们的尾迹中漂浮，并不断折磨船员，直到他们抛弃岗位或陷入疯狂。一旦漂泊精足够使船员绝望，他们就会进入船只并吞噬倒下者的尸体。

幸运的是——或者对旅行者来说并非如此，漂泊精通常觉得食用活体生物令人反感，尽管他们异于常物的思维使他们在战斗中受到威胁时会对活跃的敌人使用这种吞噬物质的空无之能。大多数漂泊精会漂浮在废弃船只的残骸中休眠数月甚至数年，直到一艘路过的船只引发的宇宙涟漪将他们从沉睡中唤醒。

PTZUgeuTohqB1dNm.name: 鞭尾掠吼龙 Whiptail Renkroda
PTZUgeuTohqB1dNm.publicNotes:
鞭尾掠吼龙栖息在山坡和岩石丘陵地带，在黑暗的洞穴和岩石峭壁中筑巢。它们凭借强有力的翅膀翱翔于天空，并用它们那长长的、像鞭子一样可以缠绕住猎物的尾巴发动攻击。许多不幸的旅行者都曾被鞭尾掠吼龙的尾巴抽打，被高高卷起，然后摔死。

掠吼龙是一种大型恐龙状掠食者，原产于行星卡斯卓韦。由于走私者、偷猎者以及猎捕大型动物的巨富们的活动，它们已经扩散到丛林星球之外。掠吼龙是两足动物，身体强壮，拥有长脖子和装饰性的棘刺，它们最著名的是其可怕的吼声，它们经常大声吼叫，作为一种远程通讯的方式，并用来吓跑其他掠食者和食腐动物。掠吼龙存在超过十二种不同的物种，每一种都特别适应它们的环境或生态位。

items.name: 抽动之尾
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature within reach of the whiptail renkroda's tail uses a move action or leaves a square during a move action it's using

Effect The whiptail renkroda Strikes the target with its tail. If it hits, the whiptail renkroda disrupts the creature's action.
items.description:
触发 鞭尾掠吼龙尾部触及范围内的一个生物使用移动动作，或在使用移动动作时离开一个方格

效果 鞭尾掠吼龙用尾部打击该目标。命中时，鞭尾掠吼龙打断该生物的动作。

items.name: 空中掠食者
items.expectedDescription: When a whiptail renkroda has a Medium or smaller creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, its Grab doesn't end if it moves away. Instead, when it moves, it carries the grabbed creature with it.
items.description: 当鞭尾掠吼龙使一个中型或更小体型@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]时，它的擒获不会因为移动而结束。相反，当它移动时，它携带受擒生物一起移动。

items.name: 猛掷
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements A creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} in the whiptail renkroda's tail

Effect The whiptail renkroda flings the creature through the air, launching the creature up to 10 feet up from its tail and 30 feet away. The creature takes falling damage accordingly. If the flung creature lands on another creature, the creature it lands on takes the same amount of bludgeoning damage (@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic] save).
items.description:
需求 一个生物被鞭尾掠吼龙的尾巴@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{受擒}

效果 鞭尾掠吼龙将该生物抛向空中，从其尾部向上抛起至多10尺，并抛出30尺远。该生物受到相应的坠落伤害。若被抛出的生物落在另一个生物身上，被砸中的生物受到等量的钝击伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic]豁免）。

items.name: 恐惧咆哮
items.expectedDescription:
The whiptail renkroda bellows ferociously. Each non-renkroda creature within 60 feet must attempt a @Check[will|dc:29] save. The creature is then temporarily immune for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}.
items.description:
鞭尾掠吼龙发出凶猛咆哮。60尺内每个非掠吼龙生物必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:29]豁免。该生物随后临时免疫，持续10分钟。

大成功 生物不受影响。

成功 生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧1}。

失败 生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧2}。

大失败 生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧3}。

PUjO7U4Dc1ruDLcL.name: 流浆领主 Ichor Lord
PUjO7U4Dc1ruDLcL.publicNotes:
奥罗科兰流浆领主被新诞者所祝福——流浆在他们的血管中奔涌，而他们能召唤出短暂的流浆泉。多数领主聚集绝望的奥罗科兰人于身边，通过控制流浆供应来支配同族。

奥罗科兰人原生于现已毁灭的行星奥克腾，是污秽绝望的生物。他们在太空中漂泊流离，渴望着再度吞噬新诞者的神性精粹，或是它孕育时所栖身的子宫碎片。他们性情暴躁，嗜好暴力，且饱受折磨。

尽管部分奥罗科兰人已挣脱毒瘾桎梏，重获心智清明与自我意识，本文所述的奥罗科兰人仍依赖奥克腾的诡秘液体。

items.name: 阅读机运
items.expectedDescription: You peek into the future. Choose a particular goal or activity you plan to engage in within 1 week, or an event you expect might happen within 1 week. You learn a cryptic clue or piece of advice that could help with the chosen event, often in the form of a rhyme or omen.
items.description: 你窥视未来。选择你计划在1周内着手的特定目标或活动，或你预期可能在1周内发生的一件事件。你会获得一段晦涩的线索或者建议，它通常是诗歌或者预言，并可能在所选事件中帮助你。

items.name: 熵击
items.expectedDescription:
You unleash a ray of entropy that rapidly and indiscriminately decays matter. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, the target takes 5d8 void damage, or it takes 2d6 persistent acid damage and is glitching 1 if it has the tech trait. On a critical hit, double the damage, and if the creature has the tech trait, it's glitching 2 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1 die.
items.description:
你释放一道熵射线，迅速且不加区分地使物质衰败。对目标的AC进行一次远程法术攻击。命中时，目标受到5d8虚能伤害；若目标具有科技特征，则改为受到2d6持续酸蚀伤害，并陷入故障1。重击时，伤害翻倍；若该生物具有科技特征，则还会陷入故障2和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑1}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1个伤害骰。

items.name: 私人重力
items.expectedDescription: You alter gravity's effects on you. You treat gravity as if it were your choice of one step higher or lower (for example, if you were in an area of low gravity, you could choose either standard gravity or zero-g). While the spell is active, you reduce the distance of any forced movement that would affect you by 5 feet (minimum 0 feet), and you ignore being clumsy and untethered because of gravity effects on you. You can Dismiss the spell.
items.description: 你改变重力对自身的影响。你将重力视为比实际情况高或低一个等级，由你选择（例如，若你位于低重力区域，可以选择标准重力或零重力）。法术生效期间，任何作用于你的强制移动距离减少5尺（最低0尺），且你忽略重力对你造成的笨拙和失重。你可以解消此法术。

items.name: 分担痛苦
items.expectedDescription:
You telepathically share the sensation of agonizing pain with a creature. The target takes 3d12 mental damage and attempts a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} for 1 minute.

Heightened (6th) The spell targets up to four creatures and deals 6d12 mental damage.
items.description:
你以心灵感应向一个生物分享剧痛的感受。目标受到3d12心灵伤害，并尝试意志豁免。

大成功 生物不受影响。

成功 生物受到一半伤害。

失败 生物受到全部伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙1}，持续1分钟。

大失败 生物受到全部伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙2}，持续1分钟。

升阶（6环） 法术至多以四个生物为目标，并造成6d12心灵伤害。

items.name: 虚空低语
items.expectedDescription:
The target hears ominous sounds containing unspeakable mysteries from beyond the stars that disorient its mind. The target attempts a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The target hears the strange whispers, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target begins to wander aimlessly, using each action to Step in a random direction. When it moves, the target takes the safest route and doesn't enter hazardous terrain. The spell has a duration of 1 minute or until a creature uses a hostile action against the target.

Critical Failure As failure, except the target babbles incoherently. Any creature that begins its turn within 20 feet of the target must attempt a Will saving throw. On a failure, it must use its first action on its next turn to Step in a random direction and becomes immune to this spell for 24 hours. This is an incapacitation effect.
items.description:
目标听见来自群星之外的不祥声响，其中蕴含不可言说的奥秘，令它心智迷乱。目标尝试意志豁免。

大成功 生物不受影响。

成功 目标听到奇怪的低语，陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞1}，持续1轮。

失败 目标开始漫无目的地游荡，每个动作都会向一个随机方向快步。目标移动时会选择最安全的路线，且不会进入危险地形。此法术持续1分钟，或直到有生物对目标采取敌意动作。

大失败 如同失败，但目标还会语无伦次地呓语。任何在目标20尺内开始回合的生物都必须尝试意志豁免。失败时，它必须用下个回合的第一个动作向随机方向快步，然后对此法术免疫24小时。这是失能效果。

items.name: 卜筮术
items.expectedDescription:
You gain a vague glimpse of the future. During the casting of this spell, ask about the results of a particular course of action. The spell can predict results up to 30 minutes into the future and reveal the GM's best guess among the following outcomes: good, bad, mixed (the results will be a mix of good and bad), and nothing (there won't be particularly good or bad results).

The GM rolls a secret @Check[flat|dc:6|showDC:all|traits:secret]. On a failure, the result is always "nothing." This makes it impossible to tell whether a "nothing" result is accurate. If anyone asks about the same topic as the first casting of augury during an additional casting, the GM uses the secret roll result from the first casting. If circumstances change, though, it's possible to get a different result.
items.description:
你能够粗略地窥见未来。在施放该法术期间，询问特定行动方式的结果。法术能够预测未来至多30分钟内的结果，并使用后述结果揭示出GM得出的最有可能的猜想：吉、凶、兼（结果将是好与坏的混合）、以及平（不会产生特别好或者坏的结果）。

GM投掷一次@Check[flat|dc:6|showDC:all|traits:secret]检定。失败时，结果总是“平”。这使得任何人都无法判断“平”的结果究竟是否准确。若有任何人在另一次施法过程中询问的问题与首次卜筮术具有相同的主题，那么GM要使用与首次施法相同的秘密检定结果。不过，在情况改变时，也有可能得到不同的结果。

items.expectedDescription:
You gain a vague glimpse of the future. During the casting of this spell, ask about the results of a particular course of action. items.name: 朦胧术
items.expectedDescription: The target's form appears blurry. It becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}. As the nature of this effect still leaves the target's location obvious, the target can't use this concealment to Hide or Sneak.
items.description: 目标的形态变得模糊不清。它获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。由于该效果的原理，目标的位置仍然显而易见，目标不能使用该隐蔽来躲藏或潜行。

items.name: 侦测思想
items.expectedDescription:
You sense the presence of thinking creatures around you. You detect the presence or absence of thoughts from conscious creatures that have Intelligence modifiers of –3 or higher. You can choose to ignore the thoughts of creatures you're familiar with so they don't interfere with your detection of other thoughts. The spell can penetrate some barriers, but 3 feet of dirt or wood, 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of metal, a thin sheet of lead, or any force barrier blocks it. Creatures who are immune to mental effects are immune to detection by this spell.

Heightened (4th) You detect the number of thinking minds and whether or not the creatures are telepathic. Creatures with telepathy have louder thoughts than creatures who don't have telepathy and might be able to sense your intrusion, at the GM's discretion.
items.description:
你能感知周围生物的想法。你可以侦测周围是否存在智力调整值不低于-3的清醒生物的思维。可选择忽略熟悉生物的思维，避免干扰其他目标的侦测。该法术可以穿透一些障碍，但3尺的泥土或木头、1尺的石头、1英寸的金属、薄薄的铅片或任何立场障碍都会阻挡它。对心灵效果免疫的生物对该法术的侦测免疫。

升阶（4环）你可侦测范围内存在思维活动的意识体数量，并判断其是否具备心灵感应能力。拥有心灵感应能力的生物思维波动更强，普通生物思维信号较弱且无反馈，具体由GM裁定。

items.name: 识破无形（恒定）
items.expectedDescription:
Your gaze pierces through illusions and finds @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} creatures and spirits. You can see invisible creatures as though they weren't invisible, although their features are blurred, making them @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} and difficult to identify. You can also see incorporeal creatures, like ghosts, phased through an object from within 10 feet of an object's surface as blurry shapes seen through those objects. Subtler clues also grant you a +2 status bonus to checks you make to disbelieve illusions.

Heightened (5th) This spell has a duration of 8 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.T5bk6UH7yuYog1Fp]{Spell Effect: See the Unseen}
items.description:
你的目光穿透了幻术，发现了隐形生物和魂灵。你能看到@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}生物，就如同它们并未隐形一般，然而它们的体征仍然很模糊，使得它们具有@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}并且难以被识别。你还能看到虚体生物，比如穿入物体内的幽灵；你能透过物体，看到位于物体表面以内10尺内的此类生物的模糊轮廓。对细节更强的洞察力还让你在进行识破幻术的检定时，获得+2状态加值。

升阶（5环） 持续时间为8小时。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.T5bk6UH7yuYog1Fp]{法术效果：识破无形}

items.name: 绝望术
items.expectedDescription:
You fill the minds of your enemies with doubt. Enemies in the area must succeed at a Will save or take a –1 status penalty to attack rolls as long as they are in the area. Once per round on subsequent turns, you can Sustain the spell to increase the emanation's radius by 10 feet and force enemies in the area that weren't yet affected to attempt another saving throw.

Bane can counteract @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XSujb7EsSwKl19Uu]{Bless}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.UTLp7omqsiC36bso]{Spell Effect: Bane}
items.description:
你将疑虑充满敌人的心智。在区域的敌人必须成功通过一次意志豁免，否则只要在区域内，在攻击掷骰上即会承受-1状态减值。在后续的回合中，每轮一次，你可以维持该法术将弥漫的半径增加10尺，并令区域内尚未受到影响的敌人再次尝试豁免。

绝望术可以反制@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XSujb7EsSwKl19Uu]{祝福术}。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.UTLp7omqsiC36bso]{法术效果：绝望术}

items.name: 晕眩术
items.expectedDescription:
You push into the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals 1d6 mental damage, with a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你侵入目标的精神，利用精神冲击令目标晕眩。该冲击造成1d6心灵伤害，具有基础意志豁免。如果目标在豁免中大失败，它获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 1}。

升阶（+2） 该伤害增加1d6。

items.name: 侦测魔法
items.expectedDescription:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).
items.description:
你发出一股标记魔法存在的脉冲。你不会获得魔法存在或不存在以外的任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你或者你盟友的魔法物品以及持续法术。仅当幻术魔法的环阶低于你的侦测魔法环阶时，你才能侦测幻术魔法。但是，具有幻术灵光但是没有在外表上做伪装的物品（例如一瓶隐形药水），通常能够正常侦测。

升阶（3环阶） 你能知晓法术侦测出的最强魔法效果的环阶或等级，具体由GM决定。

升阶（4环阶） 如3环阶，你也能指出最高环阶魔法的来源。如同一种模糊感官，你不会了解具体的位置，但是可以将来源锁定到5尺立方（或者最近的那个五尺立方，如果来源体积比这个区域更大）。

items.name: 诡枪术
items.expectedDescription:
You condense a beam of mind-assaulting eldritch energy from the dark spaces between the stars and fire it at a target. Make a ranged spell attack roll against the target's AC. If you hit, you deal 2d6 mental damage. On a critical success, you deal double damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你自星辰之间的幽深领域凝聚一束袭魂慑魄的怪异能量攻击目标。尝试一次远程法术攻击骰对抗目标的AC，如果命中，你造成2d6心灵伤害，在大成功时造成双倍伤害。

升阶（+1）伤害增加1d6。

items.name: 衰弱术
items.expectedDescription:
You sap the target's strength, depending on its Fortitude save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the start of your next turn.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3} for 1 minute.
items.description:
你抽走目标的力量，基于其强韧豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭 1}，直到你的下个回合开始。

失败 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭 2}，持续1分钟。

大失败 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭 3}，持续1分钟

items.name: 恐惧术
items.expectedDescription:
You plant fear in the target; it must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to five creatures.
items.description:
你将恐惧植入目标；它必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}。

失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}。

大失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 3}，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}，持续1轮。

升阶（3环） 你能以至多五个生物为目标。

items.name: 心灵穿刺
items.expectedDescription:
You overload a creature's mind with a glut of psychic information or divine judgments. The mental onslaught deals 2d6 mental damage. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.
items.description:
你以海量心灵信息或神圣审判冲击一个生物的心智。这股精神猛攻造成2d6心灵伤害。大失败时，目标还会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞2}，持续1轮。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加2d6。

items.name: 念动之手
items.expectedDescription:
You create a floating, magical hand, either invisible or ghostlike, that grasps the target object and levitates it slowly up to 20 feet in any direction. When you Sustain the spell, you can move the object an additional 20 feet. If the object is in the air when the spell ends, the object falls.

Heightened (3rd) You can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (7th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 2 or less.
items.description:
你创造出一只漂浮着的魔法手掌，它可以隐形或者宛如幽灵，它能抓住目标物体并向着任意方向缓慢漂浮至多20尺。当你维持法术时，你能够将物体移动额外20尺。若物体位于空中之时法术结束，那么该物体便会坠落。

升阶（3环） 你能以一个1负载或更轻的无主物体为目标。

升阶（5环） 法术射程增加至60尺，而且你能以一个1负载或更轻的无主物体为目标。

升阶（7环） 法术射程增加至60尺，而且你能以一个2负载或更轻的无主物体为目标。

items.name: 虚能噬
items.expectedDescription:
You call upon the Void to harm life force. The target takes 2d4 void damage with a basic Fortitude save. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the start of your next turn.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.
items.description:
你召唤虚空之力以伤害生命力。该目标承受2d4虚能伤害，这有一次基础强韧豁免。 如果该生物在豁免中大失败，它还会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭 1}直至你的下回合开始。

升阶（+1） 该伤害增加1d4。

items.name: 奥克腾岩飞轮
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This bladed hoop is carved from a chunk of aucturnite and sculpted to resemble a planet's ring. The material has mysteriously appeared light-years from Aucturn's original orbit.
items.description:
强化： 1

这个带刃圆环由一块奥克腾岩（aucturnite）雕刻而成，造型仿照行星环。此材料神秘地出现在距离奥克腾（Aucturn）原轨道数光年之外的地方。

items.name: 流浆喷溅
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger The ichor lord is dealt piercing or slashing damage

Effect Hallucinogenic ichor spurts from the ichor lord's wound, dealing @Damage[1d6[mental]|options:area-damage] damage to non-orocoran creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] centered on the ichor lord (@Check[will|dc:28|basic] save).
items.description:
触发 流浆领主受到穿刺或挥砍伤害

效果 致幻流浆从流浆领主的伤口喷出，造成@Damage[1d6[mental]|options:area-damage]伤害，影响以流浆领主为中心的@Template[type:emanation|distance:10]内的所有非奥罗科兰人生物（@Check[will|dc:28|basic]豁免）。

items.name: 致幻
items.expectedDescription:
An orocoran's stomach fluids are laced with hallucinogens due to their consumption of the ichor-like birthing fluids expelled by Aucturn during the hatching of the Newborn.

A creature hit with the projectile vomit must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:28] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round (1d4 rounds on a critical failure).
items.description:
奥罗科兰人摄入了新诞者孵化时奥克腾排出的流浆状羊水，因此其胃液中混有致幻剂。

被呕吐喷射命中的生物必须成功通过@Check[will|dc:28]豁免，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{困惑}，持续1轮（大失败时为1d4轮）。

items.name: 流浆之泉
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements The ichor lord is touching solid ground

Frequency once per hour

Effect With a psychic cry to the Newborn, the ichor lord tears open the earth, causing a geyser of hallucinogenic ichor to burst from the ground within 100 feet. This geyser occupies a 50-foot-tall cylinder with a 10-foot radius base. The base of this geyser must be on the ground or a similar solid surface, and the geyser must be oriented vertically. Each creature in the area takes @Damage[4d6[bludgeoning],4d6[mental]|options:area-damage]{4d6 bludgeoning damage and 4d6 mental damage}, with a @Check[reflex|dc:28] save. A creature pushed into the air by the geyser can't be pushed beyond the top of the geyser. After being pushed into the air, a creature falls unless it's flying, is in zero gravity, or has some other means of staying aloft in its current environment, taking falling damage as normal.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and isn't pushed into the air.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is pushed 20 feet into the air.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is pushed 40 feet into the air. The geyser continues to flow for 1 minute, gently raining ichor in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] centered on the geyser's base. An orocoran in the area of this rain can drink the ichor once per round as a single action with the manipulate trait; if they do, they become invigorated, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to damage rolls and resistance 5 to physical damage until the beginning of their next turn.
items.description:
需求 流浆领主正接触坚实地面

频率 每小时一次

效果 流浆领主以心能呼唤新诞者，撕开大地，使一道致幻流浆喷泉从100尺内的地面喷出。喷泉占据一个高50尺、底面半径10尺的圆柱体。喷泉的底面必须位于地面或类似的坚实表面上，且喷泉必须垂直朝上。区域内每个生物受到@Damage[4d6[bludgeoning],4d6[mental]|options:area-damage]{4d6钝击伤害和4d6心灵伤害}，并进行一次@Check[reflex|dc:28]豁免。被喷泉推至空中的生物不会被推至高于喷泉顶端的位置。被推至空中后，除非该生物正在飞行、处于零重力环境，或有其他能在当前环境中停留空中的手段，否则其便会坠落，如常受到坠落伤害。

大成功 生物不受影响。

成功 生物受到一半伤害，且不会被推至空中。

失败 生物受到全额伤害，并被推至空中20尺处。

大失败 生物受到双倍伤害，并被推至空中40尺处。喷泉持续喷涌1分钟，流浆以喷泉底面为中心，在@Template[type:emanation|distance:30]内如细雨般轻柔洒落。位于这片流浆雨区域内的奥罗科兰人每轮可以用一个具有操作特征的单动作饮用流浆一次；若如此做，其便充满活力，在伤害掷骰上获得+2环境加值，并获得物理伤害抗力5，直到其下一回合开始。

items.name: 舔舐伤口
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency once per round

Requirements A creature within reach of the orocoran's proboscis is taking persistent bleed damage

Effect The orocoran flicks out their proboscis and sups on the flowing blood of their enemy. The orocoran regains Hit Points equal to the target's persistent bleed value.
items.description:
频率每轮一次

要求奥罗科兰人的管状口器触及内有一个生物正在受到持续流血伤害

效果奥罗科兰人弹出管状口器，吸食敌人流出的血液。奥罗科兰人恢复等同于目标持续流血值的生命值。
