@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Qr5rgoZvI4KmFY0N]{Spell Effect: Calm}
items.description:
你令区域内的生物强制冷静，令它们进入平和的状态；每个生物必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 平静的冲动令该生物在攻击掷骰上承受-1状态减值。

失败 任何会影响该生物的情绪效果会被压制，并且该生物无法进行敌对行为。如果该目标成为任何其他生物敌对行为的目标，它不再受到安定心神的影响。

大失败 如同失败，但是敌对行为不会结束该效果。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Qr5rgoZvI4KmFY0N]{法术效果：安定心神}

items.name: 净化苦难
items.expectedDescription:
Gentle restorative magic pushes back the effects of toxins and more complex maladies. Choose an affliction on the target, such as a curse, disease, or poison. If it has advanced past stage one, reduce the stage by one. This reduction can be applied only once to a given case of an affliction, with the case ending when it's completely cured. Although the reduction can't occur again, heightened versions of this spell attempt to counteract with each casting.

Heightened (3rd) Attempt to counteract the affliction if it is a disease or poison.

Heightened (4th) Attempt to counteract the affliction if it is a curse, disease, or poison.
items.description:
温和的恢复魔法抑制毒素和更复杂疾患的影响。选择目标的一个苦难，例如诅咒、疾病、或者毒素。如果它已经超过阶段1，减少1个阶段。直到某一次苦难被完全治愈之前，对于这次苦难，这种减少只能生效一次。尽管这种减少不能再次发生，升阶版本的该法术每次施法都能尝试反制它。

升阶（3环） 如果苦难是疾病或者毒素，尝试反制它。

升阶（4环） 如果苦难是诅咒、疾病或者毒素，尝试反制它。

items.name: 清神醒脑
items.expectedDescription:
You drive mental contamination from the target's mind. Attempt to counteract an effect of your choice imposing one of these conditions on the target: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied}. If you failed to counteract the effect but you would have if its counteract rank were 2 lower, instead suppress the effect until the beginning of your next turn. The effect's duration doesn't elapse while it's suppressed. This spell can't counteract or suppress conditions that are part of curses, diseases, or a natural state of the target.

Heightened (4th) Add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed} to the list of conditions.

Heightened (6th) As 4th rank, plus add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed}.

Heightened (8th) As 4th rank, plus add doomed and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned}.
items.description:
你将精神污染从目标的头脑中驱除。尝试反制目标上的任一个由你选择的造成下列状态的效果：@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧}以及@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞}。如果你未能反制该效果，但是如果其反制环阶低2的话你会成功，则改为压制该效应，直至你的下回合开始。在被压制时，该效果的持续时间不会减少。该法术不会反制或者压制属于目标的诅咒、疾病或者自然情况一部分的状态。

升阶（4环） 增加@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{困惑}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{被控制}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢}到状态列表中。

升阶（6环） 同4环阶，额外增加@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{毁灭}到状态列表中。

升阶（8环） 同4环阶，额外增加毁灭和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑}到状态列表中。

items.name: 忍受环境
items.expectedDescription:
You shield the target against dangerous temperatures. Choose severe cold or heat. The target is protected from the temperature you chose (but not extreme cold or heat).

Heightened (3rd) The target is protected from severe cold and severe heat.

Heightened (5th) The target is protected from severe cold, severe heat, extreme cold, and extreme heat.
items.description:
你保护目标对抗危险气温。选择严寒或炎热。目标不受你选择的气温的影响，但这对极寒和极热无效。

升阶（3环） 目标受到保护，免遭严寒和炎热影响。

升阶（5环） 目标受到保护，免遭严寒、炎热、极寒和极热影响。

items.name: 抵抗能量伤害
items.expectedDescription:
A shield of elemental energy protects a creature against one type of energy damage. Choose acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage. The target and its gear gain resistance 5 against the damage type you chose.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.con2Hzt47JjpuUej]{Spell Effect: Resist Energy}

Heightened (4th) The resistance increases to 10, and you can target up to two creatures.

Heightened (7th) The resistance increases to 15, and you can target up to five creatures.
items.description:
元素护盾保护一个生物免受某一种类型能量的伤害。选择酸蚀，寒冷，电击，火焰或者音波伤害。目标和其装备获得对你所选择伤害类型的抗力5。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.con2Hzt47JjpuUej]{法术效果：抵抗能量伤害}

升阶（4环） 该抗力增加到10，并且你能以至多两个生物为目标。

升阶（7环） 该抗力增加到15，并且你能以至多五个生物为目标。

items.name: 识破无形
items.expectedDescription:
Your gaze pierces through illusions and finds @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} creatures and spirits. You can see invisible creatures as though they weren't invisible, although their features are blurred, making them @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} and difficult to identify. You can also see incorporeal creatures, like ghosts, phased through an object from within 10 feet of an object's surface as blurry shapes seen through those objects. Subtler clues also grant you a +2 status bonus to checks you make to disbelieve illusions.

Heightened (5th) This spell has a duration of 8 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.T5bk6UH7yuYog1Fp]{Spell Effect: See the Unseen}
items.description:
你的目光穿透了幻术，发现了隐形生物和魂灵。你能看到@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}生物，就如同它们并未隐形一般，然而它们的体征仍然很模糊，使得它们具有@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}并且难以被识别。你还能看到虚体生物，比如穿入物体内的幽灵；你能透过物体，看到位于物体表面以内10尺内的此类生物的模糊轮廓。对细节更强的洞察力还让你在进行识破幻术的检定时，获得+2状态加值。

升阶（5环） 持续时间为8小时。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.T5bk6UH7yuYog1Fp]{法术效果：识破无形}

items.name: 关照术
items.expectedDescription:
As long as you and the target are on the same plane of existence and both alive, you remain aware of its present state. You know the target's direction from you, distance from you, and any conditions affecting it.

Heightened (4th) The spell's range increases to 30 feet, and you can target up to 10 creatures.
items.description:
只要你和目标处于相同的位面，并且均活着，你就会一直知晓其当前状态。你知晓目标和你相对的方向，与你的距离，以及任何正影响其的状态。

升阶（4环） 该法术的射程增加到30尺，并且你能以至多10个生物为目标。

items.name: 通译语言
items.expectedDescription:
The target can understand the meaning of a single language it is hearing or reading when you cast the spell. This doesn't let it understand codes, language couched in metaphor, and the like (subject to GM discretion). If the target can hear multiple languages and knows that, it can choose which language to understand; otherwise, choose one of the languages randomly.

Heightened (3rd) The target can also speak the language.

Heightened (4th) You can target up to 10 creatures, and targets can also speak the language.
items.description:
在你施放该法术时，目标会理解其正听到或者阅读的一种语言的含义。这不会令其能够理解密文，使用隐喻表达的含义，或者类似的内容（由GM所判定）。如果目标能够听见数种语言并且了解该情况，它能选择要理解的那种语言；否则，随机选择这种语言。

升阶（3环阶） 该目标也能使用该语言交流。

升阶（4环阶） 你能以至多10个生物作为目标，并且这些目标也能使用该语言交流。

items.name: 侦测魔法
items.expectedDescription:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).
items.description:
你发出一股标记魔法存在的脉冲。你不会获得魔法存在或不存在以外的任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你或者你盟友的魔法物品以及持续法术。仅当幻术魔法的环阶低于你的侦测魔法环阶时，你才能侦测幻术魔法。但是，具有幻术灵光但是没有在外表上做伪装的物品（例如一瓶隐形药水），通常能够正常侦测。

升阶（3环阶） 你能知晓法术侦测出的最强魔法效果的环阶或等级，具体由GM决定。

升阶（4环阶） 如3环阶，你也能指出最高环阶魔法的来源。如同一种模糊感官，你不会了解具体的位置，但是可以将来源锁定到5尺立方（或者最近的那个五尺立方，如果来源体积比这个区域更大）。

items.name: 严厉护卫
items.expectedDescription:
You ward an ally against the attacks and hostile spells from the target enemy. The target ally gains a +1 status bonus to Armor Class and saving throws against the target enemy's attacks, spells, and other effects.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ctMxYPGEpstvhW9C]{Spell Effect: Forbidding Ward}

Heightened (6th) The status bonus increases to +2.
items.description:
你保护一个盟友，以抵御目标敌人的攻击和敌对法术。目标盟友在对抗目标敌人的攻击、法术及其他效应时，AC和豁免获得+1状态加值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ctMxYPGEpstvhW9C]{法术效果：严厉护卫}

升阶（6环） 该状态加值增加到+2。

items.name: 神导术
items.expectedDescription:
You ask for the guidance of supernatural entities, granting the target a +1 status bonus to one attack roll, Perception check, saving throw, or skill check the target attempts before the duration ends. The target chooses which roll to use the bonus on before rolling. If the target uses the bonus, the spell ends. Either way, the target is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3qHKBDF7lrHw8jFK]{Spell Effect: Guidance}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3LyOkV25p7wA181H]{Effect: Guidance Immunity}
items.description:
你请求超自然存在的引导，赋予目标在持续时间结束前的一次攻击掷骰、察觉检定、豁免或技能检定上获得+1状态加值。目标在掷骰前选择是否使用该加值。如果目标使用该加值，该法术结束。无论怎样结束，该目标接下来会临时免疫1小时。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3qHKBDF7lrHw8jFK]{法术效果：神导术}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3LyOkV25p7wA181H]{效果：神导术免疫}

items.name: 治疗术
items.expectedDescription:
You channel vital energy to heal the living or damage the undead. If the target is a willing living creature, you restore 1d8 Hit Points. If the target is undead, you deal that amount of vitality damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 The spell has a range of touch.

2 (concentrate) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing a living creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (concentrate) You disperse vital energy in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. This targets all living and undead creatures in the burst.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.
items.description:
你引导命能，以治疗活物或者伤害不死生物。如果目标是自愿活物，你使其恢复1d8生命值。如果目标是不死生物，你对其造成等量命能伤害，并且它可以进行基础强韧豁免。你在施放该法术时花费的动作数量决定其目标，范围，区域和其他参数。

1 该法术的射程为接触。

2（专注）该法术的射程为30尺。如果你在治疗一个活物，回复的生命值增加8。

3（专注）你在@Template[emanation|distance:30]内释放命能。这会以区域中所有活物和不死生物为目标。

升阶（+1） 治疗或者伤害的量增加1d8，两个动作版本的额外治疗增加8。

items.name: 灌注命能
items.expectedDescription:
You empower attacks with vital energy. The number of targets is equal to the number of actions you spent casting this spell. Each target's unarmed and weapon Strikes deal an extra 1d4 vitality damage. (This damage typically damages only undead). If you have the holy trait, you can add that trait to this spell and to the Strikes affected by the spell.

Heightened (3rd) The damage increases to 2d4 damage.

Heightened (5th) The damage increases to 3d4 damage.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.X7RD0JRxhJV9u2LC]{Spell Effect: Infuse Vitality}
items.description:
你使用命能增强攻击。目标的数量等于你施放该法术时花费的动作数量。每个目标的无武装和武器打击额外造成1d4命能伤害。（该伤害通常只会伤害不死生物）。如果你具有圣洁（holy）特征，你可以将该特征附加到此法术及受其影响的打击上。

升阶（3环） 该伤害增加到2d4。

升阶（5环） 该伤害增加到3d4。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.X7RD0JRxhJV9u2LC]{法术效果：灌注命能}

items.name: 调整重心
items.expectedDescription: Applying a combination of vital energy and acupressure, you help the target regain its footing. The target loses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} condition if it has it. The target becomes immune to the off-guard condition until the start of your next turn, even if the condition would be circumstantially applied, such as by being flanked or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. The target is then immune to reorient for 10 minutes.
items.description: 结合使用元气和穴位按摩，帮助目标重新站稳。目标会失去@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]状态（如果有的话）。在下一回合开始前，目标将免疫措手不及状态，即使是被夹击或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]等会施加措手不及情况下也是如此。然后，目标在 10 分钟内对调整重心免疫。

items.name: 庇护术
items.expectedDescription:
You ward a creature with protective energy that deters attacks. Creatures attempting to attack the target must attempt a Will save each time. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends.

Critical Success Sanctuary ends.

Success The creature can attempt its attack and any other attacks against the target this turn.

Failure The creature can't attack the target and wastes the action. It can't attempt further attacks against the target this turn.

Critical Failure The creature wastes the action and can't attempt to attack the target for the rest of sanctuary's duration.
items.description:
你引动防护能量，保护一个生物抵御攻击。尝试攻击该目标的生物必须每次尝试一次意志豁免。如果目标使用敌对动作，该法术结束。

大成功 庇护术结束。

成功 该生物可以尝试这次攻击，并在本回合内继续对目标进行其他攻击。

失败 该生物无法攻击目标，并浪费该动作。本回合内它无法继续尝试攻击目标。

大失败 该生物浪费该动作，并且在庇护术剩余持续时间中均无法尝试攻击目标。

items.name: 灵魂链接
items.expectedDescription:
You form a spiritual link with another creature, taking in its pain. When you Cast this Spell and at the start of each of your turns, if the target is below maximum Hit Points, it regains 2 Hit Points (or the difference between its current and maximum Hit Points, if that's lower). You lose as many Hit Points as the target regained.

This is a spiritual transfer, so no effects apply that would increase the Hit Points the target regains or decrease the Hit Points you lose. This transfer also ignores any temporary Hit Points you or the target have. Since this effect doesn't involve vitality or void energy, spirit link works even if you or the target is undead. While the duration persists, you gain no benefit from regeneration or fast healing. You can Dismiss this spell, and if you're ever at 0 Hit Points, spirit link ends automatically.

Heightened (+1) The number of Hit Points transferred each time increases by 2.
items.description:
你和其他生物建立了一条灵魂链接，令你代为承受其苦痛。当你施放该法术，以及在你回合开始时，如果目标生命值低于其最大生命值，它回复2生命值（或者其当前生命值和最大生命值的差值，如果这更低）。你失去等于目标回复量的生命值。

这是一种基于灵魂的转移，所以没有任何效果会增加目标获得的生命值或者减少你失去的生命值。这种转移也会忽略你或者目标所拥有的任何临时生命值。由于该效果中没有任何命能或者虚能作用，灵魂链接在你或者目标为不死生物时也生效。在持续时间中，你不会从再生或者快速回复中受益。你可以解消该法术，并且一旦你为0生命值，灵魂链接自动结束。

升阶（+1） 每次转移的生命值增加2。

items.name: 稳定伤势
items.expectedDescription: Life energy shuts death's door. The target loses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} condition, though it remains @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} at 0 Hit Points.
items.description: 生命能量将目标从鬼门关拉回。目标失去 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{濒死} 状态，但它仍然 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{失去意识}，并为0生命值。

items.expectedName: +2 status to all saves vs. divine
items.name: 对抗神术的所有豁免获得+2状态加值
调谐灵光
items.expectedDescription: 60 feet. All allied creatures in the aura gain a +5-foot status bonus to Speeds (if the dragon is photon-attuned), or all enemies take a –5-foot status penalty to Speeds (if the dragon is graviton-attuned).
items.description: 60尺。灵光内所有盟友的各项速度获得+5尺状态加值（若龙与光量子调谐），或所有敌人的各项速度承受–5尺状态减值（若龙与引力子调谐）。

items.name: 反应打击
items.expectedDescription: @Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ReactiveStrike]
items.description: @Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ReactiveStrike]

items.name: 宇宙调谐
items.expectedDescription:
The cosmic dragon is always attuned to an underlying stellar force: either photons or gravitons. They can swap attunement as a free action once at the start of their turn in combat and is otherwise attuned to whichever force they choose at any time outside of combat. The dragon's melee Strikes deal an additional @Damage[2d6[fire]] damage while they're photon-attuned and an additional @Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]] damage plus Knockdown while they're graviton-attuned. The damage of their cosmic blast Strike is likewise determined by their current attunement, as are the effects of some of their other abilities. The dragon can choose to exclude any creatures from any effect of the aura or action that uses the aura.

The dragon can always sense the distance and direction to the nearest Drift beacon and to the Starstone on Absalom Station.
items.description:
宇宙龙始终与某种基本恒星之力调谐：光量子或引力子。战斗中，它可以在回合开始时以自由动作切换调谐，每次回合开始时仅限一次；战斗外则可随时选择与任意一种力量调谐。与光量子调谐时，龙的近战打击额外造成@Damage[2d6[fire]]伤害；与引力子调谐时，额外造成@Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]]伤害并附加击倒。其宇宙爆裂打击的伤害同样由当前调谐状态决定，部分其他能力的效应也是如此。龙可以选择任意生物，使其不受灵光或使用此灵光的动作所产生的任何效应影响。

龙始终能够感知最近的漂流信标和艾巴萨罗姆空间站的星石的距离与方向。

items.name: 星辰吐息
items.expectedDescription: The dragon unleashes divine power like that from the core of a star or black hole, dealing @Damage[10d10[spirit]|options:area-damage] damage in a @Template[type:cone|distance:40] (@Check[will|dc:34|basic|options:area-effect] save). The dragon can't use Stellar Breath for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.
items.description: 龙释放如同源自恒星或黑洞核心的神能，造成@Damage[10d10[spirit]|options:area-damage]伤害，影响@Template[type:cone|distance:40]（@Check[will|dc:34|basic|options:area-effect]豁免）。龙在[[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4轮}内无法使用星辰吐息。

items.name: 星辰微粒
items.expectedDescription: The dragon conjures a mote of stellar energy that shares their current attunement. They direct the mote to a square within 90 feet. While the mote is deployed, the dragon's attunement aura also emanates from that square, with the same emanation radius. The dragon can Sustain to move the mote up to 90 feet or to recall the mote from any distance. The mote is made of cosmic energy, doesn't occupy a space, and can't be targeted or destroyed by any effect.
items.description: 龙召唤一枚与其当前调谐状态一致的恒星能量微粒，并将其指引到90尺内的一个方格。微粒部署期间，龙的调谐灵光也会从该方格弥漫，弥漫半径相同。龙可以维持，以将微粒移动至多90尺，或从任意距离召回微粒。微粒由宇宙能量构成，不占据空间，也无法被任何效应选为目标或摧毁。

items.name: 星辰脉冲
items.expectedDescription:
The dragon imposes an effect on creatures within their attunement aura. The effect is based on the dragon's current attunement. The dragon can't use Stellar Pulse again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Stellar Pulse]]{1d4 rounds}.

  • Graviton Each creature must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:34|options:area-effect] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} for 1 round.

  • Photon Each creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} and can use the extra action only to Stride or Strike.
items.description:
龙对调谐灵光内的生物施加效应，效应取决于其当前的调谐状态。龙在[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Stellar Pulse]]{1d4轮}内无法再次使用星辰脉冲。

  • 引力子 每个生物必须成功通过@Check[fortitude|dc:34|options:area-effect]豁免，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}，持续1轮。

  • 光量子 每个生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{迅捷}，额外动作仅能用于行走或打击。

T3lt2o82IHEktluT.name: 成年宇宙龙（施法者） Cosmic Dragon (Adult, Spellcaster)
T3lt2o82IHEktluT.publicNotes: 这些威严的龙体现了构成宇宙万物基础并维系其平衡的恒星之力。宇宙龙睿智、合群、耐心，接纳遇见的所有生灵；它们将所有生物视为宇宙中平等的组成部分，既可能与学者共同讨论天体物理，也可能与受压迫者一同感慨命运的曲折。大多数宇宙龙都能变身，但通常只是为了让其他生物感到自在。它们厌恶欺骗，即使处于另一种形态，也总会表明自己是龙。

items.name: 触发术
items.expectedDescription:
You prepare a spell that will trigger later. While casting contingency, you also cast another spell of 4th rank or lower with a casting time of no more than 3 actions. This companion spell must be one that can affect you. You must make any decisions for the spell when you cast contingency, such as choosing a damage type for resist energy. During the casting, choose a trigger under which the spell will be cast, using the same restrictions as for the trigger of a Ready action. Once contingency is cast, you can cause the companion spell to come into effect as a reaction with that trigger. It affects only you, even if it would affect more creatures. If you define complicated conditions, as determined by the GM, the trigger might fail. If you cast contingency again, the newer casting supersedes the older.

Heightened (8th) You can choose a spell of 5th rank or lower.

Heightened (9th) You can choose a spell of 6th rank or lower.

Heightened (10th) You can choose a spell of 7th rank or lower.
items.description:
你准备好一个法术，其可以在之后被触发。当施放触发术时，你也同时施放另一个4环阶或者更低的法术，施法时间不超过3个动作。这个伴随的法术必须是能够影响你的法术。你必须在设定触发术时，为该法术决定任何需要决定的选项，例如选择抵抗能量的伤害类型。在施放时，选择一个该法术会被施放的触发条件，限制如同准备动作的触发条件。触发术施放后，当所选触发条件满足时，你可以用反应令伴随法术生效。该法术只影响你，即使它通常可以影响更多生物。如果你定义了复杂的条件，触发可能会失败，这由GM决定。如果你施放触发术，新的触发术会取代旧的。

升阶（8环） 你可以选择5环阶或者更低的法术。

升阶（9环） 你可以选择6环阶或者更低的法术。

升阶（10环） 你可以选择7环阶或者更低的法术。

items.name: 回溯过去
items.expectedDescription:
Opening your mind to mental echoes, you gain impressions from past events that occurred in your current location. Retrocognition reveals psychic impressions from events that occurred over the course of the last day throughout the first minute of the duration, followed by impressions from the next day back the next minute, and so on. These echoes don't play out like a vision but instead reveal impressions of emotions and metaphors that provide cryptic clues and details of the past. If you witness a traumatic or turbulent event through an impression, the spell ends unless you succeed at a Will save with a DC of at least 30 and possibly as much as 50, depending on the severity of the event. The GM determines whether an event is traumatic and chooses the DC.

Heightened (8th) You gain impressions of events that occurred over the previous year for each minute you concentrate, instead of the previous day, though the details diminish, making it harder to distinguish impressions from all but the most major events.

Heightened (9th) You gain impressions of events that occurred over the previous century for each minute you concentrate, instead of the previous day, though the details diminish, making it almost impossible to distinguish impressions from all but the most major events.
items.description:
你敞开心灵接纳心灵回响，获得当前位置过去发生事件的印象。在持续时间的第一分钟内，回溯过去揭示过去一天内事件的心灵印象；下一分钟揭示再往前一天的印象，依此类推。这些回响不会像影像一样重现，而是以情绪与隐喻的印象，提供有关过去的晦涩线索与细节。若你通过印象见证了创伤性或动荡的事件，法术便会结束，除非你成功通过一次意志豁免，DC至少30，并可能根据事件的严重程度高达50。GM决定事件是否具有创伤性，并选择DC。

升阶（8环） 你每专注一分钟，便获得前一年而非前一天内事件的印象，但细节减少，除最重大的事件外，其余印象都更难辨别。

升阶（9环） 你每专注一分钟，便获得前一个世纪而非前一天内事件的印象，但细节减少，除最重大的事件外，其余印象几乎无法辨别。

items.name: 洞烛机先
items.expectedDescription:
You delve into the possible futures of the next few seconds to understand all the ways your foe might avoid harm, then cast out a vision of that future to those around you. Designate a creature. The first time each target makes an attack roll against that creature during true target's duration, the attacker rolls twice and uses the better result. The attacker also ignores circumstance penalties to the attack roll and any flat check required due to the designated creature being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.HuvucQ5nfpuVWNrw]{Spell Effect: True Target}
items.description:
你深入后续数秒的可能未来，以此了解敌人可能避免伤害的各种手段，再将此未来的影像传递给周围的人。指定一个生物。在洞烛机先持续时间中，每个目标首次对指定生物进行攻击掷骰时，攻击者掷骰两次并采用较好的结果。该攻击者也会忽视攻击掷骰的环境减值，以及因指定生物处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{藏匿}而必须进行的任何纯骰检定。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.HuvucQ5nfpuVWNrw]{法术效果：洞烛机先}

items.name: 呼唤精魂
items.expectedDescription:
You tear the veil to the afterlife and call a spirit from its final resting place. You must call the spirit by name, and you must provide a connection to the spirit, such as a possession, a garment, or a piece of its corpse. A spirit unwilling to heed your call can attempt a Will save to avoid it; on a critical success, a trickster spirit Impersonates the spirit you meant to call. The DC of the Will save is 2 lower if you haven't met the spirit in life. Either way, the spirit appears as a wispy form of the creature you meant to call. Each minute of the duration, you can ask the spirit a question. It can answer how it pleases or even refuse to answer. If the spirit isn't in the afterlife (such as if it's an undead), all results other than critical failures use the failure effect.

Critical Success The spirit is particularly cooperative, and even if it has strong reasons to deceive you, it takes a -2 circumstance penalty to its Deception checks.

Success You call the spirit.

Failure You fail to call a spirit.

Critical Failure One or more evil spirits appear and attack.
items.description:
你掀开了彼世与此世的界限，将精魂（spirit）从其安息之地唤起。你必须呼唤精魂的名字，而且必须准备与精魂相关的物件，比如它生前的随身物品、衣服、或者取自它尸体的残骸。不愿回应你的呼唤的精魂能够尝试一次意志豁免来拒绝；豁免大成功时，另一个骗子精魂会假扮成你所呼唤的精魂来回应呼唤。如果精魂生前没有见过你，那么它抵抗呼唤的意志豁免DC会降低2点。无论如何，精魂会出现在你面前，其缥缈的外观就如同你想要呼唤的生物一样。在持续时间内的每一分钟，你都能够问精魂一个问题。它会以自己喜欢的方式回答，甚至可以拒绝回答。若精魂不在来世（比如它现在是不死生物）的话，大失败之外的其他结果都会使用失败的效应。

大成功 精魂会十分配合你，哪怕它具有足够的理由来欺骗你，也会在欺骗检定中承受-2的环境减值。

成功 你能够呼唤精魂。

失败 你未能呼唤精魂。

大失败 一个或更多的邪恶精魂（evil spirits）出现并对你发起攻击。

items.name: 实言术（恒定）
items.expectedDescription:
The target can understand all words regardless of language and also speak the languages of other creatures. When in a mixed group of creatures, each time the target speaks, it can choose a creature and speak in a language that creature understands, even if the target doesn't know what language that is.

Heightened (7th) The duration is 8 hours.
items.description:
无论什么语言，目标都可以理解其所有的词语，也能说其他生物的语言。当处于一群各异的生物中时，每次目标说话时，都可以选择一个生物，并使用一种该生物理解的语言来讲述，即使该目标不知道这语言具体是什么。

升阶（7环） 持续时间为8小时。

items.name: 阅读机运
items.expectedDescription: You peek into the future. Choose a particular goal or activity you plan to engage in within 1 week, or an event you expect might happen within 1 week. You learn a cryptic clue or piece of advice that could help with the chosen event, often in the form of a rhyme or omen.
items.description: 你窥视未来。选择你计划在1周内着手的特定目标或活动，或你预期可能在1周内发生的一件事件。你会获得一段晦涩的线索或者建议，它通常是诗歌或者预言，并可能在所选事件中帮助你。

items.name: 死者交谈
items.expectedDescription:
You grant the target corpse a semblance of life, which it uses to speak the answers to three questions posed to it. This spell calls on the physical body's latent memories rather than summoning back the deceased's spirit, so the corpse must be mostly intact for the spell to function. The more damage the corpse has taken, the more inaccurate or patchwork its answers are, and it must have a throat and mouth to speak at all. If anyone has previously cast this spell on the corpse in the last week, the spell automatically fails. The corpse can attempt a Will save to resist answering the questions using the statistics of the original creature at its time of death, with the following effects.

Critical Success The target can lie or refuse to answer your questions, and the target's spirit haunts you for 24 hours, bothering you and causing you to be unable to gain any rest for that time.

Success The target can provide false information or refuse to answer your questions.

Failure The target must answer truthfully, but its answers can be brief, cryptic, and repetitive. It can still mislead you or attempt to stall so that the spell's duration runs out before you can ask all your questions.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target's answers are more direct and less repetitive, though still cryptic. It takes a -2 status penalty to Deception checks to deceive or mislead you.
items.description:
你赋予目标尸体生命的要素，令其能够回答三个你向它提出的问题。该法术会唤起身躯的潜在记忆，而不是唤回目标已经死去的灵魂，所以该法术需要该尸体基本完好才能运作。尸体受到的损伤越多，其回答便越不准确、越支离破碎，并且它必须要有嘴和喉咙才有可能说话。如果任何人在一周内已经对该尸体施放了该法术，该法术会自动失败。该尸体可以尝试一次意志豁免来抵抗回答该问题，使用其原本生物在死亡时的数据，并且有下列效果。

大成功 目标可以撒谎或者拒绝回答你的问题，并且该目标的灵魂会对你作祟24小时，不断干扰你，令你在此期间无法获得任何休息。

成功 目标可以提供错误的信息，或者拒绝回答你的问题。

失败 目标必须如实回答问题，但它的回答可以是简短的，谜语般的，重复的。它仍然可以误导你，或者尝试拖延时间，以令在你问完所有问题之前法术持续时间耗尽。

大失败 如同失败，但是目标的答案会更加直接，很少重复，但仍然如同谜语。在它欺骗和误导你的欺骗检定上承受-2状态减值。

items.name: 次元移位
items.expectedDescription:
You instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to an unoccupied space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container—the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are then temporarily immune for 1 hour.
items.description:
你立即将自身以及自己正在穿戴和持有的物品从当前空间转移走，移动至法术射程内你能看到的未被占据的空间。如果这将会带着其他生物与你一同移动——即便你把该生物放置在异次元容器中——你就会失去该法术。

升阶（5环） 法术射程增加至1里。你不需要看到目的地，只要你曾经去过目的地，并且知晓该地点与你相对的位置以及距离即可。之后你会在1小时内临时免疫该法术。

items.name: 加速术
items.expectedDescription:
Magic empowers the target to act faster. It gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition and can use the extra action each round only for Strike and Stride actions.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 6 creatures.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ElkXovNrHB0Doi6O]{Spell Effect: Haste}
items.description:
魔法强化了目标，令其行动迅速。它获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{迅捷}状态，并且每轮只能将额外动作用于打击或行走。

升阶（7环阶） 你能以至多6个生物为目标。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ElkXovNrHB0Doi6O]{法术效果：加速术}

items.name: 缓慢术
items.expectedDescription:
You dilate the flow of time around the target, slowing its actions.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} for 1 minute.

Heightened (6th) You can target up to 10 creatures.
items.description:
你令目标周围的时间膨胀，令其行动缓慢。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 1} ，持续1轮。

失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 1}，持续1分钟。

大失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 2}，持续1分钟。

升阶（6环） 你能以至多10个生物为目标。

items.name: 卜筮术
items.expectedDescription:
You gain a vague glimpse of the future. During the casting of this spell, ask about the results of a particular course of action. The spell can predict results up to 30 minutes into the future and reveal the GM's best guess among the following outcomes: good, bad, mixed (the results will be a mix of good and bad), and nothing (there won't be particularly good or bad results).

The GM rolls a secret @Check[flat|dc:6|showDC:all|traits:secret]. On a failure, the result is always "nothing." This makes it impossible to tell whether a "nothing" result is accurate. If anyone asks about the same topic as the first casting of augury during an additional casting, the GM uses the secret roll result from the first casting. If circumstances change, though, it's possible to get a different result.
items.description:
你能够粗略地窥见未来。在施放该法术期间，询问特定行动方式的结果。法术能够预测未来至多30分钟内的结果，并使用后述结果揭示出GM得出的最有可能的猜想：吉、凶、兼（结果将是好与坏的混合）、以及平（不会产生特别好或者坏的结果）。

GM投掷一次@Check[flat|dc:6|showDC:all|traits:secret]检定。失败时，结果总是“平”。这使得任何人都无法判断“平”的结果究竟是否准确。若有任何人在另一次施法过程中询问的问题与首次卜筮术具有相同的主题，那么GM要使用与首次施法相同的秘密检定结果。不过，在情况改变时，也有可能得到不同的结果。

items.name: 朦胧术
items.expectedDescription: The target's form appears blurry. It becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}. As the nature of this effect still leaves the target's location obvious, the target can't use this concealment to Hide or Sneak.
items.description: 目标的形态变得模糊不清。它获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。由于该效果的原理，目标的位置仍然显而易见，目标不能使用该隐蔽来躲藏或潜行。

items.name: 解除魔法
items.expectedDescription: You unravel the magic behind a spell or effect. Attempt a counteract check against the target. If you successfully counteract a magic item, the item becomes a mundane item of its type for 10 minutes. This doesn't change the item's non-magical properties. If the target is an artifact or similar item, you automatically fail.
items.description: 你干扰法术或者效果中的魔法力量。尝试一次反制检定，对抗目标。如果你成功对抗一个魔法物品，该物品成为该类型的普通物品，持续10分钟。这不会改变物体的非魔法性质。如果目标是一件神器或者类似的物品，你自动失败。

items.name: 识破无形
items.expectedDescription:
Your gaze pierces through illusions and finds @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} creatures and spirits. You can see invisible creatures as though they weren't invisible, although their features are blurred, making them @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} and difficult to identify. You can also see incorporeal creatures, like ghosts, phased through an object from within 10 feet of an object's surface as blurry shapes seen through those objects. Subtler clues also grant you a +2 status bonus to checks you make to disbelieve illusions.

Heightened (5th) This spell has a duration of 8 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.T5bk6UH7yuYog1Fp]{Spell Effect: See the Unseen}
items.description:
你的目光穿透了幻术，发现了隐形生物和魂灵。你能看到@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}生物，就如同它们并未隐形一般，然而它们的体征仍然很模糊，使得它们具有@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}并且难以被识别。你还能看到虚体生物，比如穿入物体内的幽灵；你能透过物体，看到位于物体表面以内10尺内的此类生物的模糊轮廓。对细节更强的洞察力还让你在进行识破幻术的检定时，获得+2状态加值。

升阶（5环） 持续时间为8小时。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.T5bk6UH7yuYog1Fp]{法术效果：识破无形}

items.name: 识破无形（恒定）
items.expectedDescription:
Your gaze pierces through illusions and finds @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} creatures and spirits. You can see invisible creatures as though they weren't invisible, although their features are blurred, making them @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} and difficult to identify. You can also see incorporeal creatures, like ghosts, phased through an object from within 10 feet of an object's surface as blurry shapes seen through those objects. Subtler clues also grant you a +2 status bonus to checks you make to disbelieve illusions.

Heightened (5th) This spell has a duration of 8 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.T5bk6UH7yuYog1Fp]{Spell Effect: See the Unseen}
items.description:
你的目光穿透了幻术，发现了隐形生物和魂灵。你能看到@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}生物，就如同它们并未隐形一般，然而它们的体征仍然很模糊，使得它们具有@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}并且难以被识别。你还能看到虚体生物，比如穿入物体内的幽灵；你能透过物体，看到位于物体表面以内10尺内的此类生物的模糊轮廓。对细节更强的洞察力还让你在进行识破幻术的检定时，获得+2状态加值。

升阶（5环） 持续时间为8小时。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.T5bk6UH7yuYog1Fp]{法术效果：识破无形}

items.name: 侦测魔法
items.expectedDescription:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).
items.description:
你发出一股标记魔法存在的脉冲。你不会获得魔法存在或不存在以外的任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你或者你盟友的魔法物品以及持续法术。仅当幻术魔法的环阶低于你的侦测魔法环阶时，你才能侦测幻术魔法。但是，具有幻术灵光但是没有在外表上做伪装的物品（例如一瓶隐形药水），通常能够正常侦测。

升阶（3环阶） 你能知晓法术侦测出的最强魔法效果的环阶或等级，具体由GM决定。

升阶（4环阶） 如3环阶，你也能指出最高环阶魔法的来源。如同一种模糊感官，你不会了解具体的位置，但是可以将来源锁定到5尺立方（或者最近的那个五尺立方，如果来源体积比这个区域更大）。

items.name: 圣枪术
items.expectedDescription:
You unleash a beam of divine energy. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, the target takes 2d4 spirit damage (double damage on a critical hit).

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.
items.description:
你施放一道神圣能量的射线。对目标尝试一次远程法术攻击，对抗目标的AC。命中时，该目标承受2d4精魂伤害（在重击时造成双倍伤害）。

升阶（+1） 该伤害增加1d4。

items.name: 伤口回响
items.expectedDescription:
You manifest an injury from the future or past to harm a creature in the present. Choose bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage. The target takes 1d8 of the selected damage type with a basic Will save. If the target fails its save and then takes the same type of damage before the end of your next turn, it takes an additional @Damage[ceil((@item.level)/2)d4[persistent,bleed]] damage.

Heightened (+2) The initial damage increases by 1d8, and the persistent damage on a failure increases by 1d4.
items.description:
你自未来或者过去具现出一道伤口来伤害当下的生物。选择钝击，穿刺或挥砍伤害，目标受到1d8所选类型伤害，具有一次基础意志豁免。如果目标豁免失败，并且在你的下个回合结束前受到了相同类型的伤害，其还会额外受到@Damage[ceil((@item.level)/2)d4[persistent,bleed]]伤害。

升阶（+2）初始伤害增加1d8，豁免失败时的持续伤害增加1d4。

items.name: 护盾术
items.expectedDescription:
You raise a magical shield of force. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction with your magic shield. The shield has Hardness 5. You can use the spell's reaction to reduce damage from any spell or magical effect, even if it doesn't deal physical damage. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity}

Heightened (+2) The shield's Hardness increases by 5.
items.description:
你举起一面力场构成的魔法护盾。这视同你使用了举盾动作，赋予你在AC上的+1环境加值，直到你的下个回合开始，且无需用手持握。

当该法术生效时，你可以使用你的魔法护盾来进行 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{盾牌格挡}反应动作。该盾牌具有硬度5。你可以使用该法术的反应动作来减少任何来自法术或者魔法效果的伤害，即使这不造成物理伤害。在你使用盾牌格挡后，该法术结束，并且你无法在10分钟内再次施放它。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{法术效果：护盾术}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{效果：护盾术免疫}

升阶（+2） 该盾牌的硬度增加5。

items.name: 冻寒长矛
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This polearm's shaft houses rapidly circulating supercooled gas that condenses and channels endothermic energy into a cryogenic blade.
items.description:
强化： 1

这件长柄武器的杆内有快速循环的过冷气体，将吸热能量凝聚并引导为低温刀刃。

items.name: 激光步枪
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

These dependable, mass-produced rifles shoot concentrated beams of energy out of square-shaped barrels. The universal standard Pact Worlds model is highly modifiable and designed to function with a variety of accessories and upgrades, with wielders adapting the laser rifle to their preferences and even kit-bashing it into a nearly unrecognizable weapon.
items.description:
强化： 1

这些可靠的量产步枪从方形枪管射出集中的能量束。协约世界（Pact Worlds）的通用标准型号便于大幅改装，可搭配多种配件与强化模块使用；持用者能依自己的偏好调整激光步枪，甚至混装零件，将其改得几乎面目全非。

items.name: 纳米锋刃刺剑
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

The edge of this precision-crafted foil is sharpened to the thickness of a single atom, using regenerating nanites to maintain itself after countless strikes.
items.description:
强化： 1

这把精工刺剑的刃口被磨至单原子厚度，并用再生纳米机器人在无数次打击后维持锋利。

items.name: 第二皮肤
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 0

Soft but resilient fabric contours perfectly to the wearer's body, offering basic protection without sacrificing comfort. Second skin is commonly worn underneath casual clothing.
items.description:
强化： 0

柔软而坚韧的面料完美贴合穿戴者的身体，在不牺牲舒适度的情况下提供基础防护。第二皮肤通常穿在日常衣服里面。

items.name: 变身
items.expectedDescription: A temporai can take the appearance of any Small, Medium, or Large humanoid. This doesn't change their Speed or their attack and damage modifiers with their Strikes, but it might change the damage type their Strikes deal.
items.description: 时序护卫使可以变成任何小型、中型或大型类人生物的外貌。这不会改变它的速度，也不会改变其打击的攻击和伤害调整值，但可能改变其打击造成的伤害类型。

items.name: 多肢灵巧
items.expectedDescription: A temporai can Switch Hands as a free action.
items.description: 时序护卫使可以使用一个自由动作换手

items.name: 时光尽逝
items.expectedDescription:
The temporai turns their gaze to a single target within 120 feet, forcing upon it all the fragments of time it has shed. The target takes @Damage[12d8[mental]] damage and must attempt a @Check[will|dc:34] save. Regardless of the result, the target then becomes temporarily immune to Out of Time for 1 day.

Critical Success The target takes no damage.

Success The target takes half damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}, or increases these conditions by 1.

Failure As success, but full damage and the conditions' value is 2.

Critical Failure As success, but double damage and the conditions' value is 3.
items.description:
时序护卫使将目光转向120尺内的单一目标，迫使其承受其已剥离的所有时间碎片。目标受到@Damage[12d8[mental]]伤害，且必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:34]豁免。无论结果如何，目标随后临时免疫时光尽逝，持续1天。

大成功 目标不受伤害。

成功 目标受到一半伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙1}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失1}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭1}，或使这些状态的状态值提高1。

失败 如同成功，但受到全额伤害，且这些状态的状态值为2。

大失败 如同成功，但受到双倍伤害，且这些状态的状态值为3。

items.name: 时光之砂
items.expectedDescription: With a flick of their wrist, the temporai disperses a wave of time-altering sand, dealing @Damage[15d6[spirit]|options:area-damage] damage to all creatures in a @Template[type:cone|distance:60] (@Check[fortitude|dc:34|basic] save). Creatures that fail their save are additionally slowed for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}. The temporai can't use Sands of Time again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Sands of Time]]{1d4 rounds}.
items.description: 时序护卫使轻抖手腕，挥散出一波改变时间的砂砾，造成@Damage[15d6[spirit]|options:area-damage]伤害，影响@Template[type:cone|distance:60]内的所有生物（@Check[fortitude|dc:34|basic]豁免）。豁免失败的生物还会陷入缓慢，持续[[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4轮}。时序护卫使在[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Sands of Time]]{1d4轮}内不能再次使用时光之砂。

items.name: 感知命运
items.expectedDescription: A temporai always rolls a 20 for initiative
items.description: 时序护卫使的先攻掷骰结果始终为20。

items.name: 牧者之触
items.expectedDescription: An erabryth's Strikes have the benefit of a ghost killer upgrade and deal an extra 5d6 void damage to living creatures or 5d6 vitality damage to undead.
items.description: 伊拉布里斯引魂使的打击享有灭鬼强化的好处，并对活物额外造成5d6虚能伤害，或对不死生物额外造成5d6命能伤害。

TIAKvaPlJiULdukC.name: 叠态幽骸 Vorthuul
TIAKvaPlJiULdukC.publicNotes: 叠态幽骸是一种不死存在，它拥有两种交叠却并不协调的形态：一种是在无尽折磨中扭曲尖啸的灵魂，另一种则是满溢着宁静的漆黑骸骨。其中一种形态可能会看起显得更加真实，但在下一刻又变得截然相反。

items.name: 重力碾压
items.expectedDescription: 5 feet. A vorthuul is surrounded by the crushing gravitational forces of a black hole. A creature that enters or begins its turn in the aura takes @Damage[3d6[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:26|basic] save).
items.description: 5尺。叠态幽骸周围环绕着黑洞般的碾压引力。进入此灵光或在其中开始回合的生物受到@Damage[3d6[bludgeoning]]伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:26|basic]豁免）。

items.name: 事件视界
items.expectedDescription: A vorthuul naturally draws in light. The DC of the flat check to target a vorthuul @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} or hidden due to dim light or darkness is reduced by 2. A vorthuul takes a –2 circumstance penalty to AC and saving throws against light effects and to AC against attacks from weapons in the laser group.
items.description: 叠态幽骸会自然地吸引光线。当由于叠态幽骸昏暗光照或黑暗而获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]或藏匿时，你以它为目标作出的纯骰检定的DC会降低2点。叠态幽骸在对抗光亮效果时，AC和豁免会承受-2点环境减值，并且在对抗激光武器组的武器作出的攻击时，AC会承受-2点环境减值。

items.name: 量子二元性
items.expectedDescription:
Vorthuuls exist in two states: one in perfect tranquility, the other in perpetual agony. The vorthuul gains bonuses depending on the dominant state. They decide which is dominant as a free action when they roll initiative.

  • Absolute Tranquility The vorthuul gains a +1 status bonus to saves against emotion effects and resistance 10 to mental damage.

  • Everburning Agony The vorthuul gains a +1 status bonus to saves against vitality effects and resistance 10 to fire damage.
items.description:
叠态幽骸同时存在于两种状态：一种处于完美宁静，另一种处于永恒痛苦。叠态幽骸依照占据主导的状态获得加值。它在掷骰先攻时，以一个自由动作决定哪种状态占据主导。

  • 绝对宁静 叠态幽骸对抗情绪效果的豁免获得+1状态加值，并获得对心灵伤害的抗力10。

  • 永燃苦痛 叠态幽骸对抗命能效果的豁免获得+1状态加值，并获得对火焰伤害的抗力10。

items.name: 反应打击
items.expectedDescription: @Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ReactiveStrike]
items.description: @Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ReactiveStrike]

items.name: 虚能治疗
items.expectedDescription: @Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.NegativeHealing]
items.description: @Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.NegativeHealing]

items.name: 重力旋涡
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency once per hour

Effect The vorthuul intensifies their gravitational pull for 1 minute, increasing the radius of their crushing gravity aura to 20 feet. Additionally, while this aura is expanded, creatures moving in any direction other than directly toward the vorthuul treat squares in the aura as difficult terrain.
items.description:
频率每小时一次

效果叠态幽骸增强自身的引力，持续1分钟，使其重力碾压灵光的半径扩大至20尺。此外，在灵光扩大期间，生物向任何非直接朝向叠态幽骸的方向移动时，都将灵光内的方格视为困难地形。

items.name: 量子苦痛
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency once per round

Requirements The vorthuul is in absolute tranquility state

Effect The vorthuul enters everburning agony in torrents of anguish. Each creature in the vorthuul's crushing gravity aura must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:28] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure).
items.description:
频率 每轮一次

需求 叠态幽骸处于绝对宁静状态

效果 叠态幽骸在痛苦的洪流中进入永燃苦痛状态。叠态幽骸重力碾压灵光内的每个生物都必须通过一次@Check[will|dc:28]豁免，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心1}（大失败时为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心2}）。

items.name: 量子宁静
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency once per round

Requirements The vorthuul is in everburning agony state

Effect The vorthuul enters absolute tranquility in a wave of oppressive stillness. Each creature in the vorthuul's crushing gravity aura must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:28] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round (or slowed 1 for 3 rounds on a critical failure).
items.description:
频率 每轮一次

需求 叠态幽骸处于永燃苦痛状态

效果 叠态幽骸在一阵压抑的寂静中进入绝对宁静状态。叠态幽骸重力碾压灵光内的每个生物都必须通过一次@Check[fortitude|dc:28]豁免，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢1}，持续1轮（大失败时为缓慢1，持续3轮）。

items.name: 奇点容器
items.expectedDescription: The vorthuul forces their physical and psychological torment upon a creature they touch. The target must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:28] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} for 1 minute ([[/act escape dc=28]]). As long as it's immobilized in this way, it takes @Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]] damage and @Damage[1d6[mental]] damage at the end of each of its turns. Creatures that Escape become temporarily immune to this vorthuul's Singularity Pocket for 24 hours.
items.description: 叠态幽骸将自身肉体和精神上的折磨强加给它触碰的一个生物。目标必须通过一次@Check[will|dc:28]豁免，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}，持续1分钟（[[/act escape dc=28]]）。只要以此方式被禁足，目标就会在其每个回合结束时受到@Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]]伤害和@Damage[1d6[mental]]伤害。逃脱的生物对该叠态幽骸的奇点容器暂时免疫24小时。

TvSLqbhQ9tZ3Ptp8.name: 废水灵 Wastewither
TvSLqbhQ9tZ3Ptp8.publicNotes:
工业废水若积存过久未处理，会在蒸发时从水元素位面吸引来废水灵。废水灵会污染其接触的一切，将坚实的土地与洁净的水源化为污泥。许多企业排污点和有毒物质泄漏处都会吸引或催生废水灵，而它们的存在又会进一步污染生态系统。

元素生物是原初位面侵入此间的能量化身。它们形态多样，既有风与水中无心智的涡流，也有能够运用原能魔法的复杂实体。太空旅行的兴起与科技的进步，使更多元素的活体化身得以在宇宙中显现。

山火、太阳风暴和洪水等自然事件，可能将大群难以驾驭的元素生物释放到行星或某片星域。有时，强大元素生物的聚集会引发规模惊人的自然灾难，例如烧毁行星电网的超强太阳耀斑，或是在气态巨行星大气中旋转不息的风暴。

items.name: 剧毒气息
items.expectedDescription: 15 feet. A poisonous mist lingers around the wastewither. When a creature enters or starts its turn in the aura, it must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:23] save. Environmental protections or an appropriate spell provides a +2 circumstance bonus to saves against the aura.

U5dR7Q1JtpyfMsIu.name: 机械化战术型战争机器 Robotic Tactical War Machine
U5dR7Q1JtpyfMsIu.publicNotes:
多倍工业公司（Multifold Industries）与泽泽尔军械集团合作，造出了最早的机械化遥控战争机器之一。这台机器代号为“tashtari”，专为快速部署到战场而设计。tashtari能够在远处支援突击部队，同时干扰战场上的敌方通讯。

这场入侵始于阿巴隆的新械族接连发现的探测器。传感器炽亮、长着分节触须的奇异机器不知从何处现身，看似毫无规律地撕裂基础设施，并在整个协约世界宙域搜集情报。恐慌迅速蔓延，但这些机器总会消失得无影无踪，或在被捕获时爆炸，因此始终无法证实目击报告或辨明其身份。流言渐起，称这些机器采用了一种前所未见的生物科技。不久，理事军正式介入，将这些事件封锁在最高机密权限的精金壁垒之后。

后断层纪元325年阳愈月（Sarenith），在数十次军事行动均未能与行踪飘忽的探测器交战之后，一支从伊达里号派出的战斗机联队终于走运，在其中一台机器自毁前将其瘫痪。协约世界的顶尖科学家设法让这台生物科技载具吐露了部分秘密，它由此成为了“本土制造”的遥控战争机器的原型，如今这类机器正接受战斗应用测试。这些仿制品并非活物，而是使用机器人制造模板建造的，因为原始生物科技设计的核心过于复杂，协约科技尚无法对其进行逆向工程。

遥控战争机器是可以从极远距离控制的替身。原始的生物科技战争机器通过心灵链接或未知无线电频率连接驾驶者的心智。机械式遥控战争机器则通过数据链路连接计算机，供驾驶者使用键盘、虚拟现实设备，甚至电子游戏手柄来控制自己的替身。

items.name: 星际通讯

items.description: 这台遥控战争机器会与其驾驶员保持持续的数据连接，并使用驾驶员的语言及技能调整值来处理任何未列出的技能。此外，驾驶员还能通过数据链接以这台遥控战争机器作为“传声筒”进行发声。

US4CO4Q85ZITI6W9.name: 星岩仙后 Sterieid Queen
US4CO4Q85ZITI6W9.publicNotes:
最巨大的小行星是星岩仙后的家园，其中有些直径达数里之遥。由于这些小行星更有可能拥有近似大气层的环境，星岩仙后习惯了与其他居民共享领地；只要她们与环境都受到尊重，她们通常并不介意。

宁芙是美丽的精类，外貌呈现为具有精灵特征的类人生物。她们通常以女性形态现身，但也有各种性别和表现形式的宁芙存在。许多宁芙生活在星球上，担当着自然池塘、森林、洞穴和悬崖的守护者，而其他宁芙——通常被称为太空宁芙——则以与天体相关联而闻名。和她们那些与星球绑定的同类一样，太空宁芙守护着与自己绑定的领地，防止其遭受剥削或伤害。

作为艺术的爱好者，宁芙对富有创造力的人特别友好，提出用故事、图画或歌曲来描绘宁芙，是赢得她们青睐的可靠方法——除非宁芙不喜欢最终的成果，并因艺术家用平庸的作品侮辱她们而大发雷霆。视频播客和直播是较为合群的宁芙中流行的消遣方式，无论是为了展示她们所处的偏远环境，还是为了寻找表演的观众。一些宁芙会吸引电影摄制组到她们的领地拍摄，但有两个条件：一是拍摄不得破坏环境，二是宁芙必须在电影中担任重要角色。

除非她们的领地受到威胁，大多数太空宁芙对凡人持友善或不关心的态度，但她们的记忆力极佳。任何造访太空宁芙领地的人都应该研究该宁芙怀有的怨恨、过往与凡人的接触经历，或是该区域近期发生的任何可能影响宁芙对途经其家园的生物看法的重大事件。

展现出正确态度和能力的凡人，例如通过保护一颗星体免遭毁灭，或创作出特别美丽的艺术品，可能会吸引太空宁芙的注意。有时，太空宁芙会主动提出担任恒星武士（solarians）或秘术师（mystics）的导师，尽管她们很少主动寻找学生。太空宁芙很少同时与不止一个人建立这种关系，并且通常只愿为能持续数十年乃至数百年的关系作出承诺，因此她们在选择学生时极为挑剔。

items.name: 岩石交谈
items.expectedDescription:
You can ask questions of and receive answers from natural or worked stone. While stone is not intelligent, you speak with the natural spirits of the stone, which have a personality colored by the type of stone, as well as by the type of structure the stone is part of, for worked stone. A stone's perspective, perception, and knowledge give it a worldview different enough from a human's that it doesn't consider the same details important. Stones can mostly answer questions about creatures that touched them in the past and what is concealed beneath or behind them.

Heightened (6th) The duration is 8 hours.
items.description:
你能向自然或人造的石材提出问题和得到回答。尽管石材并不具有智能，但你会与石材之中的自然之灵沟通，它们的性格受到石材种类的影响，加工过的石材还会受到其所属建筑类别的影响。石材看待事物的视角、感知能力、以及知识赋予了它与人类截然不同的世界观，以至于它会认为相同的细节并不重要。石材大多都能够回答曾经碰触过它们的生物的相关内容、以及它们下方或后方究竟隐藏着什么。

升阶（6环） 持续时间为8小时。

You shape a wall of solid stone. You create a 1-inch-thick wall of stone up to 120 feet long, and 20 feet high. You can shape the wall's path, placing each 5 feet of the wall on the border between squares. The wall doesn't need to stand vertically, so you can use it to form a bridge or set of stairs, for example. You must conjure the wall in an unbroken open space so its edges don't pass through any creatures or objects, or the spell is lost.

Each 10-foot-by-10-foot section of the wall has AC 10, Hardness 14, and 50 Hit Points, and it's immune to critical hits and precision damage. A destroyed section of the wall can be moved through, but the rubble created from it is difficult terrain.

Heightened (+2) The Hit Points of each section of the wall increase by 15.

每一段10尺乘10尺的墙壁具有AC10，硬度14，以及50生命值，并且它免疫重击和精准伤害。一段被摧毁的墙壁可以移动通过，但是因此留下的碎石会令其变成困难地形。

升阶（+2） 每一段墙的生命值增加15。
