items.description:
你将目标石块变成你选择的粗糙形状。该塑形过程十分粗糙，无法制造复杂的组件，细致的细节，可动部分，或者其他类似的东西。当你塑形一个石头时，站在其上的生物必须尝试一次反射豁免或者特技检定。

成功 目标不受影响。

失败 目标在石头上@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}。

大失败 该生物从石头上摔落（如可能）并且倒地着地。

items.name: 地缚术
items.expectedDescription:
Using the weight of earth, you hamper a target's flight, with effects based on its Fortitude save. If the creature reaches the ground safely, it doesn't take falling damage.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target falls safely up to 120 feet.

Failure The target falls safely up to 120 feet. If it hits the ground, it can't Fly, levitate, or otherwise leave the ground for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target falls safely up to 120 feet. If it hits the ground, it can't Fly, levitate, or otherwise leave the ground for 1 minute.
items.description:
你使用大地的重量以干扰目标的飞行能力，其效果基于强韧豁免。如果该生物安全到达地面，它不会承受坠落伤害。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标安全坠落至多120尺。

失败 目标安全坠落至多120尺。如果它碰到地面，它1轮内不能飞行，浮空或者以其他方式离开地面。

大失败 目标安全坠落至多120尺。如果它碰到地面，它1分钟内不能飞行，浮空或者以其他方式离开地面。

items.name: 闪电枷锁
items.expectedDescription:
You supercharge the targets' electromagnetism and pull them with a tether of lightning. Make a ranged spell attack against each target. If you attack two targets, both attacks count toward your multiple attack penalty, but it doesn't increase until after both attacks. The targets each take 4d8 electricity damage and are pulled 5 feet closer to you, or 10 feet closer on a critical hit. If both attacks hit, you can choose to move the creatures closer to one another instead of closer to you. Moving a target into a barrier, creature, or obstacle causes the target to stop before entering that space.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d8.
items.description:
你使目标的电磁场过载，并以闪电锁链将其拽向自己。对每个目标进行一次远程法术攻击。若攻击两个目标，两次攻击均计入多重攻击减值，但该减值仅在两次攻击完成后生效。每个目标受到4d8电击伤害并且向着你的方向被拉拽5尺（大成功10尺）。如果两次攻击都命中，你可以选择让两个生物彼此靠近而不是被拉向你。如果目标在位移过程中碰到街垒、生物或障碍，目标会在进入那个方格之前停下。

升阶（+1）该伤害增加1d8。

items.name: 生命容器
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature within range enters an environment that would be harmful to it.

A shimmering bubble envelops the target's body, allowing it to breathe normally in a vacuum or other unsafe environment and protecting it from severe temperatures and radiation.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 5 additional creatures to gain protection against the environment the triggering creature entered. The spell lasts for 8 hours and also protects against extreme temperatures and radiation.

Heightened (10th) You can target up to 10 additional creatures to gain protection against the environment the triggering creature entered. The spell lasts until your next daily preparations and also protects against incredible temperatures and radiation.
items.description:
触发射程内的生物进入对其有害的环境。

一个闪亮的气泡包裹目标的身体，让它在真空或其他不安全的环境中正常呼吸，并保护它免受严重（severe）温度和辐射的伤害。

升阶（7环）你可指定最多5个额外生物为目标，使其获得针对触发生物所处环境的防护效果。法术持续8小时，并且可以抵御极端（extreme ）温度和辐射。

升阶（10环）你可指定最多10个额外生物为目标，使其获得针对触发生物所处环境的防护效果。法术持续到你下次日常准备，并能抵御严酷（incredible ）温度和辐射。

items.name: 融身化石
items.expectedDescription:
You can either transform into a stone or merge with stone. While transformed, you can't move or affect anything outside the stone, but you can cast spells as long as they don't require line of effect beyond the stone. You can Dismiss this spell.

  • Merge with Stone The spell's duration is 10 minutes. While casting the spell, you must touch a stone with enough volume to fit you and your possessions or the spell is disrupted. While merged, you can hear, but not see, what's going on outside the stone. If the stone takes damage while you're inside it, you're expelled from the stone and take 10d6 damage. Magic passage expels you without dealing damage. The spell ends if you're ever outside the stone.
  • Turn into a Stone The spell's duration is 8 hours. You become a Large stone. Perception checks don't reveal your true nature, but a successful Nature or Survival check against your spell DC reveals that you appear to be a stone that is strangely new to the area. While in this form, you can observe everything around you, using your normal senses. As a stone, your AC is 23, and only status bonuses, status penalties, circumstance bonuses, and circumstance penalties affect you. Any successes and critical successes you roll on Reflex saves are failures
items.description:
你能选择变化为一块石头或者与石头融合。在变形后，你不能移动，也不能影响任何石头之外的任何事物，但你能够施法，前提是这些法术不需要石头外侧的效果线。你能解消该法术。

  • 与石头融合 法术持续时间为10分钟。当你施法时，你必须碰触一块体积足够容纳你和你的随身物品的石头，否则法术会被打断。在融入之后，你能听到、但不能看到这块石头外侧发生的事情。当你身处石头之内时，若石头承受伤害，你就会被驱逐至石头之外，并且承受10d6点伤害。魔法通道也会把你驱逐出去，但是不会造成伤害。当你离开石头之时，法术便会结束。
  • 变为石头 法术持续时间为8小时。你变为一块大型石头。察觉检定无法揭示出你的真实本质，但是成功通过自然或生存检定对抗你的法术DC，能够揭示出你化身的石头对于该地区来说是一种怪异的新出现的存在。当你处于该形态时，能够使用正常的感官观察自身周遭的一切事物。作为一块石头，你的AC为23，只有状态加值、状态减值、环境加值和环境减值影响你。你在反射豁免中投掷出的任何成功和大成功都被视同为失败。

items.name: 腐蚀转化
items.expectedDescription:
You launch a torrent of magical nanites that begin dissolving your target. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, you deal 3d8 acid damage plus 1d6 persistent acid damage. On a critical hit, double the initial damage, but not the persistent damage.

Heightened (+2) The initial damage increases by 2d8, and the persistent acid damage increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你发射出一股魔法纳米粒子，开始溶解你的目标。对目标进行远程法术攻击检定。命中时，你会造成3d8酸蚀伤害加1d6持续酸蚀伤害。如果大成功，初始伤害加倍，但持续伤害不加倍。

升阶（+2）初始伤害增加2d8，持续酸蚀伤害增加1d6。

items.name: 粉碎音波
items.expectedDescription:
A high-frequency sonic attack shatters a nearby object. You deal 2d10 sonic damage to the object, ignoring the object's Hardness if it is 4 or lower.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10, and the Hardness the spell ignores increases by 2.
items.description:
高频音波攻击击碎附近的一件物体。你对该物体造成2d10音波伤害，如果物体的硬度为4或者更低，忽视该硬度。

升阶（+1） 该伤害增加1d10，法术所能忽视的硬度增加2。

items.name: 侦测魔法
items.expectedDescription:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).
items.description:
你发出一股标记魔法存在的脉冲。你不会获得魔法存在或不存在以外的任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你或者你盟友的魔法物品以及持续法术。仅当幻术魔法的环阶低于你的侦测魔法环阶时，你才能侦测幻术魔法。但是，具有幻术灵光但是没有在外表上做伪装的物品（例如一瓶隐形药水），通常能够正常侦测。

升阶（3环阶） 你能知晓法术侦测出的最强魔法效果的环阶或等级，具体由GM决定。

升阶（4环阶） 如3环阶，你也能指出最高环阶魔法的来源。如同一种模糊感官，你不会了解具体的位置，但是可以将来源锁定到5尺立方（或者最近的那个五尺立方，如果来源体积比这个区域更大）。

items.name: 焕发光彩
items.expectedDescription:
You create an illusion that causes the target to appear more charming and genteel to observers. The spell accentuates the target's appearance, clothing, voice, and mannerisms according to what an observer finds appealing. Held items are unaffected, and any worn item removed from the creature returns to its true appearance.

The target gains a +1 status bonus to Diplomacy checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} and lets the target add its level to Diplomacy checks if untrained. In addition, the target can attempt a Diplomacy check to Gather Information in only 10 minutes. You can Dismiss this spell.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.hOp5ybOzyJlECU6B]

Heightened (+2) The bonus increases by 1, to a maximum of +4 at 7th rank.
items.description:
你制造一种幻象，使目标在观察者面前显得更加迷人和优雅。该法术会根据观察者认为吸引人的地方来突出目标的外表、衣着、声音和举止。手持物品不受影响，从生物身上取下的任何穿戴物品都会恢复原貌。

目标在进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]的交涉检定中获得+1状态加值，如果目标未受训，则可以在进行交涉检定时加上其等级。此外，目标还可以只花10分钟尝试交涉检定进行收集信息。你可以解消此法术。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.hOp5ybOzyJlECU6B]

升阶（+2）加值提升1，最多在7环时提升至+4。

items.name: 神导术
items.expectedDescription:
You ask for the guidance of supernatural entities, granting the target a +1 status bonus to one attack roll, Perception check, saving throw, or skill check the target attempts before the duration ends. The target chooses which roll to use the bonus on before rolling. If the target uses the bonus, the spell ends. Either way, the target is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3qHKBDF7lrHw8jFK]{Spell Effect: Guidance}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3LyOkV25p7wA181H]{Effect: Guidance Immunity}
items.description:
你请求超自然存在的引导，赋予目标在持续时间结束前的一次攻击掷骰、察觉检定、豁免或技能检定上获得+1状态加值。目标在掷骰前选择是否使用该加值。如果目标使用该加值，该法术结束。无论怎样结束，该目标接下来会临时免疫1小时。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3qHKBDF7lrHw8jFK]{法术效果：神导术}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3LyOkV25p7wA181H]{效果：神导术免疫}

items.name: 魔法伎俩
items.expectedDescription:
The simplest magic does your bidding. You can perform simple magical effects for as long as you Sustain the spell. Each time you Sustain the spell, you can choose one of four options.

  • Cook Cool, warm, or flavor 1 pound of nonliving material.
  • Lift Slowly lift an unattended object of light Bulk or less 1 foot off the ground.
  • Make Create a temporary object of negligible Bulk, made of congealed magical substance. The object looks crude and artificial and is extremely fragile-it can't be used as a tool, weapon, or locus or cost for a spell.
  • Tidy Color, clean, or soil an object of light Bulk or less. You can affect an object of 1 Bulk with 10 rounds of concentration, and a larger object at 1 minute per Bulk.

Prestidigitation can't deal damage or cause adverse conditions. Any actual change to an object (beyond what is noted above) persists only as long as you Sustain the spell.
items.description:
最简单的魔法帮你完成杂务。只要你维持该法术，你就可以产生简单的魔法效果。每当你维持该法术时，你可以选择四个选项中的一个。

  • 烹饪 为1磅非活物材料冷却，加热，或者调味。
  • 抬起 将一件轻负载或者更低的无主物品缓慢抬离地面1尺。
  • 创造 创造一个负载可忽略的临时物体，它由凝结的魔法物质组成。该物体看起来粗糙、不自然，且极其脆弱——它无法被用做工具、武器、施法载体或法术费用。
  • 整理 为一件轻负载或者更低的物体染色，清洁，或者弄脏它。你可以通过10轮专注来影响一件1负载的物体，对于更大的物体为每负载1分钟。

魔法伎俩无法造成伤害或者负面效果。对一件物体的任何改变（在上述内容之外的）只会在你仍维持该法术时持续。

items.name: 碎石猛击
items.expectedDescription:
A spray of heavy rocks flies through the air in front of you. The rubble deals 2d4 bludgeoning damage to each creature in the area. Each creature must attempt a Reflex save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is pushed 5 feet away from you.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is pushed 10 feet away from you.

Heightened (+1) Increase the damage by 2d4.
items.description:
一排大石头从你前方的空中飞过。该碎石对区域中每个生物造成2d4钝击伤害 。每个生物必须尝试一次反射豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物承受一半伤害。

失败 该生物承受完整伤害，并且被推离你5尺。

大失败 该生物承受双倍伤害，并且被推离你10尺。

升阶（+1） 该伤害增加2d4。

items.name: 扫描环境
items.expectedDescription:
You analyze the natural environment in the area within 1 mile, learning general information about the atmosphere, biomes, and gravity. You forecast the weather for the next hour, including the direction it will come from; learn which atmospheres, biomes, and gravity are in the area, as well as the direction and distance to those elements; and learn if anything in the area presents an environmental hazard, including cold or heat dangers (at what temperature range), radiation (at what severity), smoke effects, and underwater conditions. This is enough to detect large effects that span spaces over 30 feet in diameter only. You gain a general sense of where and how far away these dangers are.

Heightened (+1) The scanned area increases in radius by 1 mile.
items.description:
你分析1英里范围内的自然环境，了解大气层、生物群落和重力的一般信息。预测未来一小时的天气，包括天气自哪而来；了解该区域有哪些大气、生物群落和重力，以及与这些元素的方向和距离；了解该区域是否存在环境危害，包括冷热危险（在什么温度范围）、辐射（严重程度）、烟雾效果和水下条件。这足以探测到直径超过30英尺的大型效果。你可以大致了解这些危险的位置和距离。

升阶（+1）扫描范围增加1英里。

items.name: 寻觅星辰
items.expectedDescription:
In your mind's eye, you chart a path through the cosmos. If you're in Pact Worlds space, you immediately know which direction to travel in order to reach the Starstone on Absalom Station. If you're outside the Pact System, you know the direction to the nearest Drift beacon or the Starstone.

Heightened (7th) You can instead know the direction to a familiar location, such as a world or way station you've visited.
items.description:
在你的脑海中，你绘制了一条穿越宇宙的路径。如果你在协约世界的空间中，你就能立刻知道前往星石和艾巴萨罗姆空间站的方向。如果你在协约世界以外的空间，你会知道前往最近的漂流信标或星石的方向。

升阶（7环）你可以知道前往熟悉地点的方向，例如你曾经去过的世界或中转站。

items.name: 跌绊术
items.expectedDescription:
A burst of microgravity causes a tremor around the target, pulling it toward the ground. The target must attempt a Reflex save.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round. If the target was flying, swimming, or floating, it falls 10 feet downward.

Critical Failure The target falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. If the target was flying, swimming, or floating, it falls 20 feet downward.

Heightened (+1) If the target falls, it falls an additional 5 feet on a failure and 10 feet on a critical failure.
items.description:
一阵微弱重力会在目标周围造成震颤，将其拉向地面。目标尝试反射豁免。

失败目标会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]1轮。如果目标是在飞行、游泳或漂浮，则会向下坠落10尺。

大失败目标@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]。如果目标正在飞行、游泳或漂浮，则会向下坠落20尺。

升阶（+1） 如果目标在飞行，失败时会额外向下坠落5尺，大失败时会额外向下坠落10尺。

items.name: 天体链接
items.expectedDescription:
A nymph queen is intrinsically tied to a specific celestial body, such as a supergiant star for a heliad queen.

As long as the queen is healthy, her territory thrives, and she can attempt to [[/r 1d20+21 #Counteract]] counteract spells and rituals that alter its physical properties with a counteract rank of 5.

If a nymph queen is injured or unhealthy, however, her celestial body also weakens: asteroids wobble out of orbit, stars dim, and the gravity of black holes diminishes. Restoring the nymph queen returns her celestial body to its equilibrium.
items.description:
仙后与某一特定天体有着内在联系，例如炽光仙后与一颗超巨星相连。

只要仙后健康，她的领地便欣欣向荣，她也可以尝试以[[/r 1d20+21 #Counteract]]抵消会改变该天体物理性质的法术和仪式，抵消环阶为5。

但如果仙后受伤或不健康，她的天体也会衰弱：小行星摇晃着偏离轨道、恒星黯淡、黑洞的引力减弱。使仙后恢复健康也会使其天体重归平衡。

items.name: 碎岩场域
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger The sterieid takes physical damage

Effect Shards of rocky debris fly off the sterieid's body, dealing @Damage[3d12[bludgeoning]] damage to all adjacent creatures (@Check[reflex|dc:29|basic] save) and giving the sterieid the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition until the end of their next turn.
items.description:
触发星岩仙女受到物理伤害

效果岩石碎片从星岩仙女的身体上飞射而出，对所有相邻生物造成@Damage[3d12[bludgeoning]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:29|basic]豁免），并使星岩仙女陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}状态，直到其下个回合结束。

items.name: 冰冷灵气
items.expectedDescription: 20 feet. A sterieid's body radiates an icy chill. Creatures entering or starting their turns in the aura take @Damage[3d6[cold]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:29|basic] save); a creature that critically fails its save is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} until the start of its next turn as it grows sluggish from the cold.
items.description: 20尺。星岩仙女的身体散发冰寒。进入此灵光或在其中开始回合的生物受到@Damage[3d6[cold]]伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:29|basic]豁免）；豁免大失败的生物还会因寒冷而变得迟钝，陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙1}，直到该生物的下个回合开始。

items.name: 散播魅力
items.expectedDescription:
The nymph queen magically superimposes her image on all technological items capable of displaying it, such as datapads or comm units, within planetary range. Alternatively, she can send this image to any comm address or addresses that she knows.

Each creature that can see the image must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:29] or have their attitude toward her improve by one step (two steps on a critical failure).

Affected creatures' attitudes revert to their previous level if the nymph queen uses a hostile action against them or their allies.
items.description:
宁芙仙后以魔法将自己的影像叠加显示在行星范围内所有能够显示该影像的科技物品上，例如数据板或通讯器。她也可以选择将此影像发送至自己知道的任意一个或多个通讯地址。

每个能看见影像的生物都必须通过一次@Check[will|dc:29]，否则对她的态度提升一级（大失败时提升两级）。

若宁芙仙后对受影响的生物或其盟友使用敌对动作，受影响生物的态度便恢复为先前的水平。

items.name: 天体跃迁
items.expectedDescription: A nymph queen can traverse her celestial body near-instantaneously. A nymph queen can use Celestial Step to teleport to any area on or within her territory, vanishing into its surface and reemerging at her intended destination.
items.description: 宁芙仙后几乎能瞬间穿越自己的天体。宁芙仙后可以用天体跃迁，潜入天体表面，再从预定目的地出现，传送到其领地表面或内部的任意区域。

items.name: 变身
items.expectedDescription: Nymph queens can transform between their original form, which looks much like a typical nymph of their kind, and any Small or Medium humanoid form, typically choosing a version of their natural form with the appearance of the chosen species.
items.description: 宁芙仙后可以在原形与任何小型或中型类人生物形态之间变身；其原形看起来非常像同种的典型宁芙。她们通常选择保留自身天然形貌、但具有所选物种外貌的形态。

items.name: 联络粉丝
items.expectedDescription:
A nymph queen can inspire a single intelligent creature by sending them a motivational video or text message. As long as the creature keeps the message saved and remains in good standing with the nymph queen, they gain a +1 status bonus to all Crafting, Performance, and Lore checks related to art or performance.

As a 1-action Interact action, the creature can play or view the message to bolster their spirits. Doing so allows the creature to attempt a [[/r 1d20+21 #Counteract]] counteract check against a single emotion effect affecting them.

When the nymph queen's message is used in this way, it becomes a mundane video or text afterward.
items.description:
仙后可以通过向单一有智能生物发送励志视频或文字信息来鼓舞其精神。只要该生物仍保存着这条信息，且与仙后关系良好，其所有与艺术或表演相关的手艺、表演和学识检定获得+1状态加值。

该生物可以用一个1动作的交互动作，播放或查看信息，以振奋精神。这允许该生物尝试一次[[/r 1d20+21 #Counteract]]抵消检定，对抗正影响其的单一情绪效果。

仙后的信息以此方式使用后，会变为普通的视频或文字。

items.name: 原子能爆破
items.expectedDescription:
You magically split an atom, creating an explosion with radioactive fallout. All creatures in the area take 5d12 bludgeoning damage and 5d12 fire damage, and they're exposed to extreme radiation that uses your spellcasting DC as the @Check[fortitude]{Fortitude DC} for radiation sickness incurred by exposure to this radiation. The onset and frequency of this magical radiation is 1 round, and the area remains radioactive for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The target is unaffected by the initial damage.

Success The target takes half damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 minute.

Failure The target takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, and the target takes double damage.
items.description:
你用魔法分裂一个原子，制造一场带有放射性尘埃的爆炸。区域内的所有生物都会受到5d12钝击伤害和5d12火焰伤害，并暴露于极端辐射环境下，该辐射会导致辐射病，使用你的法术DC作为染上此辐射病的@Check[fortitude]{强韧DC}。这种魔法辐射的潜伏期和频率为1轮，该区域在10分钟内持续辐射。

大成功目标不受初始伤害影响。

成功目标受到一半伤害并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]1分钟。

失败目标受到全额伤害并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]1分钟。

大失败同失败，目标受到双倍伤害。

items.name: 地震术
items.expectedDescription:
You shake the ground, topple creatures into fissures, and collapse structures. The GM might add additional effects in certain areas. Cliffs might collapse, causing creatures to fall, or a lake might drain as fissures open up below its surface, leaving a morass of quicksand.

  • Shaking Ground The ground is difficult terrain, and creatures on it take a -2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls, AC, and skill checks. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.09rtx50laDw68FGT]{Spell Effect: Earthquake (Shaking Ground)}
  • Fissures Each creature on the ground must attempt a Reflex save at the start of its turn to keep its footing and avoid falling into 40-foot-deep fissures that open beneath it. The fissures are permanent, and their sides require successful @Check[athletics|dc:15|traits:action:climb] to Climb.
  • Collapse Structures and ceilings might collapse. The GM rolls a flat check for each (@Check[flat|dc:16] for a sturdy structure, @Check[flat|dc:14] for an average structure and most natural formations, @Check[flat|dc:9] for a shoddy structure, all adjusted higher or lower as the GM sees fit). A collapse deals 11d6 bludgeoning damage to each creature caught in it with a basic Reflex save. A creature falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} unless it critically succeeds and falls into a fissure if it critically fails.

Heightened (10th) You create a massive earthquake that can devastate a settlement. The range increases to half a mile and the area to a quarter-mile burst.
items.description:
你震撼大地，将生物绊入裂谷，并且摧毁建筑。在特定环境中，GM可能会增加额外的效果。悬崖可能会崩塌，造成生物坠落，湖可能会由于其下方的裂隙而干涸，剩下一片流沙陷阱。

  • 震撼大地 地面成为困难地形，其上的生物在攻击掷骰、AC及技能检定上承受-2环境减值。@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.09rtx50laDw68FGT]{法术效果：地震术（震撼大地）}
  • 裂隙 每个在地面上的生物必须在其回合开始时尝试一次反射豁免，以站稳脚步来避免坠落到脚下裂开的40尺深的缝隙中。这些裂隙是永久的，攀爬其侧面需要成功通过@Check[athletics|dc:15|traits:action:climb]检定。
  • 崩塌 建筑物和顶棚可能会崩塌。GM为每座建筑或顶棚进行一次纯骰检定（坚固建筑@Check[flat|dc:16]，常规建筑和多数自然结构@Check[flat|dc:14]，粗劣建筑@Check[flat|dc:9]，GM均可按合适调整其高低）。崩塌对每个处于崩塌中的生物造成11d6钝击伤害，尝试一次基础反射豁免。除非它大成功，否则会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}，并且如果大失败会坠入裂隙。

升阶（10环） 你可以创造一个范围巨大的足以摧毁一个聚居地的地震。射程增加到半里，范围为四分之一里爆发。

items.name: 重力场
items.expectedDescription:
Bending the laws of the Universe to your will, you increase the forces of gravity in an area. All flying creatures in the area descend 40 feet. The entire area is greater difficult terrain for Flying and Climbing creatures, and difficult terrain for creatures on the ground. Any creature pulled to the ground by a gravity field takes bludgeoning damage as though it had fallen.

Gravity in the area increases by one step (for example, zero-g becomes low gravity, low gravity becomes standard, standard gravity becomes high gravity, and high gravity becomes extreme gravity).
items.description:
你扭曲宇宙法则，增强一个区域内的重力。区域内所有飞行生物下降40尺。整个区域对飞行生物和攀爬生物来说是高等困难地形，对地面生物来说是困难地形。任何被重力场拉到地面上的生物都会受到钝击伤害，如同坠落一样。

该区域内的重力增加一级（例如，零重力变为低重力，低重力变为标准重力，标准重力变为高重力，高重力变为极端重力）。

items.name: 辟能圣盾
items.expectedDescription:
You protect the target with a powerful, long-lasting energy barrier. The target gains resistance 5 to acid, cold, electricity, fire, force, sonic, vitality, and void damage.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.4Lo2qb5PmavSsLNk]{Spell Effect: Energy Aegis}

Heightened (9th) The resistances increase to 10.
items.description:
你使用长效的强力能量护盾保护目标。目标获得对酸蚀、寒冷、电击、火焰、力场、音波、命能、以及虚能伤害的抗力5。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.4Lo2qb5PmavSsLNk]{法术效果：辟能圣盾}

升阶（9环） 该抗力提升到10。

items.name: 钢墙术
items.expectedDescription:
You shape a wall of solid steel. You create a 4-inch-thick wall of steel up to 120 feet long and 20 feet high. You can shape the wall's path, placing each 5 feet of the wall on the border between squares. The wall doesn't need to stand vertically, so you can use it to form a bridge or set of stairs, for example. You must conjure the wall in an unbroken open space so its edges don't pass through any creatures or objects, or the spell is lost.

Each 10-foot-by-10-foot section of the wall has AC 10, Hardness 18, and 60 Hit Points, and it's immune to critical hits and precision damage. A destroyed section of the wall can be moved through, but the rubble created from it is difficult terrain.

Heightened (+1) The Hit Points of each section of the wall increase by 15.
items.description:
你塑造一面固体钢墙。你创造一面4英尺厚，至多120尺长，20尺高的钢铁墙体。你可以塑造墙体的轨迹，将每一段5尺的墙放在方格的边界上。墙不需要垂直竖立，所以你可以用其来形成桥或者阶梯。你必须将墙召唤在连续的开放空间里，其边缘不能穿过任何生物或物体，否则法术便会失败。

每块10尺见方的墙段具有AC 10、硬度18和60点生命值，并且免疫重击和精准伤害。被摧毁的墙段可以穿过，但它产生的瓦砾属于困难地形。

升阶（+1）每段墙体的生命值增加15。

items.name: 火箭冲撞
items.expectedDescription:
You emit a rocket of flame from behind you and blast forward. You move in a straight line up to twice your Speed; you can move through spaces occupied by creatures, and the movement doesn't trigger reactions. Creatures in the area take 6d12 fire damage with a basic Reflex save. On a critical failure, a creature also takes 2d6 persistent fire damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round. You reappear at the end of the line.

Heightened (+2) The fire damage increases by 2d12, and the persistent fire damage on a critical failure increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你向身后火箭喷射，极速向前冲刺。你直线移动两倍于你速度的距离，你可以穿过被生物占据的空间，并且这一移动不会触发反应。在区域内的生物受到6d12火焰伤害，这具有一次基础反射豁免。在大失败时，该生物还会额外受到2d6持续火焰伤害并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]1轮。你将重新出现在直线的终点。

升阶（+2）火焰伤害增加2d12，豁免大失败的持续火焰伤害增加1d6。

items.name: 切割现实
items.expectedDescription:
You slice through reality, forming a chasm of life-draining entropy in a straight line 20 feet high, 120 feet long, and 2 inches thick. The chasm provides cover. The chasm deals 7d8 void damage to each creature that's in the chasm's space when it's created, that attempts to pass through the chasm, or that ends its turn inside the chasm, with a basic Reflex save. A creature that succeeds at this save when the chasm is created is pushed to the nearest space on the side of its choice. Creatures trying to move through the chasm fail to do so if they critically fail the save, ending their movement next to the chasm.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d8.
items.description:
你划破现实，在一条20尺高、120尺长、2英寸厚的直线上形成一道能使生命流失的熵裂隙。裂隙提供掩蔽。裂隙会对在形成时位于其空间内、试图穿过裂隙或在裂隙内结束回合的每个生物造成7d8虚能伤害，具有一次基础反射豁免。如果生物在裂隙形成时豁免成功，则会被推到其选择的一侧最近的空间。试图穿过裂隙的生物如果豁免失败，就会在裂隙旁结束移动。

升阶（+1）伤害增加 1d8。

items.name: 等离子墙
items.expectedDescription:
You shape a wall of crackling plasma that burns creatures passing through it. You create either a 5-foot-thick wall of plasma in a straight line up to 60 feet long and 10 feet high, or a 5-foot-thick, 10-foot-radius ring of plasma with the same height. The wall stands vertically in either form; if you wish, the wall can be of a shorter length or height. Everything on each side of the wall is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} from creatures on the opposite side. Any creature that crosses the wall or is occupying the wall's area at the start of its turn takes 4d6 fire damage and 2d6 persistent electricity damage.

Heightened (+1) The persistent electricity damage increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你塑造一面由劈啪作响的等离子体形成的墙壁，其会燃烧通过的生物。你创造一条5尺厚，至多60尺长10尺高的直线墙体，或者5尺厚，10尺半径，相同高度的环形墙体。不论哪种形式，墙体都垂直竖立。如果你愿意，墙体可以更短或者更矮。墙体两侧的任何物体对彼此都是@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]的。任何试图穿过墙体或者在墙体占据区域内开始回合的生物受到4d6火焰伤害和2d6持续电击伤害。

升阶（+1）持续电击伤害增加1d6。

items.name: X光视域
items.expectedDescription: You empower yourself to see through most materials and walls within 60 feet. Your sight is blocked by 2 feet of wood or plastic, 1 foot of stone, 2 inches of common metal, or any amount of lead or any starmetal, and you can only see in black and white.
items.description: 你激活透视能力，可看穿60尺内大多数材质与墙体。你的视线会被2尺厚的木材或塑料，1尺厚的岩石，2寸厚的普通金属或者任意厚度的铅或星金阻隔，并且你的视野为黑白的。

items.name: 控制机器
items.expectedDescription:
You take control of a technological creature or object and command it telepathically. If you issue an obviously self-destructive order to a sapient target, the target doesn't act until you issue a new order. The effect depends on its Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} as it fights off your commands.

Failure You control the target. It gains the controlled condition, but it can attempt a Will save at the end of each of its turns. On a success, the spell ends.

Critical Failure As a failure, but the target receives a new save only if it's sapient and you give it a new order that's against its nature, such as killing its allies.

Heightened (10th) The duration is unlimited.
items.description:
你控制一个科技生物或物体，并通过心灵感应命令它。如果你向有智能的目标下达明显会使其自我毁灭的命令，目标不会行动，直到你下达新的命令。效果取决于其意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标在抵抗你的命令时陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑1}。

失败 你控制目标。其获得被控制状态，但可以在其每个回合结束时尝试一次意志豁免。成功时，法术结束。

大失败 如同失败，但只有当目标具有智能，且你向其下达违背其本性的新命令（例如杀死盟友）时，目标才获得新的豁免机会。

升阶（10环） 持续时间变为无限。

items.name: 系统超荷
items.expectedDescription:
You flood the area with a wave of electrical interference. You deal 7d8 electricity damage to creatures in the area. Each creature in the area must attempt a Reflex save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage, and any of its items with the tech trait become glitching 1 for 1 minute or until the condition is removed.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage, and any of its items with the tech trait become glitching 2 for 1 minute or until the condition is removed.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d8.
items.description:
你用电磁干涉淹没区域。对区域内所有其他生物造成7d8电击伤害。每个区域内的生物都必须尝试一次反射豁免。

大成功目标不受影响。

成功目标受到一半伤害。

失败目标受到全部伤害并且所有具有科技特征的物品会陷入故障1持续1分钟或者被移除。

大失败目标受到两倍伤害并且所有具有科技特征的物品会陷入故障2持续1分钟或者被移除。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 1d8。

items.name: 毒云术
items.expectedDescription:
You conjure a poisonous fog. This functions as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9XHmC2JgTUIQ1CCm]{Mist}, except the area moves 10 feet away from you each round. You deal 6d8 poison damage to each breathing creature that starts its turn in the spell's area. You can Dismiss the spell.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d8.
items.description:
你创造一团有毒云雾。该效果如同@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9XHmC2JgTUIQ1CCm]{迷雾术}一般，除了该区域会每轮远离你10尺。在法术区域内开始回合的每个需要呼吸的生物受到6d8毒素伤害。你可以解消该法术。

升阶（+1） 该伤害增加1d8。

items.name: 困惑术
items.expectedDescription:
You befuddle your target with strange impulses, causing it to act randomly. The effects are determined by the target's Will save. You can Dismiss the spell.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target babbles incoherently and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 minute. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns to end the confusion.

Critical Failure The target is Confused for 1 minute, with no save to end early.

Heightened (8th) You can target up to 10 creatures.
items.description:
你以奇异的冲动扰乱目标心智，使其随机行动。法术效果由目标的意志豁免决定。你可以解消该法术。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标胡言乱语，并且获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 1}。

失败 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{困惑}1分钟。在其每个回合结束，它能尝试一次新豁免来结束困惑术。

大失败 目标困惑1分钟，并且没有提前结束的豁免。

升阶（8环阶） 你能以至多10个生物为目标。

items.name: 火焰护盾（恒定）
items.expectedDescription:
You create a hovering shield made of fire. As long as the shield persists, its heat grants you cold resistance 5 and makes you immune to mild and severe environmental cold. You can Raise a Shield with the fire shield as a normal shield to gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC. You can use the Shield Block reaction with the fire shield, which has Hardness 10, is immune to fire, and has 40 HP (with no Broken Threshold), and its Hardness is halved against effects that have the water trait. If you Shield Block a melee attack that is either an unarmed attack or made by an adjacent attacker, the attacker takes 2d6 fire damage.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.1RsScTvNdGD9zGWe]{Spell Effect: Fire Shield}

Heightened (+2) The cold resistance increases by 5, the HP increase by 10, and the fire damage increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你创造出一面由火焰构成的盾牌悬停在空中。只要盾牌存在，它的热量就会让你获得5点寒冷抗力，使你免疫环境中的轻度寒冷及严寒。你能如同使用普通盾牌一般对火焰护盾使用举盾动作并使得AC获得+1环境加值。你也能使用火焰护盾进行盾牌格挡反应动作，它具有10点硬度、免疫火焰、以及40点生命值（不具有破损阈值），其硬度在对抗具有水特征的效果时减半。若你盾牌格挡一次近战攻击，且该次攻击是无武装攻击或者由相邻攻击者作出的话，攻击者承受2d6点火焰伤害。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.1RsScTvNdGD9zGWe]{法术效果：火焰护盾}

升阶（+2） 寒冷抗力增加5点，生命值增加10点，火焰伤害增加1d6点。

items.name: 次元移位
items.expectedDescription:
You instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to an unoccupied space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container—the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are then temporarily immune for 1 hour.
items.description:
你立即将自身以及自己正在穿戴和持有的物品从当前空间转移走，移动至法术射程内你能看到的未被占据的空间。如果这将会带着其他生物与你一同移动——即便你把该生物放置在异次元容器中——你就会失去该法术。

升阶（5环） 法术射程增加至1里。你不需要看到目的地，只要你曾经去过目的地，并且知晓该地点与你相对的位置以及距离即可。之后你会在1小时内临时免疫该法术。

items.name: 行动无碍
items.expectedDescription:
You repel effects that would hinder a creature or slow its movement. While under this spell's effect, the target ignores effects that would give them a circumstance penalty to Speed. When they attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} an effect that has them @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, they automatically succeed unless the effect is magical and of a higher rank than the unfettered movement spell.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.CdAyAiMGESvgNQtz]{Spell Effect: Unfettered Movement}
items.description:
你驱散可能影响一个生物的阻碍。当处于该法术效果中时，法术目标忽视会赋予其速度环境减值的效果。当法术目标尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{逃脱}一个令其@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{受擒}或者@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{束缚}的效果时，它自动成功，除非该效果是魔法性的，并且其环阶比行动无碍更高。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.CdAyAiMGESvgNQtz]{法术效果：行动无碍}

items.name: 蒸汽形态
items.expectedDescription:
The target transforms into a vaporous state. In this state, the target is amorphous. It loses any item bonus to AC and all other effects and bonuses from armor, and it uses its proficiency modifier for unarmored defense. It gains resistance 8 to physical damage and is immune to precision damage. It can't cast spells, activate items, or use actions that have the attack or manipulate trait. It gains a fly Speed of 10 feet and can slip through tiny cracks. The target can Dismiss the spell.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.sILRkGTwoBywy0BU]{Spell Effect: Vapor Form}
items.description:
目标变化成气体形态。在此状态下，目标形态不定。它失去所有AC上的物品加值，以及从护甲得到的所有其他效果和加值，并且使用其熟练度调整值用于无甲防御。它对物理伤害获得抗力8，并且免疫精准伤害。它无法施放法术，启动物品，或者使用具有攻击或者操作特征的动作。它获得10尺飞行速度，并且可以钻过微小的缝隙。目标可以解消该法术。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.sILRkGTwoBywy0BU]{法术效果：蒸汽形态}

items.name: 目盲术
items.expectedDescription:
You blind the target. The effect is determined by the target's Fortitude save. The target then becomes temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} until its next turn begins.

Failure The target is Blinded for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is Blinded permanently.
items.description:
你令目标目盲。法术效果由目标的强韧豁免决定。目标会临时免疫1分钟。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标直到其下个回合开始前陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲}。

失败 目标目盲1分钟。

大失败 目标永久目盲。

items.name: 火球术
items.expectedDescription:
A roaring blast of fire detonates at a spot you designate, dealing 6d6 fire damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.
items.description:
在你指定的位置爆发出咆哮的烈焰，造成6d6火焰伤害。

升阶（+1） 该伤害增加2d6。

items.name: 火球术
items.expectedDescription:
A roaring blast of fire detonates at a spot you designate, dealing 6d6 fire damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.
items.description:
在你指定的位置爆发出咆哮的烈焰，造成6d6火焰伤害。

升阶（+1） 该伤害增加2d6。

items.name: 加速术
items.expectedDescription:
Magic empowers the target to act faster. It gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition and can use the extra action each round only for Strike and Stride actions.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 6 creatures.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ElkXovNrHB0Doi6O]{Spell Effect: Haste}
items.description:
魔法强化了目标，令其行动迅速。它获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{迅捷}状态，并且每轮只能将额外动作用于打击或行走。

升阶（7环阶） 你能以至多6个生物为目标。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ElkXovNrHB0Doi6O]{法术效果：加速术}

items.name: 缓慢术
items.expectedDescription:
You dilate the flow of time around the target, slowing its actions.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} for 1 minute.

Heightened (6th) You can target up to 10 creatures.
items.description:
你令目标周围的时间膨胀，令其行动缓慢。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 1} ，持续1轮。

失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 1}，持续1分钟。

大失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 2}，持续1分钟。

升阶（6环） 你能以至多10个生物为目标。

items.name: 迷雾术
items.expectedDescription: You call forth a cloud of mist. All creatures within the mist become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and all creatures outside the mist become concealed to creatures within it. You can Dismiss the cloud.
items.description: 你唤来一团迷雾。在雾中的所有生物获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}，并且在雾外的所有生物对其内的生物获得隐蔽。你可以解消这团云雾。

items.name: 识破无形
items.expectedDescription:
Your gaze pierces through illusions and finds @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} creatures and spirits. You can see invisible creatures as though they weren't invisible, although their features are blurred, making them @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} and difficult to identify. You can also see incorporeal creatures, like ghosts, phased through an object from within 10 feet of an object's surface as blurry shapes seen through those objects. Subtler clues also grant you a +2 status bonus to checks you make to disbelieve illusions.

Heightened (5th) This spell has a duration of 8 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.T5bk6UH7yuYog1Fp]{Spell Effect: See the Unseen}
items.description:
你的目光穿透了幻术，发现了隐形生物和魂灵。你能看到@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}生物，就如同它们并未隐形一般，然而它们的体征仍然很模糊，使得它们具有@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}并且难以被识别。你还能看到虚体生物，比如穿入物体内的幽灵；你能透过物体，看到位于物体表面以内10尺内的此类生物的模糊轮廓。对细节更强的洞察力还让你在进行识破幻术的检定时，获得+2状态加值。

升阶（5环） 持续时间为8小时。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.T5bk6UH7yuYog1Fp]{法术效果：识破无形}

items.name: 身健体康
items.expectedDescription:
You send a surge of healing energy to restore the target's body. Attempt to counteract an effect of your choice imposing one of these conditions on the target: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened}. If you didn't counteract the effect, but you would have if its counteract rank were 2 lower, instead suppress the effect until the beginning of your next turn. The effect's duration doesn't elapse while it's suppressed.

This spell can't counteract or suppress curses, diseases, or conditions that are part of the target's normal state.

Heightened (4th) Add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed} to the list of conditions.

Heightened (6th) As 4th rank, plus add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dTwPJuKgBQCMxixg]{Petrified}.

Heightened (8th) As 4th rank, plus add petrified and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned}.
items.description:
你送出一股治愈的能量以恢复目标的躯体。尝试反制目标上的任一个由你选择的造成下列状态的效果：@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{耳聋}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心}。如果你未能反制该效果，但是如果其反制环阶低2的话你会成功，则改为压制该效应，直至你的下回合开始。在被压制时，该效果的持续时间不会减少。

此法术无法反制或压制诅咒、疾病或属于目标正常状态一部分的状态。

升阶（4环） 增加@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢}到状态列表中。

升阶（6环） 同4环阶，额外增加@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dTwPJuKgBQCMxixg]{石化}到状态列表中。

升阶（8环） 同4环阶，额外增加石化和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑}到状态列表中。

items.name: 分析目标
items.expectedDescription:
You focus on the target, gathering data as magical holograms display information. When the casting is complete, you learn biometric information about the target, including its fingerprints, medical conditions, and other basic physiological information. You or anyone you advise about the analysis gains a +1 status bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} the creature, to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} on the creature, and to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about it. If the target is illusory or under the effects of illusion magic, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your analyze target spell.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

Heightened (3rd) The status bonus increases to +2, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Heightened (6th) The status bonus increases to +3, and you can target any number of creatures.
items.description:
你专注在目标身上，收集数据并以魔法全息图像显示。当施法完成，你会获得目标的所有生物特征信息，包括指纹、医疗状况和其他基本生理信息。你或任何得到你基于分析建议的人，在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]为该生物、对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]、以及对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]的检定上获得+1状态加值。如果目标是幻觉或者处于幻术魔法效果下，仅当效果的环级低于你分析目标的法术环级，你才能够探测到结果。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

升阶（3环）状态加值提升到+2，并且你可以至多10名生物作为目标。

升阶（6环）状态加值提升到+3，并且你可以任意名生物作为目标。

items.name: 酸液喷溅
items.expectedDescription:
You fling a large glob of acid that immediately detonates, spraying nearby creatures. Creatures in the area take 1d8 acid damage with a basic Reflex save; on a critical failure, the creature also takes @Damage[(1+floor((@item.rank -1)/2))[persistent,acid]] damage.

Heightened (+2) The initial damage increases by 1d8, and the persistent damage on a critical failure increases by 1.
items.description:
你发射一团立即爆发的酸液，泼溅到周围生物上。区域中的生物承受1d8酸蚀伤害，这有一次基础反射豁免；在大失败时，该生物也会承受@Damage[(1+floor((@item.rank -1)/2))[persistent,acid]]伤害。

升阶（+2） 该初始伤害增加1d8，并且大失败时的持续伤害增加1。

items.name: 命令术
items.expectedDescription:
You shout a command that's hard to ignore. You can command the target to approach you, run away (as if it had the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition), release what it's holding, drop @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, or stand in place. It can't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.A72nHGUtNXgY5Ey9]{Delay} or take any reactions until it has obeyed your command. The effects depend on the target's Will save.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure For the first action on its next turn, the creature must use a single action to do as you command.

Critical Failure The target must use all its actions on its next turn to obey your command.

Heightened (5th) You can target up to 10 creatures.
items.description:
你喊出一句难以被忽视的命令。你可以命令目标接近你，逃离你（如同获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}状态），扔下持有物，@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}，或者站立在原地。它不能@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.A72nHGUtNXgY5Ey9]{延迟}或者使用任何反应动作，直到它服从你的命令为止。法术效果基于目标的意志豁免。

成功 目标不受影响。

失败 作为该生物下个回合的第一个动作，其必须用一个单动作来完成你的命令。

大失败 目标必须使用其下个回合的全部动作来完成你的命令。

升阶（5环） 你能以至多10个生物为目标。

items.name: 侦测魔法
items.expectedDescription:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).
items.description:
你发出一股标记魔法存在的脉冲。你不会获得魔法存在或不存在以外的任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你或者你盟友的魔法物品以及持续法术。仅当幻术魔法的环阶低于你的侦测魔法环阶时，你才能侦测幻术魔法。但是，具有幻术灵光但是没有在外表上做伪装的物品（例如一瓶隐形药水），通常能够正常侦测。

升阶（3环阶） 你能知晓法术侦测出的最强魔法效果的环阶或等级，具体由GM决定。

升阶（4环阶） 如3环阶，你也能指出最高环阶魔法的来源。如同一种模糊感官，你不会了解具体的位置，但是可以将来源锁定到5尺立方（或者最近的那个五尺立方，如果来源体积比这个区域更大）。

items.name: 油腻术
items.expectedDescription:
You conjure grease, choosing an area or target.

  • Area [4 contiguous 5-foot squares] All solid ground in the area is covered with grease. Each creature standing on the greasy surface must succeed at a Reflex save or an Acrobatics check against your spell DC or fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. Creatures using an action to move onto the greasy surface during the spell's duration must attempt either a Reflex save or an Acrobatics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance}. A creature that Steps or Crawls doesn't have to attempt a check or save.
  • Target [1 object of Bulk 1 or less] If you Cast the Spell on an unattended object, anyone trying to pick up the object must succeed at an Acrobatics check or Reflex save against your spell DC to do so. If you target an attended object, the creature that has the object must attempt an Acrobatics check or Reflex save. On a failure, the holder or wielder takes a –2 circumstance penalty to all checks that involve using the object; on a critical failure, the holder or wielder releases the item. The object lands in an adjacent square of the GM's choice. If you Cast this Spell on a worn object, the wearer gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves against attempts to grapple them.
items.description:
你创造一片油，选择区域或是目标。

  • 区域 [4个连续的5尺方格] 区域中的所有坚实地面覆盖上一层油。在油滑的表面上站立的生物必须尝试成功通过一次对抗你法术DC的反射或者特技检定，否则@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}。在法术持续时间内，使用动作移动到油滑表面上的生物必须尝试一次反射豁免或者特技检定来@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{保持平衡}。快步或者爬行的生物无需尝试检定或者豁免。
  • 目标 [一个1负载或者更低的物体] 如果你对无主物品施放该法术，任何尝试捡起该物体的人必须成功尝试一次对抗你法术DC的特技检定或者反射豁免才能如此做。如果你以被持有的物品为目标，拥有该物品的生物必须尝试一次特技检定或者反射豁免。失败时，持握者或者持用者在使用该物体的所有检定上承受-2环境减值；在大失败时，持握者或者持用者会掉落该物品。该物品会掉落在一个由GM选择的相邻方格内。如果你对一个穿戴物品施放该法术，穿戴者在对抗擒拿他的强韧豁免上获得+2环境加值。

items.name: 引火术
items.expectedDescription:
You snap your fingers and point at a target, which begins to smolder. Make a spell attack roll against the target's AC, dealing 2d4 fire damage on a hit. If the target is within your melee reach, you can choose to make a melee spell attack with the flame instead of a ranged spell attack, which increases all the spell's damage dice to d6s.

Critical Success The target takes double damage and 1d4 persistent fire damage.

Success The target takes full damage.

Heightened (+1) The initial damage increases by 1d4 and the persistent fire damage on a critical hit increases by 1d4.

@Damage[(@item.rank)d4[persistent,fire]]{Scaling Persistent Fire Damage}

@Damage[(@item.rank)d6[persistent,fire]]{Scaling Persistent Fire Damage (Melee)}
items.description:
你打个响指并指向一个目标，后者便开始阴燃。作出一次法术攻击检定对抗目标的AC，命中时造成2d4点火焰伤害。若目标位于你的近战触及范围内，你能选择用火焰进行一次近战法术攻击以取代远程法术攻击，这会使得法术的所有伤害骰提升至d6骰子。

大成功 目标承受双倍伤害以及1d4点持续火焰伤害。

成功 目标承受全额伤害。

升阶（+1） 起始伤害增加1d4点，重击的持续火焰伤害增加1d4点。

@Damage[(@item.rank)d4[persistent,fire]]{随环阶提升的持续火焰伤害}

@Damage[(@item.rank)d6[persistent,fire]]{随环阶提升的持续火焰伤害（近战）}

items.name: 测量术
items.expectedDescription:
You learn the approximate measurements (length, width, depth, height, and weight) of creatures and objects you can observe in the area. If an object or creature extends out of the area, you learn only the measurements within the area, but nothing about what you can't observe. For example, you can't determine the thickness or weight of a wall you can observe only one side of, or the depth of water that extends beyond the spell's range. Each time you Sustain the spell, you learn the exact measurements of one creature or object in the area, including imprecisions or anomalies that might indicate structural weakness. Magically altered targets give you information that reflects what you observe rather than accurate measurements.

Heightened (+1) Extend the range of measure by 100 feet.
items.description:
你可以了解周围生物和物体的大致尺寸（长度、宽度、深度、高度和重量）。如果物体或生物延伸出了该射程，你只能了解该区域内的测量值，而无法观察到的东西则无法了解。例如，你无法确定只能观察到一面的墙壁的厚度或重量，也无法确定超出法术射程的水深。每次维持法术时，你都会了解该区域内一种生物或物体的精确测量结果，包括可能揭示结构弱点的不精确或异常现象。被魔法改变的目标所提供的信息反映的是你所观察到的情况，而不是精确测量值。

升阶（+1）延展测量距离100尺。

items.name: 魔法伎俩
items.expectedDescription:
The simplest magic does your bidding. You can perform simple magical effects for as long as you Sustain the spell. Each time you Sustain the spell, you can choose one of four options.

  • Cook Cool, warm, or flavor 1 pound of nonliving material.
  • Lift Slowly lift an unattended object of light Bulk or less 1 foot off the ground.
  • Make Create a temporary object of negligible Bulk, made of congealed magical substance. The object looks crude and artificial and is extremely fragile-it can't be used as a tool, weapon, or locus or cost for a spell.
  • Tidy Color, clean, or soil an object of light Bulk or less. You can affect an object of 1 Bulk with 10 rounds of concentration, and a larger object at 1 minute per Bulk.

Prestidigitation can't deal damage or cause adverse conditions. Any actual change to an object (beyond what is noted above) persists only as long as you Sustain the spell.
items.description:
最简单的魔法帮你完成杂务。只要你维持该法术，你就可以产生简单的魔法效果。每当你维持该法术时，你可以选择四个选项中的一个。

  • 烹饪 为1磅非活物材料冷却，加热，或者调味。
  • 抬起 将一件轻负载或者更低的无主物品缓慢抬离地面1尺。
  • 创造 创造一个负载可忽略的临时物体，它由凝结的魔法物质组成。该物体看起来粗糙、不自然，且极其脆弱——它无法被用做工具、武器、施法载体或法术费用。
  • 整理 为一件轻负载或者更低的物体染色，清洁，或者弄脏它。你可以通过10轮专注来影响一件1负载的物体，对于更大的物体为每负载1分钟。

魔法伎俩无法造成伤害或者负面效果。对一件物体的任何改变（在上述内容之外的）只会在你仍维持该法术时持续。

items.name: 阅读灵光
items.expectedDescription:
You focus on the target object, opening your mind to perceive magical auras. When the casting is complete, you know whether that item is magical. You or anyone you advise about the aura gains a +2 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{Identify Magic} on the item. If the object is illusory, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your read aura spell.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.J6OhRNSN23KzOPRL]{Spell Effect: Read Aura}

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to 10 objects.

Heightened (6th) You can target any number of objects.
items.description:
你专注于目标物体，拓展神智，以感受魔法灵光。当你完成施法后，你得知该物品是否具有魔法。你或任何经你告知灵光信息的人在对该物品@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{辨识魔法}时获得+2环境加值。如果该物体是幻象，仅当该效果的环阶低于你的阅读灵光环阶时你才能发现此事实。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.J6OhRNSN23KzOPRL]{法术效果：阅读灵光}

升阶（3环） 你能以至多10个物体为目标。

升阶（6环） 你能以任意数量物体为目标。

items.name: 睡眠术
items.expectedDescription:
Each creature in the area becomes drowsy, possibly nodding off. A creature that falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} from this spell doesn't fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} or release what it's holding. This spell doesn't prevent creatures from waking up due to a successful Perception check, limiting its utility in combat.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes a –1 status penalty to Perception checks for 1 round.

Failure The creature falls unconscious. If it's still unconscious after 1 minute, it wakes up automatically.

Critical Failure The creature falls unconscious. If it's still unconscious after 1 hour, it wakes up automatically.

Heightened (4th) The creatures fall unconscious for 1 round on a failure or 1 minute on a critical failure. They fall prone and release what they're holding, and they can't attempt Perception checks to wake up. When the duration ends, the creature is sleeping normally instead of automatically waking up.
items.description:
区域中的每个生物垂头歪脑昏昏欲睡。由于该法术@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{失去意识}的生物不会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}，也不会松开其持握的东西。此法术不妨碍生物通过成功的察觉检定醒来，并因此限制其在战斗中的能力。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物在察觉检定上承受-1状态减值，持续1轮。

失败 该生物失去意识。如果它在1分钟后仍然失去意识，它自动醒来。

大失败 该生物失去意识。如果它在1小时后仍然失去意识，它自动醒来。

升阶（4环） 目标在失败时失去意识1轮，在大失败时失去意识1分钟。它们会倒地，并松开其持握的东西，并且它们无法尝试察觉检定以醒来。当持续时间结束时，该生物会正常睡着，而不是自动醒来。

items.name: 辐射灵光
items.expectedDescription: 90 feet. A creature that enters the radioactive aura must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:37] save against incredible radiation sickness. It's then temporarily immune to radioactive aura for 10 minutes.
items.description: 90尺。进入辐射灵光的生物必须进行一次@Check[fortitude|dc:37]豁免来对抗惊人辐射病。此后，它对辐射灵光暂时免疫10分钟。

items.name: 渊铀漩涡
items.expectedDescription: If the next action the dragon uses is Radiation Breath, the radiation becomes supercharged with arcane power. Each creature that fails its save against Radiation Breath takes @Damage[4d6[persistent,force]] damage as the supercharged radiation tears it apart from within. Each creature that critically fails its save is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} as long as it has this persistent force damage.
items.description: 若龙接下来使用的动作是辐射吐息，辐射便会充满奥术能量而过载。每个对抗辐射吐息的豁免失败的生物都会受到@Damage[4d6[persistent,force]]伤害，过载的辐射从内部将其撕裂。在此持续力场伤害结束前，豁免大失败的生物还会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢1}。

items.name: 辐射控制
items.expectedDescription: Abysium dragons have ultimate control over the radioactive energy that grows within their bodies. Any time an abysium dragon deals fire or poison damage, they can choose whether that damage is magical, and they can change any amount of the fire damage to poison (or any amount of poison damage to fire).
items.description: 渊铀龙能完全控制体内滋生的辐射能量。每当渊铀龙造成火焰或毒素伤害时，都可以选择该伤害是否属于魔法伤害，并能将任意数量的火焰伤害改为毒素伤害（或将任意数量的毒素伤害改为火焰伤害）。

items.name: 辐射吐息
items.expectedDescription: The dragon breathes a blast of caustic superheated gas that deals @Damage[10d6[fire],5d12[persistent,poison]|options:area-damage] damage in a @Template[type:cone|distance:60] (@Check[fortitude|dc:40|basic|options:area-effect] save). They can't use Radiation Breath again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Radiation Breath]]{1d4 rounds}.
items.description: 龙喷出一股具有腐蚀性的过热气体，造成@Damage[10d6[fire],5d12[persistent,poison]|options:area-damage]伤害，范围为@Template[type:cone|distance:60]（@Check[fortitude|dc:40|basic|options:area-effect]豁免）。之后[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Radiation Breath]]{1d4轮}内无法再次使用辐射吐息。

items.name: 辐射充能
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency once per day

Requirements The dragon is within 60 feet of a source of incredible radiation other than any abysium dragon

Effect The dragon draws on the source of radiation, regaining all their expended spontaneous spell slots.
items.description:
频率 每天一次

需求 龙位于一处惊人辐射源的60尺内，且该辐射源并非任何渊铀龙

效果 龙汲取辐射源的能量，恢复所有已消耗的自发法术位。

UpudCKfPxXAU0Sve.name: 古渊铀龙（施法者） Abysium Dragon (Ancient, Spellcaster)
UpudCKfPxXAU0Sve.publicNotes: 渊铀龙将辐射既视为毁灭之力，亦视作能量之源，它们与同名的放射性天金渊铀紧密相连。这些龙的体内会沉积纯净的渊铀；随着年龄增长，它们身上的放射性也愈发强烈，使其变得更加好斗、焦躁，甚至感到孤独，因为很少有生物能在一头年老的渊铀龙身边长久存活。渊铀龙常投身于殖装制作、武器制作（以利用其与生俱来的能量源）以及机器人制造（以求得陪伴）等活动。这些工作驱使渊铀龙不断寻找坚固且抗辐射的材料用于制作，它们往往会花费数年时间，在小型卫星和小行星上搜寻珍贵材料。

items.name: 侦测思想
items.expectedDescription:
You sense the presence of thinking creatures around you. You detect the presence or absence of thoughts from conscious creatures that have Intelligence modifiers of –3 or higher. You can choose to ignore the thoughts of creatures you're familiar with so they don't interfere with your detection of other thoughts. The spell can penetrate some barriers, but 3 feet of dirt or wood, 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of metal, a thin sheet of lead, or any force barrier blocks it. Creatures who are immune to mental effects are immune to detection by this spell.

Heightened (4th) You detect the number of thinking minds and whether or not the creatures are telepathic. Creatures with telepathy have louder thoughts than creatures who don't have telepathy and might be able to sense your intrusion, at the GM's discretion.
items.description:
你能感知周围生物的想法。你可以侦测周围是否存在智力调整值不低于-3的清醒生物的思维。可选择忽略熟悉生物的思维，避免干扰其他目标的侦测。该法术可以穿透一些障碍，但3尺的泥土或木头、1尺的石头、1英寸的金属、薄薄的铅片或任何立场障碍都会阻挡它。对心灵效果免疫的生物对该法术的侦测免疫。

升阶（4环）你可侦测范围内存在思维活动的意识体数量，并判断其是否具备心灵感应能力。拥有心灵感应能力的生物思维波动更强，普通生物思维信号较弱且无反馈，具体由GM裁定。

items.name: 末日刷屏
items.expectedDescription:
You magically broadcast grim news onto nearby devices, holo projectors, screens, and other displays (including comm units on armor). Creatures in the area who can see one or more displays must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by the display.

Failure The creature is fascinated by the display and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} (even if the fascination ends).

Critical Failure The creature is fascinated by the display, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1} (even if the fascination ends).
items.description:
你以魔法在附近的设备、全息投影仪、屏幕及其他显示装置（包括护甲上的通讯装置）上播出噩耗。区域内能看见至少一个显示装置的生物必须进行意志豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物被显示装置@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{迷魂}。

失败 该生物被显示装置迷魂，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧2}（即使迷魂结束，惊惧仍然生效）。

大失败 该生物被显示装置迷魂，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧3}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{毁灭1}（即使迷魂结束，后两者仍然生效）。

items.name: 情绪控制
items.expectedDescription:
You share a mood by psychically projecting an intense emotion into a creature's mind. The target attempts a Will save. On a failure, the target experiences your choice of the following emotions, but if you pick anger or joy this spell gains the incapacitation trait.

  • Anger On its next turn, the target spends its first action to attack the nearest creature, even if it's an ally.
  • Joy The target can't take any hostile actions.
  • Fear The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.
  • Sorrow The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} and bursts into tears.

Heightened (4th) The spell affects all creatures in a 20-foot burst. Each creature must be affected by the same emotion.
items.description:
你以心能向一个生物的心中投射强烈情绪，使其与你感同身受。目标尝试一次意志豁免。失败时，目标体验以下一种由你选择的情绪，但如果选择愤怒或喜悦，此法术获得失能特征。

  • 愤怒 在其下一回合，目标花费第一个动作攻击最近的生物，即使对方是盟友。
  • 喜悦 目标无法采取任何敌对行动。
  • 恐惧 目标陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧2}。
  • 悲伤 目标陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢1}，并泪流满面。

升阶（4环） 法术影响20尺爆发内的所有生物。每个生物必须受到相同情绪的影响。

items.name: 分析目标
items.expectedDescription:
You focus on the target, gathering data as magical holograms display information. When the casting is complete, you learn biometric information about the target, including its fingerprints, medical conditions, and other basic physiological information. You or anyone you advise about the analysis gains a +1 status bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} the creature, to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} on the creature, and to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about it. If the target is illusory or under the effects of illusion magic, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your analyze target spell.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

Heightened (3rd) The status bonus increases to +2, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Heightened (6th) The status bonus increases to +3, and you can target any number of creatures.
items.description:
你专注在目标身上，收集数据并以魔法全息图像显示。当施法完成，你会获得目标的所有生物特征信息，包括指纹、医疗状况和其他基本生理信息。你或任何得到你基于分析建议的人，在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]为该生物、对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]、以及对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]的检定上获得+1状态加值。如果目标是幻觉或者处于幻术魔法效果下，仅当效果的环级低于你分析目标的法术环级，你才能够探测到结果。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

升阶（3环）状态加值提升到+2，并且你可以至多10名生物作为目标。

升阶（6环）状态加值提升到+3，并且你可以任意名生物作为目标。

items.name: 天界信使
items.expectedDescription:
You transport yourself to either a celestial plane or a world in the Universe where worshippers of your patron can be found. You must be of no higher level than double angelic messenger's spell rank.

Critical Success As success, but if you've never visited that plane or world before, you appear right in front of the message's intended recipient.

Success You arrive on the target plane or world at the last location you visited on that plane or world, or to a random location within [[/r 10d10 #Miles Off]] miles of your message's intended recipient if you've never visited that plane or world before.

Failure You don't travel.

Critical Failure You accidentally travel to the wrong plane, possibly a dangerous plane.
items.description:
你把自身传送至天界位面或者物质宇宙中可以找到你所侍奉存在的信徒的世界里。你的等级不能高于天界信使的法术环阶的两倍。

大成功 同成功，但若你从未到访过该位面或世界，你会直接出现在此消息的预定接收者面前。

成功 你抵达目标位面或世界上你上次到访的位置；若你从未到访过该位面或世界，则抵达此消息的预定接收者周围[[/r 10d10 #Miles Off]]里内的随机地点。

失败 你未能成功旅行。

大失败 你意外旅行到了错误的位面，且很可能是危险的位面。

items.name: 治疗术
items.expectedDescription:
You channel vital energy to heal the living or damage the undead. If the target is a willing living creature, you restore 1d8 Hit Points. If the target is undead, you deal that amount of vitality damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 The spell has a range of touch.

2 (concentrate) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing a living creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (concentrate) You disperse vital energy in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. This targets all living and undead creatures in the burst.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.
items.description:
你引导命能，以治疗活物或者伤害不死生物。如果目标是自愿活物，你使其恢复1d8生命值。如果目标是不死生物，你对其造成等量命能伤害，并且它可以进行基础强韧豁免。你在施放该法术时花费的动作数量决定其目标，范围，区域和其他参数。

1 该法术的射程为接触。

2（专注）该法术的射程为30尺。如果你在治疗一个活物，回复的生命值增加8。

3（专注）你在@Template[emanation|distance:30]内释放命能。这会以区域中所有活物和不死生物为目标。

升阶（+1） 治疗或者伤害的量增加1d8，两个动作版本的额外治疗增加8。

items.name: 传讯术
items.expectedDescription:
You mouth words quietly, but instead of coming out of your mouth, they're transferred directly to the ears of the target. While others can't hear your words any better than if you normally mouthed them, the target can hear your words as if they were standing next to you. The target can give a brief response as a reaction, or as a free action on their next turn if they wish, but they must be able to see you and be within range to do so. If they respond, their response is delivered directly to your ear, just like the original message.

Heightened (3rd) The spell's range increases to 500 feet.
items.description:
你无声地念出言语，这段言语会直接送到目标耳中，而不是从你的嘴中念出。其他人只能像平常看你无声地动嘴一样，无法更清楚地听到这些话，但法术目标会如同正站在你身边一般听到你的言语。目标可以通过一个反应动作做出一段简要回应，或者根据其意愿，也可以通过其下个回合的自由动作来回应，但它如此做时必须能看见你，并且在射程内。如果它做出回应，它的回应会直接送达你的耳中，如同最初的信息一般。

升阶（3环） 法术的射程增加到500尺。

items.name: 激励铃声
items.expectedDescription:
You cause the target comm unit to play a cosmically composed personal theme song specific to its owner. VWeK7AEA3pMmfLgZ.publicNotes:
宣谕天使，或称宣传天使，是激进希望的神性化身，同时也是天界对信息战的回应。部分宣谕天使源于革命领袖或名流的圣洁灵魂，这些伟人生前曾以自身影响力扶助世人，逝后便升华为天界使者。另一些宣谕天使则自发地从某个运动或理想的凝聚信念与渴望中形成。

宣谕天使扮演着天界舆论导向者与政治组织者的角色，激励盟友团结奋进，即便胜算渺茫仍坚守目标。他们常扶持与自身信念目标相符的凡间事业，虽总期望以振奋人心的演说或极致善行感化众生，却不惧为信念战斗，无论自己将付出何种代价。当战斗结束时，其首要之务便是救治同伴，并拯救那些可能被感化加入事业的敌人。尽管盟友通常欣赏他们坚定的希望与乐观的态度，对手却憎恨宣谕天使身上那些被视为“有毒的积极态度”与“安慰性谎言”的特质。

尽管当代许多天使由遍布宇宙的凡人灵魂升格而成，这些天界生物实为全宇宙最古老的存在之一。作为神祇的战士与信使，他们全然献身于自身使命——无论是铲除邪恶，抑或将神谕传遍银河。

名为奥斯克瑞斯的恐怖战争机器，仅见于与先驱者相关的古老遗迹之中。其形态如两座叠置的金字塔，内部蕴藏着成分未知的白色能量核心。这些战争机器惯常在战场上瞬移穿梭，令敌人怒火中烧。这些战争机器最初被发现独自游荡于阿巴隆的先驱者城市中，后来在协约世界之外的地点被辨认出来，这为先驱者在宇宙中的扩张活动的理论提供了佐证。

奥斯克瑞斯拒绝正面交锋，始终与敌人保持距离，释放出耀眼的能量光束，将那些不幸与之交战者的肢体切断。它们以极远距离的精准攻击，将敌人一点点肢解。若被迫近身作战，它们能释放时间能量冲击波减缓攻击者，从而争取时间重新调整位置，继续实施肢解轰炸。

如同其他先驱者的构装体，这些守卫拒绝交流，并抵御着几乎所有试图覆盖或破解其程序的尝试。星系中部分顶尖智者曾成功暂时突破奥斯克瑞斯内部的精密程序，但此类入侵行为总会被迅速探测并击退，表明每台这种奇怪机器内部都栖息着不断进化的智能。

当从多个角度发起攻击时，便能轻易压倒奥斯克瑞斯的探测网格与反应机制。新械族学者认为，这些构装体原本是为对抗仅擅长二维作战的敌人而打造的，尽管奥斯克瑞斯自身具备卓越的三维作战能力，它们却始终以敌人仅能二维作战的方式进行战斗。

据推测，奥斯克瑞斯采用的独特战术与武器，旨在应对一种特定威胁：来自位面碎片主宰（Planashar Dominion）的平面族（planashars）。平面族来自名为“无限循环”（Infinite Loop）的仅有二维的不同现实。近期他们悄然入侵星系，自称“聚合派”（Those Who Converge），袭击阿巴隆的先驱者城市及太阳聚居地诺玛（Noma）。奥斯克瑞斯专为对抗平面族而生，这一事实更印证了先驱者与平面族之间存在某种关联。

由于奥斯克瑞斯习惯于对抗仅存在于二维空间的生物，它对涉及三维空间的战术显得格外脆弱——例如多角度攻击。尽管奥斯克瑞斯无法完全理解此类战术，但它能感知到自己正被三维思维所牵制，并会利用强大的瞬移能力，在每次机会出现时迅速转移至更安全的位置。

VmHWS0Jm6aBSEJIu.name: 机械化菁英型战争机器 Robotic Elite War Machine
VmHWS0Jm6aBSEJIu.publicNotes:
“aurovak”战争机器是当前协约世界机器人军事技术的巅峰，由一群精灵、弗米蚁族与拉申塔工程师在卡斯卓韦一项全新的联合倡议下合作开发。

这场入侵始于阿巴隆的新械族接连发现的探测器。传感器炽亮、长着分节触须的奇异机器不知从何处现身，看似毫无规律地撕裂基础设施，并在整个协约世界宙域搜集情报。恐慌迅速蔓延，但这些机器总会消失得无影无踪，或在被捕获时爆炸，因此始终无法证实目击报告或辨明其身份。流言渐起，称这些机器采用了一种前所未见的生物科技。不久，理事军正式介入，将这些事件封锁在最高机密权限的精金壁垒之后。

后断层纪元325年阳愈月（Sarenith），在数十次军事行动均未能与行踪飘忽的探测器交战之后，一支从伊达里号派出的战斗机联队终于走运，在其中一台机器自毁前将其瘫痪。协约世界的顶尖科学家设法让这台生物科技载具吐露了部分秘密，它由此成为了“本土制造”的遥控战争机器的原型，如今这类机器正接受战斗应用测试。这些仿制品并非活物，而是使用机器人制造模板建造的，因为原始生物科技设计的核心过于复杂，协约科技尚无法对其进行逆向工程。

遥控战争机器是可以从极远距离控制的替身。原始的生物科技战争机器通过心灵链接或未知无线电频率连接驾驶者的心智。机械式遥控战争机器则通过数据链路连接计算机，供驾驶者使用键盘、虚拟现实设备，甚至电子游戏手柄来控制自己的替身。

需求 遥控战争机器位于目标触及范围之外

items.description: @Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ReactiveStrike]

items.description: 该战争机器的远程打击以极高速度发射，在水下使用时不会受到任何减值。

items.name: 超视距交战
items.expectedDescription: The remote war machine makes a ranged Strike at a target as though its weapon had double its normal range. This Strike ignores all forms of concealment and cover.
items.description: 遥控战争机器对一个目标进行一次远程打击，将其武器射程视为通常的两倍。该次打击忽略一切形式的隐蔽和掩蔽。
