items.name: 拆除
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger The kyokor (or other kaiju) applies any amount of force to the structure

Effect The building trembles. The floors of the building and the streets within 30 feet of the building become difficult terrain; creatures on this difficult terrain take a –2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls, AC, and skill checks. The hazard rolls initiative.
items.description:
触发狂寇（或其他怪兽）对该建筑结构施加任意程度的力

效果建筑震颤起来。建筑的楼层地面及建筑30尺内的街道变为困难地形；位于这些困难地形上的生物，其攻击检定、AC和技能检定承受–2环境减值。该危害掷先攻。

cnText_system_attributes_stealth_details.expected: (master) to notice cracks forming in the walls of the structure as the kyokor (or another kaiju) approaches.
cnText_system_attributes_stealth_details.text: （大师）以察觉克约科（或其他怪兽）接近时建筑墙壁上形成的裂缝。

cnText_system_details_description.expected:
The kyokor (or other kaiju) grazes a structure, severely compromising the building's stability and possibly causing it to collapse.

When a kyokor passes by or through a settlement—or even attacks!—it leaves a trail of destruction that can be represented by the following hazards.

Terrifying, skyscraper-sized beasts roam the wastelands of Daimalko. Called colossi by the population, these monsters erupted from deep within the earth to stomp cities into dust, decimating the population and destroying every surface civilization on the planet in a terrifying Awakening. Kyokors are among the most dreaded colossi. There's no hope of defeating one without a valko—a war machine created by Daimalko's stubborn survivors to fight the colossi.
cnText_system_details_description.text:
克约科（或其他怪兽）擦过一座建筑，严重破坏其稳定性，并可能令其坍塌。

克约科经过或穿越聚居地——甚至发动攻击！——时，会留下一条毁灭之路，可以用以下危害表示。

令人恐惧、如摩天大楼般庞大的巨兽游荡在戴马尔科的荒原上。当地居民称它们为巨像。在那场可怕的觉醒中，这些怪物从地下深处涌出，将城市践踏成尘土，令人口锐减，并摧毁了这颗星球上的所有地表文明。克约科是最令人畏惧的巨像之一。没有瓦尔科就毫无战胜它的希望；瓦尔科是戴马尔科顽强的幸存者为对抗巨像而制造的战争机器。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[athletics|dc:43] (master), @Check[civil-engineering-lore|dc:43] (master), or @Check[crafting|dc:43] (master) check to brace the structure to reduce the risk of collapse until the end of the creature's next turn. The DC of the flat check for this round (see Routine) is increased by 4 on a success, or by 8 on a critical success. Increasing the flat check DC to 21 or higher stabilizes the structure, ending this hazard.
cnText_system_details_disable.text: 进行@Check[athletics|dc:43]（大师）、@Check[civil-engineering-lore|dc:43]（大师）或@Check[crafting|dc:43]（大师）检定，以支撑建筑，降低其坍塌风险，持续至该生物下回合结束。成功会使本轮的纯骰检定DC（见运作流程）提高4，大成功则提高8。将纯骰检定DC提高至21或更高即可稳固建筑，结束此危害。

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: The building becomes susceptible to Demolish again [[/gmr 1d6 #rounds]]{1d6 rounds} after it's stabilized.
cnText_system_details_reset.text: 建筑被稳固[[/gmr 1d6 #rounds]]{1d6轮}后，会再次受到摧毁影响。

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (1 action) The GM rolls a @Check[flat|dc:9] to determine if the building collapses, increasing the DC as listed in Disable. On a success, dust and debris fall within the building and 30 feet around it, providing concealment and dealing @Damage[6d6[bludgeoning]] damage to [[/gmr 1d4 #Targets]] randomly chosen targets (@Check[reflex|dc:35|basic] save); on a critical failure, a creature is also knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. On a critical success on the flat check, the effect is the same, but the debris deals @Damage[12d6[bludgeoning]] damage to [[/gmr 2d4 #Targets]] randomly chosen targets instead (@Check[reflex|dc:35|basic] save); on a critical failure, a creature is knocked prone and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} by rubble until freed ([[/act force-open dc=38]]; [[/act escape dc=35]]).
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （1动作）GM进行一次@Check[flat|dc:9]，以判断建筑是否坍塌，DC按解除栏所述提高。成功时，尘土和碎片落在建筑内部及周围30尺内，提供隐蔽，并造成@Damage[6d6[bludgeoning]]伤害，伤及[[/gmr 1d4 #Targets]]个随机选中的目标（@Check[reflex|dc:35|basic]豁免）；大失败时，生物还会被击倒而@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}。纯骰检定大成功时，效应相同，但碎片改为造成@Damage[12d6[bludgeoning]]伤害，伤及[[/gmr 2d4 #Targets]]个随机选中的目标（@Check[reflex|dc:35|basic]豁免）；大失败时，生物被击倒，并受到瓦砾@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{束缚}，直至获救（[[/act force-open dc=38]]；[[/act escape dc=35]]）。

WGjO7cofQ1T2RX2C.name: 暴射魔（暴走恶魔） Daipex

items.name: 恶魔协定
items.expectedDescription:
You call in a favor from one demon of level 2 or lower, two demons of level 0 or lower, or three demons of level –1 or lower.

Critical Success You conjure the demon or demons. They are eager to pursue the task, so they don't ask for a favor.

Success You conjure the demon or demons. They are not eager to pursue the task, so they require a favor in return.

Failure You don't conjure any demons.

Critical Failure The demon or demons are angry that you disturbed them. They appear before you, but they immediately attack you.

Heightened (+1) Increase the level of demon you call by 2 for each option.
items.description:
你能呼唤其他恶魔来帮忙，其等级为1个2级或更低等级的恶魔、2个0级或更低等级的恶魔、或者3个-1级或更低等级的恶魔。

大成功 你成功呼唤恶魔到来。它们渴望完成这项任务，因此不会寻求回报。

成功 你成功呼唤恶魔到来。它们并不渴望完成这项任务，因此会要求你提供回报。

失败 你没能呼唤任何恶魔。

大失败 恶魔因为你的打扰而愤怒。它们在你面前现身，但会立即对你发动攻击。

升阶（+1） 每个选项中你能呼唤的恶魔等级增加2级。

items.name: 臂炮
items.expectedDescription: A daipex's powerful arms can be fused into one or more cannons. These arm cannons also can't be Disarmed or Released. The daipex takes a –4 circumstance penalty to any action that requires fine motor control.
items.description: 暴射魔强健的手臂可以融合为一门或多门臂炮。这些臂炮同样无法被卸武或解除装置。此外，任何需要精细操作的动作，暴射魔都会受到 –4 环境减值。

items.name: 焦臭瘴气
items.expectedDescription: 5 feet. The heat from a daipex's arm cannons burns the intestines fed into the grafted weapons as ammunition. A creature that enters or begins its turn in the aura must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:23|options:area-effect,inflicts:sickened] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.
items.description: 5尺。暴射魔臂炮的热量会烧灼填入其移植武器、用作弹药的肠子。进入此灵光或在其中开始回合的生物必须通过一次@Check[fortitude|dc:23|options:area-effect,inflicts:sickened]豁免，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心1}。

items.name: 脱靶易伤
items.expectedDescription: A daipex is full of unceasing rage and despises it when they can't deal damage. When a daipex critically fails a Strike or when a creature critically succeeds at its save against Hail of Bullets, the daipex takes @Damage[3d6[mental]] damage.
items.description: 暴射魔充满永不止息的怒火，厌恶无法造成伤害的情况。当暴射魔打击大失败，或有生物对抗其弹幕齐射的豁免大成功时，暴射魔受到@Damage[3d6[mental]]伤害。

items.name: 弹幕齐射
items.expectedDescription: The daipex fires a @Template[type:cone|distance:30] of bullets, dealing @Damage[6d10[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic|options:area-effect] save) to creatures in the area. The daipex is pushed 10 feet in the opposite direction and can't use Hail of Bullets again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Hail of Bullets]]{1d4 rounds}.
items.description: 暴射魔向@Template[type:cone|distance:30]射出子弹，对区域内生物造成@Damage[6d10[piercing]|options:area-damage]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic|options:area-effect]豁免）。暴射魔被朝相反方向推动10尺，且在[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Hail of Bullets]]{1d4轮}内无法再次使用弹幕齐射。

items.name: 弹幕之雨
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency once per round

Effect The daipex makes two arm cannon Strikes against a single target. The daipex's multiple attack penalty is applied normally. If both Strikes hit, combine their damage for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses.
items.description:
频率 每轮一次

效果 暴射魔对单个目标进行两次臂炮打击。正常应用暴射魔的多重攻击减值。若两次打击均命中，在应用抗力和弱点时合并其伤害。

items.name: 后坐反冲
items.expectedDescription: A daipex's relatively small legs can't withstand their arm cannon's kickback. When a daipex makes an arm cannon Strike, they're pushed 5 feet in the opposite direction of the Strike's target. The daipex can take a –2 circumstance penalty to the Strike to avoid this forced movement.
items.description: 暴射魔相对细小的双腿承受不住臂炮的后坐力。暴射魔进行臂炮打击时，会朝远离打击目标的方向被推动5尺。暴射魔可以让该次打击承受–2环境减值，以避免这次强迫移动。

WGjO7cofQ1T2RX2C.publicNotes:
暴射魔由那些一生被愤怒和无差别暴力支配的罪孽凡人的灵魂所化。它们庞大的身躯主要由一对与粗壮手臂的血肉融为一体的链式机枪组成，相比之下，它们的双腿却异常短小，根本无法完全承受攻击时产生的巨大力量。暴射魔只有在必要时才会使用双腿，平时则依靠手臂移动，以减轻腿部肌肉的负担。

暴射魔会随身携带猎物的内脏，有时会把一串肠子挂在脖子上，或者直接拖在地上。它们把这些脏器塞进手臂里，通过收缩手臂肌肉，将腐烂的肉块压缩成弹药，直接从身体里发射出去。虽然它们通常储备的弹药足够让手臂武器连续射击数小时，但万一在战斗中弹药耗尽，它们要么从战场上的尸体中补充更多弹药，要么为了胜利牺牲自己的血肉来制造弹药。

所有凡人生物死后，其灵魂通常会在骨园接受审判。而那些生前作恶多端者——尤其是通过伤害他人或极端自私行为玷污灵魂者——会被放逐至外层裂隙，最终在那里凝聚成恶魔。这些邪恶生物唯一渴求的，就是腐蚀凡间生灵的生命，以确保恶魔同类的队伍永不衰减。

WbHO3zQXCuiLMWnW.name: 炽光仙女 Heliad

items.name: 等离子墙
items.expectedDescription:
You shape a wall of crackling plasma that burns creatures passing through it. You create either a 5-foot-thick wall of plasma in a straight line up to 60 feet long and 10 feet high, or a 5-foot-thick, 10-foot-radius ring of plasma with the same height. The wall stands vertically in either form; if you wish, the wall can be of a shorter length or height. Everything on each side of the wall is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} from creatures on the opposite side. Any creature that crosses the wall or is occupying the wall's area at the start of its turn takes 4d6 fire damage and 2d6 persistent electricity damage.

Heightened (+1) The persistent electricity damage increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你塑造一面由劈啪作响的等离子体形成的墙壁，其会燃烧通过的生物。你创造一条5尺厚，至多60尺长10尺高的直线墙体，或者5尺厚，10尺半径，相同高度的环形墙体。不论哪种形式，墙体都垂直竖立。如果你愿意，墙体可以更短或者更矮。墙体两侧的任何物体对彼此都是@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]的。任何试图穿过墙体或者在墙体占据区域内开始回合的生物受到4d6火焰伤害和2d6持续电击伤害。

升阶（+1）持续电击伤害增加1d6。

items.name: 火焰护盾
items.expectedDescription:
You create a hovering shield made of fire. As long as the shield persists, its heat grants you cold resistance 5 and makes you immune to mild and severe environmental cold. You can Raise a Shield with the fire shield as a normal shield to gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC. You can use the Shield Block reaction with the fire shield, which has Hardness 10, is immune to fire, and has 40 HP (with no Broken Threshold), and its Hardness is halved against effects that have the water trait. If you Shield Block a melee attack that is either an unarmed attack or made by an adjacent attacker, the attacker takes 2d6 fire damage.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.1RsScTvNdGD9zGWe]{Spell Effect: Fire Shield}

Heightened (+2) The cold resistance increases by 5, the HP increase by 10, and the fire damage increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你创造出一面由火焰构成的盾牌悬停在空中。只要盾牌存在，它的热量就会让你获得5点寒冷抗力，使你免疫环境中的轻度寒冷及严寒。你能如同使用普通盾牌一般对火焰护盾使用举盾动作并使得AC获得+1环境加值。你也能使用火焰护盾进行盾牌格挡反应动作，它具有10点硬度、免疫火焰、以及40点生命值（不具有破损阈值），其硬度在对抗具有水特征的效果时减半。若你盾牌格挡一次近战攻击，且该次攻击是无武装攻击或者由相邻攻击者作出的话，攻击者承受2d6点火焰伤害。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.1RsScTvNdGD9zGWe]{法术效果：火焰护盾}

升阶（+2） 寒冷抗力增加5点，生命值增加10点，火焰伤害增加1d6点。

items.name: 火球术
items.expectedDescription:
A roaring blast of fire detonates at a spot you designate, dealing 6d6 fire damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.
items.description:
在你指定的位置爆发出咆哮的烈焰，造成6d6火焰伤害。

升阶（+1） 该伤害增加2d6。

items.name: 灼热火矢
items.expectedDescription:
You fire a ray of heat and flame. Make a spell attack roll against a single creature. On a hit, the target takes 2d6 fire damage, and on a critical hit, the target takes double damage.

For each additional action you use when Casting the Spell, you can fire an additional ray at a different target, to a maximum of three rays targeting three different targets for 3 actions. These attacks each increase your multiple attack penalty, but you don't increase your multiple attack penalty until after you make all the spell attack rolls for blazing bolt. If you spend 2 or more actions Casting the Spell, the damage increases to 4d6 fire damage on a hit, and it still deals double damage on a critical hit.

Heightened (+1) The damage to each target increases by 1d6 for the 1-action version, or by 2d6 for the 2-action and 3-action versions.
items.description:
你发射出热能与火焰构成的射线。进行一次法术攻击掷骰对抗单个生物。命中时，目标承受2d6点火焰伤害，重击时，目标承受双倍伤害。

你在施放该法术时使用的每个额外动作，都能够对一个不同的目标发射出1道额外射线，至多为3个动作对3个不同目标发射3道射线。这些攻击均会增加你的多重攻击减值，但是直至你作出所有灼热火矢的法术攻击掷骰之前都不会增加你的多重攻击减值。若你花费2个或更多动作施放该法术，命中时的伤害增加至4d6点火焰伤害，它仍会在重击时造成双倍伤害。

升阶（+1） 单动作版本的目标承受的伤害增加1d6点，双动作或三动作对每个目标的伤害增加2d6点。

items.name: 魅惑术
items.expectedDescription:
To the target, your words are honey and your visage seems bathed in a dreamy haze. It must attempt a Will save, with a +4 circumstance bonus if you or your allies recently threatened it or used hostile actions against it.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you use hostile actions against the target, the spell ends. When the spell ends, the target doesn't necessarily realize it was charmed unless its friendship with you or the actions you convinced it to take clash with its expectations, meaning you could potentially convince the target to continue being your friend via mundane means.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and aware you tried to charm it.

Success The target is unaffected but thinks your spell was something harmless instead of charm, unless it identifies the spell.

Failure The target's attitude becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v66R7FdOf11l94im]{Friendly} toward you. If it was Friendly, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v44P3WUcU1j0115l]{Helpful}. It can't use hostile actions against you.

Critical Failure The target's attitude becomes Helpful toward you, and it can't use hostile actions against you.

Heightened (4th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations.

Heightened (8th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations, and you can target up to 10 creatures.
items.description:
在目标看来，你的言语甜蜜动听，你的形象笼罩在梦幻般的光晕中。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免，如果你或者你的盟友最近威胁它或者对它进行了敌对行为，会获得+4环境加值。

你可以解消该法术。如果你对目标使用任何敌对动作，法术终止。当该法术结束时，目标不一定会意识到自己被魅惑了，除非它和你的友好关系，或者你说服它去做的事情与其期望发生冲突。这也即是说你可以通过常规的方法说服目标继续作为你的朋友。

大成功 目标不受影响，并且意识到你尝试魅惑它。

成功 该目标不受影响，但是认为你的法术是某种无害的东西，而不是魅惑术，除非它能识别该法术。

失败 目标对你的态度变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v66R7FdOf11l94im]{友善}。如果已经是友善，则变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v44P3WUcU1j0115l]{乐于帮助}。它不能对你做出敌对行为。

大失败 目标变为乐于帮助并且不能对你做出敌对行为。

升阶（8环） 法术持续至你下次进行每日准备，并且你能以至多10个生物作为目标。

items.name: 焕发光彩

The spell accentuates the target's appearance, clothing, voice, and mannerisms according to what an observer finds appealing. Held items are unaffected, and any worn item removed from the creature returns to its true appearance.

The target gains a +1 status bonus to Diplomacy checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} and lets the target add its level to Diplomacy checks if untrained. In addition, the target can attempt a Diplomacy check to Gather Information in only 10 minutes. You can Dismiss this spell.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.hOp5ybOzyJlECU6B]

items.name: 光亮术
items.expectedDescription:

items.description:
你将积聚的热能导向附近目标。你对目标造成2d6火焰伤害。如果豁免失败，目标手持的装备会在下一轮变得灼热。除非目标在回合开始时扔掉当前手持的装备，否则会受@Damage[(3*@item.rank)[fire]]伤害。

This doesn't give them any information about the ship, its occupants, or its exact position. The nymph can send a message to the ship as if using a personal comm unit.
items.description: 当宁芙处于与其绑定的天体上时，她能感应到距离天体一天航程范围内的接近的星舰。这不会给她提供关于星舰、其乘员或其确切位置的任何信息。宁芙可以像使用个人通讯单元一样向星舰发送信息。

items.name: 辐光凝视
items.expectedDescription:
30 feet. A heliad's eyes blaze like a sun. When a creature enters or starts its turn in the aura, it must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:24] save. The heliad can deactivate or activate this aura by using a single action, which has the concentrate trait.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} until the start of its next turn.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} until the start of its next turn.
items.description:
30尺。炽光仙女的双眼如太阳般炽烈。生物进入灵光或在灵光内开始回合时，必须尝试一次@Check[fortitude|dc:24]豁免。炽光仙女可以使用一个具有专注特征的单动作，关闭或开启此灵光。

成功 生物不受影响。

失败 生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}，直到其下一回合开始。

大失败 生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲}，直到其下一回合开始。

items.name: 恒星依存
items.expectedDescription: A heliad is mystically bonded to a single protostar or small dwarf star. If they're away from their bonded star for more than 24 hours, they become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} and must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:24] save each additional 24 hours or increase their drained value by 1. A heliad can perform a 24-hour ritual to bond themself to a new star.
items.description: 炽光仙女与一颗原恒星或小型矮星以神秘的方式绑定。如果离开绑定的星体超过24小时，它便陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失1}，此后每过24小时都必须成功通过@Check[fortitude|dc:24]豁免，否则流失值增加1。炽光仙女可以举行一个24小时的仪式，将自己与一颗新的星体绑定。

items.name: 超新星
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger The heliad dies

Effect The heliad's body explodes into brilliant, luminous flame. Each creature in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] takes @Damage[6d8[fire]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:24|basic] save). Creatures that critically fail are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 minute.
items.description:
触发炽光仙女死亡

效果炽光仙女的身躯爆裂成璀璨耀眼的火焰。@Template[type:emanation|distance:10]内的每个生物受到@Damage[6d8[fire]|options:area-damage]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:24|basic]豁免）。豁免大失败的生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲}，持续1分钟。

WbHO3zQXCuiLMWnW.publicNotes:
作为遍布星系各处的恒星上的居民，炽光仙女们往往性情友善且乐于交际，但她们中大多数人的脾气如同她们那炽热的家园一般变幻莫测。炽光仙女们栖息于仍在凝聚中的原恒星或是较小的矮星之中。尽管她们并非凡人，却遵循着一种与所居住的恒星生命历程相呼应的“生命周期”——随着恒星燃烧愈发炽热、逐渐成熟，她们的力量也随之增长；而当恒星燃尽时，她们则会逐渐衰弱。

许多炽光仙女对她们恒星所在的整个恒星系都满怀兴趣，热切地关注着恒星系内行星上的居民（如果有的话）的新闻、八卦以及活动，或是留意着过往的旅行者。她们对访客的到来感到兴奋不已，并经常广播信息，向那些冒险靠近她们恒星的生物提供款待。为了接待这些访客，炽光仙女们常常在特殊的保护气泡内建造住所，供那些无法在那种环境中生存的生物居住。

宁芙是美丽的精类，外貌呈现为具有精灵特征的类人生物。她们通常以女性形态现身，但也有各种性别和表现形式的宁芙存在。许多宁芙生活在星球上，担当着自然池塘、森林、洞穴和悬崖的守护者，而其他宁芙——通常被称为太空宁芙——则以与天体相关联而闻名。和她们那些与星球绑定的同类一样，太空宁芙守护着与自己绑定的领地，防止其遭受剥削或伤害。

作为艺术的爱好者，宁芙对富有创造力的人特别友好，提出用故事、图画或歌曲来描绘宁芙，是赢得她们青睐的可靠方法——除非宁芙不喜欢最终的成果，并因艺术家用平庸的作品侮辱她们而大发雷霆。视频播客和直播是较为合群的宁芙中流行的消遣方式，无论是为了展示她们所处的偏远环境，还是为了寻找表演的观众。一些宁芙会吸引电影摄制组到她们的领地拍摄，但有两个条件：一是拍摄不得破坏环境，二是宁芙必须在电影中担任重要角色。

除非她们的领地受到威胁，大多数太空宁芙对凡人持友善或不关心的态度，但她们的记忆力极佳。任何造访太空宁芙领地的人都应该研究该宁芙怀有的怨恨、过往与凡人的接触经历，或是该区域近期发生的任何可能影响宁芙对途经其家园的生物看法的重大事件。

展现出正确态度和能力的凡人，例如通过保护一颗星体免遭毁灭，或创作出特别美丽的艺术品，可能会吸引太空宁芙的注意。有时，太空宁芙会主动提出担任恒星武士（solarians）或秘术师（mystics）的导师，尽管她们很少主动寻找学生。太空宁芙很少同时与不止一个人建立这种关系，并且通常只愿为能持续数十年乃至数百年的关系作出承诺，因此她们在选择学生时极为挑剔。

WgVbdad5NIqf86qc.name: 星岩角斗士 Tergaiator
WgVbdad5NIqf86qc.publicNotes:
在宇宙的小行星带中，以及那些岩石天体的表面，栖息着这些热爱比拼的巨大元素生物——星岩角斗士。它们会在摔跤与跳跃时，用小行星碎片加固自己的身体。它们依赖小行星内部的养分茁壮成长，并会为保护家园免遭贪婪采矿企业的过度开采而战。

元素生物是原初位面侵入此间的能量化身。它们形态多样，既有风与水中无心智的涡流，也有能够运用原能魔法的复杂实体。太空旅行的兴起与科技的进步，使更多元素的活体化身得以在宇宙中显现。

山火、太阳风暴和洪水等自然事件，可能将大群难以驾驭的元素生物释放到行星或某片星域。有时，强大元素生物的聚集会引发规模惊人的自然灾难，例如烧毁行星电网的超强太阳耀斑，或是在气态巨行星大气中旋转不息的风暴。

Frequency once per minute

WmyIqf9u7s5KB86U.name: 奥罗科兰人 Orocoran
WmyIqf9u7s5KB86U.publicNotes:
大多数奥罗科兰人依附在散落于太空或极寒边域的奥克腾碎片上，尽可能吞噬新诞者子宫的碎片，并带着狂暴的食欲袭击任何靠近的生物。对于那些试图采集或搬运奥克腾岩的人，奥罗科兰人会展现出尤为激烈且毫不留情的暴力。

奥罗科兰人原生于现已毁灭的行星奥克腾，是污秽绝望的生物。他们在太空中漂泊流离，渴望着再度吞噬新诞者的神性精粹，或是它孕育时所栖身的子宫碎片。他们性情暴躁，嗜好暴力，且饱受折磨。

尽管部分奥罗科兰人已挣脱毒瘾桎梏，重获心智清明与自我意识，本文所述的奥罗科兰人仍依赖奥克腾的诡秘液体。

items.name: 卜筮术

The spell can predict results up to 30 minutes into the future and reveal the GM's best guess among the following outcomes: good, bad, mixed (the results will be a mix of good and bad), and nothing (there won't be particularly good or bad results).

The GM rolls a secret @Check[flat|dc:6|showDC:all|traits:secret]. On a failure, the result is always "nothing." This makes it impossible to tell whether a "nothing" result is accurate. If anyone asks about the same topic as the first casting of augury during an additional casting, the GM uses the secret roll result from the first casting. If circumstances change, though, it's possible to get a different result.

XFkKAb7izGg4Gbbh.name: 接生圣者普雷苏莱 Presulea Midwife
XFkKAb7izGg4Gbbh.publicNotes:
普雷苏莱的凡俗生命因自我牺牲、喂养新诞者而告终。普雷苏莱被重塑为颤抖的一团疯长赘生物与跳动的器官，闪烁着生命能量。

十三名凡人接生者照料了新诞者的降生，并因这位初生外神的觉醒而转化成诡异的存在。只要这个位面上还留有哪怕一粒奥克腾岩——曾经包裹新诞者的行星胎盘的冰冻碎块之名——接生圣者便总能再生出一模一样的新躯体。

接生圣者共有13种，但其真正数量无人知晓。他们的名字是否源自那些灵魂被用作创造接生圣者的火种的凡人仆从，或是对新诞者另有含义，同样是个谜。

每名接生圣者都以自己照料新诞者的方式来定义自身：包裹襁褓、喂养、背负、怀抱、守望、看护、祝福，或为这位外神提供其他养育之举。接生圣者是能够跨维度旅行的强大存在。他们可能出现在漂流域、艾布萨罗姆空间站的幽灵层等阈限空间，也可能现身于极寒边域的奥克腾岩碎片云中。他们难以理解的行动总在推进新诞者莫测的计划——或是他们自己的计划。

协约世界与接生圣团最为人熟知的遭遇，就发生在新诞者刚刚降生之后。为新诞者包裹襁褓、脸旁环绕着蠕动触须兜帽的阿姆涅卡直接袭击了艾布萨罗姆空间站，引发巨大能量涌动，危及站内所有人的生命。混乱随之爆发，但一群恰巧在正确时机搭上正确电梯的冒险者来到了空间站的幽灵层，在那里挫败了阿姆涅卡，阻止这名接生圣者汲取空间站反应堆的能量。此事之后，接生圣团再未如此直接地出手，但许多人怀疑这只是时间问题，也没人知道其他接生圣者究竟有多强大。

XIuQB4mCn3Xt11u9.publicNotes:
这些巨型植物有着粗壮、多节的树干，上面缀满长着尖牙的花朵。树干的顶端长着一张敞开的巨口，能够吞下大多数体格比月光花更小的生物。月光花能够缓慢移动，并以强壮的根茎发动攻击，但通常来说他们会将根部深深地扎进周遭的土地里，一动不动地等待猎物上门。

尽管月光花无法以通常的方式说话，但它们能够利用心灵感应和其他月光花进行交流。任何截获月光花心灵通讯的人，都会遭受远古丛林幻象的侵袭，那里被巨型植物统治着。这种幻象究竟是遗传记忆，还是所有月光花共享的未来之梦，至今仍是未解之谜。

月光花最初萌生于一颗早已死亡的行星，但其在星系的扩散既源于随机传播，也承载着邪恶意图。卡斯卓韦等原始荒野未受破坏的世界，正是月光花林繁茂生长之地。

XM60j0HYHMIRstY0.name: 生物科技先进型战争机器 Biotech Advanced War Machine
XM60j0HYHMIRstY0.publicNotes:
强悍而凶猛的战争机器代号为“thermatrod”，其设计旨在最大限度地制造战场上的杀戮与破坏。相比之下，“vracinea”则是协约世界已观测到的身份不明的生物科技战争机器中最弱小的种类之一。它流线形的身躯隐蔽而敏捷，迅速穿梭于敌方防线内外，将数据传给驾驶者，然后离去。若被发现，vracinea就会自毁，以销毁携带的数据记录。

这场入侵始于阿巴隆的新械族接连发现的探测器。传感器炽亮、长着分节触须的奇异机器不知从何处现身，看似毫无规律地撕裂基础设施，并在整个协约世界宙域搜集情报。恐慌迅速蔓延，但这些机器总会消失得无影无踪，或在被捕获时爆炸，因此始终无法证实目击报告或辨明其身份。流言渐起，称这些机器采用了一种前所未见的生物科技。不久，理事军正式介入，将这些事件封锁在最高机密权限的精金壁垒之后。

后断层纪元325年阳愈月（Sarenith），在数十次军事行动均未能与行踪飘忽的探测器交战之后，一支从伊达里号派出的战斗机联队终于走运，在其中一台机器自毁前将其瘫痪。协约世界的顶尖科学家设法让这台生物科技载具吐露了部分秘密，它由此成为了“本土制造”的遥控战争机器的原型，如今这类机器正接受战斗应用测试。这些仿制品并非活物，而是使用机器人制造模板建造的，因为原始生物科技设计的核心过于复杂，协约科技尚无法对其进行逆向工程。

遥控战争机器是可以从极远距离控制的替身。原始的生物科技战争机器通过心灵链接或未知无线电频率连接驾驶者的心智。机械式遥控战争机器则通过数据链路连接计算机，供驾驶者使用键盘、虚拟现实设备，甚至电子游戏手柄来控制自己的替身。

XPnaCwBoyc5nNE20.name: 克鲁维兽终灵 Koruvi Endling
XPnaCwBoyc5nNE20.publicNotes:
克鲁维兽是一种体型小巧的有蹄类生物，栖息于卡冷五号（Calen-5）这个潮湿而林木繁茂的世界。当维斯卡里姆的采矿公司在卡冷五号发现稀有星铁后，采矿热潮摧毁了该行星的赤道雨林，导致克鲁维兽灭绝。多年后，定居者报告遭遇神秘的财产损毁事件，并目睹幽灵般的野兽疯狂拆解遇到的任何科技设备。

每个物种在诞生与进化过程中都遵循着自然的弧线：兴起、繁荣、衰落，最终走向灭绝。当这些轨迹遭遇极端非自然的终结——意外捕食、工业化浪潮或外来病原体摧毁种群时——终灵便诞生了。这些灭绝物种的幽魂成员，往往作为对自身灭绝的"回应"而诞生。异星生物学家对终灵的起源众说纷纭，无法确认它们究竟是物种最后集体悲恸的具象化，还是复仇的个体精魂——那些最后熄灭的微光。

An endling can be permanently destroyed only if someone determines the reason for its existence and sets right whatever prevents the spirit from resting, such as an act of decolonization, ecological restoration, or curing the disease responsible for its extinction.
items.description: 终灵被摧毁后，会在[[/gmr 2d4 #days]]{2d4天}后于它最初出现的区域内重组，恢复全部生命值。只有当有人查明其存在的缘由，并消除阻碍灵魂安息的因素，例如采取去殖民化行动、进行生态修复，或治愈导致其灭绝的疾病，才能永久摧毁终灵。

XUXGvfT1PAvueWTF.name: 炽光仙后 Heliad Queen
XUXGvfT1PAvueWTF.publicNotes:
炽光仙后栖居于最大的矮星、成熟恒星以及超巨星之上。她们以自身恒星的耀眼光芒为傲，常常身着特制衣物，这些衣物能折射光线，以彰显其家园的璀璨光芒。

宁芙是美丽的精类，外貌呈现为具有精灵特征的类人生物。她们通常以女性形态现身，但也有各种性别和表现形式的宁芙存在。许多宁芙生活在星球上，担当着自然池塘、森林、洞穴和悬崖的守护者，而其他宁芙——通常被称为太空宁芙——则以与天体相关联而闻名。和她们那些与星球绑定的同类一样，太空宁芙守护着与自己绑定的领地，防止其遭受剥削或伤害。

作为艺术的爱好者，宁芙对富有创造力的人特别友好，提出用故事、图画或歌曲来描绘宁芙，是赢得她们青睐的可靠方法——除非宁芙不喜欢最终的成果，并因艺术家用平庸的作品侮辱她们而大发雷霆。视频播客和直播是较为合群的宁芙中流行的消遣方式，无论是为了展示她们所处的偏远环境，还是为了寻找表演的观众。一些宁芙会吸引电影摄制组到她们的领地拍摄，但有两个条件：一是拍摄不得破坏环境，二是宁芙必须在电影中担任重要角色。

除非她们的领地受到威胁，大多数太空宁芙对凡人持友善或不关心的态度，但她们的记忆力极佳。任何造访太空宁芙领地的人都应该研究该宁芙怀有的怨恨、过往与凡人的接触经历，或是该区域近期发生的任何可能影响宁芙对途经其家园的生物看法的重大事件。

展现出正确态度和能力的凡人，例如通过保护一颗星体免遭毁灭，或创作出特别美丽的艺术品，可能会吸引太空宁芙的注意。有时，太空宁芙会主动提出担任恒星武士（solarians）或秘术师（mystics）的导师，尽管她们很少主动寻找学生。太空宁芙很少同时与不止一个人建立这种关系，并且通常只愿为能持续数十年乃至数百年的关系作出承诺，因此她们在选择学生时极为挑剔。

You call upon the power of the planes to transform into a Medium elemental battle form. When you Cast this Spell, choose a listed element. While in this form, you gain the corresponding trait and the elemental trait. You have hands in this battle form and can take manipulate actions. You can Dismiss the spell.

  • AC = 19 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.

Your attack modifier is +18, and your damage bonus is +9. These are Dexterity based (air, fire, or metal) or Strength based (earth, water, or wood). If your corresponding unarmed attack modifier is higher, you can use it instead.

  • Metal

    • Melee 1 wave, Damage 1d12 bludgeoning, and you can spend an action immediately after a hit to push the target 5 feet with the effects of a successful @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}.
  • Wood
    • Speed 20 feet, climb 30 feet;
    • Melee 1 branch, Damage 2d10 bludgeoning.

Heightened (6th) Your battle form is Large and your attacks have 10-foot reach. You must have space to expand or the spell is lost. You instead gain AC = 22 + your level, 15 temporary HP, an attack modifier of +23, a damage bonus of +13, and Acrobatics or Athletics +23.

Heightened (7th) Your battle form is Huge and your attacks have 15-foot reach. You must have space to expand or the spell is lost. You instead gain AC = 22 + your level, 20 temporary HP, an attack modifier of +25, a damage bonus of +11, double the number of damage dice (including persistent damage), and Acrobatics or Athletics +25.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Qp0dlhJaCzXIx73r]{Spell Effect: Elemental Form}
items.description:
你唤来位面的能量，转变为中型元素战斗形态。当你施放该法术时，选择一个列出的元素。处于该形态时，你获得对应的特征以及元素特征。在该战斗形态中你有手，并且能进行操作动作。你可以解消该法术。

你获得后续数据和能力，无论你选择哪种战斗形态：

  • AC=19+你的等级。忽略你的护甲检定减值和速度减值。
  • 10临时生命值。
  • 黑暗视觉。
  • 一个或多个由你选择的战斗形态决定的无武装近战攻击，这是你仅能使用的打击。你对这些攻击受训。你的攻击调整值为+18、你的伤害加值为+9。这些基于敏捷（气，火或者金）或者基于力量（土，水或者木）。如果你对应的无武装攻击调整值更高，你能改为使用该调整值。
  • 特技（气，火或者金）或者运动（土，水或者木）调整值+20；如果你本身的调整值更高，忽略该改变。

你也会根据你选择的元素类型获得特定能力：

  • 气
    • 飞行 80尺，移动不会触发反应动作;
    • 近战 1 暴风, 伤害 1d4 钝击
  • 土
    • 速度20尺，掘地 20尺;
    • 近战 1 巨石, 伤害 2d10 钝击
  • 火
    • 速度 50尺； 火焰抗力 10，寒冷弱点5和水弱点5;
    • 近战 1 触须 , 伤害 1d8 火焰加1d4持续火焰伤害
  • 金
    • 速度 40尺, 飞行 20尺;
    • 近战 1 利刃（多用穿刺）, 伤害 1d8挥砍加上1d4电击
  • 水
    • 速度20尺，游泳 60尺； 火焰抗力 5;
    • 近战 1 波浪, 伤害 1d12 钝击并且你可以在命中后立即花费一个动作，获得成功的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{推撞}所产生的效应，将目标推离5尺。
  • 木
    • 速度 20尺, 攀爬 30尺;
    • 近战 1 树枝, 伤害 2d10钝击

升阶（6环） 你的战斗形态为大型，并且你的攻击具有10尺触及。你必须有空间扩大体型，否则你会失去法术。你改为获得AC=22+你的等级、15临时生命、攻击调整值+23、伤害加值+13、以及特技或者运动+23。

升阶（7环） 你的战斗形态为超大型，并且你的攻击具有15尺触及。你必须有空间扩大体型，否则你会失去法术。你改为获得AC=22+你的等级、20临时生命、攻击调整值+25、伤害加值+11并且伤害骰子翻倍（包括持续伤害），以及特技或者运动+25。

items.name: 造物术
items.expectedDescription:
You conjure a temporary object from magical energy. It must consist of earthen or plant-derived matter (such as wood, paper, brick, or stone) and be 5 cubic feet or smaller. It can't rely on intricate artistry or complex moving parts, never fulfills a cost or the like, and can't be made of precious materials or materials with a rarity of uncommon or higher. It is obviously temporarily conjured, and thus can't be sold or passed off as a genuine item. The spell gains the appropriate trait for the item created, typically earth, plant, or wood.

Heightened (5th) The item is metal and can include common minerals, like feldspar or quartz. The spell gains the metal trait if used to create a metal object
items.description:
你使用魔法能量创造一个临时的物体。它必须由土质或者植物质材料（例如木头、纸、砖块、或者石头）组成，并且为5立方尺或更小。该物体不能需求复杂的工艺，或者复杂的活动机构，并且绝不能用于支付费用或类似用途，并且不能由贵重材料，或稀有度为罕见或更高的材料组成。它显然是临时创造的，因此无法出售或冒充真品。该法术获得你制造物品的特征，通常是土（earth）、植物（plant）、或者木（wood）

升阶（5环） 该物品是金属制，并且可以包括常见矿物，例如长石或石英。该法术会获得金属（metal）特征，如果被用来创造金属物体。

items.name: 火焰护盾
items.expectedDescription:
You create a hovering shield made of fire. As long as the shield persists, its heat grants you cold resistance 5 and makes you immune to mild and severe environmental cold. You can Raise a Shield with the fire shield as a normal shield to gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC. You can use the Shield Block reaction with the fire shield, which has Hardness 10, is immune to fire, and has 40 HP (with no Broken Threshold), and its Hardness is halved against effects that have the water trait. If you Shield Block a melee attack that is either an unarmed attack or made by an adjacent attacker, the attacker takes 2d6 fire damage.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.1RsScTvNdGD9zGWe]{Spell Effect: Fire Shield}

Heightened (+2) The cold resistance increases by 5, the HP increase by 10, and the fire damage increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你创造出一面由火焰构成的盾牌悬停在空中。只要盾牌存在，它的热量就会让你获得5点寒冷抗力，使你免疫环境中的轻度寒冷及严寒。你能如同使用普通盾牌一般对火焰护盾使用举盾动作并使得AC获得+1环境加值。你也能使用火焰护盾进行盾牌格挡反应动作，它具有10点硬度、免疫火焰、以及40点生命值（不具有破损阈值），其硬度在对抗具有水特征的效果时减半。若你盾牌格挡一次近战攻击，且该次攻击是无武装攻击或者由相邻攻击者作出的话，攻击者承受2d6点火焰伤害。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.1RsScTvNdGD9zGWe]{法术效果：火焰护盾}

升阶（+2） 寒冷抗力增加5点，生命值增加10点，火焰伤害增加1d6点。

items.name: 火墙术
items.expectedDescription:
You raise a blazing wall that burns creatures passing through it. You create either a 5-foot-thick wall of flame in a straight line up to 60 feet long and 10 feet high, or a 5-foot-thick, 10-foot-radius ring of flame with the same height. The wall stands vertically in either form; if you wish, the wall can be of a shorter length or height. Everything on each side of the wall is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} from creatures on the opposite side. Any creature that crosses the wall or is occupying the wall's area at the start of its turn takes 4d6 fire damage.

Heightened (+1) The fire damage increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你令一面熊熊燃烧的火墙拔地而起，其能灼烧穿越墙体的生物。你可以创造5尺厚的直线形火墙，至多60尺长，10尺高；或是高度相同，但5尺厚，10尺半径的环状火墙。该墙体无论哪种形态均以竖直姿态矗立；只要你愿意，所创造墙体的长度与高度均可以更短。火墙一侧的任何事物对于另一侧的生物而言均为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。任何穿过该墙体，或者在其回合开始时占据墙体区域的生物承受4d6点火焰伤害。

升阶（+1）该火焰伤害增加1d6。

items.name: 闪电枷锁
items.expectedDescription:
You supercharge the targets' electromagnetism and pull them with a tether of lightning. Make a ranged spell attack against each target. If you attack two targets, both attacks count toward your multiple attack penalty, but it doesn't increase until after both attacks. The targets each take 4d8 electricity damage and are pulled 5 feet closer to you, or 10 feet closer on a critical hit. If both attacks hit, you can choose to move the creatures closer to one another instead of closer to you. Moving a target into a barrier, creature, or obstacle causes the target to stop before entering that space.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d8.
items.description:
你使目标的电磁场过载，并以闪电锁链将其拽向自己。对每个目标进行一次远程法术攻击。若攻击两个目标，两次攻击均计入多重攻击减值，但该减值仅在两次攻击完成后生效。每个目标受到4d8电击伤害并且向着你的方向被拉拽5尺（大成功10尺）。如果两次攻击都命中，你可以选择让两个生物彼此靠近而不是被拉向你。如果目标在位移过程中碰到街垒、生物或障碍，目标会在进入那个方格之前停下。

升阶（+1）该伤害增加1d8。

items.name: 注目术
items.expectedDescription:
Your words fascinate your targets. You speak or sing without interruption throughout the casting and duration. Targets who notice your speech or song might give their undivided attention; each target must attempt a Will save. The GM might grant a circumstance bonus (to a maximum of +4) if the target is of an opposing religion, ancestry, or political leaning, or is otherwise unlikely to agree with what you're saying.

Each creature that comes within range has to attempt a save when you Sustain the spell. If you're speaking, enthrall gains the linguistic trait.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and notices that you tried to use magic.

Success The target needn't pay attention but doesn't notice you tried to use magic (it might notice others are enthralled).

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} with you. It can attempt another Will save if it witnesses actions or speech with which it disagrees. If it succeeds, it's no longer fascinated and is temporarily immune for 1 hour. If the target is subject to a hostile act, or if another creature succeeds at a Diplomacy or Intimidation check against it, the fascination ends immediately.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target can't attempt a save to end the fascination if it disagrees with you.
items.description:
你的言语令目标迷魂。你在施法和持续时间中持续演说或者歌唱。注意到你的演说或者歌唱的目标可能会全神贯注于你；每个目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。如果目标的信仰，族裔，政治观念对立，或者其他它不愿认同你的说法的情况，GM可能赋予一个环境加值（最大为+4）。

在你维持法术时，每个进入射程的生物必须尝试一次豁免。如果你在演说，注目术获得语言特征。

大成功 目标不受影响，并且注意到你尝试使用魔法。

成功 目标不必注意，但是也没发现你在使用魔法（他也许发现其他人被注目术影响）。

失败 目标对你@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{迷魂}。当它发现其不认同的行为或者说法时，它可以尝试另一次意志豁免。如果它成功，他不再迷魂，并且临时免疫1小时。如果目标成为敌对行为的目标，或者另一个生物成功对其进行交涉或威吓检定，迷魂会立即结束。

大失败 如同失败，但是目标不会在其不认同你时尝试豁免以结束迷魂。

items.name: 火球术
items.expectedDescription:
A roaring blast of fire detonates at a spot you designate, dealing 6d6 fire damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.
items.description:
在你指定的位置爆发出咆哮的烈焰，造成6d6火焰伤害。

升阶（+1） 该伤害增加2d6。

items.name: 辐射术
items.expectedDescription:
You rapidly destabilize and decay the atoms around you to create a burst of magically enhanced mild radiation. Creatures in the area must attempt a Fortitude save against mild radiation sickness. This magical radiation uses your spell DC in place of the radiation's normal Fortitude DC, has an immediate onset, and the interval between each stage is 1 round. Technology doesn't gain the glitching condition from the radiation created by this spell.

Heightened (5th) The radiation increases to severe.

Heightened (7th) The radiation increases to extreme.

Heightened (9th) The radiation increases to incredible.
items.description:
你使周围的原子迅速失稳衰变，产生一阵由魔法增强的轻度辐射爆发。区域内的生物必须对轻度辐射病尝试一次强韧豁免。这种魔法辐射以你的法术DC代替通常的辐射强韧DC，立即发作，且每个阶段之间的间隔为1轮。具有科技特征的事物不会因这个法术产生的辐射获得故障状态。

升阶（5 环）辐射增至严重。

升阶（7 环）辐射增至极度。

升阶（9 环）辐射增至严酷。

items.name: 灼热火矢
items.expectedDescription:
You fire a ray of heat and flame. Make a spell attack roll against a single creature. On a hit, the target takes 2d6 fire damage, and on a critical hit, the target takes double damage.

For each additional action you use when Casting the Spell, you can fire an additional ray at a different target, to a maximum of three rays targeting three different targets for 3 actions. These attacks each increase your multiple attack penalty, but you don't increase your multiple attack penalty until after you make all the spell attack rolls for blazing bolt. If you spend 2 or more actions Casting the Spell, the damage increases to 4d6 fire damage on a hit, and it still deals double damage on a critical hit.

Heightened (+1) The damage to each target increases by 1d6 for the 1-action version, or by 2d6 for the 2-action and 3-action versions.
items.description:
你发射出热能与火焰构成的射线。进行一次法术攻击掷骰对抗单个生物。命中时，目标承受2d6点火焰伤害，重击时，目标承受双倍伤害。

你在施放该法术时使用的每个额外动作，都能够对一个不同的目标发射出1道额外射线，至多为3个动作对3个不同目标发射3道射线。这些攻击均会增加你的多重攻击减值，但是直至你作出所有灼热火矢的法术攻击掷骰之前都不会增加你的多重攻击减值。若你花费2个或更多动作施放该法术，命中时的伤害增加至4d6点火焰伤害，它仍会在重击时造成双倍伤害。

升阶（+1） 单动作版本的目标承受的伤害增加1d6点，双动作或三动作对每个目标的伤害增加2d6点。

items.name: 永亮术
items.expectedDescription:
The gemstone you touch glows, spreading bright light with a color of your choice in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet). The spell ends immediately if the gemstone is broken.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.hpbCDbDOoVyhOmck]{Spell Effect: Everlight}
items.description:
你触摸的宝石发出由你选择颜色的光芒，在20尺半径内产生明亮光照（以及接下来的20尺产生昏暗光照）。如果宝石破损，该法术立即结束。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.hpbCDbDOoVyhOmck]{法术效果：永亮术}

items.name: 灵魂激涌
items.expectedDescription:
You channel your life force into a spear of energy. You lose 6 Hit Points or, if you're in a bond with a vitality network that has at least 12 Hit Points, you can reduce the vitality bond's Hit Points by 12 instead. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, you deal 6d6 spirit damage. On a critical hit, the target takes double damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}.

Heightened (+1) Increase the damage dealt by 2d6 and the Hit Points lost by 2 (or by 4 if you spend Hit Points from a vitality network).
items.description:
你将生命力引导成一支能量长矛。你失去6点生命值；或者，若你与一个至少有12点生命值的命能网络联结，可以改为将命能联结的生命值减少12点。对目标的AC进行一次远程法术攻击。命中时，你造成6d6精魂伤害。重击时，目标受到双倍伤害并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失1}。

升阶（+1） 造成的伤害增加2d6，失去的生命值增加2点（若消耗命能网络的生命值，则增加4点）。

items.name: 燃烧之息
items.expectedDescription:
A gout of flame sprays from your mouth. You deal 2d6 fire damage to creatures in the area with a basic Reflex save.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.
items.description:
一团火焰从你的口中喷出。你对区域内的每个生物造成2d6火焰伤害，基础反射豁免。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加2d6点。

items.name: 魅惑术
items.expectedDescription:
To the target, your words are honey and your visage seems bathed in a dreamy haze. It must attempt a Will save, with a +4 circumstance bonus if you or your allies recently threatened it or used hostile actions against it.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you use hostile actions against the target, the spell ends. When the spell ends, the target doesn't necessarily realize it was charmed unless its friendship with you or the actions you convinced it to take clash with its expectations, meaning you could potentially convince the target to continue being your friend via mundane means.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and aware you tried to charm it.

Success The target is unaffected but thinks your spell was something harmless instead of charm, unless it identifies the spell.

Failure The target's attitude becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v66R7FdOf11l94im]{Friendly} toward you. If it was Friendly, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v44P3WUcU1j0115l]{Helpful}. It can't use hostile actions against you.

Critical Failure The target's attitude becomes Helpful toward you, and it can't use hostile actions against you.

Heightened (4th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations.

Heightened (8th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations, and you can target up to 10 creatures.
items.description:
在目标看来，你的言语甜蜜动听，你的形象笼罩在梦幻般的光晕中。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免，如果你或者你的盟友最近威胁它或者对它进行了敌对行为，会获得+4环境加值。

你可以解消该法术。如果你对目标使用任何敌对动作，法术终止。当该法术结束时，目标不一定会意识到自己被魅惑了，除非它和你的友好关系，或者你说服它去做的事情与其期望发生冲突。这也即是说你可以通过常规的方法说服目标继续作为你的朋友。

大成功 目标不受影响，并且意识到你尝试魅惑它。

成功 该目标不受影响，但是认为你的法术是某种无害的东西，而不是魅惑术，除非它能识别该法术。

失败 目标对你的态度变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v66R7FdOf11l94im]{友善}。如果已经是友善，则变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v44P3WUcU1j0115l]{乐于帮助}。它不能对你做出敌对行为。

大失败 目标变为乐于帮助并且不能对你做出敌对行为。

升阶（4环） 法术持续至你下次进行每日准备。

升阶（8环） 法术持续至你下次进行每日准备，并且你能以至多10个生物作为目标。

items.name: 焕发光彩
items.expectedDescription:
You create an illusion that causes the target to appear more charming and genteel to observers. The spell accentuates the target's appearance, clothing, voice, and mannerisms according to what an observer finds appealing. Held items are unaffected, and any worn item removed from the creature returns to its true appearance.

The target gains a +1 status bonus to Diplomacy checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} and lets the target add its level to Diplomacy checks if untrained. In addition, the target can attempt a Diplomacy check to Gather Information in only 10 minutes. You can Dismiss this spell.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.hOp5ybOzyJlECU6B]

Heightened (+2) The bonus increases by 1, to a maximum of +4 at 7th rank.
items.description:
你制造一种幻象，使目标在观察者面前显得更加迷人和优雅。该法术会根据观察者认为吸引人的地方来突出目标的外表、衣着、声音和举止。手持物品不受影响，从生物身上取下的任何穿戴物品都会恢复原貌。

目标在进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]的交涉检定中获得+1状态加值，如果目标未受训，则可以在进行交涉检定时加上其等级。此外，目标还可以只花10分钟尝试交涉检定进行收集信息。你可以解消此法术。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.hOp5ybOzyJlECU6B]

items.name: 神导术
items.expectedDescription:
You ask for the guidance of supernatural entities, granting the target a +1 status bonus to one attack roll, Perception check, saving throw, or skill check the target attempts before the duration ends. The target chooses which roll to use the bonus on before rolling. If the target uses the bonus, the spell ends. Either way, the target is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3qHKBDF7lrHw8jFK]{Spell Effect: Guidance}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3LyOkV25p7wA181H]{Effect: Guidance Immunity}
items.description:
你请求超自然存在的引导，赋予目标在持续时间结束前的一次攻击掷骰、察觉检定、豁免或技能检定上获得+1状态加值。目标在掷骰前选择是否使用该加值。如果目标使用该加值，该法术结束。无论怎样结束，该目标接下来会临时免疫1小时。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3LyOkV25p7wA181H]{效果：神导术免疫}

items.name: 引火术
items.expectedDescription:
You snap your fingers and point at a target, which begins to smolder. Make a spell attack roll against the target's AC, dealing 2d4 fire damage on a hit. If the target is within your melee reach, you can choose to make a melee spell attack with the flame instead of a ranged spell attack, which increases all the spell's damage dice to d6s.

Critical Success The target takes double damage and 1d4 persistent fire damage.

Success The target takes full damage.

Heightened (+1) The initial damage increases by 1d4 and the persistent fire damage on a critical hit increases by 1d4.

@Damage[(@item.rank)d4[persistent,fire]]{Scaling Persistent Fire Damage}

@Damage[(@item.rank)d6[persistent,fire]]{Scaling Persistent Fire Damage (Melee)}
items.description:
你打个响指并指向一个目标，后者便开始阴燃。作出一次法术攻击检定对抗目标的AC，命中时造成2d4点火焰伤害。若目标位于你的近战触及范围内，你能选择用火焰进行一次近战法术攻击以取代远程法术攻击，这会使得法术的所有伤害骰提升至d6骰子。

大成功 目标承受双倍伤害以及1d4点持续火焰伤害。

成功 目标承受全额伤害。

升阶（+1） 起始伤害增加1d4点，重击的持续火焰伤害增加1d4点。

@Damage[(@item.rank)d4[persistent,fire]]{随环阶提升的持续火焰伤害}

@Damage[(@item.rank)d6[persistent,fire]]{随环阶提升的持续火焰伤害（近战）}

items.name: 光亮术
items.expectedDescription:
You create an orb of light that sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet) in a color you choose. If you create the light in the same space as a willing creature, you can attach the light to the creature, causing it to float near that creature as it moves. You can Sustain the spell to move the light up to 60 feet; you can attach or detach it from a creature as part of this movement.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you Cast the Spell while you already have four light spells active, you must choose one of the existing spells to end.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.cVVZXNbV0nElVOPZ]{Spell Effect: Light}

Heightened (4th) The orb sheds light in a 60-foot radius (and dim light for the next 60 feet).
items.description:
你创造一个光球，它发出由你选择的颜色的光芒，在20尺半径内产生明亮光照（以及接下来的20尺产生昏暗光照）。如果你在一个自愿生物所占据的空间内创造光球，你可以将光球连结到该生物，使光球在该生物附近悬浮，并随其移动。你可以维持法术以移动光球至多60尺，作为这个移动的一部分，你可以将光球连结到一个生物或是从一个生物上解除连结。

你可以解消该法术。若你已经有4个光亮术生效时施放此法术，你必须结束一个已存在的法术。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.cVVZXNbV0nElVOPZ]{法术效果：光亮术}

items.name: 过热术
items.expectedDescription:
You vent heat toward a nearby target. You deal 2d6 fire damage to the target. On a failed save, the target's held equipment becomes hot to the touch for the next round. Unless the target drops its currently held equipment at the start of its turn, it takes @Damage[(3*@item.rank)[fire]] damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6. Increase the damage of touching affected objects by 3.
items.description:
你将积聚的热能导向附近目标。你对目标造成2d6火焰伤害。如果豁免失败，目标手持的装备会在下一轮变得灼热。除非目标在回合开始时扔掉当前手持的装备，否则会受@Damage[(3*@item.rank)[fire]]伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 2d6。触碰受影响物体的伤害增加3

items.name: 魔法伎俩
items.expectedDescription:
The simplest magic does your bidding. You can perform simple magical effects for as long as you Sustain the spell. Each time you Sustain the spell, you can choose one of four options.

  • Cook Cool, warm, or flavor 1 pound of nonliving material.
  • Lift Slowly lift an unattended object of light Bulk or less 1 foot off the ground.
  • Make Create a temporary object of negligible Bulk, made of congealed magical substance. The object looks crude and artificial and is extremely fragile-it can't be used as a tool, weapon, or locus or cost for a spell.
  • Tidy Color, clean, or soil an object of light Bulk or less. You can affect an object of 1 Bulk with 10 rounds of concentration, and a larger object at 1 minute per Bulk.

Prestidigitation can't deal damage or cause adverse conditions. Any actual change to an object (beyond what is noted above) persists only as long as you Sustain the spell.
items.description:
最简单的魔法帮你完成杂务。只要你维持该法术，你就可以产生简单的魔法效果。每当你维持该法术时，你可以选择四个选项中的一个。

  • 烹饪 为1磅非活物材料冷却，加热，或者调味。
  • 抬起 将一件轻负载或者更低的无主物品缓慢抬离地面1尺。
  • 创造 创造一个负载可忽略的临时物体，它由凝结的魔法物质组成。该物体看起来粗糙、不自然，且极其脆弱——它无法被用做工具、武器、施法载体或法术费用。
  • 整理 为一件轻负载或者更低的物体染色，清洁，或者弄脏它。你可以通过10轮专注来影响一件1负载的物体，对于更大的物体为每负载1分钟。

魔法伎俩无法造成伤害或者负面效果。对一件物体的任何改变（在上述内容之外的）只会在你仍维持该法术时持续。

items.name: 感应应答
items.expectedDescription: While on their bonded celestial body, a nymph can sense approaching starships within a day's travel from the celestial body. This doesn't give them any information about the ship, its occupants, or its exact position. The nymph can send a message to the ship as if using a personal comm unit.
items.description: 当宁芙处于与其绑定的天体上时，她能感应到距离天体一天航程范围内的接近的星舰。这不会给她提供关于星舰、其乘员或其确切位置的任何信息。宁芙可以像使用个人通讯单元一样向星舰发送信息。

items.name: 天体链接
items.expectedDescription:
A nymph queen is intrinsically tied to a specific celestial body, such as a supergiant star for a heliad queen.

As long as the queen is healthy, her territory thrives, and she can attempt to [[/r 1d20+26 #Counteract]] counteract spells and rituals that alter its physical properties with a counteract rank of 7.

If a nymph queen is injured or unhealthy, however, her celestial body also weakens: asteroids wobble out of orbit, stars dim, and the gravity of black holes diminishes. Restoring the nymph queen returns her celestial body to its equilibrium.
items.description:
仙后与某一特定天体有着内在联系，例如炽光仙后与一颗超巨星相连。

只要仙后健康，她的领地便欣欣向荣，她也可以尝试以[[/r 1d20+26 #Counteract]]抵消会改变该天体物理性质的法术和仪式，抵消环阶为7。

但如果仙后受伤或不健康，她的天体也会衰弱：小行星摇晃着偏离轨道、恒星黯淡、黑洞的引力减弱。使仙后恢复健康也会使其天体重归平衡。

items.name: 辐光凝视
items.expectedDescription:
60 feet. A heliad's eyes blaze like a sun. When a creature enters or starts its turn in the aura, it must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:34] save. The heliad can deactivate or activate this aura by using a single action, which has the concentrate trait.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} until the start of its next turn.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} until the start of its next turn.
items.description:
60尺。炽光仙后的双眼如太阳般炽烈。生物进入灵光或在灵光内开始回合时，必须尝试一次@Check[fortitude|dc:34]豁免。炽光仙后可以使用一个具有专注特征的单动作，关闭或开启此灵光。

成功 生物不受影响。

失败 生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}，直到其下一回合开始。

大失败 生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲}，直到其下一回合开始。

items.name: 超新星
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger The heliad queen dies

Effect The heliad's body explodes into brilliant, luminous flame. Each creature in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] takes @Damage[12d8[fire]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:34|basic] save). Creatures that critically fail are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 minute.
items.description:
触发炽光仙后死亡

效果炽光仙女的身躯爆裂成璀璨耀眼的火焰。@Template[type:emanation|distance:10]内的每个生物受到@Damage[12d8[fire]|options:area-damage]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:34|basic]豁免）。豁免大失败的生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲}，持续1分钟。

items.name: 散播魅力
items.expectedDescription:
The nymph queen magically superimposes her image on all technological items capable of displaying it, such as datapads or comm units, within planetary range. Alternatively, she can send this image to any comm address or addresses that she knows.

Each creature that can see the image must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:34] or have their attitude toward her improve by one step (two steps on a critical failure).

Affected creatures' attitudes revert to their previous level if the nymph queen uses a hostile action against them or their allies.
items.description:
宁芙仙后以魔法将自己的影像叠加显示在行星范围内所有能够显示该影像的科技物品上，例如数据板或通讯器。她也可以选择将此影像发送至自己知道的任意一个或多个通讯地址。

每个能看见影像的生物都必须通过一次@Check[will|dc:34]，否则对她的态度提升一级（大失败时提升两级）。

若宁芙仙后对受影响的生物或其盟友使用敌对动作，受影响生物的态度便恢复为先前的水平。

items.name: 天体跃迁
items.expectedDescription: A nymph queen can traverse her celestial body near-instantaneously. A nymph queen can use Celestial Step to teleport to any area on or within her territory, vanishing into its surface and reemerging at her intended destination.
items.description: 宁芙仙后几乎能瞬间穿越自己的天体。宁芙仙后可以用天体跃迁，潜入天体表面，再从预定目的地出现，传送到其领地表面或内部的任意区域。

items.name: 变身
items.expectedDescription: Nymph queens can transform between their original form, which looks much like a typical nymph of their kind, and any Small or Medium humanoid form, typically choosing a version of their natural form with the appearance of the chosen species.
items.description: 宁芙仙后可以在原形与任何小型或中型类人生物形态之间变身；其原形看起来非常像同种的典型宁芙。她们通常选择保留自身天然形貌、但具有所选物种外貌的形态。

items.name: 联络粉丝
items.expectedDescription:
A nymph queen can inspire a single intelligent creature by sending them a motivational video or text message. As long as the creature keeps the message saved and remains in good standing with the nymph queen, they gain a +1 status bonus to all Crafting, Performance, and Lore checks related to art or performance.

As a 1-action Interact action, the creature can play or view the message to bolster their spirits. Doing so allows the creature to attempt a [[/r 1d20+26 #Counteract]] counteract check against a single emotion effect affecting them.

When the nymph queen's message is used in this way, it becomes a mundane video or text afterward.
items.description:
仙后可以通过向单一有智能生物发送励志视频或文字信息来鼓舞其精神。只要该生物仍保存着这条信息，且与仙后关系良好，其所有与艺术或表演相关的手艺、表演和学识检定获得+1状态加值。

该生物可以用一个1动作的交互动作，播放或查看信息，以振奋精神。这允许该生物尝试一次[[/r 1d20+26 #Counteract]]抵消检定，对抗正影响其的单一情绪效果。

仙后的信息以此方式使用后，会变为普通的视频或文字。

XcJswM9jt3alx7eo.name: 蚀光影骸 Draiclipsed

items.name: 骸骨权杖
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This engraved club of solid bone is tempered using material from the void that can drain life energy.
items.description:
强化： 1

这根雕刻的实心骨棒，以能够汲取生命能量的虚空材料淬炼而成。

items.name: 红外视觉
items.expectedDescription: A draiclipsed can detect infrared radiation (such as that given off by warm-blooded creatures) as an imprecise sense at the listed range.
items.description: 蚀光影骸能够在所列范围内以模糊感官侦测到红外辐射（例如由温血生物散发）。

items.name: 日蚀寿衣
items.expectedDescription: 15 feet. A draiclipsed absorbs light and is perpetually surrounded by shifting shadows and lengthening darkness. Light in the area decreases by one step (for example, bright light becomes dim light).
items.description: （灵光，黑暗）15尺。蚀光影骸吸收光照，周围永久被变幻阴影和不断加深的黑暗笼罩。区域内的光照下降一级（例如，明亮光照变为昏暗光照）。

items.name: 虚能治疗
items.expectedDescription: @Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.NegativeHealing]
items.description: @Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.NegativeHealing]

items.name: 吞噬光明
items.expectedDescription: The draiclipsed opens their mouth and sucks in a magical light, consuming it to fuel their own powers. The draiclipsed attempts a counteract check against one magical light effect within 60 feet ([[/r 1d20+15 #Counteract]]{+15} counteract modifier). If successful, the draiclipsed becomes ringed in diffuse light, becoming photonic for the next 24 hours. While a draiclipsed is photonic, they're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.
items.description: 蚀光影骸张开嘴吸入魔法光照，将其吞噬，为自己的能力供能。蚀光影骸尝试反制60尺内的一个魔法光照效果（反制调整值[[/r 1d20+15 #Counteract]]{+15}）。成功时，蚀光影骸周身环绕着弥散的光芒，在接下来24小时内进入光子形态。处于光子形态的蚀光影骸具有@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。

items.name: 剿灭叛徒
items.expectedDescription: Whenever a draiclipsed would deal void damage to an undead or other creature with void healing, that void damage becomes cold damage instead.
items.description: 当蚀光影骸对不死生物或其他具有虚能治疗的生物造成虚能伤害时，该虚能伤害改为寒冷伤害。

items.name: 黑暗降临
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements The draiclipsed is photonic

Effect The draiclipsed releases the light they've consumed in a blast of corrupted electromagnetic energy, dealing @Damage[3d8[electricity],3d8[void]|options:area-damage] damage in a @Template[type:cone|distance:30] (@Check[reflex|dc:24|basic|options:area-effect] save). The draiclipsed is no longer photonic.
items.description:
要求蚀光影骸处于光子形态

效果蚀光影骸将吞噬的光以一股腐化电磁能量释放，造成@Damage[3d8[electricity],3d8[void]|options:area-damage]伤害，范围为@Template[type:cone|distance:30]（@Check[reflex|dc:24|basic|options:area-effect]豁免）。蚀光影骸不再处于光子形态。

items.name: 聚集黑暗
items.expectedDescription: If at least one other draiclipsed is within the draiclipsed's eclipse shroud, the draiclipsed's Strikes deal an additional 1d8 void damage.
items.description: 如果至少一个其他蚀光影骸处于蚀光影骸的日蚀寿衣内，蚀光影骸的打击造成额外1d8虚能伤害。

XcJswM9jt3alx7eo.publicNotes:
蚀光影骸是永餍蚀日（the Insatiable Eclipse）的不死先驱，永餍蚀日是一位在黑月降临伊奥克斯之时被埋葬的古老恐怖的蚀日星髅霸主，最近被新诞者唤醒。永餍蚀日正在集结他的军队，包括蚀光影骸军团，以重夺伊奥克斯，这个他认为已经变得堕落而轻浮的世界，因为其可耻的领袖们做出了与生者结盟的亵渎决定。

蚀光影骸是一种狡猾的骷髅不死生物，它们的漆黑骨骼能够吸收光线，使它们能够投射出深邃的阴影。它们还能吞噬魔法光芒，利用吸收的光量子来模糊自己的形态，然后以电磁能量的爆炸形式释放出来。对它们的创造者和领主绝对忠诚的蚀光影骸被训练用于公开战争，当它们并肩作战时更加危险。

Xt6ybUlOJ91cVeaJ.name: 科扎多尔人 Corzador
Xt6ybUlOJ91cVeaJ.publicNotes:
外形隐约呈人形的科扎多尔人驱赶着科扎德狼群，执行它们阴森的任务。

科扎代菌诞生于奥克腾破碎的残骸之中。它们被爆炸抛射到太空中，这些真菌群落依靠神秘力量维系在一起。他们奇特的子实体（fruiting bodies）呈现出多种形态，其中有两种在协约世界中更为常见，即科扎德狼（corzad）和科扎多尔人（corzador）。

items.name: 囊泡萌发
items.expectedDescription:
Hundreds of wirelike nerve endings erupt from the corzador's head in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30]. Each non-corzadai in the area must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:18|options:area-effect] save or be instantly observed by all corzadais within 100 feet. Corzadais in the area gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attack and damage rolls against the detected creatures as long as the targets remain in the emanation. The corzador's emanation remains in effect until it takes a move action to leave its current space.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.bestiary-effects.Item.Bw1u0YIbG0ZV1CIR]
items.description:
数百条线缆般的神经末梢从科扎多尔人的头部涌出，覆盖@Template[type:emanation|distance:30]。区域内每个非科扎代菌生物必须成功通过一次@Check[reflex|dc:18|options:area-effect]豁免，否则立即对100尺内所有科扎代菌生物处于可见状态。只要目标仍处于弥漫内，区域内的科扎代菌生物对这些被发现生物进行的攻击和伤害掷骰获得+1环境加值。科扎多尔人的弥漫持续生效，直到其使用一个移动动作离开当前空间。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.bestiary-effects.Item.Bw1u0YIbG0ZV1CIR]

items.name: 尖啸囊孢
items.expectedDescription:

Effect The corzador emits a high-pitched shriek. All non-corzadai creatures within the corzador's Follicle Emanation take @Damage[2d8[sonic]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[fortitude|dc:18|basic|options:area-effect] save.
items.description:

XzzHer0NpA4zPhRg.name: 乌尔加扎级相位兽 Ulgaazan Nyssholora
XzzHer0NpA4zPhRg.publicNotes:
曾被记录过的最大的相位兽是“不老的”乌尔加扎（Ulgaaza the Ageless），这只神话生物如此古老，如此巨大，据说足以令群山相形见绌。如今，任何达到史诗级体型的相位兽都被称作“乌尔加扎级”，尽管这些巨兽与作为名字来源的乌尔加扎相比仍不值一提。

相位兽是凶残至极的恐龙形生物，堪称卡斯卓韦行星上最危险、最令人畏惧的顶级掠食者。这些行走的武器拥有致命的生理构造：巨口内排列着双排锋利如剃刀的牙齿，镰刀般锋利的相位刃前肢能以超声波速度振动，笞鞭状的尾巴则能吸收周围大气中的电能。并且相位兽还狡黠敏锐——头顶的触须头冠能感知心灵感应信号，令当地的弗米蚁族与拉申塔人无处遁形。它们的相位刃能如切割灌木般轻易撕裂墙壁与载具，确保猎物无处可逃。

items.name: 心灵感应感知
items.expectedDescription: A nyssholora senses all creatures that have telepathy, limited telepathy, or a similar ability, such as a mystic's bond, as an imprecise sense at the listed range. This sense works through walls and other obstacles.
items.description: （原能） 相位兽能感知拥有心灵感应，有限心灵感应或类似能力的所有生物，例如秘术师的纽带，作为一种具有所列范围的模糊感官。此感官能够穿透墙壁和其他障碍物。

items.name: 音波咆哮
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature fails or critically fails a melee Strike against the nyssholora

Effect The nyssholora snarls at the triggering creature, dealing @Damage[(3d6+6)[sonic]] damage.
items.description:
触发 一个生物对相位兽的近战打击失败或大失败

效果 相位兽朝触发生物咆哮，造成@Damage[(3d6+6)[sonic]]伤害。

items.name: 碾碎
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency once per round

Requirements A creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} in the nyssholora's jaws

Effect The nyssholora chomps down on the creature, dealing @Damage[(2d12+16)[piercing]] damage.
items.description:
频率 每轮一次

需求 一个生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{受擒}于相位兽的颚中

效果 相位兽用力咬下，对该生物造成@Damage[(2d12+16)[piercing]]伤害。

items.name: 刺耳吼叫
items.expectedDescription: The nyssholora unleashes a blast of discordant sound that deal @Damage[18d6[sonic]|options:area-damage] damage in a @Template[type:cone|distance:60] (@Check[reflex|dc:38|basic] save). Objects and constructs in the area are treated as if they had half as much Hardness as usual. Creatures that critically fail their saving throw are also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round. The nyssholora can't use Discordant Bellow again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Discordant Bellow]]{1d4 rounds}.
items.description: 相位兽释放一股刺耳的声浪，造成@Damage[18d6[sonic]|options:area-damage]伤害，范围为@Template[type:cone|distance:60]（@Check[reflex|dc:38|basic]豁免）。区域内物体与构装体的硬度视为通常的一半。豁免大失败的生物还会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢1}，持续1轮。相位兽在[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Discordant Bellow]]{1d4轮}内无法再次使用刺耳吼叫。

items.name: 相位连斩
items.expectedDescription: The nyssholora Strides up to its Speed then makes a phasic blade Strike against each creature within reach. Each attack counts toward the nyssholora's multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after all the attacks.
items.description: 相位兽行走至多等于自身速度的距离，然后对触及范围内的每个生物各进行一次相位刃打击。每次攻击都计入相位兽的多重攻击减值，但该减值直到所有攻击完成后才会增加。

items.name: 相位打击
items.expectedDescription: A nyssholora's phasic blade Strike treats any object or construct it hits as if the target had half as much Hardness as usual.
items.description: 相位兽的相位刃打击将被其命中的任何物体或构装体视作硬度比通常情况减半。

Y8okEtUTLY4ZG1ki.name: 棘刺掠吼龙 Spined Renkroda
Y8okEtUTLY4ZG1ki.publicNotes:
体型粗壮、肌肉发达的棘刺掠吼龙生活在开阔的平原、台地和高原上。与大多数掠吼龙不同，它们的褶边是一种致命的武器，上面排列着数百根长达一尺的尖刺，既是出色的防御手段，也是致命的武器。

掠吼龙是一种大型恐龙状掠食者，原产于行星卡斯卓韦。由于走私者、偷猎者以及猎捕大型动物的巨富们的活动，它们已经扩散到丛林星球之外。掠吼龙是两足动物，身体强壮，拥有长脖子和装饰性的棘刺，它们最著名的是其可怕的吼声，它们经常大声吼叫，作为一种远程通讯的方式，并用来吓跑其他掠食者和食腐动物。掠吼龙存在超过十二种不同的物种，每一种都特别适应它们的环境或生态位。

items.name: 棘刺偏转
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements The spined renkroda's spines are bristled

Trigger The spined renkroda would be hit by a ranged Strike, but the damage hasn't been rolled yet

Effect The spined renkroda twists its body, deflecting part of the attack with its spines, and gains resistance 10 to the triggering damage. Its spines are no longer bristled.
items.description:
要求棘刺掠吼龙的尖刺正竖立着

触发棘刺掠吼龙即将被一次远程打击命中，但尚未掷伤害骰

效果棘刺掠吼龙扭动身体，用尖刺偏转部分攻击，对触发的伤害获得抗力10。它的尖刺不再竖立。

items.name: 竖起棘刺
items.expectedDescription: The spined renkroda bristles its spines and adopts a defensive posture, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to AC until it uses a move action, uses Spine Deflection, or makes any Strike other than a spine Strike. Any creature that attempts a melee attack against the spined renkroda takes @Damage[3d6[piercing]] damage, regardless of whether the attack hits.
items.description: 棘刺掠吼龙竖起棘刺，摆出防御姿态，AC获得+2环境加值，直到它使用移动动作、使用棘刺偏转，或进行尖刺打击以外的任何打击。任何尝试对棘刺掠吼龙进行近战攻击的生物都受到@Damage[3d6[piercing]]伤害，无论攻击是否命中。

items.name: 棘刺弹幕
items.expectedDescription: The spined renkroda makes three ranged spine Strikes.
items.description: 棘刺掠吼龙进行三次远程尖刺打击。

items.expectedDescription:

YH16QzUQB3LPZ36R.name: 恐惧共情蜘蛛 Dread Empathnid
YH16QzUQB3LPZ36R.publicNotes:
恐惧共情蜘蛛是原生在丛林行星的致命猎手。它们在有人居住的世界中繁衍兴盛，偏好捕食智慧类人生物。这些生物被负面情绪吸引，在猎物垂死之际吸收其恐惧，并将这些恐怖体验注入自身蛛网之中。

共情蜘蛛对其他生物怀有强烈的共情能力。这些8寸长的蜘蛛状生物拥有丰富的色彩，且拥有具有救命效果的毒液，这或许解释了为何它们在协约世界中常被当作伙伴或宠物。

items.name: 情绪感知

Against other creatures, this is an imprecise sense. items.description: 这是一种对处于情绪效果影响下或被强烈情绪支配（由GM判断）的生物的精确感官。对于其他生物，这事一种模糊感官。免疫情绪或心灵效果或处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.b515AZlB0sridKSq] 法术下过下的生物不能被情绪感知侦测到。

YiT1jMt24I8pdX6x.name: 艾琳卓祭司 Elindrian Celebrant
YiT1jMt24I8pdX6x.publicNotes:
这些艾琳卓人战士沉溺于暴力。他们唯一的动机似乎是传播痛苦，而他们自身却不知痛苦；其神经末梢的特殊构造使他们完全感受不到疼痛，即便经历痛苦也几乎不会遭受折磨。只要附近有艾琳卓人女王能复活他们，这些祭司便将大多数时间用于相互厮杀，磨砺施暴能力，直至更好的目标出现。

被称为艾琳卓人的种族早在亿万年前便消失于卡斯卓韦行星地表下的荒芜壳巢（husk-hives）。直至近年，他们仍只是传说中的存在，仅存于最晦涩的弗米蚁族史籍之中。如今，卡斯卓韦的学者们正竭力搜寻关于艾琳卓人的更多记载，探究其起源——更重要的是——揭开他们与恐怖泥怪生物联系的真相，这种生物近日从他们的卫星艾琳卓（Elindrae）降临。一种理论认为，艾琳卓人与被称为"乌库兰的恐噩"的泥怪生物存在某种原始羁绊，二者或许同源于艾琳卓——另有理论主张艾琳卓人最初创造了这个泥怪，或是他们是弗米蚁族的远亲，早在久远以前便遭到了恐噩的侵蚀。

items.name: 内置几丁质痛锯
items.expectedDescription: A painsaw functions in all ways like a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment.Item.eUZcCSon8XlQzOqR] but doesn't function with normal batteries.

items.name: 躯壳意识
items.expectedDescription:
Elindrians can communicate nearly instantaneously via a primal bond similar to a formian hive mind. While within telepathic range of at least one other elindrian with husk mind, an elindrian celebrant gains a +2 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls, Perception checks, and saving throws against mental effects. If one elindrian is aware of a combatant, all members of the husk mind within range are aware of it.

The elindrian's husk mind is integrated with their scent; for purposes of detecting other elindrians, formians, undead, or corpses, their scent is a precise sense, rather than imprecise.

An elindrian always knows the precise distance and direction to the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.alien-core-bestiary.Actor.BFtNnevWKUCnocyn], so long as they're on the same plane of existence.
items.description:
艾琳卓人能够通过类似弗米蚁族集体心智的原能联系，近乎瞬时地交流。处于至少另一名具有躯壳意识的艾琳卓人的心灵感应范围内时，艾琳卓祭司的先攻掷骰、察觉检定，以及对抗心灵效果的豁免获得+2环境加值。如果一名艾琳卓人察觉到某个参战者，范围内所有躯壳意识成员都会察觉到该参战者。

艾琳卓人的躯壳意识与其灵敏嗅觉相结合；侦测其他艾琳卓人、弗米蚁族、不死生物或尸体时，其灵敏嗅觉是精确感官，而非模糊感官。

只要双方处于同一存在位面，艾琳卓人就始终知道@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.alien-core-bestiary.Actor.BFtNnevWKUCnocyn]的精确距离和方向。

items.name: 痛苦羁绊
items.expectedDescription: A celebrant's painsaw is powered by the heart of another celebrant. If a celebrant is within 30 feet of a painsaw that contains their heart when the painsaw Strikes a creature, the celebrant regains a number of Hit Points equal to their level (typically 4). It's taboo for a celebrant to wield a painsaw made from their own heart or a heart from any celebrant whose death they didn't witness (or cause) themself. A painsaw otherwise functions in all ways like a painglaive but doesn't function with normal batteries. A single celebrant heart functions as a tactical battery when used with a painsaw; it recharges if the celebrant spends 10 minutes in the presence of an elindrian queen.
items.description: 祭司的苦痛之锯由另一名祭司的心脏驱动。当一名祭司位于一件装有其心脏的苦痛之锯30尺内，当该苦痛之锯打击一个生物时，此祭司恢复等同于其等级（通常为4）的生命值。祭司持用由自身心脏制成的苦痛之锯，或使用未亲眼见证（或亲手造成）其死亡的祭司心脏制成的苦痛之锯，皆属禁忌。除了不能使用正常电池外，其余所有功能苦痛之锯与苦痛大砍刀类似。在使用苦痛之锯时，一颗祭司的心脏视作一块战术型电池；当祭司在艾琳卓女王面前待上十分钟时，该心脏即可再充能。

Yt8VLqsyeOufXTap.publicNotes:
当阿卡塔咬伤类人生物时，会向其体内植入微小的寄生幼虫。死于这种寄生（即“虚空之死”）的受害者将作为虚空丧尸复苏。它们虽形似普通腐尸，但其碎裂的下颌会伸出一条蓝灰色的细长摄食管。当体内的未成熟阿卡塔感知到潜在猎物时，此触须常会因令人作呕的急切感而扭动蜷伸。

一旦宿主死亡，幼虫便会互相吞噬，直到最强壮的一只钻入受害者的脑部。经过数小时的快速孕育后，它附着在大脑上，并注入一缕死灵能量。这一过程会让幼虫变得极度饥渴，驱使它去吸食活物的血液。虚空丧尸通常能维持数周时间，期间幼虫不断生长。但最终，它的宿主会驱使它寻找一个安全且隐蔽的地方，在那里宿主会将幼虫呕吐出来，以便幼虫在宿主身体陷入静止状态前，进行最后一次的爆发式成长。几小时后，一只完全成型的阿卡塔会从冒着泡沫的水洼中爬出，并通常以这具尸体作为它的第一餐。

一般而言，阿卡塔会放任虚空丧尸自主行动，幼虫也会分散以避免食物竞争。在密闭无扰空间内，虚空丧尸会完全静止以保存能量。其体内的幼体阿卡塔进入休眠状态，以宿主体组织为食，直至成熟或感知到可用食物源。由于虚空丧尸的存在时间相对较短，后来者若发现先前的袭击现场，往往只能见到已被吞噬殆尽的残骸，或是取代之的诡异景象——一群寂静无声、布满玻璃般光泽的茧，里面蛰伏着饥肠辘辘的休眠期阿卡塔。

虚空丧尸通常无视其他不死生物，但若遭遇被寄生虫感染、或受外力操控的其他生物时，它们会表现出莫名的强烈敌意。许多人曾试图通过强迫虚空丧尸与例如撕裂蠕虫宿主、或受施法者控制的生物对抗来研究其行为模式。这类实验大多至多得出模棱两可的结论，更有不少以灾难收场。

ZDNakdcXH86fTWbA.name: 扬尘兽 Pachinyam
ZDNakdcXH86fTWbA.publicNotes:
单只扬尘兽并不构成太大威胁，但对于依赖科技的人而言却可能带来麻烦。一些扬尘兽饲养者会在宠物完成每日的尘浴（dust baths）后，额外花时间陪它们玩耍——尤其是在进入星舰或其他设施前，因为在这些地方，突如其来的尘雾可能会引发灾难性后果。

这些浑身沾满尘土、长着长耳朵、毛茸茸的穴居啮齿动物原产于戴马尔科（Daimalko），在200年前的觉醒事件（Awakening）中，它们与巨兽（colossi）一同现世。起初，它们被视为潜在的宠物，还被亲切地称作"尘兔儿"（dust bunnies），但觉醒事件的幸存者很快发现，这种生物和肆虐于这颗星球上的巨兽一样危险。

虽然一两只扬尘兽（pachinyam）表现得如同温顺的食草动物，但它们繁殖速度极快。当扬尘兽的数量达到临界点时，它们就会变成凶残的捕食者。它们扬起尘土的能力能够干扰视觉和电信通讯，这使得聚居地很难对它们发出警报或组织防御行动。在文明区域之外，尽管靠近巨兽存在明显的危险，扬尘兽种群的数量却因它们的集群本能地倾向于靠近巨兽而得到控制。还有人推测，扬尘兽集群扬起的尘云的气味会吸引饥饿的巨兽。

a7AYHtCQvlg6pFdu.name: 金乔锐蜥终灵 Jinchori Endling
a7AYHtCQvlg6pFdu.publicNotes:
金乔锐蜥曾是身躯蜿蜒的四足爬行动物，它们在普里奥里八号（Priori-8）沙漠世界上挖掘出纵横交错的隧道系统。它们的虹彩鳞片会生长成密集的装甲板，抵御那些觊觎其华丽颈褶作为时尚配饰的猎人。偷猎者开始向金乔锐蜥的隧道里灌注毒气，这种手段效果惊人，最终导致该物种灭绝。多年后，造访普里奥里八号的访客仍会瞥见发着微光的妖蜥在洞穴隧道中悄然尾随，而偷猎者则会窒息于幽魂毒素之中。

每个物种在诞生与进化过程中都遵循着自然的弧线：兴起、繁荣、衰落，最终走向灭绝。当这些轨迹遭遇极端非自然的终结——意外捕食、工业化浪潮或外来病原体摧毁种群时——终灵便诞生了。这些灭绝物种的幽魂成员，往往作为对自身灭绝的"回应"而诞生。异星生物学家对终灵的起源众说纷纭，无法确认它们究竟是物种最后集体悲恸的具象化，还是复仇的个体精魂——那些最后熄灭的微光。

aJcV6CI77HVthUe4.name: 烬蛛族士兵 Jinsul Trooper
aJcV6CI77HVthUe4.publicNotes:
在烬蛛族战帮中，地位最低的是下级士兵。这些烬蛛族会通过如下方式证明自身实力：他们冲向敌人，使用武器开火射击，并挥动锋利的腿刃近身搏杀。那些存活足够长时间的士兵会得到认可，并在艰苦的烬蛛族军旅生活中获得晋升。

烬蛛族（Jinsuls）是一个好战的物种，散布于浩界之中。它们长有六条腿，身形臃肿，周身布满眼睛；其身体上有着明显的几丁质节段，还长有一组上前肢，可用于操作设备。烬蛛族很久以前曾生活在被称为荡劫星域（the Scoured Stars）的星域，但最终离开那里，在环境恶劣的拉克斯（Rax）星球上定居下来。近来，神使杜鲁斯（the divine herald Dhurus）将烬蛛族整合为一个具有强大凝聚力的势力，即烬蛛族神权国，该势力一度短暂地重新占领了荡劫星域。最终，由多个种族以及寻星者协会（Starfinder Society）成员组成的联盟击败了杜鲁斯，烬蛛族重新分散到了浩界中。

烬蛛族在宇宙深处拥有数不胜数的基地与舰队，他们大多数都是劫掠者，四处搜刮装备，并与其他种族较量以检验自身实力。烬蛛族被灌输了这样一种观念，即自视为高等种族，认为只有荡劫星域的其他居民才稍具价值，因此他们更倾向于与敌人展开近距离战斗。

烬蛛族的数量不足以满足他们在星系中所控制的众多飞船和太空站的所有需求。为此，他们依靠机器人和自动化计算机系统（始终至少由一名烬蛛族军官指挥）来确保太空站高效运转。这些系统被编程得与烬蛛族自身一样致命且冷酷无情；即便是看起来最为无害的自动化系统或机器人，比如垃圾清理机，也可能配备致命武器，或是暗藏凶险的术法科技（technomagical）反制手段。

acPOystEh0AJQMrc.publicNotes:
噬矿蠕虫栖息于宇宙中无生命的小行星与小型卫星之上。它们的嘴部深阔如漏斗，内排多列锋利尖牙——这让它们在啃噬、熔穿岩石的过程中，能将物质研磨成细粒。噬矿蠕虫天生能感知自身最需要哪些矿物，哪怕隔着数里厚的岩层，也能精准定位这些矿物的位置。它们会将这些矿物浓缩后排出体外，沿途留下满是奇异合金与宝石级材料的隧道。

当多只噬矿蠕虫聚集时，它们的食欲会同步，进而集体猎捕特定矿物。这些蠕虫会对整片区域降下毁灭，直至需求被满足；随后，它们会突然转为互相攻击，上演一场支配权的较量。

"太空蠕虫"并非科学术语，而是对外星生物学上复杂的无脊椎动物与野兽类群的俗称——它们栖息于浩瀚太空之中。其中一些（如流散带蠕虫与沙地蠕虫）显现出智能迹象，且彼此直接相关；另一些（如噬矿蠕虫）则独立演化，其起源对科学界而言完全未知。

aj2YwRIfeI1Ol2U2.name: 虚空泥怪 Void Ooze
aj2YwRIfeI1Ol2U2.publicNotes:
虚空泥怪是星系乃至更远的星际航行者的祸患，它们从影界渗入物质宇宙。这些生物在永恒休眠中漂浮于太空，直至降落于小行星或星舰，被微弱的生命迹象唤醒。如果某只泥怪有幸觅得战场，一夜之间便能形成庞大的殖民群落，先在无人区吞噬亡者与伤者，继而蔓延至战疲士兵的营地。

各种各样的泥怪潜伏在星系各处阴暗荒废之地，它们只为满足食欲而现身，威胁着冒险者、探险家和不幸的工人。
