items.expectedDescription:
A living creature hit by a void ooze's pseudopod Strike must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:25] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} until the end of the creature's next turn (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} and deafened on a critical failure).

This numbs all of the creature's perceptive senses (such as smell, taste, and touch), applying the dazzled and blinded conditions' effects to other precise senses the creature might have.
items.description:
被虚空泥怪伪足打击命中的活物必须成功通过一次@Check[fortitude|dc:25]豁免，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{耳聋}，直到该生物的下一回合结束（大失败时则为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲}和耳聋）。

这会使该生物所有知觉感官变得麻木（例如嗅觉、味觉和触觉），将目眩和目盲状态的效果应用于该生物可能拥有的其他精确感官。

items.name: 余影绕梁
items.expectedDescription: The void ooze unleashes a pulse of magical darkness in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30]. Nonmagical light is automatically extinguished for 1 minute. The ooze also attempts to counteract any 3rd-rank or lower magical light effect in this area (counteract rank 3, counteract modifier [[/r 1d20+17 #Counteract]]{+17}).
items.description: 虚空泥怪在@Template[type:emanation|distance:30]内释放一股魔法黑暗的脉冲。非魔法光照自动熄灭1分钟。泥怪还会尝试反制此区域内任何3环或更低的魔法光照效果（反制环阶3，反制调整值[[/r 1d20+17 #Counteract]]{+17}）。

items.expectedName: Interplanar Teleport (at will; self only; to and from Akashic Record and the Universe only)
items.name: 跨界传送（随意；仅自身；只能往返于阿卡西记录与物质宇宙）
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements You have a planar key for the destination plane, used as a locus

You and your allies traverse the barriers between planes of existence. The targets move to another plane, such as the Plane of Fire, the Netherworld, or the Outer Rifts. You must know the destination plane exists and use a magic planar key created from material from that plane as a locus for the spell. While the planar keys for most prominent planes are uncommon, just like the spell interplanar teleport, more obscure planes and demiplanes often have rare or possibly even unique planar keys.

The spell is highly imprecise, and you appear 1d20×25 miles from the last place one of the targets (of your choice) was located the last time that target traveled to the plane. If it's the first time traveling to a particular plane for all targets, you appear at a random location on the plane. Interplanar teleport doesn't provide a means of return travel, though casting interplanar teleport again allows you to return to your previous plane unless there are extenuating circumstances.
items.description:
需求 你持有目的地位面的位面密钥，用作施法载体

你和你的盟友跨越位面之间的屏障进行旅行。目标移动至其他位面，比如火元素位面、幽界、或者外层裂隙。你必须知晓目标位面的存在，而且需要使用由该位面的物质制作的魔法位面密钥作为本法术的施法载体。就如同跨界传送这个法术本身一样，大多数著名位面的位面密钥具有罕见稀有度，而鲜为人知的位面及半位面通常具有稀有、甚至有可能具有独特稀有度的位面密钥。

该法术极其不精准，你会出现在目标之一（由你选择）上一次造访该位面时的位置周边，误差为1d20×25里。若所有目标都是初次造访某个特定位面，你们就会出现在该位面的随机位置。跨界传送不会提供返回的手段，不过除非发生了什么另外情况，否则再次施放跨界传送能让你返回自身之前身处的位面。

items.name: 真景术
items.expectedDescription: You see things within 60 feet as they actually are. The GM rolls a secret counteract check against any illusion, morph or polymorph effect in the area, but only for the purpose of determining whether you see through it (for instance, if the check succeeds against a polymorph spell, you can see the creature's true form, but you don't end the polymorph spell).
items.description: 你可以看见60尺内的事物的本来面貌。GM秘密进行一次反制检定，对抗区域中的所有幻术、形变或变形效应，但这只会决定你是否能看破它（例如，如果该检定成功对抗了一个变形法术，你可以看见该生物的本来形态，但你不会结束该变形法术）。

items.name: 探视魔眼
items.expectedDescription:
You create an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, floating eye, 1 inch in diameter, at a location you can see within 500 feet. It sees in all directions with your normal visual senses and continuously transmits what it sees to you.

The first time you Sustain the spell each round, you can either move the eye up to 30 feet, seeing only things in front of the eye, or move it up to 10 feet, seeing everything in all directions around it. There is no limit to how far from you the eye can move, but the spell ends immediately if you and the eye ever cease to be on the same plane of existence. You can attempt Seek actions through the eye if you want to attempt Perception checks with it. Any damage dealt to the eye destroys it and ends the spell.
items.description:
你在你能看见的500尺范围内，创造一个@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}的、漂浮的、直径1英寸的眼睛。它如你通常的视觉感官，能看见所有的方向，并且会持续将其所见传送给你。

每轮你第一次维持该法术时，你可以将眼睛移动至多30尺，且只看见眼睛前方的事物，或者将其移动至多10尺，但能看到周围所有方向的事物。眼睛移动离开你能到达的距离没有限制，但是当你和眼睛不再处于相同的位面时，法术立即结束。如果你想通过眼睛尝试察觉检定，你可以通过眼睛尝试搜索动作。对眼睛造成的任何伤害会摧毁它并结束该法术。

items.name: 主观现实
items.expectedDescription:
You alter your perceptions to convince yourself that another creature or object is an illusion. Choose one object or creature you can perceive within range. For you, the target becomes transparent and doesn't create sound, smell, or other sensory output. You can move through the target, and the target can move through you. You gain resistance to all damage originating from the target equal to your level. If you are targeted by or are in the area of one of the target's abilities or effects, the target must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:5], and if it fails, you're unaffected by the ability or effect. You're immune to all of the target's auditory, linguistic, and scent-based attacks and effects. Your attacks deal no damage to the target, and the target is immune to your spells and other effects. You and the target can affect one another indirectly, such as through a Strike from a minion or through the environment affected by a witchwarper's quantum field. When this spell ends, the target becomes immune to subjective reality for 24 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.4P2rPLVKjSpUbOWI]
items.description:
你改变自己的感知，让自己相信某个其他生物或物体是幻象。在射程内选择一个你能察觉到的物体或生物。对你来说，目标会变得透明，不会产生声音、气味或其他感官输出。你可以穿过目标，目标也可以穿过你。你会获得与你的等级相等的抗力，以抵御来自目标的所有伤害。如果你成为对方能力或效果的目标或处于对方能力或效果的范围内，目标必须成功通过@Check[flat|dc:5]，如果失败，你将不受能力或效果的影响。你免疫其所有听觉、语言和基于嗅觉的攻击和效果。你的攻击不会对目标造成伤害，目标也对你的法术和其他效果免疫。你和目标可以间接影响对方，例如来自仆从的打击或受到织维巫师量子场域影响的环境。当此法术结束时，目标会在24小时内对主观现实免疫。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.4P2rPLVKjSpUbOWI]

items.name: 实言术
items.expectedDescription:
The target can understand all words regardless of language and also speak the languages of other creatures. When in a mixed group of creatures, each time the target speaks, it can choose a creature and speak in a language that creature understands, even if the target doesn't know what language that is.

Heightened (7th) The duration is 8 hours.
items.description:
无论什么语言，目标都可以理解其所有的词语，也能说其他生物的语言。当处于一群各异的生物中时，每次目标说话时，都可以选择一个生物，并使用一种该生物理解的语言来讲述，即使该目标不知道这语言具体是什么。

升阶（7环） 持续时间为8小时。

items.name: 鹰眼术
items.expectedDescription: You create an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} floating eye at a location within range (even if it's outside your line of sight or line of effect). The eye can't move, but you can see in all directions from that point as if using your normal visual senses.
items.description: 你在射程内创造出一个@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}的悬浮眼睛（它甚至可以在你的视觉线或者效果线之外）。这只眼睛不能移动，但是你可以从该处看到所有方向，如同使用你通常的视觉感官。

items.name: 鹰眼术
items.expectedDescription: You create an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} floating eye at a location within range (even if it's outside your line of sight or line of effect). The eye can't move, but you can see in all directions from that point as if using your normal visual senses.
items.description: 你在射程内创造出一个@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}的悬浮眼睛（它甚至可以在你的视觉线或者效果线之外）。这只眼睛不能移动，但是你可以从该处看到所有方向，如同使用你通常的视觉感官。

items.name: 困惑术
items.expectedDescription:
You befuddle your target with strange impulses, causing it to act randomly. The effects are determined by the target's Will save. You can Dismiss the spell.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target babbles incoherently and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 minute. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns to end the confusion.

Critical Failure The target is Confused for 1 minute, with no save to end early.

Heightened (8th) You can target up to 10 creatures.
items.description:
你以奇异的冲动扰乱目标心智，使其随机行动。法术效果由目标的意志豁免决定。你可以解消该法术。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标胡言乱语，并且获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 1}。

失败 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{困惑}1分钟。在其每个回合结束，它能尝试一次新豁免来结束困惑术。

大失败 目标困惑1分钟，并且没有提前结束的豁免。

升阶（8环阶） 你能以至多10个生物为目标。

items.name: 怪异怒火
items.expectedDescription:
You channel the bizarre powers that exist beyond the outer reaches of the universe, dealing 3d12 mental damage to each creature in the area as phantasmal claws, jaws, and tentacles lash out at each target. Each creature in the area must attempt a Will save. The area is difficult terrain for any creature sickened by the effects of this spell.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d12.
items.description:
你引导存在于宇宙外缘之外的怪异力量，幻影利爪、巨颚与触须鞭打每个目标，对区域内每个生物造成3d12心灵伤害。区域内每个生物都必须尝试意志豁免。对因本法术效果陷入恶心的任何生物而言，该区域为困难地形。

大成功 生物不受影响。

成功 生物受到一半伤害。

失败 该生物受到全部伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}。

大失败 生物受到双倍伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心2}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d12。

items.name: 岁月重担
items.expectedDescription:
You burden a creature's body and mind with the pains and sorrows of a lifetime. The target takes 3d8 bludgeoning damage and 3d8 mental damage and must attempt a Will saving throw.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]{Encumbered} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage and is encumbered for 1 minute.

Heightened (+1) The mental damage increases by 2d8.
items.description:
你将目标毕生的苦痛与哀伤化作沉重枷锁，压垮目标的身心。尝试一次远程法术攻击骰。目标受到3d8钝击伤害和3d8心灵，并且必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功目标不受影响。

成功目标受到一半伤害。

失败目标受到全伤害并且@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]1轮。

大失败目标受到全伤害并且超载1分钟。

升阶（+1）心灵伤害增加2d8

items.name: 锐耳术
items.expectedDescription: You create an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} floating ear at a location within range (even if it's outside your line of sight or line of effect). It can't move, but you can hear through the ear as if using your normal auditory senses.
items.description: 你在射程内创造出一个@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}的悬浮耳朵（它甚至可以在你的视觉线或者效果线之外）。它不能移动，但是你可以通过该耳朵听到声音，如同你通常的听觉感官。

items.name: 加速术
items.expectedDescription:
Magic empowers the target to act faster. It gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition and can use the extra action each round only for Strike and Stride actions.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 6 creatures.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ElkXovNrHB0Doi6O]{Spell Effect: Haste}
items.description:
魔法强化了目标，令其行动迅速。它获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{迅捷}状态，并且每轮只能将额外动作用于打击或行走。

升阶（7环阶） 你能以至多6个生物为目标。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ElkXovNrHB0Doi6O]{法术效果：加速术}

items.name: 极化认知
items.expectedDescription: You rapidly catalog and collate information relevant to your current situation. You can instantly use up to 6 Recall Knowledge actions as part of Casting this Spell. For these actions, you can't use any special abilities, reactions, or free actions that trigger when you Recall Knowledge.
items.description: 你高速分类整理与你当前情况相关的信息。作为施放此法术的一部分，你可以立即使用至多6个回忆知识动作。对于这些动作，你不能使用任何在你回忆知识时触发的特殊能力，反应动作，或者自由动作。

items.name: 读心术
items.expectedDescription:
With a cursory mental touch, you attempt to read the target's mind. It must attempt a Will save. The target then becomes temporarily immune to your mind reading for 1 hour.

Critical Success The target perceives vague surface thoughts from you when you Cast the Spell.

Success You find out whether the target's Intelligence modifier is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Failure You perceive vague surface thoughts from the target when you Cast the Spell, and you find out whether its Intelligence is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Critical Failure As failure, and for the duration of the spell, you can Sustain the spell to detect the target's surface thoughts again. The target doesn't receive any additional saves.
items.description:
你通过一次短暂的心灵接触来尝试阅读目标的想法。它必须尝试一次意志豁免。目标会临时免疫你的读心术1小时。

大成功 目标感知到你施放法术时模糊的表层思想。

成功 你得知目标的智力调整值是高于，等于，还是低于你。

失败 你感知到施放法术时目标模糊的表层思想，并且你得知目标的智力是高于，等于，还是低于你。

大失败 如失败，并且在法术持续时间中，你可以维持该法术来再次侦测目标的表层想法。目标不会获得另外的豁免。

items.name: 类人形态
items.expectedDescription:
You transform your appearance to that of a Small or Medium humanoid, such as a dwarf, elf, goblin, halfling, human, or orc. You gain the humanoid trait in addition to your other traits while in this form, as well as any trait related to the creature's kind (such as goblin or human). If this transformation reduces your size, it reduces your reach accordingly (typically to 5 feet). This transformation doesn't change your statistics in any way, and you don't gain any special abilities of the humanoid form you assume. You can still wear and use your gear, which changes size (if necessary) to match your new form. If items leave your person, they return to their usual size.

Humanoid form grants you a +4 status bonus to Deception checks to pass as a generic member of the chosen ancestry, and you add your level even if you're untrained, but you can't make yourself look like a specific person. If you want to Impersonate an individual, you still need to create a disguise, though the GM won't factor in the difference in ancestry when determining the DC of your Deception check. You can Dismiss this spell.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.B9Hzt4ki8eqlXxyh]{Spell Effect: Humanoid Form}

Heightened (3rd) You gain darkvision or low-light vision if the form you assume has that ability.

Heightened (5th) You can take on the appearance of a Large humanoid. If this increases your size, you gain the effects of the enlarge spell.
items.description:
你将自身变成某种中型或者小型类人生物的外观，例如矮人、精灵、地精、半身人、人类或者兽人。处于此形态时，你保留原有的其他特征，并获得类人特征，以及其他与该生物类型相关的特征（例如地精或者人类）。如果该变形减少了你的体型，它也会相应缩短你的触及（通常减少到5尺）。该变形不会改变你的任何数据，并且你不会获得你变形为的类人形态的任何特殊能力。你仍然可以穿戴和使用你的装备，它会改变大小来适应你的新形态（仅如果需要）。如果物品离开你，它会回到本来的大小。

类人形态 赋予你在伪装成所选族裔普通成员的欺骗检定上+4状态加值，并且你会加上你的等级，即使你未受训，但是你不能让你看起来像某个特定的人。如果你想要假扮某个特定人物，你仍然需要制造伪装，但GM不会将族裔不同计入你的欺骗检定DC中。你可以解消该法术。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.B9Hzt4ki8eqlXxyh]{法术效果：类人形态}

升阶（3环阶） 如果你变作的形态有，则你获得黑暗视觉或者昏暗视觉。

升阶（5环阶） 你可以变为大型类人生物的外形。如果这使你的体型增大，你获得变巨术的效果。

items.name: 愚者之思
items.expectedDescription:
You dull the target's mind, depending on its Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} until the start of your next turn.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 3} for 1 minute.
items.description:
你令目标精神迟钝，基于其意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 1}，持续至你下个回合开始。

失败 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 2}，持续1分钟。

大失败 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 3}，持续1分钟。

items.name: 通译语言
items.expectedDescription:
The target can understand the meaning of a single language it is hearing or reading when you cast the spell. This doesn't let it understand codes, language couched in metaphor, and the like (subject to GM discretion). If the target can hear multiple languages and knows that, it can choose which language to understand; otherwise, choose one of the languages randomly.

Heightened (3rd) The target can also speak the language.

Heightened (4th) You can target up to 10 creatures, and targets can also speak the language.
items.description:
在你施放该法术时，目标会理解其正听到或者阅读的一种语言的含义。这不会令其能够理解密文，使用隐喻表达的含义，或者类似的内容（由GM所判定）。如果目标能够听见数种语言并且了解该情况，它能选择要理解的那种语言；否则，随机选择这种语言。

升阶（3环阶） 该目标也能使用该语言交流。

升阶（4环阶） 你能以至多10个生物作为目标，并且这些目标也能使用该语言交流。

items.expectedDescription:
You execute a psychic search of the Akashic Record for information about a specific topic and magically transfer this data to your comm unit or computer. When you Cast this Spell, choose any skill in which you're trained that has the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} action.

Any time during the duration, you can consult your comm unit while attempting a Recall Knowledge check using your chosen skill. This check gains a +1 status bonus. Checking your comm unit is part of the action to Recall Knowledge. You must be holding the comm unit to do so. The comm unit instantly compiles and displays snippets and selections from various media relevant to the topic, which grants you the bonus. If you roll a critical failure on this check, you get a failure instead. If the check is successful and the subject is a creature, you gain additional information or context about the creature. Once you reference the comm unit, the spell ends. When the spell ends, your access to the Akashic Record ends, and all the information you downloaded returns to the Akashic Record.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.h1i8c47U0IOrMrHJ]

Heightened (3rd) You can reference your comm unit three times before the spell ends.
items.description:
你通过灵能搜索阿卡西记录，获取特定主题的信息，并将数据魔法传输至通讯单元或计算机。施放此法术时，选择任何你至少为受训熟练度且能进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]动作的技能。

在持续时间内的任何时候，你都可以在使用所选技能进行回忆知识检定时查询通讯单元。该检定会获得+1状态加值。检查通讯单元是回忆知识动作的一部分。你必须手持通讯单元才能这样做。通讯单元会立即编译并显示与主题相关的各种媒体片段和精选内容，从而为你带来加值。如果你在检定中掷出大失败，改为失败。如果检定成功，且对象是生物，你将获得有关该生物的额外信息或内容。一旦你查询了通讯单元的信息，法术就会结束。当法术结束时，你对阿卡西记录的访问也会结束，你下载的所有信息都会返回阿卡西记录。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.h1i8c47U0IOrMrHJ]

升阶（3环）法术结束前可以用通讯单元查询信息3次。
items.name: 阿卡西下载（随意）
分析目标
items.expectedDescription:
You focus on the target, gathering data as magical holograms display information. When the casting is complete, you learn biometric information about the target, including its fingerprints, medical conditions, and other basic physiological information. You or anyone you advise about the analysis gains a +1 status bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} the creature, to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} on the creature, and to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about it. If the target is illusory or under the effects of illusion magic, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your analyze target spell.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

Heightened (3rd) The status bonus increases to +2, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Heightened (6th) The status bonus increases to +3, and you can target any number of creatures.
items.description:
你专注在目标身上，收集数据并以魔法全息图像显示。当施法完成，你会获得目标的所有生物特征信息，包括指纹、医疗状况和其他基本生理信息。你或任何得到你基于分析建议的人，在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]为该生物、对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]、以及对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]的检定上获得+1状态加值。如果目标是幻觉或者处于幻术魔法效果下，仅当效果的环级低于你分析目标的法术环级，你才能够探测到结果。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

升阶（3环）状态加值提升到+2，并且你可以至多10名生物作为目标。

升阶（6环）状态加值提升到+3，并且你可以任意名生物作为目标。

items.name: 晕眩术
items.expectedDescription:
You push into the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals 1d6 mental damage, with a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你侵入目标的精神，利用精神冲击令目标晕眩。该冲击造成1d6心灵伤害，具有基础意志豁免。如果目标在豁免中大失败，它获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 1}。

升阶（+2） 该伤害增加1d6。

items.name: 删除术
items.expectedDescription:
You delete data from a device or object with a flamboyant magical gesture. This data might be handwritten, printed, or digital. You delete up to 1,500 words' worth of text, one page of content, or one display screen worth of text or other visual information. Non-magical writing in or on an unattended or held object is automatically deleted. Attempt a counteract check to delete digital or magical writing. If you fail to delete writing that's part of a hazard, you trigger the hazard. This can't be used to delete the contents of a spellbook or similar means of storing magical formulas or spells.

If you target an attended tech item with the tracking trait, attempt a counteract check. On a success, the item becomes glitching 1. A creature holding the item can Interact to restart the software, reducing the glitching value by 1.

Heightened (7th) You can delete all the data stored locally on a single device or book, or all the data on a device or book related to a specific name, topic, or category.
items.description:
你以华丽的魔法手势删除设备或物品中的数据。这些数据可以是手写的、打印的或电子的。你最多可以删除 1,500字的文本、一页内容或一显示屏的文本或其他视觉信息。无主物品或手持物品上的非魔法文字会自动删除。尝试反制检定删除数据或魔法文字。如果你尝试删除的文字是危害的一部分，且你失败，就会触发危害。这不能用于删除魔法书或类似的存储魔法公式或法术的内容。

如果目标是具有追踪特征的科技物品，尝试一次反制检定。如果成功，该物品就会获得故障1。持有该物品的生物可以花费一个交互动作来重启用户界面，并将故障值降低1。

升阶（7环）你可以删除单个设备或书籍中本地存储的所有数据，或者删除设备或书籍中与特定名称、主题或类别相关的所有数据。

items.name: 侦测魔法
items.expectedDescription:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).
items.description:
你发出一股标记魔法存在的脉冲。你不会获得魔法存在或不存在以外的任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你或者你盟友的魔法物品以及持续法术。仅当幻术魔法的环阶低于你的侦测魔法环阶时，你才能侦测幻术魔法。但是，具有幻术灵光但是没有在外表上做伪装的物品（例如一瓶隐形药水），通常能够正常侦测。

升阶（3环阶） 你能知晓法术侦测出的最强魔法效果的环阶或等级，具体由GM决定。

升阶（4环阶） 如3环阶，你也能指出最高环阶魔法的来源。如同一种模糊感官，你不会了解具体的位置，但是可以将来源锁定到5尺立方（或者最近的那个五尺立方，如果来源体积比这个区域更大）。

items.name: 伪装灵光
items.expectedDescription:
You alter how an item's or spell's magical aura appears to effects like detect magic. You can hide the auras entirely, have an item register as a common item of lower level, or make a spell register as a common spell of the same or lower rank. You can Dismiss the spell. A caster using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gpzpAAAJ1Lza2JVl]{Detect Magic} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.OhD2Z6rIGGD5ocZA]{Read Aura} of a higher rank than disguise magic can attempt to disbelieve the illusion using the skill matching the tradition of the spell (Arcana for arcane, Religion for divine, Occultism for occult, or Nature for primal). Further attempts by the same caster get the same result as the initial check to disbelieve.

Heightened (2nd) You can Cast this Spell on a creature, disguising all items and spell effects on it.
items.description:
你改变物品或法术的魔法灵光在侦测魔法等效应中的呈现方式。你可以完全隐藏灵光，使物品显示为等级更低的常见物品，或者让一个法术看起来是相同或更低环阶的常见法术。你可以解消该法术。使用比伪装灵光更高环阶的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gpzpAAAJ1Lza2JVl]{侦测魔法}或者@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.OhD2Z6rIGGD5ocZA]{阅读灵光}的施法者，可以使用与此法术根源相符的技能（奥术为奥法，神术为宗教，异能为神秘，原能为自然）来尝试识破幻术。相同的施法者的进一步的识破尝试会得到与初次检定相同的结果。

升阶（2环阶） 你可以对一个生物施放该法术，伪装其身上所有的物品和魔法效果。

items.name: 阅读灵光
items.expectedDescription:
You focus on the target object, opening your mind to perceive magical auras. When the casting is complete, you know whether that item is magical. You or anyone you advise about the aura gains a +2 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{Identify Magic} on the item. If the object is illusory, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your read aura spell.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.J6OhRNSN23KzOPRL]{Spell Effect: Read Aura}

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to 10 objects.

Heightened (6th) You can target any number of objects.
items.description:
你专注于目标物体，拓展神智，以感受魔法灵光。当你完成施法后，你得知该物品是否具有魔法。你或任何经你告知灵光信息的人在对该物品@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{辨识魔法}时获得+2环境加值。如果该物体是幻象，仅当该效果的环阶低于你的阅读灵光环阶时你才能发现此事实。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.J6OhRNSN23KzOPRL]{法术效果：阅读灵光}

升阶（3环） 你能以至多10个物体为目标。

升阶（6环） 你能以任意数量物体为目标。

items.name: 护盾术
items.expectedDescription:
You raise a magical shield of force. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction with your magic shield. The shield has Hardness 5. You can use the spell's reaction to reduce damage from any spell or magical effect, even if it doesn't deal physical damage. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity}

Heightened (+2) The shield's Hardness increases by 5.
items.description:
你举起一面力场构成的魔法护盾。这视同你使用了举盾动作，赋予你在AC上的+1环境加值，直到你的下个回合开始，且无需用手持握。

当该法术生效时，你可以使用你的魔法护盾来进行 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{盾牌格挡}反应动作。该盾牌具有硬度5。你可以使用该法术的反应动作来减少任何来自法术或者魔法效果的伤害，即使这不造成物理伤害。在你使用盾牌格挡后，该法术结束，并且你无法在10分钟内再次施放它。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{法术效果：护盾术}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{效果：护盾术免疫}

升阶（+2） 该盾牌的硬度增加5。

items.name: 料敌机先
items.expectedDescription:
The next time you make an attack roll before the end of your turn, roll it twice and use the better result. The attack ignores circumstance penalties to the attack roll and any flat check required due to the target being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}. You are then temporarily immune to sure strike for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.fpGDAz2v5PG0zUSl]{Spell Effect: Sure Strike}
items.description:
在你的回合结束前，你下一次尝试攻击掷骰时，骰两次并使用较好的结果。该攻击会忽视对攻击掷骰的环境减值，以及因目标@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}或者@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{藏匿}而需进行的任何纯骰检定。然后你临时免疫料敌机先10分钟。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.fpGDAz2v5PG0zUSl]{法术效果：料敌机先}

items.name: 阿卡西之眼
items.expectedDescription: Instead of using their own memories, an Akashic dragon can ascertain information from the Akashic Records. This gives it the Akashic Record Lore skill, which it can use to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} of any kind.
items.description: 阿卡西龙能够不依靠自身记忆，而是从阿卡西记录中获取信息。这赋予它阿卡西记录学识技能，可用于任何类型的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{回忆知识}。

items.name: 全域视野
items.expectedDescription: @Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.AllAroundVision]
items.description: @Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.AllAroundVision]

items.expectedName: +2 Status to All Saves vs. Occult
items.name: 对抗异能的所有豁免获得+2状态加值
阿卡西干扰
items.expectedDescription:
90 feet. The swirl of constant uploads and downloads near the Akashic dragon make attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} unpredictable. A creature other than an akashic dragon that enters or begins its turn in the area must attempt a @Check[will|dc:28] save. Regardless of the result of the saving throw, the creature is temporarily immune to this dragon's Akashic interference for 1 minute.

Critical Success For 1 round, when the creature attempts to Recall Knowledge, it gains a +3 status bonus to its check.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure For 1 round, when the creature attempts to Recall Knowledge, it takes a –3 status penalty to its check.

Critical Failure As failure, but the effect lasts 1 minute.
items.description:
90尺。阿卡西龙附近持续上传下载的信息流使@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{回忆知识}变得难以预测。阿卡西龙以外的生物进入区域或在区域内开始回合时，必须尝试@Check[will|dc:28]豁免。无论豁免结果如何，该生物都会临时免疫这条龙的阿卡西干扰1分钟。

大成功 1轮内，生物尝试回忆知识时，检定获得+3状态加值。

成功 生物不受影响。

失败 1轮内，生物尝试回忆知识时，检定承受–3状态减值。

大失败 同失败，但效应持续1分钟。

items.name: 偏转激光
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger The dragon is critically hit by an attack

Effect The Akashic dragon raises a web of deflecting lasers using the eyes embedded all over their body, gaining resistance 15 to all damage against the triggering attack and absorbing some of the blow's energy, recharging their Akashic Barrage. If the Akashic dragon has succeeded at a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} check against the creature in the last minute, they gain resistance 20 instead.
items.description:
触发 龙被一次攻击重击

效果 阿卡西龙利用遍布全身的眼睛，架起一张用于偏转攻击的激光网，对抗触发攻击时获得对所有伤害的抗力15，并吸收部分攻击能量，为阿卡西弹幕重新充能。若阿卡西龙在过去一分钟内对该生物成功进行过一次@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{回忆知识}检定，则改为获得抗力20。

items.name: 阿卡西适应性
items.expectedDescription: The Akashic dragon can activate magic and tech items with the Cast a Spell activation of any tradition as if the spells they contain were occult spells.
items.description: 阿卡西龙可以启动来自任意根源、以施放法术作为启动方式的魔法和科技物品，如同其中的法术属于异能法术。

items.name: 阿卡西弹幕
items.expectedDescription: The dragon condenses cutting truths and fiery revelations from the Akashic Record into sizzling laser fire that they project as a cone from their primary eye to assail their foes. This deals @Damage[14d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage in a @Template[type:cone|distance:30] (@Check[reflex|dc:33|basic|options:area-effect,inflicts:stupefied] save). If a creature critically fails its Reflex save against Akashic Barrage and the Akashic dragon has succeeded at a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about the creature in the last minute, the creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round. The dragon can't use Akashic Barrage again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Akashic Barrage]]{1d4 rounds}.
items.description: 龙将阿卡西记录中的尖锐真理与炽热启示凝结为炙热的激光，从主眼射出锥形光束袭击敌人。这会造成@Damage[14d6[fire]|options:area-damage]伤害，范围为@Template[type:cone|distance:30]（@Check[reflex|dc:33|basic|options:area-effect,inflicts:stupefied]豁免）。若某个生物对抗阿卡西弹幕的反射豁免大失败，且阿卡西龙在过去一分钟内曾成功对该生物进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{回忆知识}检定，该生物便陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞1}，持续1轮。龙在[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Akashic Barrage]]{1d4轮}内无法再次使用阿卡西弹幕。

items.name: 敌手记录
items.expectedDescription: The first time each encounter the Akashic dragon hits and deals damage to a creature with their jaws Strike, they receive information about the creature as if they'd succeeded at a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about that creature.
items.description: 每次遭遇中，阿卡西龙首次以颚部打击命中一个生物并造成伤害时，便获得有关该生物的信息，如同成功进行了有关该生物的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{回忆知识}检定。

items.name: 惊骇启示
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements The dragon has successfully Recalled Knowledge about an enemy within 90 feet within the last minute

Effect The dragon utters a shocking truth about the creature that even it might not know, causing it and its allies to hesitate or act erratically. Every enemy within 90 feet that can hear the secret must attempt a @Check[will|dc:31|options:area-effect,inflicts:slowed,inflicts:confused] save. Each creature is then immune to Shocking Revelation for 24 hours.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round.
items.description:
需求 该龙在过去一分钟内曾对90尺内的一个敌人成功回忆知识

效果 该龙道出一个关于该生物、连其自身都可能不知道的惊人真相，使其与盟友犹豫不决或举止失常。90尺内每个能听见此秘密的敌人必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:31|options:area-effect,inflicts:slowed,inflicts:confused]豁免。随后每个生物免疫惊骇启示，持续24小时。

大成功 生物不受影响。

成功 生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢1}，持续1轮。

ayBt83OQhuO9gGX7.publicNotes:
嗜毒蜥是凶猛的爬行动物，原产于卡兹穆格的荒诞星域中的阿冉首星（Azhan Prime）。由于原生阿冉人热衷贸易，这类生物已扩散至宇宙各地，在星系诸多湿地安家落户。嗜毒蜥因天生就能察觉并以某种方式无视最猛烈毒素的能力而闻名星河——它们能抽取目标体内的毒素，并将其转化为消化酸液的燃料。即便完成毒素抽取后，嗜毒蜥体内仍会残留微量毒物，其新鲜尸体也因此成为生物科技专家与制药行家的药用宝库。

成年嗜毒蜥仅高2至3尺，体长约为身高的两倍。它们拥有如油膜般闪烁的病态蓝色皮肤，且能通过专注力使自身大致呈现出周围环境的特性。此外，面对猎人或更危险的掠食者时，嗜毒蜥会装出令人作呕的死状。这类通常温顺的肉食动物，在缺乏易捕猎的低威胁动物作为食物来源时，会变得极度凶暴，并侵入文明边缘地带觅食。

items.name: 魔法伎俩
items.expectedDescription:
The simplest magic does your bidding. You can perform simple magical effects for as long as you Sustain the spell. Each time you Sustain the spell, you can choose one of four options.

  • Cook Cool, warm, or flavor 1 pound of nonliving material.
  • Lift Slowly lift an unattended object of light Bulk or less 1 foot off the ground.
  • Make Create a temporary object of negligible Bulk, made of congealed magical substance. The object looks crude and artificial and is extremely fragile-it can't be used as a tool, weapon, or locus or cost for a spell.
  • Tidy Color, clean, or soil an object of light Bulk or less. You can affect an object of 1 Bulk with 10 rounds of concentration, and a larger object at 1 minute per Bulk.

Prestidigitation can't deal damage or cause adverse conditions. Any actual change to an object (beyond what is noted above) persists only as long as you Sustain the spell.
items.description:
最简单的魔法帮你完成杂务。只要你维持该法术，你就可以产生简单的魔法效果。每当你维持该法术时，你可以选择四个选项中的一个。

  • 烹饪 为1磅非活物材料冷却，加热，或者调味。
  • 抬起 将一件轻负载或者更低的无主物品缓慢抬离地面1尺。
  • 创造 创造一个负载可忽略的临时物体，它由凝结的魔法物质组成。该物体看起来粗糙、不自然，且极其脆弱——它无法被用做工具、武器、施法载体或法术费用。
  • 整理 为一件轻负载或者更低的物体染色，清洁，或者弄脏它。你可以通过10轮专注来影响一件1负载的物体，对于更大的物体为每负载1分钟。

魔法伎俩无法造成伤害或者负面效果。对一件物体的任何改变（在上述内容之外的）只会在你仍维持该法术时持续。

items.expectedDescription: Life energy shuts death's door. The target loses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} condition, though it remains @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} at 0 Hit Points.

items.name: 命能袭
items.expectedDescription:
You demolish the target's corrupted essence with energy from Creation's Forge. You deal 2d6 vitality damage with a basic Fortitude save. If the creature critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the start of your next turn.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你用创生熔炉的能量破坏目标的腐败本源。你造成2d6点命能伤害，这需进行一次基础强韧豁免。如果该生物在豁免中大失败，直到你的下个回合开始前，它还会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭 1}。

items.name: 微灵盟友
items.expectedDescription:
You summon a Tiny bouncing wisp of light that easily distracts even the most determined of combatants. The wisp floats near your target. A wisp doesn't take up space, grant flanking, or have any other attributes a creature would. The wisp generates bright light in a 10-foot radius. When you Cast the Spell and each time you Sustain the spell, your wisp attempts to distract your target, which must succeed at a Will save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of your next turn. A creature who critically succeeds becomes immune to wisp ally for 1 hour.

Heightened (+1) You create one additional wisp, allowing you to choose a different target. Each wisp you create must have a different target, and all of them attempt to distract their targets at the same time when you cast or Sustain this spell.
items.description:
你召唤一只小小的活跃微灵，能够分散意志最坚定的战斗人员的注意。微灵在你目标周围悬浮游弋。微灵没有占据空间，不会提供夹击，也没有其他生物会具有的属性。微灵能在10尺半径内产生明亮光照。当你施放该法术以及每次你维持该法术时，微灵试图分散目标的注意力。该目标必须通过意志豁免，否则在你下一回合开始前将陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]。豁免大成功的生物将对微灵盟友临时免疫1小时。

升阶（+1）你在施法时创造出额外一只微灵，这允许你选择一个额外目标。你创造的每个微灵都必须有不同的目标，并且当你维持该法术时，它们会同时分散各自目标的注意力。

bNb1oBwTUnNj83J1.publicNotes:
引魂精在物质宇宙间穿行，加速精类死后灵魂回归第一世界的进程，阻止招魂者将它们带入骨园。它们坚信，始祖们不应允许众神带走那些被其背弃的灵魂。除这一职责外，这些小型精类似乎会被困境中的人们吸引，并且只要力所能及，便必定提供援助。它们最常现身于受第一世界影响的区域，却也在宇宙的各个区域中穿行。

引魂精形似侏儒，拥有一蓬绿色、紫色或深蓝色的头发，其体表还分布着形似星图的发光纹路——这些纹路会在它们使用魔法或它们的锤中封存着灵魂时愈发明亮。作为体型小巧却强壮的生物，引魂精偏好以烈焰裹身冲入战斗，仅在必要时才施放法术。

bgiNmocKmS5xdELg.name: 尸花兽 Ksarik
bgiNmocKmS5xdELg.publicNotes:
尸花兽起源于卡斯卓韦的无心智植物，在暴露于弗米蚁族与拉申塔人冲突中所释放的心能数千年后，它们演化出了初步的智力与惊人的适应能力。这些身长12尺的四足生物面部长着至多十二条触须，并通过从触须团两侧伸出的两根眼柄来观察世界。尸花兽在从猎物体内汲取遗传密码后，其可变的形体可能会暂时长出蹼、翅膀或其他适应性结构。

尸花兽最初是食腐动物，但如今已演化为致命猎手，能够将其消化系统与生殖系统转化为武器。它们体内用于消化猎物的强酸可以以致命的唾液的形式喷射出去，而其身体两侧的数十根尖刺则携带其遗传密码，可如投射物般发射出去，使尸花兽幼苗在成长过程中能够以受害者为食。幼体的易于传播以及其环境适应能力，使得尸花兽的分布已远远超出了卡斯卓韦。

items.name: 适应性语言
items.expectedDescription: A ksarik understands up to 3 languages from among the prevalent languages spoken by those it has most recently attacked.
items.description: 尸花兽能理解其最近攻击过的生物所使用的主流语言（prevalent languages）中的至多三种。

豁免 @Check[fortitude|dc:18]

阶段1 携带者，无不良效果（1d6小时），

阶段2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞1}（1天），

阶段3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞2}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙2}（1天），

阶段4 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{失去意识}（1天），

阶段5 1d10+10株尸花兽幼苗从受害者体内破体而出，每株幼苗造成@Damage[1[piercing]]伤害，并结束疾病

items.name: 摄取适应
items.expectedDescription:
A ksarik's tentacle Strike siphons the target's genetic code and psychic resonance. On a successful Strike, the ksarik gains one of the target's abilities, chosen from the following.

  • The amphibious or aquatic trait
  • A new precise or imprecise sense
  • A resistance to one damage type (up to resistance 7)
  • A burrow, fly, or swim Speed (up to 30 feet)
  • The ability to wield a category of melee weapons (simple, martial, or advanced) in its tentacles that the target is trained in (using its tentacle Strike bonus)
  • Altering the type of damage dealt by its acid spit to a type (cold, electricity, fire, poison, or sonic) dealt by one of the target's Strikes or other abilities

The ksarik can't duplicate abilities from equipment. It can maintain one adaptation at a time, which it retains for 24 hours or until it uses ingested adaptation again.
items.description:
尸花兽的触须打击汲取目标的遗传编码和心能共鸣。打击成功时，尸花兽获得目标的一项能力，从以下选项中选择。

  • 两栖或水栖特征
  • 一种新的精确或模糊感官
  • 对一种伤害类型的抗力（至多为抗力7）
  • 掘地、飞行或游泳速度（至多30尺）
  • 以触须持用一类目标已受训的近战武器（简易、军用或进阶）的能力（使用其触须打击加值）
  • 将其酸液喷吐造成的伤害类型，改为目标的某项打击或其他能力所造成的一种类型（寒冷、电击、火焰、毒素或音波）

尸花兽无法复制来自装备的能力。其同一时间只能维持一种适应，持续24小时，或直到其再次使用摄取适应。

bp4ChaSm9436oH68.name: 尸骸舰队步兵 Corpse Fleet Infantry
bp4ChaSm9436oH68.publicNotes:
尸骸舰队的普通步兵都经过协同作战的训练。

尸骸舰队是由拒绝屈服于生者意志的不死至上主义者组成的军队。尸骸舰队由伊奥克斯海军叛逃者建立，旨在瓦解协约世界的团结，将伊奥克斯从生者，以及站在他们那边的骨贤的影响中解放出来。尸骸舰队顽强不屈且极其残忍，以死亡与毁灭为业，吞噬生者，剥削亡者。

items.name: 电弧手枪
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

Instead of traditional ammunition, this bulky pistol contains a capacitor that generates arcs of electricity. Its stock is crafted from polycarbon or other synthetic insulators, often tinted bright yellow and inscribed with the universal bolt symbol for high voltage.
items.description:
强化： 1

这把笨重的手枪不使用传统弹药，而是内置一个能够产生电弧的电容器。枪托由聚碳材料或其他合成绝缘材料制成，通常染成亮黄色，并刻有表示高压电的通用闪电符号。

items.name: 自瞄步枪
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This short, bulky assault rifle incorporates a piston system that allows the user to switch to auto-fire and unload a magazine with one trigger squeeze.
items.description:
强化： 1

这把短粗的突击步枪内置活塞系统，让使用者能切换至自动射击，扣动一次扳机便倾泻整个弹匣。

items.name: 战斗手套
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

These durable gloves fit over a wielder's hands (or other appendages) and feature weighted plates or spikes over the knuckles.
items.description:
强化： 1

这些耐用手套套在持用者的手上（或其他附肢上），指节处装有配重甲板或尖刺。

items.name: 念力巨蜥护甲
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

Flexible but sturdy plates layered together form this traditional armor worn by lashunta cavalry on Castrovel. In times past, a shotalashu cavalry member forged their armor from their mount's shed skin, or more rarely, the skin of a fallen mount, to honor them in future battles. Synthetic imitations are fashionable on some parts of Castrovel.
items.description:
强化： 1

这种由柔韧而坚固的甲片层叠制成的传统护甲，由卡斯卓韦（Castrovel）的拉申塔人（Lashunta）骑兵穿戴。过去，念力巨蜥骑兵（shotalashu cavalry）会用坐骑蜕下的皮，或更少见地用阵亡坐骑的皮制作护甲，以便在今后的战斗中纪念它们。合成仿制品在卡斯卓韦的某些地区颇为流行。

items.name: 协同步伐
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger An adjacent ally moves away from the Corpse Fleet infantry

Effect The Corpse Fleet infantry Strides up to half their Speed. They must move in the same direction as the triggering ally.
items.description:
触发 一个相邻盟友移动远离尸骸舰队步兵

效果 尸骸舰队步兵行走至多自身速度一半的距离，且必须朝触发盟友移动的同一方向移动。

items.name: 虚能治疗
items.expectedDescription: @Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.NegativeHealing]
items.description: @Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.NegativeHealing]

items.name: 齐射
items.expectedDescription: The Corpse Fleet infantry's ranged Strikes deal an additional 1d4 precision damage when the Corpse Fleet infantry is within the first range increment of at least one other member of the Corpse Fleet wielding a ranged weapon.
items.description: 当尸骸舰队步兵处于至少一名持用有远程武器的其他尸骸舰队成员的第一个射程增量内时，其远程打击造成额外1d4精准伤害。

bqqVBryPyM6Ho8BN.name: 数字幽灵电子游戏玩家 Digital Ghost Vidgamer
bqqVBryPyM6Ho8BN.publicNotes:
一些电子游戏玩家如此沉迷上网，以至于他们能以数字幽灵的形式显现。

数字幽灵是由被遗忘的用户账户和元数据构筑而成的数据构装体，它们被搜集起来并被格式化成源用户的拟像。

items.name: 科技感知（模糊）30尺
items.expectedDescription: A digital ghost senses creatures and items with the tech trait at the listed range.
items.description: 数字幽灵可以在所列范围内感知具有科技特征的生物和物品。

items.name: 备份
items.expectedDescription:
An offline copy of the digital ghost is stored in a device. When an active digital ghost is destroyed, it reforms after [[/gmr 2d4 #days]]{2d4 days} within the device that the copy is stored in, fully healed, but with no memory of what destroyed them. A digital ghost can be permanently removed from that device by attempting a @Check[computers|dc:24] check against the digital ghost's Will DC.

On a success, the copy of the digital ghost is purged from the device, and no new copies will be generated. On a critical success, any active copies are also purged.
items.description:
数字幽灵的一个离线副本保存在设备中。活跃的数字幽灵被摧毁后，会在[[/gmr 2d4 #days]]{2d4天}后于储存副本的设备内重新形成，完全恢复生命值，但不记得自己被何物摧毁。可以尝试一次@Check[computers|dc:24]检定，对抗数字幽灵的意志DC，将数字幽灵从该设备中永久清除。

成功时，数字幽灵的副本从设备中被清除，且不会生成新的副本。大成功时，任何活跃副本也会被清除。

items.name: 设备束缚
items.expectedDescription: A digital ghost can stray only a short distance from the device where they're stored. A typical limit is 120 feet.
items.description: 数字幽灵只能离开储存自身的设备一小段距离，通常以120尺为限。

items.name: 恶意软件感染
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency once per day

Effect The digital ghost attempts to infect an item with the tech trait being held or used by a creature within 30 feet. The bearer can attempt a @Check[will|dc:21] save.

Critical Success The item is unaffected, and the digital ghost can't use Malware Infection for 1 week.

Success The item is unaffected.

Failure The item becomes glitching 2.

Critical Failure The item becomes glitching 2, and an offline digital ghost based on the bearer is created on the device in [[/gmr 2d4 #days]]{2d4 days}.
items.description:
频率 每天一次

效果 数字幽灵试图感染一件具有科技特征、正被30尺内的生物持握或使用的物品。持用者可以尝试一次@Check[will|dc:21]豁免。

大成功 物品不受影响，且数字幽灵在1周内无法使用恶意软件感染。

成功 物品不受影响。

失败 物品陷入故障2。

大失败 物品陷入故障2，且在[[/gmr 2d4 #days]]{2d4天}后，设备上会生成一个以持用者为基础的离线数字幽灵。

items.name: 虚拟武装
items.expectedDescription: A digital ghost's weapons deal mental damage, have the ghost killer upgrade, and disappear if dropped.
items.description: 数字幽灵的武器造成心灵伤害，具有灭鬼强化，并在被丢下时消失。

cnText_prototypeToken_name.text: 数字幽灵电子游戏玩家

cZq0Rm1CoW7MPeuI.name: 悖论17 Paradox 17
cZq0Rm1CoW7MPeuI.publicNotes:
由于悖论17通常不可见，大多数记录的观测都始于听到一声轰鸣，“如同失效信号的杂音”。所有报告都提到一种深刻却难以定位的意义感。一位幸存者目睹它被一道光芒照亮，她形容所见“如同由闪亮的眼睛和玻璃羽毛构成的螺旋星系”。另一人则描述它为——“数十片交错的翅膀，其间散落着余烬”。然而关于悖论17唯一可确定的，是直接与之对抗可能何等致命。

你可曾真正确信，你所感知到的物质宇宙真实存在？你可曾确信，某天醒来时不会发现这一切不过是一场梦？曾有一颗星球上遍布哲学家，他们追寻着这些问题的答案……就在他们集体消失之前。他们留下晦涩的记录，宣称"旋涡之星"（whirling star）的光芒揭示了物质实为虚妄，物质宇宙暗中竟是精神牢笼。这些记录是已知首次遭遇名为悖论17的存在时留下的全部遗迹。

items.name: 事件视界
items.expectedDescription:
You unleash the power of a supermassive black hole. All creatures in the area take 6d10 bludgeoning and 6d10 void damage. Event horizon ignores up to 10 resistance creatures in the area have to bludgeoning, and up to 10 resistance they have to void. Each creature attempts a Reflex save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the end of its next turn.

Failure The creature takes full damage, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 3} until the end of its next turn, and slowed 1 for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is slowed 3 until the end of its next turn, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} for 1 minute.
items.description:
你释放超大质量黑洞的力量。区域内所有生物受到6d10钝击伤害和6d10虚能伤害。事件视界忽略区域内生物至多10点钝击抗力和至多10点虚能抗力。每个生物尝试一次反射豁免。

大成功 生物不受影响。

成功 生物受到一半伤害，且陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢1}，直到其下一回合结束。

失败 生物受到全额伤害，陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢3}直到其下一回合结束，并陷入缓慢1，持续1分钟。

大失败 生物受到双倍伤害，陷入缓慢3直到其下一回合结束，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢2}，持续1分钟。

items.name: 无敌咒
items.expectedDescription: You sever yourself from cause and effect. For the duration of the spell, you are immune to any effect or damage that would harm you, excluding effects caused by artifacts, deific power, and similarly powerful sources. You can selectively allow yourself to be affected by anything you're willing to have affect you.
items.description: 你把自己与因果割裂。在法术持续时间内，你免疫任何对你有害的效果或者伤害，除了由神器，神力，以及类似的强力来源造成的效果。你仍然可以受到任何你愿意受到的效果的影响。

items.name: 内爆术
items.expectedDescription:
You crush the target by causing it to collapse in on itself, dealing 75 damage. The first time each round you Sustain the spell, you must choose a new target to be subject to the same effect; the same creature can never be targeted more than once with a single casting of this spell. You also can't affect more than one creature per turn with implosion. You can't target a creature that's incorporeal, gaseous, or liquid, or otherwise lacking a solid form.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 10.
items.description:
你通过令目标自身崩坏来摧毁目标，造成75伤害。每轮你首次维持此法术时，你必须选择一个新的目标承受相同的效果；相同的生物不能被同一次施放的该法术重复作为目标。你也不能在一回合中通过内爆术影响超过一个生物。你不能以虚体，气体，液体或者其他缺少固体形态的生物作为目标。

升阶（+1） 该伤害增加10。

items.name: 切割现实
items.expectedDescription:
You slice through reality, forming a chasm of life-draining entropy in a straight line 20 feet high, 120 feet long, and 2 inches thick. The chasm provides cover. The chasm deals 7d8 void damage to each creature that's in the chasm's space when it's created, that attempts to pass through the chasm, or that ends its turn inside the chasm, with a basic Reflex save. A creature that succeeds at this save when the chasm is created is pushed to the nearest space on the side of its choice. Creatures trying to move through the chasm fail to do so if they critically fail the save, ending their movement next to the chasm.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d8.
items.description:
你划破现实，在一条20尺高、120尺长、2英寸厚的直线上形成一道能使生命流失的熵裂隙。裂隙提供掩蔽。裂隙会对在形成时位于其空间内、试图穿过裂隙或在裂隙内结束回合的每个生物造成7d8虚能伤害，具有一次基础反射豁免。如果生物在裂隙形成时豁免成功，则会被推到其选择的一侧最近的空间。试图穿过裂隙的生物如果豁免失败，就会在裂隙旁结束移动。

升阶（+1）伤害增加 1d8。

items.name: 实言术（恒定）
items.expectedDescription:
The target can understand all words regardless of language and also speak the languages of other creatures. When in a mixed group of creatures, each time the target speaks, it can choose a creature and speak in a language that creature understands, even if the target doesn't know what language that is.

Heightened (7th) The duration is 8 hours.
items.description:
无论什么语言，目标都可以理解其所有的词语，也能说其他生物的语言。当处于一群各异的生物中时，每次目标说话时，都可以选择一个生物，并使用一种该生物理解的语言来讲述，即使该目标不知道这语言具体是什么。

升阶（7环） 持续时间为8小时。

items.name: 警示波动
items.expectedDescription:
You deter enemies with a wave of hostile intent. The target takes 7d8 nonlethal mental damage, and the target must attempt a Will save. The psychic energy then arcs to another creature within 30 feet of the first target, jumps to another creature within 30 feet of that target, and so on. You can end the wave at any point. You can't target the same creature more than once, and you must have line of effect to all targets. Roll the damage only once, and apply it to each target (halving or doubling as appropriate for its saving throw outcome).

Critical Success The target creature is unaffected, and the wave ends with that target.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d8.
items.description:
你以一波敌意威慑敌人。目标受到7d8非致命心灵伤害，并且必须尝试意志豁免。随后，心灵能量会跃向初始目标30尺内的另一个生物，再跳向该生物30尺内的另一个生物，以此类推。你可以在任何时候终止波动。你不能以同一生物为目标超过一次，并且必须对所有目标都具有效果线。只掷一次伤害骰，再将伤害应用于每个目标（根据其豁免结果适当地减半或翻倍）。

大成功 目标生物不受影响，且波动在该目标处终止。

成功 目标受到一半伤害。

失败 目标受到全部伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧1}。

大失败 目标受到双倍伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧2}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加2d8。

items.name: 因果时刻
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency once per round

Trigger A creature would trigger Paradox 17's Reactive Strike, but it has no reactions remaining

Effect Paradox 17 Steps or Strikes prior to resolving the triggering action.
items.description:
频率 每轮一次

触发 一个生物即将触发悖论17的反应打击，但悖论17已无剩余反应

效果 悖论17在结算触发动作前快步或打击。

items.name: 排斥现实
items.expectedDescription: 100 feet. When a creature in the aura observes Paradox 17 for the first time each day, it must attempt a @Check[will|dc:42] save or Performance check. On a failure, reality rejects the creature for as long as it can observe Paradox 17. The affected creature becomes hidden from all other creatures (except Paradox 17) as though invisible itself.
items.description: 100尺。灵光内的生物每天首次观察悖论17时，必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:42]豁免或表演检定。失败时，只要该生物仍能观察悖论17，现实就会排斥它。受影响的生物仿佛自身隐形，对所有其他生物（悖论17除外）变为藏匿。

items.name: 感知之桥
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements Another creature is observing Paradox 17 or has triggered interdict definition in the last hour

Effect Paradox 17 teleports to any location that both Paradox 17 and the required creature can observe across any distance, even to another galaxy or plane.
items.description:
需求 另一个生物正在观察悖论17，或在过去一小时内触发过阻止定义

效果 悖论17传送到自身与满足需求的生物都能观察到的任意位置，不受距离限制，甚至可以到另一个星系或位面。

items.name: 漠视现实
items.expectedDescription: Paradox 17 can move through all creatures, objects, and structures as though they were incorporeal.
items.description: 悖论17可以移动穿越任何生物，物体，或构造物如同它是虚体一般。

items.name: 阻止定义
items.expectedDescription: Paradox 17 automatically and instantly learns and can observe the exact location of any creature on any plane that succeeds at a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} check to learn any information about Paradox 17 or any creature who communicates information about Paradox 17 in any way. The ability to observe the creature and its surroundings, wherever the creature goes, lasts 1 hour.
items.description: 悖论17能自动即时感知并锁定任何位面中任意生物的确切位置，只要该生物通过@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]检定以了解关于悖论17的任何信息，或以任何方式传递悖论17相关信息。此能力能观察生物及其周边，无论生物去向何处，持续1小时。

items.name: 天生隐形
items.expectedDescription: Paradox 17 is naturally invisible. It becomes visible only when using a hostile action.
items.description: 悖论17天生隐形。它只会在使用了敌对动作后才会变得可见。

items.name: 觉醒光芒
items.expectedDescription:
Paradox 17 burns away the fabric of reality with intense sunlight. If no creatures are observing Paradox 17, the light fills a @Template[type:cone|distance:60]. If any creature is observing Paradox 17, the area is a @Template[type:line|distance:60]. Creatures and unattended objects in the area turn temporarily translucent. Creatures in the area take @Damage[24d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage and must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:45] save. Paradox 17 can't use Waking Light again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Waking Light]]{1d4 rounds}.

Critical Success The target takes no damage.

Success The target takes half damage becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1}.

Failure The target takes full damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 2}.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 3}.
items.description:

d4dxwxR0ihnat09b.publicNotes:
与所有已知类型的光谱族不同，值守体是一种由无数微小碎片组成的碎片化生物——这些碎片协同运作，构成一个单一的网络化整体。在漂流崩溃前，从未有过遭遇值守体的记录；主流理论认为，要么是这场危机的创伤催生了它们，要么是漂流域为应对危机本身创造了它们。无论如何，如今遭遇值守体已成为家常便饭。这些光谱族集群常被派遣去渗透凡人世界，充当间谍或观察者。它们收集的信息会被传递给更强大的光谱族（如集念体）进行分析与保存。有人猜测，值守体可能一直潜伏在银河系中，作为其他光谱族的隐形间谍——而漂流危机只是让它们换上了一种凝聚力更低的新形态。

在浩瀚众界，时间的计量单位并非百年、千年或百万年，而是以"永世"（eons）——即现实本身的迭代周期为尺度。直到近三个世纪，随着漂流域（Drift）技术的出现与普及，光谱族才崭露头角，在原本停滞不前的浩瀚众界思潮中，于一片新兴领域里蓬勃发展。

尽管光谱族的起源与目标仍笼罩在迷雾中，但与它们相关的遭遇事件总围绕三大主题：新科技发现、分享超光速旅行知识，以及保护漂流域。无人知晓光谱族是否在漂流域诞生前就已存在，但它们与超空间位面的关联无可争议。著名形而上学家认为，光谱族是由被卷入漂流域的原始精质（quintessence）融合而成的产物——正如漂流域本身由多元宇宙的碎片生长而来。若此说属实，光谱族对漂流域技术扩散的兴趣便蒙上一层微妙的阴翳：每一台新的漂流引擎，都在为漂流域与光谱族自身的扩张"收割"浩瀚众界及其所有住民。

dTcRpmumuDlNk5vH.publicNotes:
尖角蜘蛛是一种由尖刺甲壳和利齿组成的贪婪生物，它依靠一组细长的蛛形腿以惊人的速度推进。它在领地内横冲直撞，吞噬一切比它小的东西，并对它所留下的毁灭痕迹感到欣喜。要躲避尖角蜘蛛是很难的，因为它会撕毁防御工事，穿透混凝土墙壁来捕食躲在建筑物内的猎物。要逃离尖角蜘蛛则更加困难，因为它能吐出一种腐蚀性的蛛丝，这种蛛丝会以魔法将猎物与自己绑定在一起，让它能够将猎物从任何距离拖到它那等待着的血盆大口前。

尖角蜘蛛拥有与其破坏力相匹配的可怕狡诈。它通常会观察一个目标定居点好几天，分析防御情况，然后才发动毁灭性的攻击。它通常是一种独居生物，除非是在训练新孵化的幼崽狩猎时。在这段时间里，它会在幼崽前面行动，横冲直撞穿过人口密集的区域，并在身后留下受伤、虚弱的猎物。最初的狂暴袭击中的幸存者很快会发现他们并不是幸运儿，因为尖角蜘蛛的幼崽会接踵而至，吞噬它们路径上的一切。

dfQw3yXo0X1O5sMf.name: 辐照不死飞行者 Irradiated Undead Flyer
dfQw3yXo0X1O5sMf.publicNotes:
飞行者是对有翼生物的统称，例如龙兽，巨蜻蜓，猛禽和其他被重度辐射复生的飞行野兽。

要在残酷的宇宙中生存，生物必须天生适应环境或采取防护措施。虽然亡者通常无需防范这些威胁，但辐射有时能使尸体（或多具尸体）复苏为不死生物！

科学家与宗教学者们一直在争论，某一特定类型的辐射是否导致了这种自发产生不生生物的现象，但所有人都认同此类辐照生物所带来的危险。多种辐射源皆可能引发此现象：恒星释放的剧烈太空辐射爆发，行星或卫星地壳中魔法增强的放射性同位素，甚至社会中新兴能源（及其放射性废料）对土地的污染。无论具体成因如何，辐照不死生物都具有相同威胁——它们释放的电离辐射会摧毁周围一切。

eDBvECDugnQ2q7Bu.publicNotes: 塔什塔里原产于绿意盎然的卡斯卓韦，如今在更广大的星系中以“激光狼”之名闻名。这些狼一般的群猎者身上覆着一层柔韧的丝状毛发，能发出磷光，让它们以独特的视觉语言无声交流。每只塔什塔里喉中都有一个节点，能引导储存的太阳能，释放聚焦的光束，这也正是“激光狼”之名的由来。一对伴侣领导着塔什塔里兽群，其中一只或两只为首领。它们通常会成为一片或多片森林及周边广大地区的顶级掠食者。树木对夜行的塔什塔里很重要，因为它们白天会睡在树顶，沐浴日光，补充太阳能。

f4QeUAZrfeIFZRHD.name: 烬蛛族祭司 Jinsul Pontiff
f4QeUAZrfeIFZRHD.publicNotes:
祭司能在激战之中激发烬蛛族近乎自杀般的狂热。他们兼具施法者与演说家的特质，是鼓舞士气的战场领袖。每位祭司都效忠于一位烬蛛族大祭司（major jinsul hierarchs），而这些大祭司又是整个烬蛛族神权国的领袖。

烬蛛族（Jinsuls）是一个好战的物种，散布于浩界之中。它们长有六条腿，身形臃肿，周身布满眼睛；其身体上有着明显的几丁质节段，还长有一组上前肢，可用于操作设备。烬蛛族很久以前曾生活在被称为荡劫星域（the Scoured Stars）的星域，但最终离开那里，在环境恶劣的拉克斯（Rax）星球上定居下来。近来，神使杜鲁斯（the divine herald Dhurus）将烬蛛族整合为一个具有强大凝聚力的势力，即烬蛛族神权国，该势力一度短暂地重新占领了荡劫星域。最终，由多个种族以及寻星者协会（Starfinder Society）成员组成的联盟击败了杜鲁斯，烬蛛族重新分散到了浩界中。

烬蛛族在宇宙深处拥有数不胜数的基地与舰队，他们大多数都是劫掠者，四处搜刮装备，并与其他种族较量以检验自身实力。烬蛛族被灌输了这样一种观念，即自视为高等种族，认为只有荡劫星域的其他居民才稍具价值，因此他们更倾向于与敌人展开近距离战斗。

烬蛛族的数量不足以满足他们在星系中所控制的众多飞船和太空站的所有需求。为此，他们依靠机器人和自动化计算机系统（始终至少由一名烬蛛族军官指挥）来确保太空站高效运转。这些系统被编程得与烬蛛族自身一样致命且冷酷无情；即便是看起来最为无害的自动化系统或机器人，比如垃圾清理机，也可能配备致命武器，或是暗藏凶险的术法科技（technomagical）反制手段。

fDFa6DJe5sYUh922.name: 艾琳卓侍僧 Elindrian Acolyte
fDFa6DJe5sYUh922.publicNotes:
这些艾琳卓人是乌库兰的恐噩的基层信徒。他们近期因某种原能力量或异能动荡——无人能确定——死而复生，执着地执行着在卡斯卓韦挖掘艾琳卓同族的骇人任务；许多其他艾琳卓人也已复生，但多数仍深埋地下。唯有当其他活着的生物介入时，他们才会停下来发动攻击。

被称为艾琳卓人的种族早在亿万年前便消失于卡斯卓韦行星地表下的荒芜壳巢（husk-hives）。直至近年，他们仍只是传说中的存在，仅存于最晦涩的弗米蚁族史籍之中。如今，卡斯卓韦的学者们正竭力搜寻关于艾琳卓人的更多记载，探究其起源——更重要的是——揭开他们与恐怖泥怪生物联系的真相，这种生物近日从他们的卫星艾琳卓（Elindrae）降临。一种理论认为，艾琳卓人与被称为"乌库兰的恐噩"的泥怪生物存在某种原始羁绊，二者或许同源于艾琳卓——另有理论主张艾琳卓人最初创造了这个泥怪，或是他们是弗米蚁族的远亲，早在久远以前便遭到了恐噩的侵蚀。

fH7ct0hzjiQ5QYVV.publicNotes:
德-诺洛是支配者中最顶尖的工程师，他们能巧妙且狡黠地将科技与生物系统融为一体，创造出任何能想象得到的装置，从阴险的武器到庞大的星舰，再到舰心泥怪（shipmind oozes）。这些造物是培育而成，而非建造出来的，但它们既不属于电控机械范畴，也不属于生物技术范畴，而是介于两者之间。德-诺洛热衷于探究他们所接触到的任何技术，并且认为，对于任何他们觉得能帮助自己更好地理解陌生装置的人，他们都有权取食其大脑。话又说回来，德-诺洛几乎会以任何理由毫无顾忌地取食大脑，在他们眼中，所有支配者之外的生物形式都是低等存在。

尽管主体为有机生命体，德-诺洛能将自身发光的液态金属分泌物浓缩为污秽的晶体，这些晶体既可用作射弹，也可作为他们那些扭曲发明的机械部件。随便一瞧，旁观者或许会以为这些造物是生物技术产物，因为它们往往看上去就像萎缩的器官和变异的身体部位，由看似粗糙或不完整的电路连接在一起。即便有人设法分离或排出德-诺洛异质肉体自然产生的毒素，试图将德-诺洛的技术植入自身作为殖装，也通常会遭受剧痛和凄惨的死亡。即便使用德-诺洛技术进行侵入性较低的实验，也充满不可预测性和危险性，而所谓“成功”的结果，充其量也只会令人觉得毛骨悚然。

fsBcm20KeLOyNMjT.name: 斥候虫 Athraxer
fsBcm20KeLOyNMjT.publicNotes:
虫群入侵时会部署斥候虫作为步兵。这些无畏而暴戾的生物对侦察星球环境与防御至关重要。单艘虫群飞船便可运载数千枚处于静滞状态的虫卵。

虫群由浩界深处一种称为虫族的昆虫状物种发展而来，许多文明认为它是世上最大的威胁。虫群由无数子群组成，每个子群又包含无数组件亚种；这支庞大的群体以心灵联合的方式行动，意图吞噬宇宙中的一切物质。最可怕的是，虫群能够同化被其吞噬者的知识与DNA。由于在大断层之前便已发展出星际旅行技术，虫群在历史中断之前就已经吞噬了无数星系；而在获得信标与名为漂流域的超空间维度后，它们的步伐更是加快了。

被虫群触及的世界会被榨干自然资源，化为称作空壳世界的荒芜之地。外人所谓的“虫群星域”，不过是虫群在肆意进军中吞噬过的一大片死寂世界。虫群将这些世界剥夺得如此彻底，以至于勘探者连稀有矿物和水等无机资源的微量痕迹都难以找到。这些空壳世界很少被彻底探索，因为探索往往会唤醒沉寂的虫群个体。人们推测，它们被留下，是为了应对被吞噬的星系再遭殖民、重新出现居民的情况。远在这片星域之外，也有零星的虫群活动，因为虫群在大断层之前的漫长岁月中派出了无数子群；即使到了今天，也只有部分子群抵达了预定目的地。

在当今时代，虫群最广为人知的或许是两件事。首先，它们对协约世界与维斯卡里姆的进攻，促成了这两大势力停止敌对，并结成脆弱的联盟。其次，虫群是希伦虫人的直系祖先。希伦虫人在大断层期间的某个时候脱离虫群，寻得了神祇海拉丝的庇护。据信，海拉丝由虫群形成之前的虫族进化而来，并背弃了后来演变成贪婪实体的虫群。

近年来，除了在浩界的苏斯基隆星系开展的机密行动之外，虫群并无活动，人们几乎只把它当作遥远的吓人传说。然而，最近人们发现了失踪的桑迪特世界克雷西斯卡，无意间唤醒了曾吞噬这个世界的休眠子群。自此，这个新获名为克雷西斯卡的子群成为了近宇的祸害，正在积极入侵桑迪特联合体的世界，并有蔓延至维斯卡里姆和协约世界等其他势力的趋势。这个被重新发现的子群已开始让其组件快速进化，虽然仍与更广大的虫群隔绝，却已对近宇构成明确威胁。

items.description: （灵光） 30尺。所有处于彼此范围内的虫群心智盟友能够进行持续的心灵沟通，并且彼此知道对方察觉到的所有威胁。如果此生物处于至少一个具有虫群心智的盟友的范围内，则其在对抗心灵效果的豁免上掷骰出成功时，改为获得大成功。

items.name: 垂死挣扎

Trigger The athraxer would die

Effect The athraxer first makes a claw Strike against a creature in reach, then dies.
items.description:
触发 斥候虫即将死亡

效果 斥候虫先对触及范围内的一个生物进行一次爪击，然后死亡。

fvzsE30UKsXVkeaM.name: 虚空棕榈 Void Palm

items.name: 反重力干扰

Upon entering this aura, any items or objects with the tech trait that employ some form of antigrav tech, including antigrav harnesses as well as most hover vehicles and starships, become glitching 1.
items.description: （灵光，魔法）120尺。虚空棕榈会使得反重力技术陷入故障。进入此灵光后，任何具有科技特征的物品或物体，如果使用了某种形式的反重力科技，包括反重力背带以及大多数悬浮载具和星舰，会陷入故障1。

items.name: 迷惑图纹
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature with darkvision within 60 feet of the void palm begins its turn

Requirements The void palm is in darkness

Effect The patterns on a void palm's mottled red fronds resemble a distant star field when viewed in the darkness. The void palm sways its fronds in a disorienting manner. The triggering creature must attempt a @Check[will|dc:25] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and becomes immune to Disorienting Patterns for 24 hours.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} until the end of the void palm's next turn.

Failure As success, and the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to the void palm's melee Strikes while it's dazzled.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 minute
items.description:

需求 虚空棕榈处于黑暗中

效果 在黑暗中观察时，虚空棕榈斑驳的红色叶片上的图纹宛如遥远的星空。虚空棕榈以令人迷失方向的方式摇动叶片。触发生物必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:25]豁免。

大成功 生物不受影响，并免疫迷惑图纹，持续24小时。

成功 生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}，直到虚空棕榈的下一回合结束。

失败 如同成功，且生物在目眩期间，对虚空棕榈的近战打击还处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}。

items.name: 双重鞭笞
items.expectedDescription: The void palm makes two sweeping frond Strikes against the same target, each using its current multiple attack penalty. If both attacks hit, combine their damage. This counts as two attacks when calculating the void palm's multiple attack penalty.
items.description: 虚空棕榈对同一目标进行两次叶片横扫打击，每次使用其当前的多重攻击减值。若两次攻击均命中，合并其伤害。在计算虚空棕榈的多重攻击减值时，此能力计作两次攻击。

items.name: 重力虚空
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency once per day

Effect The void palm creates a zero-gravity area of darkness in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:20], negating the effects of gravity and non-magical light sources in the area. Magical light sources in the area work normally. The void palm is unaffected by this lack of gravity, but other creatures that enter or start their turn in the area become untethered unless they can move normally in zero-gravity environments; they're also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} while untethered in the area. An untethered creature attempting to Push Off in the area must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:5] or the action is disrupted. The Gravity Void lasts for 10 minutes.
items.description:
频率 每天一次

效果 虚空棕榈在@Template[type:emanation|distance:20]内创造一片零重力的黑暗区域，抵消区域内重力和非魔法光源的效果。区域内的魔法光源如常生效。虚空棕榈不受无重力影响，但其他进入区域或在区域内开始回合的生物陷入失重，除非其能在零重力环境中正常移动；在该区域内失重期间，其还陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙1}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}。失重生物尝试在区域内推离时，必须成功通过一次@Check[flat|dc:5]，否则该动作被打断。重力虚空持续10分钟。

fvzsE30UKsXVkeaM.publicNotes:
虚空棕榈对知性生物及其反重力技术都构成威胁。这种植物通过将每年产生的亮蓝色种子弹射到太空中来缓慢但稳定地传播。种子获得的动量提供了足够的速度，再加上它们无视重力的超自然能力，使得大多数种子能够逃逸到太空深处。每颗种子不断漂流，直到遇到适合其维持生存的物体，无论是流浪的小行星、行星星体，还是大型星舰。

一旦嵌入合适的表面，虚空棕榈的种子就会迅速发芽。这种植物在发芽后开始从周围环境中吸取养分，这些养分会定期因为此植物受害者的腐烂尸体或氧化碎片而变得丰富。这种植物的叶片常常清除其区域内的残骸或其他碎片，这些碎片可能会被用作攀附物或配重物，或者可能会让潜在猎物察觉危险。

g0BpwKzJCsC4yFcp.name: 奥玛（星鲸） Oma

items.name: 闪电链
items.expectedDescription:
You discharge a powerful bolt of lightning at the target, dealing 8d12 electricity damage. The target must attempt a basic Reflex save. The electricity arcs to another creature within 30 feet of the first target, jumps to another creature within 30 feet of that target, and so on. You can end the chain at any point. You can't target the same creature more than once, and you must have line of effect to all targets. Roll the damage only once, and apply it to each target (halving or doubling as appropriate for its saving throw outcome). The chain ends if any one of the targets critically succeeds at its save.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d12.
items.description:
你向目标释放一束强力的闪电，造成8d12电击伤害。目标必须尝试一次基础反射豁免。电流会跳跃到第一个目标30尺内的另一个生物上，接着跳到这个生物30尺内的下一个生物上，以此类推。你可以在任何时候终止连锁。你无法将同一个生物作为目标多于一次，并且你必须与所有的目标间有效果线。只掷一次伤害骰，并将其应用于每个目标（对于其豁免结果，取半或者加倍）。若任一目标的豁免大成功，连锁便会结束。

升阶（+1） 该伤害增加1d12。

items.name: 系统超荷
items.expectedDescription:
You flood the area with a wave of electrical interference. You deal 7d8 electricity damage to creatures in the area. Each creature in the area must attempt a Reflex save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage, and any of its items with the tech trait become glitching 1 for 1 minute or until the condition is removed.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage, and any of its items with the tech trait become glitching 2 for 1 minute or until the condition is removed.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d8.
items.description:

大失败目标受到两倍伤害并且所有具有科技特征的物品会陷入故障2持续1分钟或者被移除。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 1d8。

items.name: 断电术
items.expectedDescription:
You ignite a sudden spark of electricity that surges into a technological creature or object. You de-energize an item with the tech trait or disrupt a creature with the tech trait, with effects based on the target being a creature or object.

  • Creature If your target is a creature with the tech trait, it attempts a Will save. On a failure, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 1}; on a critical failure, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 2}.

items.description:
你骤然点燃一道电火花，令其涌入一个科技生物或物体。你使具有科技特征的物品失去能量，或扰乱具有科技特征的生物，效果取决于目标是生物还是物体。
