g0BpwKzJCsC4yFcp.publicNotes:
奥玛（星鲸）也被称作太空鲸，能释放强大的魔法电磁场，既能抵御真空环境与有毒大气，又能保障其进食需求。它们从气态巨行星的粒子环与浓密大气中获取养分，但具体哪些物质对奥玛具有营养价值仍属未知。观察进食中的奥玛并非没有风险。它们有时会意外吞噬无人机及小型星舰，比如战斗机和拦截机，也有受到挑衅后有意为之的记录。

大多数奥玛被观察到独自旅行。偶尔，奥玛会组成三到五只的群体，沿着唯有它们知晓的航线与时间表，穿越恒星系迁徙。极其罕见的情况下，奥玛会以庞大数量聚集在行星的环带之间。它们的能量场相互交织，与当地气体发生反应，在广阔的宇宙空间中点燃绚烂多彩的奇观。

它们最神秘却广为人知的特征是星之歌。星之歌是一种萦绕心头的心灵感应旋律，能穿越数十亿里的太空。多数人感知到的星之歌是低吟浅唱，缓慢而哀伤。关于其具体形态众说纷纭，暗示每位聆听者所感各异。迄今所有翻译尝试均告失败，连最杰出的魔法与语言学专家也束手无策。自漂流危机爆发后，出于不明的原因，成群的奥玛开始以某种新的星之歌频率轰炸漂流信标，某些情况下甚至引发灾难性故障。

g4FWl8FkL5bbROgk.name: 迷途空间扭曲 Wayward Warp
g4FWl8FkL5bbROgk.publicNotes: 迷途空间扭曲一种活体维度裂隙，它们在扭曲周围世界的同时造成了意想不到的破坏。没有两个迷途空间扭曲看起来是相同的，也没有一个迷途空间扭曲能长时间保持相同的外观；每当一个迷途空间扭曲移动时，一个不同的潜在现实就会显现出来。空间扭曲本身是一道出现在灵光中心的裂隙，看起来像现实的一道裂口，常常呈现出一种模糊地类似于羽星的形状，其触须上排列着空间本身的碎片状裂缝。

items.name: 虚空低语
items.expectedDescription:
The target hears ominous sounds containing unspeakable mysteries from beyond the stars that disorient its mind. The target attempts a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The target hears the strange whispers, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target begins to wander aimlessly, using each action to Step in a random direction. When it moves, the target takes the safest route and doesn't enter hazardous terrain. The spell has a duration of 1 minute or until a creature uses a hostile action against the target.

Critical Failure As failure, except the target babbles incoherently. Any creature that begins its turn within 20 feet of the target must attempt a Will saving throw. On a failure, it must use its first action on its next turn to Step in a random direction and becomes immune to this spell for 24 hours. This is an incapacitation effect.
items.description:
目标听见来自群星之外的不祥声响，其中蕴含不可言说的奥秘，令它心智迷乱。目标尝试意志豁免。

大成功 生物不受影响。

成功 目标听到奇怪的低语，陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞1}，持续1轮。

失败 目标开始漫无目的地游荡，每个动作都会向一个随机方向快步。目标移动时会选择最安全的路线，且不会进入危险地形。此法术持续1分钟，或直到有生物对目标采取敌意动作。

大失败 如同失败，但目标还会语无伦次地呓语。任何在目标20尺内开始回合的生物都必须尝试意志豁免。失败时，它必须用下个回合的第一个动作向随机方向快步，然后对此法术免疫24小时。这是失能效果。

items.name: 幻象生物
items.expectedDescription:
You create an illusory image of a Large or smaller creature. It generates the appropriate sounds, smells, and feels believable to the touch. If you and the image are ever farther than 500 feet apart, the spell ends.

The image can't speak, but you can use your actions to speak through the creature, with the spell disguising your voice as appropriate. You might need to attempt a Deception or Performance check to mimic the creature, as determined by the GM. This is especially likely if you're trying to imitate a specific person and engage with someone that person knows.

In combat, the illusion can use 2 actions per turn, which it uses when you Sustain the spell. It uses your spell attack modifier for attack rolls and your spell DC for its AC. Its saving throw modifiers are equal to your spell DC – 10. It is substantial enough that it can flank other creatures. If the image is hit by an attack or fails a save, the spell ends.

The illusion can cause damage by making the target believe the illusion's attacks are real, but it cannot otherwise directly affect the physical world. If the illusory creature hits with a Strike, the target takes @Damage[3d4[mental]] damage. The illusion's Strikes are nonlethal. If the damage doesn't correspond to the image of the monster—for example, if an illusory Large dragon deals only 5 damage—the GM might allow the target to attempt an immediate Perception check to disbelieve the spell. Any relevant resistances and weaknesses apply if the target thinks they do, as judged by the GM. For example, if the illusion wields a warhammer and attacks a creature resistant to bludgeoning damage, the creature would take less mental damage. However, illusory damage does not deactivate regeneration or trigger other effects that require a certain damage type. The GM should track illusory damage dealt by the illusion.

Any creature that touches the image or uses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to examine it can attempt to disbelieve your illusion. When a creature disbelieves the illusion, it recovers from half the damage it had taken from it (if any) and doesn't take any further damage from it.

Heightened (+1) The damage of the image's Strikes increases by 1d4, and the maximum size of creature you can create increases by one (to a maximum of Gargantuan).
items.description:
你创造一个大型或者更小的生物的幻象。它发出适当的声音，气味，触摸起来也非常可信。如果你和幻象相距超过500尺，法术结束。

幻象不能说话，但是你可以使用你的动作来通过该生物说话，法术会适当地掩饰你的声音。你可能要尝试欺骗或者表演检定来模仿该生物，由GM决定。如果你想表现一个特定的人，并与一个知晓该人的人交互时，很可能会如此。

在战斗中，该幻象每回合能使用2动作，它在你维持该法术时使用这些动作。其攻击掷骰使用你的法术攻击调整值，AC使用你的法术DC。其豁免调整值等于你的法术DC-10。它足够结实，以至于可以夹击其他生物。如果幻象被攻击命中，或者在豁免中失败，法术结束。

该幻术可以通过令目标相信其攻击真实存在来造成伤害，但它不能直接影响现实世界。如果幻象生物的打击命中，目标承受@Damage[3d4[mental]]伤害。幻象的打击是非致命的。如果伤害与怪物的幻象不对应——举例而言，如果一条幻象大型龙只造成了5点伤害——GM可以允许目标立即进行一次察觉检定以识破法术。只要目标认为能，任何有关的抗力和弱点都会生效，这由GM判定。举例而言，如果幻影持用一把战锤，攻击一个具有钝击抗力的生物，该生物承受的心灵伤害会变少。但是，幻觉伤害不会抑制再生，或者触发其他需要特定伤害类型的能力。GM应当记录幻像造成的幻觉伤害。

当生物触摸幻像，或者使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{搜索}动作来检查它时，该生物可以尝试识破你的幻术。当生物识破幻术时，它回复从该幻术承受的伤害的一半（如果有），并且不会再因该幻术而承受伤害。

升阶（+1） 幻像的打击伤害增加1d4，你可以创造的生物最大体型增大一级（最大为巨型）。

items.name: 幻象生物
items.expectedDescription:
You create an illusory image of a Large or smaller creature. It generates the appropriate sounds, smells, and feels believable to the touch. If you and the image are ever farther than 500 feet apart, the spell ends.

The image can't speak, but you can use your actions to speak through the creature, with the spell disguising your voice as appropriate. You might need to attempt a Deception or Performance check to mimic the creature, as determined by the GM. This is especially likely if you're trying to imitate a specific person and engage with someone that person knows.

In combat, the illusion can use 2 actions per turn, which it uses when you Sustain the spell. It uses your spell attack modifier for attack rolls and your spell DC for its AC. Its saving throw modifiers are equal to your spell DC – 10. It is substantial enough that it can flank other creatures. If the image is hit by an attack or fails a save, the spell ends.

The illusion can cause damage by making the target believe the illusion's attacks are real, but it cannot otherwise directly affect the physical world. If the illusory creature hits with a Strike, the target takes @Damage[3d4[mental]] damage. The illusion's Strikes are nonlethal. If the damage doesn't correspond to the image of the monster—for example, if an illusory Large dragon deals only 5 damage—the GM might allow the target to attempt an immediate Perception check to disbelieve the spell. Any relevant resistances and weaknesses apply if the target thinks they do, as judged by the GM. For example, if the illusion wields a warhammer and attacks a creature resistant to bludgeoning damage, the creature would take less mental damage. However, illusory damage does not deactivate regeneration or trigger other effects that require a certain damage type. The GM should track illusory damage dealt by the illusion.

Any creature that touches the image or uses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to examine it can attempt to disbelieve your illusion. When a creature disbelieves the illusion, it recovers from half the damage it had taken from it (if any) and doesn't take any further damage from it.

Heightened (+1) The damage of the image's Strikes increases by 1d4, and the maximum size of creature you can create increases by one (to a maximum of Gargantuan).
items.description:
你创造一个大型或者更小的生物的幻象。它发出适当的声音，气味，触摸起来也非常可信。如果你和幻象相距超过500尺，法术结束。

幻象不能说话，但是你可以使用你的动作来通过该生物说话，法术会适当地掩饰你的声音。你可能要尝试欺骗或者表演检定来模仿该生物，由GM决定。如果你想表现一个特定的人，并与一个知晓该人的人交互时，很可能会如此。

在战斗中，该幻象每回合能使用2动作，它在你维持该法术时使用这些动作。其攻击掷骰使用你的法术攻击调整值，AC使用你的法术DC。其豁免调整值等于你的法术DC-10。它足够结实，以至于可以夹击其他生物。如果幻象被攻击命中，或者在豁免中失败，法术结束。

该幻术可以通过令目标相信其攻击真实存在来造成伤害，但它不能直接影响现实世界。如果幻象生物的打击命中，目标承受@Damage[3d4[mental]]伤害。幻象的打击是非致命的。如果伤害与怪物的幻象不对应——举例而言，如果一条幻象大型龙只造成了5点伤害——GM可以允许目标立即进行一次察觉检定以识破法术。只要目标认为能，任何有关的抗力和弱点都会生效，这由GM判定。举例而言，如果幻影持用一把战锤，攻击一个具有钝击抗力的生物，该生物承受的心灵伤害会变少。但是，幻觉伤害不会抑制再生，或者触发其他需要特定伤害类型的能力。GM应当记录幻像造成的幻觉伤害。

当生物触摸幻像，或者使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{搜索}动作来检查它时，该生物可以尝试识破你的幻术。当生物识破幻术时，它回复从该幻术承受的伤害的一半（如果有），并且不会再因该幻术而承受伤害。

升阶（+1） 幻像的打击伤害增加1d4，你可以创造的生物最大体型增大一级（最大为巨型）。

items.name: 愚者之思
items.expectedDescription:
You dull the target's mind, depending on its Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} until the start of your next turn.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 3} for 1 minute.
items.description:
你令目标精神迟钝，基于其意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 1}，持续至你下个回合开始。

失败 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 2}，持续1分钟。

大失败 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 3}，持续1分钟。

items.name: 眩彩喷射
items.expectedDescription:
You unleash a swirling multitude of colors that overwhelms creatures based on their Will saves.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round, and dazzled for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature is stunned for 1 round and blinded for 1 minute.
items.description:
你释放旋转变幻的纷繁色彩，根据生物的意志豁免结果对其产生影响。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}1轮。

失败 该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 1}，@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲}1轮，并目眩1分钟。

大失败 该生物震慑1轮，并目盲1分钟。

items.name: 归乡梦
items.expectedDescription: You draw on a creature's thoughts of home and the comfort it finds in that concept, overwhelming the creature with wistful memories of whatever home means to it. The target must succeed at a Will save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by the memories.
items.description: 你汲取生物对家的思念，以及它在这个概念中找到的慰藉，用任何代表家的思念记忆淹没生物。目标必须成功进行意志豁免，否则就会因这些记忆进入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]。

items.name: 诡枪术
items.expectedDescription:
You condense a beam of mind-assaulting eldritch energy from the dark spaces between the stars and fire it at a target. Make a ranged spell attack roll against the target's AC. If you hit, you deal 2d6 mental damage. On a critical success, you deal double damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你自星辰之间的幽深领域凝聚一束袭魂慑魄的怪异能量攻击目标。尝试一次远程法术攻击骰对抗目标的AC，如果命中，你造成2d6心灵伤害，在大成功时造成双倍伤害。

升阶（+1）伤害增加1d6。

items.name: 虚构幻术
items.expectedDescription:
You create a simple illusory sound or vision. A sound adds the auditory trait to the spell and the sound can't include intelligible words or elaborate music. A vision adds the visual trait, can be no larger than a 5-foot cube, and is clearly crude and undetailed if viewed from within 15 feet. When you Cast or Sustain the Spell, you can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion} with the illusion, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to your Deception check. If the attempt fails against a creature, that creature disbelieves the figment.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.2Hg3a06gZCSnUgSA]{Spell Effect: Figment}
items.description:
你创造出简单的声音或图像的幻术。声音会为法术添加听觉特征，且不能包含能被理解的单词或复杂的音乐。图像会为法术添加视觉特征，但是它不能大于5尺边长的立方体，且在15尺的距离内观察会发现它的构造明显很粗糙且缺乏细节。当你施放或维持该法术时，你能尝试用幻术让人@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{分神}，这会为你的欺骗检定提供+2环境加值。若对某个生物进行的此尝试失败了，该生物便识破虚构幻术。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.2Hg3a06gZCSnUgSA]{法术效果：虚构幻术}

items.name: 幻象造物
items.expectedDescription:
You create an illusory visual image of a stationary object. The entire image must fit within the spell's area. The object appears to animate naturally, but it doesn't make sounds or generate smells. For example, water would appear to pour down an illusory waterfall, but it would be silent.

Any creature that touches the image or uses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to examine it can attempt to disbelieve your illusion.

Heightened (2nd) Your image makes appropriate sounds, generates normal smells, and feels right to the touch. The spell gains the auditory and olfactory traits. The duration increases to 1 hour.

Heightened (5th) As the 2nd-rank version, but the duration is unlimited.
items.description:
你创造一个固定物体的视觉幻象。该幻象必须能完全处于法术区域中。该物体会自然活动，但是不会发出声音或者产生气味。举例而言，幻象瀑布中会出现水并流下，但是它会是安静的。

当生物触摸幻像，或者使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{搜索}动作来检查它时，该生物可以尝试识破你的幻术。

升阶（2环） 你的幻象也会发出合适的声音，产生正常气味，并且摸起来也很正常。该法术获得听觉和嗅觉特征。持续时间增加到1小时。

升阶（5环） 如2环阶，但是持续时间为无限。

items.name: 寻觅星辰
items.expectedDescription:
In your mind's eye, you chart a path through the cosmos. If you're in Pact Worlds space, you immediately know which direction to travel in order to reach the Starstone on Absalom Station. If you're outside the Pact System, you know the direction to the nearest Drift beacon or the Starstone.

Heightened (7th) You can instead know the direction to a familiar location, such as a world or way station you've visited.
items.description:
在你的脑海中，你绘制了一条穿越宇宙的路径。如果你在协约世界的空间中，你就能立刻知道前往星石和艾巴萨罗姆空间站的方向。如果你在协约世界以外的空间，你会知道前往最近的漂流信标或星石的方向。

升阶（7环）你可以知道前往熟悉地点的方向，例如你曾经去过的世界或中转站。

items.name: 念动之手
items.expectedDescription:
You create a floating, magical hand, either invisible or ghostlike, that grasps the target object and levitates it slowly up to 20 feet in any direction. When you Sustain the spell, you can move the object an additional 20 feet. If the object is in the air when the spell ends, the object falls.

Heightened (3rd) You can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (7th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 2 or less.
items.description:
你创造出一只漂浮着的魔法手掌，它可以隐形或者宛如幽灵，它能抓住目标物体并向着任意方向缓慢漂浮至多20尺。当你维持法术时，你能够将物体移动额外20尺。若物体位于空中之时法术结束，那么该物体便会坠落。

升阶（3环） 你能以一个1负载或更轻的无主物体为目标。

升阶（5环） 法术射程增加至60尺，而且你能以一个1负载或更轻的无主物体为目标。

升阶（7环） 法术射程增加至60尺，而且你能以一个2负载或更轻的无主物体为目标。

items.name: 虚能噬
items.expectedDescription:
You call upon the Void to harm life force. The target takes 2d4 void damage with a basic Fortitude save. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the start of your next turn.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.
items.description:
你召唤虚空之力以伤害生命力。该目标承受2d4虚能伤害，这有一次基础强韧豁免。 如果该生物在豁免中大失败，它还会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭 1}直至你的下回合开始。

升阶（+1） 该伤害增加1d4。

items.name: 扭曲感知
items.expectedDescription: A wayward warp can sense creatures within their warp field as a precise sense at the listed range.
items.description: 迷途空间扭曲能在所列范围以精确感官感知到其扭曲力场的生物。

items.name: 现实闪烁
items.expectedDescription: The wayward warp has concealment against attacks originating outside of their warp field.
items.description: 迷途空间扭曲对源自其扭曲力场外的攻击具有隐蔽。

items.name: 扭曲力场
items.expectedDescription:
15 feet. Reality within the area becomes a different type of terrain. Structures and creatures in the area aren't transformed, and the change immediately ends when the aura moves or the wayward warp dies. The nature of the aura is chosen randomly using the table below each time the wayward warp moves. A wayward warp is immune to their own warp field's effects and to the aligned damage type, but they gain weakness 5 to the opposing damage type.

[[/r 1d6]]{D6}FIELDALIGNED DAMAGEOPPOSING DAMAGEFIELD EFFECT
1CosmicVoidVitalityZero gravity
2EarthPiercingAcidDifficult terrain (sand)
3InfernoFireColdHazardous terrain (@Damage[1d6[fire]])
4StormElectricityBludgeoningHazardous terrain (@Damage[1d6[electricity]])
5FrozenColdFireUneven ground (ice)
6WaterBludgeoningElectricityUnderwater (flooded)
items.description:
15尺。区域内的现实变成另一种地形。区域内的构造物和生物不会转变；灵光移动或迷途空间扭曲死亡时，变化立即结束。每当迷途空间扭曲移动时，参照下表随机决定灵光的性质。迷途空间扭曲免疫其自身扭曲力场的效果和相符的伤害类型，但获得相对伤害类型的弱点5。

[[/r 1d6]]{D6}力场相符伤害相对伤害力场效果
1宇宙虚能命能零重力
2大地穿刺酸蚀困难地形（沙地）
3炼狱火焰寒冷有害地形（@Damage[1d6[fire]]）
4风暴电击钝击有害地形（@Damage[1d6[electricity]]）
5冰冻寒冷火焰不稳地面（冰）
6水域钝击电击水下（淹没）

items.name: 空间撕裂
items.expectedDescription: A creature hit by a wayward warp's spatial tendril must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:26] save or become misaligned to reality for 1 minute, gaining a condition based on the field effect while it remains in the warp field: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.z1ucw4CLwLqHoAp3] (cosmic), @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF] (earth or water), @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} (inferno or frozen), or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 1} (any tech creature or held tech item in storm).
items.description: 被迷途空间扭曲的空间触须命中的生物必须成功通过一次@Check[will|dc:26]豁免，否则其与现实错位，持续1分钟，在处于扭曲力场内时，根据力场效果获得一种状态：@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.z1ucw4CLwLqHoAp3]（宇宙）、@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]（大地或水域）、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙1}（炼狱或冰冻），或@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{故障1}（风暴中的任何科技生物或持握的科技物品）。

gQIOCzsMtAP201XD.name: 防卫级安保机器人 Protection-Class Security Robot
gQIOCzsMtAP201XD.publicNotes:
这类安保机器人通常采用比其他机器人更耐用的材料制造，使其具备保护其负责的人或物的能力。它们庞大厚实的机身常被部署在重要人物或贵重物品周围，承担护卫职责。

安保机器人遍布工业化星域，在协约世界与维斯卡里姆均有大量部署，企业与普通公民都会使用并定制它们。

尽管大多数士兵机器人型号被设计为尽可能具有破坏性，湮灭机器人（elimination robot）更是专为击杀而生，但安保机器人通常会在其行为程序中设置安全冗余机制，以避免在执行指定安保职能时造成超出必要限度的暴力。这使得它们尤其适用于城市环境（因为意外破坏可能伤及旁观者或引发法律纠纷），甚至适用于星舰（因为偏射的激光可能对关键星舰系统造成严重损害）。

items.name: 内置战术型激光步枪
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

These dependable, mass-produced rifles shoot concentrated beams of energy out of square-shaped barrels. The universal standard Pact Worlds model is highly modifiable and designed to function with a variety of accessories and upgrades, with wielders adapting the laser rifle to their preferences and even kit-bashing it into a nearly unrecognizable weapon.
items.description:
强化： 1

这些可靠的量产步枪从方形枪管射出集中的能量束。协约世界（Pact Worlds）的通用标准型号便于大幅改装，可搭配多种配件与强化模块使用；持用者能依自己的偏好调整激光步枪，甚至混装零件，将其改得几乎面目全非。

items.name: 掩护姿态
items.expectedDescription: The protection-class security robot enters a position that grants adjacent allies the benefits of lesser cover until the start of its next turn. A Medium or smaller creature can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover} while adjacent to the robot and gains the benefits of standard cover.
items.description: 防卫级安保机器人摆出姿势，使相邻盟友获得次等掩蔽的好处，直到其下个回合开始。一个中型或更小生物可以在机器人相邻处@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{寻找掩蔽}，获得标准掩蔽的好处。

items.name: 纳米体激增
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency once per day

Effect The security robot restores @Damage[24[healing]] Hit Points per the robot's level to one technological creature or item.
items.description:
频率 每天一次

效果 安保机器人为一个科技生物或物品恢复生命值，每机器人等级恢复@Damage[24[healing]]生命值。

hYfUp7797H0Ltb3U.name: 蜥掠灵 Skreeling
hYfUp7797H0Ltb3U.publicNotes:
蜥掠灵成群狩猎，以灰烬，金属，木头，甚至几乎一切物质维生。

蜥掠蛸，及其后代蜥掠灵，是潜伏徘徊于宇宙中的岩壁与洞穴的凶残掠食者。

items.name: 群聚攻击
items.expectedDescription: The skreeling's melee Strikes deal 1d4 persistent bleed damage to creatures within reach of one or more other skreelings.
items.description: 蜥掠灵的近战打击对处于一个或更多其他蜥掠灵触及范围内的生物造成1d4持续流血伤害。

ho2J4tE3WRoGMXUa.name: 巨刃霸主 Thresher Lord
ho2J4tE3WRoGMXUa.publicNotes:
作为重型突击部队而设计的巨刃霸主，能撕裂敌军阵型，在防御工事中开辟通道，为大批步兵组件扫清道路。从其前臂伸出的巨大刀刃不仅作为武器进化而来，更在巨刃霸主接近至近战距离时，同时提供空气动力学支撑与少量防护。

虫群由浩界深处一种称为虫族的昆虫状物种发展而来，许多文明认为它是世上最大的威胁。虫群由无数子群组成，每个子群又包含无数组件亚种；这支庞大的群体以心灵联合的方式行动，意图吞噬宇宙中的一切物质。最可怕的是，虫群能够同化被其吞噬者的知识与DNA。由于在大断层之前便已发展出星际旅行技术，虫群在历史中断之前就已经吞噬了无数星系；而在获得信标与名为漂流域的超空间维度后，它们的步伐更是加快了。

被虫群触及的世界会被榨干自然资源，化为称作空壳世界的荒芜之地。外人所谓的“虫群星域”，不过是虫群在肆意进军中吞噬过的一大片死寂世界。虫群将这些世界剥夺得如此彻底，以至于勘探者连稀有矿物和水等无机资源的微量痕迹都难以找到。这些空壳世界很少被彻底探索，因为探索往往会唤醒沉寂的虫群个体。人们推测，它们被留下，是为了应对被吞噬的星系再遭殖民、重新出现居民的情况。远在这片星域之外，也有零星的虫群活动，因为虫群在大断层之前的漫长岁月中派出了无数子群；即使到了今天，也只有部分子群抵达了预定目的地。

在当今时代，虫群最广为人知的或许是两件事。首先，它们对协约世界与维斯卡里姆的进攻，促成了这两大势力停止敌对，并结成脆弱的联盟。其次，虫群是希伦虫人的直系祖先。希伦虫人在大断层期间的某个时候脱离虫群，寻得了神祇海拉丝的庇护。据信，海拉丝由虫群形成之前的虫族进化而来，并背弃了后来演变成贪婪实体的虫群。

近年来，除了在浩界的苏斯基隆星系开展的机密行动之外，虫群并无活动，人们几乎只把它当作遥远的吓人传说。然而，最近人们发现了失踪的桑迪特世界克雷西斯卡，无意间唤醒了曾吞噬这个世界的休眠子群。自此，这个新获名为克雷西斯卡的子群成为了近宇的祸害，正在积极入侵桑迪特联合体的世界，并有蔓延至维斯卡里姆和协约世界等其他势力的趋势。这个被重新发现的子群已开始让其组件快速进化，虽然仍与更广大的虫群隔绝，却已对近宇构成明确威胁。

items.name: 运动感知
items.expectedDescription: A thresher lord can sense nearby creatures through vibrations in air or water caused by movement as an imprecise sense at the listed range.
items.description: 虫群能在所列范围内以模糊感官通过空气或水中因生物移动产生的震动感知附近生物。

items.name: 虫群心智
items.expectedDescription: 30 feet. All allies with colony mind within the listed range of each other are in constant telepathic communication and are aware of all threats any individual knows about. While within range of at least one ally with colony mind, when a creature rolls a success on a save against a mental effect, it gets a critical success instead.
items.description: （灵光） 30尺。所有处于彼此范围内的虫群心智盟友能够进行持续的心灵沟通，并且彼此知道对方察觉到的所有威胁。如果此生物处于至少一个具有虫群心智的盟友的范围内，则其在对抗心灵效果的豁免上掷骰出成功时，改为获得大成功。

items.name: 偏转刀刃
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature adjacent to the thresher lord targets the thresher lord with a melee attack

Effect The thresher lord gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.
items.description:
触发 一个与巨刃霸主相邻的生物以巨刃霸主为目标进行近战攻击

效果 巨刃霸主在对抗触发攻击的AC上获得+2环境加值。

items.name: 刀刃风暴
items.expectedDescription: The thresher lord makes three arm blade Strikes. Each Strike uses the thresher lord's current multiple attack penalty, but each Strike takes a –2 penalty. This counts as three attacks when calculating its multiple attack penalty.
items.description: 巨刃霸主进行三次臂刃打击。每次打击均使用巨刃霸主当前的多重攻击减值，但每次打击额外承受–2减值。在计算多重攻击减值时，此能力计作三次攻击。

items.name: 疾驰
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency three times per day

Effect The thresher lord Strides up to three times its Speed in a straight line.
items.description:
频率 每天三次

效果 巨刃霸主沿直线行走，至多移动自身速度三倍的距离。

items.name: 锯齿刀刃
items.expectedDescription: On a critical hit with an arm blade Strike, the thresher lord inflicts @Damage[1d8[persistent,bleed]] damage to its target.
items.description: 巨刃霸主用臂刃打击造成重击时，会对目标造成@Damage[1d8[persistent,bleed]]伤害。

items.name: 惊骇假面
items.expectedDescription:
The target appears to be a gruesome and terrifying creature. The effect is unique to each observer, so a human viewing the target might see a demon with bloody fangs, but a demon observing the target might see a glowing angelic visage.

When any creature attempts a hostile action against the target, the creature must attempt a Will save. It is then temporarily immune until the end of its next turn.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} before using its action.

Critical Failure The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}, and its action fails and is wasted.

Heightened (8th) You can target up to 5 creatures. If a creature uses a hostile action or reaction that affects multiple targets simultaneously, it needs to attempt only one save against mask of terror.
items.description:
目标看起来变成了可怖而骇人的生物。每位观察者所见的效果各不相同：人类看见目标时，可能看到一个长着血淋淋獠牙的恶魔；恶魔看见目标时，却可能看到一张散发光芒的天使面容。

任何生物尝试对目标采取敌对行动时，该生物必须尝试一次意志豁免。随后其临时免疫此效果，直到其下一回合结束。

成功 生物不受影响。

失败 生物在使用该动作前陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧2}。

大失败 生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧2}，且其动作失败并被浪费。

升阶（8环） 你可以指定至多5个生物为目标。如果生物使用了同时影响多个目标的敌对动作或反应，其只需对惊骇假面尝试一次豁免。

items.name: 支配术
items.expectedDescription:
You take command of the target, forcing it to obey your orders. If you issue an obviously self-destructive order, the target doesn't act until you issue a new order. The effect depends on its Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} as it fights off your commands.

Failure You control the target. It gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled} condition, but it can attempt a Will save at the end of each of its turns. On a success, the spell ends.

Critical Failure As a failure, but the target receives a new save only if you give it a new order that is against its nature, such as killing its allies.

Heightened (10th) The duration is unlimited.
items.description:
你操控目标，强行令其服从你的命令。如果你赋予一项明显是自灭的命令，目标不会行动，直到你下达新的命令。该效果基于其意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 1}以抵抗你的命令。

失败 你控制了目标，其获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{被控制}状态，但在其每个回合结束时可以尝试一次意志豁免。成功时，法术结束。

大失败 如同失败，但是仅当你施加违抗其天性的命令，例如杀害其盟友时，才会获得新的豁免。

升阶（10环） 该持续时间为无限。

items.name: 切割现实
items.expectedDescription:
You slice through reality, forming a chasm of life-draining entropy in a straight line 20 feet high, 120 feet long, and 2 inches thick. The chasm provides cover. The chasm deals 7d8 void damage to each creature that's in the chasm's space when it's created, that attempts to pass through the chasm, or that ends its turn inside the chasm, with a basic Reflex save. A creature that succeeds at this save when the chasm is created is pushed to the nearest space on the side of its choice. Creatures trying to move through the chasm fail to do so if they critically fail the save, ending their movement next to the chasm.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d8.
items.description:
你划破现实，在一条20尺高、120尺长、2英寸厚的直线上形成一道能使生命流失的熵裂隙。裂隙提供掩蔽。裂隙会对在形成时位于其空间内、试图穿过裂隙或在裂隙内结束回合的每个生物造成7d8虚能伤害，具有一次基础反射豁免。如果生物在裂隙形成时豁免成功，则会被推到其选择的一侧最近的空间。试图穿过裂隙的生物如果豁免失败，就会在裂隙旁结束移动。

升阶（+1）伤害增加 1d8。

items.name: 念动绞扼
items.expectedDescription: You telekinetically grasp a creature's throat or similar vital anatomy with a vicelike grip, forcefully lifting it a few inches off the ground as it struggles to breathe. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, you deal 6d12 bludgeoning damage, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}. While immobilized in this way, it must hold its breath or begin suffocating. The first time each round you Sustain the spell, the target takes 1d12 bludgeoning damage, remains immobilized, and must continue holding its breath. The target can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} (the Escape DC is your spell DC, and the attempt is affected by the incapacitation trait).
items.description: 你以精神力量牢牢扼住一个生物的咽喉或者类似重要生理结构，将其提起离地数寸，难以呼吸。尝试一次远程法术攻击对抗目标的AC，在命中时，你造成6d12钝击伤害，并且目标被@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]。当以这种方式被禁足时，目标需要屏住呼吸，否则便会开始窒息（429页）。当你每轮第一次维持该法术时，目标都会再受到1d12持续钝击伤害并保持禁足，并需要继续屏住呼吸。目标可以尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]（逃脱DC为你的法术DC，并且逃脱的尝试会受到失能特征的影响）。

items.name: 幽影爆破
items.expectedDescription:
Area varies

Defense @Check[reflex|basic|options:area-effect] or @Check[will|basic|options:area-effect] (target's choice)

You shape the shadow substance of the Netherworld into a blast. Choose @Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[acid]|options:area-damage], @Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage], @Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[cold]|options:area-damage], @Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[electricity]|options:area-damage], @Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[fire]|options:area-damage], @Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[force]|options:area-damage], @Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[piercing]|options:area-damage], @Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[slashing]|options:area-damage], @Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[sonic]|options:area-damage], or @Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[spirit]|options:area-damage] damage, and choose a @Template[cone|distance:30], a @Template[burst|distance:15] within 120 feet, or a @Template[line|distance:50]. The blast deals 6d8 damage of the type you chose to each creature in the area.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d8.
items.description:
区域 可变

防御 @Check[reflex|basic|options:area-effect]或@Check[will|basic|options:area-effect]（由目标选择）

你利用影界的幽影物质创造一团爆炸。选择@Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[acid]|options:area-damage]，@Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage]，@Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[cold]|options:area-damage]，@Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[electricity]|options:area-damage]，@Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[fire]|options:area-damage]，@Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[force]|options:area-damage]，@Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[piercing]|options:area-damage]，@Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[slashing]|options:area-damage]，@Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[sonic]|options:area-damage]或@Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[spirit]|options:area-damage]伤害，然后选择@Template[cone|distance:30]，120尺内的@Template[burst|distance:15]或@Template[line|distance:50]。该爆炸对该区域中的每个生物造成6d8你所选择类型的伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d8

items.name: 深层暗示
items.expectedDescription:
You implant a subconscious suggestion deep within the target's mind for them to follow when a trigger you specify occurs. You suggest a course of action to the target. Your directive must be phrased in such a way as to seem like a logical course of action to the target, and it can't be self-destructive or obviously against the target's self-interest. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and knows you tried to control it.

Success The target is unaffected and thinks you were talking to them normally, not casting a spell on them.

Failure The suggestion remains in the target's subconscious until the next time you prepare. If the trigger occurs before then, the target immediately follows your suggestion. The effect has a duration of 1 minute, or until the target has completed a finite suggestion or the suggestion becomes self-destructive or has other obvious negative effects.

Critical Failure As failure, but the duration is 1 hour.

Heightened (9th) You can target up to 10 creatures.
items.description:
你在目标的心智深处埋下潜意识的暗示，它们会在你指定的触发条件发生时遵照其行动。你向目标指示一系列动作。你的指示的用语对目标而言必须是一系列合理的动作，并且它不可以招致自毁或者明显违背目标自身利益。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响，并且知道你尝试控制它。

成功 目标不受影响，并且认为你在和它们正常对话，而不是对其施放法术。

失败 指示会保留在目标潜意识中，直到下一次你每日准备。如果触发条件在那之前发生，目标会立即按照你的指示行动。该效果的持续时间为1分钟，或者直到目标完成一个有终点的指示，或者直到指示变得会招致自毁，或具有其他明显的负面效果。

大失败 如同失败，但该持续时间为1小时。

升阶（9环） 你能以至多10个生物作为目标。

items.name: 怪异怒火
items.expectedDescription:
You channel the bizarre powers that exist beyond the outer reaches of the universe, dealing 3d12 mental damage to each creature in the area as phantasmal claws, jaws, and tentacles lash out at each target. Each creature in the area must attempt a Will save. The area is difficult terrain for any creature sickened by the effects of this spell.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d12.
items.description:
你引导存在于宇宙外缘之外的怪异力量，幻影利爪、巨颚与触须鞭打每个目标，对区域内每个生物造成3d12心灵伤害。区域内每个生物都必须尝试意志豁免。对因本法术效果陷入恶心的任何生物而言，该区域为困难地形。

大成功 生物不受影响。

成功 生物受到一半伤害。

失败 该生物受到全部伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心 1}。

大失败 生物受到双倍伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心2}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d12。

items.name: 岁月重担
items.expectedDescription:
You burden a creature's body and mind with the pains and sorrows of a lifetime. The target takes 3d8 bludgeoning damage and 3d8 mental damage and must attempt a Will saving throw.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]{Encumbered} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage and is encumbered for 1 minute.

Heightened (+1) The mental damage increases by 2d8.
items.description:
你将目标毕生的苦痛与哀伤化作沉重枷锁，压垮目标的身心。尝试一次远程法术攻击骰。目标受到3d8钝击伤害和3d8心灵，并且必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功目标不受影响。

成功目标受到一半伤害。

失败目标受到全伤害并且@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]1轮。

大失败目标受到全伤害并且超载1分钟。

升阶（+1）心灵伤害增加2d8

items.name: 熵击
items.expectedDescription:
You unleash a ray of entropy that rapidly and indiscriminately decays matter. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, the target takes 5d8 void damage, or it takes 2d6 persistent acid damage and is glitching 1 if it has the tech trait. On a critical hit, double the damage, and if the creature has the tech trait, it's glitching 2 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1 die.
items.description:
你释放一道熵射线，迅速且不加区分地使物质衰败。对目标的AC进行一次远程法术攻击。命中时，目标受到5d8虚能伤害；若目标具有科技特征，则改为受到2d6持续酸蚀伤害，并陷入故障1。重击时，伤害翻倍；若该生物具有科技特征，则还会陷入故障2和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑1}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1个伤害骰。

items.name: 血族盛宴
items.expectedDescription:
Your touch leeches the lifeblood out of a target to empower yourself. You deal 6d6 void damage to the target. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to half the void damage the target takes (after applying resistances and the like). You lose any remaining temporary Hit Points after 1 minute.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.
items.description:
你的接触从目标身上抽出生命之血，以强化自身。你对目标造成6d6虚能伤害。你获得等于目标承受的虚能伤害（在抗力及类似效果生效后）一半的临时生命值。你在1分钟后失去任何剩余的临时生命值。

升阶（+1） 该伤害增加2d6。

items.name: 黑暗术
items.expectedDescription:
You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.
items.description:
你创造一片黑暗的帷幕，光线无法穿透，并且光源无法在区域中发光。光线无法进入该区域，并且任何非魔法光源，例如火炬或者提灯，在区域中不会发出任何光线，即使其光照可能到达黑暗术之外也是如此。这也会压制等于或低于你的黑暗术环阶的魔法光亮。光线无法穿透，所以在区域中的生物无法看到外面。对于外面，这看起来如同一团纯粹黑暗的球。

升阶（4环） 即使具有黑暗视觉的生物（但不包括高等黑暗视觉）也几乎无法看穿这黑暗。它们透过黑暗看到的目标视为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。

items.name: 解除魔法
items.expectedDescription: You unravel the magic behind a spell or effect. Attempt a counteract check against the target. If you successfully counteract a magic item, the item becomes a mundane item of its type for 10 minutes. This doesn't change the item's non-magical properties. If the target is an artifact or similar item, you automatically fail.
items.description: 你干扰法术或者效果中的魔法力量。尝试一次反制检定，对抗目标。如果你成功对抗一个魔法物品，该物品成为该类型的普通物品，持续10分钟。这不会改变物体的非魔法性质。如果目标是一件神器或者类似的物品，你自动失败。

items.name: 隐形术
items.expectedDescription:
Illusions bend light around the target, rendering it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.
items.description:
扭曲光线的幻觉包覆目标，令其变得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}。这令该生物对所有生物 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{无踪} ，但生物可以尝试寻找目标，令其改为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{藏匿}。如果目标使用敌对动作，法术在敌对动作完成后结束。

升阶（4环） 该法术持续1分钟，但目标使用敌对动作时该法术不会结束。

items.name: 抵抗能量伤害
items.expectedDescription:
A shield of elemental energy protects a creature against one type of energy damage. Choose acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage. The target and its gear gain resistance 5 against the damage type you chose.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.con2Hzt47JjpuUej]{Spell Effect: Resist Energy}

Heightened (4th) The resistance increases to 10, and you can target up to two creatures.

Heightened (7th) The resistance increases to 15, and you can target up to five creatures.
items.description:
元素护盾保护一个生物免受某一种类型能量的伤害。选择酸蚀，寒冷，电击，火焰或者音波伤害。目标和其装备获得对你所选择伤害类型的抗力5。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.con2Hzt47JjpuUej]{法术效果：抵抗能量伤害}

升阶（4环） 该抗力增加到10，并且你能以至多两个生物为目标。

升阶（7环） 该抗力增加到15，并且你能以至多五个生物为目标。

items.name: 分析目标
items.expectedDescription:
You focus on the target, gathering data as magical holograms display information. When the casting is complete, you learn biometric information about the target, including its fingerprints, medical conditions, and other basic physiological information. You or anyone you advise about the analysis gains a +1 status bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} the creature, to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} on the creature, and to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about it. If the target is illusory or under the effects of illusion magic, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your analyze target spell.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

Heightened (3rd) The status bonus increases to +2, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Heightened (6th) The status bonus increases to +3, and you can target any number of creatures.
items.description:
你专注在目标身上，收集数据并以魔法全息图像显示。当施法完成，你会获得目标的所有生物特征信息，包括指纹、医疗状况和其他基本生理信息。你或任何得到你基于分析建议的人，在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]为该生物、对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]、以及对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]的检定上获得+1状态加值。如果目标是幻觉或者处于幻术魔法效果下，仅当效果的环级低于你分析目标的法术环级，你才能够探测到结果。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

升阶（3环）状态加值提升到+2，并且你可以至多10名生物作为目标。

升阶（6环）状态加值提升到+3，并且你可以任意名生物作为目标。

items.name: 侦测魔法
items.expectedDescription:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).
items.description:
你发出一股标记魔法存在的脉冲。你不会获得魔法存在或不存在以外的任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你或者你盟友的魔法物品以及持续法术。仅当幻术魔法的环阶低于你的侦测魔法环阶时，你才能侦测幻术魔法。但是，具有幻术灵光但是没有在外表上做伪装的物品（例如一瓶隐形药水），通常能够正常侦测。

升阶（3环阶） 你能知晓法术侦测出的最强魔法效果的环阶或等级，具体由GM决定。

升阶（4环阶） 如3环阶，你也能指出最高环阶魔法的来源。如同一种模糊感官，你不会了解具体的位置，但是可以将来源锁定到5尺立方（或者最近的那个五尺立方，如果来源体积比这个区域更大）。

items.name: 衰弱术
items.expectedDescription:
You sap the target's strength, depending on its Fortitude save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the start of your next turn.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3} for 1 minute.
items.description:
你抽走目标的力量，基于其强韧豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭 1}，直到你的下个回合开始。

失败 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭 2}，持续1分钟。

大失败 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭 3}，持续1分钟

items.name: 力场飞弹
items.expectedDescription:
You fire a shard of solidified magic toward a creature that you can see. It automatically hits and deals 1d4+1 force damage. For each additional action you use when Casting the Spell, increase the number of shards you shoot by one, to a maximum of three shards for 3 actions. You choose the target for each shard individually. If you shoot more than one shard at the same target, combine the damage before applying bonuses or penalties to damage, resistances, weaknesses, and so forth.

Heightened (+2) You fire one additional shard with each action you spend.
items.description:
你发射出一道固态的魔力碎片，射向一个你能看见的生物。它自动命中，并造成1d4+1力场伤害。你施放该法术时每额外使用一个动作，你射出的碎片增加一个，最大为3个动作发射三个碎片。你为每个碎片分别选择目标。如果你对同一个目标射击超过1个碎片，将伤害合计后再计算伤害加值，减值，抗力，弱点等。

升阶（+2） 你花费的每个动作额外射出一枚碎片。

items.name: 传讯术
items.expectedDescription:
You mouth words quietly, but instead of coming out of your mouth, they're transferred directly to the ears of the target. While others can't hear your words any better than if you normally mouthed them, the target can hear your words as if they were standing next to you. The target can give a brief response as a reaction, or as a free action on their next turn if they wish, but they must be able to see you and be within range to do so. If they respond, their response is delivered directly to your ear, just like the original message.

Heightened (3rd) The spell's range increases to 500 feet.
items.description:
你无声地念出言语，这段言语会直接送到目标耳中，而不是从你的嘴中念出。其他人只能像平常看你无声地动嘴一样，无法更清楚地听到这些话，但法术目标会如同正站在你身边一般听到你的言语。目标可以通过一个反应动作做出一段简要回应，或者根据其意愿，也可以通过其下个回合的自由动作来回应，但它如此做时必须能看见你，并且在射程内。如果它做出回应，它的回应会直接送达你的耳中，如同最初的信息一般。

升阶（3环） 法术的射程增加到500尺。

items.name: 心灵穿刺
items.expectedDescription:
You overload a creature's mind with a glut of psychic information or divine judgments. The mental onslaught deals 2d6 mental damage. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.
items.description:
你以海量心灵信息或神圣审判冲击一个生物的心智。这股精神猛攻造成2d6心灵伤害。大失败时，目标还会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞2}，持续1轮。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加2d6。

items.name: 护盾术
items.expectedDescription:
You raise a magical shield of force. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction with your magic shield. The shield has Hardness 5. You can use the spell's reaction to reduce damage from any spell or magical effect, even if it doesn't deal physical damage. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity}

Heightened (+2) The shield's Hardness increases by 5.
items.description:
你举起一面力场构成的魔法护盾。这视同你使用了举盾动作，赋予你在AC上的+1环境加值，直到你的下个回合开始，且无需用手持握。

当该法术生效时，你可以使用你的魔法护盾来进行 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{盾牌格挡}反应动作。该盾牌具有硬度5。你可以使用该法术的反应动作来减少任何来自法术或者魔法效果的伤害，即使这不造成物理伤害。在你使用盾牌格挡后，该法术结束，并且你无法在10分钟内再次施放它。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{法术效果：护盾术}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{效果：护盾术免疫}

升阶（+2） 该盾牌的硬度增加5。

items.name: 召唤亡灵
items.expectedDescription:
You summon a creature that has the undead trait and whose level is -1 to fight for you.

Heightened As listed in the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.journals.JournalEntry.S55aqwWIzpQRFhcq.JournalEntryPage.8gcp880pEWZ9VPnF]{summon} trait.
items.description:
你召唤一个具有不死特征、等级为-1的生物为你战斗。

升阶 如@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.journals.JournalEntry.S55aqwWIzpQRFhcq.JournalEntryPage.8gcp880pEWZ9VPnF]{召唤}特征所列。

items.name: 虚能噬
items.expectedDescription:
You call upon the Void to harm life force. The target takes 2d4 void damage with a basic Fortitude save. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the start of your next turn.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.
items.description:
你召唤虚空之力以伤害生命力。该目标承受2d4虚能伤害，这有一次基础强韧豁免。 如果该生物在豁免中大失败，它还会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭 1}直至你的下回合开始。

升阶（+1） 该伤害增加1d4。

items.name: 折磨杖
items.expectedDescription: Necrovites often craft and wield a horrific weapon known as a wrackstaff. In the hands of any creature other than its maker, a wrackstaff is a nonmagical club with no value.
items.description: 死灵妖经常制作并持用一种名为折磨杖的可怕武器。在制作者以外的任何生物手中，折磨杖都只是一根毫无价值的非魔法木棒。

items.name: 抬升万古石
items.expectedDescription:
Staple items within the Azlanti Star Empire, these gemstones are popular status symbols for adventurers and wealthy collectors. Despite their myriad forms and functions, these stones are purportedly all fragments of crystal tools used by otherworldly entities to build the Universe in ancient times.

When you invest one of these precisely shaped crystals, the stone orbits your head (or another visible part of your anatomy if you don't have a head) instead of being worn on your body. You can stow an aeon stone with an Interact action, and an orbiting stone can be snatched out of the air with a successful @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} action against you. A stowed or removed stone remains invested, but its effects are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF] until you return it to orbit your head again.

There are various types of aeon stones, each with a different appearance and magical effect. Each aeon stone also gains a resonant power when slotted into specific items, such as weapons with the aeon trait or antique magical devices called wayfinders.

This deep-blue prism with cloudy inclusions is light as a feather. Its resonant power gives you a +1 item bonus to Acrobatics checks.

Activate—Fly Free 1 (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You gain a fly Speed for 1 minute equal to your Speed or 20 feet, whichever is greater.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment-effects.Item.xZ5XMY55S42aGyjg]
items.description:
这些宝石是阿兹兰特星际帝国（Azlanti Star Empire）的常见物品，也是冒险者和富裕收藏家青睐的身份象征。尽管外形和功能多种多样，据说这些石头全都是异界存在在远古时代建造物质宇宙（Universe）时使用的水晶工具的碎片。

当你绑定其中一颗精确切割的水晶时，石头不会戴在身上，而会环绕头部运转（若你没有头部，则环绕身体另一处可见部位）。你可以收起一颗 万古石 ，使用一个交互动作；正在环绕的石头也能被从空中夺走，只需成功进行一次 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{卸武} 动作，以你为目标。收起或取下的石头仍保持绑定，但其效果 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF] ，直到你让它再次环绕头部。

有多种类型的 万古石，每种都有不同外观和魔法效果。每个 万古石 插入特定物品后还会获得共鸣能力，例如具有万古特征的武器，或名为以下名称的古老魔法装置： 寻路石.

这块含有云雾状杂质的深蓝色棱柱轻如羽毛。其共鸣能力为你的特技检定提供+1物品加值。

启动—自由飞翔 1 （专注）

频率 每天一次

效果 你获得等于自身速度或20尺（取较高者）的飞行速度，持续1分钟。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment-effects.Item.xZ5XMY55S42aGyjg]

items.name: 清神醒脑
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger The necrovite is targeted by a spell with the emotion trait

Effect The necrovite attempts to counteract the triggering spell (counteract rank 7, counteract modifier [[/r 1d20+30 #Counteract]]{+30}). If the spell is disrupted, the necrovite gains temporary Hit Points equal to twice the rank of the counteracted spell that last for 1 minute.
items.description:
触发死灵妖成为一个具有情绪特征的法术的目标

效果死灵妖尝试反制触发的法术（反制环级7，反制调整值[[/r 1d20+30 #Counteract]]{+30}）。如果该法术被打断，死灵妖获得等于被反制法术环级两倍的临时生命值，持续1分钟。

items.name: 疲乏威压
items.expectedDescription: 30 feet. A creature that first enters the aura must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:33] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}. Regardless of the result of the saving throw, the creature is temporarily immune to the necrovite's fatiguing presence for 24 hours.
items.description: 30尺。首次进入此灵光的生物必须通过一次@Check[fortitude|dc:33]豁免，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{疲乏}。无论豁免结果如何，该生物都会对死灵妖的疲乏威压暂时免疫24小时。

items.name: 虚能治疗
items.expectedDescription: @Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.NegativeHealing]
items.description: @Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.NegativeHealing]

items.name: 熵能之触
items.expectedDescription: Void damage dealt by a necrovite damages undead and creatures with void healing as if it were vitality damage. A necrovite's melee Strikes have the benefits of the ghost killer upgrade on attacks against incorporeal undead.
items.description: 死灵妖造成的虚能伤害会像命能伤害一样，伤害不死生物和具有虚能治疗的生物。在攻击虚体不死生物时，死灵妖的近战打击享有灭鬼强化的好处。

items.name: 痛苦印记
items.expectedDescription: When the necrovite damages a living creature with its wrackstaff, the creature must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:33] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}. Further wrackstaff damage increases the drain value by 1 on a failed save, to a maximum of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 4}.
items.description: 死灵妖用破坏之杖对一个活物造成伤害时，该生物必须成功通过@Check[fortitude|dc:33]豁免，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失1}。再次受到破坏之杖的伤害时，豁免失败会使其流失值增加1，至多为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失4}。

items.name: 复生
items.expectedDescription: When a necrovite is destroyed, their consciousness is immediately transferred to their electroencephalon. A necrovite can be permanently destroyed only if their electroencephalon is found and destroyed.
items.description: 死灵妖被摧毁时，其意识会立即转移到脑波仪中。只有找到并摧毁其脑波仪，才能永久摧毁死灵妖。

items.name: 扰乱心智
items.expectedDescription: The necrovite touches an adjacent creature and scrambles its thought patterns. The creature must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:33] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 minute. The necrovite is considered hidden to the confused target for as long as the confusion lasts.
items.description: 死灵妖触碰一个相邻生物，扰乱它的思维模式。该生物必须通过一次@Check[will|dc:33]豁免，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{困惑}，持续1分钟。只要困惑仍持续，死灵妖就视为对该困惑目标处于藏匿状态。

cnText_system_details_languages_details.text: 萨瑟蝶语，心灵感应30尺（第210页）

i9GoDnoskQ5QZEgJ.name: 珊瑚怪 Coposirix
i9GoDnoskQ5QZEgJ.publicNotes: 小塔布里德的快速且鲁莽的工业化摧毁了这颗星球，尤其是严重破坏了科皮珊瑚（copi）——一种珊瑚，它是当地珊瑚人（copaxi）祖先的栖息地。然而，在科皮珊瑚与重力之间的魔法联系最强的区域，无处不在的污染反而将其变异成了怪异的新形态。在对珊瑚人进化的扭曲模仿中，成群的科皮珊瑚融合在一起，形成了珊瑚怪，一种由变异的科皮珊瑚与部分结晶垃圾形成的外壳融合而成的蹒跚巨物，它在移动时会发出嘎吱嘎吱的声响。珊瑚怪的形态不断变化，有时甚至会呈现出令人不安的类人特征，但这些特征很快又会消失。

items.name: 渗入
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger The coposirix takes damage

Effect The coposirix's body absorbs some of what damaged it until the end of its next turn, the material seeping into its constituent copi and changing its composition. The effects of this change depends on the nature of the damage.

  • Energy Damage The coposirix's attacks deal an additional 2d6 damage of the same type as the energy damage dealt to it.

  • Physical Damage The coposirix gains resistance 6 to physical damage. If the damage was dealt by a weapon made of a special material, such as silver, the coposirix's battering sludge Strike counts as that same material for the duration of the effect.
items.description:
触发 珊瑚怪受到伤害

效果 珊瑚怪的身体吸收一部分对其造成伤害的物质，直到其下一回合结束；物质渗入构成其身体的科皮珊瑚，并改变其成分。这种变化的效果取决于伤害的性质。

  • 能量伤害 珊瑚怪的攻击额外造成2d6伤害，类型与其受到的能量伤害相同。

  • 物理伤害 珊瑚怪获得物理伤害抗力6。如果伤害由某种特殊材料（例如银）制成的武器造成，珊瑚怪的猛击污泥打击在效果持续时间内视为相同材料。

items.name: 坠落冲击
items.expectedDescription:
The coposirix bends gravity around itself, causing it to fall toward its target. The coposirix Strides up to twice its Speed in a straight line in any direction. If it ends this movement within melee reach of at least one enemy, it can make a battering sludge Strike against that target. After this attack, the coposirix falls if it isn't on a solid surface, taking half the normal amount of damage for the distance fallen and not falling @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. If the coposirix passes within 10 feet of another creature at any point during this movement, that creature is affected by the fluctuating gravity and must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:25] save.

Critical Success The creature can use the fluctuating gravity to its advantage to reposition itself. It can Step as a free action.

Success No effect.

Failure The creature is pulled 5 feet in the direction of the coposirix's travel. This follows the rules for forced movement. If at the end of this movement the creature is unsupported, it falls and lands prone, taking fall damage as normal.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature is pulled 10 feet and falls prone even if supported.
items.description:
珊瑚怪扭曲周围的重力，使自身朝目标坠落。珊瑚怪沿任意方向直线行走至多两倍于其速度的距离。如果此次移动结束时，其处于至少一个敌人的近战触及内，它可以对该目标进行一次猛击污泥打击。此次攻击后，若珊瑚怪未处于坚实表面上，它便会坠落，受到该坠落距离正常伤害的一半，且不会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}。如果珊瑚怪在此次移动中的任何时刻经过另一个生物的10尺内，该生物便会受到波动重力的影响，必须尝试一次@Check[reflex|dc:25]豁免。

大成功 生物可以利用波动重力重新调整位置。其可以用一个自由动作快步。

成功 无效果。

失败 生物沿珊瑚怪的移动方向被拉动5尺。这遵循强迫移动规则。如果此次移动结束时生物无所支撑，其便会坠落并在着地时倒地，如常受到坠落伤害。

大失败 如同失败，但生物被拉动10尺，且即使有所支撑也会倒地。

cnText_system_details_languages_details.text: 珊瑚语，无法说任何语言

items.name: 虫群覆盖
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger The dragon critically fails a saving throw

Effect Swarming insects interfere with the effect, sacrificing themselves to protect their host's body and mind. The dragon attempts a @Check[flat|dc:17]. On a success, the dragon fails the saving throw instead of critically failing.
items.description:
触发 龙的豁免大失败

效果 成群昆虫干扰此效果，牺牲自身来保护宿主的身体与心智。龙尝试一次@Check[flat|dc:17]。成功时，龙的该次豁免由大失败变为失败。

items.name: 恐怖威压
items.expectedDescription:
90 feet. @Check[will|dc:25|options:area-effect,inflicts:frightened]

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.FrightfulPresence]
items.description:
90尺，@Check[will|dc:25|options:area-effect,inflicts:frightened]

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.FrightfulPresence]

items.expectedName: +2 status to all saves vs. mental
items.name: 对抗心灵的所有豁免获得+2状态加值
龙之狂怒
items.expectedDescription: The dragon makes two claw Strikes and one tail Strike in any order.
items.description: 龙按任意顺序进行两次爪部打击和一次尾部打击。

items.name: 龙之威势
items.expectedDescription: The dragon recharges their Swarm Breath whenever they score a critical hit with a Strike.
items.description: 每当龙的打击重击时，它便为虫群吐息重新充能。

items.name: 剧痛咬击
items.expectedDescription: A creature that takes damage from a host dragon's jaws Strike or is swallowed by the dragon is also bitten by hundreds of tiny insects; the creature must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:25] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 round.
items.description: 受到宿主龙颚部打击伤害或被龙吞下的生物，还会被数百只小昆虫叮咬；该生物必须通过一次@Check[fortitude|dc:25]豁免，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭1}，持续1轮。

items.name: 虫群共生
items.expectedDescription: The host dragon is immune to any attack made by a swarm of insects or similar creature (at the GM's discretion).
items.description: 宿主龙免疫昆虫集群或类似生物（由GM裁定）发动的一切攻击。

items.name: 活吞
items.expectedDescription:
Medium, @Damage[(2d10+6)[bludgeoning]] plus excruciating bites, Rupture 19

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.SwallowWhole]
items.description:
中型, @Damage[(2d10+6)[bludgeoning]] 加剧痛咬击, 破体 19

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.SwallowWhole]

items.name: 虫群吐息
items.expectedDescription: The dragon disgorges a swarm of biting insects that deals @Damage[6d8[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage in a @Template[type:cone|distance:30] (@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic] save). They can't use Swarm Breath again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Swarm Breath]]{1d4 rounds}.
items.description: 龙吐出一群叮咬的昆虫，造成@Damage[6d8[piercing]|options:area-damage]伤害，范围为@Template[type:cone|distance:30]（@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic]豁免）。之后[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Swarm Breath]]{1d4轮}内无法再次使用虫群吐息。

iqCDCDG4iucvV107.name: 青年宿主龙 Host Dragon (Young)
iqCDCDG4iucvV107.publicNotes: 无论这些行动迟缓、贪食的巨龙漫游至何处，都有数不胜数的昆虫尾随其后，它们在宿主龙周围蜂拥而至，栖息于宿主龙身体上无数的孔洞之中。宿主龙既是虫群本身的一部分，也是虫群生态的一部分——虫群以它们的身体为食，而龙又以虫群为食；在这一可怖且延续数百年的循环中，即便宿主龙一生未曾摄取任何其他物质，也仍会不断变得更加庞大、更加强大。宿主龙从昆虫的原始本能中汲取力量，尽管它们拥有智慧，却常常表现得像那些聚集在它们身边的昆虫一样。宿主龙厌恶回答问题，并会以激烈手段抗拒他人对其本性的任何探究。

iuovM4PRyAX0NwvI.name: 地狱骑士崩解使 Hellknight Degradant
iuovM4PRyAX0NwvI.publicNotes:
地狱骑士往往研习地狱之力，从中汲取战斗风格与魔法的灵感；但他们也可能学习调谐宇宙的力量，成为恒星武士。

地狱骑士是炼狱的骑士，他们曾经统治过失落的格拉利昂上整个国家，协约世界的地狱骑士则更全面地维护律法与秩序，他们乘坐着巨大的城堡舰四处游走以扩大影响力，而非固守一处。在战斗中，地狱骑士纪律严明、毫不留情且致命无比。

items.name: 裂爪兽革甲
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

Made from the hide of a ferocious mammal native to Vesk-2, this medium armor is especially popular among vesk. Tanned slabs of the creature's thick hide are stitched together with metal wires, and the joints are reinforced with metal studs or scales.
items.description:
强化： 1

这种中甲由维斯克-2原生凶猛哺乳动物的皮革制成，在维斯克蜥人中格外流行。生物厚实的皮革经鞣制后，以金属线缝合，接合处则以金属铆钉或鳞片加固。

items.name: 反应打击
items.expectedDescription: @Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ReactiveStrike]
items.description: @Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ReactiveStrike]

items.name: 黑洞
items.expectedDescription:
The degradant deals @Damage[9d6[bludgeoning]] damage to each enemy creature within 30 feet with a @Check[fortitude|dc:26] save. The degradant can't use Black Hole again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Black Hole]]{1d4 rounds}.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and is pulled 5 feet toward the degradant.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is pulled 10 feet toward the degradant.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is pulled 30 feet toward the degradant, and is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.
items.description:
崩解使造成@Damage[9d6[bludgeoning]]伤害，影响30尺内每个敌对生物，各生物进行一次@Check[fortitude|dc:26]豁免。崩解使在[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Black Hole]]{1d4轮}内无法再次使用黑洞。

大成功 生物不受影响。

成功 生物受到一半伤害，并被朝崩解使拉近5尺。

失败 生物受到全额伤害，并被朝崩解使拉近10尺。

大失败 生物受到双倍伤害，被朝崩解使拉近30尺，并被击倒而陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}。

items.name: 重压
items.expectedDescription: The degradant uses gravity to crush an enemy within 100 feet, dealing @Damage[4d6[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:26|basic] save); on a critical failure, the creature takes an additional @Damage[1d6[persistent,bleed]] damage.
items.description: 崩解使使用引力碾压100尺内的一个敌人，造成@Damage[4d6[bludgeoning]]伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:26|basic]豁免）；大失败时，该生物额外受到@Damage[1d6[persistent,bleed]]伤害。

items.name: 引力子大砍刀
items.expectedDescription: A degradant wields a solar glaive formed of solidified gravitons. They can conjure and dismiss this weapon as a single action that has the concentrate trait. Whenever they successfully Strike a creature using their graviton glaive, the creature treats all squares adjacent to the square in which it was struck as difficult terrain until the end of the creature's next turn.
items.description: 崩解使持用一把由固化引力子组成的恒星大砍刀。他可以用一个具有专注特征的单动作来召唤或解消此武器。当他用自己的引力子大砍刀成功打击一个生物时，该生物将自己被击中时所处方格相邻的所有方格视作困难地形直到该生物的下个回合结束。

items.name: 星辰冲刺
items.expectedDescription: The degradant Strides twice, gaining a +10-foot circumstance bonus to their Speed during these moves. When they complete these Strides, all enemies within 15 feet of the degradant are pulled 15 feet closer to the degradant unless they succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:26] save.
items.description: 崩解使行走两次，在这些移动中，速度获得+10尺环境加值。完成这两次行走时，崩解使15尺内的所有敌人都会被向它拉近15尺，除非通过一次@Check[fortitude|dc:26]豁免。

items.expectedName: Interplanar Teleport (at will; self only; to and from Akashic Record and the Universe only)
items.name: 跨界传送（随意；仅自身；只能往返于阿卡西记录与物质宇宙）
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements You have a planar key for the destination plane, used as a locus

You and your allies traverse the barriers between planes of existence. The targets move to another plane, such as the Plane of Fire, the Netherworld, or the Outer Rifts. You must know the destination plane exists and use a magic planar key created from material from that plane as a locus for the spell. While the planar keys for most prominent planes are uncommon, just like the spell interplanar teleport, more obscure planes and demiplanes often have rare or possibly even unique planar keys.

The spell is highly imprecise, and you appear 1d20×25 miles from the last place one of the targets (of your choice) was located the last time that target traveled to the plane. If it's the first time traveling to a particular plane for all targets, you appear at a random location on the plane. Interplanar teleport doesn't provide a means of return travel, though casting interplanar teleport again allows you to return to your previous plane unless there are extenuating circumstances.
items.description:
需求 你持有目的地位面的位面密钥，用作施法载体

你和你的盟友跨越位面之间的屏障进行旅行。目标移动至其他位面，比如火元素位面、幽界、或者外层裂隙。你必须知晓目标位面的存在，而且需要使用由该位面的物质制作的魔法位面密钥作为本法术的施法载体。就如同跨界传送这个法术本身一样，大多数著名位面的位面密钥具有罕见稀有度，而鲜为人知的位面及半位面通常具有稀有、甚至有可能具有独特稀有度的位面密钥。

该法术极其不精准，你会出现在目标之一（由你选择）上一次造访该位面时的位置周边，误差为1d20×25里。若所有目标都是初次造访某个特定位面，你们就会出现在该位面的随机位置。跨界传送不会提供返回的手段，不过除非发生了什么另外情况，否则再次施放跨界传送能让你返回自身之前身处的位面。

items.name: 真景术
items.expectedDescription: You see things within 60 feet as they actually are. The GM rolls a secret counteract check against any illusion, morph or polymorph effect in the area, but only for the purpose of determining whether you see through it (for instance, if the check succeeds against a polymorph spell, you can see the creature's true form, but you don't end the polymorph spell).
items.description: 你可以看见60尺内的事物的本来面貌。GM秘密进行一次反制检定，对抗区域中的所有幻术、形变或变形效应，但这只会决定你是否能看破它（例如，如果该检定成功对抗了一个变形法术，你可以看见该生物的本来形态，但你不会结束该变形法术）。

items.name: 鹰眼术
items.expectedDescription: You create an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} floating eye at a location within range (even if it's outside your line of sight or line of effect). The eye can't move, but you can see in all directions from that point as if using your normal visual senses.
items.description: 你在射程内创造出一个@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}的悬浮眼睛（它甚至可以在你的视觉线或者效果线之外）。这只眼睛不能移动，但是你可以从该处看到所有方向，如同使用你通常的视觉感官。

items.name: 困惑术
items.expectedDescription:
You befuddle your target with strange impulses, causing it to act randomly. The effects are determined by the target's Will save. You can Dismiss the spell.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target babbles incoherently and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 minute. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns to end the confusion.

Critical Failure The target is Confused for 1 minute, with no save to end early.

Heightened (8th) You can target up to 10 creatures.
items.description:
你以奇异的冲动扰乱目标心智，使其随机行动。法术效果由目标的意志豁免决定。你可以解消该法术。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标胡言乱语，并且获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 1}。

失败 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{困惑}1分钟。在其每个回合结束，它能尝试一次新豁免来结束困惑术。

大失败 目标困惑1分钟，并且没有提前结束的豁免。

升阶（8环阶） 你能以至多10个生物为目标。

items.name: 读心术
items.expectedDescription:
With a cursory mental touch, you attempt to read the target's mind. It must attempt a Will save. The target then becomes temporarily immune to your mind reading for 1 hour.

Critical Success The target perceives vague surface thoughts from you when you Cast the Spell.

Success You find out whether the target's Intelligence modifier is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Failure You perceive vague surface thoughts from the target when you Cast the Spell, and you find out whether its Intelligence is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Critical Failure As failure, and for the duration of the spell, you can Sustain the spell to detect the target's surface thoughts again. The target doesn't receive any additional saves.
items.description:
你通过一次短暂的心灵接触来尝试阅读目标的想法。它必须尝试一次意志豁免。目标会临时免疫你的读心术1小时。

大成功 目标感知到你施放法术时模糊的表层思想。

成功 你得知目标的智力调整值是高于，等于，还是低于你。

失败 你感知到施放法术时目标模糊的表层思想，并且你得知目标的智力是高于，等于，还是低于你。

大失败 如失败，并且在法术持续时间中，你可以维持该法术来再次侦测目标的表层想法。目标不会获得另外的豁免。

items.expectedDescription:
You execute a psychic search of the Akashic Record for information about a specific topic and magically transfer this data to your comm unit or computer. When you Cast this Spell, choose any skill in which you're trained that has the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} action.

Any time during the duration, you can consult your comm unit while attempting a Recall Knowledge check using your chosen skill. This check gains a +1 status bonus. Checking your comm unit is part of the action to Recall Knowledge. You must be holding the comm unit to do so. The comm unit instantly compiles and displays snippets and selections from various media relevant to the topic, which grants you the bonus. If you roll a critical failure on this check, you get a failure instead. If the check is successful and the subject is a creature, you gain additional information or context about the creature. Once you reference the comm unit, the spell ends. When the spell ends, your access to the Akashic Record ends, and all the information you downloaded returns to the Akashic Record.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.h1i8c47U0IOrMrHJ]

Heightened (3rd) You can reference your comm unit three times before the spell ends.
items.description:
你通过灵能搜索阿卡西记录，获取特定主题的信息，并将数据魔法传输至通讯单元或计算机。施放此法术时，选择任何你至少为受训熟练度且能进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]动作的技能。

在持续时间内的任何时候，你都可以在使用所选技能进行回忆知识检定时查询通讯单元。该检定会获得+1状态加值。检查通讯单元是回忆知识动作的一部分。你必须手持通讯单元才能这样做。通讯单元会立即编译并显示与主题相关的各种媒体片段和精选内容，从而为你带来加值。如果你在检定中掷出大失败，改为失败。如果检定成功，且对象是生物，你将获得有关该生物的额外信息或内容。一旦你查询了通讯单元的信息，法术就会结束。当法术结束时，你对阿卡西记录的访问也会结束，你下载的所有信息都会返回阿卡西记录。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.h1i8c47U0IOrMrHJ]

升阶（3环）法术结束前可以用通讯单元查询信息3次。
items.name: 阿卡西下载（随意）
阿卡西之眼
items.expectedDescription: Instead of using their own memories, an Akashic dragon can ascertain information from the Akashic Records. This gives it the Akashic Record Lore skill, which it can use to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} of any kind.
items.description: 阿卡西龙能够不依靠自身记忆，而是从阿卡西记录中获取信息。这赋予它阿卡西记录学识技能，可用于任何类型的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{回忆知识}。

items.expectedDescription: @Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.AllAroundVision]
items.description: @Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.AllAroundVision]

items.expectedDescription:
90 feet. The swirl of constant uploads and downloads near the Akashic dragon make attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} unpredictable. A creature other than an akashic dragon that enters or begins its turn in the area must attempt a @Check[will|dc:28] save. Regardless of the result of the saving throw, the creature is temporarily immune to this dragon's Akashic interference for 1 minute.

Critical Success For 1 round, when the creature attempts to Recall Knowledge, it gains a +3 status bonus to its check.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure For 1 round, when the creature attempts to Recall Knowledge, it takes a –3 status penalty to its check.

Critical Failure As failure, but the effect lasts 1 minute.
items.description:
90尺。阿卡西龙附近持续上传下载的信息流使@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{回忆知识}变得难以预测。阿卡西龙以外的生物进入区域或在区域内开始回合时，必须尝试@Check[will|dc:28]豁免。无论豁免结果如何，该生物都会临时免疫这条龙的阿卡西干扰1分钟。

大成功 1轮内，生物尝试回忆知识时，检定获得+3状态加值。

成功 生物不受影响。

失败 1轮内，生物尝试回忆知识时，检定承受–3状态减值。

大失败 同失败，但效应持续1分钟。

items.name: 偏转激光
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger The dragon is critically hit by an attack

Effect The Akashic dragon raises a web of deflecting lasers using the eyes embedded all over their body, gaining resistance 15 to all damage against the triggering attack and absorbing some of the blow's energy, recharging their Akashic Barrage. If the Akashic dragon has succeeded at a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} check against the creature in the last minute, they gain resistance 20 instead.
items.description:
触发 龙被一次攻击重击

效果 阿卡西龙利用遍布全身的眼睛，架起一张用于偏转攻击的激光网，对抗触发攻击时获得对所有伤害的抗力15，并吸收部分攻击能量，为阿卡西弹幕重新充能。若阿卡西龙在过去一分钟内对该生物成功进行过一次@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{回忆知识}检定，则改为获得抗力20。

items.name: 阿卡西适应性
items.expectedDescription: The Akashic dragon can activate magic and tech items with the Cast a Spell activation of any tradition as if the spells they contain were occult spells.
items.description: 阿卡西龙可以启动来自任意根源、以施放法术作为启动方式的魔法和科技物品，如同其中的法术属于异能法术。

items.name: 阿卡西弹幕
items.expectedDescription: The dragon condenses cutting truths and fiery revelations from the Akashic Record into sizzling laser fire that they project as a cone from their primary eye to assail their foes. This deals @Damage[14d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage in a @Template[type:cone|distance:30] (@Check[reflex|dc:33|basic|options:area-effect,inflicts:stupefied] save). If a creature critically fails its Reflex save against Akashic Barrage and the Akashic dragon has succeeded at a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about the creature in the last minute, the creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round. The dragon can't use Akashic Barrage again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Akashic Barrage]]{1d4 rounds}.
items.description: 龙将阿卡西记录中的尖锐真理与炽热启示凝结为炙热的激光，从主眼射出锥形光束袭击敌人。这会造成@Damage[14d6[fire]|options:area-damage]伤害，范围为@Template[type:cone|distance:30]（@Check[reflex|dc:33|basic|options:area-effect,inflicts:stupefied]豁免）。若某个生物对抗阿卡西弹幕的反射豁免大失败，且阿卡西龙在过去一分钟内曾成功对该生物进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{回忆知识}检定，该生物便陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞1}，持续1轮。龙在[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Akashic Barrage]]{1d4轮}内无法再次使用阿卡西弹幕。

items.name: 龙之狂怒
items.expectedDescription: The dragon makes two claw Strikes and one tail Strike in any order.
items.description: 龙按任意顺序进行两次爪部打击和一次尾部打击。

items.name: 龙之威势

items.name: 敌手记录

items.name: 惊骇启示

需求 该龙在过去一分钟内曾对90尺内的一个敌人成功回忆知识

效果 该龙道出一个关于该生物、连其自身都可能不知道的惊人真相，使其与盟友犹豫不决或举止失常。90尺内每个能听见此秘密的敌人必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:31|options:area-effect,inflicts:slowed]豁免。随后每个生物免疫惊骇启示，持续24小时。

j6shQjKbVkbV1bnF.name: 成年阿卡西龙 Akashic Dragon (Adult)
j6shQjKbVkbV1bnF.publicNotes: 阿卡西龙通常藏身于残破、堆满遗物的巢穴，鲜少在外界露面，但偶尔也会居住在繁忙的空间站或城市等知识枢纽。这些龙天生与阿卡西记录直接相连，是傲慢的知识保管者，自认没有其他生物可能比它们更了解宇宙的秘密——而这一判断往往确实无误。阿卡西龙会在阿卡西记录中停留很长时间，离开时常以为已过去许多天，然而对银河系的其他地方而言，仅仅过了几小时。

jJ9OlkJVsoqRzmjM.name: 漂流尸聚合体 Driftdead Amalgam
jJ9OlkJVsoqRzmjM.publicNotes:
聚合体由多具漂流尸融合为一具血肉之躯，由组成它们的破碎灵魂残片驱动行动。最初的聚合体自发形成，但尸骸舰队的血肉熔炉后来造出了人工版本，将其作为突击部队部署在许多战斗的前线。

当不得安息的灵魂与位面能量结合，将自己的遗体重新活化为令人不安的生命仿制品时，漂流尸便会诞生。偶尔，来自别处、饱受侵扰的诸多精魂会融合到一起，一同寄宿到一具遗体上。漂流域内发生的任何死亡都有可能诞下漂流尸，但那些在强烈情感浪潮中殒命的活物更容易发生这种蜕变。

items.description: 30尺。漂流尸聚合体周围充斥着从漂流域撕裂出来的混乱空间。该区域为零重力。进入该区域或在其中开始回合的生物受到@Damage[4d6[void]]伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:25|basic]豁免）。

items.description: 在漂流域之外，聚合体获得虚体特征，免疫精准，并获得全部伤害 10抗力（除了力场，灭鬼，或精魂；对抗非魔法伤害抗力翻倍）

items.name: 染液飞溅

items.description: 与光棘花相邻的生物对光棘花造成穿刺或挥砍伤害时，光棘花的染液会飞溅并沾染该生物，使其受到@Damage[2d4[acid]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:15|basic]豁免）。豁免失败时，该污渍还会使任何以该生物为目标的光棘花在远程打击上获得+1状态加值，持续1分钟。

items.expectedDescription: The lumocantha whips its blossom around in a defensive move that delivers a flurry of searing lasers, dealing @Damage[3d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage to all creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:15] (@Check[reflex|dc:15|basic] save). On a failure, targets that can see the lumocantha are also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round (or 1 minute on a critical failure). The lumocantha can't use Laser Bloom again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Laser Bloom]]{1d4 rounds}.
items.description: 光棘花挥动花朵进行防御，释放出一阵灼热的激光，造成@Damage[3d6[fire]|options:area-damage]伤害，影响@Template[type:emanation|distance:15]内的所有生物（@Check[reflex|dc:15|basic]豁免）。失败时，能看见光棘花的目标还会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}，持续1轮（大失败时为1分钟）。光棘花在[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Laser Bloom]]{1d4轮}内无法再次使用激光绽放。

jUumrFqx4POabrhn.publicNotes:
最好从安全距离外观赏光棘花那绚丽的外观，因为这些植物会本能地以进入其防御范围的生物为目标，但植物和超小型生物除外。一圈长长的、半透明的黄色棘刺围绕着由众多脉动的、红宝石般的、充满染液的囊状物组成的雄蕊。它们美丽的花朵中也蕴含着其最危险的特性——形成一种有机激光。

光棘花寻求阳光的明亮与温暖，在长时间的黑暗中会减少活动且变得萎靡不振。像许多其他植物一样，它们通过光合作用获取能量，并通过根系吸收水分和养分。这些根系异常强壮且柔韧，还能轻易地从土壤中抽出，用于移动，这使得光棘花能够根据需要迁移，以寻找更适宜的土壤或光照条件。

光棘花没有心智，完全依靠本能生存。当受到魔法黑暗的影响时，光棘花会立即向最近的光源移动，尽管在此过程中它们仍会进行自我防御。如果光棘花持续处于黑暗中的时间达到3小时，它们会开始萎靡，变得行动迟缓。即使在休眠状态下，它们仍能使用激光；然而，如果完全处于黑暗中1周，它们会暂时失去激光能力。这一弱点使得这些植物可以被安全运输，不过，如果完全处于黑暗中2周，光棘花最终会因饥饿而死。

尽管光棘花最初是在维斯克-6（Vesk-6）上被发现的，但它们在整个星系中存在适宜条件的地方都能找到——有时甚至被用作装饰性的安全措施。幼年的光棘花在光照下展开时，直径约2至3尺，高度约5尺。若生长条件理想，它们可存活数百年，最终长至20尺高。

items.name: 原子能爆破
items.expectedDescription:
You magically split an atom, creating an explosion with radioactive fallout. All creatures in the area take 5d12 bludgeoning damage and 5d12 fire damage, and they're exposed to extreme radiation that uses your spellcasting DC as the @Check[fortitude]{Fortitude DC} for radiation sickness incurred by exposure to this radiation. The onset and frequency of this magical radiation is 1 round, and the area remains radioactive for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The target is unaffected by the initial damage.

Success The target takes half damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 minute.

Failure The target takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, and the target takes double damage.
items.description:
你用魔法分裂一个原子，制造一场带有放射性尘埃的爆炸。区域内的所有生物都会受到5d12钝击伤害和5d12火焰伤害，并暴露于极端辐射环境下，该辐射会导致辐射病，使用你的法术DC作为染上此辐射病的@Check[fortitude]{强韧DC}。这种魔法辐射的潜伏期和频率为1轮，该区域在10分钟内持续辐射。

大成功目标不受初始伤害影响。

成功目标受到一半伤害并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]1分钟。

失败目标受到全额伤害并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]1分钟。

大失败同失败，目标受到双倍伤害。

items.name: 火箭冲撞
items.expectedDescription:
You emit a rocket of flame from behind you and blast forward. You move in a straight line up to twice your Speed; you can move through spaces occupied by creatures, and the movement doesn't trigger reactions. Creatures in the area take 6d12 fire damage with a basic Reflex save. On a critical failure, a creature also takes 2d6 persistent fire damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round. You reappear at the end of the line.

Heightened (+2) The fire damage increases by 2d12, and the persistent fire damage on a critical failure increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你向身后火箭喷射，极速向前冲刺。你直线移动两倍于你速度的距离，你可以穿过被生物占据的空间，并且这一移动不会触发反应。在区域内的生物受到6d12火焰伤害，这具有一次基础反射豁免。在大失败时，该生物还会额外受到2d6持续火焰伤害并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]1轮。你将重新出现在直线的终点。

升阶（+2）火焰伤害增加2d12，豁免大失败的持续火焰伤害增加1d6。

items.name: 等离子墙
items.expectedDescription:
You shape a wall of crackling plasma that burns creatures passing through it. You create either a 5-foot-thick wall of plasma in a straight line up to 60 feet long and 10 feet high, or a 5-foot-thick, 10-foot-radius ring of plasma with the same height. The wall stands vertically in either form; if you wish, the wall can be of a shorter length or height. Everything on each side of the wall is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} from creatures on the opposite side. Any creature that crosses the wall or is occupying the wall's area at the start of its turn takes 4d6 fire damage and 2d6 persistent electricity damage.

Heightened (+1) The persistent electricity damage increases by 1d6.
items.description:
