@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.CdAyAiMGESvgNQtz]{Spell Effect: Unfettered Movement}
items.description:
你驱散可能影响一个生物的阻碍。当处于该法术效果中时，法术目标忽视会赋予其速度环境减值的效果。当法术目标尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{逃脱}一个令其@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{受擒}或者@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{束缚}的效果时，它自动成功，除非该效果是魔法性的，并且其环阶比行动无碍更高。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.CdAyAiMGESvgNQtz]{法术效果：行动无碍}

items.name: 蒸汽形态
items.expectedDescription:
The target transforms into a vaporous state. In this state, the target is amorphous. It loses any item bonus to AC and all other effects and bonuses from armor, and it uses its proficiency modifier for unarmored defense. It gains resistance 8 to physical damage and is immune to precision damage. It can't cast spells, activate items, or use actions that have the attack or manipulate trait. It gains a fly Speed of 10 feet and can slip through tiny cracks. The target can Dismiss the spell.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.sILRkGTwoBywy0BU]{Spell Effect: Vapor Form}
items.description:
目标变化成气体形态。在此状态下，目标形态不定。它失去所有AC上的物品加值，以及从护甲得到的所有其他效果和加值，并且使用其熟练度调整值用于无甲防御。它对物理伤害获得抗力8，并且免疫精准伤害。它无法施放法术，启动物品，或者使用具有攻击或者操作特征的动作。它获得10尺飞行速度，并且可以钻过微小的缝隙。目标可以解消该法术。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.sILRkGTwoBywy0BU]{法术效果：蒸汽形态}

items.name: 目盲术
items.expectedDescription:
You blind the target. The effect is determined by the target's Fortitude save. The target then becomes temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} until its next turn begins.

Failure The target is Blinded for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is Blinded permanently.
items.description:
你令目标目盲。法术效果由目标的强韧豁免决定。目标会临时免疫1分钟。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标直到其下个回合开始前陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲}。

失败 目标目盲1分钟。

大失败 目标永久目盲。

items.name: 火球术
items.expectedDescription:
A roaring blast of fire detonates at a spot you designate, dealing 6d6 fire damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.
items.description:
在你指定的位置爆发出咆哮的烈焰，造成6d6火焰伤害。

升阶（+1） 该伤害增加2d6。

items.name: 火球术
items.expectedDescription:
A roaring blast of fire detonates at a spot you designate, dealing 6d6 fire damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.
items.description:
在你指定的位置爆发出咆哮的烈焰，造成6d6火焰伤害。

升阶（+1） 该伤害增加2d6。

items.name: 加速术
items.expectedDescription:
Magic empowers the target to act faster. It gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition and can use the extra action each round only for Strike and Stride actions.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 6 creatures.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ElkXovNrHB0Doi6O]{Spell Effect: Haste}
items.description:
魔法强化了目标，令其行动迅速。它获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{迅捷}状态，并且每轮只能将额外动作用于打击或行走。

升阶（7环阶） 你能以至多6个生物为目标。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ElkXovNrHB0Doi6O]{法术效果：加速术}

items.name: 缓慢术
items.expectedDescription:
You dilate the flow of time around the target, slowing its actions.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} for 1 minute.

Heightened (6th) You can target up to 10 creatures.
items.description:
你令目标周围的时间膨胀，令其行动缓慢。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 1} ，持续1轮。

失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 1}，持续1分钟。

大失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 2}，持续1分钟。

升阶（6环） 你能以至多10个生物为目标。

items.name: 迷雾术
items.expectedDescription: You call forth a cloud of mist. All creatures within the mist become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and all creatures outside the mist become concealed to creatures within it. You can Dismiss the cloud.
items.description: 你唤来一团迷雾。在雾中的所有生物获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}，并且在雾外的所有生物对其内的生物获得隐蔽。你可以解消这团云雾。

items.name: 识破无形
items.expectedDescription:
Your gaze pierces through illusions and finds @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} creatures and spirits. You can see invisible creatures as though they weren't invisible, although their features are blurred, making them @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} and difficult to identify. You can also see incorporeal creatures, like ghosts, phased through an object from within 10 feet of an object's surface as blurry shapes seen through those objects. Subtler clues also grant you a +2 status bonus to checks you make to disbelieve illusions.

Heightened (5th) This spell has a duration of 8 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.T5bk6UH7yuYog1Fp]{Spell Effect: See the Unseen}
items.description:
你的目光穿透了幻术，发现了隐形生物和魂灵。你能看到@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}生物，就如同它们并未隐形一般，然而它们的体征仍然很模糊，使得它们具有@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}并且难以被识别。你还能看到虚体生物，比如穿入物体内的幽灵；你能透过物体，看到位于物体表面以内10尺内的此类生物的模糊轮廓。对细节更强的洞察力还让你在进行识破幻术的检定时，获得+2状态加值。

升阶（5环） 持续时间为8小时。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.T5bk6UH7yuYog1Fp]{法术效果：识破无形}

items.name: 身健体康
items.expectedDescription:
You send a surge of healing energy to restore the target's body. Attempt to counteract an effect of your choice imposing one of these conditions on the target: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened}. If you didn't counteract the effect, but you would have if its counteract rank were 2 lower, instead suppress the effect until the beginning of your next turn. The effect's duration doesn't elapse while it's suppressed.

This spell can't counteract or suppress curses, diseases, or conditions that are part of the target's normal state.

Heightened (4th) Add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed} to the list of conditions.

Heightened (6th) As 4th rank, plus add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dTwPJuKgBQCMxixg]{Petrified}.

Heightened (8th) As 4th rank, plus add petrified and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned}.
items.description:
你送出一股治愈的能量以恢复目标的躯体。尝试反制目标上的任一个由你选择的造成下列状态的效果：@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{耳聋}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心}。如果你未能反制该效果，但是如果其反制环阶低2的话你会成功，则改为压制该效应，直至你的下回合开始。在被压制时，该效果的持续时间不会减少。

此法术无法反制或压制诅咒、疾病或属于目标正常状态一部分的状态。

升阶（4环） 增加@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢}到状态列表中。

升阶（6环） 同4环阶，额外增加@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dTwPJuKgBQCMxixg]{石化}到状态列表中。

升阶（8环） 同4环阶，额外增加石化和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑}到状态列表中。

items.name: 分析目标
items.expectedDescription:
You focus on the target, gathering data as magical holograms display information. When the casting is complete, you learn biometric information about the target, including its fingerprints, medical conditions, and other basic physiological information. You or anyone you advise about the analysis gains a +1 status bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} the creature, to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} on the creature, and to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about it. If the target is illusory or under the effects of illusion magic, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your analyze target spell.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

Heightened (3rd) The status bonus increases to +2, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Heightened (6th) The status bonus increases to +3, and you can target any number of creatures.
items.description:
你专注在目标身上，收集数据并以魔法全息图像显示。当施法完成，你会获得目标的所有生物特征信息，包括指纹、医疗状况和其他基本生理信息。你或任何得到你基于分析建议的人，在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]为该生物、对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]、以及对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]的检定上获得+1状态加值。如果目标是幻觉或者处于幻术魔法效果下，仅当效果的环级低于你分析目标的法术环级，你才能够探测到结果。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

升阶（3环）状态加值提升到+2，并且你可以至多10名生物作为目标。

升阶（6环）状态加值提升到+3，并且你可以任意名生物作为目标。

items.name: 酸液喷溅
items.expectedDescription:
You fling a large glob of acid that immediately detonates, spraying nearby creatures. Creatures in the area take 1d8 acid damage with a basic Reflex save; on a critical failure, the creature also takes @Damage[(1+floor((@item.rank -1)/2))[persistent,acid]] damage.

Heightened (+2) The initial damage increases by 1d8, and the persistent damage on a critical failure increases by 1.
items.description:
你发射一团立即爆发的酸液，泼溅到周围生物上。区域中的生物承受1d8酸蚀伤害，这有一次基础反射豁免；在大失败时，该生物也会承受@Damage[(1+floor((@item.rank -1)/2))[persistent,acid]]伤害。

升阶（+2） 该初始伤害增加1d8，并且大失败时的持续伤害增加1。

items.name: 命令术
items.expectedDescription:
You shout a command that's hard to ignore. You can command the target to approach you, run away (as if it had the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition), release what it's holding, drop @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, or stand in place. It can't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.A72nHGUtNXgY5Ey9]{Delay} or take any reactions until it has obeyed your command. The effects depend on the target's Will save.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure For the first action on its next turn, the creature must use a single action to do as you command.

Critical Failure The target must use all its actions on its next turn to obey your command.

Heightened (5th) You can target up to 10 creatures.
items.description:
你喊出一句难以被忽视的命令。你可以命令目标接近你，逃离你（如同获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}状态），扔下持有物，@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}，或者站立在原地。它不能@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.A72nHGUtNXgY5Ey9]{延迟}或者使用任何反应动作，直到它服从你的命令为止。法术效果基于目标的意志豁免。

成功 目标不受影响。

失败 作为该生物下个回合的第一个动作，其必须用一个单动作来完成你的命令。

大失败 目标必须使用其下个回合的全部动作来完成你的命令。

升阶（5环） 你能以至多10个生物为目标。

items.name: 侦测魔法
items.expectedDescription:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).
items.description:
你发出一股标记魔法存在的脉冲。你不会获得魔法存在或不存在以外的任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你或者你盟友的魔法物品以及持续法术。仅当幻术魔法的环阶低于你的侦测魔法环阶时，你才能侦测幻术魔法。但是，具有幻术灵光但是没有在外表上做伪装的物品（例如一瓶隐形药水），通常能够正常侦测。

升阶（3环阶） 你能知晓法术侦测出的最强魔法效果的环阶或等级，具体由GM决定。

升阶（4环阶） 如3环阶，你也能指出最高环阶魔法的来源。如同一种模糊感官，你不会了解具体的位置，但是可以将来源锁定到5尺立方（或者最近的那个五尺立方，如果来源体积比这个区域更大）。

items.name: 油腻术
items.expectedDescription:
You conjure grease, choosing an area or target.

  • Area [4 contiguous 5-foot squares] All solid ground in the area is covered with grease. Each creature standing on the greasy surface must succeed at a Reflex save or an Acrobatics check against your spell DC or fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. Creatures using an action to move onto the greasy surface during the spell's duration must attempt either a Reflex save or an Acrobatics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance}. A creature that Steps or Crawls doesn't have to attempt a check or save.
  • Target [1 object of Bulk 1 or less] If you Cast the Spell on an unattended object, anyone trying to pick up the object must succeed at an Acrobatics check or Reflex save against your spell DC to do so. If you target an attended object, the creature that has the object must attempt an Acrobatics check or Reflex save. On a failure, the holder or wielder takes a –2 circumstance penalty to all checks that involve using the object; on a critical failure, the holder or wielder releases the item. The object lands in an adjacent square of the GM's choice. If you Cast this Spell on a worn object, the wearer gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves against attempts to grapple them.
items.description:
你创造一片油，选择区域或是目标。

  • 区域 [4个连续的5尺方格] 区域中的所有坚实地面覆盖上一层油。在油滑的表面上站立的生物必须尝试成功通过一次对抗你法术DC的反射或者特技检定，否则@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}。在法术持续时间内，使用动作移动到油滑表面上的生物必须尝试一次反射豁免或者特技检定来@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{保持平衡}。快步或者爬行的生物无需尝试检定或者豁免。
  • 目标 [一个1负载或者更低的物体] 如果你对无主物品施放该法术，任何尝试捡起该物体的人必须成功尝试一次对抗你法术DC的特技检定或者反射豁免才能如此做。如果你以被持有的物品为目标，拥有该物品的生物必须尝试一次特技检定或者反射豁免。失败时，持握者或者持用者在使用该物体的所有检定上承受-2环境减值；在大失败时，持握者或者持用者会掉落该物品。该物品会掉落在一个由GM选择的相邻方格内。如果你对一个穿戴物品施放该法术，穿戴者在对抗擒拿他的强韧豁免上获得+2环境加值。

items.name: 引火术
items.expectedDescription:
You snap your fingers and point at a target, which begins to smolder. Make a spell attack roll against the target's AC, dealing 2d4 fire damage on a hit. If the target is within your melee reach, you can choose to make a melee spell attack with the flame instead of a ranged spell attack, which increases all the spell's damage dice to d6s.

Critical Success The target takes double damage and 1d4 persistent fire damage.

Success The target takes full damage.

Heightened (+1) The initial damage increases by 1d4 and the persistent fire damage on a critical hit increases by 1d4.

@Damage[(@item.rank)d4[persistent,fire]]{Scaling Persistent Fire Damage}

@Damage[(@item.rank)d6[persistent,fire]]{Scaling Persistent Fire Damage (Melee)}
items.description:
你打个响指并指向一个目标，后者便开始阴燃。作出一次法术攻击检定对抗目标的AC，命中时造成2d4点火焰伤害。若目标位于你的近战触及范围内，你能选择用火焰进行一次近战法术攻击以取代远程法术攻击，这会使得法术的所有伤害骰提升至d6骰子。

大成功 目标承受双倍伤害以及1d4点持续火焰伤害。

成功 目标承受全额伤害。

升阶（+1） 起始伤害增加1d4点，重击的持续火焰伤害增加1d4点。

@Damage[(@item.rank)d4[persistent,fire]]{随环阶提升的持续火焰伤害}

@Damage[(@item.rank)d6[persistent,fire]]{随环阶提升的持续火焰伤害（近战）}

items.name: 测量术
items.expectedDescription:
You learn the approximate measurements (length, width, depth, height, and weight) of creatures and objects you can observe in the area. If an object or creature extends out of the area, you learn only the measurements within the area, but nothing about what you can't observe. For example, you can't determine the thickness or weight of a wall you can observe only one side of, or the depth of water that extends beyond the spell's range. Each time you Sustain the spell, you learn the exact measurements of one creature or object in the area, including imprecisions or anomalies that might indicate structural weakness. Magically altered targets give you information that reflects what you observe rather than accurate measurements.

Heightened (+1) Extend the range of measure by 100 feet.
items.description:
你可以了解周围生物和物体的大致尺寸（长度、宽度、深度、高度和重量）。如果物体或生物延伸出了该射程，你只能了解该区域内的测量值，而无法观察到的东西则无法了解。例如，你无法确定只能观察到一面的墙壁的厚度或重量，也无法确定超出法术射程的水深。每次维持法术时，你都会了解该区域内一种生物或物体的精确测量结果，包括可能揭示结构弱点的不精确或异常现象。被魔法改变的目标所提供的信息反映的是你所观察到的情况，而不是精确测量值。

升阶（+1）延展测量距离100尺。

items.name: 魔法伎俩
items.expectedDescription:
The simplest magic does your bidding. You can perform simple magical effects for as long as you Sustain the spell. Each time you Sustain the spell, you can choose one of four options.

  • Cook Cool, warm, or flavor 1 pound of nonliving material.
  • Lift Slowly lift an unattended object of light Bulk or less 1 foot off the ground.
  • Make Create a temporary object of negligible Bulk, made of congealed magical substance. The object looks crude and artificial and is extremely fragile-it can't be used as a tool, weapon, or locus or cost for a spell.
  • Tidy Color, clean, or soil an object of light Bulk or less. You can affect an object of 1 Bulk with 10 rounds of concentration, and a larger object at 1 minute per Bulk.

Prestidigitation can't deal damage or cause adverse conditions. Any actual change to an object (beyond what is noted above) persists only as long as you Sustain the spell.
items.description:
最简单的魔法帮你完成杂务。只要你维持该法术，你就可以产生简单的魔法效果。每当你维持该法术时，你可以选择四个选项中的一个。

  • 烹饪 为1磅非活物材料冷却，加热，或者调味。
  • 抬起 将一件轻负载或者更低的无主物品缓慢抬离地面1尺。
  • 创造 创造一个负载可忽略的临时物体，它由凝结的魔法物质组成。该物体看起来粗糙、不自然，且极其脆弱——它无法被用做工具、武器、施法载体或法术费用。
  • 整理 为一件轻负载或者更低的物体染色，清洁，或者弄脏它。你可以通过10轮专注来影响一件1负载的物体，对于更大的物体为每负载1分钟。

魔法伎俩无法造成伤害或者负面效果。对一件物体的任何改变（在上述内容之外的）只会在你仍维持该法术时持续。

items.name: 阅读灵光
items.expectedDescription:
You focus on the target object, opening your mind to perceive magical auras. When the casting is complete, you know whether that item is magical. You or anyone you advise about the aura gains a +2 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{Identify Magic} on the item. If the object is illusory, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your read aura spell.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.J6OhRNSN23KzOPRL]{Spell Effect: Read Aura}

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to 10 objects.

Heightened (6th) You can target any number of objects.
items.description:
你专注于目标物体，拓展神智，以感受魔法灵光。当你完成施法后，你得知该物品是否具有魔法。你或任何经你告知灵光信息的人在对该物品@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{辨识魔法}时获得+2环境加值。如果该物体是幻象，仅当该效果的环阶低于你的阅读灵光环阶时你才能发现此事实。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.J6OhRNSN23KzOPRL]{法术效果：阅读灵光}

升阶（3环） 你能以至多10个物体为目标。

升阶（6环） 你能以任意数量物体为目标。

items.name: 睡眠术
items.expectedDescription:
Each creature in the area becomes drowsy, possibly nodding off. A creature that falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} from this spell doesn't fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} or release what it's holding. This spell doesn't prevent creatures from waking up due to a successful Perception check, limiting its utility in combat.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes a –1 status penalty to Perception checks for 1 round.

Failure The creature falls unconscious. If it's still unconscious after 1 minute, it wakes up automatically.

Critical Failure The creature falls unconscious. If it's still unconscious after 1 hour, it wakes up automatically.

Heightened (4th) The creatures fall unconscious for 1 round on a failure or 1 minute on a critical failure. They fall prone and release what they're holding, and they can't attempt Perception checks to wake up. When the duration ends, the creature is sleeping normally instead of automatically waking up.
items.description:
区域中的每个生物垂头歪脑昏昏欲睡。由于该法术@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{失去意识}的生物不会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}，也不会松开其持握的东西。此法术不妨碍生物通过成功的察觉检定醒来，并因此限制其在战斗中的能力。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物在察觉检定上承受-1状态减值，持续1轮。

失败 该生物失去意识。如果它在1分钟后仍然失去意识，它自动醒来。

大失败 该生物失去意识。如果它在1小时后仍然失去意识，它自动醒来。

升阶（4环） 目标在失败时失去意识1轮，在大失败时失去意识1分钟。它们会倒地，并松开其持握的东西，并且它们无法尝试察觉检定以醒来。当持续时间结束时，该生物会正常睡着，而不是自动醒来。

items.expectedDescription: Abysium dragons have ultimate control over the radioactive energy that grows within their bodies. Any time an abysium dragon deals fire or poison damage, they can choose whether that damage is magical, and they can change any amount of the fire damage to poison (or any amount of poison damage to fire).
items.description: 渊铀龙能完全控制体内滋生的辐射能量。每当渊铀龙造成火焰或毒素伤害时，都可以选择该伤害是否属于魔法伤害，并能将任意数量的火焰伤害改为毒素伤害（或将任意数量的毒素伤害改为火焰伤害）。

items.expectedDescription: The dragon breathes a blast of caustic superheated gas that deals @Damage[5d6[fire],3d12[persistent,poison]|options:area-damage] damage in a @Template[type:cone|distance:30] (@Check[fortitude|dc:28|basic|options:area-effect] save). They can't use Radiation Breath again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Radiation Breath]]{1d4 rounds}.
items.description: 龙喷出一股具有腐蚀性的过热气体，造成@Damage[5d6[fire],3d12[persistent,poison]|options:area-damage]伤害，范围为@Template[type:cone|distance:30]（@Check[fortitude|dc:28|basic|options:area-effect]豁免）。之后[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Radiation Breath]]{1d4轮}内无法再次使用辐射吐息。

jo5fk2usyVRRhrtz.name: 青年渊铀龙（施法者） Abysium Dragon (Young, Spellcaster)
jo5fk2usyVRRhrtz.publicNotes: 渊铀龙将辐射既视为毁灭之力，亦视作能量之源，它们与同名的放射性天金渊铀紧密相连。这些龙的体内会沉积纯净的渊铀；随着年龄增长，它们身上的放射性也愈发强烈，使其变得更加好斗、焦躁，甚至感到孤独，因为很少有生物能在一头年老的渊铀龙身边长久存活。渊铀龙常投身于殖装制作、武器制作（以利用其与生俱来的能量源）以及机器人制造（以求得陪伴）等活动。这些工作驱使渊铀龙不断寻找坚固且抗辐射的材料用于制作，它们往往会花费数年时间，在小型卫星和小行星上搜寻珍贵材料。

jrL6wPYmf7orkM64.name: 异星卫士新兵 Xenowarden Greenhorn
jrL6wPYmf7orkM64.publicNotes:
绿卫士是异星卫士中的精英战斗部队，以自然魔法著称，常被派往发生生态剧变的地点。新加入绿卫士的成员被授予“根”（root）的军衔，但通常被称为“新兵”（greenhorns）。异星卫士新兵在紧密团结的小队中接受全面的训练。

异星卫士是一个强大且备受尊敬的组织，他们致力于保护和研究自然界，确保技术进步符合生态责任原则。其成员构成极其多样化，包括隐居山林、修习自然魔法且排斥科技的隐士，以及利用藻类开发可再生能源的科学家。在其成员构成光谱的另一端，还有像荒野骑士（Wildknights）和绿卫士（Greenguards）这样的精英战斗部队，以及像神秘的夹竹桃（Oleander）这样令人畏惧的生态恐怖分子。异星卫士由一位绿议长（Greenspeaker）领导，绿议长由众人拥戴推选产生，并接受同僚的建议。

items.name: 凿爪术
items.expectedDescription:
You temporarily morph your limb into a clawed appendage. Make a melee spell attack roll against your target's AC. If you hit, you deal your choice of 2d6 slashing damage or 2d6 piercing damage, plus 2 persistent bleed damage. On a critical success, you deal double damage and double bleed damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6 and the persistent bleed damage increases by 1.
items.description:
你将你的肢体暂时变为一个长爪的附肢。进行一次近战法术攻击掷骰，对抗你的目标的AC。如果你命中，你选择造成2d6挥砍或者2d6穿刺伤害，以及2点持续流血伤害。在大成功时，你造成双倍伤害加上双倍持续流血伤害。

升阶（+1） 该伤害增加1d6，并且持续流血伤害增加1。

items.name: 扫描环境
items.expectedDescription:
You analyze the natural environment in the area within 1 mile, learning general information about the atmosphere, biomes, and gravity. You forecast the weather for the next hour, including the direction it will come from; learn which atmospheres, biomes, and gravity are in the area, as well as the direction and distance to those elements; and learn if anything in the area presents an environmental hazard, including cold or heat dangers (at what temperature range), radiation (at what severity), smoke effects, and underwater conditions. This is enough to detect large effects that span spaces over 30 feet in diameter only. You gain a general sense of where and how far away these dangers are.

Heightened (+1) The scanned area increases in radius by 1 mile.
items.description:
你分析1英里范围内的自然环境，了解大气层、生物群落和重力的一般信息。预测未来一小时的天气，包括天气自哪而来；了解该区域有哪些大气、生物群落和重力，以及与这些元素的方向和距离；了解该区域是否存在环境危害，包括冷热危险（在什么温度范围）、辐射（严重程度）、烟雾效果和水下条件。这足以探测到直径超过30英尺的大型效果。你可以大致了解这些危险的位置和距离。

升阶（+1）扫描范围增加1英里。

items.name: 绊足藤
items.expectedDescription:
A vine appears from thin air, flicking from your hand and lashing itself to the target. Attempt a spell attack roll against the target.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.TwtUIEyenrtAbeiX]{Spell Effect: Tangle Vine}

Critical Success The target gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} condition and takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 round. It can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} against your spell DC to remove the penalty and the immobilized condition.

Success The target takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 round. It can attempt to Escape against your spell DC to remove the penalty.

Failure The target is unaffected.

Heightened (2nd) The effects last for 2 rounds.

Heightened (4th) The effects last for 1 minute.
items.description:
一条藤蔓凭空出现，从你手上弹射而出并捆绑在目标身上。对目标进行一次法术攻击掷骰。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.TwtUIEyenrtAbeiX]{法术效果：绊足藤}

大成功 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}状态，并且其速度承受-10尺环境减值，持续1轮。它能尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{逃脱}对抗你的法术DC，来以此移除减值和禁足状态。

成功 目标速度承受-10尺环境减值，持续1轮。它能尝试逃脱对抗你的法术DC来移除减值。

失败 目标不受影响。

升阶（2环） 效果持续2轮。

升阶（4环） 效果持续1分钟。

温控编织服以保温面料和散热导线织成，是一种经过加固的兜帽服饰，前往卡斯卓韦或普洛尼斯（Pulonis）的丛林等潮湿气候地区旅行时，穿戴它很流行。

extraFields.text: 20尺半径爆发范围内所有含有植物的方格

items.name: 绿色代码
items.expectedDescription: You cause flowering vines or other plant matter to grow from an unattended tech object. Plant matter explodes from the target object, filling all squares within a 20-foot burst. Whenever a creature starts its turn in the area, it takes 2d6 piercing damage (basic Reflex save). On a critical failure, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} for 1 round or until it Escapes against your spell DC. The growth covers the object, requiring a creature to succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:5] to physically access the object for the spell's duration.
items.description: 你使开花的藤蔓或其他植物从一件无人持有的科技物体上长出。植物从目标物体上爆发，填满20尺爆发内的所有方格。每当生物在区域内开始其回合时，它受到2d6穿刺伤害（基础反射豁免）。大失败时，该生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}，持续1轮，或直到其对抗你的法术DC成功脱逃。植物覆盖物体，使生物在法术持续时间内必须成功通过一次@Check[flat|dc:5]，才能实际接触该物体。

items.name: 侦测魔法
items.expectedDescription:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).
items.description:
你发出一股标记魔法存在的脉冲。你不会获得魔法存在或不存在以外的任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你或者你盟友的魔法物品以及持续法术。仅当幻术魔法的环阶低于你的侦测魔法环阶时，你才能侦测幻术魔法。但是，具有幻术灵光但是没有在外表上做伪装的物品（例如一瓶隐形药水），通常能够正常侦测。

升阶（3环阶） 你能知晓法术侦测出的最强魔法效果的环阶或等级，具体由GM决定。

升阶（4环阶） 如3环阶，你也能指出最高环阶魔法的来源。如同一种模糊感官，你不会了解具体的位置，但是可以将来源锁定到5尺立方（或者最近的那个五尺立方，如果来源体积比这个区域更大）。

items.name: 电弧击
items.expectedDescription:
An arc of lightning leaps from one target to another. Each target takes 2d4 electricity damage with a basic Reflex save.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.
items.description:
一段电弧从一个目标跳跃到另一个目标。每个目标承受2d4电击伤害，这有一次基础反射豁免。

升阶（+1） 该伤害增加1d4。

items.name: 凿爪术
items.expectedDescription:
You temporarily morph your limb into a clawed appendage. Make a melee spell attack roll against your target's AC. If you hit, you deal your choice of 2d6 slashing damage or 2d6 piercing damage, plus 2 persistent bleed damage. On a critical success, you deal double damage and double bleed damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6 and the persistent bleed damage increases by 1.
items.description:
你将你的肢体暂时变为一个长爪的附肢。进行一次近战法术攻击掷骰，对抗你的目标的AC。如果你命中，你选择造成2d6挥砍或者2d6穿刺伤害，以及2点持续流血伤害。在大成功时，你造成双倍伤害加上双倍持续流血伤害。

升阶（+1） 该伤害增加1d6，并且持续流血伤害增加1。

items.name: 治疗术
items.expectedDescription:
You channel vital energy to heal the living or damage the undead. If the target is a willing living creature, you restore 1d8 Hit Points. If the target is undead, you deal that amount of vitality damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 The spell has a range of touch.

2 (concentrate) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing a living creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (concentrate) You disperse vital energy in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. This targets all living and undead creatures in the burst.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.
items.description:
你引导命能，以治疗活物或者伤害不死生物。如果目标是自愿活物，你使其恢复1d8生命值。如果目标是不死生物，你对其造成等量命能伤害，并且它可以进行基础强韧豁免。你在施放该法术时花费的动作数量决定其目标，范围，区域和其他参数。

1 该法术的射程为接触。

2（专注）该法术的射程为30尺。如果你在治疗一个活物，回复的生命值增加8。

3（专注）你在@Template[emanation|distance:30]内释放命能。这会以区域中所有活物和不死生物为目标。

升阶（+1） 治疗或者伤害的量增加1d8，两个动作版本的额外治疗增加8。

items.name: 水流冲击
items.expectedDescription:
You call forth a powerful blast of pressurized water that bludgeons the target and knocks it back. Make a ranged spell attack roll.

Critical Success The target takes 6d6 bludgeoning damage and is knocked back 10 feet.

Success The target takes 3d6 bludgeoning damage and is knocked back 5 feet.

Heightened (+1) The bludgeoning damage increases by 2d6.
items.description:
你唤来一团强力的高压水流，撞击目标并令其后退。尝试一次远程法术攻击掷骰。

大成功 目标承受6d6钝击伤害，并且被击退10尺。

成功 目标承受3d6钝击伤害，并且被击退5尺。

升阶（+1） 该钝击伤害增加2d6。

items.name: 扫描环境
items.expectedDescription:
You analyze the natural environment in the area within 1 mile, learning general information about the atmosphere, biomes, and gravity. You forecast the weather for the next hour, including the direction it will come from; learn which atmospheres, biomes, and gravity are in the area, as well as the direction and distance to those elements; and learn if anything in the area presents an environmental hazard, including cold or heat dangers (at what temperature range), radiation (at what severity), smoke effects, and underwater conditions. This is enough to detect large effects that span spaces over 30 feet in diameter only. You gain a general sense of where and how far away these dangers are.

Heightened (+1) The scanned area increases in radius by 1 mile.
items.description:
你分析1英里范围内的自然环境，了解大气层、生物群落和重力的一般信息。预测未来一小时的天气，包括天气自哪而来；了解该区域有哪些大气、生物群落和重力，以及与这些元素的方向和距离；了解该区域是否存在环境危害，包括冷热危险（在什么温度范围）、辐射（严重程度）、烟雾效果和水下条件。这足以探测到直径超过30英尺的大型效果。你可以大致了解这些危险的位置和距离。

升阶（+1）扫描范围增加1英里。

items.name: 音波尖啸
items.expectedDescription:
You unleash a painfully rapid cone of vibrations by letting out a cathartic scream, dealing 1d8 sonic damage to creatures in the area with a basic Fortitude save. A creature that fails its saving throw also becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Heightened (+1) Increases the damage by 1d8.
items.description:
你发出一声宣泄情绪的尖叫，释放出振动快得令人痛苦的锥形音波，对区域内的生物造成1d8音波伤害，进行基础强韧豁免。豁免失败的生物还会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心1}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d8。

items.name: 召唤植物与真菌
items.expectedDescription:
You summon a creature that has the plant or fungus trait and whose level is -1 to fight for you.

Heightened As listed in the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.journals.JournalEntry.S55aqwWIzpQRFhcq.JournalEntryPage.8gcp880pEWZ9VPnF]{summon} trait.
items.description:
你召唤一个具有植物或真菌特征、等级为-1的生物为你战斗。

升阶 如@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.journals.JournalEntry.S55aqwWIzpQRFhcq.JournalEntryPage.8gcp880pEWZ9VPnF]{召唤}特征所列。

items.name: 绊足藤
items.expectedDescription:
A vine appears from thin air, flicking from your hand and lashing itself to the target. Attempt a spell attack roll against the target.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.TwtUIEyenrtAbeiX]{Spell Effect: Tangle Vine}

Critical Success The target gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} condition and takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 round. It can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} against your spell DC to remove the penalty and the immobilized condition.

Success The target takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 round. It can attempt to Escape against your spell DC to remove the penalty.

Failure The target is unaffected.

Heightened (2nd) The effects last for 2 rounds.

Heightened (4th) The effects last for 1 minute.
items.description:
一条藤蔓凭空出现，从你手上弹射而出并捆绑在目标身上。对目标进行一次法术攻击掷骰。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.TwtUIEyenrtAbeiX]{法术效果：绊足藤}

大成功 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}状态，并且其速度承受-10尺环境减值，持续1轮。它能尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{逃脱}对抗你的法术DC，来以此移除减值和禁足状态。

成功 目标速度承受-10尺环境减值，持续1轮。它能尝试逃脱对抗你的法术DC来移除减值。

失败 目标不受影响。

升阶（2环） 效果持续2轮。

升阶（4环） 效果持续1分钟。

items.name: 雷击术
items.expectedDescription:
You call down a tendril of lightning that cracks with thunder, dealing 1d12 electricity damage and 1d4 sonic damage to the target with a basic Reflex save. A target wearing metal armor or made of metal takes a –1 circumstance bonus to its save, and if damaged by the spell is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d12 electricity and 1d4 sonic.
items.description:
你呼唤一道伴随着雷鸣之声的闪电，对目标造成1d12点电击伤害和1d4点音波伤害，基础反射豁免。穿戴金属护甲或者由金属构成的生物在豁免中承受-1环境减值，若它们受到该法术的伤害，会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 1}，持续1轮。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d12点电击以及1d4点音波。

items.name: 激光手枪
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This compact pistol is the most popular sidearm in the Pact Worlds thanks to its reliability, durability, and affordability. Most common laser pistols have a lightweight polycarbon body ending in a long, slim barrel.
items.description:
强化： 1

这把紧凑的手枪因可靠、耐用且价格实惠，成为协约世界（Pact Worlds）最受欢迎的随身武器。大多数普通激光手枪有轻质聚碳枪身，末端连着细长的枪管。

items.name: 警棍
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This reinforced rod is commonly made from metal alloys and designed to strike and parry incoming blows.
items.description:
强化： 1

这根强化棍通常由金属合金制成，设计用于打击和格挡来袭攻击。

items.name: 碳素皮肤
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This form-fitting suit of carbon fiber encases the body. Most are usually dull-gray, functional garments, while pricier, bespoke suits dazzle like diamonds.
items.description:
强化： 1

这件贴身的碳纤维服将身体包裹起来。多数是暗灰色的实用服装，而更昂贵的定制服装则像钻石般耀眼。

items.name: 根系偏转
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger The rootsworn is standing on a solid surface and would be hit by a ranged Strike

Effect A mass of magical roots rapidly sprout from the ground and shield the Xenowarden rootsworn from harm. The Xenowarden rootsworn gains a +2 status bonus to their AC against the triggering Strike.
items.description:
触发 根誓者正站在坚实表面上，且即将被远程打击命中

效果 一丛魔法根须迅速从地面生长出来，保护异星卫士根誓者免受伤害。异星卫士根誓者在对抗触发打击的AC上获得+2状态加值。

items.name: 根系网络
items.expectedDescription:
1 to 2

The Xenowarden rootsworn conjures magical roots to move their allies around the battlefield. They select one willing ally within 100 feet who's standing on a solid surface, or three willing allies if they spend 2 actions to perform Root Network. The roots move each target up to their Speed in a direction of their choice, then deposit them safely on a solid surface.
items.description:
1至2

异星卫士根誓者召唤魔法根须，在战场上移动盟友。它选择100尺内站在坚实表面上的一名自愿盟友；若花费2动作使用根系网络，则可以选择三名自愿盟友。根须将每个目标朝其选择的方向移动，距离至多等于其速度，然后将其安全地放在坚实表面上。

jyMpHjBhCaHqSvgL.name: 辉耀狼蛛 Illumantula

items.name: 事件视界
items.expectedDescription:
You unleash the power of a supermassive black hole. All creatures in the area take 6d10 bludgeoning and 6d10 void damage. Event horizon ignores up to 10 resistance creatures in the area have to bludgeoning, and up to 10 resistance they have to void. Each creature attempts a Reflex save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the end of its next turn.

Failure The creature takes full damage, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 3} until the end of its next turn, and slowed 1 for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is slowed 3 until the end of its next turn, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} for 1 minute.
items.description:
你释放超大质量黑洞的力量。区域内所有生物受到6d10钝击伤害和6d10虚能伤害。事件视界忽略区域内生物至多10点钝击抗力和至多10点虚能抗力。每个生物尝试一次反射豁免。

大成功 生物不受影响。

成功 生物受到一半伤害，且陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢1}，直到其下一回合结束。

失败 生物受到全额伤害，陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢3}直到其下一回合结束，并陷入缓慢1，持续1分钟。

大失败 生物受到双倍伤害，陷入缓慢3直到其下一回合结束，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢2}，持续1分钟。

items.name: 原子能爆破
items.expectedDescription:
You magically split an atom, creating an explosion with radioactive fallout. All creatures in the area take 5d12 bludgeoning damage and 5d12 fire damage, and they're exposed to extreme radiation that uses your spellcasting DC as the @Check[fortitude]{Fortitude DC} for radiation sickness incurred by exposure to this radiation. The onset and frequency of this magical radiation is 1 round, and the area remains radioactive for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The target is unaffected by the initial damage.

Success The target takes half damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 minute.

Failure The target takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, and the target takes double damage.
items.description:
你用魔法分裂一个原子，制造一场带有放射性尘埃的爆炸。区域内的所有生物都会受到5d12钝击伤害和5d12火焰伤害，并暴露于极端辐射环境下，该辐射会导致辐射病，使用你的法术DC作为染上此辐射病的@Check[fortitude]{强韧DC}。这种魔法辐射的潜伏期和频率为1轮，该区域在10分钟内持续辐射。

大成功目标不受初始伤害影响。

成功目标受到一半伤害并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]1分钟。

失败目标受到全额伤害并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]1分钟。

大失败同失败，目标受到双倍伤害。

items.name: 呼召宇宙
items.expectedDescription:
You reach into the void and call down a vertical column of dangerous cosmic material that rains destruction upon creatures in the area and shrouds the terrain around it in a swirl of stardust. This matter is made up of bits of burning stars and chunks of frozen comets, and it deals 5d12 cold damage and 5d12 fire damage to every creature in the area when you Cast the Spell. For the spell's duration, the cosmic material reduces visibility and mobility, making the area greater difficult terrain and making everything seen within or through the area @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Heightened (10th) The cold and fire damage each increase by 2d12.
items.description:
你探入虚空并召来一片危险的宇宙物质，其在一个垂直圆柱内摧毁其中生物，并将地形化为星尘漩涡。这种物质由燃烧的恒星或冰冻的彗星组成，对施法时区域内的所有生物造成5d12火焰伤害和5d12寒冷伤害。在法术持续期间内，宇宙物质降低了能见度和机动性，使该区域内变为高等困难地形并且让该区域内或者透过其的所有事物获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]。

升阶（10环）寒冷伤害和火焰伤害各增加2d12。

items.expectedDescription:
You flash freeze a target then send subsonic waves through it, potentially reducing it into fine powder. Make a spell attack against the target. If you hit a target, the target takes 6d8 cold damage and must attempt a Fortitude save. If you critically hit, the target gets a result one degree of success worse than it rolled on its Fortitude save. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points is blasted to fine powder; its gear remains.

Critical Success The target is unaffected by further damage.

Success The target takes an additional @Damage[((@item.level -3)d8)[sonic]] damage.

Failure The target takes an additional @Damage[((@item.level)d8)[sonic]] damage.

Critical Failure The target takes an additional @Damage[((@item.level +6)d8)[sonic]] damage.

Heightened (+1) The cold and sonic damage each increase by 1d8.
items.description:
你会瞬间冻结一个目标，然后向其发送亚音速波，有可能将其变成粉末。对目标发动法术攻击。如果你击中目标，则目标会受到6d8点寒冷伤害，并必须尝试一次强韧豁免。如果你的法术攻击造成重击，目标的强韧豁免结果会下降一级成功度。减至0HP的生物会被炸成粉末，但其装备会保留。

大成功目标不受进一步伤害的影响。

成功目标受到额外@Damage[((@item.level -3)d8)[sonic]]伤害。

失败目标受到额外@Damage[((@item.level)d8)[sonic]]伤害。

大失败目标受到额外@Damage[((@item.level +6)d8)[sonic]]伤害。

升阶（+1）寒冷和音波伤害增加1d8
items.name: 冷葬（随意）

items.expectedDescription:
You slice through reality, forming a chasm of life-draining entropy in a straight line 20 feet high, 120 feet long, and 2 inches thick. The chasm provides cover. The chasm deals 7d8 void damage to each creature that's in the chasm's space when it's created, that attempts to pass through the chasm, or that ends its turn inside the chasm, with a basic Reflex save. A creature that succeeds at this save when the chasm is created is pushed to the nearest space on the side of its choice. Creatures trying to move through the chasm fail to do so if they critically fail the save, ending their movement next to the chasm.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d8.
items.description:
你划破现实，在一条20尺高、120尺长、2英寸厚的直线上形成一道能使生命流失的熵裂隙。裂隙提供掩蔽。裂隙会对在形成时位于其空间内、试图穿过裂隙或在裂隙内结束回合的每个生物造成7d8虚能伤害，具有一次基础反射豁免。如果生物在裂隙形成时豁免成功，则会被推到其选择的一侧最近的空间。试图穿过裂隙的生物如果豁免失败，就会在裂隙旁结束移动。

升阶（+1）伤害增加 1d8。
items.name: 切割现实（随意）
真视术（恒定）
items.expectedDescription: You see things within 60 feet as they actually are. jyMpHjBhCaHqSvgL.publicNotes:
尽管这种生物只是最近才出现在阿基顿星破碎的红色沙漠中，但所谓的“辉耀狼蛛”已然成为当地传说与民间故事的素材。这种生物在神秘的先驱者飞船坠毁后不久便现身于世，该飞船如今仅被称为归航者残骸。最初遭遇这种生物的绍贝德人沙漠向导将其命名为辉耀狼蛛，因其形似阿基顿冰川中的致命蜘蛛。其他协约世界的公民也沿用了这个名称，因为最贴切的描述莫过于“由光构成的蜘蛛”。

目前，辉耀狼蛛满足于在归航者残骸及其周边区域游荡度日，自现身以来仅参与过寥寥数次有意义的交锋。首次交战对象是日蚀骑士团的地狱骑士小队，辉耀狼蛛在两分钟内有条不紊地毁灭了对方80名训练最有素的士兵。数周后，当一群理事军试图闯入归航者残骸时，在辉耀狼蛛巡逻路径边缘被发现并遭遇。12名突击队员中仅两人侥幸逃生，他们对辉耀狼蛛及其能力的描述相互矛盾，致使理事军无法对进一步遭遇制定有效的方案。

根据调查站A01严谨的新械族计算，一条严格的隔离带已沿着辉耀狼蛛的巡逻路径建立。阿巴隆的构装体知晓这个存在与先驱者之间存在关联，正全力寻求与这个巡逻在坠毁星舰外部荒原的科技组件集群进行沟通的途径。迄今未获进展，他们已向协约世界各处发出紧急呼吁，招募语言学与计算机专家前往阿基顿协助研究。

在新械族持续进行实验的区域，伊洛里图的学者们揭示了辉耀狼蛛与平行现实概念之间令人不安的关联。某种程度上，辉耀狼蛛的活动会在现实中形成稳固点，那些与多元宇宙联系更紧密的生物所拥有的独特力量，在此处会莫名受阻，或被迫服从辉耀狼蛛的意志。此现象的成因至今成谜，而新械族似乎尚未意识到有必要探究这个谜团。

辉耀狼蛛的出现，让人相信它是神秘先驱者古老科技的守护者。辉耀狼蛛的科技组件与从阿巴隆提取的数据之间的相似之处，几乎证实了这一理论。然而，这种关联引出了一个问题：辉耀狼蛛仅有一只，还是先驱者众多高度先进的守卫构装体之一？先驱者本身，是否可能是协约世界全然无法抗衡的种族？

Heightened (10th) The cold and fire damage each increase by 2d12.
items.description:
你探入虚空并召来一片危险的宇宙物质，其在一个垂直圆柱内摧毁其中生物，并将地形化为星尘漩涡。这种物质由燃烧的恒星或冰冻的彗星组成，对施法时区域内的所有生物造成5d12火焰伤害和5d12寒冷伤害。在法术持续期间内，宇宙物质降低了能见度和机动性，使该区域内变为高等困难地形并且让该区域内或者透过其的所有事物获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]。

升阶（10环）寒冷伤害和火焰伤害各增加2d12。

items.name: 预警术
items.expectedDescription:
You gain a sixth sense that warns you of danger that might befall the target of the spell. If you choose a creature other than yourself as the target, you create a psychic link through which you can inform the target of danger. This link is a mental effect. Due to the amount of information this spell requires you to process, you can't have more than one foresight spell in effect at a time. Casting foresight again ends the previous foresight. While foresight is in effect, the target gains a +2 status bonus to initiative rolls and isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} creatures or when flanked. In addition, you gain the following reaction: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VOEWhPQfN3lvHivK]{Foresight}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.X9Na6IK8FSPcTuoc]{Spell Effect: Foresight}
items.description:
你获得会警告你法术目标可能遭遇危险的第六感。若目标是自身以外的生物，你会与其建立心灵链接，通过链接告知其危险。此链接是心灵效应。由于此法术要求你处理大量信息，同一时间你只能有一个预警术生效。再次施放预警术会结束先前的预警术。预警术生效期间，目标的先攻掷骰获得+2状态加值，并且不会因以下情形陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}：面对@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{无踪}生物，或被夹击。此外，你获得以下反应：@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VOEWhPQfN3lvHivK]{预警术}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.X9Na6IK8FSPcTuoc]{法术效果：预警术}

items.name: 播种奇点
items.expectedDescription:
A tiny particle of incredibly dense mass magically blossoms into a gravitational singularity that pulls creatures toward it and spatially compresses any creatures that are moved into it. You create a singularity in a 5-foot square that is unoccupied by any creatures. All creatures and unsecured objects in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:50] around the singularity are moved toward the singularity when the spell is cast, depending on their Reflex save (see below). Creatures and objects are moved starting with those closest to the singularity, so they might block the path of other creatures and objects that are pulled in later.

Creatures' spaces can overlap in the square that contains the singularity. A creature or object that enters the singularity or ends its turn there takes 10d10 bludgeoning damage with no saving throw. While in the singularity, a creature can take no actions except to attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} against your Spell DC. When the spell ends, the singularity disappears, and overlapping creatures are moved to the closest unoccupied space, as determined by the GM.

Squares in the emanation are difficult terrain for creatures moving away from the singularity, and creatures moving toward the singularity can move 10 feet for each 5 feet of movement they spend.

A creature needs to attempt a Reflex save if it's in the area when the spell is cast and when it ends its turn in the area.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is pulled 10 feet toward the singularity.

Failure The creature is pulled 20 feet toward the singularity.

Critical Failure The creature is pulled 30 feet toward the singularity.
items.description:
一粒质量极其密集的微小粒子在魔法作用下扩展为引力奇点，将生物拉向自身，并在空间上压缩被移入其中的生物。你在一个未被任何生物占据的5尺方格内创造一个奇点。法术施放时，奇点周围@Template[type:emanation|distance:50]内的所有生物和未被固定的物体，根据其反射豁免结果向奇点移动（见下文）。生物和物体从距离奇点最近者开始移动，因此它们可能挡住随后被拉入的其他生物和物体的路径。

生物的空间可以在包含奇点的方格内重叠。进入奇点或在其中结束其回合的生物或物体受到10d10钝击伤害，无法豁免。在奇点内，生物除了对抗你的法术DC尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{逃脱}之外，无法采取任何动作。法术结束时，奇点消失，重叠的生物被移至最近的未占用空间，具体由GM决定。

对于向远离奇点方向移动的生物，弥漫区域内的方格是困难地形；向奇点靠近的生物每花费5尺移动距离，便可移动10尺。

施放法术时位于区域内，以及在区域内结束其回合的生物，需要尝试一次反射豁免。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功该生物被拉向奇点10尺。

失败该生物被拉向奇点20尺。

大失败该生被拉向奇点30尺。

items.name: 噬星爆发
items.expectedDescription:
A globe of freezing darkness explodes in the area, dealing 8d10 cold damage to creatures in the area, plus an additional 8d4 void damage to living creatures. Each creature in the area must attempt a Reflex save.

If the globe overlaps with an area of magical light or affects a creature affected by magical light, eclipse burst attempts to counteract the light effect.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} by the darkness for an unlimited duration.

Heightened (+1) The cold damage increases by 1d10 and the void damage against the living increases by 1d4.
items.description:
一颗冰寒的黑暗球体在区域中爆发，对区域内生物造成8d10寒冷伤害，并对活物额外造成8d4虚能伤害。区域中的每个生物都必须尝试反射豁免。

若球体与魔法光照区域重叠，或影响到正受到魔法光照影响的生物，噬星爆发会尝试反制该光照效果。

大成功 生物不受影响。

成功 生物受到一半伤害。

失败 该生物承受完整伤害。

大失败 生物受到双倍伤害，并因黑暗而陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲}，持续时间无限。

升阶（+1） 寒冷伤害增加1d10，对活物的虚能伤害增加1d4。

items.name: 辟能圣盾
items.expectedDescription:
You protect the target with a powerful, long-lasting energy barrier. The target gains resistance 5 to acid, cold, electricity, fire, force, sonic, vitality, and void damage.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.4Lo2qb5PmavSsLNk]{Spell Effect: Energy Aegis}

Heightened (9th) The resistances increase to 10.
items.description:
你使用长效的强力能量护盾保护目标。目标获得对酸蚀、寒冷、电击、火焰、力场、音波、命能、以及虚能伤害的抗力5。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.4Lo2qb5PmavSsLNk]{法术效果：辟能圣盾}

升阶（9环） 该抗力提升到10。

items.name: 跨界传送
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements You have a planar key for the destination plane, used as a locus

You and your allies traverse the barriers between planes of existence. The targets move to another plane, such as the Plane of Fire, the Netherworld, or the Outer Rifts. You must know the destination plane exists and use a magic planar key created from material from that plane as a locus for the spell. While the planar keys for most prominent planes are uncommon, just like the spell interplanar teleport, more obscure planes and demiplanes often have rare or possibly even unique planar keys.

The spell is highly imprecise, and you appear 1d20×25 miles from the last place one of the targets (of your choice) was located the last time that target traveled to the plane. If it's the first time traveling to a particular plane for all targets, you appear at a random location on the plane. Interplanar teleport doesn't provide a means of return travel, though casting interplanar teleport again allows you to return to your previous plane unless there are extenuating circumstances.
items.description:
需求 你持有目的地位面的位面密钥，用作施法载体

你和你的盟友跨越位面之间的屏障进行旅行。目标移动至其他位面，比如火元素位面、幽界、或者外层裂隙。你必须知晓目标位面的存在，而且需要使用由该位面的物质制作的魔法位面密钥作为本法术的施法载体。就如同跨界传送这个法术本身一样，大多数著名位面的位面密钥具有罕见稀有度，而鲜为人知的位面及半位面通常具有稀有、甚至有可能具有独特稀有度的位面密钥。

该法术极其不精准，你会出现在目标之一（由你选择）上一次造访该位面时的位置周边，误差为1d20×25里。若所有目标都是初次造访某个特定位面，你们就会出现在该位面的随机位置。跨界传送不会提供返回的手段，不过除非发生了什么另外情况，否则再次施放跨界传送能让你返回自身之前身处的位面。

items.name: 阳炎爆
items.expectedDescription:
A powerful globe of searing sunlight explodes in the area, dealing 8d10 fire damage to all creatures in the area, plus an additional @Damage[(@item.level+1)d10[vitality]] damage to undead creatures. Each creature in the area must attempt a Reflex save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes full damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} permanently.

If the globe overlaps with an area of magical darkness, sunburst attempts to counteract the darkness effect.

Heightened (+1) The fire damage increases by 1d10, and the vitality damage against undead increases by 1d10.
items.description:
强力而耀眼的球状日光在区域中爆开，对该区域中的生物造成8d10火焰伤害，以及对不死生物造成额外@Damage[(@item.level+1)d10[vitality]]伤害。在该区域中的每个生物必须尝试一次反射豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物承受一半伤害。

失败 该生物承受完整伤害。

大失败 该生物承受完整伤害，并且永久 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲} 。

如果阳炎爆的球状区域与魔法黑暗的区域部分重叠，则会尝试反制该黑暗效果。

升阶（+1） 该火焰伤害增加1d10，并且对不死生物的命能伤害增加1d10。

items.name: 排斥术
items.expectedDescription:
You manifest an aura that prevents creatures from approaching you. When casting the spell, you can make the area any radius you choose, up to 40 feet. A creature must attempt a Will save if it's within the area when you Cast the Spell or as soon as it enters the area while the spell is in effect. Once a creature has attempted the save, it uses the same result for that casting of repulsion. Any restrictions on a creature's movement apply only if it voluntarily moves toward you. For example, if you move closer to a creature, it doesn't then need to move away.

Critical Success The creature's movement is not restricted.

Success The creature treats each square in the area as difficult terrain when moving closer to you.

Failure The creature can't move closer to you within the area.
items.description:
你创造一个令生物无法接近你的灵光。当施放该法术时，你可以令区域为任何你所选择的半径，至多40尺。当你施放该法术时位于区域中的生物，以及在法术生效时进入该区域的生物必须尝试一次意志豁免。生物尝试过该豁免后，对于这次施放的排斥术总使用相同的结果。仅当生物自愿向你移动时，任何对其的移动限制才会生效。例如，如果你移动靠近一个生物，它不需要走远。

大成功 该生物的移动不受影响。

成功 该生物移动靠近你时，将区域中的每一格视为困难地形。

失败 在该区域中，该生物无法移动靠近你。

items.name: 传送术
items.expectedDescription:
You and the targets are instantly transported to any location within range, as long as you can identify the location precisely both by its position relative to your starting position and by its appearance (or other identifying features). Incorrect knowledge of the location's appearance usually causes the spell to fail, but it could instead lead to teleporting to an unwanted location or some other unusual mishap determined by the GM. Teleport is not precise over great distances. The targets appear at a distance from the intended destination equal to roughly 1 percent of the total distance traveled, in a direction determined by the GM. For short journeys, this lack of precision is irrelevant, but for long distances this could be up to 1 mile.

Heightened (7th) You and the other targets can travel to any location within 1,000 miles.

Heightened (8th) You and the other targets can travel to any location on the same planet. If you travel more than 1,000 miles, you arrive only 10 miles off target.

Heightened (9th) You and the other targets can travel to any location on another planet within the same solar system. Assuming you have accurate knowledge of the location's position and appearance, you arrive on the new planet 100 miles off target.

Heightened (10th) As the 9th-rank version, but you and the other targets can travel to any planet within the same galaxy.
items.description:
你和目标会立即传送到射程内的任何位置，只要你能通过该地点到你起始地点的相对位置，以及其外观（或者典型特征）来精确定位该地点。关于该地点外观的错误的知识会令法术失败，但它也可能导致传送到非预想地点或者造成其他由GM决定的事故。传送术在距离很远时无法保证精确。目标会在距离目标地大约总旅行距离1%的地方出现，其偏移方向由GM决定。对于短途旅行，这种误差可以忽略，但是对于长距旅行这可能达到1里。

升阶（7环） 你和其他目标可以传送到1000里内的任何地点。

升阶（8环） 你和其他目标可以传送到同一星球上的任何地点。如果你旅行超过1000里，你只会偏移目标10里。

升阶（9环） 你和其他目标可以传送到同一恒星系中任何其他行星上的任意地点。若你对该地点的位置和外观有准确的知识，你会到达该星球上偏移目标100里的位置。

升阶（10环） 如9环阶版本，但是你和其他目标可以旅行到同一星系中的任何行星上。

items.name: 真景术
items.expectedDescription: You see things within 60 feet as they actually are. The GM rolls a secret counteract check against any illusion, morph or polymorph effect in the area, but only for the purpose of determining whether you see through it (for instance, if the check succeeds against a polymorph spell, you can see the creature's true form, but you don't end the polymorph spell).
items.description: 你可以看见60尺内的事物的本来面貌。GM秘密进行一次反制检定，对抗区域中的所有幻术、形变或变形效应，但这只会决定你是否能看破它（例如，如果该检定成功对抗了一个变形法术，你可以看见该生物的本来形态，但你不会结束该变形法术）。

items.name: X光视域
items.expectedDescription: You empower yourself to see through most materials and walls within 60 feet. Your sight is blocked by 2 feet of wood or plastic, 1 foot of stone, 2 inches of common metal, or any amount of lead or any starmetal, and you can only see in black and white.
items.description: 你激活透视能力，可看穿60尺内大多数材质与墙体。你的视线会被2尺厚的木材或塑料，1尺厚的岩石，2寸厚的普通金属或者任意厚度的铅或星金阻隔，并且你的视野为黑白的。

items.name: 放逐术
items.expectedDescription:
You send the target back to its home plane. The target must attempt a Will save. You can spend an extra action while Casting this Spell and add a cost to the spell to give the creature a –2 circumstance penalty to its save. The cost must be a specially gathered object that is anathema to the creature. This spell fails if you aren't on your home plane when you cast it.

Critical Success The target resists being banished and you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Success The target resists being banished.

Failure The target is banished.

Critical Failure The target is banished and can't return by any means to the plane it's banished from for 1 week.

Heightened (9th) You can target up to 10 creatures. The extra cost affects targets to which it is anathema.
items.description:
你将目标送回其原属位面。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。你可以在施放该法术的过程中花费一个额外行动，为该法术添加一个消耗，令该生物在其豁免上承受-2环境减值。此消耗必须是专门收集的一些属于该生物的禁忌（anathema）的物品。如果你施放该法术时未处于你的原属位面，该法术失败。

大成功 该生物成功抵抗被放逐，同时你获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 1}。

成功 该生物成功抵抗被放逐。

失败 目标被放逐。

大失败 该生物被放逐，并且在一周内无法通过任何办法回到被放逐前的位面。

升阶（9环） 你能以至多10个生物作为目标。额外费用只影响将该物品视为禁忌的目标。

items.name: 短讯术
items.expectedDescription: You send the creature a mental message of 25 words or fewer, and it can respond immediately with its own message of 25 words or fewer.
items.description: 你向该生物发送一段25词或者更短的精神信息，它可以立即以自己的一段不超过25词的信息回应。

items.name: 短讯术
items.expectedDescription: You send the creature a mental message of 25 words or fewer, and it can respond immediately with its own message of 25 words or fewer.
items.description: 你向该生物发送一段25词或者更短的精神信息，它可以立即以自己的一段不超过25词的信息回应。

items.name: 实言术（恒定）
items.expectedDescription:
The target can understand all words regardless of language and also speak the languages of other creatures. When in a mixed group of creatures, each time the target speaks, it can choose a creature and speak in a language that creature understands, even if the target doesn't know what language that is.

Heightened (7th) The duration is 8 hours.
items.description:
无论什么语言，目标都可以理解其所有的词语，也能说其他生物的语言。当处于一群各异的生物中时，每次目标说话时，都可以选择一个生物，并使用一种该生物理解的语言来讲述，即使该目标不知道这语言具体是什么。

升阶（7环） 持续时间为8小时。

items.name: 次元拴绳
items.expectedDescription:
You stitch the target to its current plane. While the target is affected by planar tether, the spell attempts to counteract any teleportation effect that would move the target, or any effect that would transport it to a different plane. Planar tether's duration is determined by the target's Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The effect's duration is 1 minute.

Failure The effect's duration is 10 minutes.

Critical Failure The effect's duration is 1 hour.
items.description:
你将目标固定到其当前位面。当目标受到次元拴绳影响时，该法术会尝试反制任何会移动目标的传送效应，以及任何会将其送往另一个位面的效应。次元拴绳的持续时间由目标的意志豁免决定。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 该持续时间为1分钟。

失败 该持续时间为10分钟。

大失败 该持续时间为1小时。

items.name: 英雄气概
items.expectedDescription:
You unlock the target's inner heroism, granting it a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, Perception checks, saving throws, and skill checks.

Heightened (6th) The status bonus increases to +2.

Heightened (9th) The status bonus increases to +3.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.l9HRQggofFGIxEse]{Spell Effect: Heroism}
items.description:
你解放了目标内在的英勇，赋予其在攻击掷骰、察觉检定、豁免和技能检定上的+1状态加值。

升阶（6环） 该状态加值增加到+2。

升阶（9环） 该状态加值增加到+3。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.l9HRQggofFGIxEse]{法术效果：英雄气概}

items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature within range enters an environment that would be harmful to it.

A shimmering bubble envelops the target's body, allowing it to breathe normally in a vacuum or other unsafe environment and protecting it from severe temperatures and radiation.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 5 additional creatures to gain protection against the environment the triggering creature entered. The spell lasts for 8 hours and also protects against extreme temperatures and radiation.

Heightened (10th) You can target up to 10 additional creatures to gain protection against the environment the triggering creature entered. The spell lasts until your next daily preparations and also protects against incredible temperatures and radiation.
items.description:
触发射程内的生物进入对其有害的环境。

一个闪亮的气泡包裹目标的身体，让它在真空或其他不安全的环境中正常呼吸，并保护它免受严重（severe）温度和辐射的伤害。

升阶（7环）你可指定最多5个额外生物为目标，使其获得针对触发生物所处环境的防护效果。法术持续8小时，并且可以抵御极端（extreme ）温度和辐射。

升阶（10环）你可指定最多10个额外生物为目标，使其获得针对触发生物所处环境的防护效果。法术持续到你下次日常准备，并能抵御严酷（incredible ）温度和辐射。
items.name: 生命容器（随意）
安定心神
items.expectedDescription:
You forcibly calm creatures in the area, soothing them into a nonviolent state; each creature must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success Calming urges impose a -1 status penalty to the creature's attack rolls.

Failure Any emotion effects that would affect the creature are suppressed and the creature can't use hostile actions. If the target is subject to hostility from any other creature, it ceases to be affected by calm.

Critical Failure As failure, but hostility doesn't end the effect.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Qr5rgoZvI4KmFY0N]{Spell Effect: Calm}
items.description:
你令区域内的生物强制冷静，令它们进入平和的状态；每个生物必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 平静的冲动令该生物在攻击掷骰上承受-1状态减值。

items.description: 你干扰法术或者效果中的魔法力量。尝试一次反制检定，对抗目标。如果你成功对抗一个魔法物品，该物品成为该类型的普通物品，持续10分钟。这不会改变物体的非魔法性质。如果目标是一件神器或者类似的物品，你自动失败。

items.expectedDescription:

Heightened (5th) The target is protected from severe cold, severe heat, extreme cold, and extreme heat.
items.description:

升阶（5环） 目标受到保护，免遭严寒、炎热、极寒和极热影响。

items.expectedDescription:
A shield of elemental energy protects a creature against one type of energy damage. Choose acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage. The target and its gear gain resistance 5 against the damage type you chose.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.con2Hzt47JjpuUej]{Spell Effect: Resist Energy}

Heightened (7th) The resistance increases to 15, and you can target up to five creatures.
items.description:

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.con2Hzt47JjpuUej]{法术效果：抵抗能量伤害}

items.name: 识破无形
items.expectedDescription:
Your gaze pierces through illusions and finds @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} creatures and spirits. You can see invisible creatures as though they weren't invisible, although their features are blurred, making them @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} and difficult to identify. You can also see incorporeal creatures, like ghosts, phased through an object from within 10 feet of an object's surface as blurry shapes seen through those objects. Subtler clues also grant you a +2 status bonus to checks you make to disbelieve illusions.

Heightened (5th) This spell has a duration of 8 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.T5bk6UH7yuYog1Fp]{Spell Effect: See the Unseen}
items.description:
你的目光穿透了幻术，发现了隐形生物和魂灵。你能看到@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}生物，就如同它们并未隐形一般，然而它们的体征仍然很模糊，使得它们具有@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}并且难以被识别。你还能看到虚体生物，比如穿入物体内的幽灵；你能透过物体，看到位于物体表面以内10尺内的此类生物的模糊轮廓。对细节更强的洞察力还让你在进行识破幻术的检定时，获得+2状态加值。

升阶（5环） 持续时间为8小时。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.T5bk6UH7yuYog1Fp]{法术效果：识破无形}

If you didn't counteract the effect, but you would have if its counteract rank were 2 lower, instead suppress the effect until the beginning of your next turn. The effect's duration doesn't elapse while it's suppressed.

This spell can't counteract or suppress curses, diseases, or conditions that are part of the target's normal state.

Heightened (4th) Add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed} to the list of conditions.

Heightened (6th) As 4th rank, plus add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dTwPJuKgBQCMxixg]{Petrified}.

Heightened (8th) As 4th rank, plus add petrified and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned}.
items.description:

此法术无法反制或压制诅咒、疾病或属于目标正常状态一部分的状态。

升阶（4环） 增加@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢}到状态列表中。

升阶（6环） 同4环阶，额外增加@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dTwPJuKgBQCMxixg]{石化}到状态列表中。

items.name: 关照术
items.expectedDescription:
As long as you and the target are on the same plane of existence and both alive, you remain aware of its present state. You know the target's direction from you, distance from you, and any conditions affecting it.

Heightened (4th) The spell's range increases to 30 feet, and you can target up to 10 creatures.
items.description:
只要你和目标处于相同的位面，并且均活着，你就会一直知晓其当前状态。你知晓目标和你相对的方向，与你的距离，以及任何正影响其的状态。

升阶（4环） 该法术的射程增加到30尺，并且你能以至多10个生物为目标。

items.name: 通译语言
items.expectedDescription:
The target can understand the meaning of a single language it is hearing or reading when you cast the spell. This doesn't let it understand codes, language couched in metaphor, and the like (subject to GM discretion). If the target can hear multiple languages and knows that, it can choose which language to understand; otherwise, choose one of the languages randomly.

Heightened (3rd) The target can also speak the language.

Heightened (4th) You can target up to 10 creatures, and targets can also speak the language.
items.description:
在你施放该法术时，目标会理解其正听到或者阅读的一种语言的含义。这不会令其能够理解密文，使用隐喻表达的含义，或者类似的内容（由GM所判定）。如果目标能够听见数种语言并且了解该情况，它能选择要理解的那种语言；否则，随机选择这种语言。

升阶（3环阶） 该目标也能使用该语言交流。

升阶（4环阶） 你能以至多10个生物作为目标，并且这些目标也能使用该语言交流。

items.name: 侦测魔法
items.expectedDescription:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).
items.description:
你发出一股标记魔法存在的脉冲。你不会获得魔法存在或不存在以外的任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你或者你盟友的魔法物品以及持续法术。仅当幻术魔法的环阶低于你的侦测魔法环阶时，你才能侦测幻术魔法。但是，具有幻术灵光但是没有在外表上做伪装的物品（例如一瓶隐形药水），通常能够正常侦测。

升阶（3环阶） 你能知晓法术侦测出的最强魔法效果的环阶或等级，具体由GM决定。

升阶（4环阶） 如3环阶，你也能指出最高环阶魔法的来源。如同一种模糊感官，你不会了解具体的位置，但是可以将来源锁定到5尺立方（或者最近的那个五尺立方，如果来源体积比这个区域更大）。

items.name: 严厉护卫
items.expectedDescription:
You ward an ally against the attacks and hostile spells from the target enemy. The target ally gains a +1 status bonus to Armor Class and saving throws against the target enemy's attacks, spells, and other effects.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ctMxYPGEpstvhW9C]{Spell Effect: Forbidding Ward}

Heightened (6th) The status bonus increases to +2.
items.description:
你保护一个盟友，以抵御目标敌人的攻击和敌对法术。目标盟友在对抗目标敌人的攻击、法术及其他效应时，AC和豁免获得+1状态加值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ctMxYPGEpstvhW9C]{法术效果：严厉护卫}

升阶（6环） 该状态加值增加到+2。

items.name: 神导术
items.expectedDescription:
You ask for the guidance of supernatural entities, granting the target a +1 status bonus to one attack roll, Perception check, saving throw, or skill check the target attempts before the duration ends. The target chooses which roll to use the bonus on before rolling. If the target uses the bonus, the spell ends. Either way, the target is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3qHKBDF7lrHw8jFK]{Spell Effect: Guidance}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3LyOkV25p7wA181H]{Effect: Guidance Immunity}
items.description:
你请求超自然存在的引导，赋予目标在持续时间结束前的一次攻击掷骰、察觉检定、豁免或技能检定上获得+1状态加值。目标在掷骰前选择是否使用该加值。如果目标使用该加值，该法术结束。无论怎样结束，该目标接下来会临时免疫1小时。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3qHKBDF7lrHw8jFK]{法术效果：神导术}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3LyOkV25p7wA181H]{效果：神导术免疫}

items.name: 治疗术
items.expectedDescription:
You channel vital energy to heal the living or damage the undead. If the target is a willing living creature, you restore 1d8 Hit Points. If the target is undead, you deal that amount of vitality damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 The spell has a range of touch.

2 (concentrate) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing a living creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (concentrate) You disperse vital energy in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. This targets all living and undead creatures in the burst.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.
items.description:
你引导命能，以治疗活物或者伤害不死生物。如果目标是自愿活物，你使其恢复1d8生命值。如果目标是不死生物，你对其造成等量命能伤害，并且它可以进行基础强韧豁免。你在施放该法术时花费的动作数量决定其目标，范围，区域和其他参数。

1 该法术的射程为接触。

2（专注）该法术的射程为30尺。如果你在治疗一个活物，回复的生命值增加8。

3（专注）你在@Template[emanation|distance:30]内释放命能。这会以区域中所有活物和不死生物为目标。

升阶（+1） 治疗或者伤害的量增加1d8，两个动作版本的额外治疗增加8。

items.name: 灌注命能
items.expectedDescription:
You empower attacks with vital energy. The number of targets is equal to the number of actions you spent casting this spell. Each target's unarmed and weapon Strikes deal an extra 1d4 vitality damage. (This damage typically damages only undead). If you have the holy trait, you can add that trait to this spell and to the Strikes affected by the spell.

Heightened (3rd) The damage increases to 2d4 damage.

Heightened (5th) The damage increases to 3d4 damage.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.X7RD0JRxhJV9u2LC]{Spell Effect: Infuse Vitality}
items.description:
你使用命能增强攻击。目标的数量等于你施放该法术时花费的动作数量。每个目标的无武装和武器打击额外造成1d4命能伤害。（该伤害通常只会伤害不死生物）。如果你具有圣洁（holy）特征，你可以将该特征附加到此法术及受其影响的打击上。

升阶（3环） 该伤害增加到2d4。

升阶（5环） 该伤害增加到3d4。

items.name: 调整重心
items.expectedDescription: Applying a combination of vital energy and acupressure, you help the target regain its footing. The target loses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} condition if it has it. The target becomes immune to the off-guard condition until the start of your next turn, even if the condition would be circumstantially applied, such as by being flanked or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. The target is then immune to reorient for 10 minutes.
items.description: 结合使用元气和穴位按摩，帮助目标重新站稳。目标会失去@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]状态（如果有的话）。在下一回合开始前，目标将免疫措手不及状态，即使是被夹击或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]等会施加措手不及情况下也是如此。然后，目标在 10 分钟内对调整重心免疫。

items.name: 庇护术
items.expectedDescription:
You ward a creature with protective energy that deters attacks. Creatures attempting to attack the target must attempt a Will save each time. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends.

Critical Success Sanctuary ends.

Success The creature can attempt its attack and any other attacks against the target this turn.

Failure The creature can't attack the target and wastes the action. It can't attempt further attacks against the target this turn.

Critical Failure The creature wastes the action and can't attempt to attack the target for the rest of sanctuary's duration.
items.description:
你引动防护能量，保护一个生物抵御攻击。尝试攻击该目标的生物必须每次尝试一次意志豁免。如果目标使用敌对动作，该法术结束。

大成功 庇护术结束。

成功 该生物可以尝试这次攻击，并在本回合内继续对目标进行其他攻击。

失败 该生物无法攻击目标，并浪费该动作。本回合内它无法继续尝试攻击目标。

大失败 该生物浪费该动作，并且在庇护术剩余持续时间中均无法尝试攻击目标。

items.name: 灵魂链接
items.expectedDescription:
You form a spiritual link with another creature, taking in its pain. When you Cast this Spell and at the start of each of your turns, if the target is below maximum Hit Points, it regains 2 Hit Points (or the difference between its current and maximum Hit Points, if that's lower). You lose as many Hit Points as the target regained.

This is a spiritual transfer, so no effects apply that would increase the Hit Points the target regains or decrease the Hit Points you lose. This transfer also ignores any temporary Hit Points you or the target have. Since this effect doesn't involve vitality or void energy, spirit link works even if you or the target is undead. While the duration persists, you gain no benefit from regeneration or fast healing. You can Dismiss this spell, and if you're ever at 0 Hit Points, spirit link ends automatically.

Heightened (+1) The number of Hit Points transferred each time increases by 2.
items.description:
你和其他生物建立了一条灵魂链接，令你代为承受其苦痛。当你施放该法术，以及在你回合开始时，如果目标生命值低于其最大生命值，它回复2生命值（或者其当前生命值和最大生命值的差值，如果这更低）。你失去等于目标回复量的生命值。

这是一种基于灵魂的转移，所以没有任何效果会增加目标获得的生命值或者减少你失去的生命值。这种转移也会忽略你或者目标所拥有的任何临时生命值。由于该效果中没有任何命能或者虚能作用，灵魂链接在你或者目标为不死生物时也生效。在持续时间中，你不会从再生或者快速回复中受益。你可以解消该法术，并且一旦你为0生命值，灵魂链接自动结束。

升阶（+1） 每次转移的生命值增加2。

items.name: 稳定伤势
items.expectedDescription: Life energy shuts death's door. The target loses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} condition, though it remains @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} at 0 Hit Points.
items.description: 生命能量将目标从鬼门关拉回。目标失去 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{濒死} 状态，但它仍然 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{失去意识}，并为0生命值。

items.description: 60尺。灵光内所有盟友的各项速度获得+5尺状态加值（若龙与光量子调谐），或所有敌人的各项速度承受–5尺状态减值（若龙与引力子调谐）。
