items.name: 宇宙调谐
items.expectedDescription:
The cosmic dragon is always attuned to an underlying stellar force: either photons or gravitons. They can swap attunement as a free action once at the start of their turn in combat and is otherwise attuned to whichever force they choose at any time outside of combat. The dragon's melee Strikes deal an additional @Damage[2d6[fire]] damage while they're photon-attuned and an additional @Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]] damage plus Knockdown while they're graviton-attuned. The damage of their cosmic blast Strike is likewise determined by their current attunement, as are the effects of some of their other abilities. The dragon can choose to exclude any creatures from any effect of the aura or action that uses the aura.

The dragon can always sense the distance and direction to the nearest Drift beacon and to the Starstone on Absalom Station.
items.description:
宇宙龙始终与某种基本恒星之力调谐：光量子或引力子。战斗中，它可以在回合开始时以自由动作切换调谐，每次回合开始时仅限一次；战斗外则可随时选择与任意一种力量调谐。与光量子调谐时，龙的近战打击额外造成@Damage[2d6[fire]]伤害；与引力子调谐时，额外造成@Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]]伤害并附加击倒。其宇宙爆裂打击的伤害同样由当前调谐状态决定，部分其他能力的效应也是如此。龙可以选择任意生物，使其不受灵光或使用此灵光的动作所产生的任何效应影响。

龙始终能够感知最近的漂流信标和艾巴萨罗姆空间站的星石的距离与方向。

items.name: 星辰吐息
items.expectedDescription: The dragon unleashes divine power like that from the core of a star or black hole, dealing @Damage[13d10[spirit]|options:area-damage] damage in a @Template[type:cone|distance:50] (@Check[will|dc:41|basic|options:area-effect] save). The dragon can't use Stellar Breath for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.
items.description: 龙释放如同源自恒星或黑洞核心的神能，造成@Damage[13d10[spirit]|options:area-damage]伤害，影响@Template[type:cone|distance:50]（@Check[will|dc:41|basic|options:area-effect]豁免）。龙在[[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4轮}内无法使用星辰吐息。

items.name: 星辰微粒
items.expectedDescription: The dragon conjures a mote of stellar energy that shares their current attunement. They direct the mote to a square within 90 feet. While the mote is deployed, the dragon's attunement aura also emanates from that square, with the same emanation radius. The dragon can Sustain to move the mote up to 90 feet or to recall the mote from any distance. The mote is made of cosmic energy, doesn't occupy a space, and can't be targeted or destroyed by any effect.
items.description: 龙召唤一枚与其当前调谐状态一致的恒星能量微粒，并将其指引到90尺内的一个方格。微粒部署期间，龙的调谐灵光也会从该方格弥漫，弥漫半径相同。龙可以维持，以将微粒移动至多90尺，或从任意距离召回微粒。微粒由宇宙能量构成，不占据空间，也无法被任何效应选为目标或摧毁。

items.name: 星辰脉冲
items.expectedDescription:
The dragon imposes an effect on creatures within their attunement aura. The dragon can choose either option for each creature, regardless of their current attunement. The dragon can't use Stellar Pulse again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Stellar Pulse]]{1d4 rounds}.

  • Graviton Each creature must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:41|options:area-effect] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} for 1 round.

  • Photon Each creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} and can use the extra action only to Stride or Strike.
items.description:
该龙对其调谐灵光内的生物施加效果。无论该龙当前处于何种调谐状态，都可以为每个生物选择任一选项。该龙在[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Stellar Pulse]]{1d4轮}内无法再次使用星辰脉冲。

  • 引力子 每个生物必须成功通过一次@Check[fortitude|dc:41|options:area-effect]豁免，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}，持续1轮。

  • 光量子 每个生物获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{迅捷}，且只能将额外动作用于行走或打击。

k02qUbpmQDjr0QX4.name: 古宇宙龙（施法者） Cosmic Dragon (Ancient, Spellcaster)
k02qUbpmQDjr0QX4.publicNotes: 这些威严的龙体现了构成宇宙万物基础并维系其平衡的恒星之力。宇宙龙睿智、合群、耐心，接纳遇见的所有生灵；它们将所有生物视为宇宙中平等的组成部分，既可能与学者共同讨论天体物理，也可能与受压迫者一同感慨命运的曲折。大多数宇宙龙都能变身，但通常只是为了让其他生物感到自在。它们厌恶欺骗，即使处于另一种形态，也总会表明自己是龙。

items.name: 魅影舰队
items.expectedDescription: A menacing vision of a fleet of hostile starships fills the mind of each creature in the area. The ships appear to be 1,000 feet overhead bombarding the ground with laser fire. The vision deals 10d8 mental damage with a basic Will save. On a critical failure, the target also believes it's being pursued and moves to take cover. It must spend an action to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover} on each of its turns, which may require it to first move to a new space or Drop Prone. It can attempt a new Will save at the end of each of its turns, and on a success, it disbelieves the phantasm and stops being forced to Take Cover.
items.description: 该区域内的每只生物脑海中都会浮现出敌对星舰舰队的可怕景象。这些飞船看起来就在头顶上 1,000 英尺处，会用激光炮火轰击地面。该幻象会造成10d8心灵伤害，需要进行基础意志豁免。如果大失败，目标会认为自己被追击，并移动躲避。他必须在每个回合都花费一个动作@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]，这意味着他必须使用第一个动作移动到一个新空间或执行趴下（Drop Prone）动作。他可以在每个回合结束时尝试新的意志豁免，如果成功，目标就会识破幻象，并停止逃跑或畏缩。

items.name: 真景术
items.expectedDescription: You see things within 60 feet as they actually are. The GM rolls a secret counteract check against any illusion, morph or polymorph effect in the area, but only for the purpose of determining whether you see through it (for instance, if the check succeeds against a polymorph spell, you can see the creature's true form, but you don't end the polymorph spell).
items.description: 你可以看见60尺内的事物的本来面貌。GM秘密进行一次反制检定，对抗区域中的所有幻术、形变或变形效应，但这只会决定你是否能看破它（例如，如果该检定成功对抗了一个变形法术，你可以看见该生物的本来形态，但你不会结束该变形法术）。

items.name: 精神质询（随意）
items.expectedDescription:
You cast your thoughts through a creature's mind, sifting for information. You access the target's memories and knowledge unless it fends you off with a Will save.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure Each round of the spell's duration, you can Sustain the spell to ask a different question and attempt to uncover the answer. For each question, the target can attempt a Deception check against your spell DC; if the target succeeds, you don't learn the answer, and on a critical success, the target gives you a false answer that you believe is truthful Once you've asked the target a given question, asking it again, even with a separate casting of mind probe, produces the same result.

Critical Failure As failure, and the target takes a –4 circumstance penalty to Deception checks against your questions.
items.description:
你将你的精神投射入一个生物的精神以寻找信息。除非其成功通过意志豁免抵挡你，否则你可以获得目标的记忆与知识。

成功 目标不受影响。

失败 法术持续时间的每一轮中，你可以维持该法术来询问一个不同的问题，并尝试发现答案。对于每个问题，目标可以尝试一次欺骗检定，对抗你的法术DC；如果目标成功，你不会得知答案，并且当大成功时，目标会提供给你一个假的答案，并且你信以为真。在你向目标提问过一个问题后，再次提问该问题，即使通过另一次施放的精神质询，也会得到相同的结果。

大失败 如同失败，并且目标在对抗你的问题的欺骗检定上承受-4环境减值。

items.name: 神经脉冲
items.expectedDescription:
You emit a pulsating mental blast that penetrates the minds of all enemies in the area. Each enemy in the area must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2}.

Critical Failure The creature is Stunned for 1 round.
items.description:
你释放出爆发的精神脉冲，穿透区域中每个敌人的精神。每个该区域中的敌人必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 1}。

失败 该生物获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 2}。

大失败 该生物震慑，持续1轮。

items.name: 净化苦难
items.expectedDescription:
Gentle restorative magic pushes back the effects of toxins and more complex maladies. Choose an affliction on the target, such as a curse, disease, or poison. If it has advanced past stage one, reduce the stage by one. This reduction can be applied only once to a given case of an affliction, with the case ending when it's completely cured. Although the reduction can't occur again, heightened versions of this spell attempt to counteract with each casting.

Heightened (3rd) Attempt to counteract the affliction if it is a disease or poison.

Heightened (4th) Attempt to counteract the affliction if it is a curse, disease, or poison.
items.description:
温和的恢复魔法抑制毒素和更复杂疾患的影响。选择目标的一个苦难，例如诅咒、疾病、或者毒素。如果它已经超过阶段1，减少1个阶段。直到某一次苦难被完全治愈之前，对于这次苦难，这种减少只能生效一次。尽管这种减少不能再次发生，升阶版本的该法术每次施法都能尝试反制它。

升阶（3环） 如果苦难是疾病或者毒素，尝试反制它。

升阶（4环） 如果苦难是诅咒、疾病或者毒素，尝试反制它。

items.name: 恐惧术（随意）
items.expectedDescription:
You plant fear in the target; it must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to five creatures.
items.description:
你将恐惧植入目标；它必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}。

失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}。

大失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 3}，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}，持续1轮。

升阶（3环） 你能以至多五个生物为目标。

items.name: 治疗术
items.expectedDescription:
You channel vital energy to heal the living or damage the undead. If the target is a willing living creature, you restore 1d8 Hit Points. If the target is undead, you deal that amount of vitality damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 The spell has a range of touch.

2 (concentrate) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing a living creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (concentrate) You disperse vital energy in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. This targets all living and undead creatures in the burst.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.
items.description:
你引导命能，以治疗活物或者伤害不死生物。如果目标是自愿活物，你使其恢复1d8生命值。如果目标是不死生物，你对其造成等量命能伤害，并且它可以进行基础强韧豁免。你在施放该法术时花费的动作数量决定其目标，范围，区域和其他参数。

1 该法术的射程为接触。

2（专注）该法术的射程为30尺。如果你在治疗一个活物，回复的生命值增加8。

3（专注）你在@Template[emanation|distance:30]内释放命能。这会以区域中所有活物和不死生物为目标。

升阶（+1） 治疗或者伤害的量增加1d8，两个动作版本的额外治疗增加8。

items.name: 扩散
items.expectedDescription: The shaa spreads their matter thin, becoming Gargantuan and gaining a space and reach of 20 feet. The shaa can take only purely mental actions or use Thicken while in this state. A shaa can return to their normal size by spending a single action, which has the concentrate trait.
items.description: 纱将自身物质摊薄，变为巨型，占据空间与触及均变为20尺。处于此状态时，纱只能使用纯粹的心智动作或使用凝聚。纱可以花费一个具有专注特征的单动作恢复正常体型。

items.name: 凝聚
items.expectedDescription: The shaa agitates their molecules and becomes semitransparent and virtually impenetrable for 1 minute. In this form, the shaa isn't incorporeal, gains resistance 25 to all damage, and gains 150 temporary Hit Points for 1 minute. They can take no actions and are immovable. The shaa reverts to their natural form at the end of the duration.
items.description: 纱激发自身的分子，变得半透明且几乎无法穿透，持续1分钟。处于此形态时，纱不再是虚体，获得对所有伤害的抗力25，并获得150点临时生命值，持续1分钟。它无法使用任何动作，也无法被移动。持续时间结束时，纱恢复自身的自然形态。

items.name: 病毒蒸汽
items.expectedDescription:
Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:37]

Stage 1 carrier (1 day)

Stage 2 the creature becomes partially vaporous and treats all other creatures as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} (1 day)

Stage 3 the creature is incorporeal and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} (1 day)

kT4Inc0H9UO3yU5h.name: 黑蚀-纱（纱形态） Haeshi-Shaa (Shaa Form)
kT4Inc0H9UO3yU5h.publicNotes:
尽管处于纱形态时明显更为强大，黑蚀-纱往往会将生命的这一阶段用于深思。若沉思被打断，纱会成为报复心极强的敌人。

黑蚀-纱是黑色支配者中相对较新的成员。这些寿命悠长的生物，在一生中会持续以一种神秘的周期，在液态与气态之间不可预测地转换。在液态的黑蚀（haeshi）形态下，它们是翻腾涌动、混有块状物的流体；而在气态的纱（shaa）形态下，它们则更像是朦胧的棕色雾气。无论处于何种形态，它们都会发出没有调子的和声嗡鸣，令他人深感不适。

黑蚀-纱在黑色支配者中作为某种祭司阶层存在，其两种形态均宣扬熵增与湮灭的教义，不过两种形态的理解有着微小的差异。黑蚀形态倾向于采取积极、激进的实践方式，而纱形态则更倾向于进行冥想，常常会花费数月甚至数年的时间进行沉思。黑蚀-纱坚信，任何物体或生物最完美、最神圣的状态，是彻底分解为其最基本的粒子个体。它们声称（但这一说法存疑）自己能够看见，甚至预测所有事物迈向熵寂的终点这一过程的轨迹。

事实上，黑蚀-纱连自己何时会转换为另一种形态都无法预测。有些黑蚀-纱曾试图通过寻求特定类型的生命体验或知识来催化这种转变，虽然有许多相反的说法，却从未有确凿的实例证明有黑蚀-纱能强行促成这种转变。大多数黑蚀-纱选择静静地等待下一次蜕变，在等待期间，它们有长达数个世纪的时间来传播黑色支配者那令人不安的教义，并推进它们那神秘莫测的计划。

kq2FWmVIIxoKc4pj.publicNotes:
智慧绿色球体最近才出现在协约世界（Pact Worlds）的空间中，而且它们出现的地方，从来不见紫色球体的踪影。尽管这两种球体的历史与关系尚不明确，但学者们至少发现它们使用同一种语言交流，且生理构造相似。然而，它们的行为与紫色球体截然不同：它们回避与其他生物接触，极少交朋友，且只要有机会就会撒谎，尽管它们并不擅长欺骗，就如同紫色球体尽管竭尽全力却仍不擅长交涉一样。一些学者开始猜测，这两类球体或许互为敌人，尽管并无它们之间发生冲突的记录，也没有任何智慧球体愿意深入探讨另一类球体。绿色球体在大多数话题上都倾向于撒谎，这进一步增加了对智慧球体及其明显敌对关系的研究难度。

智慧绿色球体的直径为3尺，与智慧紫色球体相仿，但若被问及其体型（或几乎任何其他特征），它们总会给出稍有些不准确的答案——三尺半、两尺四寸——总之，它们认为怎么说能让对方更印象深刻或更困惑就怎么说。它们唯一从不撒谎的特征是颜色（它们都坚称，所有智慧绿色球体的颜色都完全一致，这并不完全正确，它们的颜色存在细微的差异）。它们会乐此不疲地与周围的人争论绿色的确切色调。不止一人有过这样的推测：智慧绿色球体通过与他人进行无意义的争论来获取某种养分，但更有可能的是，它们根本不需要养分，只是单纯享受这种争论的过程。

当智慧绿色球体觉得自己即将输掉一场争论时，它们通常会使用炽光闪现，然后飞走。

这些神秘的球形生物似乎没有母星、组织化的社会、传统或宗教信仰。人们对它们的目击事件零星发生——它们会短暂大量出现，随后消失一年或更久，然后又在宇宙中完全不同的区域重新现身数月。学者和这些球体的朋友注意到，每次它们现身时，其数量都在减少。

智慧球体偶尔会形成永久性联结，三到六个球体（据人们所知，它们总是同类型）融合成一个被称为发光体（luminant）的团体。只有处于生命周期高级阶段的智慧球体才能形成这样的团体，且这种融合是永久且不可逆转的。发光体拥有极高的智慧，但比其他智慧球体更为隐居避世，因此很难洞察它们在智慧球体社会中的动机或目的。

kvgMMU0WDsVCw94m.publicNotes:
小塔布里德形似螃蟹的查兹蟹以科皮（copi）为原材料构筑甲壳——这种类似珊瑚的水螅体也是构成类人生物珊瑚人身体的物质。科皮内部含有特殊空腔，能将物质压缩成密集储存物，形成类似黑洞的加压腔室。查兹蟹用爪分解科皮后，将材料融入自身甲壳，在体表创造出重力井效应。除非因受伤或生病死亡，否则它们实际处于永生状态。传说它们的甲壳会随年龄增长持续扩张——在珊瑚人的民间故事中，查兹蟹被描绘得如同岛屿般庞大。

AG 322年，小塔布里德的一场近海大陆架崩塌摧毁了该星球上查兹蟹的主要产卵地，但这并非这种顽强物种的终结。AG 324 年，邻近星系的科研团队监测到剧烈波动的重力测量读数。循着这些异常读数，科学家发现并追踪了一群沿着本地漂流航道（Drift lane）迁徙的查兹蟹。查兹蟹的这种迁徙行为是全新出现的，许多科学家热衷于研究这些被称为筏群（rafts）的迁徙群体。次年，更多查兹蟹筏群现身于其他星系，包括加瓦尼斯卡星系与协约星系。

l02q2ZmGsBNX4zHx.name: 闪晶石哨兵 Shimmerstone Sentinel
l02q2ZmGsBNX4zHx.publicNotes: 作为强大的守护构装体，闪晶石哨兵能够操控并吸收情感，将敌人的情绪反而作为自身的武器加以利用。它们由闪晶石铸造而成——这种具有共情能力的矿物开采自维斯克八号行星，天然具备平复周围生灵情绪的特性。闪晶石哨兵可汲取强烈的情绪能量，并将其注入自身躯体，从而强化攻击威力。

items.name: 情绪感知
items.expectedDescription: A shimmerstone sentinel can sense the emotions of creatures within the listed range as an imprecise sense. Emotion sense is a precise sense against creatures under an emotion effect. A creature under the effects of calm can't be noticed via emotion sense.
items.description: （情绪，心灵）闪晶石哨兵能以模糊感官察觉到所列范围内生物的情绪。若目标生物正处于情绪效果影响下，情绪感知则成为精确感官。但处于安定心神（Calm）效果影响下的生物，无法通过情绪感知被察觉。

items.name: 吸收敌意
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger The shimmerstone sentinel is damaged by a creature that isn't immune to emotion effects and is within 60 feet

Effect The shimmerstone sentinel absorbs the negative emotions of its attacker, causing its shimmerstone to darken to cloudy red, and becomes emotionally charged.
items.description:
触发 闪晶石哨兵受到来自60尺内一个不免疫情绪效果的生物的伤害

效果 闪晶石哨兵吸收攻击者的负面情绪，使自身的闪晶石变为暗沉浑浊的红色，并进入情绪充能状态。

items.name: 宁静气场
items.expectedDescription: 20 feet. Shimmerstone sentinels exude an aura of calm. Each time a creature in the area attempts an offensive action, such as an attack or casting a spell, that creature must attempt a @Check[will|dc:29] save; on a failure, the action is disrupted. A creature that succeeds becomes temporarily immune to the shimmerstone sentinel's calming presence for 1 day.
items.description: 20尺。闪晶石哨兵散发出宁静的灵光。每当区域内的生物尝试进攻性动作，例如攻击或施法，该生物都必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:29]豁免；失败时，该动作被打断。成功的生物对该闪晶石哨兵的宁静气场暂时免疫1天。

items.name: 情绪充能
items.expectedDescription: A shimmerstone sentinel that's emotionally charged deals an additional @Damage[1d8[mental]] damage with its Strikes. In addition, a creature damaged by an emotionally charged shimmerstone sentinel's fist or shimmer beam Strike is bombarded by emotion and must attempt a @Check[will|dc:32] save. On a critical failure, the creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round.
items.description: 处于情绪充能状态的闪晶石哨兵，其打击额外造成@Damage[1d8[mental]]伤害。此外，处于情绪充能状态的闪晶石哨兵用拳头或闪光射线打击造成伤害时，受伤生物会遭受情绪冲击，必须尝试@Check[will|dc:32]豁免。大失败时，该生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{困惑}，持续1轮。

items.name: 强势推进
items.expectedDescription: The shimmerstone sentinel Strides up to its Speed, pushing back each creature whose space it moves into and damaging them if they try to stop its movement. A creature can bar the way by succeeding at a @Check[fortitude|dc:32] save. On a critical success, the resisting creature takes no damage; otherwise, it's damaged as if hit by the shimmerstone sentinel's fist.
items.description: 闪晶石哨兵行走至多其速度的距离。它每进入一个生物占据的空间，就将该生物向后推开；如果该生物试图阻止其移动，则对其造成伤害。生物若成功通过@Check[fortitude|dc:32]豁免，便可阻挡去路。大成功时，阻挡者不受伤害；否则，它受到如同被闪晶石哨兵拳头命中所造成的伤害。

items.name: 释放情绪
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements The shimmerstone sentinel is emotionally charged

Effect The shimmerstone sentinel releases the negative emotions it absorbed in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] that affects the minds of nearby creatures. Creatures in the area take @Damage[7d6[mental]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[will|dc:32|basic] save). On a failure, a creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round, or for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds} on a critical failure. The shimmerstone sentinel is no longer emotionally charged.
items.description:
需求 闪晶石哨兵处于情绪充能状态

效果 闪晶石哨兵将吸收的负面情绪释放至@Template[type:emanation|distance:30]内，影响附近生物的心智。区域内生物受到@Damage[7d6[mental]|options:area-damage]伤害（@Check[will|dc:32|basic]豁免）。失败时，生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{困惑}，持续1轮；大失败时则持续[[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4轮}。闪晶石哨兵不再处于情绪充能状态。

items.name: 地缚术
items.expectedDescription:
Using the weight of earth, you hamper a target's flight, with effects based on its Fortitude save. If the creature reaches the ground safely, it doesn't take falling damage.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target falls safely up to 120 feet.

Failure The target falls safely up to 120 feet. If it hits the ground, it can't Fly, levitate, or otherwise leave the ground for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target falls safely up to 120 feet. If it hits the ground, it can't Fly, levitate, or otherwise leave the ground for 1 minute.
items.description:
你使用大地的重量以干扰目标的飞行能力，其效果基于强韧豁免。如果该生物安全到达地面，它不会承受坠落伤害。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标安全坠落至多120尺。

失败 目标安全坠落至多120尺。如果它碰到地面，它1轮内不能飞行，浮空或者以其他方式离开地面。

大失败 目标安全坠落至多120尺。如果它碰到地面，它1分钟内不能飞行，浮空或者以其他方式离开地面。

items.name: 生命容器
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature within range enters an environment that would be harmful to it.

A shimmering bubble envelops the target's body, allowing it to breathe normally in a vacuum or other unsafe environment and protecting it from severe temperatures and radiation.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 5 additional creatures to gain protection against the environment the triggering creature entered. The spell lasts for 8 hours and also protects against extreme temperatures and radiation.

Heightened (10th) You can target up to 10 additional creatures to gain protection against the environment the triggering creature entered. The spell lasts until your next daily preparations and also protects against incredible temperatures and radiation.
items.description:
触发射程内的生物进入对其有害的环境。

一个闪亮的气泡包裹目标的身体，让它在真空或其他不安全的环境中正常呼吸，并保护它免受严重（severe）温度和辐射的伤害。

升阶（7环）你可指定最多5个额外生物为目标，使其获得针对触发生物所处环境的防护效果。法术持续8小时，并且可以抵御极端（extreme ）温度和辐射。

升阶（10环）你可指定最多10个额外生物为目标，使其获得针对触发生物所处环境的防护效果。法术持续到你下次日常准备，并能抵御严酷（incredible ）温度和辐射。

items.name: 风墙术
items.expectedDescription:
You create a barrier of gusting winds that hinders anything moving through it. The wall of swirling winds is 5 feet thick, 60 feet long, and 30 feet high. The wall stands vertically, but you can shape its path. Though the wall of wind distorts the air, it does not hamper sight. The wall has the following effects.

  • Ammunition from physical ranged attacks-such as arrows, bolts, sling bullets, and other objects of similar size-can't pass through the wall. Attacks with bigger ranged weapons, such as javelins, take a -2 circumstance penalty to their attack rolls if their paths pass through the wall. Massive ranged weapons and spell effects that don't create physical objects pass through the wall with no penalty.
  • The wall is difficult terrain to creatures attempting to move overland through it. Gases, including creatures in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.V8wXOsoejQhe6CyG]{Vapor Form}, can't pass through the wall.
  • A creature that attempts to fly through the wall using a move action must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature can move through the wall normally this turn.

Success The flying creature can move through the wall this turn, but the wall is difficult terrain.

Failure The wall stops the movement of the flying creature, and any remaining movement from its current action is wasted.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature is pushed 10 feet away from the wall.
items.description:
你创造一层会干扰所有通过事物的暴风墙。这面由旋风组成的墙有5尺厚，60尺长，30尺高。该墙为竖直的，但你可以指定其形态。虽然风墙会搅动空气，但不会阻碍视觉。该墙壁具有下列效果。

  • 来自物理远程攻击的弹药（例如箭，矢，投石索弹丸，以及其他类似大小的物体）无法穿过该墙。更大的远程武器的攻击，例如标枪，如果其路线通过该墙壁，则其在攻击掷骰上承受-2环境减值。重型远程武器和不创造实体物体的法术效果可以不受减值地通过该墙。
  • 该墙对尝试从地面通过它的生物为困难地形。气体，以及处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.V8wXOsoejQhe6CyG]{蒸汽形态}的生物，无法穿过墙壁。
  • 尝试使用移动动作飞过墙壁的生物必须尝试一次强韧豁免。

大成功 该生物本回合可以正常移动穿过该墙。

成功 该飞行生物本回合可以穿过该墙，但该墙为困难地形。

失败 该墙阻挡飞行生物的移动，并且当前动作的剩余移动力被浪费。

大失败 如同失败，并且该生物会被推离该墙10尺。

items.name: 纠缠植被
items.expectedDescription:
Plants and fungi burst out or quickly grow, entangling creatures. All surfaces in the area are difficult terrain. Each round that a creature starts its turn in the area, it must attempt a Reflex save. On a failure, it takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds until it leaves the area, and on a critical failure, it's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} for 1 round. Creatures can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} to remove these effects.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.rjM25qfw5BKj9h97]{Spell Effect: Entangling Flora}
items.description:
植物与菌类无法抑制地快速成长，缠绕生物。区域内的所有表面均为困难地形。对于每轮内在该区域内开始自身回合的生物，必须尝试一次反射豁免。失败时，其速度承受-10尺环境减值，直至离开该区域为止，大失败时，它还会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}1轮。生物能够尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{逃脱}来移除这些效果。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.rjM25qfw5BKj9h97]{法术效果：纠缠植被}

extraFields.expected: all squares in a 20-foot-radius burst that contain plants
extraFields.text: 20尺半径爆发范围内所有含有植物的方格

items.name: 忍受环境
items.expectedDescription:
You shield the target against dangerous temperatures. Choose severe cold or heat. The target is protected from the temperature you chose (but not extreme cold or heat).

Heightened (3rd) The target is protected from severe cold and severe heat.

Heightened (5th) The target is protected from severe cold, severe heat, extreme cold, and extreme heat.
items.description:
你保护目标对抗危险气温。选择严寒或炎热。目标不受你选择的气温的影响，但这对极寒和极热无效。

升阶（3环） 目标受到保护，免遭严寒和炎热影响。

升阶（5环） 目标受到保护，免遭严寒、炎热、极寒和极热影响。

items.name: 动物交谈
items.expectedDescription: You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with animals. The spell doesn't make them more friendly than normal. Cunning animals are likely to be terse and evasive, while less intelligent ones often make inane comments.
items.description: 你能向动物提问、得到动物的回答、以及对动物使用交涉技能。该法术不会让动物们变得比平时更加友善。狡猾动物的沟通表现得简短且模棱两可，而缺乏智能的动物通常会发表无意义的意见。

items.name: 水中呼吸
items.expectedDescription:
The targets can breathe underwater.

Heightened (3rd) The duration increases to 8 hours.

Heightened (4th) The duration increases to until your next daily preparations.
items.description:
目标可以在水中呼吸。

升阶（3环） 该持续时间增加到8小时。

升阶（4环） 持续时间延长至你的下次每日准备。

items.name: 重负术
items.expectedDescription:
You reinforce the target's musculoskeletal system to bear more weight. The target can carry 3 more Bulk than normal before becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]{Encumbered} and up to a maximum of 6 more Bulk.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.5yCL7InrJDHpaQjz]{Spell Effect: Ant Haul}
items.description:
你增强了目标的骨骼和肌肉系统，以承受更大的重量。目标在陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]{超载}前，可比平常多携带3负载，最大承载量也增加6负载。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.5yCL7InrJDHpaQjz]{法术效果：重负术}

items.name: 酸液喷溅
items.expectedDescription:
You fling a large glob of acid that immediately detonates, spraying nearby creatures. Creatures in the area take 1d8 acid damage with a basic Reflex save; on a critical failure, the creature also takes @Damage[(1+floor((@item.rank -1)/2))[persistent,acid]] damage.

Heightened (+2) The initial damage increases by 1d8, and the persistent damage on a critical failure increases by 1.
items.description:
你发射一团立即爆发的酸液，泼溅到周围生物上。区域中的生物承受1d8酸蚀伤害，这有一次基础反射豁免；在大失败时，该生物也会承受@Damage[(1+floor((@item.rank -1)/2))[persistent,acid]]伤害。

升阶（+2） 该初始伤害增加1d8，并且大失败时的持续伤害增加1。

items.name: 侦测魔法
items.expectedDescription:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).
items.description:
你发出一股标记魔法存在的脉冲。你不会获得魔法存在或不存在以外的任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你或者你盟友的魔法物品以及持续法术。仅当幻术魔法的环阶低于你的侦测魔法环阶时，你才能侦测幻术魔法。但是，具有幻术灵光但是没有在外表上做伪装的物品（例如一瓶隐形药水），通常能够正常侦测。

升阶（3环阶） 你能知晓法术侦测出的最强魔法效果的环阶或等级，具体由GM决定。

升阶（4环阶） 如3环阶，你也能指出最高环阶魔法的来源。如同一种模糊感官，你不会了解具体的位置，但是可以将来源锁定到5尺立方（或者最近的那个五尺立方，如果来源体积比这个区域更大）。

items.name: 侦测毒素
items.expectedDescription:
You detect whether a creature is venomous or poisonous, or if an object is poison or has been poisoned. You do not ascertain whether the target is poisonous in multiple ways, nor do you learn the type or types of poison. Certain substances, like lead and alcohol, are poisons and so mask other poisons.

Heightened (2nd) You learn the number and types of poison.
items.description:
你可以侦测一个生物是否分泌毒素或者具有毒素，或者一件物体是否是毒素或者已经被下毒。你无法判断目标是否有多种毒素，也无法了解毒素的种类。特定的物质，例如铅或者酒精，是毒素，并会遮盖其他毒素。

升阶（2环） 你会得知毒素的数量和类型。

items.name: 恐惧术
items.expectedDescription:
You plant fear in the target; it must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to five creatures.
items.description:
你将恐惧植入目标；它必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}。

失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}。

大失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 3}，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}，持续1轮。

l30BDEavVjQCIMJu.publicNotes: 无论这些行动迟缓、贪食的巨龙漫游至何处，都有数不胜数的昆虫尾随其后，它们在宿主龙周围蜂拥而至，栖息于宿主龙身体上无数的孔洞之中。宿主龙既是虫群本身的一部分，也是虫群生态的一部分——虫群以它们的身体为食，而龙又以虫群为食；在这一可怖且延续数百年的循环中，即便宿主龙一生未曾摄取任何其他物质，也仍会不断变得更加庞大、更加强大。宿主龙从昆虫的原始本能中汲取力量，尽管它们拥有智慧，却常常表现得像那些聚集在它们身边的昆虫一样。宿主龙厌恶回答问题，并会以激烈手段抗拒他人对其本性的任何探究。

Any creature that touches the image or uses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to examine it can attempt to disbelieve your illusion.

items.name: 机械诡计
items.expectedDescription: When a clangit has spent at least 1 hour exploring a ship or space station, the gremlin gains an innate sense of its inner workings and can remotely control mechanical infrastructure within 60 feet, performing simple actions such as opening and shutting airlocks and doors, opening heat vents, activating alarms, turning lights on and off, or tampering with gravity controls.
items.description: 当空间站小魔怪花费至少1小时在星舰或空间站内探索时，小魔怪便能洞悉其内部运作机制，可以在60尺内远程操控机械设施，执行诸如开启关闭气闸与舱门、开启散热口、启动警报、开关照明设备或干扰重力控制系统等简单操作。

l6ZlVIzPcbVLBxHI.publicNotes:
克朗吉特，或者说空间站小魔怪，对他们栖身空间站的内部运作了如指掌，并乐于惩罚或捉弄那些体型更大、对内部构造的了解却不如它们的居民。那些“闹鬼”的空间站与飞船——伴随着神秘的电力波动、随机开合的舱门、总在关键时刻失灵的设备，以及频发的无法解释的事故——很可能正栖息着一个或多个空间站小魔怪。

当他们不搞恶作剧时，一些空间站小魔怪会监控并维修维持众多老旧空间站运转的精密机械——这一点很可能使它们在艾布萨罗姆空间站等大型聚居地免遭灭绝。大多数空间站小魔怪身高约2尺，体重约7磅——能在通风管道中滑行，挤进狭窄的维修隧道的完美体型。

早在大断层之前很久，小魔怪便以残忍的诡计肆虐物质宇宙，如今它们已完全适应了科技充斥的星系。无论是扰乱通讯装置，星舰，还是整座空间站，小魔怪都乐此不疲地制造毁灭与混乱。

一岁的幼羚豹会聚集在一起形成“幼兽群”（glarings）。它们在出生几天后就会被母兽遗弃，随后会被一头成年羚豹收养，由这头成年兽将它们一并养大。

在阿基顿星的冬域地区旅行时，人们可能会遭遇当地顶级掠食者——食肉性的羚豹。

ltKN9MPVQO9M81Yy.publicNotes:
尖耳的啸叫蝙蝠（kaukarikis）那布满倒刺的尾巴上带有毒液，这使它们在当地获得了“毒刺蝙蝠”（“stingbats”）的绰号。啸叫蝙蝠在温暖森林的树冠层中繁衍生息，它们以大小不一的群体形式聚居，这些群体通常被称为哗众（clamors）。啸叫蝙蝠主要以有毒和半腐烂的水果以及偶尔出现的毒虫为食。虽然它们所吃的大部分食物对其他生物而言都有毒，但啸叫蝙蝠已经进化到能将这种毒素转化为防御机制。它们的身体会处理毒素，并将其储存在尾巴末端的毒刺下方的囊中。随后，它们可以将这种新产生的毒液注入到威胁他们族群的敌对生物体内。

啸叫蝙蝠的哗众会利用它们独特的叫声来吓退捕食者和潜在的入侵者。当一只啸叫蝙蝠察觉到可能的威胁时，它会发出一种颤音般的叫喊声，这种声音正是它们名字的由来。这一信号会提醒附近的其他啸叫蝙蝠，它们会各自发出叫声作为回应，随着啸叫蝙蝠们在树间跳跃、发出呼喊和尖叫，嘈杂的叫喊声迅速增强，音量也越来越大。对于大多数捕食者来说，一想到那些尖叫声背后是带毒刺的尾巴，就足以让它们退缩了，许多哗众依靠这种策略的程度不亚于依靠它们的毒刺。

mbVSG7ZN6OsxmODd.name: 税务级市政机器人 Tax-Class Civil Robot

items.name: 内置商用型脉冲手枪
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This imposing pistol fires a jolt of paralyzing electricity from its barrel. Its remaining charges are visible as glowing lines of energy radiating down its body. Pulsecaster pistols are often used by bounty hunters and law enforcement who need to keep their targets alive.
items.description:

这把威武的手枪从枪管射出一束麻痹电流。剩余充能以沿枪身延伸的发光能量线显示。赏金猎人和执法人员往往需要活捉目标，因此常用脉冲投射手枪。

items.name: 内置渗透者工具包（商用型）
items.expectedDescription: You need an infiltrator's toolkit to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick Locks} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{Disable Devices} (of some types) using the Thievery skill.
items.description: 你需要渗透者工具包来用贼活技能@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]（部分类型）。

items.expectedDescription: These ubiquitous handheld computers incorporate a comm unit, microphone, speaker, camera, infosphere browser, and data storage. They can store thousands of hours of recordings, play games, and perform simple computing functions, such as time tracking and notifications, word processing, calculations, data processing, streaming media, and broadcasting emergency alerts from local governments. In most societies, commercial datapads are relatively flimsy, designed to rapidly wear out or fall behind on the latest features and updates to encourage the consumer to replace it with a newer model. In contrast, higher-end datapads are made to last and often include a sturdier chassis and extra functions.
items.description: 此类泛用手持计算机集成了通讯单元，麦克风，扬声器，摄像头，信息圈浏览器以及数据存储功能。其可以存储数千小时的记录，支持游玩游戏和执行简单的计算功能（如计时提醒，文本处理，计算，数据处理，流媒体以及当地政府的紧急广播）。在大多数社群里，商用型数据板相当脆弱，刻意设计以快速损坏或被最新的特性和更新淘汰，以此来刺激消费者置换更新的型号。相比之下，高端的数据板旨在长期使用，且通常包含更坚固的框架和额外功能。
items.name: 内置数据板（商用型）
内置黑客工具包（商用型）
items.expectedDescription: A hacking toolkit is required for Computers checks to Hack computers. You can use a hacking toolkit to access a computer without using a user interface, but this requires physical contact with the computer or contact via an infosphere or a similar linked network.
items.description: 骇入计算机的计算机检定需要使用黑客工具包。你可以使用黑客工具包来不通过用户界面访问计算机，但这需要与计算机进行物理接触，或通过信息圈或相似的链接网络进行连接。

items.name: 反应卸武
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature within the robot's reach attempts a melee or ranged Strike against the tax-class civil robot with a held weapon

Effect The robot uses its gasping hook to attempt to [[/act disarm]] the triggering creature's weapon with a +1 circumstance bonus to its check.
items.description:
触发 机器人触及范围内的一个生物用持握的武器尝试对税务级市政机器人进行近战或远程打击

效果 机器人用抓钩尝试[[/act disarm]]触发生物的武器，且此检定获得+1环境加值。

items.name: 征税员
items.expectedDescription: A tax-class civil robot can be placated by paying the fees, fines, or taxes it seeks to collect by offering the robot a credstick with an Interact action. If the robot takes a target's equipment (see repossession), it will count half the equipment's value toward the total tax owed. A creature can attempt a 3-action activity to fool the robot by Hacking it using a hacking toolkit and succeeding at a @Check[computers|dc:18] or Accounting Lore check. Programmed to accept many forms of payment, the robot takes a –2 penalty to AC and saving throws against actions that use a Computers check, such as the Combat Hack skill feat.
items.description: 通过交互动作向税务级市政机器人递上信用棒，支付其追讨的费用、罚款或税款，即可安抚它。如果机器人拿走目标的装备（见财产扣押），其会将装备价值的一半计入抵缴的应付税款。生物可以尝试一项3动作活动，使用黑客工具包骇入机器人，并成功通过一次@Check[computers|dc:18]或财会学识检定，来欺骗机器人。由于机器人被编程为接受多种付款方式，对抗使用计算机检定的行动（例如战斗骇入技能专长）时，其AC和豁免受到–2减值。

items.name: 财产扣押
items.expectedDescription: When a tax-class civil robot succeeds at a check to [[/act steal]] or critically succeeds at a check to [[/act disarm]] an item, it immediately picks up the item (if necessary) and stows it in a lockbox in the robot's frame. The robot can open the lockbox with a single Interact action without difficulty, but others must Pick the Lock (DC 18); a creature that attempts to do so while the tax-class civil robot is aware takes a –4 circumstance penalty to the check.
items.description: 税务级市政机器人对一件物品的[[/act steal]]检定成功，或[[/act disarm]]检定大成功时，会立即拾起该物品（若有必要），并将其存放在机身内的保险箱中。机器人可以用一个交互动作轻松打开保险箱，但其他生物必须开锁（DC 18）；若税务级市政机器人察觉到此事，尝试开锁的生物在检定上承受–4环境减值。

mbVSG7ZN6OsxmODd.publicNotes:
税务级机器人征收员专门追踪尚有款项未付清的债务人，并通过持续骚扰迫使其偿还欠款。阿巴达尔集团是首个应用该技术的实体，至今仍拥有、运营并出租协约世界内多数税务级机器人。该公司会从每笔还款中抽取分成，并监控机器人以确保交易合法——这一操作既增强了这些设备在公众眼中的合法性，也让被机器人当众追讨的债务人倍感羞辱。通常情况下，只要债务人支付一小部分欠款（通常足以覆盖滞纳金、罚款及调用机器人提醒服务的成本），机器人便会离开；这类机器人常被视为虽无大碍却令人难堪的麻烦，债务人往往直接支付少量费用让其撤离，避免进一步纠纷。而由高利贷业者改装的机器人则通常会与其它催收人员一同行动，并被编程设定为全额追讨欠款。

市政机器人几乎遍布任何大型聚居地，由当地政府部署使用。它们的主要职责并非维护治安，而是执行一些基础性工作，例如收集垃圾、为市民提供信息咨询或征收税款。不过，若有必要，它们仍具备抵御破坏分子的自卫能力。

n0Ez5gOBW85915bX.name: 轰杀级刺客机器人 Demolition-Class Assassin Robot

items.name: 内置破障枪
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This snub-nosed scattergun is commonly used to blast through doors and walls. Smaller than a reaction breacher, this scattergun is infamous for its mighty recoil.
items.description:
强化： 1

这把短枪管霰弹枪常被用来轰开门和墙壁。它比反应破门枪更小，却以猛烈的反冲而臭名昭著。

items.expectedName: Integrated tools appropriate for disguise shell

自毁协议
items.expectedDescription: The circuitry of an assassin robot self-destructs upon the robot's destruction, making tracing its owner extremely difficult. Add 10 to the DC of a Computers check to recover data from a destroyed assassin robot.
items.description: 当刺客机器人被摧毁时，其电路系统将自动触发自毁程序，这使得追踪其所有者变得极其困难。从被摧毁的刺客机器人中恢复数据时，计算机检定的DC需额外增加10点。

items.name: 突击
items.expectedDescription: The demolition-class assassin robot attempts to close the distance between it and its target, removing all obstacles in its way. The robot makes a ranged Strike with its breaching gun against the Force Open DC of a door or other obstacle. If successful, the obstacle gains the broken condition. The robot then Strides twice toward (and even through) the obstacle, but if the obstacle still bars the robot's movement, it stops adjacent to the obstacle and attempts an Athletics check to [[/act force-open]] the obstacle with a +4 circumstance bonus.
items.description: 轰杀级刺客机器人试图拉近自身与目标的距离，清除沿途的一切障碍。机器人用破障枪进行一次远程打击，对抗一扇门或其他障碍的破拆DC。成功时，障碍获得破损状态。随后机器人朝障碍行走两次（甚至穿过障碍），但若障碍仍阻挡机器人的移动，它便停在障碍旁边，尝试一次运动检定来[[/act force-open]]障碍，且该检定获得+4环境加值。

items.name: 伪装外壳
items.expectedDescription: The demolition-class assassin robot enters or leaves its disguised form. While in its disguised form, it loses the ability to make Strikes or use its Breaching Rush ability, but it becomes indistinguishable from a noncombatant robot or drone model that it's based on; it gets an automatic result of 33 on Deception checks and DCs to pass as a robot of that model. Damage to the robot can prevent this disguise from being effective at the GM's discretion.
items.description: 轰杀级刺客机器人可启动或解除伪装形态。处于伪装形态时，它将失去打击和突击能力的效果，但与它所伪装的非战斗机器人或无人机型号没有分别；在伪装成该型号机器人时，他的欺骗检定结果和欺骗DC自动取33点。在GM的裁定下 ，对刺客机器人造成伤害可能使它的伪装失效。

items.name: 偷袭
items.expectedDescription: The demolition-class assassin robot's Strikes deal an additional 2d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.
items.description: 轰杀级刺客机器人的打击对@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}生物额外造成2d6精准伤害。

items.name: 目标锁定
items.expectedDescription: The demolition-class assassin robot establishes a target lock on a creature it can see within 120 feet. The creature can't become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} against the robot or [[/act create-a-diversion]] against the robot. This ability lasts until the robot loses line of sight with the target or the target otherwise becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}.
items.description: 轰杀级刺客机器人锁定120尺内一个它能看见的生物。该生物无法对机器人处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}状态，也不能对机器人[[/act create-a-diversion]]。此能力持续生效，直到机器人失去对目标的视线，或目标以其他方式陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{藏匿}。

n0Ez5gOBW85915bX.publicNotes:
这类机器人因极端暴力与攻击性倾向得名，但其任务初始阶段仍以隐秘渗透为首要原则。从外观上看，它们覆有与工业、市政、家用机器人或无人机相似的外壳，以遮掩真实本质。

一旦锁定目标，它们便不再顾及隐蔽——这些杀戮机器会从隐藏面板中弹出武器与传感组件，以全速冲向目标。凭借其数据库中收录的、关于绝大多数门扉应力点与应急释放机制的海量信息，唯有最坚固的屏障才能长时间将它们阻挡在外。

在一些社会中，机器将许多流程自动化。因此，有人试图让谋杀也自动化，似乎顺理成章。大多数制造商绝不会承认曾创造过这种设计，富有的人物只得通过隐秘渠道，从秘密设施或不择手段的制造商手中获取这些机体。无论来源如何，都可以为这些机器人设定目标，再放任它们行动；主人确信，要么目标会死去，要么机器人烧毁的电路会使目标无法证明是谁企图杀害自己。

n59Z1WQjP1RXebSM.name: 漂流尸崩溃者 Driftdead Crasher

items.name: 虚空低语
items.expectedDescription:
The target hears ominous sounds containing unspeakable mysteries from beyond the stars that disorient its mind. The target attempts a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The target hears the strange whispers, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target begins to wander aimlessly, using each action to Step in a random direction. When it moves, the target takes the safest route and doesn't enter hazardous terrain. The spell has a duration of 1 minute or until a creature uses a hostile action against the target.

Critical Failure As failure, except the target babbles incoherently. Any creature that begins its turn within 20 feet of the target must attempt a Will saving throw. On a failure, it must use its first action on its next turn to Step in a random direction and becomes immune to this spell for 24 hours. This is an incapacitation effect.
items.description:
目标听见来自群星之外的不祥声响，其中蕴含不可言说的奥秘，令它心智迷乱。目标尝试意志豁免。

大成功 生物不受影响。

成功 目标听到奇怪的低语，陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞1}，持续1轮。

失败 目标开始漫无目的地游荡，每个动作都会向一个随机方向快步。目标移动时会选择最安全的路线，且不会进入危险地形。此法术持续1分钟，或直到有生物对目标采取敌意动作。

大失败 如同失败，但目标还会语无伦次地呓语。任何在目标20尺内开始回合的生物都必须尝试意志豁免。失败时，它必须用下个回合的第一个动作向随机方向快步，然后对此法术免疫24小时。这是失能效果。

items.name: 黑暗术
items.expectedDescription:
You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.
items.description:
你创造一片黑暗的帷幕，光线无法穿透，并且光源无法在区域中发光。光线无法进入该区域，并且任何非魔法光源，例如火炬或者提灯，在区域中不会发出任何光线，即使其光照可能到达黑暗术之外也是如此。这也会压制等于或低于你的黑暗术环阶的魔法光亮。光线无法穿透，所以在区域中的生物无法看到外面。对于外面，这看起来如同一团纯粹黑暗的球。

升阶（4环） 即使具有黑暗视觉的生物（但不包括高等黑暗视觉）也几乎无法看穿这黑暗。它们透过黑暗看到的目标视为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。

items.name: 归乡梦
items.expectedDescription: You draw on a creature's thoughts of home and the comfort it finds in that concept, overwhelming the creature with wistful memories of whatever home means to it. The target must succeed at a Will save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by the memories.
items.description: 你汲取生物对家的思念，以及它在这个概念中找到的慰藉，用任何代表家的思念记忆淹没生物。目标必须成功进行意志豁免，否则就会因这些记忆进入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]。

items.name: 恐惧术
items.expectedDescription:
You plant fear in the target; it must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to five creatures.
items.description:
你将恐惧植入目标；它必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}。

失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}。

大失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 3}，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}，持续1轮。

升阶（3环） 你能以至多五个生物为目标。

items.name: 虚构幻术
items.expectedDescription:
You create a simple illusory sound or vision. A sound adds the auditory trait to the spell and the sound can't include intelligible words or elaborate music. A vision adds the visual trait, can be no larger than a 5-foot cube, and is clearly crude and undetailed if viewed from within 15 feet. When you Cast or Sustain the Spell, you can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion} with the illusion, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to your Deception check. If the attempt fails against a creature, that creature disbelieves the figment.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.2Hg3a06gZCSnUgSA]{Spell Effect: Figment}
items.description:
你创造出简单的声音或图像的幻术。声音会为法术添加听觉特征，且不能包含能被理解的单词或复杂的音乐。图像会为法术添加视觉特征，但是它不能大于5尺边长的立方体，且在15尺的距离内观察会发现它的构造明显很粗糙且缺乏细节。当你施放或维持该法术时，你能尝试用幻术让人@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{分神}，这会为你的欺骗检定提供+2环境加值。若对某个生物进行的此尝试失败了，该生物便识破虚构幻术。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.2Hg3a06gZCSnUgSA]{法术效果：虚构幻术}

items.name: 冻伤术
items.expectedDescription:
An orb of biting cold coalesces around your target, freezing its body. The target takes 2d4 cold damage with a basic Fortitude save. On a critical failure, the target also gains weakness 1 to bludgeoning until the start of your next turn.

n59Z1WQjP1RXebSM.publicNotes:
虽然大部分漂流尸都是寄居于自身遗体的精魂，但有些灵魂死亡时会被从躯壳中弹出。这些恶灵绝望地挣扎着，试图回到自己的躯体中，沿着他们支离破碎的记忆在没有目的地的道路上前行——而那些与之相遇的生者就有难了。

崩溃者的名号并非来自创造了他们中不少成员的漂流崩溃（Drift Crash）——他们是因惯于附身星际飞船并将其引向碰撞航线而得此称号。若被困在附身飞船的乘客未能生还，这些牺牲者便可能自我扭曲成新的崩溃者，而非前往来世。

当不得安息的灵魂与位面能量结合，将自己的遗体重新活化为令人不安的生命仿制品时，漂流尸便会诞生。偶尔，来自别处、饱受侵扰的诸多精魂会融合到一起，一同寄宿到一具遗体上。漂流域内发生的任何死亡都有可能诞下漂流尸，但那些在强烈情感浪潮中殒命的活物更容易发生这种蜕变。

一颗冰寒的黑暗球体在区域中爆发，对区域内生物造成8d10寒冷伤害，并对活物额外造成8d4虚能伤害。区域中的每个生物都必须尝试反射豁免。

若球体与魔法光照区域重叠，或影响到正受到魔法光照影响的生物，噬星爆发会尝试反制该光照效果。

items.name: 宇宙调谐
items.expectedDescription:
The cosmic dragon is always attuned to an underlying stellar force: either photons or gravitons. The dragon's melee Strikes deal an additional @Damage[2d6[fire]] damage while they're photon-attuned and an additional @Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]] damage plus Knockdown while they're graviton-attuned. The damage of their cosmic blast Strike is likewise determined by their current attunement, as are the effects of some of their other abilities. The dragon can always sense the distance and direction to the nearest Drift beacon and to the Starstone on Absalom Station.

neRhNGqn4SL5bV8u.name: 月巨人 Moon Giant
neRhNGqn4SL5bV8u.publicNotes:
月巨人是体型最大的类人生物之一，站立时约24尺高。他们的体重随所在地而差异很大，因为他们的质量会随环绕当前位置的卫星天体数量增加而增长，但这种特性似乎从未影响过他们的行动能力。月巨人们大多冷静且性情平和，但月相变化与天象异变极易影响其情绪，任何接近者都应先观测星象。这些巨人常担任先知，接受朝圣者的馈赠或祭品以换取服务。

巨人是有着许多种类的庞大类人生物，遍布整个星系。

items.name: 阳炎爆
items.expectedDescription:
A powerful globe of searing sunlight explodes in the area, dealing 8d10 fire damage to all creatures in the area, plus an additional @Damage[(@item.level+1)d10[vitality]] damage to undead creatures. Each creature in the area must attempt a Reflex save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes full damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} permanently.

If the globe overlaps with an area of magical darkness, sunburst attempts to counteract the darkness effect.

Heightened (+1) The fire damage increases by 1d10, and the vitality damage against undead increases by 1d10.
items.description:
强力而耀眼的球状日光在区域中爆开，对该区域中的生物造成8d10火焰伤害，以及对不死生物造成额外@Damage[(@item.level+1)d10[vitality]]伤害。在该区域中的每个生物必须尝试一次反射豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物承受一半伤害。

失败 该生物承受完整伤害。

大失败 该生物承受完整伤害，并且永久 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲} 。

如果阳炎爆的球状区域与魔法黑暗的区域部分重叠，则会尝试反制该黑暗效果。

升阶（+1） 该火焰伤害增加1d10，并且对不死生物的命能伤害增加1d10。

items.name: 虚空淹没
items.expectedDescription:
A well of desolate darkness scours all life, dealing 10d10 void damage to all living creatures in the area. Each creature in the area must attempt a Reflex save. If void scour overlaps with an area of magical light or affects a creature affected by magical light, void scour attempts to counteract the light effect.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and @Damage[(@item.rank - 6)d6[persistent,void]] damage, and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and @Damage[(@item.rank - 5)d6[persistent,void]] damage, and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2}.

Heightened (+1) Increase the initial void damage by 2d10. The persistent void damage increases by 1d6 on a failure, or by 2d6 on critical failure.
items.description:
一口荒寂的黑暗深井涤荡一切生命，对区域内所有活物造成10d10虚能伤害。区域内每个生物必须尝试一次反射豁免。如果虚空淹没与魔法光亮区域重叠，或影响了受到魔法光亮影响的生物，虚空淹没会尝试抵消该光亮效果。

大成功 生物不受影响。

成功 生物受到一半伤害。

失败 生物受到全额伤害及@Damage[(@item.rank - 6)d6[persistent,void]]伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失1}。

大失败 生物受到双倍伤害及@Damage[(@item.rank - 5)d6[persistent,void]]伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失2}。

升阶（+1） 初始虚能伤害增加2d10。失败时的持续虚能伤害增加1d6，大失败时则增加2d6。

items.name: 口袋真空
items.expectedDescription:
You create a sudden vacuum, forcing creatures in the area to hold their breath or fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} and start suffocating. The explosive decompression deals 5d12 bludgeoning damage to each creature in the area when the spell is cast or that enters the area during the duration (unless they were already in a vacuum), with a basic Fortitude save. Creatures who critically fail the save are also knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d12.
items.description:
你会突然制造出真空状态，迫使周围的生物屏住呼吸，否则就会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]并开始窒息。施法时或在法术持续时间内进入该区域的生物都会受到突然减压造成的5d12钝击伤害（除非他们原本就处于真空状态），这需要一次基础强韧豁免。豁免大失败的生物会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]。

升阶 （+1） 伤害增加1d12。

items.name: 精神质询
items.expectedDescription:
You cast your thoughts through a creature's mind, sifting for information. You access the target's memories and knowledge unless it fends you off with a Will save.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure Each round of the spell's duration, you can Sustain the spell to ask a different question and attempt to uncover the answer. For each question, the target can attempt a Deception check against your spell DC; if the target succeeds, you don't learn the answer, and on a critical success, the target gives you a false answer that you believe is truthful Once you've asked the target a given question, asking it again, even with a separate casting of mind probe, produces the same result.

Critical Failure As failure, and the target takes a –4 circumstance penalty to Deception checks against your questions.
items.description:
你将你的精神投射入一个生物的精神以寻找信息。除非其成功通过意志豁免抵挡你，否则你可以获得目标的记忆与知识。

成功 目标不受影响。

失败 法术持续时间的每一轮中，你可以维持该法术来询问一个不同的问题，并尝试发现答案。对于每个问题，目标可以尝试一次欺骗检定，对抗你的法术DC；如果目标成功，你不会得知答案，并且当大成功时，目标会提供给你一个假的答案，并且你信以为真。在你向目标提问过一个问题后，再次提问该问题，即使通过另一次施放的精神质询，也会得到相同的结果。

大失败 如同失败，并且目标在对抗你的问题的欺骗检定上承受-4环境减值。

items.name: 警示波动
items.expectedDescription:

The psychic energy then arcs to another creature within 30 feet of the first target, jumps to another creature within 30 feet of that target, and so on. You can end the wave at any point. You can't target the same creature more than once, and you must have line of effect to all targets. Roll the damage only once, and apply it to each target (halving or doubling as appropriate for its saving throw outcome).

Critical Success The target creature is unaffected, and the wave ends with that target.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

失败 目标受到全部伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧1}。

o2xzZ0oc6TgctS90.publicNotes:
虚化蜥蜴，这些来自浩界偏远行星的可怕生物，虽体型相对较小，却令人联想到史前巨兽。这些行动迟缓的四足动物，以爬行动物特征和骨质外骨骼为标志，唤起了人们对远古巨兽的神秘恐惧。其偏居的缘由不言自明，多数异种生物学家认为，这种生物的凝视能引发其他物种的精神痛苦，使得在虚化蜥蜴领地附近定居成为艰巨挑战。当虚化蜥蜴出现在已建立的社区附近时，往往会引发残酷的猎杀行动。

这种生物凭借标志性的虚空凝视能力，引发了对其血统的诸多猜测。某些理论认为，虚化蜥蜴的祖先拥有更强大的凝视攻击，因此在通晓失落格拉利昂古老传说的人群中，它们被冠以“虚空蛇怪”（void basilisks）之名。更有有趣的假说指出，数千年前，嗜毁之神吞噬者的邪教徒或许曾通过选择性繁育出首批虚化蜥蜴，这事件发生于大断层之前。

尽管久负威名，虚化蜥蜴仍被用作吞噬者教派基地的守卫，甚至成为拥抱宇宙混沌之人的宠物。有趣的是，当它们被戴上眼罩、面纱或其他能使其凝视失效的装置时，虚化蜥蜴便变得温顺无害——这种驯化在各种文化鲜有尝试。

虚化蜥蜴以极少食物维生，每日仅进食一次，摄取肉类、果实、菌类或任何可得的植物。其生理系统至今仍是科学家研究课题，理论涵盖超高效代谢至吸收宇宙辐射，如同树木光合作用吸收阳光。边缘学说提出，虚化蜥蜴或许仅靠弥漫整个星系的奥术能量维生，这挑战着科学认知的边界。

oKJ6AOaajqt8RqrX.name: 金肤怪（飞船窃贼） Alloid (Ship Stealer)
oKJ6AOaajqt8RqrX.publicNotes:
金肤怪是黑色支配者派来祸害星系的星际拾荒者。这些高挑、瘦长的生物有着光滑的皮肤，表面似乎泛着金属光泽，通常呈铜色或金色。金肤怪的身体结构柔韧得惊人，能塑造形体以钻进狭窄空间，或摊得像纸一样薄，贴附在表面。据说，只要付出很大努力，它们甚至能模仿其他人。

虽然遇到过金肤怪的人还不够多，这个名字尚未真正流传开来，但在协约世界，它们已被俗称为“飞船窃贼”（ship stealers）。它们经常三到五个结群，在太空港徘徊，物色潜在目标。它们常寻找船员数量比自身小群规模多不了多少的小船，或拥有许多藏身处的大船，然后通常趁补给时，躲进容器或背包偷偷登船。

飞船进入太空、船员安顿下来后，这些金肤怪便会行动。最理想的做法是用毒刺逐个制服目标，使猎物的血肉变得与它们自身一样可塑，便于藏匿身体。绑架船员后，它们会把飞船开到可以与其他金肤怪——或它们的支配者主人——会合的地方，将星舰拆解成零件。它们如何处置活着的猎物，至今无人知晓。

大断层之前，黑色支配者在奥克腾拥有强大势力，偶尔会入侵其他星球，例如失落的格拉利昂，寻找可以吞食的大脑，并执行其他神秘计划。如今，协约世界的居民明白，支配者在星系各处设有秘密基地——协约世界或许时不时会吸引它们的注意，但它们的任务遍及众多世界和恒星系。

外人最常见到的支配者生物只是斥候，支配者共同体中更强大的成员仅偶尔现身，给社会带来恐怖。关于这些生物的故事，就像能从这类遭遇中幸存的人数一样寥寥无几——大多数太空旅行者都知道，一旦发现舰船或领地有支配者存在的迹象，就应立即逃离。

ofuvxmY6FRhRUb6i.name: 古宿主龙 Host Dragon (Ancient)
ofuvxmY6FRhRUb6i.publicNotes: 无论这些行动迟缓、贪食的巨龙漫游至何处，都有数不胜数的昆虫尾随其后，它们在宿主龙周围蜂拥而至，栖息于宿主龙身体上无数的孔洞之中。宿主龙既是虫群本身的一部分，也是虫群生态的一部分——虫群以它们的身体为食，而龙又以虫群为食；在这一可怖且延续数百年的循环中，即便宿主龙一生未曾摄取任何其他物质，也仍会不断变得更加庞大、更加强大。宿主龙从昆虫的原始本能中汲取力量，尽管它们拥有智慧，却常常表现得像那些聚集在它们身边的昆虫一样。宿主龙厌恶回答问题，并会以激烈手段抗拒他人对其本性的任何探究。

oilbk9sgGQC0u0um.name: 惑心小魔怪 Gnackle
oilbk9sgGQC0u0um.publicNotes:
许多不幸遭遇惑心小魔怪的可怜人往往为时已晚才惊觉。这些小魔怪沉迷于观看其他生物遭受屈辱性失败，常耗费数周甚至更长时间精心挑选并培养受害者，最终引诱其走向自我毁灭。他们先通过读取目标心灵，探知对方最渴望的事物，继而以魔法伪装成仙女教母或类似的愿望实现者，诱使受害者相信自己肩负伟大使命。他们送上神奇“礼物”，不断怂恿目标追求更宏大的野心。然而当小魔怪认定受害者陷入足够狼狈或危险的境地时，便会将这份馈赠扭曲成可怕的诅咒。

早在大断层之前很久，小魔怪便以残忍的诡计肆虐物质宇宙，如今它们已完全适应了科技充斥的星系。无论是扰乱通讯装置，星舰，还是整座空间站，小魔怪都乐此不疲地制造毁灭与混乱。

Success You find out whether the target's Intelligence modifier is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Failure You perceive vague surface thoughts from the target when you Cast the Spell, and you find out whether its Intelligence is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3Ktyd5F9lOPo4myk]{Spell Effect: Illusory Disguise}
items.description:
你创造幻象，使目标看起来像另一种体态相同的生物，身高差距在6英寸内，体重差距在50磅内。该伪装通常足以掩盖它的身份，但不足以让目标假扮另一个特定个人。该法术会改变它的外观和声音，但不会改变仪态。你可以改变其穿着和佩带的物品，例如让它的护甲看起来像是连衣裙。持握的物品不受影响，并且穿戴的物品离开该生物时会回复其本来外观。

施放幻象伪装视为欺骗技能的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{乔装}的设立伪装；这忽视任何目标可能会从扮作外形不同的生物中获得的环境减值，并且会赋予目标在避免他人看破它的伪装的欺骗检定上+4状态加值，并且即使目标未受训也加上它的等级。你可以解消该法术。

升阶（3环） 目标可以伪装成与其体型相同的任何生物，甚至是特定个人。你必须曾见过特定个人，才能重现其外观，并且要听过它的声音，才能重现其声音。

升阶（4环） 你能以至多10个自愿生物为目标。如果你以多个生物为目标，你可以为每个目标指定不同的伪装，但都不能伪装成特定个人。你可以单独解消每个伪装，或者一起解消。

升阶（7环） 如同4环阶，但是你可以伪装成特定个人。你必须曾见过特定个人，才能重现其外观，并且要听过它的声音，才能重现其声音。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3Ktyd5F9lOPo4myk]{法术效果：幻象伪装}

ooZMSCAd3OyfyXOe.name: 相位兽 Nyssholora
ooZMSCAd3OyfyXOe.publicNotes:
成年相位兽仅在交配和抚育新孵化的幼崽时结伴成对，在此期间它们会将领地边界视为共享区域——其余时间它们极具领地意识。

相位兽是凶残至极的恐龙形生物，堪称卡斯卓韦行星上最危险、最令人畏惧的顶级掠食者。这些行走的武器拥有致命的生理构造：巨口内排列着双排锋利如剃刀的牙齿，镰刀般锋利的相位刃前肢能以超声波速度振动，笞鞭状的尾巴则能吸收周围大气中的电能。并且相位兽还狡黠敏锐——头顶的触须头冠能感知心灵感应信号，令当地的弗米蚁族与拉申塔人无处遁形。它们的相位刃能如切割灌木般轻易撕裂墙壁与载具，确保猎物无处可逃。

items.description: （原能） 相位兽能感知拥有心灵感应，有限心灵感应或类似能力的所有生物，例如秘术师的纽带，作为一种具有所列范围的模糊感官。此感官能够穿透墙壁和其他障碍物。

p87ZL2JDCT0nuhrP.name: 生物科技巨人 Biotech Giant
p87ZL2JDCT0nuhrP.publicNotes:
漫长的岁月里，这些巨人穿越星海寻找家园。当他们在浩界探索潜在的新家园时，却被一种奇异的真菌侵袭，这种真菌吞噬他们所触及的一切。巨人的体型使他们免于立即灭亡，但大多数人只能眼睁睁看着菌丝的蓝绿色触须覆盖他们的新家园。绝望中，巨人倾尽所有资源投入科学研究，试图根除真菌。然而他们最终学会了适应。巨人们开始与真菌共生，将其嫁接到皮肤上，融入自身科技中。如今，这些巨人以科学家和生态系统守护者的身份探索星系。虽然他们大多为其他物种提供科学专长，但一个名为“孢子行者”（sporerunners）的冒险家群体正日益壮大，他们深入星系最危险的区域，踏上寻找他们称之为家的行星的征程。

巨人是有着许多种类的庞大类人生物，遍布整个星系。

items.name: 电化菌丝
items.expectedDescription: 10 feet. At the beginning of their turn, while the biotech giant is in contact with the ground, they can extend fungal tendrils from their body, starting as a 10-foot aura and increasing or decreasing by an additional 5 feet per turn as the giant wishes at the start of their turn. Any creature entering or starting its turn in the aura takes @Damage[5d8[electricity]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:28|basic|options:area-effect] save). When the giant Steps or Strides, they end their current aura and leave behind fungal ground cover in those spaces, starting a new aura at the beginning of their next turn.
items.description: 10尺。在生物科技巨人的回合开始时，如果其接触地面，便可以从身体中伸出真菌触须，形成初始范围10尺的灵光；此后每个回合开始时，可以按巨人的意愿额外增加或减少5尺。任何进入灵光或在灵光内开始回合的生物受到@Damage[5d8[electricity]|options:area-damage]伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:28|basic|options:area-effect]豁免）。巨人快步或行走时，会结束当前灵光，在这些空间内留下真菌地表覆盖层，并在其下一回合开始时形成新的灵光。

items.name: 真菌地表覆盖层
items.expectedDescription: Any creature that starts its turn in an area of fungal ground cover must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:26|options:area-effect,damaging-effect] save or take @Damage[3d8[electricity]|options:area-damage] damage. This area is also difficult terrain for creatures other than biotech giants and fungus. Any amount of fire damage automatically destroys a square of fungal ground cover.
items.description: 任何在真菌地表覆盖层区域内开始回合的生物，都必须成功通过@Check[reflex|dc:26|options:area-effect,damaging-effect]豁免，否则受到@Damage[3d8[electricity]|options:area-damage]伤害。对于生物科技巨人与真菌以外的生物，该区域同时也是困难地形。任何数值的火焰伤害都会自动摧毁一格真菌地表覆盖层。

items.name: 菌丝覆写
items.expectedDescription: When the biotech giant Strikes a creature with their mycelial whip or spore cannon, they leave some of the fungus behind, which immediately attempts to graft itself onto the targeted creature. The affected creature must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:28] save; on a failure, its implanted augmentations that count toward its implant limit cease to function for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.
items.description: 生物科技巨人用菌丝鞭或孢子炮对一个生物进行打击时，会留下一些真菌，这些真菌随即尝试将自身嫁接到目标生物身上。受影响的生物必须尝试@Check[fortitude|dc:28]豁免；失败时，其计入植入上限的已植入殖装会停止运作[[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4轮}。

items.expectedDescription:
You call in a favor from one demon of level 2 or lower, two demons of level 0 or lower, or three demons of level –1 or lower.

Critical Success You conjure the demon or demons. They are eager to pursue the task, so they don't ask for a favor.

Success You conjure the demon or demons. They are not eager to pursue the task, so they require a favor in return.

Failure You don't conjure any demons.

Critical Failure The demon or demons are angry that you disturbed them. They appear before you, but they immediately attack you.

Heightened (+1) Increase the level of demon you call by 2 for each option.

你能呼唤其他恶魔来帮忙，其等级为1个2级或更低等级的恶魔、2个0级或更低等级的恶魔、或者3个-1级或更低等级的恶魔。

大成功 你成功呼唤恶魔到来。它们渴望完成这项任务，因此不会寻求回报。

成功 你成功呼唤恶魔到来。它们并不渴望完成这项任务，因此会要求你提供回报。

失败 你没能呼唤任何恶魔。

大失败 恶魔因为你的打扰而愤怒。它们在你面前现身，但会立即对你发动攻击。

升阶（+1） 每个选项中你能呼唤的恶魔等级增加2级。

This sniper rifle breaks down into small parts, allowing its wielder to smuggle the weapon without attracting attention. Most assassin rifles are equipped with powerful scopes and digital sights.
items.description:

这把狙击步枪可以拆解成小型零件，让持用者能够在不引人注意的情况下夹带武器。大多数刺客步枪都配备了强力瞄准镜和数字瞄具。

items.name: 精神脆弱
items.expectedDescription: While a jygyk embodies remorseless vengeance, they can't fathom being attacked in kind. If a creature critically hits a jygyk who damaged it on the jygyk's previous turn, the jygyk takes @Damage[3d6[mental]] damage.
items.description: 恨念魔虽然体现着毫无悔意的复仇，却无法理解自己遭到同样的反击。若某个生物重击恨念魔，而恨念魔在自己的上一回合中曾伤害过该生物，恨念魔便受到@Damage[3d6[mental]]伤害。

items.name: 专家级神射手
items.expectedDescription: The jygyk doubles the range increment of weapons in the sniper weapon group they wield. If they're ever unarmed or out of ammunition, they can Interact to create an tactical weapon in the sniper weapon group or 30 projectiles.
items.description: 恨念魔在使用狙击武器组中的武器时，其武器的射程增量翻倍。如果恨念魔处于无武装或弹药耗尽的状态，它可以通过一次交互动作，制造出一件属于狙击武器组的战术型武器，或制造出 30 发射弹弹药。

items.name: 消逝无踪
items.expectedDescription: The jygyk melts into their surroundings and becomes undetected, not even emitting sound or odor. A creature must succeed at a @Check[perception|dc:25] check to [[/act seek]] the jygyk. If the jygyk uses a hostile action, moves, or speaks, they become detected again after the action is completed.
items.description: 恨念魔融入周围环境，变为无踪，甚至不发出声音或气味。生物必须通过@Check[perception|dc:25]检定，才能[[/act seek]]恨念魔。若恨念魔使用敌意动作、移动或说话，该动作完成后，它会重新被探知。

items.name: 精准瞄准
items.expectedDescription: The jygyk takes careful aim at a target. If the jygyk's next action is to make a ranged Strike with a weapon in the sniper weapon group, that Strike deals an additional weapon die of damage.
items.description: 恨念魔仔细瞄准一个目标。若恨念魔的下个动作是用狙击武器组的武器进行远程打击，该次打击会额外造成一个武器伤害骰的伤害。

items.name: 移位
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency once per round

Trigger The jygyk's last action was a ranged Strike

Effect The jygyk teleports to any location they can see within 25 feet.
items.description:
频率 每轮一次

触发 恨念魔的上个动作是远程打击

效果 恨念魔传送到25尺内它能看见的任意位置。

pTob7hduhssogZCI.publicNotes:
恨念魔是冷酷复仇的化身，它们会悄无声息地追踪凡人，并在极远距离外将其狙杀。三条腿赋予它们狙击时所需的绝对稳定性，而透镜般的双眼能侦测2里范围内的猎物。

恨念魔会对目标产生病态执念，甚至能同时对数十名凡人怀揣刻骨仇恨。一只新生的恨念魔可能首先猎杀生前憎恶之人，或按特定特征搜寻受害者。

恨念魔行动谨慎，通常会跟踪目标数周，记住其移动规律，留意其日常习惯，以找出理想的攻击时机与地点。近身战可能对它们造成灾难性后果，因此若被迫近距离交战，它们会优先逃离。

所有凡人生物死后，其灵魂通常会在骨园接受审判。而那些生前作恶多端者——尤其是通过伤害他人或极端自私行为玷污灵魂者——会被放逐至外层裂隙，最终在那里凝聚成恶魔。这些邪恶生物唯一渴求的，就是腐蚀凡间生灵的生命，以确保恶魔同类的队伍永不衰减。

pU3d9PLxRDE6HSsL.publicNotes:
穿界巨魔出现在强大魔法或宇宙现象撕裂时空结构的区域。他们或许源自另一个完全不同的现实，却发现自己被困在这个既令人困惑又充满美味猎物的宇宙中。

穿界巨魔通常身高约15尺，体重约1500磅。他们的皮肤呈苍白绿色且部分半透明，透出发光的紫色血管和内部畸形器官的阴影。每条肢体上都长着至多十二根锋利的玻璃状尖刺，巨魔能将其折断投掷。以这种方式折断的尖刺会在一小时内重新长出。

穿界巨魔似乎本能地理解巨人语，也能学习其他语言，但他们极少开口说话。一般而言，噪音似乎会令它们惊慌不安，战斗中它们往往会攻击噪音最大的生物，除非存在更严重的威胁。与普通巨魔不同，这些生物拥有有限范围的心灵感应能力，思维也较为复杂。然而，要接近到能与穿界巨魔进行心灵感应的距离，通常意味着站在其利爪可及之处，而鲜有人敢冒此风险。

在前大断层时代，巨魔以凶残的杀手著称，他们拥有再生血肉的能力，几乎能从任何伤势中恢复，并以毁灭性的暴力作出反击。在随后的几个世纪里，更令人毛骨悚然的巨魔物种从太空深处涌现。

pjh2PB4JwYlgMTwj.name: 蓝藻灵 Cyanoscum
pjh2PB4JwYlgMTwj.publicNotes:
这些木元素虽然有着啮齿动物的可爱外形，主体却不幸由能产生毒素的藻类组成。蓝藻灵能在任何温暖、潮湿的环境中繁盛生长。蓝藻灵形成的水华很容易发现：远看如同漂在静水上的蓝绿色草甸，或是一簇簇附着在植物与岩石上的绒状青绿色苔藓。被这壮丽景象打动的探险者，可能冒险靠近水边，或伸手触摸柔软鲜丽的苔藓，结果便与这些美丽却有毒的生物接触。

元素生物是原初位面侵入此间的能量化身。它们形态多样，既有风与水中无心智的涡流，也有能够运用原能魔法的复杂实体。太空旅行的兴起与科技的进步，使更多元素的活体化身得以在宇宙中显现。

山火、太阳风暴和洪水等自然事件，可能将大群难以驾驭的元素生物释放到行星或某片星域。有时，强大元素生物的聚集会引发规模惊人的自然灾难，例如烧毁行星电网的超强太阳耀斑，或是在气态巨行星大气中旋转不息的风暴。

qEtvjbS5IyBYjTMo.publicNotes:
贪食龙兽是龙兽中的一种异常变种，因为它们不具有喷吐式的吐息武器。贪食龙兽因其相对较小的体型和强大的吸气巨口而被培育成了几乎完全驯化的生物。边境殖民地与深空探索公司经常依赖贪食龙兽，而非猫科动物或其他害虫控制生物。

野外生活的贪食龙兽具有家族性且领地意识极强，经常成群结队地游荡。在被纳入到文明体系内或者与智慧物种结伴时，贪食龙兽的领地意识与家族性倾向则会表现为对其伙伴的真挚的忠诚纽带。

龙兽与它们那体型更为庞大的龙类表亲的相似之处，不仅仅体现在那布满鳞片的可怖外表上。从身材娇小的妖精龙兽到堪比星舰庞大的星辰龙兽，龙兽拥有着与龙类相似的带翼爬行类的形态、修长的颈部、以及吐息武器。但与通常同时拥有前肢和翅膀的龙类不同，龙兽一般只具备其中一种。然而，龙兽那蜿蜒的长尾与尖锐的颚齿也足够弥补这些不足了。

尽管比龙类更具兽性，但龙兽仍然拥有令人难以应付的狡诈，而且大多具备与龙类能力共通的某种形态的吐息武器。然而，较低的智力让龙兽远比其他龙类生物更易驯化，其群居天性又令它们成为了出色的团队猎手。

items.name: 预警术
items.expectedDescription:
You gain a sixth sense that warns you of danger that might befall the target of the spell. If you choose a creature other than yourself as the target, you create a psychic link through which you can inform the target of danger. This link is a mental effect. Due to the amount of information this spell requires you to process, you can't have more than one foresight spell in effect at a time. Casting foresight again ends the previous foresight. While foresight is in effect, the target gains a +2 status bonus to initiative rolls and isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} creatures or when flanked. In addition, you gain the following reaction: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VOEWhPQfN3lvHivK]{Foresight}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.X9Na6IK8FSPcTuoc]{Spell Effect: Foresight}
items.description:
你获得会警告你法术目标可能遭遇危险的第六感。若目标是自身以外的生物，你会与其建立心灵链接，通过链接告知其危险。此链接是心灵效应。由于此法术要求你处理大量信息，同一时间你只能有一个预警术生效。再次施放预警术会结束先前的预警术。预警术生效期间，目标的先攻掷骰获得+2状态加值，并且不会因以下情形陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}：面对@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{无踪}生物，或被夹击。此外，你获得以下反应：@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VOEWhPQfN3lvHivK]{预警术}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.X9Na6IK8FSPcTuoc]{法术效果：预警术}

items.name: 念动爆发
items.expectedDescription:
You launch a barrage of powerful psychokinetic energy that overpowers creatures, hurls objects, and deals damage. When you Cast this Spell and the first time each round you Sustain the spell, you can choose one of the following effects. You can't choose the same effect twice in a row.

  • Back Off! You hurl up to 15 objects or creatures up to 40 feet in any direction (including up or down). You can hurl up to a total weight of 40 Bulk per creature or object. Creatures take bludgeoning damage based on the distance they moved and land @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, as though they'd taken falling damage. Creatures that succeed on a Fortitude save against the spell avoid being moved.
  • Hard Rain You pummel all creatures in the area with debris and objects in the area, dealing 5d10 bludgeoning damage with a basic Reflex save.
  • Psychokinetic Slam Your psychokinetic storm slams into all creatures in the area. Make a ranged spell attack roll. All targets you hit take 7d6 force damage and are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.
items.description:
你发射一连串强大的精神能量，压倒生物、投掷物品并造成伤害。当你施放此法术时，以及每轮第一次维持此法术时，你可以选择以下效果之一。不能连续两次选择相同的效果。

  • 退开！你将至多15个物体或生物向任意方向（包括向上或向下）抛出至多40尺。你可以抛掷的每个生物或物体重量至多为40负载。生物根据移动距离受到钝击伤害，并在落地时@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}，如同受到坠落伤害。成功通过此法术强韧豁免的生物不会被移动。
  • 骤雨你以区域内的碎屑和物体猛击区域内所有生物，造成5d10钝击伤害，进行一次基础反射豁免。
  • 念动力猛击你的念动力风暴撞向区域内所有生物。进行一次远程法术攻击掷骰。所有被命中的目标受到7d6力场伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 1}。

items.name: 无影无踪
items.expectedDescription: You shroud a creature from others' senses. The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}, not just to sight but to all senses, allowing the target to count as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} no matter what precise and imprecise senses an observer might have. It's still possible for a creature to find the target by Seeking, looking for disturbed dust, hearing gaps in the sound spectrum, or finding some other way to discover the presence of an otherwise-undetectable creature.
items.description: 你使一个生物躲过其他生物的感官。目标变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{无踪}，不仅对视觉如此，对所有感官也是如此，使目标无论观察者拥有什么精确或模糊感官，都能视为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}。生物仍有可能通过搜索来找到目标，例如寻找被扰动的灰尘、听出声谱中的空缺，或用其他方法发现这个原本无法察觉的生物的存在。

items.name: 确知位置
items.expectedDescription: You learn the name of the target's exact location (including the building, community, and country) and plane of existence. You can target a creature only if you've seen it in person, have one of its significant belongings, or have a piece of its body, such as a lock of hair. To target an object, you must have touched it or have a fragment of it. Pinpoint automatically overcomes protections against detection of lower rank than this spell, even if they would normally have a chance to block it.
items.description: 你得知目标精确位置的名称（包括建筑、社区和国家）及其所在位面。若以生物为目标，你必须曾当面见过它，拥有它的一件重要物品，或拥有其身体的一部分，例如一缕头发。若以物体为目标，你必须曾触摸过它，或拥有其碎片。确知位置自动克服环阶低于本法术的反侦测防护，即使这些防护通常有机会阻挡此法术。

items.name: 跨界传送
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements You have a planar key for the destination plane, used as a locus

You and your allies traverse the barriers between planes of existence. The targets move to another plane, such as the Plane of Fire, the Netherworld, or the Outer Rifts. You must know the destination plane exists and use a magic planar key created from material from that plane as a locus for the spell. While the planar keys for most prominent planes are uncommon, just like the spell interplanar teleport, more obscure planes and demiplanes often have rare or possibly even unique planar keys.

The spell is highly imprecise, and you appear 1d20×25 miles from the last place one of the targets (of your choice) was located the last time that target traveled to the plane. If it's the first time traveling to a particular plane for all targets, you appear at a random location on the plane. Interplanar teleport doesn't provide a means of return travel, though casting interplanar teleport again allows you to return to your previous plane unless there are extenuating circumstances.
items.description:
需求 你持有目的地位面的位面密钥，用作施法载体

你和你的盟友跨越位面之间的屏障进行旅行。目标移动至其他位面，比如火元素位面、幽界、或者外层裂隙。你必须知晓目标位面的存在，而且需要使用由该位面的物质制作的魔法位面密钥作为本法术的施法载体。就如同跨界传送这个法术本身一样，大多数著名位面的位面密钥具有罕见稀有度，而鲜为人知的位面及半位面通常具有稀有、甚至有可能具有独特稀有度的位面密钥。

该法术极其不精准，你会出现在目标之一（由你选择）上一次造访该位面时的位置周边，误差为1d20×25里。若所有目标都是初次造访某个特定位面，你们就会出现在该位面的随机位置。跨界传送不会提供返回的手段，不过除非发生了什么另外情况，否则再次施放跨界传送能让你返回自身之前身处的位面。

items.name: 次元封固
items.expectedDescription: You create a visible magical barrier that attempts to counteract teleportation effects and planar travel into or out of the area, including items that allow access to extradimensional spaces. Planar seal tries to counteract any attempt to summon a creature into the area but doesn't stop the creature from departing when the summoning ends.
items.description: 你创造出一道可见的魔法屏障，试图反制进入或离开法术区域的传送效果以及位面旅行，这也包括允许使用异次元空间的物体。次元封固会尝试反制在区域内召唤生物的任何尝试，但是不会阻止召唤结束时这些生物的离去。

items.name: 回溯过去
items.expectedDescription:
Opening your mind to mental echoes, you gain impressions from past events that occurred in your current location. Retrocognition reveals psychic impressions from events that occurred over the course of the last day throughout the first minute of the duration, followed by impressions from the next day back the next minute, and so on. These echoes don't play out like a vision but instead reveal impressions of emotions and metaphors that provide cryptic clues and details of the past. If you witness a traumatic or turbulent event through an impression, the spell ends unless you succeed at a Will save with a DC of at least 30 and possibly as much as 50, depending on the severity of the event. The GM determines whether an event is traumatic and chooses the DC.

Heightened (8th) You gain impressions of events that occurred over the previous year for each minute you concentrate, instead of the previous day, though the details diminish, making it harder to distinguish impressions from all but the most major events.

Heightened (9th) You gain impressions of events that occurred over the previous century for each minute you concentrate, instead of the previous day, though the details diminish, making it almost impossible to distinguish impressions from all but the most major events.
items.description:
你敞开心灵接纳心灵回响，获得当前位置过去发生事件的印象。在持续时间的第一分钟内，回溯过去揭示过去一天内事件的心灵印象；下一分钟揭示再往前一天的印象，依此类推。这些回响不会像影像一样重现，而是以情绪与隐喻的印象，提供有关过去的晦涩线索与细节。若你通过印象见证了创伤性或动荡的事件，法术便会结束，除非你成功通过一次意志豁免，DC至少30，并可能根据事件的严重程度高达50。GM决定事件是否具有创伤性，并选择DC。

升阶（8环） 你每专注一分钟，便获得前一年而非前一天内事件的印象，但细节减少，除最重大的事件外，其余印象都更难辨别。

升阶（9环） 你每专注一分钟，便获得前一个世纪而非前一天内事件的印象，但细节减少，除最重大的事件外，其余印象几乎无法辨别。

items.name: 失智术
items.expectedDescription:
You drastically reduce the target's mental faculties. The target must attempt a Will save. The effects of this curse can be removed only through effects that target curses.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 4} with an unlimited duration.

Critical Failure The target's intellect is permanently reduced below that of an animal, and it treats its Charisma, Intelligence, and Wisdom modifiers as –5. It loses all class abilities that require mental faculties, including all spellcasting. If the target is a PC, they become an NPC under the GM's control.
items.description:
你大幅缩减了目标的精神能力。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。该诅咒仅能被以诅咒为目标的效果移除。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 2}，持续1轮。

失败 目标@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 4}，持续时间为无限。

大失败 目标的智能被永久降低到比动物更低的水平，它的魅力，智力以及感知调整值视为-5。它失去所有需要精神能力的职业能力，包括所有的施法能力。如果该目标为PC，它成为由GM控制的NPC。

items.name: 探知术
items.expectedDescription:
You magically spy on a creature of your choice. Scrying works like @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zvKWclOZ7A53DObE]{Clairvoyance}, except that the image you receive is less precise, insufficient for teleport and similar spells. Instead of creating an eye in a set location within 500 feet, you instead create an eye that manifests just above the target. You can choose a target either by name or by touching one of its possessions or a piece of its body. You can still wear and use your gear, which changes size (if necessary) to match your new form. If items leave your person, they return to their usual size.

If you want to Impersonate an individual, you still need to create a disguise, though the GM won't factor in the difference in ancestry when determining the DC of your Deception check.
